title: 高亮度 X 光束線
summary: 以 3 GeV 儲存環上的波盪器硬 X 光束線為例，說明光束線為何只能保存而不能增加亮度，並把掠射全反射鏡、前端熱負載、鏡面斜率誤差與量測、光束位置穩定度、Kirkpatrick–Baez 聚焦與通量校正串成一份可驗收的光束線工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Using an undulator hard X-ray beamline on a 3 GeV storage ring, the course shows why a beamline can only preserve and never increase brilliance, then links grazing-incidence mirrors, front-end heat load, mirror slope error and its metrology, beam-position stability, Kirkpatrick–Baez focusing and flux calibration into an acceptance-ready beamline engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: KB 奈米聚焦預算練習：E = 15 keV（λ ≈ 0.827 Å），垂直 KB 鏡長 L = 0.12 m、掠射角 θ = 3.5 mrad（低於 Rh 在 15 keV 的臨界角約 4.5 mrad），p = 50 m、q = 0.12 m。孔徑 A = L·θ = 0.42 mm，NA = A/(2q) = 1.75×10⁻³，繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) ≈ 20.8 nm；光源垂直 FWHM 12 µm 乘以 M = q/p = 2.4×10⁻³ 得 28.8 nm；斜率誤差 50 nrad rms 貢獻 2.355×2×50×10⁻⁹×0.12 ≈ 28.3 nm；鏡面俯仰振動 10 nrad rms 貢獻約 5.7 nm。平方和 √(20.8² + 28.8² + 28.3² + 5.7²) ≈ 45.7 nm FWHM。兩面 Rh 鏡各以反射率 0.85 計，傳輸約 72%。若斜率誤差放寬到 0.1 µrad，該項變為 56.5 nm，總光斑約 67 nm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際光束線規格。
workedExample.textEn: KB nanofocus budget exercise: E = 15 keV (λ ≈ 0.827 Å), vertical KB mirror length L = 0.12 m, grazing angle θ = 3.5 mrad (below the Rh critical angle of about 4.5 mrad at 15 keV), p = 50 m and q = 0.12 m. The aperture is A = L·θ = 0.42 mm, NA = A/(2q) = 1.75×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) ≈ 20.8 nm; a 12 µm FWHM vertical source times M = q/p = 2.4×10⁻³ gives 28.8 nm; 50 nrad rms slope error contributes 2.355×2×50×10⁻⁹×0.12 ≈ 28.3 nm; 10 nrad rms pitch vibration adds about 5.7 nm. The quadrature sum √(20.8² + 28.8² + 28.3² + 5.7²) ≈ 45.7 nm FWHM. Taking reflectivity 0.85 for each of the two Rh mirrors, transmission is about 72%. Relaxing slope error to 0.1 µrad makes that term 56.5 nm and the total spot about 67 nm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real beamline specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」與「全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance" and "Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「波盪器光源點與相空間」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Undulator source point and phase space” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 亮度定義為每秒、每平方毫米光源面積、每平方毫弧度發散角、每 0.1% 頻寬的光子數，衡量的是單位相空間體積內的光子密度。依 Liouville 定理，被動光學元件只能重新分配相空間而不能壓縮它：鏡子可以把光斑縮小，但發散角必然等比放大，任何像差、散射、振動或不匹配的孔徑都只會損失亮度。因此光束線設計的核心是讓每個元件的接收度與光源相空間匹配，並把亮度損失分配到可量化的項目。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波盪器光源點與相空間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Brilliance is photons per second per square millimetre of source area per square milliradian of divergence per 0.1% bandwidth, a measure of photon density in phase space. By Liouville's theorem passive optics can only redistribute phase space, never compress it: a mirror can shrink the spot but the divergence grows in proportion, and every aberration, scatter, vibration or mismatched aperture can only lose brilliance. The core of beamline design is therefore to match each element's acceptance to the source phase space and assign brilliance losses to quantifiable items. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Undulator source point and phase space”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光子的繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/(4π)，12.4 keV（λ ≈ 1 Å）時約 7.96 pm·rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The diffraction-limited photon emittance is ε_r = λ/(4π), about 7.96 pm·rad at 12.4 keV (λ ≈ 1 Å).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「波盪器光源點與相空間」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Undulator source point and phase space”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度
knowledge.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance
knowledge.text: 亮度定義為每秒、每平方毫米光源面積、每平方毫弧度發散角、每 0.1% 頻寬的光子數，衡量的是單位相空間體積內的光子密度。依 Liouville 定理，被動光學元件只能重新分配相空間而不能壓縮它：鏡子可以把光斑縮小，但發散角必然等比放大，任何像差、散射、振動或不匹配的孔徑都只會損失亮度。
knowledge.textEn: Brilliance is photons per second per square millimetre of source area per square milliradian of divergence per 0.1% bandwidth, a measure of photon density in phase space. By Liouville's theorem passive optics can only redistribute phase space, never compress it: a mirror can shrink the spot but the divergence grows in proportion, and every aberration, scatter, vibration or mismatched aperture can only lose brilliance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance" is correct?
options: 加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。
亮度定義為每秒、每平方毫米光源面積、每平方毫弧度發散角、每 0.1% 頻寬的光子數，衡量的是單位相空間體積內的光子密度。
X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。
optionsEn: Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself.
Brilliance is photons per second per square millimetre of source area per square milliradian of divergence per 0.1% bandwidth, a measure of photon density in phase space.
X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light.
quiz.explanation: 亮度定義為每秒、每平方毫米光源面積、每平方毫弧度發散角、每 0.1% 頻寬的光子數，衡量的是單位相空間體積內的光子密度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Brilliance is photons per second per square millimetre of source area per square milliradian of divergence per 0.1% bandwidth, a measure of photon density in phase space. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波盪器光源點與相空間」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Undulator source point and phase space” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光子的繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/(4π)，12.4 keV（λ ≈ 1 Å）時約 7.96 pm·rad。若電子束 ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad、ε_y = 16 pm·rad（假設 1% 耦合），各平面同調分率 ε_r/(ε + ε_r) 為 0.49% 與 33%，總同調分率約 0.16%，水平方向是瓶頸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The diffraction-limited photon emittance is ε_r = λ/(4π), about 7.96 pm·rad at 12.4 keV (λ ≈ 1 Å). For electron emittances ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad and ε_y = 16 pm·rad (1% coupling assumed), the per-plane coherent fraction ε_r/(ε + ε_r) is 0.49% and 33%, giving about 0.16% overall, with the horizontal plane as the bottleneck. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光源參數與光線追跡或波前傳播程式算出每個元件位置的光斑與發散，與元件的幾何接收度比較；試車時以狹縫掃描量測光源像大小與發散角，並用雙狹縫或光柵干涉量測同調長度，與 ε_r 的預測比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute spot and divergence at every element from the source parameters with ray-tracing or wavefront-propagation codes and compare them with each element's geometric acceptance; at commissioning measure source-image size and divergence with slit scans, and coherence length with double slits or grating interferometry, against the ε_r prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光子的繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/(4π)，12.4 keV（λ ≈ 1 Å）時約 7.96 pm·rad。若電子束 ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad、ε_y = 16 pm·rad（假設 1% 耦合），各平面同調分率 ε_r/(ε + ε_r) 為 0.49% 與 33%，總同調分率約 0.16%，水平方向是瓶頸。
knowledge.textEn: The diffraction-limited photon emittance is ε_r = λ/(4π), about 7.96 pm·rad at 12.4 keV (λ ≈ 1 Å). For electron emittances ε_x = 1.6 nm·rad and ε_y = 16 pm·rad (1% coupling assumed), the per-plane coherent fraction ε_r/(ε + ε_r) is 0.49% and 33%, giving about 0.16% overall, with the horizontal plane as the bottleneck.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 掠射角很小，所以鏡面誤差的影響也會被同樣縮小。
離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。
光子的繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/(4π)，12.4 keV（λ ≈ 1 Å）時約 7.96 pm·rad。
optionsEn: Because the grazing angle is small, mirror errors are scaled down by the same factor.
The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus.
The diffraction-limited photon emittance is ε_r = λ/(4π), about 7.96 pm·rad at 12.4 keV (λ ≈ 1 Å).
quiz.explanation: 光子的繞射極限發射度 ε_r = λ/(4π)，12.4 keV（λ ≈ 1 Å）時約 7.96 pm·rad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The diffraction-limited photon emittance is ε_r = λ/(4π), about 7.96 pm·rad at 12.4 keV (λ ≈ 1 Å). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「波盪器光源點與相空間」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Undulator source point and phase space” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以光源參數與光線追跡或波前傳播程式算出每個元件位置的光斑與發散，與元件的幾何接收度比較；試車時以狹縫掃描量測光源像大小與發散角，並用雙狹縫或光柵干涉量測同調長度，與 ε_r 的預測比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute spot and divergence at every element from the source parameters with ray-tracing or wavefront-propagation codes and compare them with each element's geometric acceptance; at commissioning measure source-image size and divergence with slit scans, and coherence length with double slits or grating interferometry, against the ε_r prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鏡子長度或狹縫開口與光源相空間不匹配時，邊緣光被截斷或帶著像差進入聚焦，樣品處通量與同調度同時低於預期，而每個元件單獨檢查都顯示合格。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When mirror length or slit opening does not match the source phase space, edge rays are clipped or enter the focus with aberration, so flux and coherence at the sample both fall short even though every element passes its individual check.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以光源參數與光線追跡或波前傳播程式算出每個元件位置的光斑與發散，與元件的幾何接收度比較；試車時以狹縫掃描量測光源像大小與發散角，並用雙狹縫或光柵干涉量測同調長度，與 ε_r 的預測比對。
knowledge.textEn: Compute spot and divergence at every element from the source parameters with ray-tracing or wavefront-propagation codes and compare them with each element's geometric acceptance; at commissioning measure source-image size and divergence with slit scans, and coherence length with double slits or grating interferometry, against the ε_r prediction.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「亮度、相空間與光束線接收度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance"?
options: 以光源參數與光線追跡或波前傳播程式算出每個元件位置的光斑與發散，與元件的幾何接收度比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。
optionsEn: Compute spot and divergence at every element from the source parameters with ray-tracing or wavefront-propagation codes and compare them with each element's geometric acceptance.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small.
quiz.explanation: 以光源參數與光線追跡或波前傳播程式算出每個元件位置的光斑與發散，與元件的幾何接收度比較；試車時以狹縫掃描量測光源像大小與發散角，並用雙狹縫或光柵干涉量測同調長度，與 ε_r 的預測比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute spot and divergence at every element from the source parameters with ray-tracing or wavefront-propagation codes and compare them with each element's geometric acceptance; at commissioning measure source-image size and divergence with slit scans, and coherence length with double slits or grating interferometry, against the ε_r prediction. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 亮度、相空間與光束線接收度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, phase space and beamline acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波盪器光源點與相空間」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Undulator source point and phase space” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鏡子長度或狹縫開口與光源相空間不匹配時，邊緣光被截斷或帶著像差進入聚焦，樣品處通量與同調度同時低於預期，而每個元件單獨檢查都顯示合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When mirror length or slit opening does not match the source phase space, edge rays are clipped or enter the focus with aberration, so flux and coherence at the sample both fall short even though every element passes its individual check. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此光束線設計的核心是讓每個元件的接收度與光源相空間匹配，並把亮度損失分配到可量化的項目。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The core of beamline design is therefore to match each element's acceptance to the source phase space and assign brilliance losses to quantifiable items.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: When mirror length or slit opening does not match the source phase space, edge rays are clipped or enter the focus with aberration, so flux and coherence at the sample both fall short even though every element passes its individual check.

steps.title: 全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「掠射鏡塗層條帶」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grazing-mirror coating stripes” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: X 光波段材料的折射率略小於 1，寫成 n = 1 − δ，因此光從真空以很小的掠射角入射時會發生全外反射。臨界角 θc = √(2δ)，而 δ 與材料電子密度及波長平方成正比，所以高密度塗層（Rh、Pt）能在較大角度或較高能量下反射，矽則較早截止。光束線利用這個能量截止：選擇塗層條帶與掠射角，讓所需能量完整反射，而單色器同時通過的三倍、五倍高次諧波被濾掉。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「掠射鏡塗層條帶」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At X-ray energies the refractive index is slightly below one, n = 1 − δ, so light arriving from vacuum at a very small grazing angle is totally externally reflected. The critical angle is θc = √(2δ), and δ scales with the material's electron density and with wavelength squared, so dense coatings such as Rh or Pt reflect at larger angles or higher energies while silicon cuts off earlier. Beamlines exploit this cut-off: choosing the coating stripe and grazing angle passes the wanted energy fully while rejecting the third and fifth harmonics that the monochromator also transmits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Grazing-mirror coating stripes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π)，以自由電子近似得 θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV（Si）與 ≈ 67 mrad·keV（Rh）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π); in the free-electron approximation θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV for Si and ≈ 67 mrad·keV for Rh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「掠射鏡塗層條帶」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Grazing-mirror coating stripes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The critical angle is θc = √(2δ), and δ scales with the material's electron density and with wavelength squared, so dense coatings such as Rh or Pt reflect at larger angles or higher energies while silicon cuts off earlier.

optionsEn: X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light.

steps.title: 全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「掠射鏡塗層條帶」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grazing-mirror coating stripes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π)，以自由電子近似得 θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV（Si）與 ≈ 67 mrad·keV（Rh）。掠射角 3 mrad 時，Si 條帶約在 10.4 keV 截止、Rh 條帶約在 22 keV 截止；要在 8 keV 工作並抑制 24 keV 的三次諧波，應選 Si 條帶或把 Rh 條帶角度提高到約 3.5 mrad 以上。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π); in the free-electron approximation θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV for Si and ≈ 67 mrad·keV for Rh. At 3 mrad grazing the Si stripe cuts off near 10.4 keV and the Rh stripe near 22 keV; to work at 8 keV while rejecting the 24 keV third harmonic, use the Si stripe or raise a Rh stripe above about 3.5 mrad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 CXRO 等公開光學常數計算各條帶在工作角度的反射率曲線（含異常色散修正）；在光束線上以單色器掃描能量，用游離腔或光二極體量測鏡前後通量比，並在三倍能量處用吸收濾片或能量鑑別偵測器確認諧波抑制比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute reflectivity curves for each stripe at the working angle from public optical constants such as CXRO, including anomalous-dispersion corrections; on the beamline scan energy with the monochromator, measure the flux ratio before and after the mirror with ion chambers or photodiodes, and confirm harmonic rejection at three times the energy with absorbers or an energy-resolving detector.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π)，以自由電子近似得 θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV（Si）與 ≈ 67 mrad·keV（Rh）。掠射角 3 mrad 時，Si 條帶約在 10.4 keV 截止、Rh 條帶約在 22 keV 截止；要在 8 keV 工作並抑制 24 keV 的三次諧波，應選 Si 條帶或把 Rh 條帶角度提高到約 3.5 mrad 以上。
knowledge.textEn: δ = r_e·λ²·n_e/(2π); in the free-electron approximation θc·E ≈ 31 mrad·keV for Si and ≈ 67 mrad·keV for Rh. At 3 mrad grazing the Si stripe cuts off near 10.4 keV and the Rh stripe near 22 keV; to work at 8 keV while rejecting the 24 keV third harmonic, use the Si stripe or raise a Rh stripe above about 3.5 mrad.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off", which statement holds?

With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small.

steps.title: 全外反射、臨界角與高次諧波截止：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total external reflection, critical angle and harmonic cut-off: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「掠射鏡塗層條帶」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Grazing-mirror coating stripes” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 CXRO 等公開光學常數計算各條帶在工作角度的反射率曲線（含異常色散修正）；在光束線上以單色器掃描能量，用游離腔或光二極體量測鏡前後通量比，並在三倍能量處用吸收濾片或能量鑑別偵測器確認諧波抑制比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute reflectivity curves for each stripe at the working angle from public optical constants such as CXRO, including anomalous-dispersion corrections; on the beamline scan energy with the monochromator, measure the flux ratio before and after the mirror with ion chambers or photodiodes, and confirm harmonic rejection at three times the energy with absorbers or an energy-resolving detector. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把鏡子停在錯誤的條帶或角度時，高次諧波穿過鏡子進入實驗站，吸收光譜出現偽訊號、繞射強度被錯誤歸一化，問題常在數據分析階段才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Parking the mirror on the wrong stripe or angle lets harmonics through to the experiment, producing spurious features in absorption spectra and wrong intensity normalisation in diffraction, often discovered only during data analysis.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 CXRO 等公開光學常數計算各條帶在工作角度的反射率曲線（含異常色散修正）；在光束線上以單色器掃描能量，用游離腔或光二極體量測鏡前後通量比，並在三倍能量處用吸收濾片或能量鑑別偵測器確認諧波抑制比。

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.instruction: 把鏡子停在錯誤的條帶或角度時，高次諧波穿過鏡子進入實驗站，吸收光譜出現偽訊號、繞射強度被錯誤歸一化，問題常在數據分析階段才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

quiz.explanationEn: Parking the mirror on the wrong stripe or angle lets harmonics through to the experiment, producing spurious features in absorption spectra and wrong intensity normalisation in diffraction, often discovered only during data analysis. stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載」與「斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Undulator power, front-end masks and heat load: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Front-end masks and first mirror” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波盪器送出的總功率是千瓦級，但實驗需要的單色光子功率只有毫瓦到瓦級，所以光束線前段的任務是安全地把多餘功率丟掉。前端區以水冷銅合金固定遮罩與可動狹縫限制角度範圍，濾片與第一面鏡進一步吸收低能與高能部分。第一個承受白光的光學元件會因局部溫度梯度產生熱鼓包，改變斜率與焦距；材料以 α/k（熱膨脹係數除以熱導率）衡量，矽冷卻到約 125 K 時熱膨脹係數趨近零，是高功率密度元件的常見解法。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The front end limits the angular range with water-cooled copper-alloy fixed masks and movable slits, and filters and the first mirror absorb further low- and high-energy power. The first optic to see white beam develops a thermal bump from local temperature gradients that alters slope and focal length; materials are ranked by α/k, expansion coefficient over conductivity, and silicon cooled to about 125 K, where its expansion coefficient approaches zero, is the usual answer for high power density. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Front-end masks and first mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：總功率 P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total power is P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undulator power, front-end masks and heat load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Front-end masks and first mirror” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：總功率 P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A]。E = 3 GeV、λu = 22 mm、K = 1.5（B0 = K/(0.934·λu[cm]) ≈ 0.73 T）、L = 3 m、I = 0.5 A，P ≈ 4.6 kW；而 12.8 keV（第 7 諧波）處 10¹⁴ ph/s 的光只攜帶約 0.2 W。α/k：室溫矽 ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W，Glidcop ≈ 4.5×10⁻⁸ m/W，室溫矽的熱變形約只有銅合金的四成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total power is P[kW] = 0.633·E²[GeV]·B0²[T]·L[m]·I[A]. For E = 3 GeV, λu = 22 mm, K = 1.5 (B0 = K/(0.934·λu[cm]) ≈ 0.73 T), L = 3 m and I = 0.5 A, P ≈ 4.6 kW, while 10¹⁴ ph/s at 12.8 keV (seventh harmonic) carries only about 0.2 W. α/k is ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W for room-temperature silicon and ≈ 4.5×10⁻⁸ m/W for Glidcop, so room-temperature silicon distorts only about 40% as much as the copper alloy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以功率密度分布計算程式算出各遮罩、濾片與鏡面的吸收功率，作為有限元素熱—結構分析的輸入，求出表面斜率變化；運轉時比較冷卻水量熱、元件熱電偶讀值與預測值，並在不同間隙與電流下量測焦點位置漂移，驗證熱變形模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute absorbed power on each mask, filter and mirror with a power-density code and feed it into finite-element thermal-structural analysis to obtain the surface slope change; in operation compare water calorimetry and thermocouple readings with prediction, and measure focal-position drift at different gaps and currents to validate the thermal-deformation model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

For E = 3 GeV, λu = 22 mm, K = 1.5 (B0 = K/(0.934·λu[cm]) ≈ 0.73 T), L = 3 m and I = 0.5 A, P ≈ 4.6 kW, while 10¹⁴ ph/s at 12.8 keV (seventh harmonic) carries only about 0.2 W. α/k is ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁸ m/W for room-temperature silicon and ≈ 4.5×10⁻⁸ m/W for Glidcop, so room-temperature silicon distorts only about 40% as much as the copper alloy.

quiz.question: 依「波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 波盪器功率、前端遮罩與熱負載：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undulator power, front-end masks and heat load: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「前端遮罩與第一面鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Front-end masks and first mirror” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以功率密度分布計算程式算出各遮罩、濾片與鏡面的吸收功率，作為有限元素熱—結構分析的輸入，求出表面斜率變化；運轉時比較冷卻水量熱、元件熱電偶讀值與預測值，並在不同間隙與電流下量測焦點位置漂移，驗證熱變形模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute absorbed power on each mask, filter and mirror with a power-density code and feed it into finite-element thermal-structural analysis to obtain the surface slope change; in operation compare water calorimetry and thermocouple readings with prediction, and measure focal-position drift at different gaps and currents to validate the thermal-deformation model. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：閉合波盪器間隙或提高儲存電流後，第一面鏡的熱鼓包使焦點沿光軸移動並放大光斑，使用者看到通量隨時間與間隙變化；若遮罩接收角估錯，射線直接照到未冷卻的法蘭，造成真空洩漏。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After closing the undulator gap or raising stored current, the thermal bump on the first mirror shifts the focus along the axis and enlarges the spot, so users see flux vary with time and gap; if a mask acceptance angle is wrong, radiation strikes an uncooled flange and causes a vacuum leak.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Slope error, roughness and mirror fabrication: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掠射鏡長達數百毫米，因為掠射角只有毫弧度，光斑在鏡面上被拉長數百倍。鏡面誤差依空間尺度分成兩類：毫米到全長尺度的斜率誤差使反射光偏折兩倍，在焦點處加寬光斑；微米以下的高頻粗糙度則把光散射出鏡面反射方向，降低反射率。現代鏡體以單晶矽製作，經確定性拋光、離子束修形或彈性發射加工把斜率誤差壓到 0.1 µrad 甚至 50 nrad 均方根以下。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grazing mirrors are hundreds of millimetres long because a milliradian grazing angle stretches the footprint hundreds of times. Surface errors fall into two classes by length scale: slope errors from millimetres to full length deflect the reflected ray by twice the error and broaden the focus, while sub-micrometre roughness scatters light out of the specular direction and lowers reflectivity. Modern blanks are single-crystal silicon brought to 0.1 µrad or even below 50 nrad RMS slope error by deterministic polishing, ion-beam figuring or elastic emission machining. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：斜率誤差造成的焦斑加寬 σ ≈ 2σ_s·q：σ_s = 0.1 µrad、焦距 q = 0.2 m 得 40 nm rms（約 94 nm FWHM）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Slope-error spot broadening is σ ≈ 2σ_s·q: σ_s = 0.1 µrad and a focal distance q = 0.2 m give 40 nm rms (about 94 nm FWHM).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「掠射角很小，所以鏡面誤差的影響也會被同樣縮小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because the grazing angle is small, mirror errors are scaled down by the same factor." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Grazing mirrors are hundreds of millimetres long because a milliradian grazing angle stretches the footprint hundreds of times. Surface errors fall into two classes by length scale: slope errors from millimetres to full length deflect the reflected ray by twice the error and broaden the focus, while sub-micrometre roughness scatters light out of the specular direction and lowers reflectivity.

steps.title: 斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slope error, roughness and mirror fabrication: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：斜率誤差造成的焦斑加寬 σ ≈ 2σ_s·q：σ_s = 0.1 µrad、焦距 q = 0.2 m 得 40 nm rms（約 94 nm FWHM）。粗糙度造成的反射率損失 1 − exp[−(4πσθ/λ)²]：σ = 0.3 nm、θ = 3 mrad、λ = 1 Å 時約 1.3%，σ = 1 nm 時升到約 13%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Slope-error spot broadening is σ ≈ 2σ_s·q: σ_s = 0.1 µrad and a focal distance q = 0.2 m give 40 nm rms (about 94 nm FWHM). Roughness costs reflectivity 1 − exp[−(4πσθ/λ)²]: about 1.3% for σ = 0.3 nm, θ = 3 mrad and λ = 1 Å, rising to about 13% for σ = 1 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製造過程中交替使用斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀量測，依每次量測的殘差規劃下一次修形停留時間；粗糙度以白光干涉與 AFM 在不同取樣長度量測並合成功率譜密度，確認各頻段 σ 都在預算內，再把量到的表面高度圖代入波前傳播模擬預測焦斑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During fabrication alternate slope profilometry and stitching interferometry, planning each figuring dwell map from the previous residual; measure roughness with white-light interferometry and AFM at several sampling lengths, merge them into a power spectral density, confirm each band's σ is in budget, and propagate the measured height map through a wavefront simulation to predict the focus.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 斜率誤差造成的焦斑加寬 σ ≈ 2σ_s·q：σ_s = 0.1 µrad、焦距 q = 0.2 m 得 40 nm rms（約 94 nm FWHM）。粗糙度造成的反射率損失 1 − exp[−(4πσθ/λ)²]：σ = 0.3 nm、θ = 3 mrad、λ = 1 Å 時約 1.3%，σ = 1 nm 時升到約 13%。
knowledge.textEn: Slope-error spot broadening is σ ≈ 2σ_s·q: σ_s = 0.1 µrad and a focal distance q = 0.2 m give 40 nm rms (about 94 nm FWHM). Roughness costs reflectivity 1 − exp[−(4πσθ/λ)²]: about 1.3% for σ = 0.3 nm, θ = 3 mrad and λ = 1 Å, rising to about 13% for σ = 1 nm.

steps.title: 斜率誤差、粗糙度與鏡面製造：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slope error, roughness and mirror fabrication: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「單晶矽鏡體與拋光面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Single-crystal silicon blank and polished surface” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 製造過程中交替使用斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀量測，依每次量測的殘差規劃下一次修形停留時間；粗糙度以白光干涉與 AFM 在不同取樣長度量測並合成功率譜密度，確認各頻段 σ 都在預算內，再把量到的表面高度圖代入波前傳播模擬預測焦斑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During fabrication alternate slope profilometry and stitching interferometry, planning each figuring dwell map from the previous residual; measure roughness with white-light interferometry and AFM at several sampling lengths, merge them into a power spectral density, confirm each band's σ is in budget, and propagate the measured height map through a wavefront simulation to predict the focus. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只要求全長 PV 高度而沒有規定斜率誤差與中頻譜段時，鏡面可能高度合格卻帶有數毫米週期的波紋，在焦點兩側產生衛星峰並破壞相干成像的條紋對比。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Specifying only full-length PV height without slope error and mid-frequency bands can yield a mirror that passes height yet carries millimetre-period ripple, creating satellite peaks beside the focus and destroying fringe contrast in coherent imaging.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.titleEn: Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鏡面斜率誤差小到 50 nrad 時，量測本身成為瓶頸：長程輪廓儀與奈米光學量測機以自準直儀或筆形光束量測斜率並積分成高度，拼接干涉儀則把多個子孔徑拼成全長高度圖。兩種方法的系統誤差來源不同，交叉比對才可信。鏡子裝上彎曲機構或冷卻夾具後形狀還會改變，因此最後要在光束線上以刀口掃描、斑點追蹤或光柵干涉直接量測 X 光波前，把離線數據與線上表現連起來。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When slope errors reach 50 nrad, metrology itself becomes the bottleneck: long trace profilers and nanometre optical component measuring machines measure slope with autocollimators or pencil beams and integrate it into height, while stitching interferometers combine sub-apertures into a full-length height map. The two have different systematic errors and must be cross-checked to be trusted. Mounting on a bender or cooled holder changes the shape again, so the final step measures the X-ray wavefront on the beamline by knife-edge scans, speckle tracking or grating interferometry, linking ex-situ data to in-situ performance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜率輪廓儀量到的高度圖就等於鏡子在光束線上的實際形狀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The profiler height map is exactly the mirror's shape on the beamline." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。L = 300 mm、Δs = 0.5 µrad 時 Δh ≈ 18.8 nm。若規格是 0.15 µrad rms，量測不確定度應低於其三分之一，約 50 nrad rms。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8. With L = 300 mm and Δs = 0.5 µrad, Δh ≈ 18.8 nm. If the specification is 0.15 µrad rms, measurement uncertainty should be below a third of it, about 50 nrad rms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差；把輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀的結果轉成同一取樣長度比較；線上以刀口在焦點前後掃描取得光斑剖面，與用量測高度圖做的波前傳播預測比較，差異應小於 10%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics; convert profiler and stitching-interferometer results to a common sampling length and compare; on the beamline scan a knife edge through and around focus to obtain spot profiles and compare with a wavefront-propagation prediction from the measured height map, expecting agreement within 10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。L = 300 mm、Δs = 0.5 µrad 時 Δh ≈ 18.8 nm。若規格是 0.15 µrad rms，量測不確定度應低於其三分之一，約 50 nrad rms。
knowledge.textEn: For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8. With L = 300 mm and Δs = 0.5 µrad, Δh ≈ 18.8 nm. If the specification is 0.15 µrad rms, measurement uncertainty should be below a third of it, about 50 nrad rms.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation", which statement holds?
options: 以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。
光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。
X 光鏡面反射率高是因為塗層像可見光鋁鏡一樣是好導體。
optionsEn: For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8.
Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second.
X-ray mirrors reflect well because the coating is a good conductor, like an aluminium mirror for visible light.
quiz.explanation: 以拋物線形誤差估計，全長 L 上的斜率峰谷 Δs 對應高度峰谷 Δh = Δs·L/8。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a parabolic error over length L, a slope peak-to-valley Δs corresponds to a height peak-to-valley Δh = Δs·L/8. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差；把輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀的結果轉成同一取樣長度比較；線上以刀口在焦點前後掃描取得光斑剖面，與用量測高度圖做的波前傳播預測比較，差異應小於 10%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics; convert profiler and stitching-interferometer results to a common sampling length and compare; on the beamline scan a knife edge through and around focus to obtain spot profiles and compare with a wavefront-propagation prediction from the measured height map, expecting agreement within 10%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres; without in-situ wavefront measurement one only sees a spot twice the expected size with no traceable cause.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差；把輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀的結果轉成同一取樣長度比較；線上以刀口在焦點前後掃描取得光斑剖面，與用量測高度圖做的波前傳播預測比較，差異應小於 10%。
knowledge.textEn: Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics; convert profiler and stitching-interferometer results to a common sampling length and compare; on the beamline scan a knife edge through and around focus to obtain spot profiles and compare with a wavefront-propagation prediction from the measured height map, expecting agreement within 10%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差。
光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics.
A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.
quiz.explanation: 以同一面參考平面鏡在輪廓儀上正反向各掃描一次並旋轉 180° 再量，分離儀器系統誤差；把輪廓儀與拼接干涉儀的結果轉成同一取樣長度比較；線上以刀口在焦點前後掃描取得光斑剖面，與用量測高度圖做的波前傳播預測比較，差異應小於 10%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan the same reference flat forward and backward and again after a 180° rotation to separate instrument systematics; convert profiler and stitching-interferometer results to a common sampling length and compare; on the beamline scan a knife edge through and around focus to obtain spot profiles and compare with a wavefront-propagation prediction from the measured height map, expecting agreement within 10%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜率輪廓儀與拼接干涉」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Slope profiler and stitching interferometry” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres; without in-situ wavefront measurement one only sees a spot twice the expected size with no traceable cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鏡子裝上彎曲機構或冷卻夾具後形狀還會改變，因此最後要在光束線上以刀口掃描、斑點追蹤或光柵干涉直接量測 X 光波前，把離線數據與線上表現連起來。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mounting on a bender or cooled holder changes the shape again, so the final step measures the X-ray wavefront on the beamline by knife-edge scans, speckle tracking or grating interferometry, linking ex-situ data to in-situ performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜率輪廓儀量到的高度圖就等於鏡子在光束線上的實際形狀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The profiler height map is exactly the mirror's shape on the beamline." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。
knowledge.textEn: A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres; without in-situ wavefront measurement one only sees a spot twice the expected size with no traceable cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鏡面離線量測與線上波前驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ex-situ mirror metrology and in-situ wavefront validation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。
實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus.
A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres.
quiz.explanation: 實驗室量測時鏡子以三點支撐，安裝到光束線卻以夾具固定，重力下垂與夾持應力造成數十奈米的形變；若沒有線上波前量測，只會看到光斑比預期大兩倍而找不到原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mirror measured on three-point support in the lab but clamped on the beamline sags under gravity and clamping stress by tens of nanometres; without in-situ wavefront measurement one only sees a spot twice the expected size with no traceable cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反射鏡的俯仰角改變 δ 會使反射光偏轉 2δ，而且偏轉被後方的長距離放大，所以鏡面的奈弧度級振動與熱漂移直接變成樣品處的光斑抖動。一般要求光斑位置的穩定度優於光斑尺寸的 10%。光束線用刀片式或鑽石四象限 X 光束位置監測器量測光束位置，再以壓電致動器回授鏡面或單色器角度；振動來源包括地板、冷卻水流、液氮沸騰與真空幫浦，必須用預算表逐項分配。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pitch change δ on a mirror deflects the reflected beam by 2δ, amplified by the long downstream lever arm, so nanoradian vibration and thermal drift of mirrors become spot jitter at the sample. The usual requirement is spot-position stability better than 10% of the spot size. Beamlines measure position with blade-type or diamond quadrant X-ray beam-position monitors and feed back to mirror or monochromator angles with piezo actuators; vibration sources include the floor, cooling-water flow, liquid-nitrogen boiling and vacuum pumps, and each must be allocated in a budget table. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算
knowledge.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget
knowledge.text: 反射鏡的俯仰角改變 δ 會使反射光偏轉 2δ，而且偏轉被後方的長距離放大，所以鏡面的奈弧度級振動與熱漂移直接變成樣品處的光斑抖動。一般要求光斑位置的穩定度優於光斑尺寸的 10%。
knowledge.textEn: A pitch change δ on a mirror deflects the reflected beam by 2δ, amplified by the long downstream lever arm, so nanoradian vibration and thermal drift of mirrors become spot jitter at the sample. The usual requirement is spot-position stability better than 10% of the spot size.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光束位置穩定度與振動預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Beam-position stability and the vibration budget" is correct?
options: 反射鏡的俯仰角改變 δ 會使反射光偏轉 2δ，而且偏轉被後方的長距離放大，所以鏡面的奈弧度級振動與熱漂移直接變成樣品處的光斑抖動。
離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。
只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。
optionsEn: A pitch change δ on a mirror deflects the reflected beam by 2δ, amplified by the long downstream lever arm, so nanoradian vibration and thermal drift of mirrors become spot jitter at the sample.
The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus.
With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small.
quiz.explanation: 反射鏡的俯仰角改變 δ 會使反射光偏轉 2δ，而且偏轉被後方的長距離放大，所以鏡面的奈弧度級振動與熱漂移直接變成樣品處的光斑抖動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A pitch change δ on a mirror deflects the reflected beam by 2δ, amplified by the long downstream lever arm, so nanoradian vibration and thermal drift of mirrors become spot jitter at the sample. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。距光源 30 m 的上游平面鏡俯仰 50 nrad 使虛光源移動 2δ×30 m = 3 µm，經縮小倍率 M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 後只移動 15 nm；對 100 nm 光斑，KB 的俯仰穩定度需優於約 17 nrad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm. A 50 nrad pitch on an upstream flat mirror 30 m from the source moves the virtual source by 2δ×30 m = 3 µm, which the demagnification M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 reduces to 15 nm; for a 100 nm spot the KB pitch must be stable to better than about 17 nrad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度；在樣品位置以快速相機或四象限偵測器記錄光斑位置頻譜，與各來源的預算比對，並逐一關閉冷卻水、幫浦或液氮供應找出主要貢獻者。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles; record the spot-position spectrum at the sample with a fast camera or quadrant detector, compare with each budgeted source, and switch off cooling water, pumps or liquid-nitrogen supply one at a time to identify the dominant contributor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。距光源 30 m 的上游平面鏡俯仰 50 nrad 使虛光源移動 2δ×30 m = 3 µm，經縮小倍率 M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 後只移動 15 nm；對 100 nm 光斑，KB 的俯仰穩定度需優於約 17 nrad。
knowledge.textEn: A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm. A 50 nrad pitch on an upstream flat mirror 30 m from the source moves the virtual source by 2δ×30 m = 3 µm, which the demagnification M = 0.3/60 = 1/200 reduces to 15 nm; for a 100 nm spot the KB pitch must be stable to better than about 17 nrad.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光束位置穩定度與振動預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Beam-position stability and the vibration budget", which statement holds?
options: 加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。
KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。
光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。
optionsEn: Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself.
A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm.
A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.
quiz.explanation: KB 鏡本身俯仰 50 nrad、焦距 q = 0.3 m 時焦點移動 2δ·q = 30 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 50 nrad pitch on the KB mirror itself with q = 0.3 m moves the focus by 2δ·q = 30 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度；在樣品位置以快速相機或四象限偵測器記錄光斑位置頻譜，與各來源的預算比對，並逐一關閉冷卻水、幫浦或液氮供應找出主要貢獻者。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles; record the spot-position spectrum at the sample with a fast camera or quadrant detector, compare with each budgeted source, and switch off cooling water, pumps or liquid-nitrogen supply one at a time to identify the dominant contributor. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊；若 X 光束位置監測器裝在熱不穩定的支架上，回授反而把支架漂移寫進光束。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images; if the X-ray BPM sits on a thermally unstable stand, the feedback writes the stand's drift into the beam.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度；在樣品位置以快速相機或四象限偵測器記錄光斑位置頻譜，與各來源的預算比對，並逐一關閉冷卻水、幫浦或液氮供應找出主要貢獻者。
knowledge.textEn: Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles; record the spot-position spectrum at the sample with a fast camera or quadrant detector, compare with each budgeted source, and switch off cooling water, pumps or liquid-nitrogen supply one at a time to identify the dominant contributor.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光束位置穩定度與振動預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam-position stability and the vibration budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
掠射角很小，所以鏡面誤差的影響也會被同樣縮小。
以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Because the grazing angle is small, mirror errors are scaled down by the same factor.
Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles.
quiz.explanation: 以加速度計與電容式位移感測器量測各鏡座的振動功率譜並積分成均方根角度；在樣品位置以快速相機或四象限偵測器記錄光斑位置頻譜，與各來源的預算比對，並逐一關閉冷卻水、幫浦或液氮供應找出主要貢獻者。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure vibration power spectra on each mirror mount with accelerometers and capacitive sensors and integrate them into RMS angles; record the spot-position spectrum at the sample with a fast camera or quadrant detector, compare with each budgeted source, and switch off cooling water, pumps or liquid-nitrogen supply one at a time to identify the dominant contributor. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光束位置穩定度與振動預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam-position stability and the vibration budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「X 光束位置監測器與鏡面俯仰」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “X-ray BPM and mirror pitch” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊；若 X 光束位置監測器裝在熱不穩定的支架上，回授反而把支架漂移寫進光束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images; if the X-ray BPM sits on a thermally unstable stand, the feedback writes the stand's drift into the beam. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：光束線用刀片式或鑽石四象限 X 光束位置監測器量測光束位置，再以壓電致動器回授鏡面或單色器角度；振動來源包括地板、冷卻水流、液氮沸騰與真空幫浦，必須用預算表逐項分配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beamlines measure position with blade-type or diamond quadrant X-ray beam-position monitors and feed back to mirror or monochromator angles with piezo actuators; vibration sources include the floor, cooling-water flow, liquid-nitrogen boiling and vacuum pumps, and each must be allocated in a budget table.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊；若 X 光束位置監測器裝在熱不穩定的支架上，回授反而把支架漂移寫進光束。
knowledge.textEn: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images; if the X-ray BPM sits on a thermally unstable stand, the feedback writes the stand's drift into the beam.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光束位置穩定度與振動預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam-position stability and the vibration budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。
optionsEn: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small.
quiz.explanation: 液氮冷卻單色器的沸騰振動在數十 Hz 處耦合到下游鏡座，奈米聚焦光斑在掃描成像時出現週期性條紋與模糊；若 X 光束位置監測器裝在熱不穩定的支架上，回授反而把支架漂移寫進光束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Boiling vibration from a liquid-nitrogen-cooled monochromator couples at tens of hertz into downstream mounts, putting periodic streaks and blur into nanofocus scanning images; if the X-ray BPM sits on a thermally unstable stand, the feedback writes the stand's drift into the beam. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源」與「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source" and "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Kirkpatrick–Baez 鏡組以兩面互相垂直的橢圓柱面掠射鏡分別聚焦垂直與水平方向，沒有色差，能在寬能量範圍內使用。焦斑由三項決定：光源大小乘以縮小倍率 q/p、鏡面孔徑造成的繞射極限、以及斜率誤差與振動。水平發射度大時，常在中段放置次級光源狹縫，把縮小倍率作用在狹縫開口上，以通量換取更小的光斑與更高的同調度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Kirkpatrick–Baez pair focuses vertically and horizontally with two orthogonal elliptical-cylinder grazing mirrors, free of chromatic aberration and usable over a wide energy range. The spot is set by three terms: source size times the demagnification q/p, the diffraction limit from the mirror aperture, and slope error plus vibration. When horizontal emittance is large, a secondary-source slit is placed mid-beamline so the demagnification acts on the slit opening, trading flux for a smaller spot and higher coherence. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鏡長 L = 0.1 m、θ = 3 mrad，孔徑 A = L·θ = 300 µm，q = 0.15 m 時 NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³，λ = 1 Å 的繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm；垂直光源 FWHM 11.8 µm 經 p = 60 m 縮小 1/400 得 29 nm，平方和約 53 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With mirror length L = 0.1 m and θ = 3 mrad the aperture is A = L·θ = 300 µm; at q = 0.15 m, NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM at λ = 1 Å is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm; an 11.8 µm FWHM vertical source demagnified 1/400 from p = 60 m gives 29 nm, about 53 nm in quadrature.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鏡長 L = 0.1 m、θ = 3 mrad，孔徑 A = L·θ = 300 µm，q = 0.15 m 時 NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³，λ = 1 Å 的繞射極限 FWHM ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm；垂直光源 FWHM 11.8 µm 經 p = 60 m 縮小 1/400 得 29 nm，平方和約 53 nm。水平以 20 µm 次級狹縫、距 KB 30 m、q = 0.3 m，幾何像約 0.2 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With mirror length L = 0.1 m and θ = 3 mrad the aperture is A = L·θ = 300 µm; at q = 0.15 m, NA ≈ A/(2q) = 1×10⁻³ and the diffraction-limited FWHM at λ = 1 Å is ≈ 0.88λ/(2NA) = 44 nm; an 11.8 µm FWHM vertical source demagnified 1/400 from p = 60 m gives 29 nm, about 53 nm in quadrature. Horizontally a 20 µm secondary slit 30 m upstream with q = 0.3 m images to about 0.2 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雷射或可見光自準直預對準後，在 X 光下逐一掃描每面鏡的俯仰與彎曲參數，使用刀口掃描取得焦斑並以多個軸向位置判斷像散與焦點位置；改變次級狹縫開口，記錄焦斑尺寸與通量的關係曲線，與幾何加繞射模型比較以確認最佳工作點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After pre-alignment with lasers or visible autocollimation, scan each mirror's pitch and bending parameters under X-rays, measure the spot by knife-edge scans and judge astigmatism and focal position from several axial positions; vary the secondary-slit opening, record spot size against flux, and compare with a geometric-plus-diffraction model to choose the operating point.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Horizontally a 20 µm secondary slit 30 m upstream with q = 0.3 m images to about 0.2 µm.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: KB focusing, the diffraction limit and the secondary source: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以雷射或可見光自準直預對準後，在 X 光下逐一掃描每面鏡的俯仰與彎曲參數，使用刀口掃描取得焦斑並以多個軸向位置判斷像散與焦點位置；改變次級狹縫開口，記錄焦斑尺寸與通量的關係曲線，與幾何加繞射模型比較以確認最佳工作點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After pre-alignment with lasers or visible autocollimation, scan each mirror's pitch and bending parameters under X-rays, measure the spot by knife-edge scans and judge astigmatism and focal position from several axial positions; vary the secondary-slit opening, record spot size against flux, and compare with a geometric-plus-diffraction model to choose the operating point. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：兩面鏡的焦點沒有落在同一平面時出現像散，樣品處光斑一邊銳利一邊模糊；次級狹縫的刀口品質不良或熱漂移時，狹縫本身成為不穩定的光源，奈米光斑隨之晃動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the two mirrors do not focus on the same plane the spot is astigmatic, sharp in one direction and blurred in the other; a poor or thermally drifting secondary-slit edge becomes an unstable source, and the nanofocus wanders with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以雷射或可見光自準直預對準後，在 X 光下逐一掃描每面鏡的俯仰與彎曲參數，使用刀口掃描取得焦斑並以多個軸向位置判斷像散與焦點位置；改變次級狹縫開口，記錄焦斑尺寸與通量的關係曲線，與幾何加繞射模型比較以確認最佳工作點。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: KB 聚焦、繞射極限與次級光源：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「KB 鏡組與次級光源狹縫」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “KB mirror pair and secondary-source slit” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 兩面鏡的焦點沒有落在同一平面時出現像散，樣品處光斑一邊銳利一邊模糊；次級狹縫的刀口品質不良或熱漂移時，狹縫本身成為不穩定的光源，奈米光斑隨之晃動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the two mirrors do not focus on the same plane the spot is astigmatic, sharp in one direction and blurred in the other; a poor or thermally drifting secondary-slit edge becomes an unstable source, and the nanofocus wanders with it. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When horizontal emittance is large, a secondary-source slit is placed mid-beamline so the demagnification acts on the slit opening, trading flux for a smaller spot and higher coherence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要縮小倍率夠大，KB 鏡的光斑可以無限縮小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With enough demagnification a KB spot can be made arbitrarily small." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
