steps.objective: 說明「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」如何決定高亮度 X 光束線的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “High-brilliance X-ray beamlines”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光束線交接要證明的是使用者在樣品處拿到的光子：能量範圍、通量、光斑尺寸、位置穩定度與諧波含量都必須以經校正的偵測器量化。通量通常用已知厚度的矽光二極體量測，光子在矽中每產生一對電子電洞平均需約 3.66 eV，再修正吸收比例；同時要與光源計算值比較，找出傳輸損失落在哪個元件。輻射屏蔽實驗站與聯鎖系統的驗證由輻射安全單位依法規執行，屬於交接文件的必要部分。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Beamline handoff must prove what users receive at the sample: energy range, flux, spot size, position stability and harmonic content, each quantified with calibrated detectors. Flux is usually measured with a silicon photodiode of known thickness, where each electron–hole pair costs about 3.66 eV on average, corrected for the absorbed fraction, and compared with the source calculation to locate where transmission is lost. Verification of the shielded hutch and its interlocks is performed by the radiation-safety group under regulation and is a required part of the handoff record. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff
knowledge.text: 光束線交接要證明的是使用者在樣品處拿到的光子：能量範圍、通量、光斑尺寸、位置穩定度與諧波含量都必須以經校正的偵測器量化。通量通常用已知厚度的矽光二極體量測，光子在矽中每產生一對電子電洞平均需約 3.66 eV，再修正吸收比例；同時要與光源計算值比較，找出傳輸損失落在哪個元件。
knowledge.textEn: Beamline handoff must prove what users receive at the sample: energy range, flux, spot size, position stability and harmonic content, each quantified with calibrated detectors. Flux is usually measured with a silicon photodiode of known thickness, where each electron–hole pair costs about 3.66 eV on average, corrected for the absorbed fraction, and compared with the source calculation to locate where transmission is lost.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff" is correct?
options: 光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。
加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。
光束線交接要證明的是使用者在樣品處拿到的光子：能量範圍、通量、光斑尺寸、位置穩定度與諧波含量都必須以經校正的偵測器量化。
optionsEn: Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second.
Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself.
Beamline handoff must prove what users receive at the sample: energy range, flux, spot size, position stability and harmonic content, each quantified with calibrated detectors.
quiz.explanation: 光束線交接要證明的是使用者在樣品處拿到的光子：能量範圍、通量、光斑尺寸、位置穩定度與諧波含量都必須以經校正的偵測器量化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Beamline handoff must prove what users receive at the sample: energy range, flux, spot size, position stability and harmonic content, each quantified with calibrated detectors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。光二極體電流 I = 0.5 mA、w = 3.66 eV、E = 12.4 keV、300 µm 矽在此能量的吸收比 η ≈ 0.70 時，N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s；若光源計算在同頻寬給出 3×10¹² ph/s，光束線傳輸約 44%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η). With photodiode current I = 0.5 mA, w = 3.66 eV, E = 12.4 keV and an absorbed fraction η ≈ 0.70 for 300 µm silicon at this energy, N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s; if the source calculation predicts 3×10¹² ph/s in the same bandwidth, beamline transmission is about 44%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線；以刀口掃描記錄焦斑、以快速相機記錄八小時以上的位置漂移，與規格表逐項比較，並把鏡面量測、熱分析、振動預算與諧波抑制數據彙整成交接報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy; record the focus by knife-edge scans and position drift over at least eight hours with a fast camera, compare item by item with the specification, and compile mirror metrology, thermal analysis, vibration budget and harmonic-rejection data into the handoff report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。光二極體電流 I = 0.5 mA、w = 3.66 eV、E = 12.4 keV、300 µm 矽在此能量的吸收比 η ≈ 0.70 時，N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s；若光源計算在同頻寬給出 3×10¹² ph/s，光束線傳輸約 44%。
knowledge.textEn: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η). With photodiode current I = 0.5 mA, w = 3.66 eV, E = 12.4 keV and an absorbed fraction η ≈ 0.70 for 300 µm silicon at this energy, N ≈ 0.5×10⁻³×3.66/(1.602×10⁻¹⁹×12 400×0.70) ≈ 1.3×10¹² ph/s; if the source calculation predicts 3×10¹² ph/s in the same bandwidth, beamline transmission is about 44%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。
光束線只要讓所需的光通過就好，總功率不是光學問題。
斜率輪廓儀量到的高度圖就等於鏡子在光束線上的實際形狀。
optionsEn: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η).
A beamline only needs to pass the wanted light; total power is not an optics problem.
The profiler height map is exactly the mirror's shape on the beamline.
quiz.explanation: 光子通量 N = I·w/(e·E·η)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Photon flux is N = I·w/(e·E·η). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線；以刀口掃描記錄焦斑、以快速相機記錄八小時以上的位置漂移，與規格表逐項比較，並把鏡面量測、熱分析、振動預算與諧波抑制數據彙整成交接報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy; record the focus by knife-edge scans and position drift over at least eight hours with a fast camera, compare item by item with the specification, and compile mirror metrology, thermal analysis, vibration budget and harmonic-rejection data into the handoff report. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降；交接報告若缺少能量相依的傳輸曲線，日後碳污染累積時就沒有基準可比。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination; a handoff report lacking an energy-dependent transmission curve leaves no baseline when carbon contamination later builds up.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線；以刀口掃描記錄焦斑、以快速相機記錄八小時以上的位置漂移，與規格表逐項比較，並把鏡面量測、熱分析、振動預算與諧波抑制數據彙整成交接報告。
knowledge.textEn: Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy; record the focus by knife-edge scans and position drift over at least eight hours with a fast camera, compare item by item with the specification, and compile mirror metrology, thermal analysis, vibration budget and harmonic-rejection data into the handoff report.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線。
離樣品越遠的鏡子，振動造成的焦點移動一定越大。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy.
The farther a mirror sits from the sample, the more its vibration must move the focus.
quiz.explanation: 以標準實驗室校正過的光二極體或游離腔作為參考，在多個能量點量測通量並畫出傳輸率隨能量的曲線；以刀口掃描記錄焦斑、以快速相機記錄八小時以上的位置漂移，與規格表逐項比較，並把鏡面量測、熱分析、振動預算與諧波抑制數據彙整成交接報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a photodiode or ion chamber calibrated against a standards laboratory as reference, measure flux at several energies and plot transmission against energy; record the focus by knife-edge scans and position drift over at least eight hours with a fast camera, compare item by item with the specification, and compile mirror metrology, thermal analysis, vibration budget and harmonic-rejection data into the handoff report. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光二極體通量計與驗收紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Photodiode flux meter and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降；交接報告若缺少能量相依的傳輸曲線，日後碳污染累積時就沒有基準可比。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination; a handoff report lacking an energy-dependent transmission curve leaves no baseline when carbon contamination later builds up. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：輻射屏蔽實驗站與聯鎖系統的驗證由輻射安全單位依法規執行，屬於交接文件的必要部分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Verification of the shielded hutch and its interlocks is performed by the radiation-safety group under regulation and is a required part of the handoff record.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光二極體電流直接等於每秒到達的光子數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Photodiode current directly equals the number of photons arriving per second." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降；交接報告若缺少能量相依的傳輸曲線，日後碳污染累積時就沒有基準可比。
knowledge.textEn: Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination; a handoff report lacking an energy-dependent transmission curve leaves no baseline when carbon contamination later builds up.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試車驗收：通量、光斑、穩定度與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Commissioning acceptance: flux, spot, stability and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
加一組聚焦鏡可以讓光束線的亮度高過光源本身。
用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Adding focusing mirrors can make the beamline brighter than the source itself.
Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination.
quiz.explanation: 用未校正或飽和的光二極體量通量，會把高通量下的非線性誤判為光束線損失，或反過來掩蓋鏡面污染造成的反射率下降；交接報告若缺少能量相依的傳輸曲線，日後碳污染累積時就沒有基準可比。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measuring flux with an uncalibrated or saturated photodiode mistakes high-flux nonlinearity for beamline loss, or conversely hides reflectivity loss from mirror contamination; a handoff report lacking an energy-dependent transmission curve leaves no baseline when carbon contamination later builds up. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 中子散射儀
summary: 從中子的德布羅意波長與毫電子伏特能量出發，說明反應爐與散裂源如何經緩速器產生熱與冷中子，再把超鏡導管、斬波器飛行時間、三軸譜儀的單色器與分析器、³He 偵測器效率、釩標準歸一化與背景計數統計整合成一份可驗收的中子散射儀工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Starting from the de Broglie wavelength and millielectronvolt energy of neutrons, the course shows how reactors and spallation sources produce thermal and cold neutrons through moderators, then integrates supermirror guides, chopper time of flight, triple-axis monochromators and analysers, ³He detector efficiency, vanadium normalisation and background counting statistics into an acceptance-ready neutron-scattering instrument record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 冷中子飛行時間能譜練習：入射波長 λi = 4 Å，vi = 3956/4 = 989 m/s，Ei = 81.81/16 ≈ 5.11 meV。樣品到偵測器 L2 = 3.0 m，彈性中子飛行時間 t2 = 3.0/989 ≈ 3.033 ms。若中子在樣品激發 ħω = 1.0 meV 的激發，Ef ≈ 4.11 meV，λf = √(81.81/4.11) ≈ 4.46 Å，vf ≈ 887 m/s，t2 ≈ 3.382 ms，比彈性晚約 0.349 ms。彈性能量解析度 ΔE/E ≈ 2Δt/t2，取等效時間不確定 Δt = 15 µs，ΔE/E ≈ 0.99%，ΔE ≈ 51 µeV。若源頻率 60 Hz、源到偵測器總路徑 23 m，4 Å 中子總飛行 23.26 ms 已超過 16.67 ms 框架，帶寬斬波器必須把波長範圍限制在約 3956/(60×23) ≈ 2.87 Å 以內。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際儀器規格。
workedExample.textEn: Cold-neutron time-of-flight exercise: incident wavelength λi = 4 Å gives vi = 3956/4 = 989 m/s and Ei = 81.81/16 ≈ 5.11 meV. With sample-to-detector distance L2 = 3.0 m the elastic flight time is t2 = 3.0/989 ≈ 3.033 ms. If the neutron creates a ħω = 1.0 meV excitation in the sample, Ef ≈ 4.11 meV, λf = √(81.81/4.11) ≈ 4.46 Å, vf ≈ 887 m/s and t2 ≈ 3.382 ms, arriving about 0.349 ms after the elastic line. The elastic energy resolution is ΔE/E ≈ 2Δt/t2; taking an effective timing uncertainty Δt = 15 µs gives ΔE/E ≈ 0.99% and ΔE ≈ 51 µeV. At a 60 Hz source with a 23 m total source-to-detector path, a 4 Å neutron takes 23.26 ms, longer than the 16.67 ms frame, so the bandwidth choppers must restrict the band to about 3956/(60×23) ≈ 2.87 Å. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「中子波長、速度與能量換算」與「散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion" and "Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熱中子與冷中子能譜」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中子不帶電，能穿透數公分金屬到達樣品內部，並經由短程核力與原子核散射；它還帶有磁矩，能直接感受未成對電子的磁結構。散射長度隨同位素不規則變化，氫與氘的差異讓軟物質可以做對比變換。熱中子的波長約 1 到 2 Å，與原子間距相當，能量約數十 meV，與聲子和磁激發相當，所以同一束中子能同時量結構與動力學，這是中子散射儀存在的物理理由。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱中子與冷中子能譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neutrons are uncharged, penetrate centimetres of metal to reach the bulk of a sample, and scatter from nuclei through the short-range nuclear force; they also carry a magnetic moment that senses unpaired-electron magnetism directly. Scattering lengths vary irregularly between isotopes, and the hydrogen–deuterium difference allows contrast variation in soft matter. Thermal neutrons have wavelengths of about 1 to 2 Å, comparable to interatomic spacings, and energies of tens of meV, comparable to phonons and magnetic excitations, so one beam probes structure and dynamics together, which is the physical reason neutron-scattering instruments exist. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s] and E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]. λ = 1.798 Å corresponds to v ≈ 2200 m/s and E ≈ 25.3 meV (room-temperature thermal neutrons); a 4 Å cold neutron has v = 989 m/s and E ≈ 5.11 meV; λ = 1 Å gives E ≈ 81.8 meV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熱中子與冷中子能譜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算
knowledge.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion
knowledge.text: 中子不帶電，能穿透數公分金屬到達樣品內部，並經由短程核力與原子核散射；它還帶有磁矩，能直接感受未成對電子的磁結構。散射長度隨同位素不規則變化，氫與氘的差異讓軟物質可以做對比變換。
knowledge.textEn: Neutrons are uncharged, penetrate centimetres of metal to reach the bulk of a sample, and scatter from nuclei through the short-range nuclear force; they also carry a magnetic moment that senses unpaired-electron magnetism directly. Scattering lengths vary irregularly between isotopes, and the hydrogen–deuterium difference allows contrast variation in soft matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「中子波長、速度與能量換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion" is correct?
options: 原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。
中子不帶電，能穿透數公分金屬到達樣品內部，並經由短程核力與原子核散射；它還帶有磁矩，能直接感受未成對電子的磁結構。
只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。
optionsEn: Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly.
Neutrons are uncharged, penetrate centimetres of metal to reach the bulk of a sample, and scatter from nuclei through the short-range nuclear force.
With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q.
quiz.explanation: 中子不帶電，能穿透數公分金屬到達樣品內部，並經由短程核力與原子核散射；它還帶有磁矩，能直接感受未成對電子的磁結構。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Neutrons are uncharged, penetrate centimetres of metal to reach the bulk of a sample, and scatter from nuclei through the short-range nuclear force; they also carry a magnetic moment that senses unpaired-electron magnetism directly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱中子與冷中子能譜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s]，E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]。λ = 1.798 Å 對應 v ≈ 2200 m/s、E ≈ 25.3 meV（室溫熱中子）；λ = 4 Å 的冷中子 v = 989 m/s、E ≈ 5.11 meV；λ = 1 Å 則 E ≈ 81.8 meV。波長加倍，速度減半而能量降為四分之一。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s] and E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]. λ = 1.798 Å corresponds to v ≈ 2200 m/s and E ≈ 25.3 meV (room-temperature thermal neutrons); a 4 Å cold neutron has v = 989 m/s and E ≈ 5.11 meV; λ = 1 Å gives E ≈ 81.8 meV. Doubling the wavelength halves the speed and quarters the energy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知晶格常數的標準粉末（例如矽）量測布拉格峰位置反推入射波長，並與飛行時間量得的速度換算結果比較；兩者差異應在 0.1% 以內，否則要檢查飛行距離量測或單色器角度零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure Bragg-peak positions of a standard powder with known lattice constant, such as silicon, to infer the incident wavelength, and compare it with the value converted from a time-of-flight velocity measurement; they should agree within 0.1%, otherwise check the flight-path survey or the monochromator angle zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s]，E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]。λ = 1.798 Å 對應 v ≈ 2200 m/s、E ≈ 25.3 meV（室溫熱中子）；λ = 4 Å 的冷中子 v = 989 m/s、E ≈ 5.11 meV；λ = 1 Å 則 E ≈ 81.8 meV。波長加倍，速度減半而能量降為四分之一。
knowledge.textEn: λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s] and E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]. λ = 1.798 Å corresponds to v ≈ 2200 m/s and E ≈ 25.3 meV (room-temperature thermal neutrons); a 4 Å cold neutron has v = 989 m/s and E ≈ 5.11 meV; λ = 1 Å gives E ≈ 81.8 meV. Doubling the wavelength halves the speed and quarters the energy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「中子波長、速度與能量換算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion", which statement holds?
options: m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。
中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。
optionsEn: A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle.
A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength.
λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s] and E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]. λ = 1.798 Å corresponds to v ≈ 2200 m/s and E ≈ 25.3 meV (room-temperature thermal neutrons).
quiz.explanation: λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s]，E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: λ[Å] = 3956/v[m/s] and E[meV] = 81.81/λ²[Å]. λ = 1.798 Å corresponds to v ≈ 2200 m/s and E ≈ 25.3 meV (room-temperature thermal neutrons); a 4 Å cold neutron has v = 989 m/s and E ≈ 5.11 meV; λ = 1 Å gives E ≈ 81.8 meV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「熱中子與冷中子能譜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知晶格常數的標準粉末（例如矽）量測布拉格峰位置反推入射波長，並與飛行時間量得的速度換算結果比較；兩者差異應在 0.1% 以內，否則要檢查飛行距離量測或單色器角度零點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure Bragg-peak positions of a standard powder with known lattice constant, such as silicon, to infer the incident wavelength, and compare it with the value converted from a time-of-flight velocity measurement; they should agree within 0.1%, otherwise check the flight-path survey or the monochromator angle zero. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Carrying over X-ray habits while ignoring neutron sensitivity to light elements and isotopes misjudges sample scattering and absorption; for example a sample holder containing natural boron or cadmium absorbs most cold neutrons and the signal nearly vanishes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知晶格常數的標準粉末（例如矽）量測布拉格峰位置反推入射波長，並與飛行時間量得的速度換算結果比較；兩者差異應在 0.1% 以內，否則要檢查飛行距離量測或單色器角度零點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure Bragg-peak positions of a standard powder with known lattice constant, such as silicon, to infer the incident wavelength, and compare it with the value converted from a time-of-flight velocity measurement; they should agree within 0.1%, otherwise check the flight-path survey or the monochromator angle zero.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「中子波長、速度與能量換算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion"?
options: 以已知晶格常數的標準粉末（例如矽）量測布拉格峰位置反推入射波長，並與飛行時間量得的速度換算結果比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
三軸譜儀的能量解析度與掃描方向無關，只看單色器。
optionsEn: Measure Bragg-peak positions of a standard powder with known lattice constant, such as silicon, to infer the incident wavelength, and compare it with the value converted from a time-of-flight velocity measurement.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Triple-axis energy resolution depends only on the monochromator, not the scan direction.
quiz.explanation: 以已知晶格常數的標準粉末（例如矽）量測布拉格峰位置反推入射波長，並與飛行時間量得的速度換算結果比較；兩者差異應在 0.1% 以內，否則要檢查飛行距離量測或單色器角度零點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure Bragg-peak positions of a standard powder with known lattice constant, such as silicon, to infer the incident wavelength, and compare it with the value converted from a time-of-flight velocity measurement; they should agree within 0.1%, otherwise check the flight-path survey or the monochromator angle zero. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 中子波長、速度與能量換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱中子與冷中子能譜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Thermal and cold neutron spectrum” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Carrying over X-ray habits while ignoring neutron sensitivity to light elements and isotopes misjudges sample scattering and absorption; for example a sample holder containing natural boron or cadmium absorbs most cold neutrons and the signal nearly vanishes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熱中子的波長約 1 到 2 Å，與原子間距相當，能量約數十 meV，與聲子和磁激發相當，所以同一束中子能同時量結構與動力學，這是中子散射儀存在的物理理由。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Thermal neutrons have wavelengths of about 1 to 2 Å, comparable to interatomic spacings, and energies of tens of meV, comparable to phonons and magnetic excitations, so one beam probes structure and dynamics together, which is the physical reason neutron-scattering instruments exist.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。
knowledge.textEn: Carrying over X-ray habits while ignoring neutron sensitivity to light elements and isotopes misjudges sample scattering and absorption; for example a sample holder containing natural boron or cadmium absorbs most cold neutrons and the signal nearly vanishes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「中子波長、速度與能量換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Neutron wavelength, velocity and energy conversion" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。
只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Carrying over X-ray habits while ignoring neutron sensitivity to light elements and isotopes misjudges sample scattering and absorption.
With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q.
quiz.explanation: 把 X 光的經驗直接套用而忽略中子對輕元素與同位素的敏感度，會錯估樣品的散射與吸收；例如含天然硼或鎘的樣品座會吸收大部分冷中子，訊號幾乎消失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Carrying over X-ray habits while ignoring neutron sensitivity to light elements and isotopes misjudges sample scattering and absorption; for example a sample holder containing natural boron or cadmium absorbs most cold neutrons and the signal nearly vanishes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中子散射實驗量的是散射函數 S(Q, ω)：入射波向量 ki 與散射波向量 kf 的差就是動量轉移 Q，兩者動能之差就是樣品吸收或放出的能量 ħω。彈性散射只看 Q，給出結構；非彈性散射同時看 Q 與 ħω，給出聲子或磁子色散。因為 ki、kf 與散射角受運動學三角形約束，給定入射能量時並不是每一組 (Q, ω) 都能到達，儀器設計必須先確認目標激發落在可達區域內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neutron scattering measures the scattering function S(Q, ω): the difference between incident and scattered wavevectors ki and kf is the momentum transfer Q, and the difference in kinetic energy is the energy ħω absorbed or released by the sample. Elastic scattering looks at Q only and yields structure; inelastic scattering looks at Q and ħω together and yields phonon or magnon dispersions. Because ki, kf and the scattering angle are tied by the kinematic triangle, not every (Q, ω) pair is reachable for a given incident energy, so instrument design must first confirm that the target excitation lies in the accessible region. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移
knowledge.titleEn: Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer
knowledge.text: 中子散射實驗量的是散射函數 S(Q, ω)：入射波向量 ki 與散射波向量 kf 的差就是動量轉移 Q，兩者動能之差就是樣品吸收或放出的能量 ħω。彈性散射只看 Q，給出結構；非彈性散射同時看 Q 與 ħω，給出聲子或磁子色散。
knowledge.textEn: Neutron scattering measures the scattering function S(Q, ω): the difference between incident and scattered wavevectors ki and kf is the momentum transfer Q, and the difference in kinetic energy is the energy ħω absorbed or released by the sample. Elastic scattering looks at Q only and yields structure; inelastic scattering looks at Q and ħω together and yields phonon or magnon dispersions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer" is correct?
options: 只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。
緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。
中子散射實驗量的是散射函數 S(Q, ω)：入射波向量 ki 與散射波向量 kf 的差就是動量轉移 Q，兩者動能之差就是樣品吸收或放出的能量 ħω。
optionsEn: With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q.
A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons.

Neutron scattering measures the scattering function S(Q, ω): the difference between incident and scattered wavevectors ki and kf is the momentum transfer Q, and the difference in kinetic energy is the energy ħω absorbed or released by the sample.
quiz.explanation: 中子散射實驗量的是散射函數 S(Q, ω)：入射波向量 ki 與散射波向量 kf 的差就是動量轉移 Q，兩者動能之差就是樣品吸收或放出的能量 ħω。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Neutron scattering measures the scattering function S(Q, ω): the difference between incident and scattered wavevectors ki and kf is the momentum transfer Q, and the difference in kinetic energy is the energy ħω absorbed or released by the sample. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。λ = 2.359 Å、2θ = 90° 時 Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹，對應晶面間距 d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å；ħω = Ei − Ef。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]. For λ = 2.359 Å and 2θ = 90°, Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹, corresponding to a lattice spacing d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å; the energy transfer is ħω = Ei − Ef. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋；試車時以單晶標準樣品的已知布拉格反射校正晶體方位矩陣，再量一條已知聲子分支，比較峰位與文獻值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage; at commissioning calibrate the crystal orientation matrix on known Bragg reflections of a single-crystal standard, then measure a known phonon branch and compare peak positions with literature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。λ = 2.359 Å、2θ = 90° 時 Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹，對應晶面間距 d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å；ħω = Ei − Ef。
knowledge.textEn: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]. For λ = 2.359 Å and 2θ = 90°, Q = 4π·sin45°/2.359 ≈ 3.77 Å⁻¹, corresponding to a lattice spacing d = 2π/Q ≈ 1.67 Å; the energy transfer is ħω = Ei − Ef.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer", which statement holds?
options: 彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。
飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。
三軸譜儀的能量解析度與掃描方向無關，只看單色器。
optionsEn: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²].
A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time.
Triple-axis energy resolution depends only on the monochromator, not the scan direction.
quiz.explanation: 彈性散射 Q = 4π·sinθ/λ（2θ 為散射角），能量與波向量 E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For elastic scattering Q = 4π·sinθ/λ with 2θ the scattering angle, and energy relates to wavevector as E[meV] = 2.072·k²[Å⁻²]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋；試車時以單晶標準樣品的已知布拉格反射校正晶體方位矩陣，再量一條已知聲子分支，比較峰位與文獻值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage; at commissioning calibrate the crystal orientation matrix on known Bragg reflections of a single-crystal standard, then measure a known phonon branch and compare peak positions with literature. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist; with a poorly calibrated orientation matrix the scan path drifts off the high-symmetry direction and the dispersion appears flattened or split.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋；試車時以單晶標準樣品的已知布拉格反射校正晶體方位矩陣，再量一條已知聲子分支，比較峰位與文獻值。
knowledge.textEn: Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage; at commissioning calibrate the crystal orientation matrix on known Bragg reflections of a single-crystal standard, then measure a known phonon branch and compare peak positions with literature.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋。
只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage.
With high enough incident flux the background level does not affect measurement time.
quiz.explanation: 在實驗規劃軟體中畫出給定 Ei 與偵測器角度範圍的 (Q, ω) 可達區域，把文獻或計算的色散曲線疊上去確認覆蓋；試車時以單晶標準樣品的已知布拉格反射校正晶體方位矩陣，再量一條已知聲子分支，比較峰位與文獻值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot the accessible (Q, ω) region for the chosen Ei and detector-angle range in planning software and overlay literature or calculated dispersions to confirm coverage; at commissioning calibrate the crystal orientation matrix on known Bragg reflections of a single-crystal standard, then measure a known phonon branch and compare peak positions with literature. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「散射向量 Q 與能量轉移 ħω」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Scattering vector Q and energy transfer ħω” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist; with a poorly calibrated orientation matrix the scan path drifts off the high-symmetry direction and the dispersion appears flattened or split. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為 ki、kf 與散射角受運動學三角形約束，給定入射能量時並不是每一組 (Q, ω) 都能到達，儀器設計必須先確認目標激發落在可達區域內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because ki, kf and the scattering angle are tied by the kinematic triangle, not every (Q, ω) pair is reachable for a given incident energy, so instrument design must first confirm that the target excitation lies in the accessible region.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。
knowledge.textEn: With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist; with a poorly calibrated orientation matrix the scan path drifts off the high-symmetry direction and the dispersion appears flattened or split.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「散射向量、動量守恆與能量轉移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scattering vector, momentum conservation and energy transfer" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。
入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons.
With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist.
quiz.explanation: 入射能量選得太低時，想量的高能激發落在運動學禁區，量測時間全部浪費在沒有訊號的區域；方位矩陣若沒校正好，掃描路徑偏離高對稱方向，色散看起來被拉平或分裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With too low an incident energy the high-energy excitation of interest falls in the kinematically forbidden region and the beamtime is spent where no signal can exist; with a poorly calibrated orientation matrix the scan path drifts off the high-symmetry direction and the dispersion appears flattened or split. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「中子源與緩速器」與「中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Neutron sources and moderators" and "Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 中子源與緩速器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Neutron sources and moderators: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 研究用反應爐以鈾分裂產生連續的百萬電子伏特快中子，散裂源則以高能質子撞擊重金屬靶產生脈衝快中子。兩者都必須經過緩速器，讓中子與輕原子核多次彈性碰撞降到熱平衡：室溫輕水或重水產生熱中子，約 20 K 的液態氫冷源把頻譜推向長波長。緩速器的材料、溫度、體積與耦合方式決定了中子頻譜峰值與脈衝寬度，對散裂源而言是通量與時間解析度的取捨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Research reactors produce a continuous flux of MeV fast neutrons from uranium fission, while spallation sources produce pulsed fast neutrons by striking a heavy-metal target with high-energy protons. Both need a moderator, in which repeated elastic collisions with light nuclei bring the neutrons to thermal equilibrium: room-temperature light or heavy water yields thermal neutrons, and a liquid-hydrogen cold source near 20 K shifts the spectrum to long wavelengths. Moderator material, temperature, volume and coupling set the spectral peak and the pulse width, which for a spallation source is a trade between flux and time resolution. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 中子源與緩速器
knowledge.text: 研究用反應爐以鈾分裂產生連續的百萬電子伏特快中子，散裂源則以高能質子撞擊重金屬靶產生脈衝快中子。兩者都必須經過緩速器，讓中子與輕原子核多次彈性碰撞降到熱平衡：室溫輕水或重水產生熱中子，約 20 K 的液態氫冷源把頻譜推向長波長。
knowledge.textEn: Research reactors produce a continuous flux of MeV fast neutrons from uranium fission, while spallation sources produce pulsed fast neutrons by striking a heavy-metal target with high-energy protons. Both need a moderator, in which repeated elastic collisions with light nuclei bring the neutrons to thermal equilibrium: room-temperature light or heavy water yields thermal neutrons, and a liquid-hydrogen cold source near 20 K shifts the spectrum to long wavelengths.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「中子源與緩速器」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Neutron sources and moderators" is correct?
options: 研究用反應爐以鈾分裂產生連續的百萬電子伏特快中子，散裂源則以高能質子撞擊重金屬靶產生脈衝快中子。
緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。
m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。
optionsEn: Research reactors produce a continuous flux of MeV fast neutrons from uranium fission, while spallation sources produce pulsed fast neutrons by striking a heavy-metal target with high-energy protons.
A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons.
A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle.
quiz.explanation: 研究用反應爐以鈾分裂產生連續的百萬電子伏特快中子，散裂源則以高能質子撞擊重金屬靶產生脈衝快中子。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Research reactors produce a continuous flux of MeV fast neutrons from uranium fission, while spallation sources produce pulsed fast neutrons by striking a heavy-metal target with high-energy protons. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 中子源與緩速器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neutron sources and moderators: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。2 MeV 降到 25.3 meV：氫 ξ = 1，n ≈ 18；氘 ξ = 0.725，n ≈ 25；碳 ξ = 0.158，n ≈ 115，所以含氫材料最短距離內完成緩速，但氫的吸收也較大。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision. From 2 MeV to 25.3 meV: hydrogen with ξ = 1 needs n ≈ 18, deuterium with ξ = 0.725 needs n ≈ 25 and carbon with ξ = 0.158 needs n ≈ 115, so hydrogenous moderators slow neutrons in the shortest distance, though hydrogen also absorbs more. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端；對脈衝源再以已知單晶的布拉格峰形狀反推脈衝時間結構，並追蹤冷源溫度與正氫比例變化時頻譜的改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator; for a pulsed source infer the emission-time structure from Bragg-peak shapes of a known crystal, and track spectral changes as cold-source temperature and ortho-hydrogen fraction vary.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。2 MeV 降到 25.3 meV：氫 ξ = 1，n ≈ 18；氘 ξ = 0.725，n ≈ 25；碳 ξ = 0.158，n ≈ 115，所以含氫材料最短距離內完成緩速，但氫的吸收也較大。
knowledge.textEn: The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision. From 2 MeV to 25.3 meV: hydrogen with ξ = 1 needs n ≈ 18, deuterium with ξ = 0.725 needs n ≈ 25 and carbon with ξ = 0.158 needs n ≈ 115, so hydrogenous moderators slow neutrons in the shortest distance, though hydrogen also absorbs more.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「中子源與緩速器」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Neutron sources and moderators", which statement holds?
options: 中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。
從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。
只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。
optionsEn: A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength.
The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision.
With high enough incident flux the background level does not affect measurement time.
quiz.explanation: 從 E0 緩速到 E 所需的平均碰撞次數 n = ln(E0/E)/ξ，ξ 為每次碰撞的平均對數能量減損。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The mean number of collisions to slow from E0 to E is n = ln(E0/E)/ξ, with ξ the mean logarithmic energy decrement per collision. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 中子源與緩速器：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neutron sources and moderators: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端；對脈衝源再以已知單晶的布拉格峰形狀反推脈衝時間結構，並追蹤冷源溫度與正氫比例變化時頻譜的改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator; for a pulsed source infer the emission-time structure from Bragg-peak shapes of a known crystal, and track spectral changes as cold-source temperature and ortho-hydrogen fraction vary. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降；若只看反應爐功率而不監測冷源狀態，會誤以為是儀器本身故障。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together; watching only reactor power without monitoring the cold source leads to blaming the instruments.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端；對脈衝源再以已知單晶的布拉格峰形狀反推脈衝時間結構，並追蹤冷源溫度與正氫比例變化時頻譜的改變。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator; for a pulsed source infer the emission-time structure from Bragg-peak shapes of a known crystal, and track spectral changes as cold-source temperature and ortho-hydrogen fraction vary.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「中子源與緩速器」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Neutron sources and moderators"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。
在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly.
Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator.
quiz.explanation: 在光束口以飛行時間法量測中子波長譜，與緩速器中子輸運模擬比較峰值波長與長波長尾端；對脈衝源再以已知單晶的布拉格峰形狀反推脈衝時間結構，並追蹤冷源溫度與正氫比例變化時頻譜的改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the wavelength spectrum at the beam port by time of flight and compare peak wavelength and long-wavelength tail with neutron-transport simulation of the moderator; for a pulsed source infer the emission-time structure from Bragg-peak shapes of a known crystal, and track spectral changes as cold-source temperature and ortho-hydrogen fraction vary. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 中子源與緩速器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Neutron sources and moderators: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反應爐爐心、散裂靶與緩速器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Reactor core, spallation target and moderator” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降；若只看反應爐功率而不監測冷源狀態，會誤以為是儀器本身故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together; watching only reactor power without monitoring the cold source leads to blaming the instruments. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：緩速器的材料、溫度、體積與耦合方式決定了中子頻譜峰值與脈衝寬度，對散裂源而言是通量與時間解析度的取捨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moderator material, temperature, volume and coupling set the spectral peak and the pulse width, which for a spallation source is a trade between flux and time resolution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降；若只看反應爐功率而不監測冷源狀態，會誤以為是儀器本身故障。
knowledge.textEn: When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together; watching only reactor power without monitoring the cold source leads to blaming the instruments.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「中子源與緩速器」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Neutron sources and moderators" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。
optionsEn: When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle.
quiz.explanation: 冷源液態氫的正氫比例或溫度偏離設計時，冷中子通量下降且頻譜偏移，所有使用長波長的儀器同時看到計數率下降；若只看反應爐功率而不監測冷源狀態，會誤以為是儀器本身故障。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When the ortho-hydrogen fraction or temperature of the liquid-hydrogen cold source drifts from design, cold-neutron flux falls and the spectrum shifts, so every long-wavelength instrument sees lower count rates together; watching only reactor power without monitoring the cold source leads to blaming the instruments. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「超鏡中子導管」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Supermirror neutron guide” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中子在大多數材料中的折射率略小於 1，以小角度入射鎳表面時會全反射，因此鍍鎳的玻璃或金屬矩形管能像光纖一樣把中子傳送到數十公尺外，讓儀器遠離爐心背景。超鏡在鎳層之上疊加數百到上千層厚度漸變的 Ni/Ti 多層膜，以布拉格反射把臨界角延伸到鎳的 m 倍。導管越長、m 值越高，能傳輸的發散角越大，但每次反射的損耗會隨反彈次數累積。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超鏡中子導管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neutrons see a refractive index slightly below one in most materials and are totally reflected from nickel at small grazing angles, so nickel-coated glass or metal rectangular guides transport them tens of metres like an optical fibre, moving instruments away from core background. Supermirrors stack hundreds to thousands of graded Ni/Ti multilayers on top of nickel, using Bragg reflection to extend the critical angle to m times that of nickel. Longer guides and higher m transport more divergence, but per-reflection loss accumulates with the number of bounces. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Supermirror neutron guide”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：天然鎳的臨界角約 0.1°/Å，超鏡 θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值
knowledge.titleEn: Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value
knowledge.text: 中子在大多數材料中的折射率略小於 1，以小角度入射鎳表面時會全反射，因此鍍鎳的玻璃或金屬矩形管能像光纖一樣把中子傳送到數十公尺外，讓儀器遠離爐心背景。超鏡在鎳層之上疊加數百到上千層厚度漸變的 Ni/Ti 多層膜，以布拉格反射把臨界角延伸到鎳的 m 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Neutrons see a refractive index slightly below one in most materials and are totally reflected from nickel at small grazing angles, so nickel-coated glass or metal rectangular guides transport them tens of metres like an optical fibre, moving instruments away from core background. Supermirrors stack hundreds to thousands of graded Ni/Ti multilayers on top of nickel, using Bragg reflection to extend the critical angle to m times that of nickel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

中子在大多數材料中的折射率略小於 1，以小角度入射鎳表面時會全反射，因此鍍鎳的玻璃或金屬矩形管能像光纖一樣把中子傳送到數十公尺外，讓儀器遠離爐心背景。
飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。
optionsEn: A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle.

Neutrons see a refractive index slightly below one in most materials and are totally reflected from nickel at small grazing angles, so nickel-coated glass or metal rectangular guides transport them tens of metres like an optical fibre, moving instruments away from core background.
A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time.
quiz.explanation: 中子在大多數材料中的折射率略小於 1，以小角度入射鎳表面時會全反射，因此鍍鎳的玻璃或金屬矩形管能像光纖一樣把中子傳送到數十公尺外，讓儀器遠離爐心背景。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Neutrons see a refractive index slightly below one in most materials and are totally reflected from nickel at small grazing angles, so nickel-coated glass or metal rectangular guides transport them tens of metres like an optical fibre, moving instruments away from core background. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超鏡中子導管」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Supermirror neutron guide” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：天然鎳的臨界角約 0.1°/Å，超鏡 θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]。m = 3、λ = 4 Å 時 θc ≈ 1.2°。長 50 m、寬 50 mm 的導管，平均角度 0.6° 的中子反彈次數 N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5；每次反射率 0.95 時傳輸 ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58，降到 0.90 則只剩約 0.33。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]. For m = 3 and λ = 4 Å, θc ≈ 1.2°. In a 50 m long, 50 mm wide guide a neutron at a mean angle of 0.6° bounces N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5 times; at 0.95 reflectivity per bounce transmission is ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58, dropping to about 0.33 at 0.90. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每段導管出廠前以中子反射率儀量測 R(Q) 曲線，確認 m 值邊緣的反射率；安裝時以雷射追蹤儀把各段的對齊與接縫控制在數十微米與數十微弧度內；完成後在導管末端以飛行時間量測波長相依的通量與發散，與光線追跡模擬比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge; at installation align sections and joints to tens of micrometres and tens of microradians with a laser tracker; afterwards measure wavelength-dependent flux and divergence at the guide exit by time of flight and compare with ray-tracing simulation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 天然鎳的臨界角約 0.1°/Å，超鏡 θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]。m = 3、λ = 4 Å 時 θc ≈ 1.2°。長 50 m、寬 50 mm 的導管，平均角度 0.6° 的中子反彈次數 N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5；每次反射率 0.95 時傳輸 ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58，降到 0.90 則只剩約 0.33。
knowledge.textEn: Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]. For m = 3 and λ = 4 Å, θc ≈ 1.2°. In a 50 m long, 50 mm wide guide a neutron at a mean angle of 0.6° bounces N ≈ L·θ/w ≈ 10.5 times; at 0.95 reflectivity per bounce transmission is ≈ 0.95^10.5 ≈ 0.58, dropping to about 0.33 at 0.90.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value", which statement holds?

quiz.explanationEn: Natural nickel has a critical angle of about 0.1° per Å, and a supermirror gives θc ≈ m×0.1°×λ[Å]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「超鏡中子導管」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Supermirror neutron guide” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每段導管出廠前以中子反射率儀量測 R(Q) 曲線，確認 m 值邊緣的反射率；安裝時以雷射追蹤儀把各段的對齊與接縫控制在數十微米與數十微弧度內；完成後在導管末端以飛行時間量測波長相依的通量與發散，與光線追跡模擬比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge; at installation align sections and joints to tens of micrometres and tens of microradians with a laser tracker; afterwards measure wavelength-dependent flux and divergence at the guide exit by time of flight and compare with ray-tracing simulation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：導管段之間的錯位或玻璃基板因長期輻照與真空失效而破裂，會在特定波長造成通量缺口，下游所有儀器同時受影響；只在單一波長檢查通量時，這種缺口很容易被漏掉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Misalignment between guide sections, or glass substrates cracking after long irradiation or vacuum failure, punches wavelength-specific holes in the flux that hit every downstream instrument; checking flux at a single wavelength easily misses such gaps.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每段導管出廠前以中子反射率儀量測 R(Q) 曲線，確認 m 值邊緣的反射率；安裝時以雷射追蹤儀把各段的對齊與接縫控制在數十微米與數十微弧度內；完成後在導管末端以飛行時間量測波長相依的通量與發散，與光線追跡模擬比較。
knowledge.textEn: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge; at installation align sections and joints to tens of micrometres and tens of microradians with a laser tracker; afterwards measure wavelength-dependent flux and divergence at the guide exit by time of flight and compare with ray-tracing simulation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value"?

optionsEn: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanationEn: Before delivery measure the R(Q) curve of each guide section on a neutron reflectometer to confirm reflectivity at the m-value edge; at installation align sections and joints to tens of micrometres and tens of microradians with a laser tracker; afterwards measure wavelength-dependent flux and divergence at the guide exit by time of flight and compare with ray-tracing simulation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 中子導管、臨界角與超鏡 m 值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Neutron guides, critical angle and the supermirror m-value: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超鏡中子導管」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Supermirror neutron guide” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 導管段之間的錯位或玻璃基板因長期輻照與真空失效而破裂，會在特定波長造成通量缺口，下游所有儀器同時受影響；只在單一波長檢查通量時，這種缺口很容易被漏掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Misalignment between guide sections, or glass substrates cracking after long irradiation or vacuum failure, punches wavelength-specific holes in the flux that hit every downstream instrument; checking flux at a single wavelength easily misses such gaps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：導管越長、m 值越高，能傳輸的發散角越大，但每次反射的損耗會隨反彈次數累積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Longer guides and higher m transport more divergence, but per-reflection loss accumulates with the number of bounces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
