stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」與「中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution" and "Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Disk choppers and flight path” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 飛行時間法以中子到達偵測器的時間決定速度，再換算波長與能量。散裂源本身是脈衝，反應爐則需以高速旋轉的盤式或費米斬波器把連續束切成短脈衝。波長解析度由脈衝時間寬度相對於總飛行時間的比例與飛行路徑不確定度決定；而相鄰脈衝的慢中子不能追上下一個脈衝的快中子，否則發生框架重疊，因此還需要帶寬斬波器限制每個脈衝的波長範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Time of flight fixes a neutron's speed from its arrival time at the detector and converts it to wavelength and energy. A spallation source is pulsed by nature, while a reactor needs fast-spinning disk or Fermi choppers to cut the continuous beam into short pulses. Wavelength resolution is set by pulse width relative to total flight time and by path-length uncertainty; slow neutrons of one pulse must not overlap fast neutrons of the next, or frame overlap occurs, so bandwidth choppers limit the wavelength band of each pulse. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Disk choppers and flight path”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Flight time is t = L·λ/3956; for L = 20 m and λ = 4 Å, t ≈ 20.2 ms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Disk choppers and flight path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 飛行時間法以中子到達偵測器的時間決定速度，再換算波長與能量。散裂源本身是脈衝，反應爐則需以高速旋轉的盤式或費米斬波器把連續束切成短脈衝。
knowledge.textEn: Time of flight fixes a neutron's speed from its arrival time at the detector and converts it to wavelength and energy. A spallation source is pulsed by nature, while a reactor needs fast-spinning disk or Fermi choppers to cut the continuous beam into short pulses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution" is correct?
options: 飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。
中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。
飛行時間法以中子到達偵測器的時間決定速度，再換算波長與能量。
optionsEn: A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time.
A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength.
Time of flight fixes a neutron's speed from its arrival time at the detector and converts it to wavelength and energy.
quiz.explanation: 飛行時間法以中子到達偵測器的時間決定速度，再換算波長與能量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Time of flight fixes a neutron's speed from its arrival time at the detector and converts it to wavelength and energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Disk choppers and flight path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。L = 20 m、λ = 4 Å 時 t ≈ 20.2 ms。60 Hz 源每框架 16.67 ms，可用帶寬 Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å。緩速器脈衝寬 100 µs 與路徑不確定 2 cm 時，Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Flight time is t = L·λ/3956; for L = 20 m and λ = 4 Å, t ≈ 20.2 ms. A 60 Hz source gives 16.67 ms per frame and a usable bandwidth Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å. With a 100 µs moderator pulse and a 2 cm path uncertainty, Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以中子監測器在斬波器前後量測時間譜，確認各斬波器的相位與開口時間符合時序設計；在樣品位置放置已知單晶或粉末標準，量測布拉格峰的時間寬度並與解析度模型比較；刻意縮短帶寬斬波器開口，檢查長時間尾端是否有來自前一框架的慢中子。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design; place a known single-crystal or powder standard at the sample and compare Bragg-peak time widths with the resolution model; deliberately narrow the bandwidth-chopper opening and check the long-time tail for slow neutrons from the previous frame.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。L = 20 m、λ = 4 Å 時 t ≈ 20.2 ms。60 Hz 源每框架 16.67 ms，可用帶寬 Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å。緩速器脈衝寬 100 µs 與路徑不確定 2 cm 時，Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%。
knowledge.textEn: Flight time is t = L·λ/3956; for L = 20 m and λ = 4 Å, t ≈ 20.2 ms. A 60 Hz source gives 16.67 ms per frame and a usable bandwidth Δλ = 3956×T/L ≈ 3.30 Å. With a 100 µs moderator pulse and a 2 cm path uncertainty, Δλ/λ ≈ √[(0.1/20.2)² + (0.02/20)²] ≈ 0.50%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution", which statement holds?
options: 飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。
只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。
只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。
optionsEn: Flight time is t = L·λ/3956; for L = 20 m and λ = 4 Å, t ≈ 20.2 ms.
With high enough incident flux the background level does not affect measurement time.
With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q.
quiz.explanation: 飛行時間 t = L·λ/3956。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Flight time is t = L·λ/3956; for L = 20 m and λ = 4 Å, t ≈ 20.2 ms. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Disk choppers and flight path” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以中子監測器在斬波器前後量測時間譜，確認各斬波器的相位與開口時間符合時序設計；在樣品位置放置已知單晶或粉末標準，量測布拉格峰的時間寬度並與解析度模型比較；刻意縮短帶寬斬波器開口，檢查長時間尾端是否有來自前一框架的慢中子。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design; place a known single-crystal or powder standard at the sample and compare Bragg-peak time widths with the resolution model; deliberately narrow the bandwidth-chopper opening and check the long-time tail for slow neutrons from the previous frame. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：斬波器相位隨轉速漂移或控制器重新開機後未重新鎖相，入射能量偏移而使用者沒有察覺，整組非彈性數據的能量刻度錯誤；框架重疊則讓慢中子出現在錯誤的時間通道，形成假峰。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If chopper phase drifts with speed or is not re-locked after a controller restart, the incident energy shifts unnoticed and a whole inelastic data set carries the wrong energy scale; frame overlap places slow neutrons in the wrong time channels and creates spurious peaks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以中子監測器在斬波器前後量測時間譜，確認各斬波器的相位與開口時間符合時序設計；在樣品位置放置已知單晶或粉末標準，量測布拉格峰的時間寬度並與解析度模型比較；刻意縮短帶寬斬波器開口，檢查長時間尾端是否有來自前一框架的慢中子。
knowledge.textEn: Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design; place a known single-crystal or powder standard at the sample and compare Bragg-peak time widths with the resolution model; deliberately narrow the bandwidth-chopper opening and check the long-time tail for slow neutrons from the previous frame.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以中子監測器在斬波器前後量測時間譜，確認各斬波器的相位與開口時間符合時序設計。
緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design.
A bigger moderator always gives more and colder neutrons.
quiz.explanation: 以中子監測器在斬波器前後量測時間譜，確認各斬波器的相位與開口時間符合時序設計；在樣品位置放置已知單晶或粉末標準，量測布拉格峰的時間寬度並與解析度模型比較；刻意縮短帶寬斬波器開口，檢查長時間尾端是否有來自前一框架的慢中子。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure time spectra with neutron monitors before and after the choppers to confirm phases and opening times against the timing design; place a known single-crystal or powder standard at the sample and compare Bragg-peak time widths with the resolution model; deliberately narrow the bandwidth-chopper opening and check the long-time tail for slow neutrons from the previous frame. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「盤式斬波器與飛行路徑」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Disk choppers and flight path” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 斬波器相位隨轉速漂移或控制器重新開機後未重新鎖相，入射能量偏移而使用者沒有察覺，整組非彈性數據的能量刻度錯誤；框架重疊則讓慢中子出現在錯誤的時間通道，形成假峰。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If chopper phase drifts with speed or is not re-locked after a controller restart, the incident energy shifts unnoticed and a whole inelastic data set carries the wrong energy scale; frame overlap places slow neutrons in the wrong time channels and creates spurious peaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：波長解析度由脈衝時間寬度相對於總飛行時間的比例與飛行路徑不確定度決定；而相鄰脈衝的慢中子不能追上下一個脈衝的快中子，否則發生框架重疊，因此還需要帶寬斬波器限制每個脈衝的波長範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wavelength resolution is set by pulse width relative to total flight time and by path-length uncertainty; slow neutrons of one pulse must not overlap fast neutrons of the next, or frame overlap occurs, so bandwidth choppers limit the wavelength band of each pulse.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 斬波器相位隨轉速漂移或控制器重新開機後未重新鎖相，入射能量偏移而使用者沒有察覺，整組非彈性數據的能量刻度錯誤；框架重疊則讓慢中子出現在錯誤的時間通道，形成假峰。
knowledge.textEn: If chopper phase drifts with speed or is not re-locked after a controller restart, the incident energy shifts unnoticed and a whole inelastic data set carries the wrong energy scale; frame overlap places slow neutrons in the wrong time channels and creates spurious peaks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斬波器、飛行時間與波長解析度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Choppers, time of flight and wavelength resolution" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。
斬波器相位隨轉速漂移或控制器重新開機後未重新鎖相，入射能量偏移而使用者沒有察覺，整組非彈性數據的能量刻度錯誤；框架重疊則讓慢中子出現在錯誤的時間通道，形成假峰。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength.
If chopper phase drifts with speed or is not re-locked after a controller restart, the incident energy shifts unnoticed and a whole inelastic data set carries the wrong energy scale.
quiz.explanation: 斬波器相位隨轉速漂移或控制器重新開機後未重新鎖相，入射能量偏移而使用者沒有察覺，整組非彈性數據的能量刻度錯誤；框架重疊則讓慢中子出現在錯誤的時間通道，形成假峰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If chopper phase drifts with speed or is not re-locked after a controller restart, the incident energy shifts unnoticed and a whole inelastic data set carries the wrong energy scale; frame overlap places slow neutrons in the wrong time channels and creates spurious peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「³He 正比管與釩標準」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中子本身不游離，必須先被核反應轉成帶電粒子：³He(n,p)³H 反應釋放 764 keV，正比管收集質子與氚的游離電荷，伽瑪射線產生的訊號小很多，容易以脈高鑑別排除。³He 吸收截面與波長成正比，長波長效率高；但 ³He 供應短缺促使 ¹⁰B 塗層氣體偵測器與 ⁶Li 閃爍體等替代方案發展。各偵測器管的效率不同，必須以幾乎純非同調散射的釩樣品做歸一化，讓不同角度的強度可以比較。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「³He 正比管與釩標準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neutrons do not ionise directly and must first be converted into charged particles by a nuclear reaction: ³He(n,p)³H releases 764 keV, a proportional tube collects the ionisation of the proton and triton, and gamma rays give much smaller signals that pulse-height discrimination rejects. The ³He absorption cross-section is proportional to wavelength, so long wavelengths are detected efficiently; the ³He supply shortage has driven alternatives such as ¹⁰B-lined gas detectors and ⁶Li scintillators. Tubes differ in efficiency, so they are normalised against vanadium, an almost purely incoherent scatterer, to make intensities at different angles comparable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：偵測效率 η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x)，吸收截面與波長成正比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Detection efficiency is η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x), with the absorption cross-section proportional to wavelength. ³He at 10 bar and 293 K has n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³; with σ(1.798 Å) = 5333 b and a mean path x ≈ 20 mm, η ≈ 93%; at λ = 1 Å, σ ≈ 2966 b and η ≈ 77%; at λ = 4 Å, η ≈ 99.7%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「³He 正比管與釩標準」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「³He 正比管與釩標準」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：偵測效率 η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x)，吸收截面與波長成正比。10 bar、293 K 的 ³He 數密度 n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³，σ(1.798 Å) = 5333 b，平均路徑 x ≈ 20 mm 時 η ≈ 93%；λ = 1 Å 時 σ ≈ 2966 b、η ≈ 77%；λ = 4 Å 時 η ≈ 99.7%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Detection efficiency is η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x), with the absorption cross-section proportional to wavelength. ³He at 10 bar and 293 K has n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³; with σ(1.798 Å) = 5333 b and a mean path x ≈ 20 mm, η ≈ 93%; at λ = 1 Å, σ ≈ 2966 b and η ≈ 77%; at λ = 4 Å, η ≈ 99.7%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以中子源與伽瑪源分別量測每支管的脈高譜，設定在 764 keV 全能峰與壁效應肩部以下、伽瑪訊號以上的鑑別門檻；量測釩樣品的彈性散射強度並扣除空容器背景，得到每支管的相對效率表，與上次校正比較，變化超過 2% 的管要檢查高壓與氣體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record pulse-height spectra for every tube with a neutron source and a gamma source, and set the discriminator below the 764 keV full-energy peak and wall-effect shoulder but above the gamma signal; measure elastic scattering from vanadium, subtract the empty-can background to obtain a relative-efficiency table, compare with the last calibration, and check high voltage and gas for any tube that changed by more than 2%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Detection efficiency is η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x), with the absorption cross-section proportional to wavelength. ³He at 10 bar and 293 K has n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³; with σ(1.798 Å) = 5333 b and a mean path x ≈ 20 mm, η ≈ 93%; at λ = 1 Å, σ ≈ 2966 b and η ≈ 77%; at λ = 4 Å, η ≈ 99.7%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation", which statement holds?
options: 原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。
偵測效率 η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x)，吸收截面與波長成正比。
緩速器越大越好，中子一定會越多越冷。
optionsEn: Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly.
Detection efficiency is η = 1 − exp(−n·σ·x), with the absorption cross-section proportional to wavelength. ³He at 10 bar and 293 K has n = P/(kT) ≈ 2.47×10²⁶ m⁻³.

steps.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「³He 正比管與釩標準」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以中子源與伽瑪源分別量測每支管的脈高譜，設定在 764 keV 全能峰與壁效應肩部以下、伽瑪訊號以上的鑑別門檻；量測釩樣品的彈性散射強度並扣除空容器背景，得到每支管的相對效率表，與上次校正比較，變化超過 2% 的管要檢查高壓與氣體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record pulse-height spectra for every tube with a neutron source and a gamma source, and set the discriminator below the 764 keV full-energy peak and wall-effect shoulder but above the gamma signal; measure elastic scattering from vanadium, subtract the empty-can background to obtain a relative-efficiency table, compare with the last calibration, and check high voltage and gas for any tube that changed by more than 2%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鑑別門檻設太低時伽瑪背景混入，非彈性弱訊號被淹沒；某支管漏氣或高壓偏移時效率下降，如果沒有定期釩歸一化，資料上會出現與角度相關的假強度變化，被誤讀為樣品織構。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With the discriminator too low gamma background leaks in and buries weak inelastic signals; a leaking tube or drifting high voltage lowers efficiency, and without regular vanadium normalisation the data show angle-dependent false intensity changes that are misread as sample texture.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation"?

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 中子偵測效率、替代技術與釩歸一化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Neutron detection efficiency, alternative technologies and vanadium normalisation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「³He 正比管與釩標準」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “³He proportional tubes and vanadium standard” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鑑別門檻設太低時伽瑪背景混入，非彈性弱訊號被淹沒；某支管漏氣或高壓偏移時效率下降，如果沒有定期釩歸一化，資料上會出現與角度相關的假強度變化，被誤讀為樣品織構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With the discriminator too low gamma background leaks in and buries weak inelastic signals; a leaking tube or drifting high voltage lowers efficiency, and without regular vanadium normalisation the data show angle-dependent false intensity changes that are misread as sample texture. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：各偵測器管的效率不同，必須以幾乎純非同調散射的釩樣品做歸一化，讓不同角度的強度可以比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tubes differ in efficiency, so they are normalised against vanadium, an almost purely incoherent scatterer, to make intensities at different angles comparable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「中子偵測器的效率與中子波長無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A neutron detector's efficiency does not depend on neutron wavelength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 鑑別門檻設太低時伽瑪背景混入，非彈性弱訊號被淹沒；某支管漏氣或高壓偏移時效率下降，如果沒有定期釩歸一化，資料上會出現與角度相關的假強度變化，被誤讀為樣品織構。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「三軸譜儀整合與解析度」與「背景、計數統計與試車交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution" and "Background, counting statistics and commissioning handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三軸譜儀整合與解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “PG monochromator, analyser and filter” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 三軸譜儀以三個旋轉軸依序決定入射能量（單色器）、樣品取向與散射角、以及散射能量（分析器），可以在 (Q, ω) 空間中逐點量測任意路徑。熱導熱解石墨 PG(002) 晶體常用作單色器與分析器，並以彎曲晶面聚焦提高通量。固定 Ef = 14.7 meV 的設定可讓 PG 濾片有效抑制 λ/2 高次諧波。儀器解析度是一個四維橢球，其大小與方向由準直器、晶體鑲嵌度與散射幾何決定，量測聲子時必須讓橢球長軸沿色散方向才能得到尖銳的峰。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A triple-axis spectrometer uses three rotation axes in sequence to set the incident energy (monochromator), the sample orientation and scattering angle, and the scattered energy (analyser), measuring point by point along any path in (Q, ω) space. Pyrolytic graphite PG(002) crystals commonly serve as monochromator and analyser, with curved arrays focusing to raise flux. Fixing Ef = 14.7 meV lets a PG filter suppress the λ/2 harmonic effectively. The resolution is a four-dimensional ellipsoid whose size and orientation are set by collimators, crystal mosaic and scattering geometry, and a phonon peak is sharp only when the ellipsoid's long axis lies along the dispersion. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “PG monochromator, analyser and filter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：固定散射能量 Ef = 14.7 meV 時，λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å、kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹；石墨 PG(002) 晶面間距 d = 3.355 Å，布拉格角 θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6°，所以分析器散射角 2θA ≈ 41.2°。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With the scattered energy fixed at Ef = 14.7 meV, λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å and kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹; graphite PG(002) has d = 3.355 Å, so the Bragg angle is θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6° and the analyser scattering angle is 2θA ≈ 41.2°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三軸譜儀的能量解析度與掃描方向無關，只看單色器。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Triple-axis energy resolution depends only on the monochromator, not the scan direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “PG monochromator, analyser and filter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.titleEn: Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “PG monochromator, analyser and filter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：固定散射能量 Ef = 14.7 meV 時，λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å、kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹；石墨 PG(002) 晶面間距 d = 3.355 Å，布拉格角 θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6°，所以分析器散射角 2θA ≈ 41.2°。同一角度也會反射 λf/2 的二次諧波，其能量為 4×14.7 = 58.8 meV，必須由 PG 濾片衰減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With the scattered energy fixed at Ef = 14.7 meV, λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å and kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹; graphite PG(002) has d = 3.355 Å, so the Bragg angle is θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6° and the analyser scattering angle is 2θA ≈ 41.2°. The same angle also reflects the λf/2 second harmonic, whose energy is 4×14.7 = 58.8 meV, and the PG filter must attenuate it. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以釩的非同調彈性散射掃描分析器角度，確定 Ef 的零點與能量寬度；以標準單晶的布拉格峰做 θ–2θ 與搖擺掃描量測 Q 解析度，並在已知聲子上以聚焦與反聚焦兩種幾何掃描，比較峰寬與 Cooper–Nathans 或 Popovici 解析度計算值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the analyser angle on incoherent elastic scattering from vanadium to fix the Ef zero and energy width; measure Q resolution with θ–2θ and rocking scans on Bragg peaks of a standard crystal, and scan a known phonon in focusing and defocusing geometries, comparing peak widths with Cooper–Nathans or Popovici resolution calculations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 固定散射能量 Ef = 14.7 meV 時，λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å、kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹；石墨 PG(002) 晶面間距 d = 3.355 Å，布拉格角 θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6°，所以分析器散射角 2θA ≈ 41.2°。同一角度也會反射 λf/2 的二次諧波，其能量為 4×14.7 = 58.8 meV，必須由 PG 濾片衰減。
knowledge.textEn: With the scattered energy fixed at Ef = 14.7 meV, λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å and kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹; graphite PG(002) has d = 3.355 Å, so the Bragg angle is θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6° and the analyser scattering angle is 2θA ≈ 41.2°. The same angle also reflects the λf/2 second harmonic, whose energy is 4×14.7 = 58.8 meV, and the PG filter must attenuate it.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「三軸譜儀整合與解析度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution", which statement holds?
options: 只要偵測器角度涵蓋夠大，任何能量轉移都可以在任意 Q 量到。
m 值越高的超鏡在所有角度的反射率都比較高。
optionsEn: With wide enough detector coverage any energy transfer can be measured at any Q.
A higher-m supermirror has higher reflectivity at every angle.
With the scattered energy fixed at Ef = 14.7 meV, λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å and kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹.
quiz.explanation: 固定散射能量 Ef = 14.7 meV 時，λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å、kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹；石墨 PG(002) 晶面間距 d = 3.355 Å，布拉格角 θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6°，所以分析器散射角 2θA ≈ 41.2°。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With the scattered energy fixed at Ef = 14.7 meV, λf = √(81.81/14.7) ≈ 2.359 Å and kf ≈ 2.663 Å⁻¹; graphite PG(002) has d = 3.355 Å, so the Bragg angle is θA = arcsin(λf/2d) ≈ 20.6° and the analyser scattering angle is 2θA ≈ 41.2°. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三軸譜儀整合與解析度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “PG monochromator, analyser and filter” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以釩的非同調彈性散射掃描分析器角度，確定 Ef 的零點與能量寬度；以標準單晶的布拉格峰做 θ–2θ 與搖擺掃描量測 Q 解析度，並在已知聲子上以聚焦與反聚焦兩種幾何掃描，比較峰寬與 Cooper–Nathans 或 Popovici 解析度計算值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the analyser angle on incoherent elastic scattering from vanadium to fix the Ef zero and energy width; measure Q resolution with θ–2θ and rocking scans on Bragg peaks of a standard crystal, and scan a known phonon in focusing and defocusing geometries, comparing peak widths with Cooper–Nathans or Popovici resolution calculations. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：PG 濾片未放入或方向錯誤時，λ/2 中子在分析器上與 λ 同時滿足布拉格條件，非彈性掃描中出現來自高次諧波的假峰；解析度橢球與色散方向配錯時，真實的尖銳激發被量成寬而弱的鼓包。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without the PG filter, or with it misoriented, λ/2 neutrons satisfy the analyser Bragg condition along with λ and create spurious harmonic peaks in inelastic scans; with the resolution ellipsoid mismatched to the dispersion, a genuinely sharp excitation appears as a broad, weak hump.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以釩的非同調彈性散射掃描分析器角度，確定 Ef 的零點與能量寬度；以標準單晶的布拉格峰做 θ–2θ 與搖擺掃描量測 Q 解析度，並在已知聲子上以聚焦與反聚焦兩種幾何掃描，比較峰寬與 Cooper–Nathans 或 Popovici 解析度計算值。
knowledge.textEn: Scan the analyser angle on incoherent elastic scattering from vanadium to fix the Ef zero and energy width; measure Q resolution with θ–2θ and rocking scans on Bragg peaks of a standard crystal, and scan a known phonon in focusing and defocusing geometries, comparing peak widths with Cooper–Nathans or Popovici resolution calculations.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三軸譜儀整合與解析度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution"?
options: 以釩的非同調彈性散射掃描分析器角度，確定 Ef 的零點與能量寬度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
飛行路徑越長，計數率與解析度會同時變好。
optionsEn: Scan the analyser angle on incoherent elastic scattering from vanadium to fix the Ef zero and energy width.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A longer flight path improves count rate and resolution at the same time.
quiz.explanation: 以釩的非同調彈性散射掃描分析器角度，確定 Ef 的零點與能量寬度；以標準單晶的布拉格峰做 θ–2θ 與搖擺掃描量測 Q 解析度，並在已知聲子上以聚焦與反聚焦兩種幾何掃描，比較峰寬與 Cooper–Nathans 或 Popovici 解析度計算值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan the analyser angle on incoherent elastic scattering from vanadium to fix the Ef zero and energy width; measure Q resolution with θ–2θ and rocking scans on Bragg peaks of a standard crystal, and scan a known phonon in focusing and defocusing geometries, comparing peak widths with Cooper–Nathans or Popovici resolution calculations. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 三軸譜儀整合與解析度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「PG 單色器、分析器與濾片」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “PG monochromator, analyser and filter” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: PG 濾片未放入或方向錯誤時，λ/2 中子在分析器上與 λ 同時滿足布拉格條件，非彈性掃描中出現來自高次諧波的假峰；解析度橢球與色散方向配錯時，真實的尖銳激發被量成寬而弱的鼓包。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Without the PG filter, or with it misoriented, λ/2 neutrons satisfy the analyser Bragg condition along with λ and create spurious harmonic peaks in inelastic scans; with the resolution ellipsoid mismatched to the dispersion, a genuinely sharp excitation appears as a broad, weak hump. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：儀器解析度是一個四維橢球，其大小與方向由準直器、晶體鑲嵌度與散射幾何決定，量測聲子時必須讓橢球長軸沿色散方向才能得到尖銳的峰。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The resolution is a four-dimensional ellipsoid whose size and orientation are set by collimators, crystal mosaic and scattering geometry, and a phonon peak is sharp only when the ellipsoid's long axis lies along the dispersion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三軸譜儀的能量解析度與掃描方向無關，只看單色器。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Triple-axis energy resolution depends only on the monochromator, not the scan direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: PG 濾片未放入或方向錯誤時，λ/2 中子在分析器上與 λ 同時滿足布拉格條件，非彈性掃描中出現來自高次諧波的假峰；解析度橢球與色散方向配錯時，真實的尖銳激發被量成寬而弱的鼓包。
knowledge.textEn: Without the PG filter, or with it misoriented, λ/2 neutrons satisfy the analyser Bragg condition along with λ and create spurious harmonic peaks in inelastic scans; with the resolution ellipsoid mismatched to the dispersion, a genuinely sharp excitation appears as a broad, weak hump.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「三軸譜儀整合與解析度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Triple-axis spectrometer integration and resolution" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
PG 濾片未放入或方向錯誤時，λ/2 中子在分析器上與 λ 同時滿足布拉格條件，非彈性掃描中出現來自高次諧波的假峰。
只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Without the PG filter, or with it misoriented, λ/2 neutrons satisfy the analyser Bragg condition along with λ and create spurious harmonic peaks in inelastic scans.
With high enough incident flux the background level does not affect measurement time.
quiz.explanation: PG 濾片未放入或方向錯誤時，λ/2 中子在分析器上與 λ 同時滿足布拉格條件，非彈性掃描中出現來自高次諧波的假峰；解析度橢球與色散方向配錯時，真實的尖銳激發被量成寬而弱的鼓包。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without the PG filter, or with it misoriented, λ/2 neutrons satisfy the analyser Bragg condition along with λ and create spurious harmonic peaks in inelastic scans; with the resolution ellipsoid mismatched to the dispersion, a genuinely sharp excitation appears as a broad, weak hump. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 背景、計數統計與試車交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Background, counting statistics and commissioning handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「屏蔽、背景監測與驗收紀錄」如何決定中子散射儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shielding, background monitoring and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Neutron-scattering instruments”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中子散射的訊號通常每秒只有幾個計數，背景來自爐心或散裂靶的快中子與伽瑪、相鄰儀器、樣品環境與空氣散射，因此背景控制直接決定實驗所需時間。屏蔽以混凝土、鋼與含硼或含鋰材料組成，並以吸收材內襯樣品區與偵測器箱，屬於設施輻射安全設計，由專責單位依法規驗證。儀器交接要以標準樣品證明波長刻度、解析度、偵測器歸一化與訊雜比，並把計數統計換算成使用者實際需要的量測時間。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「屏蔽、背景監測與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neutron-scattering signals are often only a few counts per second, with background from fast neutrons and gammas of the core or spallation target, neighbouring instruments, sample environment and air scattering, so background control directly sets how long an experiment takes. Shielding combines concrete, steel and boron- or lithium-bearing absorbers lining the sample area and detector tank, and is part of the facility radiation-safety design verified by the responsible group under regulation. Instrument handoff must prove wavelength calibration, resolution, detector normalisation and signal-to-background with standard samples, and turn counting statistics into the measurement time users will actually need. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Shielding, background monitoring and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若樣品（訊號 S 加背景 B）與純背景各量測 t 秒，扣除後淨訊號的相對誤差 = √(S + 2B)/(S·√t)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Counting sample (signal S plus background B) and background for t seconds each, the relative error of the net signal is √(S + 2B)/(S·√t).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With high enough incident flux the background level does not affect measurement time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「屏蔽、背景監測與驗收紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Shielding, background monitoring and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背景、計數統計與試車交接
knowledge.titleEn: Background, counting statistics and commissioning handoff
knowledge.text: 中子散射的訊號通常每秒只有幾個計數，背景來自爐心或散裂靶的快中子與伽瑪、相鄰儀器、樣品環境與空氣散射，因此背景控制直接決定實驗所需時間。屏蔽以混凝土、鋼與含硼或含鋰材料組成，並以吸收材內襯樣品區與偵測器箱，屬於設施輻射安全設計，由專責單位依法規驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Neutron-scattering signals are often only a few counts per second, with background from fast neutrons and gammas of the core or spallation target, neighbouring instruments, sample environment and air scattering, so background control directly sets how long an experiment takes. Shielding combines concrete, steel and boron- or lithium-bearing absorbers lining the sample area and detector tank, and is part of the facility radiation-safety design verified by the responsible group under regulation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With high enough incident flux the background level does not affect measurement time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背景、計數統計與試車交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Background, counting statistics and commissioning handoff" is correct?
options: 只要入射通量夠高，背景高低就不影響實驗時間。
原子序越大的元素，對中子的散射一定越強。
中子散射的訊號通常每秒只有幾個計數，背景來自爐心或散裂靶的快中子與伽瑪、相鄰儀器、樣品環境與空氣散射，因此背景控制直接決定實驗所需時間。

Elements with higher atomic number always scatter neutrons more strongly.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Background, counting statistics and commissioning handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屏蔽、背景監測與驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shielding, background monitoring and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若樣品（訊號 S 加背景 B）與純背景各量測 t 秒，扣除後淨訊號的相對誤差 = √(S + 2B)/(S·√t)。S = 2 cps、B = 1 cps 時要達 1% 需 t = (√4/(2×0.01))² = 10 000 s ≈ 2.8 h；背景降到 0.2 cps 時只需約 6000 s ≈ 1.7 h，同樣精度省下 40% 的束流時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Counting sample (signal S plus background B) and background for t seconds each, the relative error of the net signal is √(S + 2B)/(S·√t). For S = 2 cps and B = 1 cps, 1% needs t = (√4/(2×0.01))² = 10 000 s ≈ 2.8 h; lowering background to 0.2 cps needs only about 6000 s ≈ 1.7 h, saving 40% of the beamtime for the same precision. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在束流關閉、主光閘開啟但樣品位置放置強吸收體、以及正常量測三種狀態下記錄偵測器計數率，分離設施背景、束流相關背景與樣品訊號；以釩、標準粉末與已知單晶完成波長、解析度與效率校正，並把背景率、計數率與預估量測時間表寫入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record detector count rates with beam off, with the main shutter open but a strong absorber at the sample position, and in normal measurement, to separate facility background, beam-related background and sample signal; complete wavelength, resolution and efficiency calibration with vanadium, a standard powder and a known single crystal, and file background rates, count rates and a predicted measurement-time table in the handoff record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 背景、計數統計與試車交接：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「屏蔽、背景監測與驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Shielding, background monitoring and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在束流關閉、主光閘開啟但樣品位置放置強吸收體、以及正常量測三種狀態下記錄偵測器計數率，分離設施背景、束流相關背景與樣品訊號；以釩、標準粉末與已知單晶完成波長、解析度與效率校正，並把背景率、計數率與預估量測時間表寫入交接文件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record detector count rates with beam off, with the main shutter open but a strong absorber at the sample position, and in normal measurement, to separate facility background, beam-related background and sample signal; complete wavelength, resolution and efficiency calibration with vanadium, a standard powder and a known single crystal, and file background rates, count rates and a predicted measurement-time table in the handoff record. steps.observation: 注意干擾：相鄰儀器更換設定或光閘開啟時背景跳升，若沒有持續監測背景，使用者會把背景變化誤認為樣品隨溫度的相變；樣品環境中未加吸收內襯的鋁件散射，會在特定 Q 位置產生假的布拉格峰。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When a neighbouring instrument changes configuration or opens its shutter the background jumps, and without continuous background monitoring users mistake the change for a temperature-driven phase transition in the sample; unshielded aluminium parts in the sample environment scatter and produce false Bragg peaks at specific Q.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 背景、計數統計與試車交接：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 相鄰儀器更換設定或光閘開啟時背景跳升，若沒有持續監測背景，使用者會把背景變化誤認為樣品隨溫度的相變；樣品環境中未加吸收內襯的鋁件散射，會在特定 Q 位置產生假的布拉格峰。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

title: 閃爍體粒子偵測器
summary: 以 NaI(Tl)、LYSO 晶體與 EJ-200 塑膠閃爍體為例，追蹤一個 662 keV 伽瑪光子如何變成數萬個閃爍光子、數千個光電子與一個可校正的脈衝，並把 Birks 淬滅、光學耦合與反射層、PMT 與 SiPM、能量解析度分解、溫度增益漂移與符合計時整合成可交接的偵測器工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Using NaI(Tl), LYSO crystals and EJ-200 plastic, the course follows a 662 keV gamma ray as it becomes tens of thousands of scintillation photons, thousands of photoelectrons and one calibratable pulse, then integrates Birks quenching, optical coupling and reflectors, PMTs and SiPMs, energy-resolution decomposition, temperature-driven gain drift and coincidence timing into a transferable detector engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: NaI(Tl) 伽瑪能譜儀練習：76 mm 晶體在 ¹³⁷Cs 662 keV 光電峰產生 38×662 ≈ 25 160 個光子。假設光收集 0.65、PMT 量子效率 0.28，N_pe = 25 160×0.65×0.28 ≈ 4580；超額雜訊因子 1.2 時統計項 2.355×√(1.2/4580) ≈ 3.8%。再假設晶體非比例性與不均勻性合計 5.5%，總解析度 √(3.8² + 5.5²) ≈ 6.7% FWHM，即約 44 keV。康普頓邊緣 E_C = E/(1 + m_ec²/2E) = 662/(1 + 511/1324) ≈ 478 keV，背散射峰約 662 − 478 ≈ 184 keV。若把 PMT 換成 PDE 0.40 的 SiPM 陣列且光收集不變，N_pe ≈ 6540，統計項降到約 3.2%，總解析度只改善到約 6.4%，顯示本質項主導。數值為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: NaI(Tl) gamma-spectrometer exercise: a 76 mm crystal produces 38×662 ≈ 25 160 photons in the ¹³⁷Cs 662 keV photopeak. Assuming light collection 0.65 and PMT quantum efficiency 0.28, N_pe = 25 160×0.65×0.28 ≈ 4580; with an excess noise factor of 1.2 the statistical term is 2.355×√(1.2/4580) ≈ 3.8%. Assuming crystal non-proportionality and non-uniformity together contribute 5.5%, the total resolution is √(3.8² + 5.5²) ≈ 6.7% FWHM, about 44 keV. The Compton edge is E_C = E/(1 + m_ec²/2E) = 662/(1 + 511/1324) ≈ 478 keV and the backscatter peak lies near 662 − 478 ≈ 184 keV. Replacing the PMT with a SiPM array of PDE 0.40 at unchanged light collection gives N_pe ≈ 6540, lowering the statistical term to about 3.2% but the total only to about 6.4%, showing that the intrinsic term dominates. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閃爍機制、光產額與衰減時間」與「Birks 淬滅與粒子相依的光輸出」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scintillation mechanism, light yield and decay time" and "Birks quenching and particle-dependent light output": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閃爍機制、光產額與衰減時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Scintillation mechanism, light yield and decay time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「活化劑發光中心與衰減時間」如何決定閃爍體粒子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Activator luminescence centre and decay time” determines the key performance of “Scintillation particle detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 無機晶體中，游離粒子產生的電子電洞對在晶格中遷移，被 Tl⁺ 或 Ce³⁺ 等活化劑捕獲後以可見光釋放能量，光產額高但衰減時間從數十到數百奈秒；有機與塑膠閃爍體則由苯環 π 電子的螢光發光，光產額較低但衰減只有數奈秒。發光波長必須落在晶體本身透明且光偵測器敏感的範圍內，塑膠閃爍體因此加入波長轉換劑。選材時光產額決定能量解析度，衰減時間決定計數率與計時能力，密度與原子序決定攔截效率，三者必須同時權衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「活化劑發光中心與衰減時間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In inorganic crystals the electron–hole pairs created by an ionising particle migrate through the lattice until activators such as Tl⁺ or Ce³⁺ capture them and release the energy as visible light, giving high yield with decay times from tens to hundreds of nanoseconds; organic and plastic scintillators emit by fluorescence of π electrons in aromatic rings, with lower yield but decay of only a few nanoseconds. Emission must fall where the material is transparent and the photodetector is sensitive, which is why plastics include wavelength shifters. Light yield sets energy resolution, decay time sets count rate and timing, and density and atomic number set stopping efficiency, so material choice balances all three. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Activator luminescence centre and decay time”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: NaI(Tl) yields about 38 photons/keV, so a 662 keV deposit produces 38×662 ≈ 25 200 photons; at 410 nm (3.02 eV) about 11.5% of the deposited energy becomes light.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「光產額最高的閃爍體在所有應用中都是最好的選擇。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 閃爍機制、光產額與衰減時間
knowledge.titleEn: Scintillation mechanism, light yield and decay time
knowledge.text: 無機晶體中，游離粒子產生的電子電洞對在晶格中遷移，被 Tl⁺ 或 Ce³⁺ 等活化劑捕獲後以可見光釋放能量，光產額高但衰減時間從數十到數百奈秒；有機與塑膠閃爍體則由苯環 π 電子的螢光發光，光產額較低但衰減只有數奈秒。發光波長必須落在晶體本身透明且光偵測器敏感的範圍內，塑膠閃爍體因此加入波長轉換劑。
knowledge.textEn: In inorganic crystals the electron–hole pairs created by an ionising particle migrate through the lattice until activators such as Tl⁺ or Ce³⁺ capture them and release the energy as visible light, giving high yield with decay times from tens to hundreds of nanoseconds; organic and plastic scintillators emit by fluorescence of π electrons in aromatic rings, with lower yield but decay of only a few nanoseconds. Emission must fall where the material is transparent and the photodetector is sensitive, which is why plastics include wavelength shifters.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：光產額最高的閃爍體在所有應用中都是最好的選擇。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The scintillator with the highest light yield is the best choice for every application. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閃爍機制、光產額與衰減時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scintillation mechanism, light yield and decay time" is correct?
options: 光產額最高的閃爍體在所有應用中都是最好的選擇。
無機晶體中，游離粒子產生的電子電洞對在晶格中遷移，被 Tl⁺ 或 Ce³⁺ 等活化劑捕獲後以可見光釋放能量，光產額高但衰減時間從數十到數百奈秒。
同樣沉積 1 MeV，任何粒子在閃爍體中產生的光都一樣多。
optionsEn: The scintillator with the highest light yield is the best choice for every application.

In inorganic crystals the electron–hole pairs created by an ionising particle migrate through the lattice until activators such as Tl⁺ or Ce³⁺ capture them and release the energy as visible light, giving high yield with decay times from tens to hundreds of nanoseconds.
Any particle depositing 1 MeV produces the same amount of light in a scintillator.
quiz.explanation: 無機晶體中，游離粒子產生的電子電洞對在晶格中遷移，被 Tl⁺ 或 Ce³⁺ 等活化劑捕獲後以可見光釋放能量，光產額高但衰減時間從數十到數百奈秒；有機與塑膠閃爍體則由苯環 π 電子的螢光發光，光產額較低但衰減只有數奈秒。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In inorganic crystals the electron–hole pairs created by an ionising particle migrate through the lattice until activators such as Tl⁺ or Ce³⁺ capture them and release the energy as visible light, giving high yield with decay times from tens to hundreds of nanoseconds; organic and plastic scintillators emit by fluorescence of π electrons in aromatic rings, with lower yield but decay of only a few nanoseconds. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閃爍機制、光產額與衰減時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scintillation mechanism, light yield and decay time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「活化劑發光中心與衰減時間」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Activator luminescence centre and decay time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：NaI(Tl) 光產額約 38 光子/keV，662 keV 沉積產生 38×662 ≈ 25 200 個光子；以 410 nm（3.02 eV）計，約 11.5% 的沉積能量變成光。相對 NaI(Tl)，LSO/LYSO 約 85%、衰減約 40 ns，BGO 約 21%、衰減約 300 ns；EJ-200 約 10 000 光子/MeV、衰減 2.1 ns。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: NaI(Tl) yields about 38 photons/keV, so a 662 keV deposit produces 38×662 ≈ 25 200 photons; at 410 nm (3.02 eV) about 11.5% of the deposited energy becomes light. Relative to NaI(Tl), LSO/LYSO gives about 85% with about 40 ns decay and BGO about 21% with about 300 ns; EJ-200 gives about 10 000 photons/MeV with 2.1 ns decay. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一支已校正的 PMT 與相同耦合條件，依序量測待測晶體與參考 NaI(Tl) 晶體在 ¹³⁷Cs 662 keV 的光電峰位置，比值即為相對光產額；以快速示波器或時間相關單光子計數量測脈衝波形並擬合衰減常數，與規格書比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: With the same calibrated PMT and identical coupling, measure the 662 keV ¹³⁷Cs photopeak position of the crystal under test and of a reference NaI(Tl) crystal in turn, taking the ratio as relative light yield; record pulse shapes with a fast oscilloscope or time-correlated single-photon counting and fit decay constants for comparison with the datasheet.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: NaI(Tl) 光產額約 38 光子/keV，662 keV 沉積產生 38×662 ≈ 25 200 個光子；以 410 nm（3.02 eV）計，約 11.5% 的沉積能量變成光。相對 NaI(Tl)，LSO/LYSO 約 85%、衰減約 40 ns，BGO 約 21%、衰減約 300 ns；EJ-200 約 10 000 光子/MeV、衰減 2.1 ns。
knowledge.textEn: NaI(Tl) yields about 38 photons/keV, so a 662 keV deposit produces 38×662 ≈ 25 200 photons; at 410 nm (3.02 eV) about 11.5% of the deposited energy becomes light. Relative to NaI(Tl), LSO/LYSO gives about 85% with about 40 ns decay and BGO about 21% with about 300 ns; EJ-200 gives about 10 000 photons/MeV with 2.1 ns decay.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「閃爍機制、光產額與衰減時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scintillation mechanism, light yield and decay time", which statement holds?
options: SiPM 的輸出電荷永遠與入射光子數成正比。
能量刻度做過一次之後，閃爍偵測器的峰位就會一直固定。
NaI(Tl) 光產額約 38 光子/keV，662 keV 沉積產生 38×662 ≈ 25 200 個光子。

Once calibrated, a scintillation detector's peak positions stay fixed.
NaI(Tl) yields about 38 photons/keV, so a 662 keV deposit produces 38×662 ≈ 25 200 photons.

quiz.explanationEn: NaI(Tl) yields about 38 photons/keV, so a 662 keV deposit produces 38×662 ≈ 25 200 photons; at 410 nm (3.02 eV) about 11.5% of the deposited energy becomes light. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 閃爍機制、光產額與衰減時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scintillation mechanism, light yield and decay time: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「活化劑發光中心與衰減時間」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Activator luminescence centre and decay time” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以同一支已校正的 PMT 與相同耦合條件，依序量測待測晶體與參考 NaI(Tl) 晶體在 ¹³⁷Cs 662 keV 的光電峰位置，比值即為相對光產額；以快速示波器或時間相關單光子計數量測脈衝波形並擬合衰減常數，與規格書比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: With the same calibrated PMT and identical coupling, measure the 662 keV ¹³⁷Cs photopeak position of the crystal under test and of a reference NaI(Tl) crystal in turn, taking the ratio as relative light yield; record pulse shapes with a fast oscilloscope or time-correlated single-photon counting and fit decay constants for comparison with the datasheet. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：NaI(Tl) 會吸濕，封裝漏氣後表面潮解變黃，光產額與均勻性逐漸下降，光電峰向低能漂移並變寬；若只用定期能量刻度修正而不檢查封裝，數月後才會發現解析度已不可接受。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: NaI(Tl) is hygroscopic: once the housing leaks the surface hydrates and yellows, light yield and uniformity fall, and the photopeak drifts down and broadens; correcting only with periodic energy recalibration without inspecting the housing reveals the unacceptable resolution months later.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一支已校正的 PMT 與相同耦合條件，依序量測待測晶體與參考 NaI(Tl) 晶體在 ¹³⁷Cs 662 keV 的光電峰位置，比值即為相對光產額；以快速示波器或時間相關單光子計數量測脈衝波形並擬合衰減常數，與規格書比較。
knowledge.textEn: With the same calibrated PMT and identical coupling, measure the 662 keV ¹³⁷Cs photopeak position of the crystal under test and of a reference NaI(Tl) crystal in turn, taking the ratio as relative light yield; record pulse shapes with a fast oscilloscope or time-correlated single-photon counting and fit decay constants for comparison with the datasheet.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「閃爍機制、光產額與衰減時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scintillation mechanism, light yield and decay time"?
options: 以同一支已校正的 PMT 與相同耦合條件，依序量測待測晶體與參考 NaI(Tl) 晶體在 ¹³⁷Cs 662 keV 的光電峰位置，比值即為相對光產額。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。

quiz.explanationEn: With the same calibrated PMT and identical coupling, measure the 662 keV ¹³⁷Cs photopeak position of the crystal under test and of a reference NaI(Tl) crystal in turn, taking the ratio as relative light yield; record pulse shapes with a fast oscilloscope or time-correlated single-photon counting and fit decay constants for comparison with the datasheet. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 閃爍機制、光產額與衰減時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scintillation mechanism, light yield and decay time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「活化劑發光中心與衰減時間」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Activator luminescence centre and decay time” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: NaI(Tl) 會吸濕，封裝漏氣後表面潮解變黃，光產額與均勻性逐漸下降，光電峰向低能漂移並變寬；若只用定期能量刻度修正而不檢查封裝，數月後才會發現解析度已不可接受。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: NaI(Tl) is hygroscopic: once the housing leaks the surface hydrates and yellows, light yield and uniformity fall, and the photopeak drifts down and broadens; correcting only with periodic energy recalibration without inspecting the housing reveals the unacceptable resolution months later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：選材時光產額決定能量解析度，衰減時間決定計數率與計時能力，密度與原子序決定攔截效率，三者必須同時權衡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Light yield sets energy resolution, decay time sets count rate and timing, and density and atomic number set stopping efficiency, so material choice balances all three.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「光產額最高的閃爍體在所有應用中都是最好的選擇。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The scintillator with the highest light yield is the best choice for every application." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
