quiz.question: 關於「增益穩定度、溫度漂移與監測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gain stability, temperature drift and monitoring" is correct?
options: 閃爍偵測器的峰位會隨溫度與偏壓漂移：晶體光產額本身有溫度係數，PMT 增益隨高壓呈冪次關係，SiPM 的崩潰電壓隨溫度上升，固定偏壓下過電壓變小、增益與 PDE 同時下降。
能量刻度做過一次之後，閃爍偵測器的峰位就會一直固定。
衰減時間越長的閃爍體收集越多光，計時就越準。
optionsEn: Peak positions drift with temperature and bias: crystal light yield has its own temperature coefficient, PMT gain follows a power law in high voltage, and the SiPM breakdown voltage rises with temperature so that at fixed bias the overvoltage shrinks and gain and PDE fall together.
Once calibrated, a scintillation detector's peak positions stay fixed.
A scintillator with a longer decay collects more light and therefore times better.
quiz.explanation: 閃爍偵測器的峰位會隨溫度與偏壓漂移：晶體光產額本身有溫度係數，PMT 增益隨高壓呈冪次關係，SiPM 的崩潰電壓隨溫度上升，固定偏壓下過電壓變小、增益與 PDE 同時下降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Peak positions drift with temperature and bias: crystal light yield has its own temperature coefficient, PMT gain follows a power law in high voltage, and the SiPM breakdown voltage rises with temperature so that at fixed bias the overvoltage shrinks and gain and PDE fall together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 增益穩定度、溫度漂移與監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gain stability, temperature drift and monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏壓、溫度感測與 LED 監測」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bias, temperature sensing and LED monitor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：SiPM 增益正比於過電壓 V_ov；假設崩潰電壓溫度係數 54 mV/K、V_ov = 3 V，則 ΔG/G ≈ 0.054/3 ≈ 1.8%/K，溫度變化 5 K 使峰位移動約 9%。PMT 增益 G ∝ V^(k·n)，取 k = 0.7、n = 10 級，高壓漣波 0.1% 造成增益變化約 0.7%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: SiPM gain is proportional to overvoltage V_ov; assuming a breakdown-voltage temperature coefficient of 54 mV/K and V_ov = 3 V, ΔG/G ≈ 0.054/3 ≈ 1.8%/K, so a 5 K change shifts peaks by about 9%. PMT gain follows G ∝ V^(k·n); with k = 0.7 and n = 10 stages, a 0.1% high-voltage ripple changes gain by about 0.7%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把模組放入溫控箱，在 15 到 35 °C 間分階段量測 LED 峰與 ¹³⁷Cs 光電峰位置，求出各自的溫度係數；開啟偏壓補償後重複量測，確認峰位變化壓到 0.5%/K 以下；並以長時間記錄比較 LED 與放射源峰的比值，判斷漂移來自光偵測器還是晶體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place the module in a climate chamber and measure LED and ¹³⁷Cs photopeak positions in steps between 15 and 35 °C to obtain their temperature coefficients; repeat with bias compensation enabled and confirm peak movement below 0.5%/K; compare the ratio of LED and source peaks over long recordings to tell photodetector drift from crystal drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: SiPM 增益正比於過電壓 V_ov；假設崩潰電壓溫度係數 54 mV/K、V_ov = 3 V，則 ΔG/G ≈ 0.054/3 ≈ 1.8%/K，溫度變化 5 K 使峰位移動約 9%。PMT 增益 G ∝ V^(k·n)，取 k = 0.7、n = 10 級，高壓漣波 0.1% 造成增益變化約 0.7%。
knowledge.textEn: SiPM gain is proportional to overvoltage V_ov; assuming a breakdown-voltage temperature coefficient of 54 mV/K and V_ov = 3 V, ΔG/G ≈ 0.054/3 ≈ 1.8%/K, so a 5 K change shifts peaks by about 9%. PMT gain follows G ∝ V^(k·n); with k = 0.7 and n = 10 stages, a 0.1% high-voltage ripple changes gain by about 0.7%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「增益穩定度、溫度漂移與監測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gain stability, temperature drift and monitoring", which statement holds?
options: 光產額最高的閃爍體在所有應用中都是最好的選擇。
SiPM 增益正比於過電壓 V_ov。
晶體越透明，光就一定越容易被光偵測器收集到。
optionsEn: The scintillator with the highest light yield is the best choice for every application.
SiPM gain is proportional to overvoltage V_ov.
The more transparent the crystal, the more easily the photodetector collects its light.
quiz.explanation: SiPM 增益正比於過電壓 V_ov；假設崩潰電壓溫度係數 54 mV/K、V_ov = 3 V，則 ΔG/G ≈ 0.054/3 ≈ 1.8%/K，溫度變化 5 K 使峰位移動約 9%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: SiPM gain is proportional to overvoltage V_ov; assuming a breakdown-voltage temperature coefficient of 54 mV/K and V_ov = 3 V, ΔG/G ≈ 0.054/3 ≈ 1.8%/K, so a 5 K change shifts peaks by about 9%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 增益穩定度、溫度漂移與監測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gain stability, temperature drift and monitoring: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「偏壓、溫度感測與 LED 監測」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bias, temperature sensing and LED monitor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把模組放入溫控箱，在 15 到 35 °C 間分階段量測 LED 峰與 ¹³⁷Cs 光電峰位置，求出各自的溫度係數；開啟偏壓補償後重複量測，確認峰位變化壓到 0.5%/K 以下；並以長時間記錄比較 LED 與放射源峰的比值，判斷漂移來自光偵測器還是晶體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place the module in a climate chamber and measure LED and ¹³⁷Cs photopeak positions in steps between 15 and 35 °C to obtain their temperature coefficients; repeat with bias compensation enabled and confirm peak movement below 0.5%/K; compare the ratio of LED and source peaks over long recordings to tell photodetector drift from crystal drift. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：白天與夜間的機房溫差讓未補償的 SiPM 系統峰位漂移近 10%，能量窗口固定時計數率出現日週期變化，被誤認為放射源或樣品的真實變化；若 LED 本身也隨溫度漂移，監測反而把錯誤寫入修正。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Day-night room temperature swings shift peaks by nearly 10% in an uncompensated SiPM system, so with a fixed energy window the count rate shows a daily cycle that is mistaken for a real change in source or sample; if the LED itself drifts with temperature, monitoring writes the error into the correction.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把模組放入溫控箱，在 15 到 35 °C 間分階段量測 LED 峰與 ¹³⁷Cs 光電峰位置，求出各自的溫度係數；開啟偏壓補償後重複量測，確認峰位變化壓到 0.5%/K 以下；並以長時間記錄比較 LED 與放射源峰的比值，判斷漂移來自光偵測器還是晶體。
knowledge.textEn: Place the module in a climate chamber and measure LED and ¹³⁷Cs photopeak positions in steps between 15 and 35 °C to obtain their temperature coefficients; repeat with bias compensation enabled and confirm peak movement below 0.5%/K; compare the ratio of LED and source peaks over long recordings to tell photodetector drift from crystal drift.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「增益穩定度、溫度漂移與監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gain stability, temperature drift and monitoring"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
SiPM 的輸出電荷永遠與入射光子數成正比。
把模組放入溫控箱，在 15 到 35 °C 間分階段量測 LED 峰與 ¹³⁷Cs 光電峰位置，求出各自的溫度係數。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A SiPM's output charge is always proportional to the number of incident photons.
Place the module in a climate chamber and measure LED and ¹³⁷Cs photopeak positions in steps between 15 and 35 °C to obtain their temperature coefficients.
quiz.explanation: 把模組放入溫控箱，在 15 到 35 °C 間分階段量測 LED 峰與 ¹³⁷Cs 光電峰位置，求出各自的溫度係數；開啟偏壓補償後重複量測，確認峰位變化壓到 0.5%/K 以下；並以長時間記錄比較 LED 與放射源峰的比值，判斷漂移來自光偵測器還是晶體。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place the module in a climate chamber and measure LED and ¹³⁷Cs photopeak positions in steps between 15 and 35 °C to obtain their temperature coefficients; repeat with bias compensation enabled and confirm peak movement below 0.5%/K; compare the ratio of LED and source peaks over long recordings to tell photodetector drift from crystal drift. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 增益穩定度、溫度漂移與監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gain stability, temperature drift and monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏壓、溫度感測與 LED 監測」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bias, temperature sensing and LED monitor” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 白天與夜間的機房溫差讓未補償的 SiPM 系統峰位漂移近 10%，能量窗口固定時計數率出現日週期變化，被誤認為放射源或樣品的真實變化；若 LED 本身也隨溫度漂移，監測反而把錯誤寫入修正。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Day-night room temperature swings shift peaks by nearly 10% in an uncompensated SiPM system, so with a fixed energy window the count rate shows a daily cycle that is mistaken for a real change in source or sample; if the LED itself drifts with temperature, monitoring writes the error into the correction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長時間運轉的系統因此需要溫度感測與偏壓補償，並以穩定的 LED 光脈衝或內建參考放射源持續監測增益，把光偵測器漂移與晶體變化分開判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Long-running systems therefore need temperature sensing with bias compensation and continuous gain monitoring with a stable LED pulser or an embedded reference source, distinguishing photodetector drift from crystal changes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「能量刻度做過一次之後，閃爍偵測器的峰位就會一直固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once calibrated, a scintillation detector's peak positions stay fixed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 白天與夜間的機房溫差讓未補償的 SiPM 系統峰位漂移近 10%，能量窗口固定時計數率出現日週期變化，被誤認為放射源或樣品的真實變化；若 LED 本身也隨溫度漂移，監測反而把錯誤寫入修正。
knowledge.textEn: Day-night room temperature swings shift peaks by nearly 10% in an uncompensated SiPM system, so with a fixed energy window the count rate shows a daily cycle that is mistaken for a real change in source or sample; if the LED itself drifts with temperature, monitoring writes the error into the correction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「增益穩定度、溫度漂移與監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gain stability, temperature drift and monitoring" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 白天與夜間的機房溫差讓未補償的 SiPM 系統峰位漂移近 10%，能量窗口固定時計數率出現日週期變化，被誤認為放射源或樣品的真實變化。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
衰減時間越長的閃爍體收集越多光，計時就越準。
optionsEn: Day-night room temperature swings shift peaks by nearly 10% in an uncompensated SiPM system, so with a fixed energy window the count rate shows a daily cycle that is mistaken for a real change in source or sample.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A scintillator with a longer decay collects more light and therefore times better.
quiz.explanation: 白天與夜間的機房溫差讓未補償的 SiPM 系統峰位漂移近 10%，能量窗口固定時計數率出現日週期變化，被誤認為放射源或樣品的真實變化；若 LED 本身也隨溫度漂移，監測反而把錯誤寫入修正。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Day-night room temperature swings shift peaks by nearly 10% in an uncompensated SiPM system, so with a fixed energy window the count rate shows a daily cycle that is mistaken for a real change in source or sample; if the LED itself drifts with temperature, monitoring writes the error into the correction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「計時解析度與符合量測」與「模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Timing resolution and coincidence measurement" and "Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 計時解析度與符合量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Timing resolution and coincidence measurement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「符合時間窗與時間拾取」如何決定閃爍體粒子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coincidence window and time pick-off” determines the key performance of “Scintillation particle detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閃爍事件的到達時間由最早幾個光電子決定，因此計時解析度取決於光產額、上升與衰減時間、光偵測器的單光子時間抖動以及晶體內光程差。兩個偵測器同時觸發才記錄的符合量測能抑制背景，但窗口內兩個無關事件也會被誤認為符合，形成隨機符合，其速率與兩路單計數率的乘積成正比。正子斷層掃描以 511 keV 光子對的符合定位反應線，飛行時間差進一步把事件定位在線上的某一段，所以符合時間解析度直接換算成影像訊雜比。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「符合時間窗與時間拾取」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The arrival time of a scintillation event is set by the first few photoelectrons, so timing resolution depends on light yield, rise and decay times, the photodetector's single-photon time jitter and optical path differences in the crystal. Coincidence counting, which records only when two detectors fire together, suppresses background, but two unrelated events within the window are also accepted as random coincidences at a rate proportional to the product of the two singles rates. Positron emission tomography locates lines of response from coincident 511 keV photon pairs, and the time-of-flight difference further confines the event to a segment of the line, so coincidence time resolution translates directly into image signal-to-noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coincidence window and time pick-off”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光統計下限 σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe)：LYSO τd = 40 ns、假設 τr = 0.1 ns、N_pe = 3920，σt ≈ 32 ps，符合時間解析度下限約 √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The photostatistical bound is σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe): for LYSO with τd = 40 ns, an assumed τr = 0.1 ns and N_pe = 3920, σt ≈ 32 ps and the coincidence-time-resolution bound is about √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「衰減時間越長的閃爍體收集越多光，計時就越準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A scintillator with a longer decay collects more light and therefore times better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「符合時間窗與時間拾取」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Coincidence window and time pick-off”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 計時解析度與符合量測
knowledge.text: 閃爍事件的到達時間由最早幾個光電子決定，因此計時解析度取決於光產額、上升與衰減時間、光偵測器的單光子時間抖動以及晶體內光程差。兩個偵測器同時觸發才記錄的符合量測能抑制背景，但窗口內兩個無關事件也會被誤認為符合，形成隨機符合，其速率與兩路單計數率的乘積成正比。
knowledge.textEn: The arrival time of a scintillation event is set by the first few photoelectrons, so timing resolution depends on light yield, rise and decay times, the photodetector's single-photon time jitter and optical path differences in the crystal. Coincidence counting, which records only when two detectors fire together, suppresses background, but two unrelated events within the window are also accepted as random coincidences at a rate proportional to the product of the two singles rates.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：衰減時間越長的閃爍體收集越多光，計時就越準。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A scintillator with a longer decay collects more light and therefore times better. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「計時解析度與符合量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Timing resolution and coincidence measurement" is correct?
options: 衰減時間越長的閃爍體收集越多光，計時就越準。
閃爍事件的到達時間由最早幾個光電子決定，因此計時解析度取決於光產額、上升與衰減時間、光偵測器的單光子時間抖動以及晶體內光程差。
符合量測的效率等於單一偵測器的效率。
optionsEn: A scintillator with a longer decay collects more light and therefore times better.

The arrival time of a scintillation event is set by the first few photoelectrons, so timing resolution depends on light yield, rise and decay times, the photodetector's single-photon time jitter and optical path differences in the crystal.
Coincidence efficiency equals single-detector efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 閃爍事件的到達時間由最早幾個光電子決定，因此計時解析度取決於光產額、上升與衰減時間、光偵測器的單光子時間抖動以及晶體內光程差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The arrival time of a scintillation event is set by the first few photoelectrons, so timing resolution depends on light yield, rise and decay times, the photodetector's single-photon time jitter and optical path differences in the crystal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 計時解析度與符合量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Timing resolution and coincidence measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「符合時間窗與時間拾取」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coincidence window and time pick-off” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光統計下限 σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe)：LYSO τd = 40 ns、假設 τr = 0.1 ns、N_pe = 3920，σt ≈ 32 ps，符合時間解析度下限約 √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM。實際 200 ps 對應定位 Δx = c·Δt/2 = 3 cm。隨機符合率 R = 2τ·r1·r2：2τ = 4 ns、單計數各 10⁵ cps 得 40 cps。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The photostatistical bound is σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe): for LYSO with τd = 40 ns, an assumed τr = 0.1 ns and N_pe = 3920, σt ≈ 32 ps and the coincidence-time-resolution bound is about √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM. A real 200 ps corresponds to Δx = c·Δt/2 = 3 cm. The random rate is R = 2τ·r1·r2; with 2τ = 4 ns and 10⁵ cps singles on each side, R = 40 cps. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 ²²Na 正子源置於兩個相同模組之間，記錄時間差分布並擬合半高寬得到符合時間解析度，再除以 √2 得單一偵測器值；改變時間拾取門檻（前緣或恆比鑑別）找最佳點；以延遲窗口法量測隨機符合率，與 2τ·r1·r2 預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place a ²²Na positron source between two identical modules, record the time-difference distribution and fit its FWHM as the coincidence time resolution, dividing by √2 for a single detector; vary the time pick-off threshold for leading-edge or constant-fraction discrimination to find the optimum; measure randoms with a delayed window and compare with the 2τ·r1·r2 prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光統計下限 σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe)：LYSO τd = 40 ns、假設 τr = 0.1 ns、N_pe = 3920，σt ≈ 32 ps，符合時間解析度下限約 √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM。實際 200 ps 對應定位 Δx = c·Δt/2 = 3 cm。隨機符合率 R = 2τ·r1·r2：2τ = 4 ns、單計數各 10⁵ cps 得 40 cps。
knowledge.textEn: The photostatistical bound is σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe): for LYSO with τd = 40 ns, an assumed τr = 0.1 ns and N_pe = 3920, σt ≈ 32 ps and the coincidence-time-resolution bound is about √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM. A real 200 ps corresponds to Δx = c·Δt/2 = 3 cm. The random rate is R = 2τ·r1·r2; with 2τ = 4 ns and 10⁵ cps singles on each side, R = 40 cps.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「計時解析度與符合量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Timing resolution and coincidence measurement", which statement holds?
options: 同樣沉積 1 MeV，任何粒子在閃爍體中產生的光都一樣多。
SiPM 的輸出電荷永遠與入射光子數成正比。
光統計下限 σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe)：LYSO τd = 40 ns、假設 τr = 0.1 ns、N_pe = 3920，σt ≈ 32 ps，符合時間解析度下限約 √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM。
optionsEn: Any particle depositing 1 MeV produces the same amount of light in a scintillator.
A SiPM's output charge is always proportional to the number of incident photons.

The photostatistical bound is σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe): for LYSO with τd = 40 ns, an assumed τr = 0.1 ns and N_pe = 3920, σt ≈ 32 ps and the coincidence-time-resolution bound is about √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM.
quiz.explanation: 光統計下限 σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe)：LYSO τd = 40 ns、假設 τr = 0.1 ns、N_pe = 3920，σt ≈ 32 ps，符合時間解析度下限約 √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The photostatistical bound is σt ≈ √(τr·τd/N_pe): for LYSO with τd = 40 ns, an assumed τr = 0.1 ns and N_pe = 3920, σt ≈ 32 ps and the coincidence-time-resolution bound is about √2×2.355×32 ≈ 106 ps FWHM. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 計時解析度與符合量測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Timing resolution and coincidence measurement: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「符合時間窗與時間拾取」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Coincidence window and time pick-off” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 ²²Na 正子源置於兩個相同模組之間，記錄時間差分布並擬合半高寬得到符合時間解析度，再除以 √2 得單一偵測器值；改變時間拾取門檻（前緣或恆比鑑別）找最佳點；以延遲窗口法量測隨機符合率，與 2τ·r1·r2 預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place a ²²Na positron source between two identical modules, record the time-difference distribution and fit its FWHM as the coincidence time resolution, dividing by √2 for a single detector; vary the time pick-off threshold for leading-edge or constant-fraction discrimination to find the optimum; measure randoms with a delayed window and compare with the 2τ·r1·r2 prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：前緣鑑別在脈衝幅度變化大時產生時間游走，造成與能量相關的時間偏移，符合峰變寬且不對稱；符合窗口開得過寬時，高計數率下隨機符合超過真符合，影像對比與定量全部失真。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Leading-edge discrimination with widely varying pulse amplitudes produces time walk, an energy-dependent timing shift that broadens and skews the coincidence peak; an overly wide coincidence window lets randoms exceed true coincidences at high rates, distorting image contrast and quantification.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 ²²Na 正子源置於兩個相同模組之間，記錄時間差分布並擬合半高寬得到符合時間解析度，再除以 √2 得單一偵測器值；改變時間拾取門檻（前緣或恆比鑑別）找最佳點；以延遲窗口法量測隨機符合率，與 2τ·r1·r2 預測比較。
knowledge.textEn: Place a ²²Na positron source between two identical modules, record the time-difference distribution and fit its FWHM as the coincidence time resolution, dividing by √2 for a single detector; vary the time pick-off threshold for leading-edge or constant-fraction discrimination to find the optimum; measure randoms with a delayed window and compare with the 2τ·r1·r2 prediction.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「計時解析度與符合量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Timing resolution and coincidence measurement"?
options: 以 ²²Na 正子源置於兩個相同模組之間，記錄時間差分布並擬合半高寬得到符合時間解析度，再除以 √2 得單一偵測器值。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要換成量子效率更高的光偵測器，NaI(Tl) 的解析度就能無限改善。
optionsEn: Place a ²²Na positron source between two identical modules, record the time-difference distribution and fit its FWHM as the coincidence time resolution, dividing by √2 for a single detector.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A higher-efficiency photodetector can improve NaI(Tl) resolution without limit.
quiz.explanation: 以 ²²Na 正子源置於兩個相同模組之間，記錄時間差分布並擬合半高寬得到符合時間解析度，再除以 √2 得單一偵測器值；改變時間拾取門檻（前緣或恆比鑑別）找最佳點；以延遲窗口法量測隨機符合率，與 2τ·r1·r2 預測比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place a ²²Na positron source between two identical modules, record the time-difference distribution and fit its FWHM as the coincidence time resolution, dividing by √2 for a single detector; vary the time pick-off threshold for leading-edge or constant-fraction discrimination to find the optimum; measure randoms with a delayed window and compare with the 2τ·r1·r2 prediction. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 計時解析度與符合量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Timing resolution and coincidence measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「符合時間窗與時間拾取」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Coincidence window and time pick-off” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 前緣鑑別在脈衝幅度變化大時產生時間游走，造成與能量相關的時間偏移，符合峰變寬且不對稱；符合窗口開得過寬時，高計數率下隨機符合超過真符合，影像對比與定量全部失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Leading-edge discrimination with widely varying pulse amplitudes produces time walk, an energy-dependent timing shift that broadens and skews the coincidence peak; an overly wide coincidence window lets randoms exceed true coincidences at high rates, distorting image contrast and quantification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：正子斷層掃描以 511 keV 光子對的符合定位反應線，飛行時間差進一步把事件定位在線上的某一段，所以符合時間解析度直接換算成影像訊雜比。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Positron emission tomography locates lines of response from coincident 511 keV photon pairs, and the time-of-flight difference further confines the event to a segment of the line, so coincidence time resolution translates directly into image signal-to-noise.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「衰減時間越長的閃爍體收集越多光，計時就越準。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A scintillator with a longer decay collects more light and therefore times better." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 前緣鑑別在脈衝幅度變化大時產生時間游走，造成與能量相關的時間偏移，符合峰變寬且不對稱；符合窗口開得過寬時，高計數率下隨機符合超過真符合，影像對比與定量全部失真。
knowledge.textEn: Leading-edge discrimination with widely varying pulse amplitudes produces time walk, an energy-dependent timing shift that broadens and skews the coincidence peak; an overly wide coincidence window lets randoms exceed true coincidences at high rates, distorting image contrast and quantification.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「計時解析度與符合量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Timing resolution and coincidence measurement" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
前緣鑑別在脈衝幅度變化大時產生時間游走，造成與能量相關的時間偏移，符合峰變寬且不對稱；符合窗口開得過寬時，高計數率下隨機符合超過真符合，影像對比與定量全部失真。
符合量測的效率等於單一偵測器的效率。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Leading-edge discrimination with widely varying pulse amplitudes produces time walk, an energy-dependent timing shift that broadens and skews the coincidence peak.
Coincidence efficiency equals single-detector efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 前緣鑑別在脈衝幅度變化大時產生時間游走，造成與能量相關的時間偏移，符合峰變寬且不對稱；符合窗口開得過寬時，高計數率下隨機符合超過真符合，影像對比與定量全部失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Leading-edge discrimination with widely varying pulse amplitudes produces time walk, an energy-dependent timing shift that broadens and skews the coincidence peak; an overly wide coincidence window lets randoms exceed true coincidences at high rates, distorting image contrast and quantification. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偵測器模組與驗收紀錄」如何決定閃爍體粒子偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Detector module and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Scintillation particle detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把晶體、反射層、光偵測器、前端電子與冷卻組成模組時，晶體厚度與材料必須先滿足攔截效率，再兼顧光收集、計時與成本；符合量測的效率是單一偵測器效率的平方，所以厚度不足的代價會被放大。量產時每個模組的增益、解析度與時間偏移都不同，需要逐模組校正表，並以均勻性、死時間、計數率線性與長期穩定度作為驗收項目，連同包覆規格與材料批號寫入交接文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偵測器模組與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When crystals, reflectors, photodetectors, front-end electronics and cooling are assembled into a module, crystal material and thickness must first meet stopping efficiency before light collection, timing and cost are balanced; coincidence efficiency is the square of single-detector efficiency, so insufficient thickness is penalised twice. In production every module differs in gain, resolution and time offset and needs its own calibration table, and acceptance covers uniformity, dead time, count-rate linearity and long-term stability, filed with wrapping specifications and material batch numbers in the handoff record. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Detector module and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：攔截機率 P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stopping probability is P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「符合量測的效率等於單一偵測器的效率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Coincidence efficiency equals single-detector efficiency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「偵測器模組與驗收紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Detector module and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接
knowledge.titleEn: Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff
knowledge.text: 把晶體、反射層、光偵測器、前端電子與冷卻組成模組時，晶體厚度與材料必須先滿足攔截效率，再兼顧光收集、計時與成本；符合量測的效率是單一偵測器效率的平方，所以厚度不足的代價會被放大。量產時每個模組的增益、解析度與時間偏移都不同，需要逐模組校正表，並以均勻性、死時間、計數率線性與長期穩定度作為驗收項目，連同包覆規格與材料批號寫入交接文件。
knowledge.textEn: When crystals, reflectors, photodetectors, front-end electronics and cooling are assembled into a module, crystal material and thickness must first meet stopping efficiency before light collection, timing and cost are balanced; coincidence efficiency is the square of single-detector efficiency, so insufficient thickness is penalised twice. In production every module differs in gain, resolution and time offset and needs its own calibration table, and acceptance covers uniformity, dead time, count-rate linearity and long-term stability, filed with wrapping specifications and material batch numbers in the handoff record.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：符合量測的效率等於單一偵測器的效率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Coincidence efficiency equals single-detector efficiency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff" is correct?
options: 符合量測的效率等於單一偵測器的效率。
光產額最高的閃爍體在所有應用中都是最好的選擇。
把晶體、反射層、光偵測器、前端電子與冷卻組成模組時，晶體厚度與材料必須先滿足攔截效率，再兼顧光收集、計時與成本。
optionsEn: Coincidence efficiency equals single-detector efficiency.
The scintillator with the highest light yield is the best choice for every application.

When crystals, reflectors, photodetectors, front-end electronics and cooling are assembled into a module, crystal material and thickness must first meet stopping efficiency before light collection, timing and cost are balanced.
quiz.explanation: 把晶體、反射層、光偵測器、前端電子與冷卻組成模組時，晶體厚度與材料必須先滿足攔截效率，再兼顧光收集、計時與成本；符合量測的效率是單一偵測器效率的平方，所以厚度不足的代價會被放大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When crystals, reflectors, photodetectors, front-end electronics and cooling are assembled into a module, crystal material and thickness must first meet stopping efficiency before light collection, timing and cost are balanced; coincidence efficiency is the square of single-detector efficiency, so insufficient thickness is penalised twice. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偵測器模組與驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Detector module and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：攔截機率 P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt)。以 511 keV 衰減長度約 LYSO 11.4 mm、BGO 10.4 mm、NaI(Tl) 29 mm（教學近似）計，20 mm 晶體單側 P 分別約 0.83、0.85、0.50，成對符合效率 P² 約 0.68、0.73、0.25。NaI 要達到相同符合效率需要厚得多的晶體。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stopping probability is P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt). Taking 511 keV attenuation lengths of about 11.4 mm for LYSO, 10.4 mm for BGO and 29 mm for NaI(Tl) as teaching approximations, a 20 mm crystal stops about 0.83, 0.85 and 0.50 on one side, and pair coincidence efficiency P² is about 0.68, 0.73 and 0.25. NaI needs a much thicker crystal for the same coincidence efficiency. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知活度的點源在多個位置量測每個模組的計數率，扣除幾何因子後與蒙地卡羅模擬的攔截效率比較；逐步提高源活度量測計數率線性與死時間；連續運轉一週記錄峰位、解析度與時間偏移的漂移，並把逐模組校正表與量測條件一起交接。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each module's count rate with a point source of known activity at several positions, correct for geometry and compare with Monte Carlo stopping efficiency; raise source activity step by step to measure count-rate linearity and dead time; run continuously for a week logging drift of peak position, resolution and time offset, and hand over per-module calibration tables together with the measurement conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 攔截機率 P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt)。以 511 keV 衰減長度約 LYSO 11.4 mm、BGO 10.4 mm、NaI(Tl) 29 mm（教學近似）計，20 mm 晶體單側 P 分別約 0.83、0.85、0.50，成對符合效率 P² 約 0.68、0.73、0.25。NaI 要達到相同符合效率需要厚得多的晶體。
knowledge.textEn: Stopping probability is P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt). Taking 511 keV attenuation lengths of about 11.4 mm for LYSO, 10.4 mm for BGO and 29 mm for NaI(Tl) as teaching approximations, a 20 mm crystal stops about 0.83, 0.85 and 0.50 on one side, and pair coincidence efficiency P² is about 0.68, 0.73 and 0.25. NaI needs a much thicker crystal for the same coincidence efficiency.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff", which statement holds?
options: 攔截機率 P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt)。
晶體越透明，光就一定越容易被光偵測器收集到。
只要換成量子效率更高的光偵測器，NaI(Tl) 的解析度就能無限改善。
optionsEn: Stopping probability is P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt).
The more transparent the crystal, the more easily the photodetector collects its light.
A higher-efficiency photodetector can improve NaI(Tl) resolution without limit.
quiz.explanation: 攔截機率 P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Stopping probability is P = 1 − exp(−x/λatt). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「偵測器模組與驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Detector module and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知活度的點源在多個位置量測每個模組的計數率，扣除幾何因子後與蒙地卡羅模擬的攔截效率比較；逐步提高源活度量測計數率線性與死時間；連續運轉一週記錄峰位、解析度與時間偏移的漂移，並把逐模組校正表與量測條件一起交接。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each module's count rate with a point source of known activity at several positions, correct for geometry and compare with Monte Carlo stopping efficiency; raise source activity step by step to measure count-rate linearity and dead time; run continuously for a week logging drift of peak position, resolution and time offset, and hand over per-module calibration tables together with the measurement conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了降低成本選用較薄晶體，單側效率只下降一成多，但符合效率下降二成以上，系統靈敏度不足才在臨床或實驗驗收時被發現；缺少逐模組校正表時，更換單一模組就會在影像中留下環狀假影。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Choosing thinner crystals to save cost lowers single-side efficiency by only a little over a tenth but cuts coincidence efficiency by over a fifth, and the sensitivity shortfall appears only at clinical or experimental acceptance; without per-module calibration tables, replacing a single module leaves ring artefacts in the image.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知活度的點源在多個位置量測每個模組的計數率，扣除幾何因子後與蒙地卡羅模擬的攔截效率比較；逐步提高源活度量測計數率線性與死時間；連續運轉一週記錄峰位、解析度與時間偏移的漂移，並把逐模組校正表與量測條件一起交接。
knowledge.textEn: Measure each module's count rate with a point source of known activity at several positions, correct for geometry and compare with Monte Carlo stopping efficiency; raise source activity step by step to measure count-rate linearity and dead time; run continuously for a week logging drift of peak position, resolution and time offset, and hand over per-module calibration tables together with the measurement conditions.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以已知活度的點源在多個位置量測每個模組的計數率，扣除幾何因子後與蒙地卡羅模擬的攔截效率比較。
能量刻度做過一次之後，閃爍偵測器的峰位就會一直固定。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure each module's count rate with a point source of known activity at several positions, correct for geometry and compare with Monte Carlo stopping efficiency.
Once calibrated, a scintillation detector's peak positions stay fixed.
quiz.explanation: 以已知活度的點源在多個位置量測每個模組的計數率，扣除幾何因子後與蒙地卡羅模擬的攔截效率比較；逐步提高源活度量測計數率線性與死時間；連續運轉一週記錄峰位、解析度與時間偏移的漂移，並把逐模組校正表與量測條件一起交接。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure each module's count rate with a point source of known activity at several positions, correct for geometry and compare with Monte Carlo stopping efficiency; raise source activity step by step to measure count-rate linearity and dead time; run continuously for a week logging drift of peak position, resolution and time offset, and hand over per-module calibration tables together with the measurement conditions. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偵測器模組與驗收紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Detector module and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了降低成本選用較薄晶體，單側效率只下降一成多，但符合效率下降二成以上，系統靈敏度不足才在臨床或實驗驗收時被發現；缺少逐模組校正表時，更換單一模組就會在影像中留下環狀假影。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing thinner crystals to save cost lowers single-side efficiency by only a little over a tenth but cuts coincidence efficiency by over a fifth, and the sensitivity shortfall appears only at clinical or experimental acceptance; without per-module calibration tables, replacing a single module leaves ring artefacts in the image. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量產時每個模組的增益、解析度與時間偏移都不同，需要逐模組校正表，並以均勻性、死時間、計數率線性與長期穩定度作為驗收項目，連同包覆規格與材料批號寫入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In production every module differs in gain, resolution and time offset and needs its own calibration table, and acceptance covers uniformity, dead time, count-rate linearity and long-term stability, filed with wrapping specifications and material batch numbers in the handoff record.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「符合量測的效率等於單一偵測器的效率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Coincidence efficiency equals single-detector efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了降低成本選用較薄晶體，單側效率只下降一成多，但符合效率下降二成以上，系統靈敏度不足才在臨床或實驗驗收時被發現；缺少逐模組校正表時，更換單一模組就會在影像中留下環狀假影。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模組整合、攔截效率與驗收交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Module integration, stopping efficiency and acceptance handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
光產額最高的閃爍體在所有應用中都是最好的選擇。
為了降低成本選用較薄晶體，單側效率只下降一成多，但符合效率下降二成以上，系統靈敏度不足才在臨床或實驗驗收時被發現。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The scintillator with the highest light yield is the best choice for every application.

title: 矽像素粒子追蹤器
summary: 以 CMS 與 ALICE 的像素追蹤器為參照，從最小游離粒子在 285 µm 矽中釋放約兩萬兩千個電子出發，把空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、混合式與 MAPS 架構、輻射損傷、位置解析度、物質量、觸發緩衝與軌跡式對準串成一份可驗收、可交接的追蹤器工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Using the CMS and ALICE pixel trackers as references, start from the roughly 22,000 electrons a minimum-ionising particle frees in 285 µm of silicon, then connect depletion and Lorentz drift, hybrid versus MAPS architectures, radiation damage, spatial resolution, material budget, trigger buffering and track-based alignment into an acceptable, transferable tracker engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 加速器、光束線與粒子偵測器

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 內層模組設計練習：假設高亮度型內層採 50×50 µm² 像素、150 µm 厚感測器與 400×384 像素的讀出晶片。薄感測器取最可能值 72 e⁻/µm，訊號 MPV ≈ 72 × 150 = 10,800 e⁻；門檻 1,000 e⁻ 為 MPV 的 9.3%，雜訊 80 e⁻ 時門檻與雜訊比為 12.5。二元解析度 50/√12 ≈ 14.4 µm；感測器物質量 150/93,700 ≈ 0.16% X₀。未照射時 3 kΩ·cm 基材的空乏電壓按 d² 縮放為 95 × (150/285)² ≈ 26 V；照射到 Φ_eq = 2×10¹⁵ cm⁻² 後 N_eff ≈ 3×10¹³ cm⁻³，空乏電壓約 510 V。每像素體積 3.75×10⁻⁷ cm³，20 °C 漏電流 = 4×10⁻¹⁷ × 2×10¹⁵ × 3.75×10⁻⁷ = 30 nA，冷到 −15 °C 乘以 0.030 得 0.90 nA；整顆晶片 153,600 像素約 0.14 mA，500 V 偏壓下約 0.07 W。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實驗的規格。
workedExample.textEn: Inner-module design exercise: assume a high-luminosity inner layer with 50×50 µm² pixels, a 150 µm sensor and a 400×384-pixel readout chip. Taking a most probable 72 e⁻/µm for thin sensors, the signal MPV ≈ 72 × 150 = 10,800 e⁻; a 1,000 e⁻ threshold is 9.3% of the MPV, and with 80 e⁻ noise the threshold-to-noise ratio is 12.5. Binary resolution is 50/√12 ≈ 14.4 µm and sensor material is 150/93,700 ≈ 0.16% X₀. Unirradiated 3 kΩ·cm bulk depletes at 95 × (150/285)² ≈ 26 V by d² scaling; after Φ_eq = 2×10¹⁵ cm⁻², N_eff ≈ 3×10¹³ cm⁻³ and the depletion voltage is about 510 V. Each pixel has a volume of 3.75×10⁻⁷ cm³, so leakage at 20 °C is 4×10⁻¹⁷ × 2×10¹⁵ × 3.75×10⁻⁷ = 30 nA, and cooling to −15 °C multiplies by 0.030 to give 0.90 nA; the 153,600-pixel chip draws about 0.14 mA, about 0.07 W at 500 V. Values are teaching assumptions, not any experiment's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號」與「空乏電壓、漂移時間與 Lorentz 角」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal" and "Depletion voltage, drift time and the Lorentz angle": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」如何決定矽像素粒子追蹤器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “MIP ionisation track and signal charge” determines the key performance of “Silicon-pixel particle trackers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 帶電粒子穿過矽時以游離方式損失能量，最小游離粒子（MIP）的平均能損約 1.66 MeV·cm²/g，每產生一對電子—電洞需要 3.62 eV。少數高能 δ 電子會一次帶走大量能量，使能損分佈成為右尾很長的 Landau 分佈，最可能值只有平均值的約七成，因此門檻與信噪比必須用最可能值而非平均值設計。像素追蹤器的任務，就是在 LHC 25 ns 的束團間隔內把這數千到兩萬多個電子收集進讀出電路，並判斷它是否越過門檻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A charged particle crossing silicon loses energy by ionisation; a minimum-ionising particle (MIP) deposits on average about 1.66 MeV·cm²/g, and each electron–hole pair costs 3.62 eV. A few energetic delta electrons occasionally carry away a large share of the energy, so the loss follows a Landau distribution with a long upper tail whose most probable value is only about 70% of the mean; thresholds and signal-to-noise must therefore be designed on the most probable value, not the mean. The pixel tracker's job is to collect these several thousand to twenty-odd thousand electrons into the readout circuit within the 25 ns LHC bunch spacing and decide whether they cross threshold. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MIP ionisation track and signal charge”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平均能損 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm，除以 3.62 eV 得平均約 107 對/µm；最可能值約 78 對/µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mean loss 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm; dividing by 3.62 eV gives about 107 pairs/µm on average, with a most probable value near 78 pairs/µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “MIP ionisation track and signal charge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號
knowledge.titleEn: Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal
knowledge.text: 帶電粒子穿過矽時以游離方式損失能量，最小游離粒子（MIP）的平均能損約 1.66 MeV·cm²/g，每產生一對電子—電洞需要 3.62 eV。少數高能 δ 電子會一次帶走大量能量，使能損分佈成為右尾很長的 Landau 分佈，最可能值只有平均值的約七成，因此門檻與信噪比必須用最可能值而非平均值設計。
knowledge.textEn: A charged particle crossing silicon loses energy by ionisation; a minimum-ionising particle (MIP) deposits on average about 1.66 MeV·cm²/g, and each electron–hole pair costs 3.62 eV. A few energetic delta electrons occasionally carry away a large share of the energy, so the loss follows a Landau distribution with a long upper tail whose most probable value is only about 70% of the mean; thresholds and signal-to-noise must therefore be designed on the most probable value, not the mean.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal" is correct?
options: 每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。
帶電粒子穿過矽時以游離方式損失能量，最小游離粒子（MIP）的平均能損約 1.66 MeV·cm²/g，每產生一對電子—電洞需要 3.62 eV。
只要接上偏壓，整片感測器就全部是靈敏區，空乏深度與偏壓無關。
optionsEn: Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed.
A charged particle crossing silicon loses energy by ionisation.
Once bias is applied the whole sensor is sensitive, and depletion depth does not depend on voltage.
quiz.explanation: 帶電粒子穿過矽時以游離方式損失能量，最小游離粒子（MIP）的平均能損約 1.66 MeV·cm²/g，每產生一對電子—電洞需要 3.62 eV。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A charged particle crossing silicon loses energy by ionisation; a minimum-ionising particle (MIP) deposits on average about 1.66 MeV·cm²/g, and each electron–hole pair costs 3.62 eV. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “MIP ionisation track and signal charge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平均能損 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm，除以 3.62 eV 得平均約 107 對/µm；最可能值約 78 對/µm。285 µm 感測器：MPV ≈ 78 × 285 ≈ 22,200 e⁻ ≈ 3.6 fC，平均值約 30,500 e⁻。若前端雜訊為 120 e⁻ ENC、門檻 1,800 e⁻，則 MPV 信噪比 ≈ 185，門檻只佔 MPV 的 8%，同時是雜訊的 15 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mean loss 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm; dividing by 3.62 eV gives about 107 pairs/µm on average, with a most probable value near 78 pairs/µm. For a 285 µm sensor the MPV ≈ 78 × 285 ≈ 22,200 e⁻ ≈ 3.6 fC, while the mean is about 30,500 e⁻. With 120 e⁻ ENC front-end noise and a 1,800 e⁻ threshold, the MPV signal-to-noise is about 185 and the threshold is only 8% of the MPV yet 15 times the noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 ⁹⁰Sr β 源（高能端電子近似 MIP）或測試束照射模組，先用讀出晶片內建的校正注入電容把 ToT 或 ADC 值換成電子數，再對叢集電荷擬合 Landau 與 Gauss 的摺積求 MPV 與寬度，與 22,000 e⁻ 的預期比較；同時在無照射時掃描門檻取得每個像素的 S 曲線，由其寬度求 ENC、由其中點求實際門檻分佈。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Irradiate the module with a ⁹⁰Sr beta source, whose high-energy electrons approximate MIPs, or with a test beam; first convert ToT or ADC values into electrons with the readout chip's built-in calibration-injection capacitor, then fit a Landau convolved with a Gaussian to the cluster charge to obtain MPV and width and compare with the expected 22,000 e⁻.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 平均能損 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm，除以 3.62 eV 得平均約 107 對/µm；最可能值約 78 對/µm。285 µm 感測器：MPV ≈ 78 × 285 ≈ 22,200 e⁻ ≈ 3.6 fC，平均值約 30,500 e⁻。若前端雜訊為 120 e⁻ ENC、門檻 1,800 e⁻，則 MPV 信噪比 ≈ 185，門檻只佔 MPV 的 8%，同時是雜訊的 15 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Mean loss 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm; dividing by 3.62 eV gives about 107 pairs/µm on average, with a most probable value near 78 pairs/µm. For a 285 µm sensor the MPV ≈ 78 × 285 ≈ 22,200 e⁻ ≈ 3.6 fC, while the mean is about 30,500 e⁻. With 120 e⁻ ENC front-end noise and a 1,800 e⁻ threshold, the MPV signal-to-noise is about 185 and the threshold is only 8% of the MPV yet 15 times the noise.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal", which statement holds?
options: 漏電流只取決於累積的輻射劑量，與運轉溫度無關。
像素越小，頂點解析度一定越好，與物質量無關。
平均能損 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm，除以 3.62 eV 得平均約 107 對/µm。
optionsEn: Leakage current depends only on accumulated radiation dose, not on operating temperature.
Smaller pixels always give better vertex resolution regardless of material.
Mean loss 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm.
quiz.explanation: 平均能損 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm，除以 3.62 eV 得平均約 107 對/µm；最可能值約 78 對/µm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean loss 1.664 MeV·cm²/g × 2.329 g/cm³ = 3.88 MeV/cm = 388 eV/µm; dividing by 3.62 eV gives about 107 pairs/µm on average, with a most probable value near 78 pairs/µm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “MIP ionisation track and signal charge” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 ⁹⁰Sr β 源（高能端電子近似 MIP）或測試束照射模組，先用讀出晶片內建的校正注入電容把 ToT 或 ADC 值換成電子數，再對叢集電荷擬合 Landau 與 Gauss 的摺積求 MPV 與寬度，與 22,000 e⁻ 的預期比較；同時在無照射時掃描門檻取得每個像素的 S 曲線，由其寬度求 ENC、由其中點求實際門檻分佈。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Irradiate the module with a ⁹⁰Sr beta source, whose high-energy electrons approximate MIPs, or with a test beam; first convert ToT or ADC values into electrons with the readout chip's built-in calibration-injection capacitor, then fit a Landau convolved with a Gaussian to the cluster charge to obtain MPV and width and compare with the expected 22,000 e⁻. Without beam, scan the threshold to obtain each pixel's S-curve, taking ENC from its width and the true threshold distribution from its midpoints. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把平均值 30,500 e⁻ 當成設計值，門檻與增益看似留有大量餘裕；實際上落在 MPV 附近或更低的事件（斜入射把電荷分給相鄰像素、照射後電荷收集下降）會有一部分掉到門檻以下，命中效率從 99% 以上滑落，軌跡出現缺點，低動量軌跡的重建效率下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Designing on the 30,500 e⁻ mean makes threshold and gain look comfortably margined; in reality events near or below the MPV, such as inclined tracks sharing charge with neighbours or irradiated sensors collecting less, partly fall below threshold, hit efficiency slips from above 99%, tracks acquire missing hits and low-momentum reconstruction efficiency drops.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 ⁹⁰Sr β 源（高能端電子近似 MIP）或測試束照射模組，先用讀出晶片內建的校正注入電容把 ToT 或 ADC 值換成電子數，再對叢集電荷擬合 Landau 與 Gauss 的摺積求 MPV 與寬度，與 22,000 e⁻ 的預期比較；同時在無照射時掃描門檻取得每個像素的 S 曲線，由其寬度求 ENC、由其中點求實際門檻分佈。
knowledge.textEn: Irradiate the module with a ⁹⁰Sr beta source, whose high-energy electrons approximate MIPs, or with a test beam; first convert ToT or ADC values into electrons with the readout chip's built-in calibration-injection capacitor, then fit a Landau convolved with a Gaussian to the cluster charge to obtain MPV and width and compare with the expected 22,000 e⁻. Without beam, scan the threshold to obtain each pixel's S-curve, taking ENC from its width and the true threshold distribution from its midpoints.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal"?
options: 以 ⁹⁰Sr β 源（高能端電子近似 MIP）或測試束照射模組，先用讀出晶片內建的校正注入電容把 ToT 或 ADC 值換成電子數，再對叢集電荷擬合 Landau 與 Gauss 的摺積求 MPV 與寬度，與 22,000 e⁻ 的預期比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
感測器效率 99.9%，整個像素系統的效率就是 99.9%。
optionsEn: Irradiate the module with a ⁹⁰Sr beta source, whose high-energy electrons approximate MIPs, or with a test beam.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the sensor is 99.9% efficient, the whole pixel system is 99.9% efficient.
quiz.explanation: 以 ⁹⁰Sr β 源（高能端電子近似 MIP）或測試束照射模組，先用讀出晶片內建的校正注入電容把 ToT 或 ADC 值換成電子數，再對叢集電荷擬合 Landau 與 Gauss 的摺積求 MPV 與寬度，與 22,000 e⁻ 的預期比較；同時在無照射時掃描門檻取得每個像素的 S 曲線，由其寬度求 ENC、由其中點求實際門檻分佈。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Irradiate the module with a ⁹⁰Sr beta source, whose high-energy electrons approximate MIPs, or with a test beam; first convert ToT or ADC values into electrons with the readout chip's built-in calibration-injection capacitor, then fit a Landau convolved with a Gaussian to the cluster charge to obtain MPV and width and compare with the expected 22,000 e⁻. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “MIP ionisation track and signal charge” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把平均值 30,500 e⁻ 當成設計值，門檻與增益看似留有大量餘裕；實際上落在 MPV 附近或更低的事件（斜入射把電荷分給相鄰像素、照射後電荷收集下降）會有一部分掉到門檻以下，命中效率從 99% 以上滑落，軌跡出現缺點，低動量軌跡的重建效率下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Designing on the 30,500 e⁻ mean makes threshold and gain look comfortably margined; in reality events near or below the MPV, such as inclined tracks sharing charge with neighbours or irradiated sensors collecting less, partly fall below threshold, hit efficiency slips from above 99%, tracks acquire missing hits and low-momentum reconstruction efficiency drops. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：像素追蹤器的任務，就是在 LHC 25 ns 的束團間隔內把這數千到兩萬多個電子收集進讀出電路，並判斷它是否越過門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The pixel tracker's job is to collect these several thousand to twenty-odd thousand electrons into the readout circuit within the 25 ns LHC bunch spacing and decide whether they cross threshold.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每顆穿過像素的粒子都產生同樣多的電子，訊號是固定值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every particle crossing a pixel frees the same number of electrons, so the signal is fixed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把平均值 30,500 e⁻ 當成設計值，門檻與增益看似留有大量餘裕；實際上落在 MPV 附近或更低的事件（斜入射把電荷分給相鄰像素、照射後電荷收集下降）會有一部分掉到門檻以下，命中效率從 99% 以上滑落，軌跡出現缺點，低動量軌跡的重建效率下降。
knowledge.textEn: Designing on the 30,500 e⁻ mean makes threshold and gain look comfortably margined; in reality events near or below the MPV, such as inclined tracks sharing charge with neighbours or irradiated sensors collecting less, partly fall below threshold, hit efficiency slips from above 99%, tracks acquire missing hits and low-momentum reconstruction efficiency drops.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「最小游離粒子能損與 Landau 訊號」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Minimum-ionising energy loss and the Landau signal" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若把平均值 30,500 e⁻ 當成設計值，門檻與增益看似留有大量餘裕。
只要接上偏壓，整片感測器就全部是靈敏區，空乏深度與偏壓無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Designing on the 30,500 e⁻ mean makes threshold and gain look comfortably margined.
Once bias is applied the whole sensor is sensitive, and depletion depth does not depend on voltage.
quiz.explanation: 若把平均值 30,500 e⁻ 當成設計值，門檻與增益看似留有大量餘裕；實際上落在 MPV 附近或更低的事件（斜入射把電荷分給相鄰像素、照射後電荷收集下降）會有一部分掉到門檻以下，命中效率從 99% 以上滑落，軌跡出現缺點，低動量軌跡的重建效率下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing on the 30,500 e⁻ mean makes threshold and gain look comfortably margined; in reality events near or below the MPV, such as inclined tracks sharing charge with neighbours or irradiated sensors collecting less, partly fall below threshold, hit efficiency slips from above 99%, tracks acquire missing hits and low-momentum reconstruction efficiency drops. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 空乏電壓、漂移時間與 Lorentz 角：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Depletion voltage, drift time and the Lorentz angle: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「反向偏壓空乏區」如何決定矽像素粒子追蹤器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reverse-biased depletion region” determines the key performance of “Silicon-pixel particle trackers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 矽感測器是一個大面積的反向偏壓 p–n 二極體，只有空乏區內產生的電荷會在電場中漂移並在讀出電極感應出訊號，未空乏區的電荷只能慢慢擴散甚至被複合，所以感測器必須全空乏或至少讓集電側空乏。空乏深度隨偏壓的平方根增加，全空乏電壓與有效摻雜濃度及厚度平方成正比。在 CMS 3.8 T 螺線管磁場中，漂移的電子受 Lorentz 力偏轉，使電荷橫向散到相鄰像素；工程上反而利用這個偏轉做電荷分享內插。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反向偏壓空乏區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A silicon sensor is a large-area reverse-biased p–n diode: only charge generated inside the depleted region drifts in the field and induces a signal on the readout electrode, whereas charge in undepleted silicon diffuses slowly or recombines, so the sensor must be fully depleted or at least depleted on the collecting side. Depletion depth grows with the square root of bias, and the full-depletion voltage scales with effective doping and the square of thickness. In the 3.8 T CMS solenoid field the drifting electrons are deflected by the Lorentz force and spread charge sideways into neighbouring pixels, an effect engineers exploit for charge-sharing interpolation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reverse-biased depletion region”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：V_d = q·N_eff·d²/(2ε)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: V_d = q·N_eff·d²/(2ε).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要接上偏壓，整片感測器就全部是靈敏區，空乏深度與偏壓無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once bias is applied the whole sensor is sensitive, and depletion depth does not depend on voltage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「反向偏壓空乏區」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Reverse-biased depletion region”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 空乏電壓、漂移時間與 Lorentz 角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Depletion voltage, drift time and the Lorentz angle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反向偏壓空乏區」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reverse-biased depletion region” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V_d = q·N_eff·d²/(2ε)。3 kΩ·cm n 型矽 N_eff = 1/(q·µ_e·ρ) ≈ 1.5×10¹² cm⁻³，d = 285 µm，ε = 11.9ε₀ = 1.05×10⁻¹² F/cm：V_d ≈ 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ × 1.54×10¹² × (0.0285 cm)²/(2 × 1.05×10⁻¹²) ≈ 95 V。偏壓 150 V（平均場 5.3 kV/cm）並考慮速度飽和，電子漂移約 6 ns、電洞約 14 ns。Lorentz 角 tanθ_L = r_H·µ·B ≈ 1.15 × 0.096 m²/(V·s) × 3.8 T ≈ 0.42，θ_L ≈ 23°，穿過 285 µm 的橫向偏移約 120 µm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V_d = q·N_eff·d²/(2ε). For 3 kΩ·cm n-type silicon N_eff = 1/(q·µ_e·ρ) ≈ 1.5×10¹² cm⁻³; with d = 285 µm and ε = 11.9ε₀ = 1.05×10⁻¹² F/cm, V_d ≈ 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ × 1.54×10¹² × (0.0285 cm)²/(2 × 1.05×10⁻¹²) ≈ 95 V. At 150 V bias (mean field 5.3 kV/cm), including velocity saturation, electrons drift for about 6 ns and holes for about 14 ns. The Lorentz angle is tanθ_L = r_H·µ·B ≈ 1.15 × 0.096 m²/(V·s) × 3.8 T ≈ 0.42, θ_L ≈ 23°, a lateral shift of about 120 µm across 285 µm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量 C–V 曲線：1/C² 對偏壓先線性上升，到全空乏處轉平，轉折點即 V_d；同時量 I–V 確認崩潰電壓遠高於工作點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the C–V curve: 1/C² rises linearly with bias and flattens at full depletion, and the knee gives V_d; measure I–V at the same time to confirm that breakdown lies well above the operating point.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
