The gas system runs as a closed, continuously purified loop with oxygen and water held at ppm level, because electrons attach to electronegative molecules and vanish, and drift velocity shifts with E/N, temperature and pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要中央電極電壓正確，漂移電場就自動均勻。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the central-electrode voltage is right, the drift field is automatically uniform. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「場籠、高壓與氣體純度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field cage, high voltage and gas purity" is correct?
options: 場籠用鍍鋁 Mylar 條帶環繞漂移體積，由電阻鏈把 −100 kV 逐級分壓，讓每一條帶的電位落在理想的線性分佈上，電場才能在 2.5 m 的全長保持均勻。
只要中央電極電壓正確，漂移電場就自動均勻。
氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。
optionsEn: The field cage surrounds the drift volume with aluminised Mylar strips whose potentials are set by a resistor chain dividing the −100 kV step by step, so that every strip sits on the ideal linear potential and the field stays uniform over the 2.5 m drift.
If the central-electrode voltage is right, the drift field is automatically uniform.
Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement.
quiz.explanation: 場籠用鍍鋁 Mylar 條帶環繞漂移體積，由電阻鏈把 −100 kV 逐級分壓，讓每一條帶的電位落在理想的線性分佈上，電場才能在 2.5 m 的全長保持均勻；靠近讀出面另有裙狀電極修正端部場。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The field cage surrounds the drift volume with aluminised Mylar strips whose potentials are set by a resistor chain dividing the −100 kV step by step, so that every strip sits on the ideal linear potential and the field stays uniform over the 2.5 m drift; skirt electrodes near the readout plane correct the end field. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 場籠、高壓與氣體純度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field cage, high voltage and gas purity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「場籠與電阻鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Field cage and resistor chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 165 條帶、15 mm 間距（教學值）估算：每級電壓 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V，正是 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm；若電阻鏈總阻值 4.1 GΩ，鏈電流 I ≈ 24 µA、功耗 2.4 W；單一電阻 1% 的誤差讓該級多出約 6 V，在一個間距內形成 1% 的局部場畸變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking 165 strips at 15 mm pitch (teaching values): each step is 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V, exactly 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm; with a total chain resistance of 4.1 GΩ the chain current is I ≈ 24 µA and the dissipation 2.4 W; a 1% error in one resistor adds about 6 V to that step, a 1% local field distortion over one pitch. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測各分壓節點電位（或電阻鏈各段阻值）並與線性目標比較；以氧分析儀與露點計監測 O₂ 與 H₂O，用 Goofie 型漂移速度監測器連續記錄 v_d；最後用雷射直線軌跡的殘差檢查場均勻性與 E×B 畸變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure every divider node (or each chain segment) against the linear target; monitor O₂ and H₂O with an oxygen analyser and a dew-point meter, record v_d continuously with a Goofie-type drift-velocity monitor, and finally check field uniformity and E×B distortion from residuals of straight laser tracks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 165 條帶、15 mm 間距（教學值）估算：每級電壓 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V，正是 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm；若電阻鏈總阻值 4.1 GΩ，鏈電流 I ≈ 24 µA、功耗 2.4 W；單一電阻 1% 的誤差讓該級多出約 6 V，在一個間距內形成 1% 的局部場畸變。
knowledge.textEn: Taking 165 strips at 15 mm pitch (teaching values): each step is 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V, exactly 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm; with a total chain resistance of 4.1 GΩ the chain current is I ≈ 24 µA and the dissipation 2.4 W; a 1% error in one resistor adds about 6 V to that step, a 1% local field distortion over one pitch.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「場籠、高壓與氣體純度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Field cage, high voltage and gas purity", which statement holds?
options: 對所有列直接取平均就能得到最好的 dE/dx 解析度。
以 165 條帶、15 mm 間距（教學值）估算：每級電壓 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V，正是 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm。
每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。
optionsEn: A plain average over all rows gives the best dE/dx resolution.
Taking 165 strips at 15 mm pitch (teaching values): each step is 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V, exactly 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm.
If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation.
quiz.explanation: 以 165 條帶、15 mm 間距（教學值）估算：每級電壓 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V，正是 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm；若電阻鏈總阻值 4.1 GΩ，鏈電流 I ≈ 24 µA、功耗 2.4 W；單一電阻 1% 的誤差讓該級多出約 6 V，在一個間距內形成 1% 的局部場畸變。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Taking 165 strips at 15 mm pitch (teaching values): each step is 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V, exactly 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm; with a total chain resistance of 4.1 GΩ the chain current is I ≈ 24 µA and the dissipation 2.4 W; a 1% error in one resistor adds about 6 V to that step, a 1% local field distortion over one pitch. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 場籠、高壓與氣體純度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field cage, high voltage and gas purity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「場籠與電阻鏈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Field cage and resistor chain” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量測各分壓節點電位（或電阻鏈各段阻值）並與線性目標比較；以氧分析儀與露點計監測 O₂ 與 H₂O，用 Goofie 型漂移速度監測器連續記錄 v_d；最後用雷射直線軌跡的殘差檢查場均勻性與 E×B 畸變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure every divider node (or each chain segment) against the linear target; monitor O₂ and H₂O with an oxygen analyser and a dew-point meter, record v_d continuously with a Goofie-type drift-velocity monitor, and finally check field uniformity and E×B distortion from residuals of straight laser tracks. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：場籠內一次微放電或一顆漂移的電阻會使局部電位偏離，該區的電子被徑向推移，軌跡出現系統性的弓形殘差；若洩漏讓氧升到數十 ppm，遠端漂移的信號明顯衰減。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A micro-discharge or a drifting resistor shifts the local potential, electrons there are pushed radially and tracks show systematic bow-shaped residuals; a leak raising oxygen to tens of ppm visibly attenuates long-drift signals.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測各分壓節點電位（或電阻鏈各段阻值）並與線性目標比較；以氧分析儀與露點計監測 O₂ 與 H₂O，用 Goofie 型漂移速度監測器連續記錄 v_d；最後用雷射直線軌跡的殘差檢查場均勻性與 E×B 畸變。
knowledge.textEn: Measure every divider node (or each chain segment) against the linear target; monitor O₂ and H₂O with an oxygen analyser and a dew-point meter, record v_d continuously with a Goofie-type drift-velocity monitor, and finally check field uniformity and E×B distortion from residuals of straight laser tracks.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「場籠、高壓與氣體純度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field cage, high voltage and gas purity"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
電子沿電場一路加速到很高速度，所以漂移時間可以忽略。
量測各分壓節點電位（或電阻鏈各段阻值）並與線性目標比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Electrons accelerate along the field to very high speed, so drift time can be ignored.
Measure every divider node (or each chain segment) against the linear target.
quiz.explanation: 量測各分壓節點電位（或電阻鏈各段阻值）並與線性目標比較；以氧分析儀與露點計監測 O₂ 與 H₂O，用 Goofie 型漂移速度監測器連續記錄 v_d；最後用雷射直線軌跡的殘差檢查場均勻性與 E×B 畸變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure every divider node (or each chain segment) against the linear target; monitor O₂ and H₂O with an oxygen analyser and a dew-point meter, record v_d continuously with a Goofie-type drift-velocity monitor, and finally check field uniformity and E×B distortion from residuals of straight laser tracks. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 場籠、高壓與氣體純度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field cage, high voltage and gas purity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「場籠與電阻鏈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Field cage and resistor chain” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 場籠內一次微放電或一顆漂移的電阻會使局部電位偏離，該區的電子被徑向推移，軌跡出現系統性的弓形殘差；若洩漏讓氧升到數十 ppm，遠端漂移的信號明顯衰減。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A micro-discharge or a drifting resistor shifts the local potential, electrons there are pushed radially and tracks show systematic bow-shaped residuals; a leak raising oxygen to tens of ppm visibly attenuates long-drift signals. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：氣體系統以閉迴路循環並連續純化，氧與水必須壓在 ppm 等級，否則電子被電負性分子吸附而消失，而且漂移速度會隨 E/N、溫度與壓力改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The gas system runs as a closed, continuously purified loop with oxygen and water held at ppm level, because electrons attach to electronegative molecules and vanish, and drift velocity shifts with E/N, temperature and pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要中央電極電壓正確，漂移電場就自動均勻。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the central-electrode voltage is right, the drift field is automatically uniform." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 場籠內一次微放電或一顆漂移的電阻會使局部電位偏離，該區的電子被徑向推移，軌跡出現系統性的弓形殘差；若洩漏讓氧升到數十 ppm，遠端漂移的信號明顯衰減。
knowledge.textEn: A micro-discharge or a drifting resistor shifts the local potential, electrons there are pushed radially and tracks show systematic bow-shaped residuals; a leak raising oxygen to tens of ppm visibly attenuates long-drift signals.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「場籠、高壓與氣體純度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field cage, high voltage and gas purity" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 場籠內一次微放電或一顆漂移的電阻會使局部電位偏離，該區的電子被徑向推移，軌跡出現系統性的弓形殘差；若洩漏讓氧升到數十 ppm，遠端漂移的信號明顯衰減。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。
optionsEn: A micro-discharge or a drifting resistor shifts the local potential, electrons there are pushed radially and tracks show systematic bow-shaped residuals.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement.
quiz.explanation: 場籠內一次微放電或一顆漂移的電阻會使局部電位偏離，該區的電子被徑向推移，軌跡出現系統性的弓形殘差；若洩漏讓氧升到數十 ppm，遠端漂移的信號明顯衰減。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A micro-discharge or a drifting resistor shifts the local potential, electrons there are pushed radially and tracks show systematic bow-shaped residuals; a leak raising oxygen to tens of ppm visibly attenuates long-drift signals. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: GEM 氣體增益與離子回流：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: GEM gas gain and ion back-flow: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四層 GEM 讀出室」如何決定時間投影室偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Four-GEM readout chambers” determines the key performance of “Time-projection-chamber detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 讀出室把漂移來的電子送進 50 µm 厚、佈滿 70 µm 微孔的 GEM 箔，孔內數十 kV/cm 的場讓電子雪崩倍增。ALICE 在 Run 3 把每個讀出室做成四層 GEM 疊（標準孔距與大孔距交替），總增益約 2000，同時把離子回流壓到 1% 以下，取代了需要閘極柵而產生死時間的多絲正比室，才能在 50 kHz 的鉛鉛碰撞率下連續讀出。雪崩的統計漲落與第一層 GEM 的電子收集效率共同決定能量解析度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四層 GEM 讀出室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The readout chambers feed drifted electrons into 50 µm thick GEM foils pierced with 70 µm holes, where fields of tens of kV/cm drive avalanche multiplication. For Run 3 ALICE built each chamber as a four-GEM stack alternating standard and large-pitch foils, giving a total gain of about 2000 while holding ion back-flow below 1%; this replaced the multiwire chambers whose gating grid created dead time, and allows continuous readout at the 50 kHz Pb–Pb collision rate. Avalanche statistics together with electron collection efficiency in the first GEM set the energy resolution. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four-GEM readout chambers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：回流離子數 = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 個離子／初級電子；理想能量解析度 σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N)，取 F = 0.2、b = 0.6、N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155，得約 7%；實測約 12% 代表有效電子數只剩 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 個，即第一層 GEM 的有效透過率約 36%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Back-flowing ions = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 ions per primary electron; the ideal energy resolution σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N) with F = 0.2, b = 0.6 and N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155 is about 7%; a measured 12% implies only 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 effective electrons, i.e. an effective transparency of about 36% in the first GEM.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四層 GEM 讀出室」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Four-GEM readout chambers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: GEM 氣體增益與離子回流
knowledge.titleEn: GEM gas gain and ion back-flow
knowledge.text: 讀出室把漂移來的電子送進 50 µm 厚、佈滿 70 µm 微孔的 GEM 箔，孔內數十 kV/cm 的場讓電子雪崩倍增。ALICE 在 Run 3 把每個讀出室做成四層 GEM 疊（標準孔距與大孔距交替），總增益約 2000，同時把離子回流壓到 1% 以下，取代了需要閘極柵而產生死時間的多絲正比室，才能在 50 kHz 的鉛鉛碰撞率下連續讀出。
knowledge.textEn: The readout chambers feed drifted electrons into 50 µm thick GEM foils pierced with 70 µm holes, where fields of tens of kV/cm drive avalanche multiplication. For Run 3 ALICE built each chamber as a four-GEM stack alternating standard and large-pitch foils, giving a total gain of about 2000 while holding ion back-flow below 1%; this replaced the multiwire chambers whose gating grid created dead time, and allows continuous readout at the 50 kHz Pb–Pb collision rate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「GEM 氣體增益與離子回流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "GEM gas gain and ion back-flow" is correct?
options: 氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。
讀出室把漂移來的電子送進 50 µm 厚、佈滿 70 µm 微孔的 GEM 箔，孔內數十 kV/cm 的場讓電子雪崩倍增。
漂移速度在試運轉時量一次就夠用了。
optionsEn: Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement.
The readout chambers feed drifted electrons into 50 µm thick GEM foils pierced with 70 µm holes, where fields of tens of kV/cm drive avalanche multiplication.
Measuring the drift velocity once at commissioning is enough.
quiz.explanation: 讀出室把漂移來的電子送進 50 µm 厚、佈滿 70 µm 微孔的 GEM 箔，孔內數十 kV/cm 的場讓電子雪崩倍增。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The readout chambers feed drifted electrons into 50 µm thick GEM foils pierced with 70 µm holes, where fields of tens of kV/cm drive avalanche multiplication. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: GEM 氣體增益與離子回流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: GEM gas gain and ion back-flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四層 GEM 讀出室」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Four-GEM readout chambers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：回流離子數 = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 個離子／初級電子；理想能量解析度 σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N)，取 F = 0.2、b = 0.6、N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155，得約 7%；實測約 12% 代表有效電子數只剩 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 個，即第一層 GEM 的有效透過率約 36%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Back-flowing ions = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 ions per primary electron; the ideal energy resolution σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N) with F = 0.2, b = 0.6 and N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155 is about 7%; a measured 12% implies only 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 effective electrons, i.e. an effective transparency of about 36% in the first GEM. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用 ⁵⁵Fe 的 5.9 keV X 光量每個讀出室的增益與能量解析度；以保護電極上陰極電流對陽極電流的比值量離子回流；掃描各層 GEM 電壓畫出增益對 IBF 的折衷曲線，並以長期測試確認工作點的放電率可接受。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure gain and energy resolution per chamber with 5.9 keV ⁵⁵Fe X-rays; measure ion back-flow as the ratio of cathode to anode current on the protection electrodes; scan the individual GEM voltages to map the gain-versus-IBF trade-off, and confirm in long-term tests that the discharge rate at the chosen working point is acceptable.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 回流離子數 = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 個離子／初級電子；理想能量解析度 σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N)，取 F = 0.2、b = 0.6、N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155，得約 7%；實測約 12% 代表有效電子數只剩 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 個，即第一層 GEM 的有效透過率約 36%。
knowledge.textEn: Back-flowing ions = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 ions per primary electron; the ideal energy resolution σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N) with F = 0.2, b = 0.6 and N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155 is about 7%; a measured 12% implies only 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 effective electrons, i.e. an effective transparency of about 36% in the first GEM.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「GEM 氣體增益與離子回流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "GEM gas gain and ion back-flow", which statement holds?
options: 連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。
電子沿電場一路加速到很高速度，所以漂移時間可以忽略。
回流離子數 = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 個離子／初級電子。
optionsEn: Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed.
Electrons accelerate along the field to very high speed, so drift time can be ignored.
Back-flowing ions = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 ions per primary electron.
quiz.explanation: 回流離子數 = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 個離子／初級電子；理想能量解析度 σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N)，取 F = 0.2、b = 0.6、N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155，得約 7%；實測約 12% 代表有效電子數只剩 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 個，即第一層 GEM 的有效透過率約 36%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Back-flowing ions = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 ions per primary electron; the ideal energy resolution σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N) with F = 0.2, b = 0.6 and N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155 is about 7%; a measured 12% implies only 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 effective electrons, i.e. an effective transparency of about 36% in the first GEM. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: GEM 氣體增益與離子回流：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: GEM gas gain and ion back-flow: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「四層 GEM 讀出室」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Four-GEM readout chambers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用 ⁵⁵Fe 的 5.9 keV X 光量每個讀出室的增益與能量解析度；以保護電極上陰極電流對陽極電流的比值量離子回流；掃描各層 GEM 電壓畫出增益對 IBF 的折衷曲線，並以長期測試確認工作點的放電率可接受。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure gain and energy resolution per chamber with 5.9 keV ⁵⁵Fe X-rays; measure ion back-flow as the ratio of cathode to anode current on the protection electrodes; scan the individual GEM voltages to map the gain-versus-IBF trade-off, and confirm in long-term tests that the discharge rate at the chosen working point is acceptable. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了改善能量解析度而調高第一層 GEM 電壓，離子回流隨之上升，高碰撞率下空間電荷畸變失控；反之壓得太低則透過率下降、dE/dx 解析度變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising the first-GEM voltage to improve energy resolution raises ion back-flow and lets space-charge distortion run away at high rate; pushing it too low cuts transparency and worsens dE/dx resolution.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用 ⁵⁵Fe 的 5.9 keV X 光量每個讀出室的增益與能量解析度；以保護電極上陰極電流對陽極電流的比值量離子回流；掃描各層 GEM 電壓畫出增益對 IBF 的折衷曲線，並以長期測試確認工作點的放電率可接受。
knowledge.textEn: Measure gain and energy resolution per chamber with 5.9 keV ⁵⁵Fe X-rays; measure ion back-flow as the ratio of cathode to anode current on the protection electrodes; scan the individual GEM voltages to map the gain-versus-IBF trade-off, and confirm in long-term tests that the discharge rate at the chosen working point is acceptable.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「GEM 氣體增益與離子回流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "GEM gas gain and ion back-flow"?
options: 用 ⁵⁵Fe 的 5.9 keV X 光量每個讀出室的增益與能量解析度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
磁場會同時壓低橫向與縱向擴散。
optionsEn: Measure gain and energy resolution per chamber with 5.9 keV ⁵⁵Fe X-rays.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The magnetic field suppresses both transverse and longitudinal diffusion.
quiz.explanation: 用 ⁵⁵Fe 的 5.9 keV X 光量每個讀出室的增益與能量解析度；以保護電極上陰極電流對陽極電流的比值量離子回流；掃描各層 GEM 電壓畫出增益對 IBF 的折衷曲線，並以長期測試確認工作點的放電率可接受。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure gain and energy resolution per chamber with 5.9 keV ⁵⁵Fe X-rays; measure ion back-flow as the ratio of cathode to anode current on the protection electrodes; scan the individual GEM voltages to map the gain-versus-IBF trade-off, and confirm in long-term tests that the discharge rate at the chosen working point is acceptable. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: GEM 氣體增益與離子回流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: GEM gas gain and ion back-flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「四層 GEM 讀出室」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Four-GEM readout chambers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了改善能量解析度而調高第一層 GEM 電壓，離子回流隨之上升，高碰撞率下空間電荷畸變失控；反之壓得太低則透過率下降、dE/dx 解析度變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the first-GEM voltage to improve energy resolution raises ion back-flow and lets space-charge distortion run away at high rate; pushing it too low cuts transparency and worsens dE/dx resolution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雪崩的統計漲落與第一層 GEM 的電子收集效率共同決定能量解析度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Avalanche statistics together with electron collection efficiency in the first GEM set the energy resolution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了改善能量解析度而調高第一層 GEM 電壓，離子回流隨之上升，高碰撞率下空間電荷畸變失控；反之壓得太低則透過率下降、dE/dx 解析度變差。
knowledge.textEn: Raising the first-GEM voltage to improve energy resolution raises ion back-flow and lets space-charge distortion run away at high rate; pushing it too low cuts transparency and worsens dE/dx resolution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「GEM 氣體增益與離子回流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "GEM gas gain and ion back-flow" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
為了改善能量解析度而調高第一層 GEM 電壓，離子回流隨之上升，高碰撞率下空間電荷畸變失控；反之壓得太低則透過率下降、dE/dx 解析度變差。
漂移速度在試運轉時量一次就夠用了。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Raising the first-GEM voltage to improve energy resolution raises ion back-flow and lets space-charge distortion run away at high rate.
Measuring the drift velocity once at commissioning is enough.
quiz.explanation: 為了改善能量解析度而調高第一層 GEM 電壓，離子回流隨之上升，高碰撞率下空間電荷畸變失控；反之壓得太低則透過率下降、dE/dx 解析度變差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising the first-GEM voltage to improve energy resolution raises ion back-flow and lets space-charge distortion run away at high rate; pushing it too low cuts transparency and worsens dE/dx resolution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正」與「增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration" and "Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雷射校正與畸變圖」如何決定時間投影室偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laser calibration and distortion maps” determines the key performance of “Time-projection-chamber detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 要把到達時間換成 z，必須隨時掌握漂移速度；ALICE 用 266 nm 脈衝雷射經鏡組在腔內產生 336 條直線軌跡，並以獨立的漂移速度監測器追蹤氣體狀態。高碰撞率下回流的離子以約 1.6 cm/ms 緩慢漂移，在腔內累積成空間電荷，其徑向電場把漂移電子推離真實位置；畸變與離子密度成正比，必須用軌跡殘差或電流讀出建立隨時間更新的畸變圖加以修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射校正與畸變圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Converting arrival time into z needs the drift velocity at all times; ALICE fires a pulsed 266 nm laser through mirror bundles to create 336 straight tracks inside the volume and follows gas condition with a separate drift-velocity monitor. At high rate the back-flowing ions drift slowly at about 1.6 cm/ms and accumulate as space charge whose radial field pushes drifting electrons off their true positions; the distortion scales with ion density and must be corrected with time-dependent maps built from track residuals or current readout. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser calibration and distortion maps”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：離子穿越時間 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms，50 kHz 鉛鉛碰撞下腔內同時存有約 8000 個事件的離子。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Ion transit time is 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms, so at 50 kHz Pb–Pb the ions of about 8000 events coexist in the volume.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漂移速度在試運轉時量一次就夠用了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Measuring the drift velocity once at commissioning is enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雷射校正與畸變圖」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Laser calibration and distortion maps”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正
knowledge.titleEn: Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration
knowledge.text: 要把到達時間換成 z，必須隨時掌握漂移速度；ALICE 用 266 nm 脈衝雷射經鏡組在腔內產生 336 條直線軌跡，並以獨立的漂移速度監測器追蹤氣體狀態。高碰撞率下回流的離子以約 1.6 cm/ms 緩慢漂移，在腔內累積成空間電荷，其徑向電場把漂移電子推離真實位置；畸變與離子密度成正比，必須用軌跡殘差或電流讀出建立隨時間更新的畸變圖加以修正。
knowledge.textEn: Converting arrival time into z needs the drift velocity at all times; ALICE fires a pulsed 266 nm laser through mirror bundles to create 336 straight tracks inside the volume and follows gas condition with a separate drift-velocity monitor. At high rate the back-flowing ions drift slowly at about 1.6 cm/ms and accumulate as space charge whose radial field pushes drifting electrons off their true positions; the distortion scales with ion density and must be corrected with time-dependent maps built from track residuals or current readout.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漂移速度在試運轉時量一次就夠用了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Measuring the drift velocity once at commissioning is enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration" is correct?
options: 漂移速度在試運轉時量一次就夠用了。
對所有列直接取平均就能得到最好的 dE/dx 解析度。
要把到達時間換成 z，必須隨時掌握漂移速度；ALICE 用 266 nm 脈衝雷射經鏡組在腔內產生 336 條直線軌跡，並以獨立的漂移速度監測器追蹤氣體狀態。
optionsEn: Measuring the drift velocity once at commissioning is enough.
A plain average over all rows gives the best dE/dx resolution.
Converting arrival time into z needs the drift velocity at all times.
quiz.explanation: 要把到達時間換成 z，必須隨時掌握漂移速度；ALICE 用 266 nm 脈衝雷射經鏡組在腔內產生 336 條直線軌跡，並以獨立的漂移速度監測器追蹤氣體狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Converting arrival time into z needs the drift velocity at all times; ALICE fires a pulsed 266 nm laser through mirror bundles to create 336 straight tracks inside the volume and follows gas condition with a separate drift-velocity monitor. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷射校正與畸變圖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laser calibration and distortion maps” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：離子穿越時間 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms，50 kHz 鉛鉛碰撞下腔內同時存有約 8000 個事件的離子。取均勻離子密度 ρ = 2×10⁴ cm⁻³（教學假設）、半徑 1 m：E_r = ρe·r/(2ε₀) = 3.2×10⁻⁹ C/m³ × 1 m ÷ (2×8.85×10⁻¹² F/m) ≈ 180 V/m = 1.8 V/cm，E_r/E_z = 0.45%，全長漂移的徑向位移 ≈ 250 cm × 0.0045 ≈ 1.1 cm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ion transit time is 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms, so at 50 kHz Pb–Pb the ions of about 8000 events coexist in the volume. For a uniform ion density ρ = 2×10⁴ cm⁻³ (teaching assumption) at radius 1 m, E_r = ρe·r/(2ε₀) = 3.2×10⁻⁹ C/m³ × 1 m ÷ (2×8.85×10⁻¹² F/m) ≈ 180 V/m = 1.8 V/cm, E_r/E_z = 0.45%, and a full-drift electron is displaced radially by ≈ 250 cm × 0.0045 ≈ 1.1 cm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對幾何已知的雷射軌跡擬合直線並取殘差，分離漂移速度誤差（z 的線性縮放）與空間電荷畸變（隨 r、z 變化的徑向殘差）；把內層矽追蹤器外推的軌跡與 TPC 叢集比較，更新畸變圖，確認修正後殘差回到 1 mm 以下。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit straight lines to laser tracks of known geometry and take residuals, separating drift-velocity error (a linear z scaling) from space-charge distortion (radial residuals varying with r and z); compare clusters with tracks extrapolated from the inner silicon tracker, update the distortion map and confirm that corrected residuals return below 1 mm.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 離子穿越時間 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms，50 kHz 鉛鉛碰撞下腔內同時存有約 8000 個事件的離子。取均勻離子密度 ρ = 2×10⁴ cm⁻³（教學假設）、半徑 1 m：E_r = ρe·r/(2ε₀) = 3.2×10⁻⁹ C/m³ × 1 m ÷ (2×8.85×10⁻¹² F/m) ≈ 180 V/m = 1.8 V/cm，E_r/E_z = 0.45%，全長漂移的徑向位移 ≈ 250 cm × 0.0045 ≈ 1.1 cm。
knowledge.textEn: Ion transit time is 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms, so at 50 kHz Pb–Pb the ions of about 8000 events coexist in the volume. For a uniform ion density ρ = 2×10⁴ cm⁻³ (teaching assumption) at radius 1 m, E_r = ρe·r/(2ε₀) = 3.2×10⁻⁹ C/m³ × 1 m ÷ (2×8.85×10⁻¹² F/m) ≈ 180 V/m = 1.8 V/cm, E_r/E_z = 0.45%, and a full-drift electron is displaced radially by ≈ 250 cm × 0.0045 ≈ 1.1 cm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration", which statement holds?
options: 離子穿越時間 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms，50 kHz 鉛鉛碰撞下腔內同時存有約 8000 個事件的離子。
每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。
磁場會同時壓低橫向與縱向擴散。
optionsEn: Ion transit time is 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms, so at 50 kHz Pb–Pb the ions of about 8000 events coexist in the volume.
If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation.
The magnetic field suppresses both transverse and longitudinal diffusion.
quiz.explanation: 離子穿越時間 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms，50 kHz 鉛鉛碰撞下腔內同時存有約 8000 個事件的離子。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Ion transit time is 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms, so at 50 kHz Pb–Pb the ions of about 8000 events coexist in the volume. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雷射校正與畸變圖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Laser calibration and distortion maps” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對幾何已知的雷射軌跡擬合直線並取殘差，分離漂移速度誤差（z 的線性縮放）與空間電荷畸變（隨 r、z 變化的徑向殘差）；把內層矽追蹤器外推的軌跡與 TPC 叢集比較，更新畸變圖，確認修正後殘差回到 1 mm 以下。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit straight lines to laser tracks of known geometry and take residuals, separating drift-velocity error (a linear z scaling) from space-charge distortion (radial residuals varying with r and z); compare clusters with tracks extrapolated from the inner silicon tracker, update the distortion map and confirm that corrected residuals return below 1 mm. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若畸變圖更新慢於碰撞率的變化（例如束流強度在幾分鐘內下降），修正會過量或不足，表現為隨時間漂移的動量尺度與頂點偏移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If distortion maps update more slowly than the collision rate changes, for instance when beam intensity drops within minutes, the correction over- or under-shoots and appears as a time-dependent momentum scale and vertex offset.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對幾何已知的雷射軌跡擬合直線並取殘差，分離漂移速度誤差（z 的線性縮放）與空間電荷畸變（隨 r、z 變化的徑向殘差）；把內層矽追蹤器外推的軌跡與 TPC 叢集比較，更新畸變圖，確認修正後殘差回到 1 mm 以下。
knowledge.textEn: Fit straight lines to laser tracks of known geometry and take residuals, separating drift-velocity error (a linear z scaling) from space-charge distortion (radial residuals varying with r and z); compare clusters with tracks extrapolated from the inner silicon tracker, update the distortion map and confirm that corrected residuals return below 1 mm.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
對幾何已知的雷射軌跡擬合直線並取殘差，分離漂移速度誤差（z 的線性縮放）與空間電荷畸變（隨 r、z 變化的徑向殘差）。
只要中央電極電壓正確，漂移電場就自動均勻。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Fit straight lines to laser tracks of known geometry and take residuals, separating drift-velocity error (a linear z scaling) from space-charge distortion (radial residuals varying with r and z).
If the central-electrode voltage is right, the drift field is automatically uniform.
quiz.explanation: 對幾何已知的雷射軌跡擬合直線並取殘差，分離漂移速度誤差（z 的線性縮放）與空間電荷畸變（隨 r、z 變化的徑向殘差）；把內層矽追蹤器外推的軌跡與 TPC 叢集比較，更新畸變圖，確認修正後殘差回到 1 mm 以下。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit straight lines to laser tracks of known geometry and take residuals, separating drift-velocity error (a linear z scaling) from space-charge distortion (radial residuals varying with r and z); compare clusters with tracks extrapolated from the inner silicon tracker, update the distortion map and confirm that corrected residuals return below 1 mm. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷射校正與畸變圖」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Laser calibration and distortion maps” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若畸變圖更新慢於碰撞率的變化（例如束流強度在幾分鐘內下降），修正會過量或不足，表現為隨時間漂移的動量尺度與頂點偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If distortion maps update more slowly than the collision rate changes, for instance when beam intensity drops within minutes, the correction over- or under-shoots and appears as a time-dependent momentum scale and vertex offset. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高碰撞率下回流的離子以約 1.6 cm/ms 緩慢漂移，在腔內累積成空間電荷，其徑向電場把漂移電子推離真實位置；畸變與離子密度成正比，必須用軌跡殘差或電流讀出建立隨時間更新的畸變圖加以修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At high rate the back-flowing ions drift slowly at about 1.6 cm/ms and accumulate as space charge whose radial field pushes drifting electrons off their true positions; the distortion scales with ion density and must be corrected with time-dependent maps built from track residuals or current readout.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漂移速度在試運轉時量一次就夠用了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Measuring the drift velocity once at commissioning is enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若畸變圖更新慢於碰撞率的變化（例如束流強度在幾分鐘內下降），修正會過量或不足，表現為隨時間漂移的動量尺度與頂點偏移。
knowledge.textEn: If distortion maps update more slowly than the collision rate changes, for instance when beam intensity drops within minutes, the correction over- or under-shoots and appears as a time-dependent momentum scale and vertex offset.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
對所有列直接取平均就能得到最好的 dE/dx 解析度。
若畸變圖更新慢於碰撞率的變化（例如束流強度在幾分鐘內下降），修正會過量或不足，表現為隨時間漂移的動量尺度與頂點偏移。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A plain average over all rows gives the best dE/dx resolution.

If distortion maps update more slowly than the collision rate changes, for instance when beam intensity drops within minutes, the correction over- or under-shoots and appears as a time-dependent momentum scale and vertex offset.
quiz.explanation: 若畸變圖更新慢於碰撞率的變化（例如束流強度在幾分鐘內下降），修正會過量或不足，表現為隨時間漂移的動量尺度與頂點偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If distortion maps update more slowly than the collision rate changes, for instance when beam intensity drops within minutes, the correction over- or under-shoots and appears as a time-dependent momentum scale and vertex offset. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氪增益圖與 dE/dx」如何決定時間投影室偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Krypton gain map and dE/dx” determines the key performance of “Time-projection-chamber detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: TPC 的第二項任務是用沿軌跡的能損 dE/dx 鑑別粒子：每一列墊片各量一次叢集電荷，152 列以截斷平均合併以壓制 Landau 分佈的長尾，再與 Bethe–Bloch 曲線比對。前提是每一塊墊片的增益都已知：ALICE 把放射性 ⁸³ᵐKr 注入氣體，其 41.6 keV 的衰變在整個腔內均勻發生，每塊墊片上的峰值位置就是該墊片的增益刻度。dE/dx 解析度由樣本數、樣本長度、增益校正品質與擴散共同決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氪增益圖與 dE/dx」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The second job of a TPC is particle identification from energy loss along the track: each pad row measures one cluster charge, the 152 rows are combined as a truncated mean to suppress the Landau tail, and the result is compared with Bethe–Bloch curves. This requires the gain of every pad to be known: ALICE injects radioactive ⁸³ᵐKr into the gas, its 41.6 keV decays occur uniformly throughout the volume, and the peak position on each pad is that pad's gain scale. The dE/dx resolution then depends on sample count, sample length, gain-calibration quality and diffusion. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Krypton gain map and dE/dx”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一次 ⁸³ᵐKr 衰變產生 N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 個初級電子，增益 2000 後約 2.2×10⁶ 個電子 ≈ 0.35 pC；若單一墊片的增益刻度不確定度為 2%，對 152 列截斷平均的貢獻只有 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16%，遠低於 5–6% 的總 dE/dx 解析度，但整列或整區的共同偏差不會被平均掉。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One ⁸³ᵐKr decay yields N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 primary electrons, about 2.2×10⁶ electrons ≈ 0.35 pC after a gain of 2000; a 2% uncertainty in a single pad's gain contributes only 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16% to a 152-row truncated mean, far below the 5–6% total dE/dx resolution, whereas a common offset of a whole row or region is not averaged away.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「對所有列直接取平均就能得到最好的 dE/dx 解析度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A plain average over all rows gives the best dE/dx resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氪增益圖與 dE/dx」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Krypton gain map and dE/dx”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別
knowledge.titleEn: Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification

This requires the gain of every pad to be known: ALICE injects radioactive ⁸³ᵐKr into the gas, its 41.6 keV decays occur uniformly throughout the volume, and the peak position on each pad is that pad's gain scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：對所有列直接取平均就能得到最好的 dE/dx 解析度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification" is correct?
options: TPC 的第二項任務是用沿軌跡的能損 dE/dx 鑑別粒子：每一列墊片各量一次叢集電荷，152 列以截斷平均合併以壓制 Landau 分佈的長尾，再與 Bethe–Bloch 曲線比對。
對所有列直接取平均就能得到最好的 dE/dx 解析度。
連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。
optionsEn: The second job of a TPC is particle identification from energy loss along the track: each pad row measures one cluster charge, the 152 rows are combined as a truncated mean to suppress the Landau tail, and the result is compared with Bethe–Bloch curves.
A plain average over all rows gives the best dE/dx resolution.
Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed.
quiz.explanation: TPC 的第二項任務是用沿軌跡的能損 dE/dx 鑑別粒子：每一列墊片各量一次叢集電荷，152 列以截斷平均合併以壓制 Landau 分佈的長尾，再與 Bethe–Bloch 曲線比對。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氪增益圖與 dE/dx」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Krypton gain map and dE/dx” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一次 ⁸³ᵐKr 衰變產生 N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 個初級電子，增益 2000 後約 2.2×10⁶ 個電子 ≈ 0.35 pC；若單一墊片的增益刻度不確定度為 2%，對 152 列截斷平均的貢獻只有 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16%，遠低於 5–6% 的總 dE/dx 解析度，但整列或整區的共同偏差不會被平均掉。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One ⁸³ᵐKr decay yields N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 primary electrons, about 2.2×10⁶ electrons ≈ 0.35 pC after a gain of 2000; a 2% uncertainty in a single pad's gain contributes only 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16% to a 152-row truncated mean, far below the 5–6% total dE/dx resolution, whereas a common offset of a whole row or region is not averaged away. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐墊片擬合 Kr 峰建立增益圖，檢查其空間均勻性與隨時間的穩定度；用宇宙射線或低動量的質子、π、電子樣本擬合 Bethe–Bloch 參數，計算各動量區間的解析度與分離能力（以 σ 為單位的峰距）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit the Kr peak pad by pad to build the gain map and check its spatial uniformity and time stability; fit Bethe–Bloch parameters to dE/dx distributions of cosmic rays or low-momentum proton, pion and electron samples, and compute resolution and separation power (peak distance in units of σ) per momentum bin.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一次 ⁸³ᵐKr 衰變產生 N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 個初級電子，增益 2000 後約 2.2×10⁶ 個電子 ≈ 0.35 pC；若單一墊片的增益刻度不確定度為 2%，對 152 列截斷平均的貢獻只有 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16%，遠低於 5–6% 的總 dE/dx 解析度，但整列或整區的共同偏差不會被平均掉。
knowledge.textEn: One ⁸³ᵐKr decay yields N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 primary electrons, about 2.2×10⁶ electrons ≈ 0.35 pC after a gain of 2000; a 2% uncertainty in a single pad's gain contributes only 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16% to a 152-row truncated mean, far below the 5–6% total dE/dx resolution, whereas a common offset of a whole row or region is not averaged away.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification", which statement holds?
options: 電子沿電場一路加速到很高速度，所以漂移時間可以忽略。
一次 ⁸³ᵐKr 衰變產生 N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 個初級電子，增益 2000 後約 2.2×10⁶ 個電子 ≈ 0.35 pC。
只要中央電極電壓正確，漂移電場就自動均勻。
optionsEn: Electrons accelerate along the field to very high speed, so drift time can be ignored.
One ⁸³ᵐKr decay yields N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 primary electrons, about 2.2×10⁶ electrons ≈ 0.35 pC after a gain of 2000.
If the central-electrode voltage is right, the drift field is automatically uniform.
quiz.explanation: 一次 ⁸³ᵐKr 衰變產生 N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 個初級電子，增益 2000 後約 2.2×10⁶ 個電子 ≈ 0.35 pC；若單一墊片的增益刻度不確定度為 2%，對 152 列截斷平均的貢獻只有 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16%，遠低於 5–6% 的總 dE/dx 解析度，但整列或整區的共同偏差不會被平均掉。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: One ⁸³ᵐKr decay yields N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 primary electrons, about 2.2×10⁶ electrons ≈ 0.35 pC after a gain of 2000; a 2% uncertainty in a single pad's gain contributes only 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16% to a 152-row truncated mean, far below the 5–6% total dE/dx resolution, whereas a common offset of a whole row or region is not averaged away. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氪增益圖與 dE/dx」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Krypton gain map and dE/dx” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 逐墊片擬合 Kr 峰建立增益圖，檢查其空間均勻性與隨時間的穩定度；用宇宙射線或低動量的質子、π、電子樣本擬合 Bethe–Bloch 參數，計算各動量區間的解析度與分離能力（以 σ 為單位的峰距）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit the Kr peak pad by pad to build the gain map and check its spatial uniformity and time stability; fit Bethe–Bloch parameters to dE/dx distributions of cosmic rays or low-momentum proton, pion and electron samples, and compute resolution and separation power (peak distance in units of σ) per momentum bin. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：增益隨大氣壓每天漂移 1–2% 卻沒有參考信號追蹤時，整條 dE/dx 曲線上下移動，鑑別帶互相滲入，電子與 π 的誤判率上升。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When gain drifts 1–2% per day with air pressure and no reference tracks it, the whole dE/dx curve shifts, identification bands leak into each other and electron–pion misidentification rises.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐墊片擬合 Kr 峰建立增益圖，檢查其空間均勻性與隨時間的穩定度；用宇宙射線或低動量的質子、π、電子樣本擬合 Bethe–Bloch 參數，計算各動量區間的解析度與分離能力（以 σ 為單位的峰距）。
knowledge.textEn: Fit the Kr peak pad by pad to build the gain map and check its spatial uniformity and time stability; fit Bethe–Bloch parameters to dE/dx distributions of cosmic rays or low-momentum proton, pion and electron samples, and compute resolution and separation power (peak distance in units of σ) per momentum bin.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。
逐墊片擬合 Kr 峰建立增益圖，檢查其空間均勻性與隨時間的穩定度。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement.
Fit the Kr peak pad by pad to build the gain map and check its spatial uniformity and time stability.
quiz.explanation: 逐墊片擬合 Kr 峰建立增益圖，檢查其空間均勻性與隨時間的穩定度；用宇宙射線或低動量的質子、π、電子樣本擬合 Bethe–Bloch 參數，計算各動量區間的解析度與分離能力（以 σ 為單位的峰距）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit the Kr peak pad by pad to build the gain map and check its spatial uniformity and time stability; fit Bethe–Bloch parameters to dE/dx distributions of cosmic rays or low-momentum proton, pion and electron samples, and compute resolution and separation power (peak distance in units of σ) per momentum bin. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氪增益圖與 dE/dx」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Krypton gain map and dE/dx” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 增益隨大氣壓每天漂移 1–2% 卻沒有參考信號追蹤時，整條 dE/dx 曲線上下移動，鑑別帶互相滲入，電子與 π 的誤判率上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When gain drifts 1–2% per day with air pressure and no reference tracks it, the whole dE/dx curve shifts, identification bands leak into each other and electron–pion misidentification rises. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：dE/dx 解析度由樣本數、樣本長度、增益校正品質與擴散共同決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The dE/dx resolution then depends on sample count, sample length, gain-calibration quality and diffusion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「對所有列直接取平均就能得到最好的 dE/dx 解析度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A plain average over all rows gives the best dE/dx resolution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」與「試運轉、效能驗證與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow" and "Commissioning, performance validation and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」如何決定時間投影室偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “SAMPA front end and readout chain” determines the key performance of “Time-projection-chamber detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每塊墊片接到 SAMPA ASIC 的一個電荷靈敏前置放大與整形通道（每顆 32 通道、10 位元 ADC、5 MHz 取樣），約 160 ns 的整形時間與縱向擴散造成的 135 ns 時間展寬相稱。524,160 個通道把數位化波形經光纖連續送出，沒有觸發也沒有死時間，再由 FPGA 讀出卡扣除共模雜訊並做零抑制，才把資料率壓到可儲存的範圍。前端的雜訊、基線穩定度與通道間串音直接決定叢集電荷與位置的品質。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every pad feeds one charge-sensitive preamplifier–shaper channel of the SAMPA ASIC (32 channels per chip, 10-bit ADC, 5 MHz sampling), whose shaping time of about 160 ns matches the 135 ns time spread from longitudinal diffusion. The 524,160 channels stream digitised waveforms continuously over optical links, with no trigger and no dead time, and FPGA readout cards subtract common-mode noise and apply zero suppression to bring the data rate into a storable range. Front-end noise, baseline stability and channel-to-channel cross-talk directly set cluster-charge and position quality. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SAMPA front end and readout chain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致；每列墊片約 30 個初級電子 × 增益 2000 = 6×10⁴ 個電子（9.6 fC），若前端等效雜訊電荷 ENC ≈ 670 個電子，單列訊噪比約 90。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes; a pad row with about 30 primary electrons × gain 2000 gives 6×10⁴ electrons (9.6 fC), and with a front-end equivalent noise charge ENC ≈ 670 electrons the per-row signal-to-noise ratio is about 90.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “SAMPA front end and readout chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流

knowledge.textEn: Every pad feeds one charge-sensitive preamplifier–shaper channel of the SAMPA ASIC (32 channels per chip, 10-bit ADC, 5 MHz sampling), whose shaping time of about 160 ns matches the 135 ns time spread from longitudinal diffusion. The 524,160 channels stream digitised waveforms continuously over optical links, with no trigger and no dead time, and FPGA readout cards subtract common-mode noise and apply zero suppression to bring the data rate into a storable range.

quiz.question: 關於「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

每塊墊片接到 SAMPA ASIC 的一個電荷靈敏前置放大與整形通道（每顆 32 通道、10 位元 ADC、5 MHz 取樣），約 160 ns 的整形時間與縱向擴散造成的 135 ns 時間展寬相稱。
每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。
optionsEn: Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed.

Every pad feeds one charge-sensitive preamplifier–shaper channel of the SAMPA ASIC (32 channels per chip, 10-bit ADC, 5 MHz sampling), whose shaping time of about 160 ns matches the 135 ns time spread from longitudinal diffusion.
If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation.

steps.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “SAMPA front end and readout chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致；每列墊片約 30 個初級電子 × 增益 2000 = 6×10⁴ 個電子（9.6 fC），若前端等效雜訊電荷 ENC ≈ 670 個電子，單列訊噪比約 90。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes; a pad row with about 30 primary electrons × gain 2000 gives 6×10⁴ electrons (9.6 fC), and with a front-end equivalent noise charge ENC ≈ 670 electrons the per-row signal-to-noise ratio is about 90. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以內建的脈衝注入電容校正每通道的增益與基線，量 ENC（基線 RMS 換算成電子數）與通道間串音；無束流時記錄基線的共模成分並驗證扣除演算法；用光纖誤碼率與緩衝區佔用率確認讀出鏈在 50 kHz 碰撞率下不丟資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate gain and baseline per channel with the built-in pulse-injection capacitor, measure ENC (baseline RMS converted to electrons) and cross-talk; record common-mode baseline components without beam and validate the subtraction algorithm; confirm with link error rates and buffer occupancy that the readout chain drops no data at 50 kHz.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致；每列墊片約 30 個初級電子 × 增益 2000 = 6×10⁴ 個電子（9.6 fC），若前端等效雜訊電荷 ENC ≈ 670 個電子，單列訊噪比約 90。
knowledge.textEn: Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes; a pad row with about 30 primary electrons × gain 2000 gives 6×10⁴ electrons (9.6 fC), and with a front-end equivalent noise charge ENC ≈ 670 electrons the per-row signal-to-noise ratio is about 90.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow", which statement holds?
options: 磁場會同時壓低橫向與縱向擴散。
氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。
原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致。
optionsEn: The magnetic field suppresses both transverse and longitudinal diffusion.
Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement.

quiz.explanationEn: Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes; a pad row with about 30 primary electrons × gain 2000 gives 6×10⁴ electrons (9.6 fC), and with a front-end equivalent noise charge ENC ≈ 670 electrons the per-row signal-to-noise ratio is about 90. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “SAMPA front end and readout chain” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以內建的脈衝注入電容校正每通道的增益與基線，量 ENC（基線 RMS 換算成電子數）與通道間串音；無束流時記錄基線的共模成分並驗證扣除演算法；用光纖誤碼率與緩衝區佔用率確認讀出鏈在 50 kHz 碰撞率下不丟資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate gain and baseline per channel with the built-in pulse-injection capacitor, measure ENC (baseline RMS converted to electrons) and cross-talk; record common-mode baseline components without beam and validate the subtraction algorithm; confirm with link error rates and buffer occupancy that the readout chain drops no data at 50 kHz. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift; too short a shaping time causes ballistic deficit, underestimating charge and biasing dE/dx low.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以內建的脈衝注入電容校正每通道的增益與基線，量 ENC（基線 RMS 換算成電子數）與通道間串音；無束流時記錄基線的共模成分並驗證扣除演算法；用光纖誤碼率與緩衝區佔用率確認讀出鏈在 50 kHz 碰撞率下不丟資料。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow"?

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.instructionEn: Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift; too short a shaping time causes ballistic deficit, underestimating charge and biasing dE/dx low. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：前端的雜訊、基線穩定度與通道間串音直接決定叢集電荷與位置的品質。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Front-end noise, baseline stability and channel-to-channel cross-talk directly set cluster-charge and position quality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。
knowledge.textEn: Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift; too short a shaping time causes ballistic deficit, underestimating charge and biasing dE/dx low.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「前端電子、連續讀出與資料流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。
每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift.
If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation.
quiz.explanation: 共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift; too short a shaping time causes ballistic deficit, underestimating charge and biasing dE/dx low. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 試運轉、效能驗證與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, performance validation and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「試運轉與校正資料庫」如何決定時間投影室偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Commissioning and calibration database” determines the key performance of “Time-projection-chamber detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 整機驗證從高壓訓練與氣密測試開始，接著用宇宙射線與雷射確認每個讀出室的效率與對準，再以 Kr 校正建立增益圖，最後在束流下量位置解析度、dE/dx 解析度與動量解析度，並把漂移速度、增益、畸變圖與對準參數連同版本號寫入校正資料庫。交接文件必須記錄工作點（各層 GEM 電壓、增益、IBF）、放電與高壓跳脫的統計，以及每一項效能指標的量測條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「試運轉與校正資料庫」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: System validation starts with high-voltage training and gas-tightness tests, continues with cosmic rays and lasers to confirm efficiency and alignment of every readout chamber, then builds the gain map with Kr calibration, and finally measures position, dE/dx and momentum resolution with beam, writing drift velocity, gain, distortion maps and alignment constants with version numbers into the calibration database. The handoff record must document the working point (GEM voltages, gain, IBF), discharge and HV-trip statistics, and the measurement conditions of every performance figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning and calibration database”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Gluckstern estimate σ_pT/pT ≈ σ_rφ·pT/(0.3·B·L²)·√(720/(N+4)): with σ_rφ = 0.8 mm, B = 0.5 T, L = 1.6 m, N = 152 and pT = 10 GeV/c this is 0.0008×10/(0.3×0.5×2.56) × √(720/156) ≈ 0.0208×2.15 ≈ 4.5%, the order of the stand-alone TPC resolution at high momentum.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「試運轉與校正資料庫」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Commissioning and calibration database”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試運轉、效能驗證與交接
knowledge.text: 整機驗證從高壓訓練與氣密測試開始，接著用宇宙射線與雷射確認每個讀出室的效率與對準，再以 Kr 校正建立增益圖，最後在束流下量位置解析度、dE/dx 解析度與動量解析度，並把漂移速度、增益、畸變圖與對準參數連同版本號寫入校正資料庫。交接文件必須記錄工作點（各層 GEM 電壓、增益、IBF）、放電與高壓跳脫的統計，以及每一項效能指標的量測條件。

The handoff record must document the working point (GEM voltages, gain, IBF), discharge and HV-trip statistics, and the measurement conditions of every performance figure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「試運轉、效能驗證與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Commissioning, performance validation and handoff" is correct?

optionsEn: If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation.
Electrons accelerate along the field to very high speed, so drift time can be ignored.

System validation starts with high-voltage training and gas-tightness tests, continues with cosmic rays and lasers to confirm efficiency and alignment of every readout chamber, then builds the gain map with Kr calibration, and finally measures position, dE/dx and momentum resolution with beam, writing drift velocity, gain, distortion maps and alignment constants with version numbers into the calibration database.
quiz.explanation: 整機驗證從高壓訓練與氣密測試開始，接著用宇宙射線與雷射確認每個讀出室的效率與對準，再以 Kr 校正建立增益圖，最後在束流下量位置解析度、dE/dx 解析度與動量解析度，並把漂移速度、增益、畸變圖與對準參數連同版本號寫入校正資料庫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
