knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雜訊只由前置放大器晶片決定，佈局與接地只影響數位部分。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Noise is set only by the preamplifier chip; layout and grounding affect only the digital side. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding" is correct?
options: 雜訊只由前置放大器晶片決定，佈局與接地只影響數位部分。
從偵測器到前置放大器輸入之間的每一 pF 雜散電容都直接加進串聯雜訊：打線、保護二極體、偏壓耦合電容與 PCB 走線都要計入。
能譜峰寬完全由前置放大器的雜訊決定。
optionsEn: Noise is set only by the preamplifier chip; layout and grounding affect only the digital side.
Every picofarad of stray capacitance between detector and preamplifier input adds directly to series noise: bond wires, protection diodes, bias-coupling capacitors and PCB traces all count.
Spectral peak width is set entirely by preamplifier noise.
quiz.explanation: 從偵測器到前置放大器輸入之間的每一 pF 雜散電容都直接加進串聯雜訊：打線、保護二極體、偏壓耦合電容與 PCB 走線都要計入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every picofarad of stray capacitance between detector and preamplifier input adds directly to series noise: bond wires, protection diodes, bias-coupling capacitors and PCB traces all count. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bias network, grounding and layout” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：在 τ = 1 µs 下串聯項為 150 e⁻ @ 25 pF，即斜率 dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF；多出 3 pF 走線電容使串聯項升到 168 e⁻，總 ENC 從 200 變成 √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻（+7%）；偏壓電阻 R_b = 10 MΩ 的熱雜訊電流 √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz，比 1 nA 漏電流的散粒雜訊 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ 還大，改用 100 MΩ 則降到 1.3×10⁻¹⁴。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At τ = 1 µs the series term is 150 e⁻ at 25 pF, a slope dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF; an extra 3 pF of trace capacitance raises the series term to 168 e⁻ and the total ENC from 200 to √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻ (+7%); a bias resistor R_b = 10 MΩ has a thermal noise current √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz, larger than the 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ shot noise of 1 nA leakage, and moving to 100 MΩ brings it down to 1.3×10⁻¹⁴. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 LCR 表或阻抗分析儀量輸入節點對地的總電容（含打線與走線）並與設計值比較；用近場探棒與頻譜分析儀找出通帶內的干擾譜線並逐一追到來源；量偏壓耦合電容在工作電壓下的 pA 級漏電流；每次接地改動前後各量一次基線 RMS。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the total input-node capacitance to ground (bond wires and traces included) with an LCR meter or impedance analyser and compare with the design; locate in-band interference lines with a near-field probe and spectrum analyser and trace each to its source; measure bias-coupling capacitor leakage at working voltage at the pA level; record baseline RMS before and after every grounding change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 在 τ = 1 µs 下串聯項為 150 e⁻ @ 25 pF，即斜率 dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF；多出 3 pF 走線電容使串聯項升到 168 e⁻，總 ENC 從 200 變成 √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻（+7%）；偏壓電阻 R_b = 10 MΩ 的熱雜訊電流 √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz，比 1 nA 漏電流的散粒雜訊 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ 還大，改用 100 MΩ 則降到 1.3×10⁻¹⁴。
knowledge.textEn: At τ = 1 µs the series term is 150 e⁻ at 25 pF, a slope dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF; an extra 3 pF of trace capacitance raises the series term to 168 e⁻ and the total ENC from 200 to √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻ (+7%); a bias resistor R_b = 10 MΩ has a thermal noise current √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz, larger than the 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ shot noise of 1 nA leakage, and moving to 100 MΩ brings it down to 1.3×10⁻¹⁴.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding", which statement holds?
options: 只要 ADC 位元數夠多，類比前端的雜訊就不重要。
電荷靈敏放大器的增益由偵測器電容決定。
在 τ = 1 µs 下串聯項為 150 e⁻ @ 25 pF，即斜率 dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF。
optionsEn: With enough ADC bits, analogue front-end noise no longer matters.
The gain of a charge-sensitive amplifier is set by the detector capacitance.
At τ = 1 µs the series term is 150 e⁻ at 25 pF, a slope dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF.
quiz.explanation: 在 τ = 1 µs 下串聯項為 150 e⁻ @ 25 pF，即斜率 dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF；多出 3 pF 走線電容使串聯項升到 168 e⁻，總 ENC 從 200 變成 √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻（+7%）；偏壓電阻 R_b = 10 MΩ 的熱雜訊電流 √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz，比 1 nA 漏電流的散粒雜訊 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ 還大，改用 100 MΩ 則降到 1.3×10⁻¹⁴。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At τ = 1 µs the series term is 150 e⁻ at 25 pF, a slope dENC_s/dC = 6 e⁻/pF; an extra 3 pF of trace capacitance raises the series term to 168 e⁻ and the total ENC from 200 to √(168² + 132²) ≈ 214 e⁻ (+7%); a bias resistor R_b = 10 MΩ has a thermal noise current √(4kT/R_b) = 4.1×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz, larger than the 1.8×10⁻¹⁴ shot noise of 1 nA leakage, and moving to 100 MΩ brings it down to 1.3×10⁻¹⁴. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bias network, grounding and layout” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 LCR 表或阻抗分析儀量輸入節點對地的總電容（含打線與走線）並與設計值比較；用近場探棒與頻譜分析儀找出通帶內的干擾譜線並逐一追到來源；量偏壓耦合電容在工作電壓下的 pA 級漏電流；每次接地改動前後各量一次基線 RMS。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the total input-node capacitance to ground (bond wires and traces included) with an LCR meter or impedance analyser and compare with the design; locate in-band interference lines with a near-field probe and spectrum analyser and trace each to its source; measure bias-coupling capacitor leakage at working voltage at the pA level; record baseline RMS before and after every grounding change. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：接地迴路讓數位時脈的諧波耦合進輸入端，基線出現週期性波紋，能譜峰變寬且位置隨時脈相位移動；打線過長或保護二極體電容過大，每通道多出數 pF 而讓整板 ENC 超標。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A ground loop couples digital-clock harmonics into the input, the baseline shows periodic ripple and spectral peaks broaden and shift with clock phase; overly long bond wires or large protection-diode capacitance add several pF per channel and push the whole board over its ENC budget.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 LCR 表或阻抗分析儀量輸入節點對地的總電容（含打線與走線）並與設計值比較；用近場探棒與頻譜分析儀找出通帶內的干擾譜線並逐一追到來源；量偏壓耦合電容在工作電壓下的 pA 級漏電流；每次接地改動前後各量一次基線 RMS。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the total input-node capacitance to ground (bond wires and traces included) with an LCR meter or impedance analyser and compare with the design; locate in-band interference lines with a near-field probe and spectrum analyser and trace each to its source; measure bias-coupling capacitor leakage at working voltage at the pA level; record baseline RMS before and after every grounding change.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding"?
options: 以 LCR 表或阻抗分析儀量輸入節點對地的總電容（含打線與走線）並與設計值比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
整形時間越長，雜訊一定越低。
optionsEn: Measure the total input-node capacitance to ground (bond wires and traces included) with an LCR meter or impedance analyser and compare with the design.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Longer shaping time always means lower noise.
quiz.explanation: 以 LCR 表或阻抗分析儀量輸入節點對地的總電容（含打線與走線）並與設計值比較；用近場探棒與頻譜分析儀找出通帶內的干擾譜線並逐一追到來源；量偏壓耦合電容在工作電壓下的 pA 級漏電流；每次接地改動前後各量一次基線 RMS。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the total input-node capacitance to ground (bond wires and traces included) with an LCR meter or impedance analyser and compare with the design; locate in-band interference lines with a near-field probe and spectrum analyser and trace each to its source; measure bias-coupling capacitor leakage at working voltage at the pA level; record baseline RMS before and after every grounding change. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bias network, grounding and layout” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 接地迴路讓數位時脈的諧波耦合進輸入端，基線出現週期性波紋，能譜峰變寬且位置隨時脈相位移動；打線過長或保護二極體電容過大，每通道多出數 pF 而讓整板 ENC 超標。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A ground loop couples digital-clock harmonics into the input, the baseline shows periodic ripple and spectral peaks broaden and shift with clock phase; overly long bond wires or large protection-diode capacitance add several pF per channel and push the whole board over its ENC budget. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：低雜訊讀出有一半是機械與佈局工程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Half of low-noise readout is mechanical and layout engineering.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雜訊只由前置放大器晶片決定，佈局與接地只影響數位部分。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Noise is set only by the preamplifier chip; layout and grounding affect only the digital side." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接地迴路讓數位時脈的諧波耦合進輸入端，基線出現週期性波紋，能譜峰變寬且位置隨時脈相位移動；打線過長或保護二極體電容過大，每通道多出數 pF 而讓整板 ENC 超標。
knowledge.textEn: A ground loop couples digital-clock harmonics into the input, the baseline shows periodic ripple and spectral peaks broaden and shift with clock phase; overly long bond wires or large protection-diode capacitance add several pF per channel and push the whole board over its ENC budget.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「前端介面、雜散電容與接地設計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Front-end interface, stray capacitance and grounding" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
接地迴路讓數位時脈的諧波耦合進輸入端，基線出現週期性波紋，能譜峰變寬且位置隨時脈相位移動。
能譜峰寬完全由前置放大器的雜訊決定。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A ground loop couples digital-clock harmonics into the input, the baseline shows periodic ripple and spectral peaks broaden and shift with clock phase.
Spectral peak width is set entirely by preamplifier noise.
quiz.explanation: 接地迴路讓數位時脈的諧波耦合進輸入端，基線出現週期性波紋，能譜峰變寬且位置隨時脈相位移動；打線過長或保護二極體電容過大，每通道多出數 pF 而讓整板 ENC 超標。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A ground loop couples digital-clock harmonics into the input, the baseline shows periodic ripple and spectral peaks broaden and shift with clock phase; overly long bond wires or large protection-diode capacitance add several pF per channel and push the whole board over its ENC budget. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解」與「最佳整形時間、堆積與雜訊預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition" and "Optimum shaping time, pile-up and the noise budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 校正從精密脈衝注入開始：階躍電壓 ΔV 經注入電容 C_inj 產生 Q = C_inj·ΔV，掃描 ΔV 得到增益、線性度與動態範圍；脈衝器峰的寬度只含電子雜訊，是分離雜訊來源的工具。對能譜儀而言，實測峰寬是三項的平方和：電子雜訊 FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε（ε 為每對電子電洞對的能量）、統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε)（F 為 Fano 因子）、以及電荷收集不完整項；把三項分開，才知道該改前端、偵測器還是整形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Calibration starts with precise pulse injection: a voltage step ΔV through an injection capacitor C_inj creates Q = C_inj·ΔV, and sweeping ΔV yields gain, linearity and dynamic range; the pulser peak width contains only electronic noise, which makes it the tool for separating noise sources. For a spectrometer the measured peak width is the quadrature sum of three terms: electronic noise FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε (ε the energy per electron–hole pair), the statistical term FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε) (F the Fano factor), and incomplete charge collection; only when the three are separated do you know whether to improve the front end, the detector or the shaping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 HPGe 偵測器量 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 譜線為例：每對電子電洞對能量 ε = 2.96 eV、Fano 因子 F = 0.11，統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV；ENC = 100 e⁻ 的電子雜訊項 FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV；電荷收集項取 0.50 keV，總 FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: HPGe at 1332 keV: ε = 2.96 eV, F = 0.11, FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV; an ENC of 100 e⁻ gives FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV; taking 0.50 keV for charge collection, total FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「能譜峰寬完全由前置放大器的雜訊決定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Spectral peak width is set entirely by preamplifier noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解
knowledge.titleEn: Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition
knowledge.text: 校正從精密脈衝注入開始：階躍電壓 ΔV 經注入電容 C_inj 產生 Q = C_inj·ΔV，掃描 ΔV 得到增益、線性度與動態範圍；脈衝器峰的寬度只含電子雜訊，是分離雜訊來源的工具。對能譜儀而言，實測峰寬是三項的平方和：電子雜訊 FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε（ε 為每對電子電洞對的能量）、統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε)（F 為 Fano 因子）、以及電荷收集不完整項；把三項分開，才知道該改前端、偵測器還是整形。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration starts with precise pulse injection: a voltage step ΔV through an injection capacitor C_inj creates Q = C_inj·ΔV, and sweeping ΔV yields gain, linearity and dynamic range; the pulser peak width contains only electronic noise, which makes it the tool for separating noise sources. For a spectrometer the measured peak width is the quadrature sum of three terms: electronic noise FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε (ε the energy per electron–hole pair), the statistical term FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε) (F the Fano factor), and incomplete charge collection; only when the three are separated do you know whether to improve the front end, the detector or the shaping.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：能譜峰寬完全由前置放大器的雜訊決定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Spectral peak width is set entirely by preamplifier noise. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition" is correct?
options: 能譜峰寬完全由前置放大器的雜訊決定。
數位整形可以同時消除雜訊與堆積的限制。
校正從精密脈衝注入開始：階躍電壓 ΔV 經注入電容 C_inj 產生 Q = C_inj·ΔV，掃描 ΔV 得到增益、線性度與動態範圍。
optionsEn: Spectral peak width is set entirely by preamplifier noise.
Digital shaping removes both the noise and the pile-up limits.
Calibration starts with precise pulse injection: a voltage step ΔV through an injection capacitor C_inj creates Q = C_inj·ΔV, and sweeping ΔV yields gain, linearity and dynamic range.
quiz.explanation: 校正從精密脈衝注入開始：階躍電壓 ΔV 經注入電容 C_inj 產生 Q = C_inj·ΔV，掃描 ΔV 得到增益、線性度與動態範圍；脈衝器峰的寬度只含電子雜訊，是分離雜訊來源的工具。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibration starts with precise pulse injection: a voltage step ΔV through an injection capacitor C_inj creates Q = C_inj·ΔV, and sweeping ΔV yields gain, linearity and dynamic range; the pulser peak width contains only electronic noise, which makes it the tool for separating noise sources. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 HPGe 偵測器量 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 譜線為例：每對電子電洞對能量 ε = 2.96 eV、Fano 因子 F = 0.11，統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV；ENC = 100 e⁻ 的電子雜訊項 FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV；電荷收集項取 0.50 keV，總 FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV。注入校正：C_inj = 100 fF、ΔV = 16 mV 給 Q = 1.6 fC = 10,000 e⁻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: HPGe at 1332 keV: ε = 2.96 eV, F = 0.11, FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV; an ENC of 100 e⁻ gives FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV; taking 0.50 keV for charge collection, total FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV. Injection calibration: C_inj = 100 fF with ΔV = 16 mV gives Q = 1.6 fC = 10,000 e⁻. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一次量測中同時取 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 峰與脈衝器峰：脈衝器峰寬給 FWHM_e，由 F 與 ε 算 FWHM_F，殘差歸給電荷收集；再用多個 γ 能量擬合峰寬平方對能量的線性關係 FWHM² = a + b·E，截距 a 應等於 FWHM_e²，斜率 b 應接近 2.355²·F·ε。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acquire the ⁶⁰Co 1332 keV peak and the pulser peak in the same run: the pulser width gives FWHM_e, F and ε give FWHM_F, and the residual is assigned to charge collection; then fit the squared width against energy for several γ lines, FWHM² = a + b·E, where the intercept a should equal FWHM_e² and the slope b should approach 2.355²·F·ε.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 HPGe 偵測器量 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 譜線為例：每對電子電洞對能量 ε = 2.96 eV、Fano 因子 F = 0.11，統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV；ENC = 100 e⁻ 的電子雜訊項 FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV；電荷收集項取 0.50 keV，總 FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV。注入校正：C_inj = 100 fF、ΔV = 16 mV 給 Q = 1.6 fC = 10,000 e⁻。
knowledge.textEn: HPGe at 1332 keV: ε = 2.96 eV, F = 0.11, FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV; an ENC of 100 e⁻ gives FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV; taking 0.50 keV for charge collection, total FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV. Injection calibration: C_inj = 100 fF with ΔV = 16 mV gives Q = 1.6 fC = 10,000 e⁻.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition", which statement holds?
options: 以 HPGe 偵測器量 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 譜線為例：每對電子電洞對能量 ε = 2.96 eV、Fano 因子 F = 0.11，統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV。
每個通道在實驗室測過雜訊，安裝後就不必再量。
整形時間越長，雜訊一定越低。
optionsEn: Once every channel's noise is measured in the lab, no remeasurement is needed after installation.
Longer shaping time always means lower noise.
quiz.explanation: 以 HPGe 偵測器量 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 譜線為例：每對電子電洞對能量 ε = 2.96 eV、Fano 因子 F = 0.11，統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV；ENC = 100 e⁻ 的電子雜訊項 FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV；電荷收集項取 0.50 keV，總 FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: HPGe at 1332 keV: ε = 2.96 eV, F = 0.11, FWHM_F = 2.355×√(0.11×1.332×10⁶×2.96) eV = 2.355×659 eV ≈ 1.55 keV; an ENC of 100 e⁻ gives FWHM_e = 2.355×100×2.96 eV ≈ 0.70 keV; taking 0.50 keV for charge collection, total FWHM = √(1.55² + 0.70² + 0.50²) ≈ 1.77 keV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在同一次量測中同時取 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 峰與脈衝器峰：脈衝器峰寬給 FWHM_e，由 F 與 ε 算 FWHM_F，殘差歸給電荷收集；再用多個 γ 能量擬合峰寬平方對能量的線性關係 FWHM² = a + b·E，截距 a 應等於 FWHM_e²，斜率 b 應接近 2.355²·F·ε。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acquire the ⁶⁰Co 1332 keV peak and the pulser peak in the same run: the pulser width gives FWHM_e, F and ε give FWHM_F, and the residual is assigned to charge collection; then fit the squared width against energy for several γ lines, FWHM² = a + b·E, where the intercept a should equal FWHM_e² and the slope b should approach 2.355²·F·ε. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：注入電容的實際值與標稱差 5% 時，所有通道的能量刻度一起偏 5%，而且線性度檢查看不出來；脈衝器上升時間若比電荷收集慢，校正出的增益會低估彈道虧損。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the injection capacitor differs from nominal by 5%, every channel's energy scale is off by 5% in a way linearity checks cannot reveal; if the pulser rise time is slower than charge collection, the calibrated gain underestimates ballistic deficit.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一次量測中同時取 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 峰與脈衝器峰：脈衝器峰寬給 FWHM_e，由 F 與 ε 算 FWHM_F，殘差歸給電荷收集；再用多個 γ 能量擬合峰寬平方對能量的線性關係 FWHM² = a + b·E，截距 a 應等於 FWHM_e²，斜率 b 應接近 2.355²·F·ε。
knowledge.textEn: Acquire the ⁶⁰Co 1332 keV peak and the pulser peak in the same run: the pulser width gives FWHM_e, F and ε give FWHM_F, and the residual is assigned to charge collection; then fit the squared width against energy for several γ lines, FWHM² = a + b·E, where the intercept a should equal FWHM_e² and the slope b should approach 2.355²·F·ε.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在同一次量測中同時取 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 峰與脈衝器峰：脈衝器峰寬給 FWHM_e，由 F 與 ε 算 FWHM_F，殘差歸給電荷收集。
輸入電晶體做得越大、閘極電容越大，雜訊就越低。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Acquire the ⁶⁰Co 1332 keV peak and the pulser peak in the same run: the pulser width gives FWHM_e, F and ε give FWHM_F, and the residual is assigned to charge collection.
A bigger input transistor with larger gate capacitance always gives lower noise.
quiz.explanation: 在同一次量測中同時取 ⁶⁰Co 的 1332 keV 峰與脈衝器峰：脈衝器峰寬給 FWHM_e，由 F 與 ε 算 FWHM_F，殘差歸給電荷收集；再用多個 γ 能量擬合峰寬平方對能量的線性關係 FWHM² = a + b·E，截距 a 應等於 FWHM_e²，斜率 b 應接近 2.355²·F·ε。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Acquire the ⁶⁰Co 1332 keV peak and the pulser peak in the same run: the pulser width gives FWHM_e, F and ε give FWHM_F, and the residual is assigned to charge collection; then fit the squared width against energy for several γ lines, FWHM² = a + b·E, where the intercept a should equal FWHM_e² and the slope b should approach 2.355²·F·ε. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 注入電容的實際值與標稱差 5% 時，所有通道的能量刻度一起偏 5%，而且線性度檢查看不出來；脈衝器上升時間若比電荷收集慢，校正出的增益會低估彈道虧損。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the injection capacitor differs from nominal by 5%, every channel's energy scale is off by 5% in a way linearity checks cannot reveal; if the pulser rise time is slower than charge collection, the calibrated gain underestimates ballistic deficit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對能譜儀而言，實測峰寬是三項的平方和：電子雜訊 FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε（ε 為每對電子電洞對的能量）、統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε)（F 為 Fano 因子）、以及電荷收集不完整項；把三項分開，才知道該改前端、偵測器還是整形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For a spectrometer the measured peak width is the quadrature sum of three terms: electronic noise FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε (ε the energy per electron–hole pair), the statistical term FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε) (F the Fano factor), and incomplete charge collection; only when the three are separated do you know whether to improve the front end, the detector or the shaping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「能譜峰寬完全由前置放大器的雜訊決定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Spectral peak width is set entirely by preamplifier noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 注入電容的實際值與標稱差 5% 時，所有通道的能量刻度一起偏 5%，而且線性度檢查看不出來；脈衝器上升時間若比電荷收集慢，校正出的增益會低估彈道虧損。
knowledge.textEn: If the injection capacitor differs from nominal by 5%, every channel's energy scale is off by 5% in a way linearity checks cannot reveal; if the pulser rise time is slower than charge collection, the calibrated gain underestimates ballistic deficit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「校正脈衝、能量刻度與解析度分解」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Calibration pulses, energy scale and resolution decomposition" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
數位整形可以同時消除雜訊與堆積的限制。
注入電容的實際值與標稱差 5% 時，所有通道的能量刻度一起偏 5%，而且線性度檢查看不出來；脈衝器上升時間若比電荷收集慢，校正出的增益會低估彈道虧損。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Digital shaping removes both the noise and the pile-up limits.
If the injection capacitor differs from nominal by 5%, every channel's energy scale is off by 5% in a way linearity checks cannot reveal.
quiz.explanation: 注入電容的實際值與標稱差 5% 時，所有通道的能量刻度一起偏 5%，而且線性度檢查看不出來；脈衝器上升時間若比電荷收集慢，校正出的增益會低估彈道虧損。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the injection capacitor differs from nominal by 5%, every channel's energy scale is off by 5% in a way linearity checks cannot reveal; if the pulser rise time is slower than charge collection, the calibrated gain underestimates ballistic deficit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 最佳整形時間、堆積與雜訊預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Optimum shaping time, pile-up and the noise budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ENC–τ 曲線與雜訊轉角」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ENC–τ curve and noise corner” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 串聯項與並聯項相等之處就是雜訊轉角，對應最佳整形時間 τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i)；轉角隨電容、漏電流與溫度移動，所以最佳 τ 不是固定值。整形時間同時決定計數率能力：一個脈衝佔用約數倍 τ，計數率 n 下的堆積機率約為 1 − exp(−n·T_p)，因此高計數率應用常犧牲 ENC 選較短的 τ，或改用梯形數位整形把雜訊濾波與彈道虧損分開處理。完整的雜訊預算要把串聯、並聯、1/f、量化與干擾各項列表後平方相加。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ENC–τ 曲線與雜訊轉角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The noise corner is where the series and parallel terms are equal, corresponding to the optimum shaping time τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i); the corner moves with capacitance, leakage and temperature, so the optimum τ is not a fixed number. Shaping time also sets rate capability: a pulse occupies several τ, and at count rate n the pile-up probability is about 1 − exp(−n·T_p), so high-rate applications often sacrifice ENC for shorter τ or use trapezoidal digital shaping that separates noise filtering from ballistic deficit. A complete noise budget tabulates series, parallel, 1/f, quantisation and interference terms and adds them in quadrature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ENC–τ curve and noise corner”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：沿用前面的總電容 C = 25 pF、e_n = 1 nV/√Hz、並聯雜訊電流 i_n = 2.2×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz：最佳整形時間 τ_opt = 25×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁹/2.2×10⁻¹⁴ ≈ 1.1 µs，此時 ENC² = 2×0.92×e_n·i_n·C = 2×0.92×10⁻⁹×2.2×10⁻¹⁴×25×10⁻¹² ≈ 1.0×10⁻³³ C²，ENC ≈ 200 e⁻；若脈衝佔用時間 T_p = 5τ = 5 µs，計數率 10 kcps 的堆積機率 1 − exp(−0.05) ≈ 4.9%，100 kcps 時升到 39%。

knowledge.title: 最佳整形時間、堆積與雜訊預算
knowledge.titleEn: Optimum shaping time, pile-up and the noise budget
knowledge.text: 串聯項與並聯項相等之處就是雜訊轉角，對應最佳整形時間 τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i)；轉角隨電容、漏電流與溫度移動，所以最佳 τ 不是固定值。整形時間同時決定計數率能力：一個脈衝佔用約數倍 τ，計數率 n 下的堆積機率約為 1 − exp(−n·T_p)，因此高計數率應用常犧牲 ENC 選較短的 τ，或改用梯形數位整形把雜訊濾波與彈道虧損分開處理。
knowledge.textEn: The noise corner is where the series and parallel terms are equal, corresponding to the optimum shaping time τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i); the corner moves with capacitance, leakage and temperature, so the optimum τ is not a fixed number. Shaping time also sets rate capability: a pulse occupies several τ, and at count rate n the pile-up probability is about 1 − exp(−n·T_p), so high-rate applications often sacrifice ENC for shorter τ or use trapezoidal digital shaping that separates noise filtering from ballistic deficit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：數位整形可以同時消除雜訊與堆積的限制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Digital shaping removes both the noise and the pile-up limits. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：沿用前面的總電容 C = 25 pF、e_n = 1 nV/√Hz、並聯雜訊電流 i_n = 2.2×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz：最佳整形時間 τ_opt = 25×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁹/2.2×10⁻¹⁴ ≈ 1.1 µs，此時 ENC² = 2×0.92×e_n·i_n·C = 2×0.92×10⁻⁹×2.2×10⁻¹⁴×25×10⁻¹² ≈ 1.0×10⁻³³ C²，ENC ≈ 200 e⁻；若脈衝佔用時間 T_p = 5τ = 5 µs，計數率 10 kcps 的堆積機率 1 − exp(−0.05) ≈ 4.9%，100 kcps 時升到 39%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With C = 25 pF, e_n = 1 nV/√Hz and i_n = 2.2×10⁻¹⁴ A/√Hz from before: τ_opt = 25×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁹/2.2×10⁻¹⁴ ≈ 1.1 µs, where ENC² = 2×0.92×e_n·i_n·C = 2×0.92×10⁻⁹×2.2×10⁻¹⁴×25×10⁻¹² ≈ 1.0×10⁻³³ C² and ENC ≈ 200 e⁻; with a pulse occupancy T_p = 5τ = 5 µs, the pile-up probability at 10 kcps is 1 − exp(−0.05) ≈ 4.9% and rises to 39% at 100 kcps. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在真實偵測器與工作溫度下量 ENC 對 τ 的曲線，找出最小值並與預測的 τ_opt 比較；用放射源改變計數率，統計被堆積拒絕器剔除的事件比例並與 1 − exp(−n·T_p) 比較；把預算表各項與量測值並列，找出佔比最大的項目。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the ENC-versus-τ curve on the real detector at operating temperature, locate the minimum and compare with the predicted τ_opt; vary the count rate with a source and compare the fraction rejected by the pile-up rejector with 1 − exp(−n·T_p); set the budget table beside the measured values and identify the dominant term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 最佳整形時間、堆積與雜訊預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Optimum shaping time, pile-up and the noise budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ENC–τ 曲線與雜訊轉角」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ENC–τ curve and noise corner” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在真實偵測器與工作溫度下量 ENC 對 τ 的曲線，找出最小值並與預測的 τ_opt 比較；用放射源改變計數率，統計被堆積拒絕器剔除的事件比例並與 1 − exp(−n·T_p) 比較；把預算表各項與量測值並列，找出佔比最大的項目。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the ENC-versus-τ curve on the real detector at operating temperature, locate the minimum and compare with the predicted τ_opt; vary the count rate with a source and compare the fraction rejected by the pile-up rejector with 1 − exp(−n·T_p); set the budget table beside the measured values and identify the dominant term. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在實驗室低漏電流條件下選定 τ，裝到較熱或受輻照的偵測器上後轉角左移，原 τ 落在並聯項主導區，ENC 比預算高出一倍以上。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If τ is chosen under cool low-leakage lab conditions, a warmer or irradiated detector shifts the corner to shorter τ, the chosen τ sits in the parallel-dominated region and ENC exceeds budget by more than a factor of two.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

quiz.explanationEn: If τ is chosen under cool low-leakage lab conditions, a warmer or irradiated detector shifts the corner to shorter τ, the chosen τ sits in the parallel-dominated region and ENC exceeds budget by more than a factor of two. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍」與「系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range" and "System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ADC, digital filtering and data links” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 現代系統把前置放大、整形、ADC 與序列化放進同一顆 ASIC：ALICE TPC 的 524,160 個墊片各有一條 SAMPA 通道，CAEN FERS-5200 一類的讀出平台則把 Citiroc 或 picoTDC 前端做成 64–128 通道的卡，經光纖集中。數位化後常以梯形濾波取代類比整形，並做基線追蹤與共模扣除；ADC 的量化雜訊 LSB/√12 必須遠小於類比 ENC，動態範圍則由滿刻度電荷與 ENC 之比決定，通常以位元數換取功耗。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modern systems put preamplifier, shaper, ADC and serialiser on one ASIC: each of the 524,160 pads of the ALICE TPC has its own SAMPA channel, and readout platforms such as CAEN FERS-5200 integrate Citiroc or picoTDC front ends on 64–128-channel cards concentrated over optical links. After digitisation a trapezoidal filter often replaces analogue shaping, with baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction; the ADC quantisation noise LSB/√12 must stay well below the analogue ENC, and the dynamic range is the ratio of full-scale charge to ENC, usually traded against power through the bit count. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ADC, digital filtering and data links”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設前端增益 50 mV/fC、10 位元 ADC、滿刻度 1 V：最小量化單位 LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻，量化雜訊 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻，與 200 e⁻ 的類比 ENC 平方相加只增加 1.5%；滿刻度電荷 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 個 MIP，動態範圍 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625；每通道功耗 1 mW 時 10⁶ 個通道共耗 1 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Gain 50 mV/fC, 10-bit ADC, 1 V full scale: LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻, quantisation noise 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻, which adds only 1.5% in quadrature to a 200 e⁻ analogue ENC; full-scale charge 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 MIPs, a dynamic range of 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625; at 1 mW per channel, 10⁶ channels dissipate 1 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要 ADC 位元數夠多，類比前端的雜訊就不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough ADC bits, analogue front-end noise no longer matters." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “ADC, digital filtering and data links”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ADC, digital filtering and data links” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設前端增益 50 mV/fC、10 位元 ADC、滿刻度 1 V：最小量化單位 LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻，量化雜訊 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻，與 200 e⁻ 的類比 ENC 平方相加只增加 1.5%；滿刻度電荷 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 個 MIP，動態範圍 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625；每通道功耗 1 mW 時 10⁶ 個通道共耗 1 kW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Gain 50 mV/fC, 10-bit ADC, 1 V full scale: LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻, quantisation noise 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻, which adds only 1.5% in quadrature to a 200 e⁻ analogue ENC; full-scale charge 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 MIPs, a dynamic range of 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625; at 1 mW per channel, 10⁶ channels dissipate 1 kW. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用注入脈衝量 ADC 線性度（INL/DNL）與增益一致性，確認通道間增益離散在 1–2% 內；以無訊號資料驗證數位基線追蹤與共模扣除後的雜訊回到單通道 ENC；量光纖鏈誤碼率、每通道功耗與溫升，並與冷卻設計比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure ADC linearity (INL/DNL) and gain uniformity with injected pulses and confirm channel-to-channel gain spread within 1–2%; use signal-free data to verify that noise after digital baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction returns to the single-channel ENC; measure optical-link bit-error rate, per-channel power and temperature rise and compare with the cooling design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 設前端增益 50 mV/fC、10 位元 ADC、滿刻度 1 V：最小量化單位 LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻，量化雜訊 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻，與 200 e⁻ 的類比 ENC 平方相加只增加 1.5%；滿刻度電荷 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 個 MIP，動態範圍 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625；每通道功耗 1 mW 時 10⁶ 個通道共耗 1 kW。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 整形時間越長，雜訊一定越低。
雜訊只由前置放大器晶片決定，佈局與接地只影響數位部分。
設前端增益 50 mV/fC、10 位元 ADC、滿刻度 1 V：最小量化單位 LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻，量化雜訊 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻，與 200 e⁻ 的類比 ENC 平方相加只增加 1.5%。
optionsEn: Longer shaping time always means lower noise.
Noise is set only by the preamplifier chip; layout and grounding affect only the digital side.
Gain 50 mV/fC, 10-bit ADC, 1 V full scale: LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻, quantisation noise 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻, which adds only 1.5% in quadrature to a 200 e⁻ analogue ENC.
quiz.explanation: 設前端增益 50 mV/fC、10 位元 ADC、滿刻度 1 V：最小量化單位 LSB = 0.98 mV = 0.0195 fC ≈ 122 e⁻，量化雜訊 122/√12 ≈ 35 e⁻，與 200 e⁻ 的類比 ENC 平方相加只增加 1.5%；滿刻度電荷 1 V ÷ 50 mV/fC = 20 fC = 1.25×10⁵ e⁻ ≈ 5.2 個 MIP，動態範圍 1.25×10⁵/200 ≈ 625；每通道功耗 1 mW 時 10⁶ 個通道共耗 1 kW。 重算時請保留單位。

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ADC, digital filtering and data links” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用注入脈衝量 ADC 線性度（INL/DNL）與增益一致性，確認通道間增益離散在 1–2% 內；以無訊號資料驗證數位基線追蹤與共模扣除後的雜訊回到單通道 ENC；量光纖鏈誤碼率、每通道功耗與溫升，並與冷卻設計比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure ADC linearity (INL/DNL) and gain uniformity with injected pulses and confirm channel-to-channel gain spread within 1–2%; use signal-free data to verify that noise after digital baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction returns to the single-channel ENC; measure optical-link bit-error rate, per-channel power and temperature rise and compare with the cooling design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：共模雜訊未扣除時整板通道一起上下擺動，單通道 ENC 看似合格，但叢集電荷總和的雜訊隨通道數線性而非平方根成長；ADC 位元數不足則低能端被量化台階撐寬。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Without common-mode subtraction all channels on a board move together, each channel's ENC looks fine but the noise of summed cluster charge grows linearly rather than as the square root of channel count; too few ADC bits widen the low-energy end with quantisation steps.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用注入脈衝量 ADC 線性度（INL/DNL）與增益一致性，確認通道間增益離散在 1–2% 內；以無訊號資料驗證數位基線追蹤與共模扣除後的雜訊回到單通道 ENC；量光纖鏈誤碼率、每通道功耗與溫升，並與冷卻設計比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure ADC linearity (INL/DNL) and gain uniformity with injected pulses and confirm channel-to-channel gain spread within 1–2%; use signal-free data to verify that noise after digital baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction returns to the single-channel ENC; measure optical-link bit-error rate, per-channel power and temperature rise and compare with the cooling design.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range"?
options: 用注入脈衝量 ADC 線性度（INL/DNL）與增益一致性，確認通道間增益離散在 1–2% 內。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
能譜峰寬完全由前置放大器的雜訊決定。

Spectral peak width is set entirely by preamplifier noise.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure ADC linearity (INL/DNL) and gain uniformity with injected pulses and confirm channel-to-channel gain spread within 1–2%; use signal-free data to verify that noise after digital baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction returns to the single-channel ENC; measure optical-link bit-error rate, per-channel power and temperature rise and compare with the cooling design. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 整合：ASIC 讀出、數位化與動態範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Integration: ASIC readout, digitisation and dynamic range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “ADC, digital filtering and data links” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 共模雜訊未扣除時整板通道一起上下擺動，單通道 ENC 看似合格，但叢集電荷總和的雜訊隨通道數線性而非平方根成長；ADC 位元數不足則低能端被量化台階撐寬。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Without common-mode subtraction all channels on a board move together, each channel's ENC looks fine but the noise of summed cluster charge grows linearly rather than as the square root of channel count; too few ADC bits widen the low-energy end with quantisation steps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：數位化後常以梯形濾波取代類比整形，並做基線追蹤與共模扣除；ADC 的量化雜訊 LSB/√12 必須遠小於類比 ENC，動態範圍則由滿刻度電荷與 ENC 之比決定，通常以位元數換取功耗。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要 ADC 位元數夠多，類比前端的雜訊就不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With enough ADC bits, analogue front-end noise no longer matters." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共模雜訊未扣除時整板通道一起上下擺動，單通道 ENC 看似合格，但叢集電荷總和的雜訊隨通道數線性而非平方根成長；ADC 位元數不足則低能端被量化台階撐寬。

steps.title: 系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」如何決定低雜訊偵測器讀出的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “Low-noise detector readout”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 系統層級的驗證是在完整安裝、接地與冷卻條件下重做雜訊量測，因為 ENC 在實驗室與實驗大廳常差一倍；接著用雜訊佔用率決定門檻：高斯雜訊超過門檻 k·ENC 的機率為 ½·erfc(k/√2)，乘上取樣率與通道數就是假訊號率，必須與效率要求折衷。交接文件必須含每通道的增益、ENC、門檻與遮蔽清單、溫度係數、注入電容常數與長期穩定度紀錄，讓後續校正可以追溯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: System-level validation repeats the noise measurements with the full installation, grounding and cooling in place, because ENC in the lab and in the experimental hall often differ by a factor of two; the threshold is then set from noise occupancy: the probability that Gaussian noise exceeds a threshold k·ENC is ½·erfc(k/√2), and multiplied by sampling rate and channel count it gives the fake-hit rate, which must be traded against efficiency. The handoff record must include per-channel gain, ENC, threshold and masking list, temperature coefficients, injection-capacitor constants and long-term stability logs so that later calibrations remain traceable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取 ENC = 800 e⁻（含安裝後的雜散電容與干擾）、門檻 4000 e⁻ = 5σ：單次取樣的雜訊超越機率 ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷；40 MHz 取樣下每通道 11.5 Hz，10⁶ 個通道合計 1.15×10⁷ Hz 的假訊號；門檻提高到 6σ = 4800 e⁻ 時機率 ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰，每通道 0.04 Hz，而 24,000 e⁻ 的 MIP 訊號仍有 5 倍餘裕。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take ENC = 800 e⁻ (including post-installation stray capacitance and interference) and a threshold of 4000 e⁻ = 5σ: the per-sample noise crossing probability is ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷; at 40 MHz sampling that is 11.5 Hz per channel and 1.15×10⁷ Hz of fake hits over 10⁶ channels; raising the threshold to 6σ = 4800 e⁻ gives ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰, 0.04 Hz per channel, while a 24,000 e⁻ MIP signal still has a margin of 5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個通道在實驗室測過雜訊，安裝後就不必再量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once every channel's noise is measured in the lab, no remeasurement is needed after installation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once every channel's noise is measured in the lab, no remeasurement is needed after installation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 ENC = 800 e⁻（含安裝後的雜散電容與干擾）、門檻 4000 e⁻ = 5σ：單次取樣的雜訊超越機率 ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷；40 MHz 取樣下每通道 11.5 Hz，10⁶ 個通道合計 1.15×10⁷ Hz 的假訊號；門檻提高到 6σ = 4800 e⁻ 時機率 ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰，每通道 0.04 Hz，而 24,000 e⁻ 的 MIP 訊號仍有 5 倍餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take ENC = 800 e⁻ (including post-installation stray capacitance and interference) and a threshold of 4000 e⁻ = 5σ: the per-sample noise crossing probability is ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷; at 40 MHz sampling that is 11.5 Hz per channel and 1.15×10⁷ Hz of fake hits over 10⁶ channels; raising the threshold to 6σ = 4800 e⁻ gives ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰, 0.04 Hz per channel, while a 24,000 e⁻ MIP signal still has a margin of 5. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐通道做門檻掃描（S 曲線）得到雜訊佔用率對門檻的關係，擬合出 ENC 與門檻偏移並與注入校正的 ENC 比較；用宇宙射線或放射源量不同門檻下的效率，選出效率 ≥ 99% 且佔用率達標的工作點；把全部參數寫入校正資料庫並做一次冷啟動重載驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run threshold scans (S-curves) channel by channel to obtain noise occupancy versus threshold, fit for ENC and threshold offset and compare with the injection-calibrated ENC; measure efficiency at several thresholds with cosmic rays or a source and choose the working point with at least 99% efficiency at the target occupancy; write all parameters into the calibration database and validate with a cold-start reload.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 取 ENC = 800 e⁻（含安裝後的雜散電容與干擾）、門檻 4000 e⁻ = 5σ：單次取樣的雜訊超越機率 ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷；40 MHz 取樣下每通道 11.5 Hz，10⁶ 個通道合計 1.15×10⁷ Hz 的假訊號；門檻提高到 6σ = 4800 e⁻ 時機率 ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰，每通道 0.04 Hz，而 24,000 e⁻ 的 MIP 訊號仍有 5 倍餘裕。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 取 ENC = 800 e⁻（含安裝後的雜散電容與干擾）、門檻 4000 e⁻ = 5σ：單次取樣的雜訊超越機率 ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷。
輸入電晶體做得越大、閘極電容越大，雜訊就越低。
能譜峰寬完全由前置放大器的雜訊決定。
optionsEn: Take ENC = 800 e⁻ (including post-installation stray capacitance and interference) and a threshold of 4000 e⁻ = 5σ: the per-sample noise crossing probability is ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷.
A bigger input transistor with larger gate capacitance always gives lower noise.
Spectral peak width is set entirely by preamplifier noise.
quiz.explanation: 取 ENC = 800 e⁻（含安裝後的雜散電容與干擾）、門檻 4000 e⁻ = 5σ：單次取樣的雜訊超越機率 ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷；40 MHz 取樣下每通道 11.5 Hz，10⁶ 個通道合計 1.15×10⁷ Hz 的假訊號；門檻提高到 6σ = 4800 e⁻ 時機率 ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰，每通道 0.04 Hz，而 24,000 e⁻ 的 MIP 訊號仍有 5 倍餘裕。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take ENC = 800 e⁻ (including post-installation stray capacitance and interference) and a threshold of 4000 e⁻ = 5σ: the per-sample noise crossing probability is ½·erfc(5/√2) ≈ 2.9×10⁻⁷; at 40 MHz sampling that is 11.5 Hz per channel and 1.15×10⁷ Hz of fake hits over 10⁶ channels; raising the threshold to 6σ = 4800 e⁻ gives ≈ 9.9×10⁻¹⁰, 0.04 Hz per channel, while a 24,000 e⁻ MIP signal still has a margin of 5. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 逐通道做門檻掃描（S 曲線）得到雜訊佔用率對門檻的關係，擬合出 ENC 與門檻偏移並與注入校正的 ENC 比較；用宇宙射線或放射源量不同門檻下的效率，選出效率 ≥ 99% 且佔用率達標的工作點；把全部參數寫入校正資料庫並做一次冷啟動重載驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run threshold scans (S-curves) channel by channel to obtain noise occupancy versus threshold, fit for ENC and threshold offset and compare with the injection-calibrated ENC; measure efficiency at several thresholds with cosmic rays or a source and choose the working point with at least 99% efficiency at the target occupancy; write all parameters into the calibration database and validate with a cold-start reload. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：門檻在實驗室條件下設定、安裝後 ENC 升高一倍卻未重新掃描時，佔用率從 10⁻⁷ 暴增到 10⁻³，資料鏈飽和、觸發率失控；反之為了壓佔用率把門檻設太高，低電荷的邊緣叢集被丟棄，位置解析度變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If thresholds set in the lab are kept after installation doubles the ENC, occupancy jumps from 10⁻⁷ to 10⁻³, the data links saturate and trigger rates run away; setting thresholds too high to suppress occupancy instead discards low-charge edge clusters and degrades position resolution.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐通道做門檻掃描（S 曲線）得到雜訊佔用率對門檻的關係，擬合出 ENC 與門檻偏移並與注入校正的 ENC 比較；用宇宙射線或放射源量不同門檻下的效率，選出效率 ≥ 99% 且佔用率達標的工作點；把全部參數寫入校正資料庫並做一次冷啟動重載驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Run threshold scans (S-curves) channel by channel to obtain noise occupancy versus threshold, fit for ENC and threshold offset and compare with the injection-calibrated ENC; measure efficiency at several thresholds with cosmic rays or a source and choose the working point with at least 99% efficiency at the target occupancy; write all parameters into the calibration database and validate with a cold-start reload.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
逐通道做門檻掃描（S 曲線）得到雜訊佔用率對門檻的關係，擬合出 ENC 與門檻偏移並與注入校正的 ENC 比較。
數位整形可以同時消除雜訊與堆積的限制。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Run threshold scans (S-curves) channel by channel to obtain noise occupancy versus threshold, fit for ENC and threshold offset and compare with the injection-calibrated ENC.
Digital shaping removes both the noise and the pile-up limits.
quiz.explanation: 逐通道做門檻掃描（S 曲線）得到雜訊佔用率對門檻的關係，擬合出 ENC 與門檻偏移並與注入校正的 ENC 比較；用宇宙射線或放射源量不同門檻下的效率，選出效率 ≥ 99% 且佔用率達標的工作點；把全部參數寫入校正資料庫並做一次冷啟動重載驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run threshold scans (S-curves) channel by channel to obtain noise occupancy versus threshold, fit for ENC and threshold offset and compare with the injection-calibrated ENC; measure efficiency at several thresholds with cosmic rays or a source and choose the working point with at least 99% efficiency at the target occupancy; write all parameters into the calibration database and validate with a cold-start reload. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 系統驗證、門檻設定與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System validation, threshold setting and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 門檻在實驗室條件下設定、安裝後 ENC 升高一倍卻未重新掃描時，佔用率從 10⁻⁷ 暴增到 10⁻³，資料鏈飽和、觸發率失控；反之為了壓佔用率把門檻設太高，低電荷的邊緣叢集被丟棄，位置解析度變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If thresholds set in the lab are kept after installation doubles the ENC, occupancy jumps from 10⁻⁷ to 10⁻³, the data links saturate and trigger rates run away; setting thresholds too high to suppress occupancy instead discards low-charge edge clusters and degrades position resolution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須含每通道的增益、ENC、門檻與遮蔽清單、溫度係數、注入電容常數與長期穩定度紀錄，讓後續校正可以追溯。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must include per-channel gain, ENC, threshold and masking list, temperature coefficients, injection-capacitor constants and long-term stability logs so that later calibrations remain traceable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個通道在實驗室測過雜訊，安裝後就不必再量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once every channel's noise is measured in the lab, no remeasurement is needed after installation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

title: 天文自適應光學
summary: 以 ESO VLT 自適應光學設施（1170 致動器的變形副鏡）與 ELT 的 2.4 m、5000 餘致動器 M4 為範本：從 r0、Greenwood 頻率與等暈角推出變形鏡與波前感測器的規格，再把擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊與非共光路像差整合成 Strehl 預算，最後以即時控制迴路與天上驗證完成工程交接。
summaryEn: Using the ESO VLT Adaptive Optics Facility with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and the 2.4 m, 5000-plus-actuator M4 of the ELT as templates: derive deformable-mirror and wavefront-sensor specifications from r0, the Greenwood frequency and the isoplanatic angle, assemble fitting, temporal, measurement and non-common-path terms into a Strehl budget, and close with real-time control dynamics and on-sky validation for engineering handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.textEn: Strehl-budget exercise: VLT 8.2 m, K band at 2.2 µm, seeing 0.7″ (r0 = 14.4 cm at 500 nm → 85 cm at K), wind 10 m/s, a 1170-actuator deformable secondary (projected pitch 0.21 m), a 1 kHz loop with f_3dB = 50 Hz and a bright on-axis NGS. Fitting: 0.28×(0.21/0.85)^(5/3) = 0.028 rad²; temporal: f_G = 0.427×10/0.85 = 5.0 Hz, (5.0/50)^(5/3) = 0.022; measurement: 500 photons per subaperture per frame, π²/(2×500)×(0.7/2.2)² = 0.001; aliasing 0.008; NCPA 50 nm → (2π×50/2200)² = 0.020; other 0.010. Total σ² = 0.089 → exp(−0.089) = 0.915; jitter 10 mas → S_j = 0.86; Strehl ≈ 0.79. If the guide star fades to 10 photons per frame the measurement term rises to 0.05, σ² = 0.138 → 0.871×0.86 ≈ 0.75; if seeing worsens to 1.2″ the fitting and temporal terms each grow by 2.45, σ² ≈ 0.21 → Strehl ≈ 0.70. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real system's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度」與「時間相干、角相干與迴路速度需求」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing" and "Temporal and angular coherence and the loop-rate requirement": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」如何決定天文自適應光學的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter” determines the key performance of “Astronomical adaptive optics”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大氣折射率的隨機起伏由溫度微差造成，其結構遵循 Kolmogorov 統計，強度以 C_n²(h) 剖面描述。沿視線積分後得到 Fried 參數 r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5)，它是波前相位變異量達到 1 rad² 的孔徑直徑：直徑大於 r0 的望遠鏡，長曝光影像不再隨口徑變銳，而被視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0 限制。因為 k = 2π/λ，r0 ∝ λ^(6/5)，所以同一片大氣在紅外線顯得平靜得多，這是近紅外成為自適應光學主戰場的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Random refractive-index fluctuations of the air arise from small temperature differences and follow Kolmogorov statistics, with strength described by the C_n²(h) profile. Integrating along the line of sight gives the Fried parameter r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5), the aperture diameter over which the wavefront phase variance reaches 1 rad²: a telescope larger than r0 gains no further sharpness in long exposures and is limited by the seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0. Because k = 2π/λ, r0 ∝ λ^(6/5), so the same atmosphere looks far calmer in the infrared, which is why the near-infrared is the main arena of adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Paranal median seeing of 0.7″ at 500 nm: r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm; at K band (2.2 µm) r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm; the K-band seeing FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″, whereas the diffraction limit λ/D of an 8.2 m telescope is ≈ 0.055″, a factor 9.4 that AO must recover.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「望遠鏡口徑越大，長曝光影像就越銳利。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Random refractive-index fluctuations of the air arise from small temperature differences and follow Kolmogorov statistics, with strength described by the C_n²(h) profile. Integrating along the line of sight gives the Fried parameter r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5), the aperture diameter over which the wavefront phase variance reaches 1 rad²: a telescope larger than r0 gains no further sharpness in long exposures and is limited by the seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：望遠鏡口徑越大，長曝光影像就越銳利。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing" is correct?
options: 望遠鏡口徑越大，長曝光影像就越銳利。
大氣折射率的隨機起伏由溫度微差造成，其結構遵循 Kolmogorov 統計，強度以 C_n²(h) 剖面描述。
只要參考星夠亮，離目標多遠都能用來校正。
optionsEn: A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images.
Random refractive-index fluctuations of the air arise from small temperature differences and follow Kolmogorov statistics, with strength described by the C_n²(h) profile.
A bright enough reference star can correct a target no matter how far away it is.
quiz.explanation: 大氣折射率的隨機起伏由溫度微差造成，其結構遵循 Kolmogorov 統計，強度以 C_n²(h) 剖面描述。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Random refractive-index fluctuations of the air arise from small temperature differences and follow Kolmogorov statistics, with strength described by the C_n²(h) profile. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Paranal 中位視寧度 0.7″（500 nm）：r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm；換到 K 波段 2.2 µm，r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm；K 波段視寧度 FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″，而 8.2 m 望遠鏡的繞射極限 λ/D ≈ 0.055″，差 9.4 倍，這就是 AO 要補回的銳度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Paranal median seeing of 0.7″ at 500 nm: r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm; at K band (2.2 µm) r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm; the K-band seeing FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″, whereas the diffraction limit λ/D of an 8.2 m telescope is ≈ 0.055″, a factor 9.4 that AO must recover. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用台址的 DIMM（差分影像運動監測儀）量 r0 並換算視寧度，與同時間科學影像的 FWHM 比較；以 MASS 或 SCIDAR 量 C_n²(h) 剖面，積分後核對是否重現 DIMM 的 r0；在兩個波段同時成像，確認 FWHM 比值符合 λ^(−1/5) 的視寧度尺度關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure r0 with the site DIMM (differential image motion monitor) and convert to seeing, comparing with the FWHM of simultaneous science images; measure the C_n²(h) profile with MASS or SCIDAR and integrate it to check that it reproduces the DIMM r0; image in two bands at once and confirm the FWHM ratio follows the λ^(−1/5) seeing scaling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Paranal median seeing of 0.7″ at 500 nm: r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm; at K band (2.2 µm) r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm; the K-band seeing FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″, whereas the diffraction limit λ/D of an 8.2 m telescope is ≈ 0.055″, a factor 9.4 that AO must recover.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing", which statement holds?
options: 波前感測器的量測精度只取決於相機的像素大小。
Strehl 只由變形鏡的致動器數量決定。
optionsEn: Wavefront-sensor accuracy depends only on the camera's pixel size.
Strehl is determined only by the number of deformable-mirror actuators.
Paranal median seeing of 0.7″ at 500 nm: r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm.
quiz.explanationEn: Paranal median seeing of 0.7″ at 500 nm: r0 = 0.98λ/θ = 0.98×5×10⁻⁷ m/(0.7×4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) ≈ 14.4 cm; at K band (2.2 µm) r0 = 14.4 cm×(2.2/0.5)^(6/5) ≈ 14.4×5.92 ≈ 85 cm; the K-band seeing FWHM = 0.98×2.2×10⁻⁶/0.85 ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.52″, whereas the diffraction limit λ/D of an 8.2 m telescope is ≈ 0.055″, a factor 9.4 that AO must recover. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用台址的 DIMM（差分影像運動監測儀）量 r0 並換算視寧度，與同時間科學影像的 FWHM 比較；以 MASS 或 SCIDAR 量 C_n²(h) 剖面，積分後核對是否重現 DIMM 的 r0；在兩個波段同時成像，確認 FWHM 比值符合 λ^(−1/5) 的視寧度尺度關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure r0 with the site DIMM (differential image motion monitor) and convert to seeing, comparing with the FWHM of simultaneous science images; measure the C_n²(h) profile with MASS or SCIDAR and integrate it to check that it reproduces the DIMM r0; image in two bands at once and confirm the FWHM ratio follows the λ^(−1/5) seeing scaling. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 r0 當成與波長無關的常數，用可見光的 r0 去設計紅外 AO，會把致動器數與迴路頻率高估數倍；反之用紅外的 r0 設計可見光感測器，則子孔徑太大而讓波前量測失效。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating r0 as wavelength-independent and designing an infrared AO system with the visible r0 overestimates actuator count and loop rate by several times; using the infrared r0 for a visible-light sensor instead makes the subapertures too large and the wavefront measurement fails.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用台址的 DIMM（差分影像運動監測儀）量 r0 並換算視寧度，與同時間科學影像的 FWHM 比較；以 MASS 或 SCIDAR 量 C_n²(h) 剖面，積分後核對是否重現 DIMM 的 r0；在兩個波段同時成像，確認 FWHM 比值符合 λ^(−1/5) 的視寧度尺度關係。
knowledge.textEn: Measure r0 with the site DIMM (differential image motion monitor) and convert to seeing, comparing with the FWHM of simultaneous science images; measure the C_n²(h) profile with MASS or SCIDAR and integrate it to check that it reproduces the DIMM r0; image in two bands at once and confirm the FWHM ratio follows the λ^(−1/5) seeing scaling.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。

steps.title: Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 r0 當成與波長無關的常數，用可見光的 r0 去設計紅外 AO，會把致動器數與迴路頻率高估數倍；反之用紅外的 r0 設計可見光感測器，則子孔徑太大而讓波前量測失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Treating r0 as wavelength-independent and designing an infrared AO system with the visible r0 overestimates actuator count and loop rate by several times; using the infrared r0 for a visible-light sensor instead makes the subapertures too large and the wavefront measurement fails. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為 k = 2π/λ，r0 ∝ λ^(6/5)，所以同一片大氣在紅外線顯得平靜得多，這是近紅外成為自適應光學主戰場的原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because k = 2π/λ, r0 ∝ λ^(6/5), so the same atmosphere looks far calmer in the infrared, which is why the near-infrared is the main arena of adaptive optics.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「望遠鏡口徑越大，長曝光影像就越銳利。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
