knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
望遠鏡口徑越大，長曝光影像就越銳利。
交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A larger telescope aperture always gives sharper long-exposure images.

If the instrument configuration (filter, focus position) tied to the NCPA offsets is not recorded at handoff, old offsets are reused after a filter change, the science Strehl silently drops 10–20% while sensor residuals look perfectly normal, and the problem surfaces only when archived PSFs are compared.
quiz.explanation: 交接時未記錄 NCPA 偏置所對應的儀器配置（濾鏡、焦點位置），換濾鏡後沿用舊偏置，科學影像的 Strehl 無聲地下降 10–20%，感測器殘差卻完全正常，問題要到比對歸檔 PSF 時才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐
titleEn: Active support of telescope primary mirrors
summary: 以 VLT 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡與 150 支軸向致動器為主軸，理解為什麼薄鏡必須由力分佈定義面形，再把彎曲模態、仰角載重、溫度梯度、30 秒積分的 Shack–Hartmann 感測、查找表與力圖健康監測整合成可驗收的主動光學工程。
summaryEn: Built around the VLT's 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus and its 150 axial actuators, this course shows why a thin mirror's figure must be defined by its force distribution, then integrates bending modes, elevation loads, thermal gradients, 30-second Shack–Hartmann sensing, look-up tables and force-map health monitoring into an acceptable active-optics engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 主動修正練習：假設一面 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄鏡位於天頂角 45°。鏡重 226 kN，軸向分量 226 × cos 45° ≈ 160 kN，150 支平均每支約 1,065 N，側向同為約 160 kN。夜間鏡體穿厚度溫差 0.4 K、α = 0.05 ppm/K：κ = 0.05×10⁻⁶ × 0.4/0.175 ≈ 1.14×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹，矢高 κa²/2 = 1.14×10⁻⁷ × 4.1²/2 ≈ 0.96 µm，交給副鏡以離焦修正。感測器量得像散係數 600 nm，主鏡迴路增益 0.3、每 45 s 修正一次，要降到 40 nm 需 n = ln(40/600)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.6，即 8 次、約 6 分鐘。殘差預算為拋光 30、印痕 15、主動 25、熱 20、風 15 nm，RSS ≈ 49 nm，在 1.0 µm 的 Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 49/1000)²] ≈ 0.91。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Active-correction exercise: assume an 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus at 45° zenith angle. The 226 kN weight has an axial component of 226 × cos 45° ≈ 160 kN, about 1,065 N on average for each of 150 actuators, and a lateral component of about 160 kN as well. At night a 0.4 K through-thickness difference with α = 0.05 ppm/K gives κ = 0.05×10⁻⁶ × 0.4/0.175 ≈ 1.14×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ and a sag of κa²/2 = 1.14×10⁻⁷ × 4.1²/2 ≈ 0.96 µm, which the secondary removes as defocus. The sensor reports 600 nm of astigmatism; with gain 0.3 and one correction every 45 s, reaching 40 nm needs n = ln(40/600)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.6, so 8 corrections or about 6 minutes. A residual budget of polishing 30, print-through 15, active 25, thermal 20 and wind 15 nm gives RSS ≈ 49 nm and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 49/1000)²] ≈ 0.91 at 1.0 µm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any telescope's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」與「主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" and "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。VLT 改用直徑 8.2 m、厚 175 mm 的 Zerodur 薄彎月鏡，厚徑比約 1:47、質量約 23 噸；然而板的彎曲剛度 D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) 隨厚度三次方下降，鏡面在自身重量下已無法保持形狀。主動支撐的出發點就是承認這面鏡子是軟的，改由支撐力的分佈來定義面形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The VLT instead uses an 8.2 m diameter, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus with an aspect ratio near 1:47 and a mass of about 23 tonnes; however the plate bending stiffness D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) falls with the cube of thickness, so the mirror can no longer hold its shape under its own weight. Active support starts by accepting that the mirror is soft and letting the distribution of support forces define its figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8.2 m thin meniscus blank”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Zerodur E = 90.3 GPa、ν = 0.243、ρ = 2530 kg/m³、t = 0.175 m：D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m，自重面載 q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For Zerodur with E = 90.3 GPa, ν = 0.243, ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and t = 0.175 m, D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m and the self-weight pressure is q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形
knowledge.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus
knowledge.text: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。VLT 改用直徑 8.2 m、厚 175 mm 的 Zerodur 薄彎月鏡，厚徑比約 1:47、質量約 23 噸；然而板的彎曲剛度 D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) 隨厚度三次方下降，鏡面在自身重量下已無法保持形狀。
knowledge.textEn: Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The VLT instead uses an 8.2 m diameter, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus with an aspect ratio near 1:47 and a mass of about 23 tonnes; however the plate bending stiffness D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) falls with the cube of thickness, so the mirror can no longer hold its shape under its own weight.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" is correct?
options: 主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。
傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。
主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。
optionsEn: Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost.

Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure.
Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time.
quiz.explanation: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Zerodur E = 90.3 GPa、ν = 0.243、ρ = 2530 kg/m³、t = 0.175 m：D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m，自重面載 q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa。若只在外緣簡支，中心撓度 w = (5 + ν)·q·a⁴/(64(1 + ν)·D) ≈ 1.9 mm（a = 4.1 m）；同口徑做成 1.37 m 厚（1:6）只撓 0.031 mm，但質量達 183 噸。改用 150 點支撐，每點分攤約 0.35 m²、跨距約 0.59 m，撓度隨跨距四次方縮小 (0.59/8.2)⁴ ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁵，量級降到數十 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For Zerodur with E = 90.3 GPa, ν = 0.243, ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and t = 0.175 m, D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m and the self-weight pressure is q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa. Simply supported only at the rim, the centre deflection w = (5 + ν)·q·a⁴/(64(1 + ν)·D) ≈ 1.9 mm for a = 4.1 m; the same aperture at 1.37 m thickness (1:6) sags only 0.031 mm but weighs 183 tonnes. With 150 supports each carrying about 0.35 m² over a span near 0.59 m, deflection scales down with the fourth power of span, (0.59/8.2)⁴ ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁵, to the order of tens of nanometres. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在 150 點支撐、不同仰角下的面形，與上式的量級互相核對；在拋光廠以與望遠鏡相同佈局的 150 點測試支撐量面形，再到望遠鏡上以波前感測器量重力變形殘差，三者一致才代表支撐模型可信。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the blank's figure on 150 supports at several elevations with a finite-element model and cross-check the order of magnitude against the formula; measure the figure in the polishing shop on a 150-point test support matching the telescope layout, then measure the gravity residual on the telescope with the wavefront sensor; only when all three agree is the support model trustworthy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

steps.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在 150 點支撐、不同仰角下的面形，與上式的量級互相核對；在拋光廠以與望遠鏡相同佈局的 150 點測試支撐量面形，再到望遠鏡上以波前感測器量重力變形殘差，三者一致才代表支撐模型可信。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the blank's figure on 150 supports at several elevations with a finite-element model and cross-check the order of magnitude against the formula; measure the figure in the polishing shop on a 150-point test support matching the telescope layout, then measure the gravity residual on the telescope with the wavefront sensor; only when all three agree is the support model trustworthy. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus"?
options: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在 150 點支撐、不同仰角下的面形，與上式的量級互相核對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。

Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless.
quiz.explanation: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在 150 點支撐、不同仰角下的面形，與上式的量級互相核對；在拋光廠以與望遠鏡相同佈局的 150 點測試支撐量面形，再到望遠鏡上以波前感測器量重力變形殘差，三者一致才代表支撐模型可信。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute the blank's figure on 150 supports at several elevations with a finite-element model and cross-check the order of magnitude against the formula; measure the figure in the polishing shop on a 150-point test support matching the telescope layout, then measure the gravity residual on the telescope with the wavefront sensor; only when all three agree is the support model trustworthy. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “8.2 m thin meniscus blank” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：主動支撐的出發點就是承認這面鏡子是軟的，改由支撐力的分佈來定義面形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Active support starts by accepting that the mirror is soft and letting the distribution of support forces define its figure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦。
主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely.
Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bending modes and correction-force patterns” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。把鏡面變形展開成自由圓板的彎曲模態最有效率，因為每個模態有各自的剛性：像散與三葉形等低階模態最軟，只需小力就能修正，高階模態所需的力則隨階數迅速增加。因此主動光學只修前十到二十個模態，更高階的誤差必須在拋光階段就做好；VLT 另把離焦與彗差交給副鏡的位置修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. Expanding the deformation in the bending modes of a free circular plate is most efficient because each mode has its own stiffness: low-order modes such as astigmatism and trefoil are softest and need little force, while the force needed rises steeply with mode order. Active optics therefore corrects only the first ten to twenty modes, higher orders must be polished out, and the VLT hands defocus and coma to secondary-mirror position control. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bending modes and correction-force patterns”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))；以 ν ≈ 0.33 的特徵值 λ² ≈ 5.25（像散）、9.08（軸對稱）、12.2（三葉形）、21.6（四葉形）與 √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s 代入，得約 15、27、36、64 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Free-plate natural frequencies are f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt)); with ν ≈ 0.33 eigenvalues λ² ≈ 5.25 (astigmatism), 9.08 (axisymmetric), 12.2 (trefoil) and 21.6 (quadrafoil) and √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s, they are about 15, 27, 36 and 64 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bending modes and correction-force patterns”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正
knowledge.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction
knowledge.text: 主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。把鏡面變形展開成自由圓板的彎曲模態最有效率，因為每個模態有各自的剛性：像散與三葉形等低階模態最軟，只需小力就能修正，高階模態所需的力則隨階數迅速增加。
knowledge.textEn: Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. Expanding the deformation in the bending modes of a free circular plate is most efficient because each mode has its own stiffness: low-order modes such as astigmatism and trefoil are softest and need little force, while the force needed rises steeply with mode order.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction" is correct?

Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence.
quiz.explanation: 主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bending modes and correction-force patterns” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))；以 ν ≈ 0.33 的特徵值 λ² ≈ 5.25（像散）、9.08（軸對稱）、12.2（三葉形）、21.6（四葉形）與 √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s 代入，得約 15、27、36、64 Hz。模態剛性 ∝ ω²，同振幅下三葉形所需力約為像散的 (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 倍、四葉形約 17 倍；若 ±120 N 力預算能修 1 µm 像散（教學假設），同樣力只修約 0.18 µm 三葉形或 0.06 µm 四葉形。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Free-plate natural frequencies are f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt)); with ν ≈ 0.33 eigenvalues λ² ≈ 5.25 (astigmatism), 9.08 (axisymmetric), 12.2 (trefoil) and 21.6 (quadrafoil) and √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s, they are about 15, 27, 36 and 64 Hz. Modal stiffness scales as ω², so at equal amplitude trefoil needs about (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 times the force of astigmatism and quadrafoil about 17 times; if a ±120 N budget corrects 1 µm of astigmatism (teaching assumption), the same force corrects only about 0.18 µm of trefoil or 0.06 µm of quadrafoil. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣；對矩陣做奇異值分解，確認奇異向量的形狀與彎曲模態相符、奇異值隨模態階數遞減，並依此決定要納入控制的模態數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix; take its singular-value decomposition, confirm that the singular vectors resemble the bending modes and that singular values fall with mode order, and use this to decide how many modes enter the control.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))；以 ν ≈ 0.33 的特徵值 λ² ≈ 5.25（像散）、9.08（軸對稱）、12.2（三葉形）、21.6（四葉形）與 √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s 代入，得約 15、27、36、64 Hz。模態剛性 ∝ ω²，同振幅下三葉形所需力約為像散的 (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 倍、四葉形約 17 倍；若 ±120 N 力預算能修 1 µm 像散（教學假設），同樣力只修約 0.18 µm 三葉形或 0.06 µm 四葉形。

Modal stiffness scales as ω², so at equal amplitude trefoil needs about (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 times the force of astigmatism and quadrafoil about 17 times; if a ±120 N budget corrects 1 µm of astigmatism (teaching assumption), the same force corrects only about 0.18 µm of trefoil or 0.06 µm of quadrafoil.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction", which statement holds?
options: 自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))。
主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。
只要有閉迴路修正，開迴路查找表就沒有用處。

Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice.
With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless.

steps.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bending modes and correction-force patterns” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣；對矩陣做奇異值分解，確認奇異向量的形狀與彎曲模態相符、奇異值隨模態階數遞減，並依此決定要納入控制的模態數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix; take its singular-value decomposition, confirm that the singular vectors resemble the bending modes and that singular values fall with mode order, and use this to decide how many modes enter the control. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若控制器試圖修正高階模態，所需的力會超出致動器範圍或讓少數致動器飽和，並把量測雜訊放大成局部力尖峰，鏡面反而出現新的高頻殘差；若把湍流當成修正對象而縮短積分時間，同樣會把大氣雜訊寫進鏡面。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the controller tries to correct high-order modes, the required forces exceed actuator range or saturate a few actuators and amplify measurement noise into local force spikes, leaving new high-frequency residuals on the mirror; shortening integration to chase turbulence likewise writes atmospheric noise into the figure.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣；對矩陣做奇異值分解，確認奇異向量的形狀與彎曲模態相符、奇異值隨模態階數遞減，並依此決定要納入控制的模態數。
knowledge.textEn: Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix; take its singular-value decomposition, confirm that the singular vectors resemble the bending modes and that singular values fall with mode order, and use this to decide how many modes enter the control.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣。
只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix.
If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy.
quiz.explanation: 在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣；對矩陣做奇異值分解，確認奇異向量的形狀與彎曲模態相符、奇異值隨模態階數遞減，並依此決定要納入控制的模態數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix; take its singular-value decomposition, confirm that the singular vectors resemble the bending modes and that singular values fall with mode order, and use this to decide how many modes enter the control. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bending modes and correction-force patterns” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若控制器試圖修正高階模態，所需的力會超出致動器範圍或讓少數致動器飽和，並把量測雜訊放大成局部力尖峰，鏡面反而出現新的高頻殘差；若把湍流當成修正對象而縮短積分時間，同樣會把大氣雜訊寫進鏡面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the controller tries to correct high-order modes, the required forces exceed actuator range or saturate a few actuators and amplify measurement noise into local force spikes, leaving new high-frequency residuals on the mirror; shortening integration to chase turbulence likewise writes atmospheric noise into the figure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此主動光學只修前十到二十個模態，更高階的誤差必須在拋光階段就做好；VLT 另把離焦與彗差交給副鏡的位置修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Active optics therefore corrects only the first ten to twenty modes, higher orders must be polished out, and the VLT hands defocus and coma to secondary-mirror position control.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若控制器試圖修正高階模態，所需的力會超出致動器範圍或讓少數致動器飽和，並把量測雜訊放大成局部力尖峰，鏡面反而出現新的高頻殘差；若把湍流當成修正對象而縮短積分時間，同樣會把大氣雜訊寫進鏡面。
knowledge.textEn: If the controller tries to correct high-order modes, the required forces exceed actuator range or saturate a few actuators and amplify measurement noise into local force spikes, leaving new high-frequency residuals on the mirror; shortening integration to chase turbulence likewise writes atmospheric noise into the figure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度」與「側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy" and "Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “150 axial actuators and load cells” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VLT 主鏡由 150 支電腦控制的軸向力致動器支撐，每支透過三腳架與 invar 墊（共 450 個）把力分散到鏡背，避免點載重在鏡面留下印痕。致動器同時承擔被動重量並疊加主動修正力，所以設計重點是力控制而非位置控制：鏡子的剛體位置由少數定義點或分區的被動系統決定，其餘致動器負責在該位置下提供正確的力分佈。仰角改變時軸向分量按 cos z 減少，力設定點必須連續追隨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The VLT primary rests on 150 computer-controlled axial force actuators, each spreading its load through a tripod and invar pads, 450 in total, so that point loads do not print through to the surface. The actuators carry the passive weight and add active correction forces on top, so the design emphasises force control rather than position control: the mirror's rigid-body position is fixed by a few defining points or passive zoned systems, and the remaining actuators supply the correct force distribution at that position. As elevation changes the axial component falls as cos z, and the force set points must follow continuously. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “150 axial actuators and load cells”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鏡重 23.0 t，W ≈ 226 kN，天頂時平均每支 1,506 N；天頂角 30° 時軸向總載 196 kN（每支 1,305 N）、側向 113 kN；60° 時軸向 113 kN（每支 753 N）、側向 196 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 23.0 t mirror, W ≈ 226 kN, an average of 1,506 N per actuator at zenith; at 30° zenith angle the axial load is 196 kN (1,305 N each) and the lateral load 113 kN; at 60° the axial load is 113 kN (753 N each) and the lateral 196 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “150 axial actuators and load cells”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度
knowledge.titleEn: Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy
knowledge.text: VLT 主鏡由 150 支電腦控制的軸向力致動器支撐，每支透過三腳架與 invar 墊（共 450 個）把力分散到鏡背，避免點載重在鏡面留下印痕。致動器同時承擔被動重量並疊加主動修正力，所以設計重點是力控制而非位置控制：鏡子的剛體位置由少數定義點或分區的被動系統決定，其餘致動器負責在該位置下提供正確的力分佈。
knowledge.textEn: The VLT primary rests on 150 computer-controlled axial force actuators, each spreading its load through a tripod and invar pads, 450 in total, so that point loads do not print through to the surface. The actuators carry the passive weight and add active correction forces on top, so the design emphasises force control rather than position control: the mirror's rigid-body position is fixed by a few defining points or passive zoned systems, and the remaining actuators supply the correct force distribution at that position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy" is correct?
options: VLT 主鏡由 150 支電腦控制的軸向力致動器支撐，每支透過三腳架與 invar 墊（共 450 個）把力分散到鏡背，避免點載重在鏡面留下印痕。
主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。
使用低膨脹的 Zerodur 後，主鏡就不需要任何熱控制。
optionsEn: The VLT primary rests on 150 computer-controlled axial force actuators, each spreading its load through a tripod and invar pads, 450 in total, so that point loads do not print through to the surface.
Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter.
With low-expansion Zerodur the primary needs no thermal control at all.
quiz.explanation: VLT 主鏡由 150 支電腦控制的軸向力致動器支撐，每支透過三腳架與 invar 墊（共 450 個）把力分散到鏡背，避免點載重在鏡面留下印痕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The VLT primary rests on 150 computer-controlled axial force actuators, each spreading its load through a tripod and invar pads, 450 in total, so that point loads do not print through to the surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “150 axial actuators and load cells” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鏡重 23.0 t，W ≈ 226 kN，天頂時平均每支 1,506 N；天頂角 30° 時軸向總載 196 kN（每支 1,305 N）、側向 113 kN；60° 時軸向 113 kN（每支 753 N）、側向 196 kN。ESO 為拋光殘差保留約 ±120 N 主動力，約為天頂被動載重的 8%；若要把力設定誤差壓在主動預算的 1% 以內，每支力精度需約 1 N 或更好。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 23.0 t mirror, W ≈ 226 kN, an average of 1,506 N per actuator at zenith; at 30° zenith angle the axial load is 196 kN (1,305 N each) and the lateral load 113 kN; at 60° the axial load is 113 kN (753 N each) and the lateral 196 kN. ESO reserves about ±120 N of active force for figuring errors, about 8% of the zenith passive load; keeping set-point errors within 1% of that active budget requires about 1 N force accuracy per actuator or better. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每支致動器出廠前以標準荷重元校正力對指令的曲線與遲滯；安裝後做力總和檢查：各支量測力的總和扣除定義點分擔後必須等於 W·cos z，在多個仰角下記錄偏差，並長期追蹤每支的力值與模型預測之差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve and hysteresis against a reference load cell; after installation perform force-sum checks in which the measured forces minus the share of the defining points must equal W·cos z, log the deviation at several elevations, and track each actuator's difference from the model over the long term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鏡重 23.0 t，W ≈ 226 kN，天頂時平均每支 1,506 N；天頂角 30° 時軸向總載 196 kN（每支 1,305 N）、側向 113 kN；60° 時軸向 113 kN（每支 753 N）、側向 196 kN。ESO 為拋光殘差保留約 ±120 N 主動力，約為天頂被動載重的 8%；若要把力設定誤差壓在主動預算的 1% 以內，每支力精度需約 1 N 或更好。
knowledge.textEn: With a 23.0 t mirror, W ≈ 226 kN, an average of 1,506 N per actuator at zenith; at 30° zenith angle the axial load is 196 kN (1,305 N each) and the lateral load 113 kN; at 60° the axial load is 113 kN (753 N each) and the lateral 196 kN. ESO reserves about ±120 N of active force for figuring errors, about 8% of the zenith passive load; keeping set-point errors within 1% of that active budget requires about 1 N force accuracy per actuator or better.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy", which statement holds?
options: 致動器越多、修正的模態越多，殘差就一定越小。
鏡重 23.0 t，W ≈ 226 kN，天頂時平均每支 1,506 N。
只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。
optionsEn: More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals.
With a 23.0 t mirror, W ≈ 226 kN, an average of 1,506 N per actuator at zenith.
If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy.
quiz.explanation: 鏡重 23.0 t，W ≈ 226 kN，天頂時平均每支 1,506 N；天頂角 30° 時軸向總載 196 kN（每支 1,305 N）、側向 113 kN；60° 時軸向 113 kN（每支 753 N）、側向 196 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 23.0 t mirror, W ≈ 226 kN, an average of 1,506 N per actuator at zenith; at 30° zenith angle the axial load is 196 kN (1,305 N each) and the lateral load 113 kN; at 60° the axial load is 113 kN (753 N each) and the lateral 196 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “150 axial actuators and load cells” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每支致動器出廠前以標準荷重元校正力對指令的曲線與遲滯；安裝後做力總和檢查：各支量測力的總和扣除定義點分擔後必須等於 W·cos z，在多個仰角下記錄偏差，並長期追蹤每支的力值與模型預測之差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve and hysteresis against a reference load cell; after installation perform force-sum checks in which the measured forces minus the share of the defining points must equal W·cos z, log the deviation at several elevations, and track each actuator's difference from the model over the long term. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某支致動器的荷重元零點漂移 20 N 而未被發現，控制器以為力正確，鏡面在該處留下局部凸起，影像外圍出現不對稱光暈；若力總和與定義點載重持續偏離，代表有機械卡滯或定義點過載。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A load-cell zero drift of 20 N on one actuator goes unnoticed, the controller believes the force is correct, and the mirror develops a local bump there that shows up as an asymmetric halo around images; a persistent mismatch between the force sum and the defining-point loads signals mechanical sticking or an overloaded defining point.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每支致動器出廠前以標準荷重元校正力對指令的曲線與遲滯；安裝後做力總和檢查：各支量測力的總和扣除定義點分擔後必須等於 W·cos z，在多個仰角下記錄偏差，並長期追蹤每支的力值與模型預測之差。
knowledge.textEn: Before delivery calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve and hysteresis against a reference load cell; after installation perform force-sum checks in which the measured forces minus the share of the defining points must equal W·cos z, log the deviation at several elevations, and track each actuator's difference from the model over the long term.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。
每支致動器出廠前以標準荷重元校正力對指令的曲線與遲滯。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost.
Before delivery calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve and hysteresis against a reference load cell.
quiz.explanation: 每支致動器出廠前以標準荷重元校正力對指令的曲線與遲滯；安裝後做力總和檢查：各支量測力的總和扣除定義點分擔後必須等於 W·cos z，在多個仰角下記錄偏差，並長期追蹤每支的力值與模型預測之差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before delivery calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve and hysteresis against a reference load cell; after installation perform force-sum checks in which the measured forces minus the share of the defining points must equal W·cos z, log the deviation at several elevations, and track each actuator's difference from the model over the long term. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “150 axial actuators and load cells” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某支致動器的荷重元零點漂移 20 N 而未被發現，控制器以為力正確，鏡面在該處留下局部凸起，影像外圍出現不對稱光暈；若力總和與定義點載重持續偏離，代表有機械卡滯或定義點過載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A load-cell zero drift of 20 N on one actuator goes unnoticed, the controller believes the force is correct, and the mirror develops a local bump there that shows up as an asymmetric halo around images; a persistent mismatch between the force sum and the defining-point loads signals mechanical sticking or an overloaded defining point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：仰角改變時軸向分量按 cos z 減少，力設定點必須連續追隨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: As elevation changes the axial component falls as cos z, and the force set points must follow continuously.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某支致動器的荷重元零點漂移 20 N 而未被發現，控制器以為力正確，鏡面在該處留下局部凸起，影像外圍出現不對稱光暈；若力總和與定義點載重持續偏離，代表有機械卡滯或定義點過載。
knowledge.textEn: A load-cell zero drift of 20 N on one actuator goes unnoticed, the controller believes the force is correct, and the mirror develops a local bump there that shows up as an asymmetric halo around images; a persistent mismatch between the force sum and the defining-point loads signals mechanical sticking or an overloaded defining point.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 某支致動器的荷重元零點漂移 20 N 而未被發現，控制器以為力正確，鏡面在該處留下局部凸起，影像外圍出現不對稱光暈。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
使用低膨脹的 Zerodur 後，主鏡就不需要任何熱控制。
optionsEn: A load-cell zero drift of 20 N on one actuator goes unnoticed, the controller believes the force is correct, and the mirror develops a local bump there that shows up as an asymmetric halo around images.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
With low-expansion Zerodur the primary needs no thermal control at all.
quiz.explanation: 某支致動器的荷重元零點漂移 20 N 而未被發現，控制器以為力正確，鏡面在該處留下局部凸起，影像外圍出現不對稱光暈；若力總和與定義點載重持續偏離，代表有機械卡滯或定義點過載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A load-cell zero drift of 20 N on one actuator goes unnoticed, the controller believes the force is correct, and the mirror develops a local bump there that shows up as an asymmetric halo around images; a persistent mismatch between the force sum and the defining-point loads signals mechanical sticking or an overloaded defining point. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「側向支撐與鏡室熱環境」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral supports and cell thermal environment” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 望遠鏡傾斜時，鏡重的 sin z 分量由黏在鏡緣的側向支撐墊承擔；側向力若不通過鏡子的質心平面就會產生彎矩，把像散壓進鏡面，因此側向支撐的位置與力分配必須與軸向力修正搭配設計。溫度則有兩種效應：穿過厚度的溫度梯度使鏡面整體彎曲，主要表現為離焦；Zerodur 熱膨脹係數的不均勻則在整體溫變下產生高階變形。此外鏡面比夜間空氣暖時會在表面形成湍流邊界層，所以白天要把鏡子預冷到預期的夜間溫度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「側向支撐與鏡室熱環境」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the telescope tilts, the sin z component of the weight is carried by lateral pads bonded to the mirror edge; lateral forces that do not act through the plane of the centre of mass create bending moments that press astigmatism into the surface, so lateral-support placement and force sharing must be designed together with axial corrections. Temperature acts in two ways: a gradient through the thickness bends the whole mirror, mainly as defocus, while inhomogeneity of the Zerodur expansion coefficient produces higher-order deformation under uniform temperature change. A mirror warmer than the night air also grows a turbulent boundary layer above its surface, so it is pre-cooled during the day to the expected night temperature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lateral supports and cell thermal environment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：穿厚度溫差 ΔT = 0.5 K、CTE α = 0.05 ppm/K、t = 0.175 m：曲率 κ = α·ΔT/t ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹，在半徑 4.1 m 的矢高變化 κa²/2 ≈ 1.2 µm，幾乎全是離焦，可由副鏡修正。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A through-thickness difference ΔT = 0.5 K with CTE α = 0.05 ppm/K and t = 0.175 m gives curvature κ = α·ΔT/t ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ and a sag change κa²/2 ≈ 1.2 µm at 4.1 m radius, almost pure defocus that the secondary can correct.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「使用低膨脹的 Zerodur 後，主鏡就不需要任何熱控制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With low-expansion Zerodur the primary needs no thermal control at all." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「側向支撐與鏡室熱環境」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Lateral supports and cell thermal environment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性
knowledge.titleEn: Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia
knowledge.text: 望遠鏡傾斜時，鏡重的 sin z 分量由黏在鏡緣的側向支撐墊承擔；側向力若不通過鏡子的質心平面就會產生彎矩，把像散壓進鏡面，因此側向支撐的位置與力分配必須與軸向力修正搭配設計。溫度則有兩種效應：穿過厚度的溫度梯度使鏡面整體彎曲，主要表現為離焦；Zerodur 熱膨脹係數的不均勻則在整體溫變下產生高階變形。

Temperature acts in two ways: a gradient through the thickness bends the whole mirror, mainly as defocus, while inhomogeneity of the Zerodur expansion coefficient produces higher-order deformation under uniform temperature change.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：使用低膨脹的 Zerodur 後，主鏡就不需要任何熱控制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia" is correct?
options: 使用低膨脹的 Zerodur 後，主鏡就不需要任何熱控制。
望遠鏡傾斜時，鏡重的 sin z 分量由黏在鏡緣的側向支撐墊承擔。
主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。
optionsEn: With low-expansion Zerodur the primary needs no thermal control at all.
When the telescope tilts, the sin z component of the weight is carried by lateral pads bonded to the mirror edge.
Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice.
quiz.explanation: 望遠鏡傾斜時，鏡重的 sin z 分量由黏在鏡緣的側向支撐墊承擔；側向力若不通過鏡子的質心平面就會產生彎矩，把像散壓進鏡面，因此側向支撐的位置與力分配必須與軸向力修正搭配設計。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When the telescope tilts, the sin z component of the weight is carried by lateral pads bonded to the mirror edge; lateral forces that do not act through the plane of the centre of mass create bending moments that press astigmatism into the surface, so lateral-support placement and force sharing must be designed together with axial corrections. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側向支撐與鏡室熱環境」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral supports and cell thermal environment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：穿厚度溫差 ΔT = 0.5 K、CTE α = 0.05 ppm/K、t = 0.175 m：曲率 κ = α·ΔT/t ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹，在半徑 4.1 m 的矢高變化 κa²/2 ≈ 1.2 µm，幾乎全是離焦，可由副鏡修正。熱時間常數 τ ≈ ρ·c·t/h：c = 821 J/(kg·K)、自然對流 h ≈ 5 W/(m²·K) 時 τ ≈ 20 h，強制通風 h ≈ 15 W/(m²·K) 時約 6.7 h，鏡溫跟不上一夜的氣溫下降。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A through-thickness difference ΔT = 0.5 K with CTE α = 0.05 ppm/K and t = 0.175 m gives curvature κ = α·ΔT/t ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ and a sag change κa²/2 ≈ 1.2 µm at 4.1 m radius, almost pure defocus that the secondary can correct. The thermal time constant τ ≈ ρ·c·t/h with c = 821 J/(kg·K) is about 20 h for natural convection h ≈ 5 W/(m²·K) and about 6.7 h with forced ventilation h ≈ 15 W/(m²·K), so the mirror cannot follow the night-time air-temperature fall. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在鏡背與鏡面附近佈設溫度感測器，記錄鏡體與圓頂空氣的溫差及穿厚度梯度，並與主動光學量到的離焦與高階模態係數對時間作相關；側向支撐則在不同天頂角比較像散係數，確認其隨 sin z 的變化已被軸向力表格抵消。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install temperature sensors at the back and near the face of the mirror, log the mirror-to-dome-air difference and the through-thickness gradient, and correlate them in time with the defocus and higher-order mode coefficients from active optics; for lateral support compare astigmatism coefficients at several zenith angles and confirm that their sin z dependence is cancelled by the axial force tables.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

optionsEn: With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless.
Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost.

steps.title: 側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「側向支撐與鏡室熱環境」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Lateral supports and cell thermal environment” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在鏡背與鏡面附近佈設溫度感測器，記錄鏡體與圓頂空氣的溫差及穿厚度梯度，並與主動光學量到的離焦與高階模態係數對時間作相關；側向支撐則在不同天頂角比較像散係數，確認其隨 sin z 的變化已被軸向力表格抵消。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install temperature sensors at the back and near the face of the mirror, log the mirror-to-dome-air difference and the through-thickness gradient, and correlate them in time with the defocus and higher-order mode coefficients from active optics; for lateral support compare astigmatism coefficients at several zenith angles and confirm that their sin z dependence is cancelled by the axial force tables. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：預冷不足時鏡面比空氣暖 2 到 3 K，整夜出現隨時間緩慢改善的鏡面視寧度，影像變寬卻被誤判為大氣條件差；側向支撐力分配錯誤時，像散係數隨天頂角系統性變化，主動光學每次換目標都在追同一個誤差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With inadequate pre-cooling the mirror runs 2 to 3 K warmer than the air, producing mirror seeing that slowly improves through the night and broadens images that are then blamed on the atmosphere; with mis-shared lateral forces astigmatism varies systematically with zenith angle and active optics chases the same error after every slew.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在鏡背與鏡面附近佈設溫度感測器，記錄鏡體與圓頂空氣的溫差及穿厚度梯度，並與主動光學量到的離焦與高階模態係數對時間作相關；側向支撐則在不同天頂角比較像散係數，確認其隨 sin z 的變化已被軸向力表格抵消。
knowledge.textEn: Install temperature sensors at the back and near the face of the mirror, log the mirror-to-dome-air difference and the through-thickness gradient, and correlate them in time with the defocus and higher-order mode coefficients from active optics; for lateral support compare astigmatism coefficients at several zenith angles and confirm that their sin z dependence is cancelled by the axial force tables.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia"?
options: 在鏡背與鏡面附近佈設溫度感測器，記錄鏡體與圓頂空氣的溫差及穿厚度梯度，並與主動光學量到的離焦與高階模態係數對時間作相關。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。
optionsEn: Install temperature sensors at the back and near the face of the mirror, log the mirror-to-dome-air difference and the through-thickness gradient, and correlate them in time with the defocus and higher-order mode coefficients from active optics.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time.
quiz.explanation: 在鏡背與鏡面附近佈設溫度感測器，記錄鏡體與圓頂空氣的溫差及穿厚度梯度，並與主動光學量到的離焦與高階模態係數對時間作相關；側向支撐則在不同天頂角比較像散係數，確認其隨 sin z 的變化已被軸向力表格抵消。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Install temperature sensors at the back and near the face of the mirror, log the mirror-to-dome-air difference and the through-thickness gradient, and correlate them in time with the defocus and higher-order mode coefficients from active optics; for lateral support compare astigmatism coefficients at several zenith angles and confirm that their sin z dependence is cancelled by the axial force tables. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側向支撐與鏡室熱環境」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Lateral supports and cell thermal environment” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 預冷不足時鏡面比空氣暖 2 到 3 K，整夜出現隨時間緩慢改善的鏡面視寧度，影像變寬卻被誤判為大氣條件差；側向支撐力分配錯誤時，像散係數隨天頂角系統性變化，主動光學每次換目標都在追同一個誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With inadequate pre-cooling the mirror runs 2 to 3 K warmer than the air, producing mirror seeing that slowly improves through the night and broadens images that are then blamed on the atmosphere; with mis-shared lateral forces astigmatism varies systematically with zenith angle and active optics chases the same error after every slew. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此外鏡面比夜間空氣暖時會在表面形成湍流邊界層，所以白天要把鏡子預冷到預期的夜間溫度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A mirror warmer than the night air also grows a turbulent boundary layer above its surface, so it is pre-cooled during the day to the expected night temperature.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「使用低膨脹的 Zerodur 後，主鏡就不需要任何熱控制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With low-expansion Zerodur the primary needs no thermal control at all." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預冷不足時鏡面比空氣暖 2 到 3 K，整夜出現隨時間緩慢改善的鏡面視寧度，影像變寬卻被誤判為大氣條件差；側向支撐力分配錯誤時，像散係數隨天頂角系統性變化，主動光學每次換目標都在追同一個誤差。
knowledge.textEn: With inadequate pre-cooling the mirror runs 2 to 3 K warmer than the air, producing mirror seeing that slowly improves through the night and broadens images that are then blamed on the atmosphere; with mis-shared lateral forces astigmatism varies systematically with zenith angle and active optics chases the same error after every slew.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
預冷不足時鏡面比空氣暖 2 到 3 K，整夜出現隨時間緩慢改善的鏡面視寧度，影像變寬卻被誤判為大氣條件差。
主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
With inadequate pre-cooling the mirror runs 2 to 3 K warmer than the air, producing mirror seeing that slowly improves through the night and broadens images that are then blamed on the atmosphere.
Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計」與「校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation" and "Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主動光學的波前感測器裝在導引探頭中，以視場邊緣的一顆星做 Shack–Hartmann 量測：微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個光點的位移正比於該處的局部波前斜率。因為要量的是鏡面而不是大氣，曝光必須長到把湍流造成的光點隨機抖動平均掉，VLT 以約 30 秒積分、約每分鐘修正一次。量到的斜率再以最小平方法投影到主鏡彎曲模態與副鏡的離焦、彗差，換算成力與位置修正量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The active-optics wavefront sensor sits in the guide probe and makes a Shack–Hartmann measurement on a star at the edge of the field: a lenslet array divides the pupil into subapertures, and each spot's displacement is proportional to the local wavefront slope. Because the target is the mirror and not the atmosphere, exposures must be long enough to average out turbulence-induced spot jitter, so the VLT integrates for about 30 s and corrects roughly once a minute. The measured slopes are projected by least squares onto the primary's bending modes and the secondary's defocus and coma, then converted into force and position corrections. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 20×20 subapertures, d = 8.2/20 = 0.41 m and r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm: the one-axis tilt variance σ² ≈ 0.17(λ/d)²(d/r₀)^(5/3) gives σ ≈ 1.16 µrad ≈ 0.24″.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計
knowledge.titleEn: Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation
knowledge.text: 主動光學的波前感測器裝在導引探頭中，以視場邊緣的一顆星做 Shack–Hartmann 量測：微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個光點的位移正比於該處的局部波前斜率。因為要量的是鏡面而不是大氣，曝光必須長到把湍流造成的光點隨機抖動平均掉，VLT 以約 30 秒積分、約每分鐘修正一次。
knowledge.textEn: The active-optics wavefront sensor sits in the guide probe and makes a Shack–Hartmann measurement on a star at the edge of the field: a lenslet array divides the pupil into subapertures, and each spot's displacement is proportional to the local wavefront slope. Because the target is the mirror and not the atmosphere, exposures must be long enough to average out turbulence-induced spot jitter, so the VLT integrates for about 30 s and corrects roughly once a minute.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation" is correct?
options: 主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。
致動器越多、修正的模態越多，殘差就一定越小。
主動光學的波前感測器裝在導引探頭中，以視場邊緣的一顆星做 Shack–Hartmann 量測：微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個光點的位移正比於該處的局部波前斜率。
optionsEn: Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice.
More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals.

The active-optics wavefront sensor sits in the guide probe and makes a Shack–Hartmann measurement on a star at the edge of the field: a lenslet array divides the pupil into subapertures, and each spot's displacement is proportional to the local wavefront slope.
quiz.explanation: 主動光學的波前感測器裝在導引探頭中，以視場邊緣的一顆星做 Shack–Hartmann 量測：微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個光點的位移正比於該處的局部波前斜率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The active-optics wavefront sensor sits in the guide probe and makes a Shack–Hartmann measurement on a star at the edge of the field: a lenslet array divides the pupil into subapertures, and each spot's displacement is proportional to the local wavefront slope. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設 20×20 子孔徑，d = 8.2/20 = 0.41 m，r₀ = 0.15 m（500 nm）：單軸傾斜方差 σ² ≈ 0.17(λ/d)²(d/r₀)^(5/3)，σ ≈ 1.16 µrad ≈ 0.24″。風速 10 m/s 時子孔徑傾斜相關時間約 d/v ≈ 0.041 s，30 s 內約 730 個獨立樣本，平均後 σ ≈ 0.24/√730 ≈ 0.009″，乘以 d 約為 18 nm 的子孔徑波前傾斜。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 20×20 subapertures, d = 8.2/20 = 0.41 m and r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm: the one-axis tilt variance σ² ≈ 0.17(λ/d)²(d/r₀)^(5/3) gives σ ≈ 1.16 µrad ≈ 0.24″. With a 10 m/s wind the subaperture tilt correlation time is about d/v ≈ 0.041 s, giving about 730 independent samples in 30 s, so averaging leaves σ ≈ 0.24/√730 ≈ 0.009″, about 18 nm of wavefront tilt across a subaperture. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先以內部參考光源校正感測器零點，也就是每個光點的參考位置；再對同一顆星以不同積分時間重複量測，畫模態係數的標準差對積分時間的曲線，應按 1/√T 下降直到量測雜訊底；並以已知的副鏡離焦偏移檢查重建係數的增益是否為 1。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: First calibrate the sensor zero point, the reference position of every spot, with an internal reference source; then repeat measurements on one star at several integration times and plot the standard deviation of mode coefficients versus integration time, which should fall as 1/√T down to the measurement-noise floor; finally inject a known secondary-mirror defocus offset to check that the reconstruction gain is unity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Assume 20×20 subapertures, d = 8.2/20 = 0.41 m and r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm: the one-axis tilt variance σ² ≈ 0.17(λ/d)²(d/r₀)^(5/3) gives σ ≈ 1.16 µrad ≈ 0.24″. With a 10 m/s wind the subaperture tilt correlation time is about d/v ≈ 0.041 s, giving about 730 independent samples in 30 s, so averaging leaves σ ≈ 0.24/√730 ≈ 0.009″, about 18 nm of wavefront tilt across a subaperture.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation", which statement holds?
options: 只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。
主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。

If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy.
