steps.title: 波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先以內部參考光源校正感測器零點，也就是每個光點的參考位置；再對同一顆星以不同積分時間重複量測，畫模態係數的標準差對積分時間的曲線，應按 1/√T 下降直到量測雜訊底；並以已知的副鏡離焦偏移檢查重建係數的增益是否為 1。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: First calibrate the sensor zero point, the reference position of every spot, with an internal reference source; then repeat measurements on one star at several integration times and plot the standard deviation of mode coefficients versus integration time, which should fall as 1/√T down to the measurement-noise floor; finally inject a known secondary-mirror defocus offset to check that the reconstruction gain is unity. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若積分只有幾秒，殘留的大氣像差被當成鏡面誤差送進致動器，主鏡每次修正都在追隨機雜訊，面形越修越差；參考零點若隨溫度漂移，則會穩定地把一個不存在的像差寫進鏡面。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With only a few seconds of integration, residual atmospheric aberration is mistaken for mirror error and sent to the actuators, so each correction chases random noise and the figure degrades; a reference zero point that drifts with temperature steadily writes a non-existent aberration into the mirror.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先以內部參考光源校正感測器零點，也就是每個光點的參考位置；再對同一顆星以不同積分時間重複量測，畫模態係數的標準差對積分時間的曲線，應按 1/√T 下降直到量測雜訊底；並以已知的副鏡離焦偏移檢查重建係數的增益是否為 1。
knowledge.textEn: First calibrate the sensor zero point, the reference position of every spot, with an internal reference source; then repeat measurements on one star at several integration times and plot the standard deviation of mode coefficients versus integration time, which should fall as 1/√T down to the measurement-noise floor; finally inject a known secondary-mirror defocus offset to check that the reconstruction gain is unity.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
先以內部參考光源校正感測器零點，也就是每個光點的參考位置。
主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
First calibrate the sensor zero point, the reference position of every spot, with an internal reference source.
Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 先以內部參考光源校正感測器零點，也就是每個光點的參考位置；再對同一顆星以不同積分時間重複量測，畫模態係數的標準差對積分時間的曲線，應按 1/√T 下降直到量測雜訊底；並以已知的副鏡離焦偏移檢查重建係數的增益是否為 1。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: First calibrate the sensor zero point, the reference position of every spot, with an internal reference source; then repeat measurements on one star at several integration times and plot the standard deviation of mode coefficients versus integration time, which should fall as 1/√T down to the measurement-noise floor; finally inject a known secondary-mirror defocus offset to check that the reconstruction gain is unity. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若積分只有幾秒，殘留的大氣像差被當成鏡面誤差送進致動器，主鏡每次修正都在追隨機雜訊，面形越修越差；參考零點若隨溫度漂移，則會穩定地把一個不存在的像差寫進鏡面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With only a few seconds of integration, residual atmospheric aberration is mistaken for mirror error and sent to the actuators, so each correction chases random noise and the figure degrades; a reference zero point that drifts with temperature steadily writes a non-existent aberration into the mirror. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量到的斜率再以最小平方法投影到主鏡彎曲模態與副鏡的離焦、彗差，換算成力與位置修正量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The measured slopes are projected by least squares onto the primary's bending modes and the secondary's defocus and coma, then converted into force and position corrections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若積分只有幾秒，殘留的大氣像差被當成鏡面誤差送進致動器，主鏡每次修正都在追隨機雜訊，面形越修越差；參考零點若隨溫度漂移，則會穩定地把一個不存在的像差寫進鏡面。
knowledge.textEn: With only a few seconds of integration, residual atmospheric aberration is mistaken for mirror error and sent to the actuators, so each correction chases random noise and the figure degrades; a reference zero point that drifts with temperature steadily writes a non-existent aberration into the mirror.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
致動器越多、修正的模態越多，殘差就一定越小。
若積分只有幾秒，殘留的大氣像差被當成鏡面誤差送進致動器，主鏡每次修正都在追隨機雜訊，面形越修越差；參考零點若隨溫度漂移，則會穩定地把一個不存在的像差寫進鏡面。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals.
With only a few seconds of integration, residual atmospheric aberration is mistaken for mirror error and sent to the actuators, so each correction chases random noise and the figure degrades.
quiz.explanation: 若積分只有幾秒，殘留的大氣像差被當成鏡面誤差送進致動器，主鏡每次修正都在追隨機雜訊，面形越修越差；參考零點若隨溫度漂移，則會穩定地把一個不存在的像差寫進鏡面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With only a few seconds of integration, residual atmospheric aberration is mistaken for mirror error and sent to the actuators, so each correction chases random noise and the figure degrades; a reference zero point that drifts with temperature steadily writes a non-existent aberration into the mirror. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「影響矩陣與誤差預算表」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Influence matrix and error-budget table” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主動光學的核心校正是影響矩陣，也就是每一支致動器或每一組模態力分佈對波前感測量測值的響應。控制器用矩陣的擬反把量到的模態係數轉成力修正，並截斷奇異值太小的模態，以免把雜訊放大。修正後的殘差要進入誤差預算：拋光殘差、支撐印痕、主動光學殘差、熱變形與風載各項以均方根相加，再換算成不同波長的 Strehl 或影像寬度，才能判斷主鏡是否滿足儀器需求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影響矩陣與誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The central calibration of active optics is the influence matrix, the response of the wavefront-sensor measurements to each actuator or each modal force pattern. The controller uses its pseudo-inverse to turn measured mode coefficients into force corrections, truncating modes with small singular values so that noise is not amplified. The corrected residual then enters the error budget: polishing residual, support print-through, active-optics residual, thermal deformation and wind load are added root-sum-square and converted into Strehl or image width at several wavelengths to judge whether the primary meets instrument needs. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Influence matrix and error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：波前 RMS 預算（教學假設）：拋光 30 nm、支撐印痕 15 nm、主動光學殘差 25 nm、熱 20 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wavefront RMS budget (teaching assumption): polishing 30 nm, support print-through 15 nm, active-optics residual 25 nm, thermal 20 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器越多、修正的模態越多，殘差就一定越小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「影響矩陣與誤差預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Influence matrix and error-budget table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget

knowledge.textEn: The central calibration of active optics is the influence matrix, the response of the wavefront-sensor measurements to each actuator or each modal force pattern. The controller uses its pseudo-inverse to turn measured mode coefficients into force corrections, truncating modes with small singular values so that noise is not amplified.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：致動器越多、修正的模態越多，殘差就一定越小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget" is correct?
options: 主動光學的核心校正是影響矩陣，也就是每一支致動器或每一組模態力分佈對波前感測量測值的響應。
致動器越多、修正的模態越多，殘差就一定越小。
只要有閉迴路修正，開迴路查找表就沒有用處。
optionsEn: The central calibration of active optics is the influence matrix, the response of the wavefront-sensor measurements to each actuator or each modal force pattern.
More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals.
With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless.
quiz.explanation: 主動光學的核心校正是影響矩陣，也就是每一支致動器或每一組模態力分佈對波前感測量測值的響應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The central calibration of active optics is the influence matrix, the response of the wavefront-sensor measurements to each actuator or each modal force pattern. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「影響矩陣與誤差預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Influence matrix and error-budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：波前 RMS 預算（教學假設）：拋光 30 nm、支撐印痕 15 nm、主動光學殘差 25 nm、熱 20 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm。Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]：2.2 µm 約 0.98、1.0 µm 約 0.91、0.5 µm 約 0.69，表示此主鏡在近紅外自適應光學下幾乎不扣分，在可見光則已消耗可觀預算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wavefront RMS budget (teaching assumption): polishing 30 nm, support print-through 15 nm, active-optics residual 25 nm, thermal 20 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm. Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²] is about 0.98 at 2.2 µm, 0.91 at 1.0 µm and 0.69 at 0.5 µm, so this primary costs almost nothing behind near-infrared adaptive optics but consumes a sizeable budget in the visible. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一施加已知振幅的單一模態，量測回推振幅，驗證矩陣增益與交叉耦合（應小於 5%）；開閉迴路交替並記錄每次修正後的殘差模態係數，取長期統計填入預算表，與設計值逐項比較，任何一項超出時追查來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply single modes of known amplitude one at a time and measure the recovered amplitude to verify matrix gain and cross-coupling, which should stay below 5%; alternate open and closed loop, log the residual mode coefficients after every correction, enter long-term statistics in the budget table, compare item by item with the design, and trace the source of any item that exceeds its allocation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 波前 RMS 預算（教學假設）：拋光 30 nm、支撐印痕 15 nm、主動光學殘差 25 nm、熱 20 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm。Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]：2.2 µm 約 0.98、1.0 µm 約 0.91、0.5 µm 約 0.69，表示此主鏡在近紅外自適應光學下幾乎不扣分，在可見光則已消耗可觀預算。
knowledge.textEn: Wavefront RMS budget (teaching assumption): polishing 30 nm, support print-through 15 nm, active-optics residual 25 nm, thermal 20 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm. Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²] is about 0.98 at 2.2 µm, 0.91 at 1.0 µm and 0.69 at 0.5 µm, so this primary costs almost nothing behind near-infrared adaptive optics but consumes a sizeable budget in the visible.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget", which statement holds?
options: 主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。
波前 RMS 預算（教學假設）：拋光 30 nm、支撐印痕 15 nm、主動光學殘差 25 nm、熱 20 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm。
主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。
optionsEn: Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost.
Wavefront RMS budget (teaching assumption): polishing 30 nm, support print-through 15 nm, active-optics residual 25 nm, thermal 20 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm.
Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 波前 RMS 預算（教學假設）：拋光 30 nm、支撐印痕 15 nm、主動光學殘差 25 nm、熱 20 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wavefront RMS budget (teaching assumption): polishing 30 nm, support print-through 15 nm, active-optics residual 25 nm, thermal 20 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「影響矩陣與誤差預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Influence matrix and error-budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 逐一施加已知振幅的單一模態，量測回推振幅，驗證矩陣增益與交叉耦合（應小於 5%）；開閉迴路交替並記錄每次修正後的殘差模態係數，取長期統計填入預算表，與設計值逐項比較，任何一項超出時追查來源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Apply single modes of known amplitude one at a time and measure the recovered amplitude to verify matrix gain and cross-coupling, which should stay below 5%; alternate open and closed loop, log the residual mode coefficients after every correction, enter long-term statistics in the budget table, compare item by item with the design, and trace the source of any item that exceeds its allocation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：影響矩陣在拋光廠支撐上量得卻直接用在望遠鏡支撐上，兩者邊界條件不同，修正某模態時同時激發另一模態，迴路收斂變慢甚至在兩個模態之間振盪；預算表若混用表面誤差與波前誤差，反射加倍效應會讓影響被低估一半。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An influence matrix measured on the polishing-shop support but applied on the telescope support has different boundary conditions, so correcting one mode excites another, convergence slows, or the loop oscillates between two modes; a budget that mixes surface and wavefront errors underestimates the impact by half because reflection doubles surface error.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐一施加已知振幅的單一模態，量測回推振幅，驗證矩陣增益與交叉耦合（應小於 5%）；開閉迴路交替並記錄每次修正後的殘差模態係數，取長期統計填入預算表，與設計值逐項比較，任何一項超出時追查來源。
knowledge.textEn: Apply single modes of known amplitude one at a time and measure the recovered amplitude to verify matrix gain and cross-coupling, which should stay below 5%; alternate open and closed loop, log the residual mode coefficients after every correction, enter long-term statistics in the budget table, compare item by item with the design, and trace the source of any item that exceeds its allocation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
使用低膨脹的 Zerodur 後，主鏡就不需要任何熱控制。
逐一施加已知振幅的單一模態，量測回推振幅，驗證矩陣增益與交叉耦合（應小於 5%）。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
With low-expansion Zerodur the primary needs no thermal control at all.
Apply single modes of known amplitude one at a time and measure the recovered amplitude to verify matrix gain and cross-coupling, which should stay below 5%.
quiz.explanation: 逐一施加已知振幅的單一模態，量測回推振幅，驗證矩陣增益與交叉耦合（應小於 5%）；開閉迴路交替並記錄每次修正後的殘差模態係數，取長期統計填入預算表，與設計值逐項比較，任何一項超出時追查來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Apply single modes of known amplitude one at a time and measure the recovered amplitude to verify matrix gain and cross-coupling, which should stay below 5%; alternate open and closed loop, log the residual mode coefficients after every correction, enter long-term statistics in the budget table, compare item by item with the design, and trace the source of any item that exceeds its allocation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「影響矩陣與誤差預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Influence matrix and error-budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 影響矩陣在拋光廠支撐上量得卻直接用在望遠鏡支撐上，兩者邊界條件不同，修正某模態時同時激發另一模態，迴路收斂變慢甚至在兩個模態之間振盪；預算表若混用表面誤差與波前誤差，反射加倍效應會讓影響被低估一半。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An influence matrix measured on the polishing-shop support but applied on the telescope support has different boundary conditions, so correcting one mode excites another, convergence slows, or the loop oscillates between two modes; a budget that mixes surface and wavefront errors underestimates the impact by half because reflection doubles surface error. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：修正後的殘差要進入誤差預算：拋光殘差、支撐印痕、主動光學殘差、熱變形與風載各項以均方根相加，再換算成不同波長的 Strehl 或影像寬度，才能判斷主鏡是否滿足儀器需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The corrected residual then enters the error budget: polishing residual, support print-through, active-optics residual, thermal deformation and wind load are added root-sum-square and converted into Strehl or image width at several wavelengths to judge whether the primary meets instrument needs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「致動器越多、修正的模態越多，殘差就一定越小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 影響矩陣在拋光廠支撐上量得卻直接用在望遠鏡支撐上，兩者邊界條件不同，修正某模態時同時激發另一模態，迴路收斂變慢甚至在兩個模態之間振盪；預算表若混用表面誤差與波前誤差，反射加倍效應會讓影響被低估一半。
knowledge.textEn: An influence matrix measured on the polishing-shop support but applied on the telescope support has different boundary conditions, so correcting one mode excites another, convergence slows, or the loop oscillates between two modes; a budget that mixes surface and wavefront errors underestimates the impact by half because reflection doubles surface error.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 影響矩陣在拋光廠支撐上量得卻直接用在望遠鏡支撐上，兩者邊界條件不同，修正某模態時同時激發另一模態，迴路收斂變慢甚至在兩個模態之間振盪。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
只要有閉迴路修正，開迴路查找表就沒有用處。
optionsEn: An influence matrix measured on the polishing-shop support but applied on the telescope support has different boundary conditions, so correcting one mode excites another, convergence slows, or the loop oscillates between two modes.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless.
quiz.explanation: 影響矩陣在拋光廠支撐上量得卻直接用在望遠鏡支撐上，兩者邊界條件不同，修正某模態時同時激發另一模態，迴路收斂變慢甚至在兩個模態之間振盪；預算表若混用表面誤差與波前誤差，反射加倍效應會讓影響被低估一半。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An influence matrix measured on the polishing-shop support but applied on the telescope support has different boundary conditions, so correcting one mode excites another, convergence slows, or the loop oscillates between two modes; a budget that mixes surface and wavefront errors underestimates the impact by half because reflection doubles surface error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工」與「整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour" and "Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每次換目標都沒有時間從零收斂，所以主動光學以開迴路查找表為基礎：依鏡筒仰角與溫度預測主鏡力分佈與副鏡位置，再用閉迴路量測逐步修正殘差。主鏡負責像散、三葉形、球差等彎曲模態，副鏡以位置移動修正離焦與彗差，兩者共用同一組感測資料但頻寬不同；VLT 另有最高約 1 Hz 的快速修正，只處理最低階項。查找表的品質決定了換目標後多久才能開始科學曝光。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: There is no time to converge from scratch after every slew, so active optics starts from open-loop look-up tables that predict primary forces and secondary position from tube elevation and temperature, and then trims the residual with closed-loop measurements. The primary handles bending modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and spherical aberration, while the secondary corrects defocus and coma by moving, both sharing the same sensor data at different bandwidths; the VLT also runs fast corrections up to about 1 Hz for the lowest-order terms only. Table quality decides how soon after a slew science exposures can start. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：迴路增益 g = 0.3、每次修正間隔 45 s：殘差 e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With loop gain g = 0.3 and 45 s between corrections, the residual follows e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有閉迴路修正，開迴路查找表就沒有用處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工
knowledge.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour
knowledge.text: 每次換目標都沒有時間從零收斂，所以主動光學以開迴路查找表為基礎：依鏡筒仰角與溫度預測主鏡力分佈與副鏡位置，再用閉迴路量測逐步修正殘差。主鏡負責像散、三葉形、球差等彎曲模態，副鏡以位置移動修正離焦與彗差，兩者共用同一組感測資料但頻寬不同；VLT 另有最高約 1 Hz 的快速修正，只處理最低階項。
knowledge.textEn: There is no time to converge from scratch after every slew, so active optics starts from open-loop look-up tables that predict primary forces and secondary position from tube elevation and temperature, and then trims the residual with closed-loop measurements. The primary handles bending modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and spherical aberration, while the secondary corrects defocus and coma by moving, both sharing the same sensor data at different bandwidths; the VLT also runs fast corrections up to about 1 Hz for the lowest-order terms only.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有閉迴路修正，開迴路查找表就沒有用處。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour" is correct?
options: 只要有閉迴路修正，開迴路查找表就沒有用處。
每次換目標都沒有時間從零收斂，所以主動光學以開迴路查找表為基礎：依鏡筒仰角與溫度預測主鏡力分佈與副鏡位置，再用閉迴路量測逐步修正殘差。
只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。
optionsEn: With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless.

There is no time to converge from scratch after every slew, so active optics starts from open-loop look-up tables that predict primary forces and secondary position from tube elevation and temperature, and then trims the residual with closed-loop measurements.
If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy.
quiz.explanation: 每次換目標都沒有時間從零收斂，所以主動光學以開迴路查找表為基礎：依鏡筒仰角與溫度預測主鏡力分佈與副鏡位置，再用閉迴路量測逐步修正殘差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: There is no time to converge from scratch after every slew, so active optics starts from open-loop look-up tables that predict primary forces and secondary position from tube elevation and temperature, and then trims the residual with closed-loop measurements. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：迴路增益 g = 0.3、每次修正間隔 45 s：殘差 e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀。初始誤差 500 nm、目標 30 nm 時 n = ln(30/500)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.9，需 8 次約 6 分鐘；若查找表把初始誤差降到 100 nm，只需 ln(0.3)/ln(0.7) ≈ 3.4，即 4 次約 3 分鐘；把增益提高到 0.5 雖可減到 5 次，卻對量測雜訊更敏感。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With loop gain g = 0.3 and 45 s between corrections, the residual follows e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀. From 500 nm down to 30 nm, n = ln(30/500)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.9, so 8 corrections or about 6 minutes; if the tables cut the initial error to 100 nm, only ln(0.3)/ln(0.7) ≈ 3.4, so 4 corrections or about 3 minutes; raising the gain to 0.5 shortens this to 5 corrections but makes the loop more sensitive to measurement noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多個仰角與溫度下記錄閉迴路收斂後的力分佈與副鏡位置，擬合成仰角與溫度的函數以更新查找表；換目標後記錄前幾次修正的殘差序列，與 (1 − g)ⁿ 模型比較，確認收斂率與設定增益一致且沒有過衝。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record the converged closed-loop force distribution and secondary position at many elevations and temperatures and fit them as functions of elevation and temperature to update the tables; after each slew log the residual sequence of the first few corrections and compare it with the (1 − g)ⁿ model to confirm that the convergence rate matches the set gain without overshoot.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 迴路增益 g = 0.3、每次修正間隔 45 s：殘差 e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀。初始誤差 500 nm、目標 30 nm 時 n = ln(30/500)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.9，需 8 次約 6 分鐘；若查找表把初始誤差降到 100 nm，只需 ln(0.3)/ln(0.7) ≈ 3.4，即 4 次約 3 分鐘；把增益提高到 0.5 雖可減到 5 次，卻對量測雜訊更敏感。
knowledge.textEn: With loop gain g = 0.3 and 45 s between corrections, the residual follows e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀. From 500 nm down to 30 nm, n = ln(30/500)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.9, so 8 corrections or about 6 minutes; if the tables cut the initial error to 100 nm, only ln(0.3)/ln(0.7) ≈ 3.4, so 4 corrections or about 3 minutes; raising the gain to 0.5 shortens this to 5 corrections but makes the loop more sensitive to measurement noise.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour", which statement holds?
options: 主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。
使用低膨脹的 Zerodur 後，主鏡就不需要任何熱控制。
迴路增益 g = 0.3、每次修正間隔 45 s：殘差 e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀。
optionsEn: Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time.
With low-expansion Zerodur the primary needs no thermal control at all.
With loop gain g = 0.3 and 45 s between corrections, the residual follows e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀.
quiz.explanation: 迴路增益 g = 0.3、每次修正間隔 45 s：殘差 e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With loop gain g = 0.3 and 45 s between corrections, the residual follows e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在多個仰角與溫度下記錄閉迴路收斂後的力分佈與副鏡位置，擬合成仰角與溫度的函數以更新查找表；換目標後記錄前幾次修正的殘差序列，與 (1 − g)ⁿ 模型比較，確認收斂率與設定增益一致且沒有過衝。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record the converged closed-loop force distribution and secondary position at many elevations and temperatures and fit them as functions of elevation and temperature to update the tables; after each slew log the residual sequence of the first few corrections and compare it with the (1 − g)ⁿ model to confirm that the convergence rate matches the set gain without overshoot. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：更換致動器或重新鍍膜後未更新查找表，每次換目標都從大誤差開始，前幾分鐘的影像品質不合格；若主鏡與副鏡同時修正彗差而沒有明確分工，兩者會互相抵消並緩慢漂移，最後讓副鏡偏心超出行程。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Failing to update the tables after an actuator exchange or recoating means every slew starts from a large error and the first minutes of data fail image-quality limits; if primary and secondary both correct coma without a clear division, they cancel each other and drift slowly until the secondary decentre runs out of range.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在多個仰角與溫度下記錄閉迴路收斂後的力分佈與副鏡位置，擬合成仰角與溫度的函數以更新查找表；換目標後記錄前幾次修正的殘差序列，與 (1 − g)ⁿ 模型比較，確認收斂率與設定增益一致且沒有過衝。
knowledge.textEn: Record the converged closed-loop force distribution and secondary position at many elevations and temperatures and fit them as functions of elevation and temperature to update the tables; after each slew log the residual sequence of the first few corrections and compare it with the (1 − g)ⁿ model to confirm that the convergence rate matches the set gain without overshoot.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour"?
options: 在多個仰角與溫度下記錄閉迴路收斂後的力分佈與副鏡位置，擬合成仰角與溫度的函數以更新查找表。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。
optionsEn: Record the converged closed-loop force distribution and secondary position at many elevations and temperatures and fit them as functions of elevation and temperature to update the tables.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice.
quiz.explanation: 在多個仰角與溫度下記錄閉迴路收斂後的力分佈與副鏡位置，擬合成仰角與溫度的函數以更新查找表；換目標後記錄前幾次修正的殘差序列，與 (1 − g)ⁿ 模型比較，確認收斂率與設定增益一致且沒有過衝。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record the converged closed-loop force distribution and secondary position at many elevations and temperatures and fit them as functions of elevation and temperature to update the tables; after each slew log the residual sequence of the first few corrections and compare it with the (1 − g)ⁿ model to confirm that the convergence rate matches the set gain without overshoot. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 更換致動器或重新鍍膜後未更新查找表，每次換目標都從大誤差開始，前幾分鐘的影像品質不合格；若主鏡與副鏡同時修正彗差而沒有明確分工，兩者會互相抵消並緩慢漂移，最後讓副鏡偏心超出行程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Failing to update the tables after an actuator exchange or recoating means every slew starts from a large error and the first minutes of data fail image-quality limits; if primary and secondary both correct coma without a clear division, they cancel each other and drift slowly until the secondary decentre runs out of range. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：查找表的品質決定了換目標後多久才能開始科學曝光。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Table quality decides how soon after a slew science exposures can start.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有閉迴路修正，開迴路查找表就沒有用處。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 更換致動器或重新鍍膜後未更新查找表，每次換目標都從大誤差開始，前幾分鐘的影像品質不合格；若主鏡與副鏡同時修正彗差而沒有明確分工，兩者會互相抵消並緩慢漂移，最後讓副鏡偏心超出行程。
knowledge.textEn: Failing to update the tables after an actuator exchange or recoating means every slew starts from a large error and the first minutes of data fail image-quality limits; if primary and secondary both correct coma without a clear division, they cancel each other and drift slowly until the secondary decentre runs out of range.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
更換致動器或重新鍍膜後未更新查找表，每次換目標都從大誤差開始，前幾分鐘的影像品質不合格。
只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Failing to update the tables after an actuator exchange or recoating means every slew starts from a large error and the first minutes of data fail image-quality limits.
If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy.
quiz.explanation: 更換致動器或重新鍍膜後未更新查找表，每次換目標都從大誤差開始，前幾分鐘的影像品質不合格；若主鏡與副鏡同時修正彗差而沒有明確分工，兩者會互相抵消並緩慢漂移，最後讓副鏡偏心超出行程。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Failing to update the tables after an actuator exchange or recoating means every slew starts from a large error and the first minutes of data fail image-quality limits; if primary and secondary both correct coma without a clear division, they cancel each other and drift slowly until the secondary decentre runs out of range. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「影像品質驗收與力圖監測」如何決定望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring” determines the key performance of “Active support of telescope primary mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主動支撐的驗收必須在望遠鏡上完成：在各仰角與溫度條件下量閉迴路後的模態殘差與影像寬度，把主鏡對總影像品質的貢獻從大氣、導星與儀器中分離出來。運轉後，力圖是主鏡健康最直接的紀錄：每支致動器的力歷史、力總和與重量的一致性、主動力是否逐漸逼近極限，都能提前揭露卡滯、荷重元漂移或支撐墊脫膠。交接文件需包含影響矩陣版本、查找表、各致動器校正係數與安全限值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影像品質驗收與力圖監測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of active support must happen on the telescope: measure closed-loop mode residuals and image width over elevation and temperature, separating the primary's contribution to total image quality from atmosphere, guide star and instrument. In operation the force map is the most direct record of mirror health: each actuator's force history, the agreement of the force sum with the weight, and whether active forces creep towards their limits all reveal sticking, load-cell drift or debonding pads early. The handoff file must hold the influence-matrix version, look-up tables, per-actuator calibration coefficients and safety limits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：力總和檢查：W = 226 kN，天頂角 30° 時軸向應為 W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN；若允許 0.5% 偏差，相當於 ±0.98 kN，超出即告警。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Force-sum check: with W = 226 kN, the axial sum at 30° zenith angle should be W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN; a 0.5% tolerance equals ±0.98 kN, beyond which an alarm is raised.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「影像品質驗收與力圖監測」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: 主動支撐的驗收必須在望遠鏡上完成：在各仰角與溫度條件下量閉迴路後的模態殘差與影像寬度，把主鏡對總影像品質的貢獻從大氣、導星與儀器中分離出來。運轉後，力圖是主鏡健康最直接的紀錄：每支致動器的力歷史、力總和與重量的一致性、主動力是否逐漸逼近極限，都能提前揭露卡滯、荷重元漂移或支撐墊脫膠。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance of active support must happen on the telescope: measure closed-loop mode residuals and image width over elevation and temperature, separating the primary's contribution to total image quality from atmosphere, guide star and instrument. In operation the force map is the most direct record of mirror health: each actuator's force history, the agreement of the force sum with the weight, and whether active forces creep towards their limits all reveal sticking, load-cell drift or debonding pads early.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。
主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。
主動支撐的驗收必須在望遠鏡上完成：在各仰角與溫度條件下量閉迴路後的模態殘差與影像寬度，把主鏡對總影像品質的貢獻從大氣、導星與儀器中分離出來。
optionsEn: If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy.
Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost.

Acceptance of active support must happen on the telescope: measure closed-loop mode residuals and image width over elevation and temperature, separating the primary's contribution to total image quality from atmosphere, guide star and instrument.
quiz.explanation: 主動支撐的驗收必須在望遠鏡上完成：在各仰角與溫度條件下量閉迴路後的模態殘差與影像寬度，把主鏡對總影像品質的貢獻從大氣、導星與儀器中分離出來。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance of active support must happen on the telescope: measure closed-loop mode residuals and image width over elevation and temperature, separating the primary's contribution to total image quality from atmosphere, guide star and instrument. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「影像品質驗收與力圖監測」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：力總和檢查：W = 226 kN，天頂角 30° 時軸向應為 W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN；若允許 0.5% 偏差，相當於 ±0.98 kN，超出即告警。主動力趨勢：若某支致動器的主動力每月增加 3 N、距 ±120 N 預算還剩 60 N，約 20 個月後耗盡，必須排入下一次維護窗口。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Force-sum check: with W = 226 kN, the axial sum at 30° zenith angle should be W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN; a 0.5% tolerance equals ±0.98 kN, beyond which an alarm is raised. Active-force trend: if one actuator's active force grows by 3 N per month with 60 N left before the ±120 N budget, it runs out in about 20 months and must be scheduled for the next maintenance window. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以天頂角 0°、30°、60° 的夜間測試記錄模態殘差、影像半高全寬與力總和，並與交接文件中的基準比對；每週自動產生力圖報告，列出偏離模型超過門檻的致動器與其趨勢，維護後重新量測影響函數確認修復。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run night tests at 0°, 30° and 60° zenith angle recording mode residuals, image FWHM and force sums, and compare them with the baselines in the handoff file; generate a weekly force-map report listing actuators whose deviation from the model exceeds threshold together with their trends, and re-measure influence functions after maintenance to confirm the repair.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 力總和檢查：W = 226 kN，天頂角 30° 時軸向應為 W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN；若允許 0.5% 偏差，相當於 ±0.98 kN，超出即告警。主動力趨勢：若某支致動器的主動力每月增加 3 N、距 ±120 N 預算還剩 60 N，約 20 個月後耗盡，必須排入下一次維護窗口。
knowledge.textEn: Force-sum check: with W = 226 kN, the axial sum at 30° zenith angle should be W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN; a 0.5% tolerance equals ±0.98 kN, beyond which an alarm is raised. Active-force trend: if one actuator's active force grows by 3 N per month with 60 N left before the ±120 N budget, it runs out in about 20 months and must be scheduled for the next maintenance window.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 力總和檢查：W = 226 kN，天頂角 30° 時軸向應為 W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN。
主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。
主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。
optionsEn: Force-sum check: with W = 226 kN, the axial sum at 30° zenith angle should be W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN.
Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter.
Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice.
quiz.explanation: 力總和檢查：W = 226 kN，天頂角 30° 時軸向應為 W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN；若允許 0.5% 偏差，相當於 ±0.98 kN，超出即告警。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Force-sum check: with W = 226 kN, the axial sum at 30° zenith angle should be W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN; a 0.5% tolerance equals ±0.98 kN, beyond which an alarm is raised. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「影像品質驗收與力圖監測」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以天頂角 0°、30°、60° 的夜間測試記錄模態殘差、影像半高全寬與力總和，並與交接文件中的基準比對；每週自動產生力圖報告，列出偏離模型超過門檻的致動器與其趨勢，維護後重新量測影響函數確認修復。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run night tests at 0°, 30° and 60° zenith angle recording mode residuals, image FWHM and force sums, and compare them with the baselines in the handoff file; generate a weekly force-map report listing actuators whose deviation from the model exceeds threshold together with their trends, and re-measure influence functions after maintenance to confirm the repair. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某個側向支撐墊的黏膠逐漸失效，鏡子在高天頂角時微小位移並產生像散，主動光學以越來越大的力補償，影像品質表面上仍合格；直到力達極限才突然無法修正，若沒有趨勢監測，失效會在觀測夜中才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The adhesive on one lateral pad slowly fails, the mirror shifts slightly at large zenith angles and develops astigmatism, and active optics compensates with ever larger forces while image quality still passes; only when forces hit their limits does correction suddenly fail, and without trend monitoring the fault appears in the middle of an observing night.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以天頂角 0°、30°、60° 的夜間測試記錄模態殘差、影像半高全寬與力總和，並與交接文件中的基準比對；每週自動產生力圖報告，列出偏離模型超過門檻的致動器與其趨勢，維護後重新量測影響函數確認修復。
knowledge.textEn: Run night tests at 0°, 30° and 60° zenith angle recording mode residuals, image FWHM and force sums, and compare them with the baselines in the handoff file; generate a weekly force-map report listing actuators whose deviation from the model exceeds threshold together with their trends, and re-measure influence functions after maintenance to confirm the repair.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以天頂角 0°、30°、60° 的夜間測試記錄模態殘差、影像半高全寬與力總和，並與交接文件中的基準比對。
致動器越多、修正的模態越多，殘差就一定越小。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Run night tests at 0°, 30° and 60° zenith angle recording mode residuals, image FWHM and force sums, and compare them with the baselines in the handoff file.
More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals.
quiz.explanation: 以天頂角 0°、30°、60° 的夜間測試記錄模態殘差、影像半高全寬與力總和，並與交接文件中的基準比對；每週自動產生力圖報告，列出偏離模型超過門檻的致動器與其趨勢，維護後重新量測影響函數確認修復。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run night tests at 0°, 30° and 60° zenith angle recording mode residuals, image FWHM and force sums, and compare them with the baselines in the handoff file; generate a weekly force-map report listing actuators whose deviation from the model exceeds threshold together with their trends, and re-measure influence functions after maintenance to confirm the repair. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「影像品質驗收與力圖監測」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某個側向支撐墊的黏膠逐漸失效，鏡子在高天頂角時微小位移並產生像散，主動光學以越來越大的力補償，影像品質表面上仍合格；直到力達極限才突然無法修正，若沒有趨勢監測，失效會在觀測夜中才被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: The adhesive on one lateral pad slowly fails, the mirror shifts slightly at large zenith angles and develops astigmatism, and active optics compensates with ever larger forces while image quality still passes; only when forces hit their limits does correction suddenly fail, and without trend monitoring the fault appears in the middle of an observing night. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件需包含影響矩陣版本、查找表、各致動器校正係數與安全限值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff file must hold the influence-matrix version, look-up tables, per-actuator calibration coefficients and safety limits.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某個側向支撐墊的黏膠逐漸失效，鏡子在高天頂角時微小位移並產生像散，主動光學以越來越大的力補償，影像品質表面上仍合格；直到力達極限才突然無法修正，若沒有趨勢監測，失效會在觀測夜中才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: The adhesive on one lateral pad slowly fails, the mirror shifts slightly at large zenith angles and develops astigmatism, and active optics compensates with ever larger forces while image quality still passes; only when forces hit their limits does correction suddenly fail, and without trend monitoring the fault appears in the middle of an observing night.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。
某個側向支撐墊的黏膠逐漸失效，鏡子在高天頂角時微小位移並產生像散，主動光學以越來越大的力補償，影像品質表面上仍合格。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost.

The adhesive on one lateral pad slowly fails, the mirror shifts slightly at large zenith angles and develops astigmatism, and active optics compensates with ever larger forces while image quality still passes.
quiz.explanation: 某個側向支撐墊的黏膠逐漸失效，鏡子在高天頂角時微小位移並產生像散，主動光學以越來越大的力補償，影像品質表面上仍合格；直到力達極限才突然無法修正，若沒有趨勢監測，失效會在觀測夜中才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The adhesive on one lateral pad slowly fails, the mirror shifts slightly at large zenith angles and develops astigmatism, and active optics compensates with ever larger forces while image quality still passes; only when forces hit their limits does correction suddenly fail, and without trend monitoring the fault appears in the middle of an observing night. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 分段鏡共相控制
summary: 以 Keck 10 m 主鏡的 36 片段鏡、108 支致動器與 168 個邊緣感測器為主軸，並對照 ELT 的 798 片段鏡，理解如何把數十片獨立鏡面維持在同一個波前上：從 piston 誤差與 Strehl、可觀測性、感測器漂移、寬頻與雙波長共相，到控制迴路與段鏡更換後的重新共相。
summaryEn: Built around the Keck 10 m primary with 36 segments, 108 actuators and 168 edge sensors, and compared with the ELT's 798 segments, this course shows how dozens of separate mirrors are held on one wavefront: from piston error and Strehl, observability and sensor drift, to broadband and dual-wavelength phasing, control loops and re-phasing after segment exchange.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
subcategoryTitle: 天文儀器與科學感測器
architectureNodes: 望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 共相預算練習：假設一面 36 片、對角 1.8 m 段鏡的主鏡要在 1.65 µm 維持 Strehl ≥ 0.95。允許的表面 piston σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.95) = 1650/12.57 × 0.2265 ≈ 29.7 nm。分配感測器雜訊 3 nm、漂移 15 nm、共相相機 10 nm、致動器 2 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS = √(9 + 225 + 100 + 4 + 225) ≈ 23.7 nm，低於 29.7 nm，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4π × 23.7/1650)²] ≈ 0.97。新段鏡安裝後誤差 12 µm：窄頻 0.85 µm 的唯一範圍只有 ±0.21 µm，雙波長 Λ = 13.6 µm 的 ±3.4 µm 也不夠，必須先以約 ±30 µm 捕獲範圍的寬頻方法定位。168 個感測器對 105 個可控自由度約 1.6 倍過定。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Phasing-budget exercise: a primary of 36 segments, each 1.8 m across corners, must hold Strehl ≥ 0.95 at 1.65 µm. The allowed surface piston is σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.95) = 1650/12.57 × 0.2265 ≈ 29.7 nm. Allocating 3 nm sensor noise, 15 nm drift, 10 nm phasing camera, 2 nm actuators and 15 nm wind gives RSS = √(9 + 225 + 100 + 4 + 225) ≈ 23.7 nm, inside 29.7 nm, with Strehl ≈ exp[−(4π × 23.7/1650)²] ≈ 0.97. A newly installed segment is off by 12 µm: the 0.85 µm narrowband range of ±0.21 µm and even the ±3.4 µm of a 13.6 µm synthetic wavelength are insufficient, so a broadband method with roughly ±30 µm capture must locate it first. The 168 sensors over-determine the 105 controllable degrees of freedom about 1.6 times. Values are teaching assumptions, not any telescope's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差」與「感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error" and "Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Keck 的 10 m 主鏡由 36 片對角約 1.8 m、厚 75 mm 的六角段鏡拼成，每片都是同一個母非球面上不同離軸位置的切片。只有當所有段鏡的高度（piston）與傾斜誤差遠小於波長時，各段反射的光才會在焦點同相疊加，得到 10 m 口徑的繞射極限；否則每片只像一台 1.8 m 的獨立望遠鏡，能量散進寬度約 λ/d 的段鏡繞射暈。反射使表面高度誤差在波前上加倍，所以共相要求是奈米級的表面精度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Keck 10 m primary is tiled from 36 hexagonal segments about 1.8 m across corners and 75 mm thick, each an off-axis piece of the same parent asphere. Only when every segment's height (piston) and tilt errors are far below the wavelength does light from all segments add in phase at focus to give the diffraction limit of a 10 m aperture; otherwise each segment behaves like a separate 1.8 m telescope and energy spreads into a segment-diffraction halo of width about λ/d. Reflection doubles surface height errors in the wavefront, so phasing demands nanometre-level surface accuracy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：波前誤差 = 2 × 表面 piston，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wavefront error equals twice the surface piston, so Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每片段鏡的面形都合格，拼起來的主鏡自然就是繞射極限。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every segment's figure passes, the assembled primary is automatically diffraction limited." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差
knowledge.text: Keck 的 10 m 主鏡由 36 片對角約 1.8 m、厚 75 mm 的六角段鏡拼成，每片都是同一個母非球面上不同離軸位置的切片。只有當所有段鏡的高度（piston）與傾斜誤差遠小於波長時，各段反射的光才會在焦點同相疊加，得到 10 m 口徑的繞射極限；否則每片只像一台 1.8 m 的獨立望遠鏡，能量散進寬度約 λ/d 的段鏡繞射暈。
knowledge.textEn: The Keck 10 m primary is tiled from 36 hexagonal segments about 1.8 m across corners and 75 mm thick, each an off-axis piece of the same parent asphere. Only when every segment's height (piston) and tilt errors are far below the wavelength does light from all segments add in phase at focus to give the diffraction limit of a 10 m aperture; otherwise each segment behaves like a separate 1.8 m telescope and energy spreads into a segment-diffraction halo of width about λ/d.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每片段鏡的面形都合格，拼起來的主鏡自然就是繞射極限。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every segment's figure passes, the assembled primary is automatically diffraction limited. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error" is correct?
options: 每片段鏡的面形都合格，拼起來的主鏡自然就是繞射極限。
Keck 的 10 m 主鏡由 36 片對角約 1.8 m、厚 75 mm 的六角段鏡拼成，每片都是同一個母非球面上不同離軸位置的切片。
邊緣感測器讀數全部為零，就證明主鏡已完全共相。
optionsEn: If every segment's figure passes, the assembled primary is automatically diffraction limited.
The Keck 10 m primary is tiled from 36 hexagonal segments about 1.8 m across corners and 75 mm thick, each an off-axis piece of the same parent asphere.
All edge-sensor readings at zero prove the primary is fully phased.
quiz.explanation: Keck 的 10 m 主鏡由 36 片對角約 1.8 m、厚 75 mm 的六角段鏡拼成，每片都是同一個母非球面上不同離軸位置的切片。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Keck 10 m primary is tiled from 36 hexagonal segments about 1.8 m across corners and 75 mm thick, each an off-axis piece of the same parent asphere. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：波前誤差 = 2 × 表面 piston，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]。σ_s = 30 nm 時，2.2 µm 的 Strehl ≈ 0.97、1.0 µm 約 0.87、0.5 µm 約 0.57。要在 2.2 µm 維持 0.9，σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.9) ≈ 57 nm；在 0.5 µm 則需 ≤ 13 nm。段鏡繞射暈寬度與核心之比約 D/d = 10/1.8 ≈ 5.6。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wavefront error equals twice the surface piston, so Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]. For σ_s = 30 nm the Strehl is about 0.97 at 2.2 µm, 0.87 at 1.0 µm and 0.57 at 0.5 µm. Holding 0.9 at 2.2 µm requires σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.9) ≈ 57 nm, and at 0.5 µm σ_s ≤ 13 nm. The segment halo is wider than the core by about D/d = 10/1.8 ≈ 5.6. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在焦面以窄頻濾光片拍攝亮星，比較影像核心與段鏡繞射暈的能量比，與由 Strehl 公式推算的 piston 殘差對照；同時在瞳面以共相相機直接量每一條段鏡邊界的階差，把量到的 σ_s 代回公式預測 Strehl，兩種量測互相驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image a bright star through a narrowband filter at focus and compare the energy ratio between core and segment halo with the piston residual inferred from the Strehl relation; at the same time measure the step at every intersegment edge with the phasing camera in the pupil, insert the measured σ_s into the formula to predict Strehl, and cross-check the two measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 波前誤差 = 2 × 表面 piston，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]。σ_s = 30 nm 時，2.2 µm 的 Strehl ≈ 0.97、1.0 µm 約 0.87、0.5 µm 約 0.57。要在 2.2 µm 維持 0.9，σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.9) ≈ 57 nm；在 0.5 µm 則需 ≤ 13 nm。段鏡繞射暈寬度與核心之比約 D/d = 10/1.8 ≈ 5.6。
knowledge.textEn: Wavefront error equals twice the surface piston, so Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]. For σ_s = 30 nm the Strehl is about 0.97 at 2.2 µm, 0.87 at 1.0 µm and 0.57 at 0.5 µm. Holding 0.9 at 2.2 µm requires σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.9) ≈ 57 nm, and at 0.5 µm σ_s ≤ 13 nm. The segment halo is wider than the core by about D/d = 10/1.8 ≈ 5.6.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error", which statement holds?
options: 致動器精度夠高，就不必在意支撐剛性與風。
共相只需要在建造完成時做一次，之後感測器會永遠維持。
波前誤差 = 2 × 表面 piston，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]。
optionsEn: With accurate enough actuators, support stiffness and wind do not matter.
Phasing is done once at commissioning and the sensors maintain it forever.
Wavefront error equals twice the surface piston, so Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²].
quiz.explanation: 波前誤差 = 2 × 表面 piston，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wavefront error equals twice the surface piston, so Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在焦面以窄頻濾光片拍攝亮星，比較影像核心與段鏡繞射暈的能量比，與由 Strehl 公式推算的 piston 殘差對照；同時在瞳面以共相相機直接量每一條段鏡邊界的階差，把量到的 σ_s 代回公式預測 Strehl，兩種量測互相驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Image a bright star through a narrowband filter at focus and compare the energy ratio between core and segment halo with the piston residual inferred from the Strehl relation; at the same time measure the step at every intersegment edge with the phasing camera in the pupil, insert the measured σ_s into the formula to predict Strehl, and cross-check the two measurements. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：可見光觀測時段鏡 piston 誤差不易察覺，因為大氣視寧度主導了影像寬度；一旦接上自適應光學在近紅外觀測，影像核心被一圈六角形繞射暈包圍，Strehl 明顯低於預期，而且無論怎麼調 AO 增益都無法改善。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: In seeing-limited visible observing, segment piston errors hide behind atmospheric seeing; once adaptive optics feeds a near-infrared camera, the core sits inside a hexagonal diffraction halo, Strehl falls well short of prediction, and no adjustment of the AO gains helps.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在焦面以窄頻濾光片拍攝亮星，比較影像核心與段鏡繞射暈的能量比，與由 Strehl 公式推算的 piston 殘差對照；同時在瞳面以共相相機直接量每一條段鏡邊界的階差，把量到的 σ_s 代回公式預測 Strehl，兩種量測互相驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Image a bright star through a narrowband filter at focus and compare the energy ratio between core and segment halo with the piston residual inferred from the Strehl relation; at the same time measure the step at every intersegment edge with the phasing camera in the pupil, insert the measured σ_s into the formula to predict Strehl, and cross-check the two measurements.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error"?
options: 在焦面以窄頻濾光片拍攝亮星，比較影像核心與段鏡繞射暈的能量比，與由 Strehl 公式推算的 piston 殘差對照。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
自適應光學會自動修掉段鏡之間的階差，所以主鏡共相不必太精確。
optionsEn: Image a bright star through a narrowband filter at focus and compare the energy ratio between core and segment halo with the piston residual inferred from the Strehl relation.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adaptive optics automatically removes steps between segments, so primary phasing need not be precise.
quiz.explanation: 在焦面以窄頻濾光片拍攝亮星，比較影像核心與段鏡繞射暈的能量比，與由 Strehl 公式推算的 piston 殘差對照；同時在瞳面以共相相機直接量每一條段鏡邊界的階差，把量到的 σ_s 代回公式預測 Strehl，兩種量測互相驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Image a bright star through a narrowband filter at focus and compare the energy ratio between core and segment halo with the piston residual inferred from the Strehl relation; at the same time measure the step at every intersegment edge with the phasing camera in the pupil, insert the measured σ_s into the formula to predict Strehl, and cross-check the two measurements. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 可見光觀測時段鏡 piston 誤差不易察覺，因為大氣視寧度主導了影像寬度；一旦接上自適應光學在近紅外觀測，影像核心被一圈六角形繞射暈包圍，Strehl 明顯低於預期，而且無論怎麼調 AO 增益都無法改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: In seeing-limited visible observing, segment piston errors hide behind atmospheric seeing; once adaptive optics feeds a near-infrared camera, the core sits inside a hexagonal diffraction halo, Strehl falls well short of prediction, and no adjustment of the AO gains helps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：反射使表面高度誤差在波前上加倍，所以共相要求是奈米級的表面精度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reflection doubles surface height errors in the wavefront, so phasing demands nanometre-level surface accuracy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每片段鏡的面形都合格，拼起來的主鏡自然就是繞射極限。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every segment's figure passes, the assembled primary is automatically diffraction limited." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 可見光觀測時段鏡 piston 誤差不易察覺，因為大氣視寧度主導了影像寬度；一旦接上自適應光學在近紅外觀測，影像核心被一圈六角形繞射暈包圍，Strehl 明顯低於預期，而且無論怎麼調 AO 增益都無法改善。
knowledge.textEn: In seeing-limited visible observing, segment piston errors hide behind atmospheric seeing; once adaptive optics feeds a near-infrared camera, the core sits inside a hexagonal diffraction halo, Strehl falls well short of prediction, and no adjustment of the AO gains helps.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
可見光觀測時段鏡 piston 誤差不易察覺，因為大氣視寧度主導了影像寬度。
邊緣感測器讀數全部為零，就證明主鏡已完全共相。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
In seeing-limited visible observing, segment piston errors hide behind atmospheric seeing.
All edge-sensor readings at zero prove the primary is fully phased.
quiz.explanation: 可見光觀測時段鏡 piston 誤差不易察覺，因為大氣視寧度主導了影像寬度；一旦接上自適應光學在近紅外觀測，影像核心被一圈六角形繞射暈包圍，Strehl 明顯低於預期，而且無論怎麼調 AO 增益都無法改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In seeing-limited visible observing, segment piston errors hide behind atmospheric seeing; once adaptive optics feeds a near-infrared camera, the core sits inside a hexagonal diffraction halo, Strehl falls well short of prediction, and no adjustment of the AO gains helps. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每片段鏡由三支位置致動器控制 piston、tip 與 tilt，相鄰段鏡共用的每條邊上裝兩個邊緣感測器，量兩片鏡緣的相對高度差。邊緣感測器只量相對值，所以整面鏡的整體 piston、tip、tilt 無法觀測，必須交給望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距；另有一種讓所有段鏡沿徑向微傾、等效改變主鏡曲率的模態，只靠感測器對兩鏡夾角的微弱靈敏度觀測，雜訊放大最大。感測器只能維持相對位置，絕對的共相零點必須由光學量測給定，而光學相位只在一個波長內唯一，這就是 2π 模糊的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each segment has three position actuators for piston, tip and tilt, and every edge shared by neighbouring segments carries two edge sensors that measure the relative height of the two rims. Because edge sensors are relative, global piston, tip and tilt of the whole mirror are unobservable and are handed to telescope pointing and secondary focus; another mode, in which every segment tilts slightly radially to mimic a change of primary curvature, is seen only through the sensors' weak dihedral-angle sensitivity and suffers the largest noise amplification. Sensors only hold relative positions, so the absolute phasing zero must come from an optical measurement, and optical phase is unique only within one wavelength: this is the origin of the 2π ambiguity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Keck：36 片 × 3 = 108 支致動器；36 片環狀排列共有 84 條共用邊，每邊 2 個感測器共 168 個量測，對 108 − 3 = 105 個可控自由度約 1.6 倍過定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Keck: 36 segments × 3 = 108 actuators; the 36-segment ring layout has 84 shared edges, and two sensors per edge give 168 measurements, about 1.6 times over-determined for the 108 − 3 = 105 controllable degrees of freedom.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「邊緣感測器讀數全部為零，就證明主鏡已完全共相。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All edge-sensor readings at zero prove the primary is fully phased." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 邊緣感測器讀數全部為零，就證明主鏡已完全共相。
感測器解析度達 1 nm，主鏡位置就能長期維持在 1 nm。
每片段鏡由三支位置致動器控制 piston、tip 與 tilt，相鄰段鏡共用的每條邊上裝兩個邊緣感測器，量兩片鏡緣的相對高度差。
optionsEn: All edge-sensor readings at zero prove the primary is fully phased.
A sensor with 1 nm resolution keeps the mirror within 1 nm indefinitely.
Each segment has three position actuators for piston, tip and tilt, and every edge shared by neighbouring segments carries two edge sensors that measure the relative height of the two rims.
