quiz.explanationEn: Raising the gain until crossover approaches a support resonance produces a persistent narrowband oscillation in the sensors, all segments shiver together and long exposures blur; if the reconstructor does not exclude global tip/tilt, primary control and the telescope guiding loop fight each other and the guide residual shows a slow limit cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「段鏡更換與影像驗收」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Segment exchange and image acceptance” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分段主鏡的鍍膜會老化，必須輪流把段鏡拆下重鍍再裝回；更換後新段鏡的位置只準到數十微米，必須先以寬頻共相捕獲、再以窄頻精調，並重新設定與它相關的所有邊緣感測器零點。驗收要同時看光學量測（共相相機殘差、焦面影像的段鏡繞射暈）與感測器健康（雜訊、漂移、失效感測器的處理），失效的感測器要從重建器移除並重算矩陣。交接文件需列出每片段鏡的序號與位置、感測器設定點版本、重建矩陣版本與更換紀錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「段鏡更換與影像驗收」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segment coatings age, so segments are removed, recoated and reinstalled in rotation; after exchange a new segment is positioned only to tens of micrometres and must be captured broadband, refined narrowband, and have the zero points of every associated edge sensor reset. Acceptance looks at optical measurements, namely phasing-camera residuals and the segment halo in focal-plane images, and at sensor health, namely noise, drift and handling of failed sensors, which must be removed from the reconstructor with the matrix recomputed. The handoff file lists each segment's serial number and position, the set-point version, the reconstructor version and the exchange log. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Segment exchange and image acceptance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ELT 共 931 片段鏡（含 133 片備品），每 18 個月全鏡重鍍一輪，平均 798/(18 × 30.4 天) ≈ 1.5 片/天，ESO 規劃約每天兩片。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The ELT has 931 segments including 133 spares, and the whole mirror is recoated every 18 months, an average of 798/(18 × 30.4 days) ≈ 1.5 segments per day, with ESO planning about two per day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「更換段鏡只是機械工作，裝回原位即可，不需重新共相。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Exchanging a segment is purely mechanical; putting it back needs no re-phasing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「段鏡更換與影像驗收」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Segment exchange and image acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Exchanging a segment is purely mechanical; putting it back needs no re-phasing.
If every segment's figure passes, the assembled primary is automatically diffraction limited.

steps.title: 段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「段鏡更換與影像驗收」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Segment exchange and image acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ELT 共 931 片段鏡（含 133 片備品），每 18 個月全鏡重鍍一輪，平均 798/(18 × 30.4 天) ≈ 1.5 片/天，ESO 規劃約每天兩片。每片段鏡最多 6 條邊、12 個感測器需重設零點；若每片重新共相需 20 分鐘（教學假設），每天約占 30 到 40 分鐘望遠鏡時間，因此流程必須自動化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The ELT has 931 segments including 133 spares, and the whole mirror is recoated every 18 months, an average of 798/(18 × 30.4 days) ≈ 1.5 segments per day, with ESO planning about two per day. Each segment has up to 6 edges and 12 sensors whose zeros must be reset; if re-phasing takes 20 minutes per segment (teaching assumption), that costs 30 to 40 minutes of telescope time per day, so the procedure must be automated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次更換後執行固定流程：機械定位、寬頻捕獲、窄頻精調、記錄新設定點，並以焦面影像確認該段鏡的繞射暈恢復正常；每月彙整所有段鏡的共相殘差、感測器漂移率與失效數量，對照交接文件中的基準趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After every exchange run a fixed sequence of mechanical positioning, broadband capture, narrowband refinement and recording of new set points, and confirm with focal-plane images that the segment's halo has returned to normal; each month compile phasing residuals, sensor drift rates and failure counts for all segments and compare them with the baseline trends in the handoff file.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: ELT 共 931 片段鏡（含 133 片備品），每 18 個月全鏡重鍍一輪，平均 798/(18 × 30.4 天) ≈ 1.5 片/天，ESO 規劃約每天兩片。每片段鏡最多 6 條邊、12 個感測器需重設零點；若每片重新共相需 20 分鐘（教學假設），每天約占 30 到 40 分鐘望遠鏡時間，因此流程必須自動化。
knowledge.textEn: The ELT has 931 segments including 133 spares, and the whole mirror is recoated every 18 months, an average of 798/(18 × 30.4 days) ≈ 1.5 segments per day, with ESO planning about two per day. Each segment has up to 6 edges and 12 sensors whose zeros must be reset; if re-phasing takes 20 minutes per segment (teaching assumption), that costs 30 to 40 minutes of telescope time per day, so the procedure must be automated.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff", which statement holds?

A sensor with 1 nm resolution keeps the mirror within 1 nm indefinitely.
Single-wavelength interferometry uniquely determines a segment step of any size.

steps.title: 段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「段鏡更換與影像驗收」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Segment exchange and image acceptance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每次更換後執行固定流程：機械定位、寬頻捕獲、窄頻精調、記錄新設定點，並以焦面影像確認該段鏡的繞射暈恢復正常；每月彙整所有段鏡的共相殘差、感測器漂移率與失效數量，對照交接文件中的基準趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After every exchange run a fixed sequence of mechanical positioning, broadband capture, narrowband refinement and recording of new set points, and confirm with focal-plane images that the segment's halo has returned to normal; each month compile phasing residuals, sensor drift rates and failure counts for all segments and compare them with the baseline trends in the handoff file. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：更換段鏡後若忘了更新感測器設定點版本，迴路會把新段鏡推回舊段鏡的位置，造成數百 nm 的階差；若失效感測器沒有從重建器移除，它的固定讀數像一條錯誤的約束，把周圍數片段鏡一起拉歪。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Forgetting to update the set-point version after an exchange makes the loop drive the new segment to the old one's position, leaving a step of hundreds of nanometres; a failed sensor left in the reconstructor acts as a false constraint whose frozen reading drags several surrounding segments askew.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次更換後執行固定流程：機械定位、寬頻捕獲、窄頻精調、記錄新設定點，並以焦面影像確認該段鏡的繞射暈恢復正常；每月彙整所有段鏡的共相殘差、感測器漂移率與失效數量，對照交接文件中的基準趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: After every exchange run a fixed sequence of mechanical positioning, broadband capture, narrowband refinement and recording of new set points, and confirm with focal-plane images that the segment's halo has returned to normal; each month compile phasing residuals, sensor drift rates and failure counts for all segments and compare them with the baseline trends in the handoff file.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
每次更換後執行固定流程：機械定位、寬頻捕獲、窄頻精調、記錄新設定點，並以焦面影像確認該段鏡的繞射暈恢復正常。

quiz.explanationEn: After every exchange run a fixed sequence of mechanical positioning, broadband capture, narrowband refinement and recording of new set points, and confirm with focal-plane images that the segment's halo has returned to normal; each month compile phasing residuals, sensor drift rates and failure counts for all segments and compare them with the baseline trends in the handoff file. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.titleEn: Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「段鏡更換與影像驗收」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 更換段鏡後若忘了更新感測器設定點版本，迴路會把新段鏡推回舊段鏡的位置，造成數百 nm 的階差；若失效感測器沒有從重建器移除，它的固定讀數像一條錯誤的約束，把周圍數片段鏡一起拉歪。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
每片段鏡的面形都合格，拼起來的主鏡自然就是繞射極限。
更換段鏡後若忘了更新感測器設定點版本，迴路會把新段鏡推回舊段鏡的位置，造成數百 nm 的階差。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
If every segment's figure passes, the assembled primary is automatically diffraction limited.
Forgetting to update the set-point version after an exchange makes the loop drive the new segment to the old one's position, leaving a step of hundreds of nanometres.
quiz.explanation: 更換段鏡後若忘了更新感測器設定點版本，迴路會把新段鏡推回舊段鏡的位置，造成數百 nm 的階差；若失效感測器沒有從重建器移除，它的固定讀數像一條錯誤的約束，把周圍數片段鏡一起拉歪。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forgetting to update the set-point version after an exchange makes the loop drive the new segment to the old one's position, leaving a step of hundreds of nanometres; a failed sensor left in the reconstructor acts as a false constraint whose frozen reading drags several surrounding segments askew. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 天文雷射導引星
summary: 以約 90 km 高的中氣層鈉層與 ESO VLT 4LGSF 的四道 22 W 鈉雷射為主軸，從 D2 線吸收截面推到每平方公尺每秒的回波光子數，再處理錐效應、無法由雷射量測的 tip-tilt、光點拉長、鈉層高度造成的假離焦與多雷射互擾，最後落到運轉協調與驗收紀錄。
summaryEn: Built around the mesospheric sodium layer near 90 km and the four 22 W sodium lasers of ESO's VLT 4LGSF, this course goes from the D2 absorption cross-section to returned photons per square metre per second, then handles the cone effect, the tip-tilt a laser cannot measure, spot elongation, false defocus from sodium altitude and multi-laser cross-talk, ending with operational coordination and acceptance records.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: LGS 光子與對焦練習：8.2 m 望遠鏡以單道 20 W 鈉雷射在天頂角 30° 觀測。距離 L = 90 km/cos 30° ≈ 104 km、氣團 1.155，單程透過率 0.85^1.155 ≈ 0.83；散射率 = 0.038 × 5.93×10¹⁹ × 0.83 ≈ 1.87×10¹⁸ s⁻¹；地面通量 = 1.87×10¹⁸/(4π × (1.04×10⁵ m)²) × 0.83 ≈ 1.1×10⁷ photons/(s·m²)，取一半為 5.7×10⁶。0.5 m 子孔徑、1 ms、效率 0.3：約 430 光子/幀，1.2″ 光點的質心雜訊 ≈ (1.2/2.355)/√430 ≈ 25 mas。LGS 感測器焦面位移 δ ≈ 120²/1.04×10⁵ m ≈ 139 mm。tip-tilt 由一顆 R = 17 星提供：1×10⁸ × 300 nm × 10^(−6.8) ≈ 4,750 photons/(s·m²)，乘 51.9 m²、效率 0.2、除以 200 Hz，約 250 光子/幀，0.8″ 光點的傾斜雜訊約 22 mas。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: LGS photon and focus exercise: an 8.2 m telescope uses one 20 W sodium laser at 30° zenith angle. Range L = 90 km/cos 30° ≈ 104 km, airmass 1.155 and one-way transmission 0.85^1.155 ≈ 0.83; scattering rate = 0.038 × 5.93×10¹⁹ × 0.83 ≈ 1.87×10¹⁸ s⁻¹; ground flux = 1.87×10¹⁸/(4π × (1.04×10⁵ m)²) × 0.83 ≈ 1.1×10⁷ photons/(s·m²), halved to 5.7×10⁶ for real losses. A 0.5 m subaperture with 1 ms frames and 0.3 efficiency collects about 430 photons per frame, and a 1.2″ spot gives centroid noise ≈ (1.2/2.355)/√430 ≈ 25 mas. The LGS sensor sits δ ≈ 120²/1.04×10⁵ m ≈ 139 mm behind the natural-star focus. Tip-tilt comes from an R = 17 star: 1×10⁸ × 300 nm × 10^(−6.8) ≈ 4,750 photons/(s·m²), times 51.9 m² and 0.2 efficiency, divided by 200 Hz, gives about 250 photons per frame and about 22 mas tilt noise for a 0.8″ spot. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」與「錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section" and "Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「中氣層鈉原子層」如何決定天文雷射導引星的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mesospheric sodium layer” determines the key performance of “Astronomical laser guide stars”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。把雷射調到鈉 D2 線 589.16 nm，鈉原子吸收後自發輻射，向各方向發出同波長的光，從地面看就像一顆位於 90 km 的人造星。鈉原子溫度約 190 K，都卜勒展寬約 1 GHz，遠大於約 10 MHz 的自然線寬，所以雷射的線寬、頻率準確度與偏振直接決定能激發多少原子。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「中氣層鈉原子層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night. A laser tuned to the sodium D2 line at 589.16 nm is absorbed and re-emitted spontaneously in all directions at the same wavelength, so from the ground it looks like an artificial star at 90 km. At about 190 K the sodium Doppler width is near 1 GHz, far larger than the roughly 10 MHz natural linewidth, so the laser's linewidth, frequency accuracy and polarisation directly decide how many atoms are excited. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mesospheric sodium layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：D2 振子強度 f = 0.641，積分截面 (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz；T = 190 K 時都卜勒半高全寬 Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz，峰值截面 ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm²，D2a 分量佔 5/8，約 9.5×10⁻¹² cm²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz; at T = 190 K the Doppler FWHM is Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz and the peak cross-section ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm², of which the D2a component carries 5/8, about 9.5×10⁻¹² cm².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「中氣層鈉原子層」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Mesospheric sodium layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面
knowledge.text: 流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。把雷射調到鈉 D2 線 589.16 nm，鈉原子吸收後自發輻射，向各方向發出同波長的光，從地面看就像一顆位於 90 km 的人造星。
knowledge.textEn: Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night. A laser tuned to the sodium D2 line at 589.16 nm is absorbed and re-emitted spontaneously in all directions at the same wavelength, so from the ground it looks like an artificial star at 90 km.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section" is correct?
options: 鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。
流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。
有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。
optionsEn: The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back.

Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night.
With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all.
quiz.explanation: 流星燒蝕留下的鈉原子在約 90 km 高、厚約 10 km 的中氣層形成一層稀薄的原子層，柱密度通常為每平方公分數十億個原子，並隨季節、緯度與夜間時間變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sodium deposited by meteor ablation forms a thin atomic layer in the mesosphere about 90 km high and roughly 10 km thick, with a column density of a few billion atoms per square centimetre that varies with season, latitude and time of night. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中氣層鈉原子層」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mesospheric sodium layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：D2 振子強度 f = 0.641，積分截面 (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz；T = 190 K 時都卜勒半高全寬 Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz，峰值截面 ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm²，D2a 分量佔 5/8，約 9.5×10⁻¹² cm²。柱密度 4×10⁹ cm⁻² 時光學厚度 τ = σ·C_Na ≈ 0.038，也就是窄頻低強度下只有約 4% 的雷射光子被鈉層吸收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz; at T = 190 K the Doppler FWHM is Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz and the peak cross-section ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm², of which the D2a component carries 5/8, about 9.5×10⁻¹² cm². With a column density of 4×10⁹ cm⁻² the optical depth τ = σ·C_Na ≈ 0.038, so a narrowband low-intensity laser loses only about 4% of its photons to the sodium layer. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以鈉雷射雷達量測鈉層柱密度與高度剖面，並與季節性統計比較；在實驗室以鈉蒸氣室掃描雷射頻率，確認 D2a 與 D2b 兩個超精細峰相隔約 1.77 GHz，據此校正雷射的絕對頻率，並記錄鎖定點相對 D2a 峰的偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sodium column density and altitude profile with a sodium lidar and compare with seasonal statistics; in the laboratory scan the laser frequency across a sodium vapour cell, confirm that the D2a and D2b hyperfine peaks are about 1.77 GHz apart, use them to calibrate the absolute laser frequency, and record the offset of the lock point from the D2a peak.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: D2 振子強度 f = 0.641，積分截面 (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz；T = 190 K 時都卜勒半高全寬 Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz，峰值截面 ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm²，D2a 分量佔 5/8，約 9.5×10⁻¹² cm²。柱密度 4×10⁹ cm⁻² 時光學厚度 τ = σ·C_Na ≈ 0.038，也就是窄頻低強度下只有約 4% 的雷射光子被鈉層吸收。
knowledge.textEn: The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz; at T = 190 K the Doppler FWHM is Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz and the peak cross-section ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm², of which the D2a component carries 5/8, about 9.5×10⁻¹² cm². With a column density of 4×10⁹ cm⁻² the optical depth τ = σ·C_Na ≈ 0.038, so a narrowband low-intensity laser loses only about 4% of its photons to the sodium layer.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「鈉層共振散射與吸收截面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section", which statement holds?
options: 鈉導引星的亮度只取決於雷射功率，與發射望遠鏡無關。
LGS 的焦距只隨天頂角改變，鈉層本身的高度是固定的。
optionsEn: Sodium guide-star brightness depends only on laser power, not on the launch telescope.
LGS focus changes only with zenith angle; the sodium layer altitude is fixed.
The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz.
quiz.explanation: D2 振子強度 f = 0.641，積分截面 (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz；T = 190 K 時都卜勒半高全寬 Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz，峰值截面 ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm²，D2a 分量佔 5/8，約 9.5×10⁻¹² cm²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The D2 oscillator strength is f = 0.641, so the integrated cross-section is (πe²/m_ec)·f ≈ 0.0265 × 0.641 ≈ 0.017 cm²·Hz; at T = 190 K the Doppler FWHM is Δν_D ≈ 1.05 GHz and the peak cross-section ≈ 0.017 × 0.939/(1.05×10⁹ Hz) ≈ 1.5×10⁻¹¹ cm², of which the D2a component carries 5/8, about 9.5×10⁻¹² cm². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「中氣層鈉原子層」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Mesospheric sodium layer” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以鈉雷射雷達量測鈉層柱密度與高度剖面，並與季節性統計比較；在實驗室以鈉蒸氣室掃描雷射頻率，確認 D2a 與 D2b 兩個超精細峰相隔約 1.77 GHz，據此校正雷射的絕對頻率，並記錄鎖定點相對 D2a 峰的偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sodium column density and altitude profile with a sodium lidar and compare with seasonal statistics; in the laboratory scan the laser frequency across a sodium vapour cell, confirm that the D2a and D2b hyperfine peaks are about 1.77 GHz apart, use them to calibrate the absolute laser frequency, and record the offset of the lock point from the D2a peak. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雷射頻率偏離 D2a 峰數百 MHz 時，回波光子數依都卜勒輪廓迅速下降，自適應光學看到的導引星變暗、波前感測雜訊升高；若把回波下降誤歸因於鈉層季節變化而不檢查頻率鎖定，問題會持續整夜。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the laser drifts a few hundred megahertz off the D2a peak, return photons fall rapidly along the Doppler profile, the guide star dims for the adaptive optics and wavefront-sensor noise rises; blaming the drop on seasonal sodium changes instead of checking the frequency lock lets the problem persist all night.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 鈉層共振散射與吸收截面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sodium-layer resonance scattering and cross-section: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中氣層鈉原子層」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Mesospheric sodium layer” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 雷射頻率偏離 D2a 峰數百 MHz 時，回波光子數依都卜勒輪廓迅速下降，自適應光學看到的導引星變暗、波前感測雜訊升高；若把回波下降誤歸因於鈉層季節變化而不檢查頻率鎖定，問題會持續整夜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the laser drifts a few hundred megahertz off the D2a peak, return photons fall rapidly along the Doppler profile, the guide star dims for the adaptive optics and wavefront-sensor noise rises; blaming the drop on seasonal sodium changes instead of checking the frequency lock lets the problem persist all night. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鈉原子溫度約 190 K，都卜勒展寬約 1 GHz，遠大於約 10 MHz 的自然線寬，所以雷射的線寬、頻率準確度與偏振直接決定能激發多少原子。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At about 190 K the sodium Doppler width is near 1 GHz, far larger than the roughly 10 MHz natural linewidth, so the laser's linewidth, frequency accuracy and polarisation directly decide how many atoms are excited.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」如何決定天文雷射導引星的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laser cone and turbulent layers” determines the key performance of “Astronomical laser guide stars”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自然星的光以平行光柱穿過大氣，雷射導引星卻位於有限高度，回波光在望遠鏡瞳面形成一個光錐；高度 h 的湍流層只被半徑縮小為 (1 − h/H) 的部分取樣，邊緣的湍流沒被量到，這就是錐效應，也稱焦點非等暈。導引星越低、口徑越大，問題越嚴重。此外雷射上行與回波下行穿過同一段大氣，導引星在天空的位置抖動同時包含上行與下行的傾斜，兩者無法分離，所以整體 tip-tilt 必須另由一顆自然星量測。瑞利導引星利用 10 到 20 km 高的空氣分子散射，亮度高，但錐效應遠比鈉導引星嚴重，多用於地表層自適應光學。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Light from a natural star crosses the atmosphere as a parallel column, but a laser guide star sits at finite altitude and its return forms a cone at the pupil; a layer at height h is sampled only over a region shrunk by (1 − h/H), leaving turbulence at the edge unmeasured, which is the cone effect or focal anisoplanatism, worse for lower beacons and larger apertures. The laser also travels up and the return comes down through the same air, so the beacon's position jitter on the sky mixes uplink and downlink tilt that cannot be separated, and overall tip-tilt must come from a natural star. Rayleigh beacons use molecular scattering at 10 to 20 km and are bright, but their cone effect is far worse than sodium's, so they mainly serve ground-layer adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser cone and turbulent layers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：8.2 m 口徑、鈉導引星 H = 90 km：h = 10 km 層的取樣直徑 D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m，外緣未取樣環寬約 0.46 m；瑞利導引星 H = 15 km 時取樣直徑只剩 2.73 m，未取樣環寬 2.73 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an 8.2 m aperture and a sodium beacon at H = 90 km, a layer at h = 10 km is sampled over D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m, leaving an unsampled rim about 0.46 m wide; a Rayleigh beacon at H = 15 km samples only 2.73 m, leaving a 2.73 m wide rim.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Laser cone and turbulent layers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The laser also travels up and the return comes down through the same air, so the beacon's position jitter on the sky mixes uplink and downlink tilt that cannot be separated, and overall tip-tilt must come from a natural star.

knowledge.text: 誤解：有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。

Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons.
Light from a natural star crosses the atmosphere as a parallel column, but a laser guide star sits at finite altitude and its return forms a cone at the pupil.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laser cone and turbulent layers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：8.2 m 口徑、鈉導引星 H = 90 km：h = 10 km 層的取樣直徑 D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m，外緣未取樣環寬約 0.46 m；瑞利導引星 H = 15 km 時取樣直徑只剩 2.73 m，未取樣環寬 2.73 m。對 h = 5 km 的層，鈉導引星與 12 km 瑞利導引星的取樣直徑分別為 7.74 m 與 4.78 m，說明瑞利星只能有效修正最低層湍流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an 8.2 m aperture and a sodium beacon at H = 90 km, a layer at h = 10 km is sampled over D(1 − h/H) ≈ 7.29 m, leaving an unsampled rim about 0.46 m wide; a Rayleigh beacon at H = 15 km samples only 2.73 m, leaving a 2.73 m wide rim. For a layer at h = 5 km the sampled diameters are 7.74 m for sodium and 4.78 m for a 12 km Rayleigh beacon, which is why Rayleigh beacons correct only the lowest turbulence effectively. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變；tip-tilt 不確定性則以 LGS 回報的整體傾斜與 NGS 傾斜之間相關係數接近零來確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions; the difference should concentrate at the pupil rim and track the turbulence profile measured by SCIDAR or MASS.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

For a layer at h = 5 km the sampled diameters are 7.74 m for sodium and 4.78 m for a 12 km Rayleigh beacon, which is why Rayleigh beacons correct only the lowest turbulence effectively.

steps.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Laser cone and turbulent layers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變；tip-tilt 不確定性則以 LGS 回報的整體傾斜與 NGS 傾斜之間相關係數接近零來確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions; the difference should concentrate at the pupil rim and track the turbulence profile measured by SCIDAR or MASS. Confirm tilt indeterminacy by showing that the global tilt reported by the LGS is nearly uncorrelated with the NGS tilt. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限；在高層湍流強的夜晚仍以單顆 LGS 做窄場修正，外緣殘差會讓近紅外 Strehl 明顯低於預估。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement; using a single LGS for narrow-field correction on nights with strong high-altitude turbulence leaves rim residuals that push near-infrared Strehl well below prediction.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變；tip-tilt 不確定性則以 LGS 回報的整體傾斜與 NGS 傾斜之間相關係數接近零來確認。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions; the difference should concentrate at the pupil rim and track the turbulence profile measured by SCIDAR or MASS. Confirm tilt indeterminacy by showing that the global tilt reported by the LGS is nearly uncorrelated with the NGS tilt.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以同一顆亮自然星交替或同時做 NGS 與 LGS 波前量測，比較兩者重建的波前差，殘差應集中在瞳面外緣，並隨 SCIDAR 或 MASS 量得的湍流高度剖面而變。
雷射導引星的安全只需注意雷射本身，與航空和衛星協調無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions.
Guide-star laser safety concerns only the laser itself, not aviation or satellite coordination.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure the wavefront with NGS and LGS on the same bright natural star, alternately or simultaneously, and compare the reconstructions; the difference should concentrate at the pupil rim and track the turbulence profile measured by SCIDAR or MASS. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷射光錐與大氣湍流層」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Laser cone and turbulent layers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限；在高層湍流強的夜晚仍以單顆 LGS 做窄場修正，外緣殘差會讓近紅外 Strehl 明顯低於預估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement; using a single LGS for narrow-field correction on nights with strong high-altitude turbulence leaves rim residuals that push near-infrared Strehl well below prediction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：瑞利導引星利用 10 到 20 km 高的空氣分子散射，亮度高，但錐效應遠比鈉導引星嚴重，多用於地表層自適應光學。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rayleigh beacons use molecular scattering at 10 to 20 km and are bright, but their cone effect is far worse than sodium's, so they mainly serve ground-layer adaptive optics.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a laser guide star, no natural guide star is needed at all." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限；在高層湍流強的夜晚仍以單顆 LGS 做窄場修正，外緣殘差會讓近紅外 Strehl 明顯低於預估。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錐效應、焦點非等暈與傾斜不確定性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cone effect, focal anisoplanatism and tilt indeterminacy" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons.
Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement.
quiz.explanation: 若以為 LGS 可提供完整波前而省略自然星傾斜感測，長曝光影像被大氣傾斜抹成寬團塊，改善非常有限；在高層湍流強的夜晚仍以單顆 LGS 做窄場修正，外緣殘差會讓近紅外 Strehl 明顯低於預估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming the LGS provides the complete wavefront and omitting natural-star tilt sensing smears long exposures into broad blobs with very little improvement; using a single LGS for narrow-field correction on nights with strong high-altitude turbulence leaves rim residuals that push near-infrared Strehl well below prediction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「589 nm 雷射源：頻率、線寬、回泵與偏振」與「發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "589 nm source: frequency, linewidth, repumping and polarisation" and "Launch telescope, uplink spot and return-photon budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 589 nm 雷射源：頻率、線寬、回泵與偏振：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: 589 nm source: frequency, linewidth, repumping and polarisation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1178 nm 拉曼光纖放大與倍頻器」如何決定天文雷射導引星的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1178 nm Raman fibre amplifier and doubler” determines the key performance of “Astronomical laser guide stars”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 現代鈉導引星雷射多為連續波系統：窄線寬二極體種子雷射在 1178 nm 起振，經拉曼光纖放大器放大到數十瓦，再以共振腔倍頻得到 589 nm，ESO 4LGSF 每道約 22 W。拉曼光纖放大的難點是在高功率下抑制受激布里淵散射，同時把線寬維持在遠窄於鈉超精細結構的程度。為了提高回波，雷射採圓偏振，以光泵把原子推進循環躍遷，並把約一成功率移到 D2b 頻率做回泵，避免原子停在不吸收的基態；地磁場造成的拉莫進動會削弱光泵效果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1178 nm 拉曼光纖放大與倍頻器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modern sodium guide-star lasers are mostly continuous-wave systems: a narrow-linewidth diode seed at 1178 nm is amplified to tens of watts in a Raman fibre amplifier and frequency-doubled in a resonant cavity to 589 nm, about 22 W per beam for ESO's 4LGSF. The hard part of Raman fibre amplification is suppressing stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power while keeping the linewidth far narrower than the sodium hyperfine structure. To raise the return, the laser is circularly polarised to optically pump atoms into the cycling transition, and about a tenth of the power is shifted to the D2b frequency as a repumper so atoms do not stay in the non-absorbing ground state; Larmor precession in the geomagnetic field weakens the pumping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1178 nm Raman fibre amplifier and doubler”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 1178.32 nm/2 = 589.16 nm, an optical frequency ν = c/λ ≈ 508.9 THz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「1178 nm 拉曼光纖放大與倍頻器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “1178 nm Raman fibre amplifier and doubler”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 589 nm 雷射源：頻率、線寬、回泵與偏振
knowledge.titleEn: 589 nm source: frequency, linewidth, repumping and polarisation
knowledge.text: 現代鈉導引星雷射多為連續波系統：窄線寬二極體種子雷射在 1178 nm 起振，經拉曼光纖放大器放大到數十瓦，再以共振腔倍頻得到 589 nm，ESO 4LGSF 每道約 22 W。拉曼光纖放大的難點是在高功率下抑制受激布里淵散射，同時把線寬維持在遠窄於鈉超精細結構的程度。
knowledge.textEn: Modern sodium guide-star lasers are mostly continuous-wave systems: a narrow-linewidth diode seed at 1178 nm is amplified to tens of watts in a Raman fibre amplifier and frequency-doubled in a resonant cavity to 589 nm, about 22 W per beam for ESO's 4LGSF. The hard part of Raman fibre amplification is suppressing stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power while keeping the linewidth far narrower than the sodium hyperfine structure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「589 nm 雷射源：頻率、線寬、回泵與偏振」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "589 nm source: frequency, linewidth, repumping and polarisation" is correct?
options: 現代鈉導引星雷射多為連續波系統：窄線寬二極體種子雷射在 1178 nm 起振，經拉曼光纖放大器放大到數十瓦，再以共振腔倍頻得到 589 nm，ESO 4LGSF 每道約 22 W。
只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。
鈉導引星的亮度只取決於雷射功率，與發射望遠鏡無關。
optionsEn: Modern sodium guide-star lasers are mostly continuous-wave systems: a narrow-linewidth diode seed at 1178 nm is amplified to tens of watts in a Raman fibre amplifier and frequency-doubled in a resonant cavity to 589 nm, about 22 W per beam for ESO's 4LGSF.
Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons.
Sodium guide-star brightness depends only on laser power, not on the launch telescope.

quiz.explanationEn: Modern sodium guide-star lasers are mostly continuous-wave systems: a narrow-linewidth diode seed at 1178 nm is amplified to tens of watts in a Raman fibre amplifier and frequency-doubled in a resonant cavity to 589 nm, about 22 W per beam for ESO's 4LGSF. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 589 nm 雷射源：頻率、線寬、回泵與偏振：定量估算
steps.titleEn: 589 nm source: frequency, linewidth, repumping and polarisation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1178 nm 拉曼光纖放大與倍頻器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1178 nm Raman fibre amplifier and doubler” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1178.32 nm/2 = 589.16 nm，光頻 ν = c/λ ≈ 508.9 THz。都卜勒寬度約 1.05 GHz、自然線寬約 10 MHz，窄線寬雷射一次只激發約 1% 的速度族群。強度：20 W、大氣透過率 0.85、中氣層光點半高全寬 1.2″（直徑 ≈ 90 km × 1.2″ ≈ 0.52 m，面積 ≈ 2,150 cm²），I ≈ 17 W/2,150 cm² ≈ 7.9 mW/cm²，約為循環躍遷飽和強度 6.26 mW/cm² 的 1.3 倍，所以再加功率的回報會遞減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 1178.32 nm/2 = 589.16 nm, an optical frequency ν = c/λ ≈ 508.9 THz. With a Doppler width near 1.05 GHz and a natural width near 10 MHz, a narrow-linewidth laser excites only about 1% of the velocity classes at once. Intensity: 20 W, 0.85 atmospheric transmission and a 1.2″ FWHM mesospheric spot (diameter ≈ 90 km × 1.2″ ≈ 0.52 m, area ≈ 2,150 cm²) give I ≈ 17 W/2,150 cm² ≈ 7.9 mW/cm², about 1.3 times the 6.26 mW/cm² cycling-transition saturation intensity, so extra power brings diminishing returns. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以波長計與鈉蒸氣參考室確認並鎖定絕對頻率，以 Fabry–Pérot 掃描確認線寬與 D2b 邊帶的功率比例，以功率計與偏振分析儀量出光功率與圓偏振度；在天上以相同功率切換圓與線偏振、開關 D2b 回泵，記錄回波光子數比例並與模擬比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm and lock the absolute frequency with a wavemeter and a sodium reference cell, check linewidth and the D2b sideband power fraction with a scanning Fabry–Pérot, and measure output power and degree of circular polarisation with a power meter and polarisation analyser; on sky, at fixed power, switch between circular and linear polarisation and toggle the D2b repumper, recording the return-photon ratios for comparison with simulation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 1178.32 nm/2 = 589.16 nm，光頻 ν = c/λ ≈ 508.9 THz。都卜勒寬度約 1.05 GHz、自然線寬約 10 MHz，窄線寬雷射一次只激發約 1% 的速度族群。強度：20 W、大氣透過率 0.85、中氣層光點半高全寬 1.2″（直徑 ≈ 90 km × 1.2″ ≈ 0.52 m，面積 ≈ 2,150 cm²），I ≈ 17 W/2,150 cm² ≈ 7.9 mW/cm²，約為循環躍遷飽和強度 6.26 mW/cm² 的 1.3 倍，所以再加功率的回報會遞減。
knowledge.textEn: 1178.32 nm/2 = 589.16 nm, an optical frequency ν = c/λ ≈ 508.9 THz. With a Doppler width near 1.05 GHz and a natural width near 10 MHz, a narrow-linewidth laser excites only about 1% of the velocity classes at once. Intensity: 20 W, 0.85 atmospheric transmission and a 1.2″ FWHM mesospheric spot (diameter ≈ 90 km × 1.2″ ≈ 0.52 m, area ≈ 2,150 cm²) give I ≈ 17 W/2,150 cm² ≈ 7.9 mW/cm², about 1.3 times the 6.26 mW/cm² cycling-transition saturation intensity, so extra power brings diminishing returns.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 589 nm 雷射源：頻率、線寬、回泵與偏振：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: 589 nm source: frequency, linewidth, repumping and polarisation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「1178 nm 拉曼光纖放大與倍頻器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “1178 nm Raman fibre amplifier and doubler” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以波長計與鈉蒸氣參考室確認並鎖定絕對頻率，以 Fabry–Pérot 掃描確認線寬與 D2b 邊帶的功率比例，以功率計與偏振分析儀量出光功率與圓偏振度；在天上以相同功率切換圓與線偏振、開關 D2b 回泵，記錄回波光子數比例並與模擬比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm and lock the absolute frequency with a wavemeter and a sodium reference cell, check linewidth and the D2b sideband power fraction with a scanning Fabry–Pérot, and measure output power and degree of circular polarisation with a power meter and polarisation analyser; on sky, at fixed power, switch between circular and linear polarisation and toggle the D2b repumper, recording the return-photon ratios for comparison with simulation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：放大器若在高功率出現受激布里淵散射，反向功率可能傷害前級元件，保護機制自動降功率，導引星亮度在夜間無預警下降；偏振純度劣化或回泵邊帶失鎖會讓回波減少數十個百分比，而雷射輸出功率看起來完全正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the amplifier develops stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power, backward power can damage upstream components and protection logic cuts the power, dimming the guide star without warning; degraded polarisation purity or a lost repump sideband cuts the return by tens of percent while the laser output power looks perfectly normal.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 589 nm 雷射源：頻率、線寬、回泵與偏振：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: 589 nm source: frequency, linewidth, repumping and polarisation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1178 nm 拉曼光纖放大與倍頻器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “1178 nm Raman fibre amplifier and doubler” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 放大器若在高功率出現受激布里淵散射，反向功率可能傷害前級元件，保護機制自動降功率，導引星亮度在夜間無預警下降；偏振純度劣化或回泵邊帶失鎖會讓回波減少數十個百分比，而雷射輸出功率看起來完全正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the amplifier develops stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power, backward power can damage upstream components and protection logic cuts the power, dimming the guide star without warning; degraded polarisation purity or a lost repump sideband cuts the return by tens of percent while the laser output power looks perfectly normal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：為了提高回波，雷射採圓偏振，以光泵把原子推進循環躍遷，並把約一成功率移到 D2b 頻率做回泵，避免原子停在不吸收的基態；地磁場造成的拉莫進動會削弱光泵效果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: To raise the return, the laser is circularly polarised to optically pump atoms into the cycling transition, and about a tenth of the power is shifted to the D2b frequency as a repumper so atoms do not stay in the non-absorbing ground state; Larmor precession in the geomagnetic field weakens the pumping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把雷射功率加倍，回波光子數就一定加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling laser power always doubles the returned photons." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: If the amplifier develops stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power, backward power can damage upstream components and protection logic cuts the power, dimming the guide star without warning; degraded polarisation purity or a lost repump sideband cuts the return by tens of percent while the laser output power looks perfectly normal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「589 nm 雷射源：頻率、線寬、回泵與偏振」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "589 nm source: frequency, linewidth, repumping and polarisation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 放大器若在高功率出現受激布里淵散射，反向功率可能傷害前級元件，保護機制自動降功率，導引星亮度在夜間無預警下降。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鈉導引星的亮度只取決於雷射功率，與發射望遠鏡無關。
optionsEn: If the amplifier develops stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power, backward power can damage upstream components and protection logic cuts the power, dimming the guide star without warning.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Sodium guide-star brightness depends only on laser power, not on the launch telescope.

quiz.explanationEn: If the amplifier develops stimulated Brillouin scattering at high power, backward power can damage upstream components and protection logic cuts the power, dimming the guide star without warning; degraded polarisation purity or a lost repump sideband cuts the return by tens of percent while the laser output power looks perfectly normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Launch telescope, uplink spot and return-photon budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雷射發射望遠鏡與回波通量」如何決定天文雷射導引星的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Launch telescope and return flux” determines the key performance of “Astronomical laser guide stars”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雷射經光束傳輸系統送到發射望遠鏡，ESO 4LGSF 每道光束直徑 30 cm；發射口徑太小時繞射使光點變大，太大則上行光束被湍流破碎，最佳值約為數倍 r₀。中氣層光點的大小決定回波的亮度分佈與波前感測器看到的光點寬度。回波光子預算是一條鏈：雷射功率、上行透過率、鈉層吸收比例、近乎等向的再發射、隨距離平方衰減、下行透過率、望遠鏡與感測器效率，每一環都要能量測並互相對得上。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射發射望遠鏡與回波通量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The laser travels through a beam-transfer system to a launch telescope, 30 cm in beam diameter per beam for ESO's 4LGSF; too small a launch aperture enlarges the spot by diffraction, while too large a beam is broken up by turbulence on the way up, so the optimum is a few times r₀. The mesospheric spot size sets the return brightness distribution and the spot width seen by the wavefront sensor. The return-photon budget is a chain of laser power, uplink transmission, sodium absorption fraction, nearly isotropic re-emission, inverse-square dilution, downlink transmission and telescope and sensor efficiency, and every link must be measurable and consistent with the others. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Launch telescope and return flux”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：20 W 對應 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s；τ = 0.038、上行透過率 0.85 得每秒 1.9×10¹⁸ 次散射；等向發射在地面的通量 1.9×10¹⁸/(4π × (9×10⁴ m)²) × 0.85 ≈ 1.6×10⁷ photons/(s·m²)，這是未計入飽和、拉莫進動與反衝的上限；天頂角 30° 時降到約 1.1×10⁷。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 20 W is 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s; with τ = 0.038 and 0.85 uplink transmission there are 1.9×10¹⁸ scatterings per second; isotropic emission gives a ground flux of 1.9×10¹⁸/(4π × (9×10⁴ m)²) × 0.85 ≈ 1.6×10⁷ photons/(s·m²), an upper bound before saturation, Larmor precession and recoil, falling to about 1.1×10⁷ at 30° zenith angle.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鈉導引星的亮度只取決於雷射功率，與發射望遠鏡無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sodium guide-star brightness depends only on laser power, not on the launch telescope." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雷射發射望遠鏡與回波通量」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Launch telescope and return flux”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

雷射經光束傳輸系統送到發射望遠鏡，ESO 4LGSF 每道光束直徑 30 cm；發射口徑太小時繞射使光點變大，太大則上行光束被湍流破碎，最佳值約為數倍 r₀。

steps.title: 發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Launch telescope, uplink spot and return-photon budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷射發射望遠鏡與回波通量」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Launch telescope and return flux” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：20 W 對應 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s；τ = 0.038、上行透過率 0.85 得每秒 1.9×10¹⁸ 次散射；等向發射在地面的通量 1.9×10¹⁸/(4π × (9×10⁴ m)²) × 0.85 ≈ 1.6×10⁷ photons/(s·m²)，這是未計入飽和、拉莫進動與反衝的上限；天頂角 30° 時降到約 1.1×10⁷。取實際值為上限的一半，0.5 m 子孔徑、1 ms、系統效率 0.3：每幀約 600 個光子。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 20 W is 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s; with τ = 0.038 and 0.85 uplink transmission there are 1.9×10¹⁸ scatterings per second; isotropic emission gives a ground flux of 1.9×10¹⁸/(4π × (9×10⁴ m)²) × 0.85 ≈ 1.6×10⁷ photons/(s·m²), an upper bound before saturation, Larmor precession and recoil, falling to about 1.1×10⁷ at 30° zenith angle. Taking half the bound, a 0.5 m subaperture, 1 ms frames and 0.3 system efficiency, each frame receives about 600 photons. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在望遠鏡上以校正過的波前感測器或小型光度計量測實際回波通量，扣除背景後換算成 photons/(s·m²)，再除以雷射出口功率與同時段的鈉柱密度得到比回波，與上式及數值模擬比較；並以天頂角掃描驗證通量隨 1/L² 與氣團的變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the telescope measure the actual return flux with a calibrated wavefront sensor or small photometer, subtract background, convert to photons/(s·m²), divide by the laser output power and the concurrent sodium column density to get the specific return, and compare with the estimate and with numerical simulation; scan zenith angle to verify the 1/L² and airmass dependence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Launch telescope, uplink spot and return-photon budget", which statement holds?
options: 雷射導引星越多越好，彼此之間不會有任何干擾。
鈉層像一面鏡子，打上去的雷射光大部分會被反射回來。
20 W 對應 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s。
optionsEn: More laser guide stars are always better and never interfere with each other.
The sodium layer acts like a mirror and reflects most of the laser light back.
20 W is 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s.
quiz.explanation: 20 W 對應 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s；τ = 0.038、上行透過率 0.85 得每秒 1.9×10¹⁸ 次散射；等向發射在地面的通量 1.9×10¹⁸/(4π × (9×10⁴ m)²) × 0.85 ≈ 1.6×10⁷ photons/(s·m²)，這是未計入飽和、拉莫進動與反衝的上限；天頂角 30° 時降到約 1.1×10⁷。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 20 W is 5.93×10¹⁹ photons/s; with τ = 0.038 and 0.85 uplink transmission there are 1.9×10¹⁸ scatterings per second; isotropic emission gives a ground flux of 1.9×10¹⁸/(4π × (9×10⁴ m)²) × 0.85 ≈ 1.6×10⁷ photons/(s·m²), an upper bound before saturation, Larmor precession and recoil, falling to about 1.1×10⁷ at 30° zenith angle. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Launch telescope, uplink spot and return-photon budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雷射發射望遠鏡與回波通量」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Launch telescope and return flux” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在望遠鏡上以校正過的波前感測器或小型光度計量測實際回波通量，扣除背景後換算成 photons/(s·m²)，再除以雷射出口功率與同時段的鈉柱密度得到比回波，與上式及數值模擬比較；並以天頂角掃描驗證通量隨 1/L² 與氣團的變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the telescope measure the actual return flux with a calibrated wavefront sensor or small photometer, subtract background, convert to photons/(s·m²), divide by the laser output power and the concurrent sodium column density to get the specific return, and compare with the estimate and with numerical simulation; scan zenith angle to verify the 1/L² and airmass dependence. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：發射望遠鏡離焦或光束品質變差時，中氣層光點從 1.2″ 擴大到 2″ 以上，回波總數未必下降，但波前感測器的光點變大、質心雜訊上升，AO 表現變差；若只監看雷射出口功率而不監看回波，傳輸光路中某片鏡面的污染會被誤認為鈉層變薄。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the launch telescope defocuses or beam quality degrades, the mesospheric spot grows from 1.2″ to beyond 2″; total return may not fall, but the wavefront-sensor spots grow, centroid noise rises and AO performance drops; monitoring only laser output power without the return lets contamination of a mirror in the transfer path be mistaken for a thinning sodium layer.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在望遠鏡上以校正過的波前感測器或小型光度計量測實際回波通量，扣除背景後換算成 photons/(s·m²)，再除以雷射出口功率與同時段的鈉柱密度得到比回波，與上式及數值模擬比較；並以天頂角掃描驗證通量隨 1/L² 與氣團的變化。
knowledge.textEn: On the telescope measure the actual return flux with a calibrated wavefront sensor or small photometer, subtract background, convert to photons/(s·m²), divide by the laser output power and the concurrent sodium column density to get the specific return, and compare with the estimate and with numerical simulation; scan zenith angle to verify the 1/L² and airmass dependence.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Launch telescope, uplink spot and return-photon budget"?
options: 在望遠鏡上以校正過的波前感測器或小型光度計量測實際回波通量，扣除背景後換算成 photons/(s·m²)，再除以雷射出口功率與同時段的鈉柱密度得到比回波，與上式及數值模擬比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
有了雷射導引星，就完全不需要任何自然導引星。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanationEn: On the telescope measure the actual return flux with a calibrated wavefront sensor or small photometer, subtract background, convert to photons/(s·m²), divide by the laser output power and the concurrent sodium column density to get the specific return, and compare with the estimate and with numerical simulation; scan zenith angle to verify the 1/L² and airmass dependence. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Launch telescope, uplink spot and return-photon budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷射發射望遠鏡與回波通量」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Launch telescope and return flux” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 發射望遠鏡離焦或光束品質變差時，中氣層光點從 1.2″ 擴大到 2″ 以上，回波總數未必下降，但波前感測器的光點變大、質心雜訊上升，AO 表現變差；若只監看雷射出口功率而不監看回波，傳輸光路中某片鏡面的污染會被誤認為鈉層變薄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the launch telescope defocuses or beam quality degrades, the mesospheric spot grows from 1.2″ to beyond 2″; total return may not fall, but the wavefront-sensor spots grow, centroid noise rises and AO performance drops; monitoring only laser output power without the return lets contamination of a mirror in the transfer path be mistaken for a thinning sodium layer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：回波光子預算是一條鏈：雷射功率、上行透過率、鈉層吸收比例、近乎等向的再發射、隨距離平方衰減、下行透過率、望遠鏡與感測器效率，每一環都要能量測並互相對得上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The return-photon budget is a chain of laser power, uplink transmission, sodium absorption fraction, nearly isotropic re-emission, inverse-square dilution, downlink transmission and telescope and sensor efficiency, and every link must be measurable and consistent with the others.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鈉導引星的亮度只取決於雷射功率，與發射望遠鏡無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sodium guide-star brightness depends only on laser power, not on the launch telescope." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 發射望遠鏡離焦或光束品質變差時，中氣層光點從 1.2″ 擴大到 2″ 以上，回波總數未必下降，但波前感測器的光點變大、質心雜訊上升，AO 表現變差；若只監看雷射出口功率而不監看回波，傳輸光路中某片鏡面的污染會被誤認為鈉層變薄。
knowledge.textEn: If the launch telescope defocuses or beam quality degrades, the mesospheric spot grows from 1.2″ to beyond 2″; total return may not fall, but the wavefront-sensor spots grow, centroid noise rises and AO performance drops; monitoring only laser output power without the return lets contamination of a mirror in the transfer path be mistaken for a thinning sodium layer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「發射望遠鏡、上行光點與回波光子預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Launch telescope, uplink spot and return-photon budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
發射望遠鏡離焦或光束品質變差時，中氣層光點從 1.2″ 擴大到 2″ 以上，回波總數未必下降，但波前感測器的光點變大、質心雜訊上升，AO 表現變差。
LGS 光點和自然星一樣是圓點，可以直接沿用自然星的感測器設計。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If the launch telescope defocuses or beam quality degrades, the mesospheric spot grows from 1.2″ to beyond 2″.
LGS spots are round like natural stars, so natural-star sensor designs carry over unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 發射望遠鏡離焦或光束品質變差時，中氣層光點從 1.2″ 擴大到 2″ 以上，回波總數未必下降，但波前感測器的光點變大、質心雜訊上升，AO 表現變差；若只監看雷射出口功率而不監看回波，傳輸光路中某片鏡面的污染會被誤認為鈉層變薄。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the launch telescope defocuses or beam quality degrades, the mesospheric spot grows from 1.2″ to beyond 2″; total return may not fall, but the wavefront-sensor spots grow, centroid noise rises and AO performance drops; monitoring only laser output power without the return lets contamination of a mirror in the transfer path be mistaken for a thinning sodium layer. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光點拉長、質心雜訊與 LGS 波前感測」與「鈉層高度、對焦追蹤與自然星低階感測」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spot elongation, centroid noise and LGS wavefront sensing" and "Sodium altitude, focus tracking and natural-star low-order sensing": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光點拉長、質心雜訊與 LGS 波前感測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Spot elongation, centroid noise and LGS wavefront sensing: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「LGS Shack–Hartmann 子孔徑光點」如何決定天文雷射導引星的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “LGS Shack–Hartmann subaperture spots” determines the key performance of “Astronomical laser guide stars”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鈉層有約 10 km 的厚度，從偏離發射點的子孔徑看過去，雷射光柱在天空上呈一條線段而不是一個點，這種透視拉長與子孔徑到發射點的距離成正比，方向在瞳面上呈放射狀排列。拉長方向的質心雜訊變大；鈉層剖面隨時間改變時光點質心也會位移，被誤讀成波前斜率。因此 LGS 波前感測器需要比自然星感測器更大的子孔徑視場與更多像素，並採用能處理拉長光點的質心演算法。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「LGS Shack–Hartmann 子孔徑光點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, a subaperture displaced from the launch point sees the laser column as a line segment on the sky rather than a point; this perspective elongation grows with the distance between subaperture and launcher and points radially across the pupil. Centroid noise rises along the elongation, and when the sodium profile changes with time the spot centroid moves and is misread as a wavefront slope. LGS wavefront sensors therefore need larger subaperture fields and more pixels than natural-star sensors, together with centroid algorithms that handle elongated spots. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “LGS Shack–Hartmann subaperture spots”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：拉長角 ε ≈ b·ΔH/H²：ΔH = 10 km、H = 90 km，b = 8 m 時 ε ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(8.1×10⁹) rad ≈ 2.0″；b = 40 m（極大望遠鏡外緣子孔徑）時約 10″。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Elongation ε ≈ b·ΔH/H²: with ΔH = 10 km and H = 90 km, b = 8 m gives ε ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(8.1×10⁹) rad ≈ 2.0″, and b = 40 m, an outer subaperture of an extremely large telescope, gives about 10″.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「LGS 光點和自然星一樣是圓點，可以直接沿用自然星的感測器設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "LGS spots are round like natural stars, so natural-star sensor designs carry over unchanged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「LGS Shack–Hartmann 子孔徑光點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “LGS Shack–Hartmann subaperture spots”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光點拉長、質心雜訊與 LGS 波前感測
knowledge.titleEn: Spot elongation, centroid noise and LGS wavefront sensing
knowledge.text: 鈉層有約 10 km 的厚度，從偏離發射點的子孔徑看過去，雷射光柱在天空上呈一條線段而不是一個點，這種透視拉長與子孔徑到發射點的距離成正比，方向在瞳面上呈放射狀排列。拉長方向的質心雜訊變大；鈉層剖面隨時間改變時光點質心也會位移，被誤讀成波前斜率。
knowledge.textEn: Because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, a subaperture displaced from the launch point sees the laser column as a line segment on the sky rather than a point; this perspective elongation grows with the distance between subaperture and launcher and points radially across the pupil. Centroid noise rises along the elongation, and when the sodium profile changes with time the spot centroid moves and is misread as a wavefront slope.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：LGS 光點和自然星一樣是圓點，可以直接沿用自然星的感測器設計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: LGS spots are round like natural stars, so natural-star sensor designs carry over unchanged. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光點拉長、質心雜訊與 LGS 波前感測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spot elongation, centroid noise and LGS wavefront sensing" is correct?
options: LGS 光點和自然星一樣是圓點，可以直接沿用自然星的感測器設計。
LGS 的焦距只隨天頂角改變，鈉層本身的高度是固定的。
鈉層有約 10 km 的厚度，從偏離發射點的子孔徑看過去，雷射光柱在天空上呈一條線段而不是一個點，這種透視拉長與子孔徑到發射點的距離成正比，方向在瞳面上呈放射狀排列。
optionsEn: LGS spots are round like natural stars, so natural-star sensor designs carry over unchanged.
LGS focus changes only with zenith angle; the sodium layer altitude is fixed.
Because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, a subaperture displaced from the launch point sees the laser column as a line segment on the sky rather than a point.
quiz.explanation: 鈉層有約 10 km 的厚度，從偏離發射點的子孔徑看過去，雷射光柱在天空上呈一條線段而不是一個點，這種透視拉長與子孔徑到發射點的距離成正比，方向在瞳面上呈放射狀排列。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Because the sodium layer is about 10 km thick, a subaperture displaced from the launch point sees the laser column as a line segment on the sky rather than a point; this perspective elongation grows with the distance between subaperture and launcher and points radially across the pupil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光點拉長、質心雜訊與 LGS 波前感測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spot elongation, centroid noise and LGS wavefront sensing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「LGS Shack–Hartmann 子孔徑光點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “LGS Shack–Hartmann subaperture spots” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拉長角 ε ≈ b·ΔH/H²：ΔH = 10 km、H = 90 km，b = 8 m 時 ε ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(8.1×10⁹) rad ≈ 2.0″；b = 40 m（極大望遠鏡外緣子孔徑）時約 10″。質心雜訊 σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/√N：N = 600、未拉長 1.2″ 時約 21 mas；拉長方向 2.0″ 約 35 mas；10″ 的光點約 175 mas，需要更多光子或截斷視場。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Elongation ε ≈ b·ΔH/H²: with ΔH = 10 km and H = 90 km, b = 8 m gives ε ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(8.1×10⁹) rad ≈ 2.0″, and b = 40 m, an outer subaperture of an extremely large telescope, gives about 10″. Centroid noise σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/√N with N = 600 is about 21 mas for an unelongated 1.2″ spot, about 35 mas along a 2.0″ elongation, and about 175 mas for a 10″ spot, which demands more photons or a truncated field. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在波前感測器原始影像上量每個子孔徑光點沿放射與切線方向的寬度，對子孔徑到發射點的距離作圖，應呈線性並與鈉層厚度一致；改變每幀光子數，量各方向質心標準差隨 1/√N 的變化；同時把鈉雷射雷達的剖面變化與感測器回報的假離焦或假球差做相關。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On raw wavefront-sensor frames measure each subaperture spot's width along the radial and tangential directions and plot it against distance from the launcher, expecting a linear trend consistent with layer thickness; vary photons per frame and measure how the centroid standard deviation in each direction scales with 1/√N; correlate sodium-lidar profile changes with the false defocus or spherical aberration reported by the sensor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 拉長角 ε ≈ b·ΔH/H²：ΔH = 10 km、H = 90 km，b = 8 m 時 ε ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(8.1×10⁹) rad ≈ 2.0″；b = 40 m（極大望遠鏡外緣子孔徑）時約 10″。質心雜訊 σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/√N：N = 600、未拉長 1.2″ 時約 21 mas；拉長方向 2.0″ 約 35 mas；10″ 的光點約 175 mas，需要更多光子或截斷視場。
knowledge.textEn: Elongation ε ≈ b·ΔH/H²: with ΔH = 10 km and H = 90 km, b = 8 m gives ε ≈ 8 × 10⁴/(8.1×10⁹) rad ≈ 2.0″, and b = 40 m, an outer subaperture of an extremely large telescope, gives about 10″. Centroid noise σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/√N with N = 600 is about 21 mas for an unelongated 1.2″ spot, about 35 mas along a 2.0″ elongation, and about 175 mas for a 10″ spot, which demands more photons or a truncated field.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.title: 光點拉長、質心雜訊與 LGS 波前感測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spot elongation, centroid noise and LGS wavefront sensing: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「LGS Shack–Hartmann 子孔徑光點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “LGS Shack–Hartmann subaperture spots” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在波前感測器原始影像上量每個子孔徑光點沿放射與切線方向的寬度，對子孔徑到發射點的距離作圖，應呈線性並與鈉層厚度一致；改變每幀光子數，量各方向質心標準差隨 1/√N 的變化；同時把鈉雷射雷達的剖面變化與感測器回報的假離焦或假球差做相關。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On raw wavefront-sensor frames measure each subaperture spot's width along the radial and tangential directions and plot it against distance from the launcher, expecting a linear trend consistent with layer thickness; vary photons per frame and measure how the centroid standard deviation in each direction scales with 1/√N; correlate sodium-lidar profile changes with the false defocus or spherical aberration reported by the sensor. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：子孔徑視場太小時，拉長光點被截斷，質心被拉向視場中心，鈉層剖面一變就產生假的波前斜率；這些假訊號在瞳面上呈放射對稱，AO 會當成真實離焦或球差去修正，使科學影像模糊。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With too small a subaperture field the elongated spot is truncated and its centroid pulled towards the field centre, so every change in the sodium profile creates false slopes; these false signals are radially symmetric across the pupil, and the AO corrects them as real defocus or spherical aberration, blurring the science image.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.
