knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偵測器系統誤差與光譜萃取」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Detector systematics and spectral extraction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
管線若未修正拼接誤差，長期資料出現週期一年、振幅約 1 m/s 的訊號，恰與地球公轉同步，容易被誤報為適居帶行星。
重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
An uncorrected stitching error yields a one-year signal of about 1 m/s locked to Earth's orbit, easily misreported as a habitable-zone planet.
Barycentric correction can simply use the exposure start time.
quiz.explanation: 管線若未修正拼接誤差，長期資料出現週期一年、振幅約 1 m/s 的訊號，恰與地球公轉同步，容易被誤報為適居帶行星；更換 CCD 控制器時序後 CTE 改變，前後資料出現無法解釋的零點偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An uncorrected stitching error yields a one-year signal of about 1 m/s locked to Earth's orbit, easily misreported as a habitable-zone planet; changing the CCD controller timing alters CTE and leaves an unexplained zero-point offset between data taken before and after. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」如何決定天文高解析光譜儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards” determines the key performance of “High-resolution astronomical spectrographs”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量到的速度包含地球自轉與公轉，必須修正到太陽系重心，而修正要用曝光期間光通量加權的中點時間，不是幾何中點；雲層或導星變化會讓兩者不同。曝光計在光譜儀內分出一小部分光，記錄通量隨時間的變化以求出加權時間。最後以多顆長期穩定的 RV 標準星、太陽光與校正源夜間漂移紀錄驗收整機，並把光纖組、溫控設定、校正序列與管線版本寫入交接文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measured velocities contain Earth's rotation and orbital motion and must be corrected to the solar-system barycentre using the flux-weighted midpoint of the exposure rather than its geometric midpoint, since clouds or guiding changes make the two differ. An exposure meter picks off a small fraction of the light inside the spectrograph and records flux versus time to obtain that weighted time. Final acceptance uses several long-term RV-stable standards, sunlight and nightly calibration-drift records, and the handoff document fixes the fibre link, thermal set points, calibration sequence and pipeline version. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²；15 分鐘曝光的加權中點若誤差 60 s，RV 誤差最大 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²; a 60 s error in the flux-weighted midpoint of a 15-minute exposure gives up to 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Barycentric correction can simply use the exposure start time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff
knowledge.text: 量到的速度包含地球自轉與公轉，必須修正到太陽系重心，而修正要用曝光期間光通量加權的中點時間，不是幾何中點；雲層或導星變化會讓兩者不同。曝光計在光譜儀內分出一小部分光，記錄通量隨時間的變化以求出加權時間。
knowledge.textEn: Measured velocities contain Earth's rotation and orbital motion and must be corrected to the solar-system barycentre using the flux-weighted midpoint of the exposure rather than its geometric midpoint, since clouds or guiding changes make the two differ. An exposure meter picks off a small fraction of the light inside the spectrograph and records flux versus time to obtain that weighted time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Barycentric correction can simply use the exposure start time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff" is correct?
options: 重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。
解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。
量到的速度包含地球自轉與公轉，必須修正到太陽系重心，而修正要用曝光期間光通量加權的中點時間，不是幾何中點；雲層或導星變化會讓兩者不同。
optionsEn: Barycentric correction can simply use the exposure start time.
Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count.

Measured velocities contain Earth's rotation and orbital motion and must be corrected to the solar-system barycentre using the flux-weighted midpoint of the exposure rather than its geometric midpoint, since clouds or guiding changes make the two differ.
quiz.explanation: 量到的速度包含地球自轉與公轉，必須修正到太陽系重心，而修正要用曝光期間光通量加權的中點時間，不是幾何中點；雲層或導星變化會讓兩者不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measured velocities contain Earth's rotation and orbital motion and must be corrected to the solar-system barycentre using the flux-weighted midpoint of the exposure rather than its geometric midpoint, since clouds or guiding changes make the two differ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²；15 分鐘曝光的加權中點若誤差 60 s，RV 誤差最大 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s。公轉加速度 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s²，同樣 60 s 只造成 0.36 m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²; a 60 s error in the flux-weighted midpoint of a 15-minute exposure gives up to 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s. The orbital acceleration 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s² adds only 0.36 m/s for the same 60 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s；三顆以上 RV 標準星每晚多次曝光，扣除光子雜訊後殘差小於 0.5 m/s；以獨立程式重算重心修正並比對到 1 cm/s；記錄真空度、溫度、光纖組號、韌體與管線版本，任何更動後都重做零點比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s; three or more RV standards observed several times nightly with residuals after photon noise below 0.5 m/s; barycentric corrections recomputed with independent code and matched to 1 cm/s; vacuum, temperatures, fibre-link ID, firmware and pipeline version logged, with a zero-point comparison repeated after any change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²；15 分鐘曝光的加權中點若誤差 60 s，RV 誤差最大 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s。公轉加速度 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s²，同樣 60 s 只造成 0.36 m/s。
knowledge.textEn: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²; a 60 s error in the flux-weighted midpoint of a 15-minute exposure gives up to 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s. The orbital acceleration 2π×29 780/(3.156×10⁷ s) ≈ 5.9×10⁻³ m/s² adds only 0.36 m/s for the same 60 s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²。
光纖只是傳光線，對 RV 精度沒有影響。
ThAr 譜線夠多就能精準校正，不需要其他光源。
optionsEn: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s².
A fibre only carries light and has no effect on RV precision.
Enough ThAr lines alone give precise calibration without any other source.
quiz.explanation: 在 La Silla（緯度 −29.26°）地球自轉速度 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s，其方向變化率 Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²；15 分鐘曝光的加權中點若誤差 60 s，RV 誤差最大 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At La Silla, latitude −29.26°, Earth's rotation speed is 465×cos29.26° ≈ 406 m/s and its direction turns at Ω·v = 7.29×10⁻⁵×406 ≈ 0.030 m/s²; a 60 s error in the flux-weighted midpoint of a 15-minute exposure gives up to 0.030×60 ≈ 1.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s；三顆以上 RV 標準星每晚多次曝光，扣除光子雜訊後殘差小於 0.5 m/s；以獨立程式重算重心修正並比對到 1 cm/s；記錄真空度、溫度、光纖組號、韌體與管線版本，任何更動後都重做零點比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s; three or more RV standards observed several times nightly with residuals after photon noise below 0.5 m/s; barycentric corrections recomputed with independent code and matched to 1 cm/s; vacuum, temperatures, fibre-link ID, firmware and pipeline version logged, with a zero-point comparison repeated after any change. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開；曝光計失效時改用幾何中點，雲天資料在高時角出現 m/s 級的額外散佈。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals; when the exposure meter fails and the geometric midpoint is used instead, cloudy-night data at high hour angle gain extra m/s-level scatter.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s；三顆以上 RV 標準星每晚多次曝光，扣除光子雜訊後殘差小於 0.5 m/s；以獨立程式重算重心修正並比對到 1 cm/s；記錄真空度、溫度、光纖組號、韌體與管線版本，任何更動後都重做零點比對。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s; three or more RV standards observed several times nightly with residuals after photon noise below 0.5 m/s; barycentric corrections recomputed with independent code and matched to 1 cm/s; vacuum, temperatures, fibre-link ID, firmware and pipeline version logged, with a zero-point comparison repeated after any change.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s。
曝光時間一直加倍，RV 誤差就會無限下降。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s.
Doubling the exposure time keeps reducing RV error without limit.
quiz.explanation: 驗收程序：連續 10 晚每晚取 ThAr 與標準具序列，日內漂移小於 1 m/s；三顆以上 RV 標準星每晚多次曝光，扣除光子雜訊後殘差小於 0.5 m/s；以獨立程式重算重心修正並比對到 1 cm/s；記錄真空度、溫度、光纖組號、韌體與管線版本，任何更動後都重做零點比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance: ThAr and etalon sequences on 10 consecutive nights with intra-night drift below 1 m/s; three or more RV standards observed several times nightly with residuals after photon noise below 0.5 m/s; barycentric corrections recomputed with independent code and matched to 1 cm/s; vacuum, temperatures, fibre-link ID, firmware and pipeline version logged, with a zero-point comparison repeated after any change. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開；曝光計失效時改用幾何中點，雲天資料在高時角出現 m/s 級的額外散佈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals; when the exposure meter fails and the geometric midpoint is used instead, cloudy-night data at high hour angle gain extra m/s-level scatter. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：最後以多顆長期穩定的 RV 標準星、太陽光與校正源夜間漂移紀錄驗收整機，並把光纖組、溫控設定、校正序列與管線版本寫入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Final acceptance uses several long-term RV-stable standards, sunlight and nightly calibration-drift records, and the handoff document fixes the fibre link, thermal set points, calibration sequence and pipeline version.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重心修正只要用曝光開始時間計算即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Barycentric correction can simply use the exposure start time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開；曝光計失效時改用幾何中點，雲天資料在高時角出現 m/s 級的額外散佈。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals; when the exposure meter fails and the geometric midpoint is used instead, cloudy-night data at high hour angle gain extra m/s-level scatter.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
解析力越高，RV 精度一定越好，不必考慮光子數。
更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Higher resolving power always improves RV precision regardless of photon count.

Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals.
quiz.explanation: 更換光纖組或校正源後若沒有用標準星重建零點，資料集出現數 m/s 的階梯偏移，與既有行星訊號混在一起要多年才能拆開；曝光計失效時改用幾何中點，雲天資料在高時角出現 m/s 級的額外散佈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing the fibre link or calibration source without re-establishing the zero point on standard stars leaves a step of several m/s in the dataset that takes years to disentangle from planet signals; when the exposure meter fails and the geometric midpoint is used instead, cloudy-night data at high hour angle gain extra m/s-level scatter. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 天文干涉儀光程控制
summary: 以 ESO VLTI（GRAVITY，四台望遠鏡、K 波段）與 CHARA 陣列（六台 1 m 望遠鏡、331 m 基線）為對象，從相干長度與地球自轉造成的光程差變化出發，建立延遲線機構、雷射計量、條紋追蹤、可見度校正與天體測量誤差預算的完整工程鏈。
summaryEn: Using the ESO VLTI with GRAVITY (four telescopes, K band) and the CHARA Array (six 1 m telescopes, 331 m baseline) as the reference instruments, the course starts from coherence length and the Earth-rotation delay rate and builds the full engineering chain of delay-line mechanics, laser metrology, fringe tracking, visibility calibration and astrometric error budgets.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 光程控制練習：假設 VLTI 基線 B = 130 m、K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm、Δλ = 0.4 µm。相干長度 L_c = λ²/Δλ = 12.1 µm；地球自轉造成的最大延遲率 ω_E·B = 7.29e−5×130 = 9.5 mm/s，1 kHz 迴路每週期改變 9.5 µm。若 0.5 µm 的 τ₀ = 3 ms，K 波段 τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 = 17.8 ms；迴路延遲 3 ms 時 σ_φ² = (3/17.8)^(5/3) = 0.052 rad²，殘餘光程差 ≈ 0.23×2.2/(2π) µm ≈ 80 nm，條紋對比因子 exp(−0.026) ≈ 0.97。要達到 10 µas 天體測量，差分光程需量到 4.85e−11×130 m = 6.3 nm；若每秒雜訊 50 nm，1800 s 平均後 1.2 nm，統計上足夠，但基線誤差 1 mm 仍留下 7.7 µas 的系統下限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Path-control exercise: assume a VLTI baseline B = 130 m, K band λ = 2.2 µm, Δλ = 0.4 µm. Coherence length L_c = λ²/Δλ = 12.1 µm; the maximum Earth-rotation delay rate ω_E·B = 7.29e−5×130 = 9.5 mm/s, so a 1 kHz loop sees 9.5 µm per cycle. If τ₀ = 3 ms at 0.5 µm, the K-band τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 = 17.8 ms; with a 3 ms loop latency σ_φ² = (3/17.8)^(5/3) = 0.052 rad², the residual OPD ≈ 0.23×2.2/(2π) µm ≈ 80 nm and the contrast factor exp(−0.026) ≈ 0.97. For 10 µas astrometry the differential OPD must be measured to 4.85e−11×130 m = 6.3 nm; with 50 nm per-second noise, 1800 s of averaging gives 1.2 nm, statistically sufficient, but a 1 mm baseline error still leaves a 7.7 µas systematic floor. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」與「頻寬、相干長度與零光程差」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution" and "Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「基線向量與幾何延遲」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Baseline vector and geometric delay” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩台相距基線 B 的望遠鏡接收同一顆星的光，星光到達兩鏡的時間差對應幾何光程差 D = B·ŝ，其中 ŝ 是指向天體的單位向量；只有把這段光程差補償到遠小於相干長度，兩道光才能在合成實驗室裡形成干涉條紋。條紋的角週期為 λ/B，因此干涉儀的角解析度由基線而非單鏡口徑決定；條紋對比（可見度）則依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理等於天體亮度分佈在空間頻率 B/λ 上的傅立葉分量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基線向量與幾何延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two telescopes separated by baseline B receive the same starlight, and the arrival-time difference corresponds to a geometric path difference D = B·ŝ, with ŝ the unit vector toward the object; only when this difference is compensated to far less than the coherence length do the two beams form fringes in the combination laboratory. The angular fringe period is λ/B, so the resolution is set by the baseline rather than the single-aperture diameter, and by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem the fringe contrast (visibility) equals the Fourier component of the brightness distribution at spatial frequency B/λ. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Baseline vector and geometric delay”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas；CHARA 在 331 m 基線、λ = 0.55 µm 時 λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「基線向量與幾何延遲」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Baseline vector and geometric delay”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度
knowledge.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution
knowledge.text: 兩台相距基線 B 的望遠鏡接收同一顆星的光，星光到達兩鏡的時間差對應幾何光程差 D = B·ŝ，其中 ŝ 是指向天體的單位向量；只有把這段光程差補償到遠小於相干長度，兩道光才能在合成實驗室裡形成干涉條紋。條紋的角週期為 λ/B，因此干涉儀的角解析度由基線而非單鏡口徑決定；條紋對比（可見度）則依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理等於天體亮度分佈在空間頻率 B/λ 上的傅立葉分量。
knowledge.textEn: Two telescopes separated by baseline B receive the same starlight, and the arrival-time difference corresponds to a geometric path difference D = B·ŝ, with ŝ the unit vector toward the object; only when this difference is compensated to far less than the coherence length do the two beams form fringes in the combination laboratory. The angular fringe period is λ/B, so the resolution is set by the baseline rather than the single-aperture diameter, and by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem the fringe contrast (visibility) equals the Fourier component of the brightness distribution at spatial frequency B/λ.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution" is correct?
options: 干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。
兩台相距基線 B 的望遠鏡接收同一顆星的光，星光到達兩鏡的時間差對應幾何光程差 D = B·ŝ，其中 ŝ 是指向天體的單位向量。
頻寬越寬收到的光越多，所以條紋總是越容易找到。
optionsEn: An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity.
Two telescopes separated by baseline B receive the same starlight, and the arrival-time difference corresponds to a geometric path difference D = B·ŝ, with ŝ the unit vector toward the object.
A wider bandwidth collects more light, so fringes are always easier to find.
quiz.explanation: 兩台相距基線 B 的望遠鏡接收同一顆星的光，星光到達兩鏡的時間差對應幾何光程差 D = B·ŝ，其中 ŝ 是指向天體的單位向量；只有把這段光程差補償到遠小於相干長度，兩道光才能在合成實驗室裡形成干涉條紋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two telescopes separated by baseline B receive the same starlight, and the arrival-time difference corresponds to a geometric path difference D = B·ŝ, with ŝ the unit vector toward the object; only when this difference is compensated to far less than the coherence length do the two beams form fringes in the combination laboratory. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基線向量與幾何延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Baseline vector and geometric delay” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas；CHARA 在 331 m 基線、λ = 0.55 µm 時 λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas。若星在離基線法線 30° 的方向，130 m 基線的幾何延遲為 130·sin30° = 65 m，必須由延遲線補償。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas. CHARA with a 331 m baseline at λ = 0.55 µm reaches λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas. For a star 30° from the baseline normal, the geometric delay on the 130 m baseline is 130·sin30° = 65 m, which the delay lines must compensate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較；同時用條紋的角週期反推有效基線長度，與測地量測的基線向量比對到毫米等級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ; also back out the effective baseline from the fringe angular period and compare with the surveyed baseline vector at the millimetre level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas；CHARA 在 331 m 基線、λ = 0.55 µm 時 λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas。若星在離基線法線 30° 的方向，130 m 基線的幾何延遲為 130·sin30° = 65 m，必須由延遲線補償。
knowledge.textEn: The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas. CHARA with a 331 m baseline at λ = 0.55 µm reaches λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas. For a star 30° from the baseline normal, the geometric delay on the 130 m baseline is 130·sin30° = 65 m, which the delay lines must compensate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution", which statement holds?
options: 真空光管只是為了防塵，光在空氣中傳輸對干涉沒有影響。
只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。
VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas。
optionsEn: Vacuum pipes only keep dust out; propagating in air does not affect the interference.
Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility.
The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas.
quiz.explanation: VLTI 四台 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的最長基線約 130 m，在 K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm 時 λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas；CHARA 在 331 m 基線、λ = 0.55 µm 時 λ/(2B) ≈ 0.17 mas。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The longest VLTI baseline between the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes is about 130 m; at λ = 2.2 µm in the K band, λ/B = 2.2e−6/130 = 1.69e−8 rad ≈ 3.5 mas. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「基線向量與幾何延遲」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Baseline vector and geometric delay” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較；同時用條紋的角週期反推有效基線長度，與測地量測的基線向量比對到毫米等級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ; also back out the effective baseline from the fringe angular period and compare with the surveyed baseline vector at the millimetre level. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：基線向量若有毫米級誤差，計算出的幾何延遲會隨時角漂移，延遲線追到錯誤位置，條紋在幾分鐘內移出相干包絡並消失；若誤差較小而未被發現，則轉成天體測量的系統偏差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A millimetre-level error in the baseline vector makes the computed geometric delay drift with hour angle, the delay line tracks to the wrong position, and the fringes walk out of the coherence envelope within minutes; a smaller unnoticed error becomes a systematic astrometric bias.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較；同時用條紋的角週期反推有效基線長度，與測地量測的基線向量比對到毫米等級。
knowledge.textEn: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ; also back out the effective baseline from the fringe angular period and compare with the surveyed baseline vector at the millimetre level.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution"?
options: 觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
閉合相位可以消除所有系統誤差，所以不需要觀測校正星。
optionsEn: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Closure phase removes all systematic errors, so calibrator stars are unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 觀測一顆直徑已知的校正星，量測條紋可見度隨投影基線的變化，與均勻圓盤模型 V = 2J₁(x)/x、x = πθB/λ 比較；同時用條紋的角週期反推有效基線長度，與測地量測的基線向量比對到毫米等級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe a calibrator star of known diameter, measure fringe visibility against projected baseline and compare with the uniform-disk model V = 2J₁(x)/x with x = πθB/λ; also back out the effective baseline from the fringe angular period and compare with the surveyed baseline vector at the millimetre level. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 基線、幾何延遲與角解析度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基線向量與幾何延遲」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Baseline vector and geometric delay” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 基線向量若有毫米級誤差，計算出的幾何延遲會隨時角漂移，延遲線追到錯誤位置，條紋在幾分鐘內移出相干包絡並消失；若誤差較小而未被發現，則轉成天體測量的系統偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A millimetre-level error in the baseline vector makes the computed geometric delay drift with hour angle, the delay line tracks to the wrong position, and the fringes walk out of the coherence envelope within minutes; a smaller unnoticed error becomes a systematic astrometric bias. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：條紋的角週期為 λ/B，因此干涉儀的角解析度由基線而非單鏡口徑決定；條紋對比（可見度）則依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理等於天體亮度分佈在空間頻率 B/λ 上的傅立葉分量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The angular fringe period is λ/B, so the resolution is set by the baseline rather than the single-aperture diameter, and by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem the fringe contrast (visibility) equals the Fourier component of the brightness distribution at spatial frequency B/λ.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基線向量若有毫米級誤差，計算出的幾何延遲會隨時角漂移，延遲線追到錯誤位置，條紋在幾分鐘內移出相干包絡並消失；若誤差較小而未被發現，則轉成天體測量的系統偏差。
knowledge.textEn: A millimetre-level error in the baseline vector makes the computed geometric delay drift with hour angle, the delay line tracks to the wrong position, and the fringes walk out of the coherence envelope within minutes; a smaller unnoticed error becomes a systematic astrometric bias.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基線、幾何延遲與角解析度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Baseline, geometric delay and angular resolution" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
基線向量若有毫米級誤差，計算出的幾何延遲會隨時角漂移，延遲線追到錯誤位置，條紋在幾分鐘內移出相干包絡並消失；若誤差較小而未被發現，則轉成天體測量的系統偏差。
頻寬越寬收到的光越多，所以條紋總是越容易找到。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

A millimetre-level error in the baseline vector makes the computed geometric delay drift with hour angle, the delay line tracks to the wrong position, and the fringes walk out of the coherence envelope within minutes.
A wider bandwidth collects more light, so fringes are always easier to find.

quiz.explanationEn: A millimetre-level error in the baseline vector makes the computed geometric delay drift with hour angle, the delay line tracks to the wrong position, and the fringes walk out of the coherence envelope within minutes; a smaller unnoticed error becomes a systematic astrometric bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 頻寬、相干長度與零光程差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「相干長度與條紋包絡」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coherence length and fringe envelope” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 寬頻光的干涉條紋被一個包絡調制，包絡寬度就是相干長度 L_c = λ²/Δλ；光程差超出 ±L_c/2 左右條紋對比便迅速下降，因此延遲線不只要補償幾何延遲，還必須找到並停留在零光程差附近。大氣活塞項（piston）讓這個點隨機抖動數微米，而延遲線隧道中的空氣色散會讓不同波長的零光程差位置分開，把條紋包絡拉長並降低對比；CHARA 為此把望遠鏡到實驗室的光路放在真空管內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相干長度與條紋包絡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Broadband fringes are modulated by an envelope whose width is the coherence length L_c = λ²/Δλ; contrast collapses once the OPD leaves roughly ±L_c/2, so the delay line must not only compensate the geometric delay but find and hold the zero-OPD point. Atmospheric piston jitters that point by several micrometres, and air dispersion in the delay tunnel separates the zero-OPD positions of different wavelengths, stretching the packet and lowering contrast; CHARA therefore carries the telescope-to-laboratory beams in vacuum pipes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coherence length and fringe envelope”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm、Δλ = 0.4 µm（2.0–2.4 µm）時 L_c = 2.2²/0.4 = 12.1 µm；若條紋追蹤器以光譜解析度 R ≈ 22 工作，Δλ = 0.1 µm，L_c 擴大到 48 µm，較容易捕捉條紋。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In the K band with λ = 2.2 µm and Δλ = 0.4 µm (2.0–2.4 µm), L_c = 2.2²/0.4 = 12.1 µm; a fringe tracker working at spectral resolution R ≈ 22 has Δλ = 0.1 µm and L_c = 48 µm, which makes fringe acquisition easier.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頻寬越寬收到的光越多，所以條紋總是越容易找到。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A wider bandwidth collects more light, so fringes are always easier to find." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「相干長度與條紋包絡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Coherence length and fringe envelope”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頻寬、相干長度與零光程差
knowledge.titleEn: Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD
knowledge.text: 寬頻光的干涉條紋被一個包絡調制，包絡寬度就是相干長度 L_c = λ²/Δλ；光程差超出 ±L_c/2 左右條紋對比便迅速下降，因此延遲線不只要補償幾何延遲，還必須找到並停留在零光程差附近。大氣活塞項（piston）讓這個點隨機抖動數微米，而延遲線隧道中的空氣色散會讓不同波長的零光程差位置分開，把條紋包絡拉長並降低對比；CHARA 為此把望遠鏡到實驗室的光路放在真空管內。

Atmospheric piston jitters that point by several micrometres, and air dispersion in the delay tunnel separates the zero-OPD positions of different wavelengths, stretching the packet and lowering contrast; CHARA therefore carries the telescope-to-laboratory beams in vacuum pipes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頻寬越寬收到的光越多，所以條紋總是越容易找到。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A wider bandwidth collects more light, so fringes are always easier to find. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頻寬、相干長度與零光程差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD" is correct?
options: 頻寬越寬收到的光越多，所以條紋總是越容易找到。
台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。
寬頻光的干涉條紋被一個包絡調制，包絡寬度就是相干長度 L_c = λ²/Δλ。
optionsEn: A wider bandwidth collects more light, so fringes are always easier to find.
Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide.
Broadband fringes are modulated by an envelope whose width is the coherence length L_c = λ²/Δλ.
quiz.explanation: 寬頻光的干涉條紋被一個包絡調制，包絡寬度就是相干長度 L_c = λ²/Δλ；光程差超出 ±L_c/2 左右條紋對比便迅速下降，因此延遲線不只要補償幾何延遲，還必須找到並停留在零光程差附近。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Broadband fringes are modulated by an envelope whose width is the coherence length L_c = λ²/Δλ; contrast collapses once the OPD leaves roughly ±L_c/2, so the delay line must not only compensate the geometric delay but find and hold the zero-OPD point. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頻寬、相干長度與零光程差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相干長度與條紋包絡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coherence length and fringe envelope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm、Δλ = 0.4 µm（2.0–2.4 µm）時 L_c = 2.2²/0.4 = 12.1 µm；若條紋追蹤器以光譜解析度 R ≈ 22 工作，Δλ = 0.1 µm，L_c 擴大到 48 µm，較容易捕捉條紋。可見光 λ = 0.7 µm、Δλ = 0.1 µm 時 L_c 僅 4.9 µm，對延遲線精度的要求更嚴。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In the K band with λ = 2.2 µm and Δλ = 0.4 µm (2.0–2.4 µm), L_c = 2.2²/0.4 = 12.1 µm; a fringe tracker working at spectral resolution R ≈ 22 has Δλ = 0.1 µm and L_c = 48 µm, which makes fringe acquisition easier. In the visible with λ = 0.7 µm and Δλ = 0.1 µm, L_c is only 4.9 µm, a far tighter delay-line requirement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以延遲線慢速掃過零光程差並記錄條紋包絡，量包絡的半高寬，與濾光片頻寬算出的 λ²/Δλ 比較；若包絡明顯比預測寬或呈不對稱的啁啾，表示縱向色散未補償，應調整色散補償器後重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the delay line slowly through zero OPD while recording the fringe packet, measure its full width at half maximum and compare with λ²/Δλ from the filter bandwidth; an envelope clearly wider than predicted, or an asymmetric chirp, indicates uncorrected longitudinal dispersion that must be removed with the dispersion compensator and re-measured.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm、Δλ = 0.4 µm（2.0–2.4 µm）時 L_c = 2.2²/0.4 = 12.1 µm；若條紋追蹤器以光譜解析度 R ≈ 22 工作，Δλ = 0.1 µm，L_c 擴大到 48 µm，較容易捕捉條紋。可見光 λ = 0.7 µm、Δλ = 0.1 µm 時 L_c 僅 4.9 µm，對延遲線精度的要求更嚴。
knowledge.textEn: In the K band with λ = 2.2 µm and Δλ = 0.4 µm (2.0–2.4 µm), L_c = 2.2²/0.4 = 12.1 µm; a fringe tracker working at spectral resolution R ≈ 22 has Δλ = 0.1 µm and L_c = 48 µm, which makes fringe acquisition easier. In the visible with λ = 0.7 µm and Δλ = 0.1 µm, L_c is only 4.9 µm, a far tighter delay-line requirement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「頻寬、相干長度與零光程差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD", which statement holds?
options: 各望遠鏡的自適應光學已修正波前，所以不需要再做條紋追蹤。
閉合相位可以消除所有系統誤差，所以不需要觀測校正星。
optionsEn: In the K band with λ = 2.2 µm and Δλ = 0.4 µm (2.0–2.4 µm), L_c = 2.2²/0.4 = 12.1 µm.
Each telescope's adaptive optics already corrects the wavefront, so fringe tracking is unnecessary.
Closure phase removes all systematic errors, so calibrator stars are unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: K 波段 λ = 2.2 µm、Δλ = 0.4 µm（2.0–2.4 µm）時 L_c = 2.2²/0.4 = 12.1 µm；若條紋追蹤器以光譜解析度 R ≈ 22 工作，Δλ = 0.1 µm，L_c 擴大到 48 µm，較容易捕捉條紋。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: In the K band with λ = 2.2 µm and Δλ = 0.4 µm (2.0–2.4 µm), L_c = 2.2²/0.4 = 12.1 µm; a fringe tracker working at spectral resolution R ≈ 22 has Δλ = 0.1 µm and L_c = 48 µm, which makes fringe acquisition easier. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頻寬、相干長度與零光程差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「相干長度與條紋包絡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Coherence length and fringe envelope” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以延遲線慢速掃過零光程差並記錄條紋包絡，量包絡的半高寬，與濾光片頻寬算出的 λ²/Δλ 比較；若包絡明顯比預測寬或呈不對稱的啁啾，表示縱向色散未補償，應調整色散補償器後重測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the delay line slowly through zero OPD while recording the fringe packet, measure its full width at half maximum and compare with λ²/Δλ from the filter bandwidth; an envelope clearly wider than predicted, or an asymmetric chirp, indicates uncorrected longitudinal dispersion that must be removed with the dispersion compensator and re-measured. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在空氣中跑數十公尺不等長光路而不補償色散時，紅端與藍端的零光程差相差數十微米，寬頻條紋對比掉到幾成，弱星根本鎖不住條紋。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Running tens of metres of unequal path in air without dispersion compensation separates the red and blue zero-OPD points by tens of micrometres, broadband fringe contrast falls to a fraction, and faint stars cannot be locked at all.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以延遲線慢速掃過零光程差並記錄條紋包絡，量包絡的半高寬，與濾光片頻寬算出的 λ²/Δλ 比較；若包絡明顯比預測寬或呈不對稱的啁啾，表示縱向色散未補償，應調整色散補償器後重測。
knowledge.textEn: Scan the delay line slowly through zero OPD while recording the fringe packet, measure its full width at half maximum and compare with λ²/Δλ from the filter bandwidth; an envelope clearly wider than predicted, or an asymmetric chirp, indicates uncorrected longitudinal dispersion that must be removed with the dispersion compensator and re-measured.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頻寬、相干長度與零光程差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以延遲線慢速掃過零光程差並記錄條紋包絡，量包絡的半高寬，與濾光片頻寬算出的 λ²/Δλ 比較。
延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Scan the delay line slowly through zero OPD while recording the fringe packet, measure its full width at half maximum and compare with λ²/Δλ from the filter bandwidth.
If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance.
quiz.explanation: 以延遲線慢速掃過零光程差並記錄條紋包絡，量包絡的半高寬，與濾光片頻寬算出的 λ²/Δλ 比較；若包絡明顯比預測寬或呈不對稱的啁啾，表示縱向色散未補償，應調整色散補償器後重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Scan the delay line slowly through zero OPD while recording the fringe packet, measure its full width at half maximum and compare with λ²/Δλ from the filter bandwidth; an envelope clearly wider than predicted, or an asymmetric chirp, indicates uncorrected longitudinal dispersion that must be removed with the dispersion compensator and re-measured. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 頻寬、相干長度與零光程差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相干長度與條紋包絡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Coherence length and fringe envelope” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在空氣中跑數十公尺不等長光路而不補償色散時，紅端與藍端的零光程差相差數十微米，寬頻條紋對比掉到幾成，弱星根本鎖不住條紋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Running tens of metres of unequal path in air without dispersion compensation separates the red and blue zero-OPD points by tens of micrometres, broadband fringe contrast falls to a fraction, and faint stars cannot be locked at all. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大氣活塞項（piston）讓這個點隨機抖動數微米，而延遲線隧道中的空氣色散會讓不同波長的零光程差位置分開，把條紋包絡拉長並降低對比；CHARA 為此把望遠鏡到實驗室的光路放在真空管內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Atmospheric piston jitters that point by several micrometres, and air dispersion in the delay tunnel separates the zero-OPD positions of different wavelengths, stretching the packet and lowering contrast; CHARA therefore carries the telescope-to-laboratory beams in vacuum pipes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頻寬越寬收到的光越多，所以條紋總是越容易找到。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A wider bandwidth collects more light, so fringes are always easier to find." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在空氣中跑數十公尺不等長光路而不補償色散時，紅端與藍端的零光程差相差數十微米，寬頻條紋對比掉到幾成，弱星根本鎖不住條紋。
knowledge.textEn: Running tens of metres of unequal path in air without dispersion compensation separates the red and blue zero-OPD points by tens of micrometres, broadband fringe contrast falls to a fraction, and faint stars cannot be locked at all.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頻寬、相干長度與零光程差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bandwidth, coherence length and zero OPD" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。
在空氣中跑數十公尺不等長光路而不補償色散時，紅端與藍端的零光程差相差數十微米，寬頻條紋對比掉到幾成，弱星根本鎖不住條紋。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide.

Running tens of metres of unequal path in air without dispersion compensation separates the red and blue zero-OPD points by tens of micrometres, broadband fringe contrast falls to a fraction, and faint stars cannot be locked at all.

quiz.explanationEn: Running tens of metres of unequal path in air without dispersion compensation separates the red and blue zero-OPD points by tens of micrometres, broadband fringe contrast falls to a fraction, and faint stars cannot be locked at all. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「延遲線機構與地球自轉延遲率」與「內部計量、空氣折射率與真空傳輸」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Delay-line mechanics and the Earth-rotation delay rate" and "Internal metrology, air refractive index and vacuum transport": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 延遲線機構與地球自轉延遲率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Delay-line mechanics and the Earth-rotation delay rate: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「延遲線台車與貓眼反射鏡」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delay-line carriage and cat's-eye retroreflector” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VLTI 的延遲線是沿隧道軌道行走的台車，上面裝著貓眼式反射鏡，光束來回兩次，所以台車走 60 m 可補償 120 m 的光程差；粗動由輪驅台車負責，細動由貓眼次鏡上的壓電致動器負責，兩者由雷射計量閉迴路串接。因為地球自轉，幾何延遲以 dD/dt = ω_E·B·cosθ 的速率連續變化，台車必須以毫米每秒等級平滑追蹤，而不是定點停住。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「延遲線台車與貓眼反射鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A VLTI delay line is a carriage running on rails in the tunnel carrying a cat's-eye retroreflector; the beam passes twice, so 60 m of carriage travel compensates 120 m of OPD. Coarse motion is the wheel-driven carriage, fine motion is a piezo actuator on the cat's-eye secondary, and both are closed through the laser metrology. Because the Earth rotates, the geometric delay changes continuously at dD/dt = ω_E·B·cosθ, so the carriage must track smoothly at millimetres per second rather than park at a point. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Delay-line carriage and cat's-eye retroreflector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s；B = 130 m 時最大延遲率 ω_E·B = 9.5 mm/s，CHARA 331 m 基線則達 24 mm/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s and B = 130 m, the maximum delay rate ω_E·B is 9.5 mm/s, and the 331 m CHARA baseline reaches 24 mm/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「延遲線台車與貓眼反射鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Delay-line carriage and cat's-eye retroreflector”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 延遲線機構與地球自轉延遲率
knowledge.titleEn: Delay-line mechanics and the Earth-rotation delay rate
knowledge.text: VLTI 的延遲線是沿隧道軌道行走的台車，上面裝著貓眼式反射鏡，光束來回兩次，所以台車走 60 m 可補償 120 m 的光程差；粗動由輪驅台車負責，細動由貓眼次鏡上的壓電致動器負責，兩者由雷射計量閉迴路串接。因為地球自轉，幾何延遲以 dD/dt = ω_E·B·cosθ 的速率連續變化，台車必須以毫米每秒等級平滑追蹤，而不是定點停住。
knowledge.textEn: A VLTI delay line is a carriage running on rails in the tunnel carrying a cat's-eye retroreflector; the beam passes twice, so 60 m of carriage travel compensates 120 m of OPD. Coarse motion is the wheel-driven carriage, fine motion is a piezo actuator on the cat's-eye secondary, and both are closed through the laser metrology.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「延遲線機構與地球自轉延遲率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Delay-line mechanics and the Earth-rotation delay rate" is correct?
options: VLTI 的延遲線是沿隧道軌道行走的台車，上面裝著貓眼式反射鏡，光束來回兩次，所以台車走 60 m 可補償 120 m 的光程差。
台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。
真空光管只是為了防塵，光在空氣中傳輸對干涉沒有影響。
optionsEn: A VLTI delay line is a carriage running on rails in the tunnel carrying a cat's-eye retroreflector.
Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide.
Vacuum pipes only keep dust out; propagating in air does not affect the interference.
quiz.explanation: VLTI 的延遲線是沿隧道軌道行走的台車，上面裝著貓眼式反射鏡，光束來回兩次，所以台車走 60 m 可補償 120 m 的光程差；粗動由輪驅台車負責，細動由貓眼次鏡上的壓電致動器負責，兩者由雷射計量閉迴路串接。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A VLTI delay line is a carriage running on rails in the tunnel carrying a cat's-eye retroreflector; the beam passes twice, so 60 m of carriage travel compensates 120 m of OPD. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 延遲線機構與地球自轉延遲率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delay-line mechanics and the Earth-rotation delay rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「延遲線台車與貓眼反射鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delay-line carriage and cat's-eye retroreflector” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s；B = 130 m 時最大延遲率 ω_E·B = 9.5 mm/s，CHARA 331 m 基線則達 24 mm/s。以 1 kHz 控制迴路計算，每個週期光程差改變 9.5 µm，約等於整個 K 波段相干長度，因此必須由細動級吸收量化誤差；貓眼雙程設計讓台車速度只需 4.7 mm/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s and B = 130 m, the maximum delay rate ω_E·B is 9.5 mm/s, and the 331 m CHARA baseline reaches 24 mm/s. At a 1 kHz loop rate the OPD changes 9.5 µm per cycle, about one K-band coherence length, so the fine stage must absorb the quantisation; the double-pass cat's eye means the carriage itself only moves at 4.7 mm/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：命令延遲線以固定速度（例如 5 mm/s）行走，用雷射計量記錄位置，扣除理想軌跡後計算 1 s 視窗內的殘差均方根與速度漣波頻譜；殘差應落在數十奈米內，漣波頻率應對應輪徑與軌道接縫的空間週期。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Command the delay line at a constant velocity (for example 5 mm/s), log the laser-metrology position, subtract the ideal trajectory and compute the residual rms in 1 s windows plus the velocity-ripple spectrum; the residual should sit within tens of nanometres and any ripple frequency should match the wheel circumference or rail-joint spacing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s；B = 130 m 時最大延遲率 ω_E·B = 9.5 mm/s，CHARA 331 m 基線則達 24 mm/s。以 1 kHz 控制迴路計算，每個週期光程差改變 9.5 µm，約等於整個 K 波段相干長度，因此必須由細動級吸收量化誤差；貓眼雙程設計讓台車速度只需 4.7 mm/s。
knowledge.textEn: With ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s and B = 130 m, the maximum delay rate ω_E·B is 9.5 mm/s, and the 331 m CHARA baseline reaches 24 mm/s. At a 1 kHz loop rate the OPD changes 9.5 µm per cycle, about one K-band coherence length, so the fine stage must absorb the quantisation; the double-pass cat's eye means the carriage itself only moves at 4.7 mm/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「延遲線機構與地球自轉延遲率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Delay-line mechanics and the Earth-rotation delay rate", which statement holds?
options: 只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。
ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s；B = 130 m 時最大延遲率 ω_E·B = 9.5 mm/s，CHARA 331 m 基線則達 24 mm/s。
延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。
optionsEn: Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility.
With ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s and B = 130 m, the maximum delay rate ω_E·B is 9.5 mm/s, and the 331 m CHARA baseline reaches 24 mm/s.
If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance.
quiz.explanation: ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s；B = 130 m 時最大延遲率 ω_E·B = 9.5 mm/s，CHARA 331 m 基線則達 24 mm/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With ω_E = 7.29e−5 rad/s and B = 130 m, the maximum delay rate ω_E·B is 9.5 mm/s, and the 331 m CHARA baseline reaches 24 mm/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 延遲線機構與地球自轉延遲率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delay-line mechanics and the Earth-rotation delay rate: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「延遲線台車與貓眼反射鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Delay-line carriage and cat's-eye retroreflector” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 命令延遲線以固定速度（例如 5 mm/s）行走，用雷射計量記錄位置，扣除理想軌跡後計算 1 s 視窗內的殘差均方根與速度漣波頻譜；殘差應落在數十奈米內，漣波頻率應對應輪徑與軌道接縫的空間週期。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Command the delay line at a constant velocity (for example 5 mm/s), log the laser-metrology position, subtract the ideal trajectory and compute the residual rms in 1 s windows plus the velocity-ripple spectrum; the residual should sit within tens of nanometres and any ripple frequency should match the wheel circumference or rail-joint spacing. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：軌道接縫或輪面缺陷造成週期性速度漣波，條紋相位以同樣頻率抖動，條紋追蹤器被迫吃掉大部分致動行程，弱星時失鎖；若細動級行程不足以蓋過台車的步進量，條紋會隨每一步跳動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Rail joints or wheel defects produce periodic velocity ripple, the fringe phase jitters at the same frequency, the fringe tracker spends most of its actuator stroke on it and loses lock on faint stars; if the fine stage cannot cover a carriage step, the fringes jump with every step.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 命令延遲線以固定速度（例如 5 mm/s）行走，用雷射計量記錄位置，扣除理想軌跡後計算 1 s 視窗內的殘差均方根與速度漣波頻譜；殘差應落在數十奈米內，漣波頻率應對應輪徑與軌道接縫的空間週期。
knowledge.textEn: Command the delay line at a constant velocity (for example 5 mm/s), log the laser-metrology position, subtract the ideal trajectory and compute the residual rms in 1 s windows plus the velocity-ripple spectrum; the residual should sit within tens of nanometres and any ripple frequency should match the wheel circumference or rail-joint spacing.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「延遲線機構與地球自轉延遲率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Delay-line mechanics and the Earth-rotation delay rate"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。
命令延遲線以固定速度（例如 5 mm/s）行走，用雷射計量記錄位置，扣除理想軌跡後計算 1 s 視窗內的殘差均方根與速度漣波頻譜。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity.

Command the delay line at a constant velocity (for example 5 mm/s), log the laser-metrology position, subtract the ideal trajectory and compute the residual rms in 1 s windows plus the velocity-ripple spectrum.
quiz.explanation: 命令延遲線以固定速度（例如 5 mm/s）行走，用雷射計量記錄位置，扣除理想軌跡後計算 1 s 視窗內的殘差均方根與速度漣波頻譜；殘差應落在數十奈米內，漣波頻率應對應輪徑與軌道接縫的空間週期。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Command the delay line at a constant velocity (for example 5 mm/s), log the laser-metrology position, subtract the ideal trajectory and compute the residual rms in 1 s windows plus the velocity-ripple spectrum; the residual should sit within tens of nanometres and any ripple frequency should match the wheel circumference or rail-joint spacing. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 延遲線機構與地球自轉延遲率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Delay-line mechanics and the Earth-rotation delay rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「延遲線台車與貓眼反射鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Delay-line carriage and cat's-eye retroreflector” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 軌道接縫或輪面缺陷造成週期性速度漣波，條紋相位以同樣頻率抖動，條紋追蹤器被迫吃掉大部分致動行程，弱星時失鎖；若細動級行程不足以蓋過台車的步進量，條紋會隨每一步跳動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Rail joints or wheel defects produce periodic velocity ripple, the fringe phase jitters at the same frequency, the fringe tracker spends most of its actuator stroke on it and loses lock on faint stars; if the fine stage cannot cover a carriage step, the fringes jump with every step. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為地球自轉，幾何延遲以 dD/dt = ω_E·B·cosθ 的速率連續變化，台車必須以毫米每秒等級平滑追蹤，而不是定點停住。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the Earth rotates, the geometric delay changes continuously at dD/dt = ω_E·B·cosθ, so the carriage must track smoothly at millimetres per second rather than park at a point.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
真空光管只是為了防塵，光在空氣中傳輸對干涉沒有影響。
optionsEn: Rail joints or wheel defects produce periodic velocity ripple, the fringe phase jitters at the same frequency, the fringe tracker spends most of its actuator stroke on it and loses lock on faint stars.

steps.title: 內部計量、空氣折射率與真空傳輸：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Internal metrology, air refractive index and vacuum transport: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雷射計量與真空光管」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laser metrology and vacuum beam pipes” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 延遲線位置由氦氖雷射干涉儀連續量測，但雷射量到的是光學長度 n·L，而空氣折射率隨壓力、溫度與濕度變化（Edlén 公式），隧道內的溫度梯度會把幾何長度與星光看到的光程分開。GRAVITY 另外從合成器反向注入一道 1908 nm 計量雷射，一路量到望遠鏡上，直接量測科學光束與條紋追蹤光束之間的差分光程，因為微角秒天體測量需要的是奈米級的差分光程知識，而不是絕對光程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射計量與真空光管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The delay-line position is read continuously by a helium–neon laser interferometer, but the laser measures optical length n·L and the air index varies with pressure, temperature and humidity (Edlén equation), so temperature gradients in the tunnel separate the geometric length from the path the starlight sees. GRAVITY additionally injects a 1908 nm metrology laser backwards from the combiner all the way to the telescopes to measure the differential path between the science and fringe-tracking beams directly, because microarcsecond astrometry needs nanometre knowledge of the differential path, not of the absolute path. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser metrology and vacuum beam pipes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：天體測量精度 σ_θ = σ_dOPD/B：要在 B = 130 m 達到 10 µas = 4.85e−11 rad，差分光程必須量到 σ_dOPD ≈ 6.3 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Astrometric precision is σ_θ = σ_dOPD/B: reaching 10 µas = 4.85e−11 rad on B = 130 m requires the differential OPD to be known to σ_dOPD ≈ 6.3 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「真空光管只是為了防塵，光在空氣中傳輸對干涉沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Vacuum pipes only keep dust out; propagating in air does not affect the interference." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雷射計量與真空光管」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Laser metrology and vacuum beam pipes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

GRAVITY additionally injects a 1908 nm metrology laser backwards from the combiner all the way to the telescopes to measure the differential path between the science and fringe-tracking beams directly, because microarcsecond astrometry needs nanometre knowledge of the differential path, not of the absolute path.

knowledge.text: 誤解：真空光管只是為了防塵，光在空氣中傳輸對干涉沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「內部計量、空氣折射率與真空傳輸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Internal metrology, air refractive index and vacuum transport" is correct?
options: 真空光管只是為了防塵，光在空氣中傳輸對干涉沒有影響。
延遲線位置由氦氖雷射干涉儀連續量測，但雷射量到的是光學長度 n·L，而空氣折射率隨壓力、溫度與濕度變化（Edlén 公式），隧道內的溫度梯度會把幾何長度與星光看到的光程分開。

The delay-line position is read continuously by a helium–neon laser interferometer, but the laser measures optical length n·L and the air index varies with pressure, temperature and humidity (Edlén equation), so temperature gradients in the tunnel separate the geometric length from the path the starlight sees.
Each telescope's adaptive optics already corrects the wavefront, so fringe tracking is unnecessary.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 內部計量、空氣折射率與真空傳輸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal metrology, air refractive index and vacuum transport: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷射計量與真空光管」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laser metrology and vacuum beam pipes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：天體測量精度 σ_θ = σ_dOPD/B：要在 B = 130 m 達到 10 µas = 4.85e−11 rad，差分光程必須量到 σ_dOPD ≈ 6.3 nm。相對地，若延遲隧道內 120 m 的雙程空氣路徑溫度變化 1 K，以 dn/dT ≈ −0.7e−6/K（Paranal 約 740 hPa）估計，光程改變 120×0.7e−6 = 84 µm，是條紋包絡的七倍，所以絕對光程必須由計量雷射即時追蹤。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Astrometric precision is σ_θ = σ_dOPD/B: reaching 10 µas = 4.85e−11 rad on B = 130 m requires the differential OPD to be known to σ_dOPD ≈ 6.3 nm. By contrast, a 1 K change over the 120 m double-pass air path in the tunnel, with dn/dT ≈ −0.7e−6/K at the roughly 740 hPa of Paranal, shifts the path by 120×0.7e−6 = 84 µm, seven coherence lengths, so the absolute path must be tracked live by the metrology laser. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以亮星條紋相位當作光程差的真值，比較計量雷射讀數與條紋相位的差異隨時間的漂移；再用已知分離角的雙星做交換觀測（swap），把計量零點與基線誤差分離出來，殘差應收斂到奈米級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the fringe phase of a bright star as the OPD truth and compare the metrology reading against it to see how the difference drifts; then observe a binary of known separation in swapped configuration to separate the metrology zero point from baseline errors, and check that the residual converges to nanometres.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 天體測量精度 σ_θ = σ_dOPD/B：要在 B = 130 m 達到 10 µas = 4.85e−11 rad，差分光程必須量到 σ_dOPD ≈ 6.3 nm。相對地，若延遲隧道內 120 m 的雙程空氣路徑溫度變化 1 K，以 dn/dT ≈ −0.7e−6/K（Paranal 約 740 hPa）估計，光程改變 120×0.7e−6 = 84 µm，是條紋包絡的七倍，所以絕對光程必須由計量雷射即時追蹤。
knowledge.textEn: Astrometric precision is σ_θ = σ_dOPD/B: reaching 10 µas = 4.85e−11 rad on B = 130 m requires the differential OPD to be known to σ_dOPD ≈ 6.3 nm. By contrast, a 1 K change over the 120 m double-pass air path in the tunnel, with dn/dT ≈ −0.7e−6/K at the roughly 740 hPa of Paranal, shifts the path by 120×0.7e−6 = 84 µm, seven coherence lengths, so the absolute path must be tracked live by the metrology laser.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「內部計量、空氣折射率與真空傳輸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Internal metrology, air refractive index and vacuum transport", which statement holds?

干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。

An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity.
