steps.title: 內部計量、空氣折射率與真空傳輸：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Internal metrology, air refractive index and vacuum transport: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雷射計量與真空光管」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Laser metrology and vacuum beam pipes” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以亮星條紋相位當作光程差的真值，比較計量雷射讀數與條紋相位的差異隨時間的漂移；再用已知分離角的雙星做交換觀測（swap），把計量零點與基線誤差分離出來，殘差應收斂到奈米級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the fringe phase of a bright star as the OPD truth and compare the metrology reading against it to see how the difference drifts; then observe a binary of known separation in swapped configuration to separate the metrology zero point from baseline errors, and check that the residual converges to nanometres. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：計量雷射的散射光或背向反射若漏進科學偵測器，會在光譜上留下假訊號並污染相位；CHARA 真空管若漏氣，管內出現對流亂流與色散，可見度在幾天內逐步下降而不容易察覺。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Scattered or back-reflected metrology laser light leaking into the science detector leaves false spectral features and corrupts the phase; a leak in a CHARA vacuum pipe introduces convective turbulence and dispersion, and visibility degrades gradually over days without an obvious cause.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以亮星條紋相位當作光程差的真值，比較計量雷射讀數與條紋相位的差異隨時間的漂移；再用已知分離角的雙星做交換觀測（swap），把計量零點與基線誤差分離出來，殘差應收斂到奈米級。
knowledge.textEn: Use the fringe phase of a bright star as the OPD truth and compare the metrology reading against it to see how the difference drifts; then observe a binary of known separation in swapped configuration to separate the metrology zero point from baseline errors, and check that the residual converges to nanometres.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「內部計量、空氣折射率與真空傳輸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Internal metrology, air refractive index and vacuum transport"?
options: 以亮星條紋相位當作光程差的真值，比較計量雷射讀數與條紋相位的差異隨時間的漂移。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
頻寬越寬收到的光越多，所以條紋總是越容易找到。
optionsEn: Use the fringe phase of a bright star as the OPD truth and compare the metrology reading against it to see how the difference drifts.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A wider bandwidth collects more light, so fringes are always easier to find.
quiz.explanation: 以亮星條紋相位當作光程差的真值，比較計量雷射讀數與條紋相位的差異隨時間的漂移；再用已知分離角的雙星做交換觀測（swap），把計量零點與基線誤差分離出來，殘差應收斂到奈米級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the fringe phase of a bright star as the OPD truth and compare the metrology reading against it to see how the difference drifts; then observe a binary of known separation in swapped configuration to separate the metrology zero point from baseline errors, and check that the residual converges to nanometres. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 內部計量、空氣折射率與真空傳輸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Internal metrology, air refractive index and vacuum transport: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷射計量與真空光管」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Laser metrology and vacuum beam pipes” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 計量雷射的散射光或背向反射若漏進科學偵測器，會在光譜上留下假訊號並污染相位；CHARA 真空管若漏氣，管內出現對流亂流與色散，可見度在幾天內逐步下降而不容易察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Scattered or back-reflected metrology laser light leaking into the science detector leaves false spectral features and corrupts the phase; a leak in a CHARA vacuum pipe introduces convective turbulence and dispersion, and visibility degrades gradually over days without an obvious cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：GRAVITY 另外從合成器反向注入一道 1908 nm 計量雷射，一路量到望遠鏡上，直接量測科學光束與條紋追蹤光束之間的差分光程，因為微角秒天體測量需要的是奈米級的差分光程知識，而不是絕對光程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: GRAVITY additionally injects a 1908 nm metrology laser backwards from the combiner all the way to the telescopes to measure the differential path between the science and fringe-tracking beams directly, because microarcsecond astrometry needs nanometre knowledge of the differential path, not of the absolute path.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「真空光管只是為了防塵，光在空氣中傳輸對干涉沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Vacuum pipes only keep dust out; propagating in air does not affect the interference." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 計量雷射的散射光或背向反射若漏進科學偵測器，會在光譜上留下假訊號並污染相位；CHARA 真空管若漏氣，管內出現對流亂流與色散，可見度在幾天內逐步下降而不容易察覺。
knowledge.textEn: Scattered or back-reflected metrology laser light leaking into the science detector leaves false spectral features and corrupts the phase; a leak in a CHARA vacuum pipe introduces convective turbulence and dispersion, and visibility degrades gradually over days without an obvious cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「內部計量、空氣折射率與真空傳輸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Internal metrology, air refractive index and vacuum transport" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
計量雷射的散射光或背向反射若漏進科學偵測器，會在光譜上留下假訊號並污染相位。
各望遠鏡的自適應光學已修正波前，所以不需要再做條紋追蹤。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Scattered or back-reflected metrology laser light leaking into the science detector leaves false spectral features and corrupts the phase.
Each telescope's adaptive optics already corrects the wavefront, so fringe tracking is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 計量雷射的散射光或背向反射若漏進科學偵測器，會在光譜上留下假訊號並污染相位；CHARA 真空管若漏氣，管內出現對流亂流與色散，可見度在幾天內逐步下降而不容易察覺。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scattered or back-reflected metrology laser light leaking into the science detector leaves false spectral features and corrupts the phase; a leak in a CHARA vacuum pipe introduces convective turbulence and dispersion, and visibility degrades gradually over days without an obvious cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間」與「可見度損失預算與校正星」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time" and "Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「條紋追蹤器與大氣活塞」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fringe tracker and atmospheric piston” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每台望遠鏡上方的大氣各自加上隨機的活塞相位，兩鏡之間的差分活塞在 K 波段有數微米均方根，而且在相干時間 τ₀ 內就會換一次。條紋追蹤器以數百赫茲到 1 kHz 的速率量測條紋相位，命令快速壓電鏡或音圈鏡即時修正光程，讓科學相機能以秒級曝光累積訊號；τ₀ 隨波長以 λ^(6/5) 成長，所以在 K 波段追蹤比在可見光容易。GRAVITY 的條紋追蹤器正是以這種方式把四台望遠鏡的六條基線同時鎖住。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「條紋追蹤器與大氣活塞」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The atmosphere above each telescope adds its own random piston phase; the differential piston between two telescopes has an rms of several micrometres in the K band and changes within the coherence time τ₀. The fringe tracker measures the fringe phase at several hundred hertz to 1 kHz and commands a fast piezo or voice-coil mirror to correct the path in real time, so the science camera can integrate for seconds; τ₀ grows as λ^(6/5), which makes tracking easier in the K band than in the visible. The GRAVITY fringe tracker locks all six baselines of the four telescopes this way. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fringe tracker and atmospheric piston”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If τ₀ = 3 ms at 0.5 µm, then at 2.2 µm τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 17.8 ms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「各望遠鏡的自適應光學已修正波前，所以不需要再做條紋追蹤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Each telescope's adaptive optics already corrects the wavefront, so fringe tracking is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「條紋追蹤器與大氣活塞」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fringe tracker and atmospheric piston”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間
knowledge.titleEn: Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time
knowledge.text: 每台望遠鏡上方的大氣各自加上隨機的活塞相位，兩鏡之間的差分活塞在 K 波段有數微米均方根，而且在相干時間 τ₀ 內就會換一次。條紋追蹤器以數百赫茲到 1 kHz 的速率量測條紋相位，命令快速壓電鏡或音圈鏡即時修正光程，讓科學相機能以秒級曝光累積訊號；τ₀ 隨波長以 λ^(6/5) 成長，所以在 K 波段追蹤比在可見光容易。
knowledge.textEn: The atmosphere above each telescope adds its own random piston phase; the differential piston between two telescopes has an rms of several micrometres in the K band and changes within the coherence time τ₀. The fringe tracker measures the fringe phase at several hundred hertz to 1 kHz and commands a fast piezo or voice-coil mirror to correct the path in real time, so the science camera can integrate for seconds; τ₀ grows as λ^(6/5), which makes tracking easier in the K band than in the visible.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：各望遠鏡的自適應光學已修正波前，所以不需要再做條紋追蹤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Each telescope's adaptive optics already corrects the wavefront, so fringe tracking is unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time" is correct?
options: 各望遠鏡的自適應光學已修正波前，所以不需要再做條紋追蹤。
只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。
每台望遠鏡上方的大氣各自加上隨機的活塞相位，兩鏡之間的差分活塞在 K 波段有數微米均方根，而且在相干時間 τ₀ 內就會換一次。
optionsEn: Each telescope's adaptive optics already corrects the wavefront, so fringe tracking is unnecessary.
Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility.
The atmosphere above each telescope adds its own random piston phase.
quiz.explanation: 每台望遠鏡上方的大氣各自加上隨機的活塞相位，兩鏡之間的差分活塞在 K 波段有數微米均方根，而且在相干時間 τ₀ 內就會換一次。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The atmosphere above each telescope adds its own random piston phase; the differential piston between two telescopes has an rms of several micrometres in the K band and changes within the coherence time τ₀. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「條紋追蹤器與大氣活塞」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fringe tracker and atmospheric piston” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若 0.5 µm 的 τ₀ = 3 ms，則 2.2 µm 的 τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 17.8 ms。以簡化的時間延遲誤差 σ_φ² ≈ (τ/τ₀)^(5/3) 估計，迴路總延遲 τ = 3 ms 時 σ_φ² = 0.052 rad²、σ_φ = 0.23 rad，對應殘餘光程差 0.23×2.2 µm/2π ≈ 80 nm，條紋對比因子 exp(−σ_φ²/2) ≈ 0.97；數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If τ₀ = 3 ms at 0.5 µm, then at 2.2 µm τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 17.8 ms. With the simplified time-delay error σ_φ² ≈ (τ/τ₀)^(5/3), a total loop latency τ = 3 ms gives σ_φ² = 0.052 rad² and σ_φ = 0.23 rad, a residual OPD of 0.23×2.2 µm/2π ≈ 80 nm and a fringe-contrast factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) ≈ 0.97; values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：擷取條紋追蹤器的遙測：把閉迴路殘差與重建的開迴路活塞序列做功率譜，計算殘差均方根並與當晚 DIMM/MASS 量到的 τ₀ 對照；再以壓電鏡注入已知頻率的正弦活塞，量測迴路的抑制傳遞函數，確認 −3 dB 頻寬與延遲與設計相符。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Capture the fringe-tracker telemetry: form power spectra of the closed-loop residual and the reconstructed open-loop piston, compute the residual rms and compare it with the τ₀ measured that night by DIMM/MASS; then inject a sinusoidal piston of known frequency with the piezo mirror and measure the rejection transfer function to confirm the −3 dB bandwidth and latency match the design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若 0.5 µm 的 τ₀ = 3 ms，則 2.2 µm 的 τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 17.8 ms。以簡化的時間延遲誤差 σ_φ² ≈ (τ/τ₀)^(5/3) 估計，迴路總延遲 τ = 3 ms 時 σ_φ² = 0.052 rad²、σ_φ = 0.23 rad，對應殘餘光程差 0.23×2.2 µm/2π ≈ 80 nm，條紋對比因子 exp(−σ_φ²/2) ≈ 0.97；數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If τ₀ = 3 ms at 0.5 µm, then at 2.2 µm τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 17.8 ms. With the simplified time-delay error σ_φ² ≈ (τ/τ₀)^(5/3), a total loop latency τ = 3 ms gives σ_φ² = 0.052 rad² and σ_φ = 0.23 rad, a residual OPD of 0.23×2.2 µm/2π ≈ 80 nm and a fringe-contrast factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) ≈ 0.97; values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time", which statement holds?
options: 延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。
頻寬越寬收到的光越多，所以條紋總是越容易找到。
optionsEn: If τ₀ = 3 ms at 0.5 µm, then at 2.2 µm τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 17.8 ms.
If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance.
A wider bandwidth collects more light, so fringes are always easier to find.
quiz.explanation: 若 0.5 µm 的 τ₀ = 3 ms，則 2.2 µm 的 τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 17.8 ms。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If τ₀ = 3 ms at 0.5 µm, then at 2.2 µm τ₀ = 3×(2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 17.8 ms. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「條紋追蹤器與大氣活塞」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fringe tracker and atmospheric piston” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 擷取條紋追蹤器的遙測：把閉迴路殘差與重建的開迴路活塞序列做功率譜，計算殘差均方根並與當晚 DIMM/MASS 量到的 τ₀ 對照；再以壓電鏡注入已知頻率的正弦活塞，量測迴路的抑制傳遞函數，確認 −3 dB 頻寬與延遲與設計相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Capture the fringe-tracker telemetry: form power spectra of the closed-loop residual and the reconstructed open-loop piston, compute the residual rms and compare it with the τ₀ measured that night by DIMM/MASS; then inject a sinusoidal piston of known frequency with the piezo mirror and measure the rejection transfer function to confirm the −3 dB bandwidth and latency match the design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：訊噪比下降時相位量測出現 2π 模糊，追蹤器鎖到相鄰一個波長的條紋（fringe jump），若科學相機仍在曝光，累積的可見度與相位會被系統性拉低；需要群延遲量測同時監看才能偵測並回復。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the signal-to-noise ratio drops, the phase measurement becomes 2π-ambiguous and the tracker locks one wavelength away (a fringe jump); if the science camera keeps integrating, the accumulated visibility and phase are biased low, and only a simultaneous group-delay measurement can detect and recover it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 擷取條紋追蹤器的遙測：把閉迴路殘差與重建的開迴路活塞序列做功率譜，計算殘差均方根並與當晚 DIMM/MASS 量到的 τ₀ 對照；再以壓電鏡注入已知頻率的正弦活塞，量測迴路的抑制傳遞函數，確認 −3 dB 頻寬與延遲與設計相符。
knowledge.textEn: Capture the fringe-tracker telemetry: form power spectra of the closed-loop residual and the reconstructed open-loop piston, compute the residual rms and compare it with the τ₀ measured that night by DIMM/MASS; then inject a sinusoidal piston of known frequency with the piezo mirror and measure the rejection transfer function to confirm the −3 dB bandwidth and latency match the design.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
擷取條紋追蹤器的遙測：把閉迴路殘差與重建的開迴路活塞序列做功率譜，計算殘差均方根並與當晚 DIMM/MASS 量到的 τ₀ 對照。
台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Capture the fringe-tracker telemetry: form power spectra of the closed-loop residual and the reconstructed open-loop piston, compute the residual rms and compare it with the τ₀ measured that night by DIMM/MASS.
Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide.
quiz.explanation: 擷取條紋追蹤器的遙測：把閉迴路殘差與重建的開迴路活塞序列做功率譜，計算殘差均方根並與當晚 DIMM/MASS 量到的 τ₀ 對照；再以壓電鏡注入已知頻率的正弦活塞，量測迴路的抑制傳遞函數，確認 −3 dB 頻寬與延遲與設計相符。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Capture the fringe-tracker telemetry: form power spectra of the closed-loop residual and the reconstructed open-loop piston, compute the residual rms and compare it with the τ₀ measured that night by DIMM/MASS; then inject a sinusoidal piston of known frequency with the piezo mirror and measure the rejection transfer function to confirm the −3 dB bandwidth and latency match the design. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「條紋追蹤器與大氣活塞」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fringe tracker and atmospheric piston” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 訊噪比下降時相位量測出現 2π 模糊，追蹤器鎖到相鄰一個波長的條紋（fringe jump），若科學相機仍在曝光，累積的可見度與相位會被系統性拉低；需要群延遲量測同時監看才能偵測並回復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the signal-to-noise ratio drops, the phase measurement becomes 2π-ambiguous and the tracker locks one wavelength away (a fringe jump); if the science camera keeps integrating, the accumulated visibility and phase are biased low, and only a simultaneous group-delay measurement can detect and recover it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：GRAVITY 的條紋追蹤器正是以這種方式把四台望遠鏡的六條基線同時鎖住。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The GRAVITY fringe tracker locks all six baselines of the four telescopes this way.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「各望遠鏡的自適應光學已修正波前，所以不需要再做條紋追蹤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Each telescope's adaptive optics already corrects the wavefront, so fringe tracking is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 訊噪比下降時相位量測出現 2π 模糊，追蹤器鎖到相鄰一個波長的條紋（fringe jump），若科學相機仍在曝光，累積的可見度與相位會被系統性拉低；需要群延遲量測同時監看才能偵測並回復。
knowledge.textEn: When the signal-to-noise ratio drops, the phase measurement becomes 2π-ambiguous and the tracker locks one wavelength away (a fringe jump); if the science camera keeps integrating, the accumulated visibility and phase are biased low, and only a simultaneous group-delay measurement can detect and recover it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「條紋追蹤、大氣活塞與相干時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fringe tracking, atmospheric piston and coherence time" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。
訊噪比下降時相位量測出現 2π 模糊，追蹤器鎖到相鄰一個波長的條紋（fringe jump），若科學相機仍在曝光，累積的可見度與相位會被系統性拉低。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility.
When the signal-to-noise ratio drops, the phase measurement becomes 2π-ambiguous and the tracker locks one wavelength away (a fringe jump).
quiz.explanation: 訊噪比下降時相位量測出現 2π 模糊，追蹤器鎖到相鄰一個波長的條紋（fringe jump），若科學相機仍在曝光，累積的可見度與相位會被系統性拉低；需要群延遲量測同時監看才能偵測並回復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When the signal-to-noise ratio drops, the phase measurement becomes 2π-ambiguous and the tracker locks one wavelength away (a fringe jump); if the science camera keeps integrating, the accumulated visibility and phase are biased low, and only a simultaneous group-delay measurement can detect and recover it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 可見度損失預算與校正星：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「可見度校正與傳遞函數」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Visibility calibration and transfer function” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量到的可見度 V_meas = T·V_true，其中系統傳遞函數 T < 1 包含殘餘活塞抖動、兩臂強度不等、偏振失配、波前殘差與色散等項，每一項都能用簡單公式估計並列成預算表。T 無法只靠模型決定，必須在科學目標前後觀測直徑已知的校正星，用它的理論可見度反推當時的 T，再內插到科學觀測；校正星的直徑不確定度因此直接進入最終結果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可見度校正與傳遞函數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The measured visibility is V_meas = T·V_true, where the system transfer function T < 1 collects residual piston jitter, unequal arm intensities, polarisation mismatch, residual wavefront error and dispersion, each estimable with a simple formula and tabulated into a budget. T cannot be fixed by modelling alone: calibrator stars of known diameter are observed before and after the science target, their theoretical visibility yields T at that time and it is interpolated to the science observation, so the calibrator's diameter uncertainty enters the final result directly. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Visibility calibration and transfer function”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: σ_OPD = 80 nm at 2.2 µm gives σ_φ = 0.23 rad and a jitter factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.974; an arm intensity ratio of 0.7 gives 2√0.7/1.7 = 0.984; with 0.95 assumed for polarisation and wavefront, T ≈ 0.974×0.984×0.95 ≈ 0.91.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「可見度校正與傳遞函數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Visibility calibration and transfer function”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

T cannot be fixed by modelling alone: calibrator stars of known diameter are observed before and after the science target, their theoretical visibility yields T at that time and it is interpolated to the science observation, so the calibrator's diameter uncertainty enters the final result directly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可見度損失預算與校正星」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars" is correct?
options: 量到的可見度 V_meas = T·V_true，其中系統傳遞函數 T < 1 包含殘餘活塞抖動、兩臂強度不等、偏振失配、波前殘差與色散等項，每一項都能用簡單公式估計並列成預算表。
只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。
閉合相位可以消除所有系統誤差，所以不需要觀測校正星。
optionsEn: The measured visibility is V_meas = T·V_true, where the system transfer function T < 1 collects residual piston jitter, unequal arm intensities, polarisation mismatch, residual wavefront error and dispersion, each estimable with a simple formula and tabulated into a budget.
Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility.
Closure phase removes all systematic errors, so calibrator stars are unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 量到的可見度 V_meas = T·V_true，其中系統傳遞函數 T < 1 包含殘餘活塞抖動、兩臂強度不等、偏振失配、波前殘差與色散等項，每一項都能用簡單公式估計並列成預算表。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The measured visibility is V_meas = T·V_true, where the system transfer function T < 1 collects residual piston jitter, unequal arm intensities, polarisation mismatch, residual wavefront error and dispersion, each estimable with a simple formula and tabulated into a budget. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可見度損失預算與校正星：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可見度校正與傳遞函數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Visibility calibration and transfer function” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：σ_OPD = 80 nm 在 2.2 µm 給 σ_φ = 0.23 rad，抖動因子 exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.974；兩臂強度比 0.7 給 2√0.7/1.7 = 0.984；偏振與波前另估 0.95，則 T ≈ 0.974×0.984×0.95 ≈ 0.91。直徑 1 mas 的校正星在 B = 130 m、2.2 µm 時 x = πθB/λ = 0.90，V ≈ 1 − x²/8 + x⁴/192 = 0.902；直徑誤差 5% 使 V 變成 0.893，帶來約 1% 的校正誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: σ_OPD = 80 nm at 2.2 µm gives σ_φ = 0.23 rad and a jitter factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.974; an arm intensity ratio of 0.7 gives 2√0.7/1.7 = 0.984; with 0.95 assumed for polarisation and wavefront, T ≈ 0.974×0.984×0.95 ≈ 0.91. A 1 mas calibrator at B = 130 m and 2.2 µm has x = πθB/λ = 0.90 and V ≈ 1 − x²/8 + x⁴/192 = 0.902; a 5% diameter error changes V to 0.893, about a 1% calibration error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以「校正星–科學目標–校正星」序列觀測，畫出 T 隨時間的曲線並檢查其平滑度；用兩顆直徑不同的校正星互相校正，結果應在誤差內一致；對點源量測閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe in calibrator–science–calibrator sequences, plot T against time and check that it varies smoothly; calibrate two calibrators of different diameters against each other and confirm consistency within errors; measure closure phases on a point source, which should be zero within noise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: σ_OPD = 80 nm 在 2.2 µm 給 σ_φ = 0.23 rad，抖動因子 exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.974；兩臂強度比 0.7 給 2√0.7/1.7 = 0.984；偏振與波前另估 0.95，則 T ≈ 0.974×0.984×0.95 ≈ 0.91。直徑 1 mas 的校正星在 B = 130 m、2.2 µm 時 x = πθB/λ = 0.90，V ≈ 1 − x²/8 + x⁴/192 = 0.902；直徑誤差 5% 使 V 變成 0.893，帶來約 1% 的校正誤差。
knowledge.textEn: σ_OPD = 80 nm at 2.2 µm gives σ_φ = 0.23 rad and a jitter factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.974; an arm intensity ratio of 0.7 gives 2√0.7/1.7 = 0.984; with 0.95 assumed for polarisation and wavefront, T ≈ 0.974×0.984×0.95 ≈ 0.91. A 1 mas calibrator at B = 130 m and 2.2 µm has x = πθB/λ = 0.90 and V ≈ 1 − x²/8 + x⁴/192 = 0.902; a 5% diameter error changes V to 0.893, about a 1% calibration error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「可見度損失預算與校正星」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars", which statement holds?
options: 干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。
σ_OPD = 80 nm 在 2.2 µm 給 σ_φ = 0.23 rad，抖動因子 exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.974。
台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。
optionsEn: An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity.
σ_OPD = 80 nm at 2.2 µm gives σ_φ = 0.23 rad and a jitter factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.974.
Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide.
quiz.explanationEn: σ_OPD = 80 nm at 2.2 µm gives σ_φ = 0.23 rad and a jitter factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.974; an arm intensity ratio of 0.7 gives 2√0.7/1.7 = 0.984; with 0.95 assumed for polarisation and wavefront, T ≈ 0.974×0.984×0.95 ≈ 0.91. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 可見度損失預算與校正星：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「可見度校正與傳遞函數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Visibility calibration and transfer function” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以「校正星–科學目標–校正星」序列觀測，畫出 T 隨時間的曲線並檢查其平滑度；用兩顆直徑不同的校正星互相校正，結果應在誤差內一致；對點源量測閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe in calibrator–science–calibrator sequences, plot T against time and check that it varies smoothly; calibrate two calibrators of different diameters against each other and confirm consistency within errors; measure closure phases on a point source, which should be zero within noise. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：校正星其實是未被發現的雙星時，它的真實可見度低於模型，反推的 T 被低估，科學目標的直徑被系統性高估；只有用多顆校正星交叉比對才能抓到這種錯誤。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the calibrator turns out to be an unrecognised binary, its true visibility is below the model, the inferred T is underestimated and the science target's diameter is systematically overestimated; only cross-checking several calibrators catches this.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以「校正星–科學目標–校正星」序列觀測，畫出 T 隨時間的曲線並檢查其平滑度；用兩顆直徑不同的校正星互相校正，結果應在誤差內一致；對點源量測閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。
knowledge.textEn: Observe in calibrator–science–calibrator sequences, plot T against time and check that it varies smoothly; calibrate two calibrators of different diameters against each other and confirm consistency within errors; measure closure phases on a point source, which should be zero within noise.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可見度損失預算與校正星」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
真空光管只是為了防塵，光在空氣中傳輸對干涉沒有影響。
以「校正星–科學目標–校正星」序列觀測，畫出 T 隨時間的曲線並檢查其平滑度。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Vacuum pipes only keep dust out; propagating in air does not affect the interference.
Observe in calibrator–science–calibrator sequences, plot T against time and check that it varies smoothly.
quiz.explanation: 以「校正星–科學目標–校正星」序列觀測，畫出 T 隨時間的曲線並檢查其平滑度；用兩顆直徑不同的校正星互相校正，結果應在誤差內一致；對點源量測閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe in calibrator–science–calibrator sequences, plot T against time and check that it varies smoothly; calibrate two calibrators of different diameters against each other and confirm consistency within errors; measure closure phases on a point source, which should be zero within noise. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 可見度損失預算與校正星：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visibility-loss budget and calibrator stars: failure diagnosis

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: T cannot be fixed by modelling alone: calibrator stars of known diameter are observed before and after the science target, their theoretical visibility yields T at that time and it is interpolated to the science observation, so the calibrator's diameter uncertainty enters the final result directly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: If the calibrator turns out to be an unrecognised binary, its true visibility is below the model, the inferred T is underestimated and the science target's diameter is systematically overestimated; only cross-checking several calibrators catches this.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 光束合成、ABCD 相位量測與閉合相位：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam combination, ABCD phase and closure phase: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「積體光學合成器與 ABCD 輸出」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Integrated-optics combiner and ABCD outputs” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: GRAVITY 用一片積體光學晶片把四道光束兩兩配對成六條基線，每條基線輸出四個相位各差 90° 的通道（A、B、C、D），共 24 個輸出同時落在偵測器上；由四個通道的強度差可以直接解出條紋的可見度與相位，不需要機械掃描。四台望遠鏡繞任一三角形把三條基線的相位相加得到閉合相位，望遠鏡各自的活塞誤差在相加時互相抵消，使閉合相位成為不受大氣影響的影像觀測量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「積體光學合成器與 ABCD 輸出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: GRAVITY pairs four beams into six baselines on one integrated-optics chip, and each baseline delivers four outputs phase-shifted by 90° (A, B, C, D), 24 outputs landing simultaneously on the detector; the visibility and phase follow directly from the intensity differences without mechanical scanning. Summing the phases of the three baselines around any telescope triangle gives the closure phase, in which telescope-specific piston errors cancel, so it is an atmosphere-free imaging observable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Integrated-optics combiner and ABCD outputs”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：I_A = I₀(1 + V cosφ)、I_B = I₀(1 − V sinφ)、I_C = I₀(1 − V cosφ)、I_D = I₀(1 + V sinφ)，故 φ = atan2(I_D − I_B, I_A − I_C)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: I_A = I₀(1 + V cosφ), I_B = I₀(1 − V sinφ), I_C = I₀(1 − V cosφ), I_D = I₀(1 + V sinφ), so φ = atan2(I_D − I_B, I_A − I_C).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閉合相位可以消除所有系統誤差，所以不需要觀測校正星。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closure phase removes all systematic errors, so calibrator stars are unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「積體光學合成器與 ABCD 輸出」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Integrated-optics combiner and ABCD outputs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 光束合成、ABCD 相位量測與閉合相位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam combination, ABCD phase and closure phase: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「積體光學合成器與 ABCD 輸出」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Integrated-optics combiner and ABCD outputs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：I_A = I₀(1 + V cosφ)、I_B = I₀(1 − V sinφ)、I_C = I₀(1 − V cosφ)、I_D = I₀(1 + V sinφ)，故 φ = atan2(I_D − I_B, I_A − I_C)。光子雜訊造成的相位誤差約 σ_φ ≈ √2/(V√N)：每條基線每幀 N = 1000 光子、V = 0.5 時 σ_φ ≈ 0.089 rad，相當於 31 nm 光程。N = 4 台望遠鏡有 6 條基線、3 個獨立閉合相位（(N−1)(N−2)/2）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: I_A = I₀(1 + V cosφ), I_B = I₀(1 − V sinφ), I_C = I₀(1 − V cosφ), I_D = I₀(1 + V sinφ), so φ = atan2(I_D − I_B, I_A − I_C). The photon-noise phase error is about σ_φ ≈ √2/(V√N): with N = 1000 photons per baseline per frame and V = 0.5, σ_φ ≈ 0.089 rad, equivalent to 31 nm of path. N = 4 telescopes give 6 baselines and 3 independent closure phases, (N−1)(N−2)/2. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用內部校正光源在實驗室內產生條紋，量出每個輸出的實際相移（不會剛好 90°）與穿透係數，建立像素到可見度矩陣（P2VM）；再用同一光源確認閉合相位在雜訊內為零，並在晶片溫度改變 1 K 後重測 P2VM，評估漂移量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Generate fringes with the internal calibration source, measure each output's actual phase shift (never exactly 90°) and transmission to build the pixel-to-visibility matrix (P2VM); then confirm with the same source that the closure phase is zero within noise, and re-measure the P2VM after a 1 K change of chip temperature to quantify drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 光束合成、ABCD 相位量測與閉合相位：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Beam combination, ABCD phase and closure phase: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「積體光學合成器與 ABCD 輸出」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Integrated-optics combiner and ABCD outputs” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用內部校正光源在實驗室內產生條紋，量出每個輸出的實際相移（不會剛好 90°）與穿透係數，建立像素到可見度矩陣（P2VM）；再用同一光源確認閉合相位在雜訊內為零，並在晶片溫度改變 1 K 後重測 P2VM，評估漂移量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Generate fringes with the internal calibration source, measure each output's actual phase shift (never exactly 90°) and transmission to build the pixel-to-visibility matrix (P2VM); then confirm with the same source that the closure phase is zero within noise, and re-measure the P2VM after a 1 K change of chip temperature to quantify drift. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias; without periodic P2VM re-measurement the bias is mistaken for source structure.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用內部校正光源在實驗室內產生條紋，量出每個輸出的實際相移（不會剛好 90°）與穿透係數，建立像素到可見度矩陣（P2VM）；再用同一光源確認閉合相位在雜訊內為零，並在晶片溫度改變 1 K 後重測 P2VM，評估漂移量。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光束合成、ABCD 相位量測與閉合相位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam combination, ABCD phase and closure phase"?

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「積體光學合成器與 ABCD 輸出」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Integrated-optics combiner and ABCD outputs” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias; without periodic P2VM re-measurement the bias is mistaken for source structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：四台望遠鏡繞任一三角形把三條基線的相位相加得到閉合相位，望遠鏡各自的活塞誤差在相加時互相抵消，使閉合相位成為不受大氣影響的影像觀測量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Summing the phases of the three baselines around any telescope triangle gives the closure phase, in which telescope-specific piston errors cancel, so it is an atmosphere-free imaging observable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉合相位可以消除所有系統誤差，所以不需要觀測校正星。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Closure phase removes all systematic errors, so calibrator stars are unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。
knowledge.textEn: After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias; without periodic P2VM re-measurement the bias is mistaken for source structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光束合成、ABCD 相位量測與閉合相位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam combination, ABCD phase and closure phase" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。
延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias.
If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance.
quiz.explanation: 晶片溫度或注入偏振改變後，實際相移偏離建立 P2VM 時的值，解出的可見度出現與波長相關的系統偏差；若無定期重做 P2VM，偏差會被誤認為天體結構。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: After a change in chip temperature or injected polarisation, the real phase shifts depart from those used to build the P2VM and the recovered visibilities carry wavelength-dependent bias; without periodic P2VM re-measurement the bias is mistaken for source structure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」如何決定天文干涉儀光程控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “End-to-end acceptance and operations record” determines the key performance of “Optical-path control in astronomical interferometers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光程控制系統的驗收不是看延遲線在實驗室的定位精度，而是看整條鏈在天上的表現：條紋鎖定比例隨視寧度與 τ₀ 的分佈、殘餘光程差均方根、延遲線可用度，以及跨夜的天體測量重複性。交接文件必須包含基線解、計量零點、P2VM、延遲線校正表與維護週期（軌道清潔、真空泵、雷射頻率檢查），因為這些參數任何一項靜悄悄地改變，都會以假的科學訊號出現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of the path-control system is judged not by the laboratory positioning accuracy of a delay line but by the whole chain on sky: fringe-lock fraction binned by seeing and τ₀, residual OPD rms, delay-line availability and night-to-night astrometric repeatability. The handoff record must carry the baseline solution, metrology zero points, the P2VM, delay-line calibration tables and maintenance intervals (rail cleaning, vacuum pumps, laser-frequency checks), because a silent change in any of these shows up as a false scientific signal. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “End-to-end acceptance and operations record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas；但基線知識誤差 1 mm 對 1″ 分離角帶來 (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas 的系統下限，所以基線必須量到次毫米，計量零點須穩定在 6 nm 內。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m; but a 1 mm baseline-knowledge error puts a systematic floor of (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas on a 1″ separation, so the baseline must be known to sub-millimetre and the metrology zero point held within 6 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “End-to-end acceptance and operations record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接
knowledge.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff
knowledge.text: 光程控制系統的驗收不是看延遲線在實驗室的定位精度，而是看整條鏈在天上的表現：條紋鎖定比例隨視寧度與 τ₀ 的分佈、殘餘光程差均方根、延遲線可用度，以及跨夜的天體測量重複性。交接文件必須包含基線解、計量零點、P2VM、延遲線校正表與維護週期（軌道清潔、真空泵、雷射頻率檢查），因為這些參數任何一項靜悄悄地改變，都會以假的科學訊號出現。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance of the path-control system is judged not by the laboratory positioning accuracy of a delay line but by the whole chain on sky: fringe-lock fraction binned by seeing and τ₀, residual OPD rms, delay-line availability and night-to-night astrometric repeatability. The handoff record must carry the baseline solution, metrology zero points, the P2VM, delay-line calibration tables and maintenance intervals (rail cleaning, vacuum pumps, laser-frequency checks), because a silent change in any of these shows up as a false scientific signal.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff" is correct?
options: 延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。
干涉儀的解析度由各望遠鏡的口徑決定，基線只影響靈敏度。
光程控制系統的驗收不是看延遲線在實驗室的定位精度，而是看整條鏈在天上的表現：條紋鎖定比例隨視寧度與 τ₀ 的分佈、殘餘光程差均方根、延遲線可用度，以及跨夜的天體測量重複性。
optionsEn: If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance.
An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity.

Acceptance of the path-control system is judged not by the laboratory positioning accuracy of a delay line but by the whole chain on sky: fringe-lock fraction binned by seeing and τ₀, residual OPD rms, delay-line availability and night-to-night astrometric repeatability.

quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance of the path-control system is judged not by the laboratory positioning accuracy of a delay line but by the whole chain on sky: fringe-lock fraction binned by seeing and τ₀, residual OPD rms, delay-line availability and night-to-night astrometric repeatability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “End-to-end acceptance and operations record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas；但基線知識誤差 1 mm 對 1″ 分離角帶來 (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas 的系統下限，所以基線必須量到次毫米，計量零點須穩定在 6 nm 內。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m; but a 1 mm baseline-knowledge error puts a systematic floor of (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas on a 1″ separation, so the baseline must be known to sub-millimetre and the metrology zero point held within 6 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較；整理鎖定比例對 τ₀ 的曲線、殘差對視寧度的曲線；驗收報告需同時列出延遲線殘差、計量漂移、可見度傳遞函數穩定度與天體測量重複性四項。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction; tabulate lock fraction versus τ₀ and residual versus seeing; the acceptance record must list delay-line residual, metrology drift, transfer-function stability and astrometric repeatability together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas；但基線知識誤差 1 mm 對 1″ 分離角帶來 (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas 的系統下限，所以基線必須量到次毫米，計量零點須穩定在 6 nm 內。
knowledge.textEn: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m; but a 1 mm baseline-knowledge error puts a systematic floor of (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas on a 1″ separation, so the baseline must be known to sub-millimetre and the metrology zero point held within 6 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas。
台車定位到 1 µm 就足夠，因為條紋包絡有十幾微米寬。
各望遠鏡的自適應光學已修正波前，所以不需要再做條紋追蹤。
optionsEn: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m.
Positioning the carriage to 1 µm is enough because the fringe packet is a dozen micrometres wide.
Each telescope's adaptive optics already corrects the wavefront, so fringe tracking is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 若差分光程雜訊為每秒 50 nm，1800 s 平均後為 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm，對 B = 130 m 相當於統計精度 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas；但基線知識誤差 1 mm 對 1″ 分離角帶來 (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas 的系統下限，所以基線必須量到次毫米，計量零點須穩定在 6 nm 內。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a differential-OPD noise of 50 nm per second, averaging 1800 s gives 50/√1800 = 1.2 nm, a statistical precision of 1.2e−9/130 = 9.1e−12 rad ≈ 1.9 µas on B = 130 m; but a 1 mm baseline-knowledge error puts a systematic floor of (1e−3/130)×1000 mas ≈ 7.7 µas on a 1″ separation, so the baseline must be known to sub-millimetre and the metrology zero point held within 6 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “End-to-end acceptance and operations record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較；整理鎖定比例對 τ₀ 的曲線、殘差對視寧度的曲線；驗收報告需同時列出延遲線殘差、計量漂移、可見度傳遞函數穩定度與天體測量重複性四項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction; tabulate lock fraction versus τ₀ and residual versus seeing; the acceptance record must list delay-line residual, metrology drift, transfer-function stability and astrometric repeatability together. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：兩次觀測之間基線模型被更新卻未記錄，天體測量結果出現數十微角秒的跳變，被當成軌道運動發表；或延遲線維護後計量零點改變，條紋追蹤在特定時角總是失鎖。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A baseline-model update between two runs that is not logged produces a jump of tens of microarcseconds in astrometry that gets published as orbital motion; or a metrology zero point changed by delay-line maintenance makes fringe tracking fail at particular hour angles.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較；整理鎖定比例對 τ₀ 的曲線、殘差對視寧度的曲線；驗收報告需同時列出延遲線殘差、計量漂移、可見度傳遞函數穩定度與天體測量重複性四項。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction; tabulate lock fraction versus τ₀ and residual versus seeing; the acceptance record must list delay-line residual, metrology drift, transfer-function stability and astrometric repeatability together.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較。
只要條紋追蹤器鎖住，量到的可見度就是天體的真實可見度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction.
Once the fringe tracker is locked, the measured visibility is the object's true visibility.
quiz.explanation: 跨數夜重複量測已知雙星的分離角，統計其散布並與模型預測比較；整理鎖定比例對 τ₀ 的曲線、殘差對視寧度的曲線；驗收報告需同時列出延遲線殘差、計量漂移、可見度傳遞函數穩定度與天體測量重複性四項。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat the separation of a known binary over several nights, compare the scatter with the model prediction; tabulate lock fraction versus τ₀ and residual versus seeing; the acceptance record must list delay-line residual, metrology drift, transfer-function stability and astrometric repeatability together. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「端到端驗收與操作紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “End-to-end acceptance and operations record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 兩次觀測之間基線模型被更新卻未記錄，天體測量結果出現數十微角秒的跳變，被當成軌道運動發表；或延遲線維護後計量零點改變，條紋追蹤在特定時角總是失鎖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A baseline-model update between two runs that is not logged produces a jump of tens of microarcseconds in astrometry that gets published as orbital motion; or a metrology zero point changed by delay-line maintenance makes fringe tracking fail at particular hour angles. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件必須包含基線解、計量零點、P2VM、延遲線校正表與維護週期（軌道清潔、真空泵、雷射頻率檢查），因為這些參數任何一項靜悄悄地改變，都會以假的科學訊號出現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must carry the baseline solution, metrology zero points, the P2VM, delay-line calibration tables and maintenance intervals (rail cleaning, vacuum pumps, laser-frequency checks), because a silent change in any of these shows up as a false scientific signal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「延遲線在實驗室達到奈米定位精度，整個干涉儀就算驗收通過。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the delay line reaches nanometre positioning in the lab, the whole interferometer passes acceptance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「端到端驗證、天體測量重複性與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "End-to-end validation, astrometric repeatability and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An interferometer's resolution is set by the telescope apertures; the baseline only affects sensitivity.
A baseline-model update between two runs that is not logged produces a jump of tens of microarcseconds in astrometry that gets published as orbital motion.

title: 電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機
summary: 以 ALMA 前端（4 K SIS 混頻器與 15 K 低溫 HEMT 中頻放大器）與綠堤 100 m 望遠鏡（GBT）的公分波接收機為對象，從輻射計方程與 SEFD 出發，拆解饋源照明、Friis 雜訊級聯、量子雜訊極限、Y 因子校正、Allan 變異數與低溫恆溫器整合，最後落到接收機驗收與交接。
summaryEn: Using the ALMA front end (4 K SIS mixers with 15 K cryogenic HEMT IF amplifiers) and the centimetre-wave receivers of the 100 m Green Bank Telescope as reference designs, the course starts from the radiometer equation and SEFD and works through feed illumination, the Friis noise cascade, the quantum noise limit, Y-factor calibration, Allan variance and cryostat integration, ending with receiver acceptance and handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 雜訊鏈練習：假設饋源與正交模轉換器在 15 K、損耗 0.3 dB（L = 1.072），第一級低溫 HEMT T₁ = 3 K、G₁ = 35 dB（3162），第二級室溫放大器 T₂ = 150 K。前端損耗貢獻 (L−1)×15 = 1.08 K，Friis 級聯 T_rx = 1.08 + 1.072×(3 + 150/3162) = 1.08 + 3.27 = 4.35 K。加上天空 5 K、地面溢出 3 K、宇宙微波背景 2.7 K，Tsys ≈ 15 K。對 GBT（A_eff ≈ 5500 m²）SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×15/5500 = 7.5e−26 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ = 7.5 Jy；以 B = 100 MHz、τ = 60 s 積分，流量靈敏度 ΔS = 7.5/√(1e8×60) = 97 µJy。若前端損耗增加到 1 dB（L = 1.259），T_rx 升到 3.9 + 1.259×3.05 = 7.7 K，Tsys 變成約 18 K，相同靈敏度需要的時間增加 (18/15)² = 1.44 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-chain exercise: assume the feed and orthomode transducer at 15 K with 0.3 dB loss (L = 1.072), a first-stage cryogenic HEMT with T₁ = 3 K and G₁ = 35 dB (3162), and a room-temperature second stage with T₂ = 150 K. The front-end loss contributes (L−1)×15 = 1.08 K and the Friis cascade gives T_rx = 1.08 + 1.072×(3 + 150/3162) = 1.08 + 3.27 = 4.35 K. Adding 5 K of sky, 3 K of ground spillover and 2.7 K of cosmic microwave background gives Tsys ≈ 15 K. For the GBT (A_eff ≈ 5500 m²) SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×15/5500 = 7.5e−26 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ = 7.5 Jy; integrating B = 100 MHz for τ = 60 s gives a flux sensitivity ΔS = 7.5/√(1e8×60) = 97 µJy. If the front-end loss grows to 1 dB (L = 1.259), T_rx rises to 3.9 + 1.259×3.05 = 7.7 K, Tsys becomes about 18 K and the time for the same sensitivity grows by (18/15)² = 1.44. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」與「饋源照明、溢出與孔徑效率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD" and "Feed illumination, spillover and aperture efficiency": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」如何決定電波望遠鏡低雜訊接收機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System noise temperature Tsys” determines the key performance of “Radio-telescope low-noise receivers”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。輻射計方程 ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) 說明靈敏度只能靠降低 Tsys、加寬頻寬或拉長積分時間；把天線有效面積一起考慮，系統等效流量密度 SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff 就是接收機與天線合起來的靈敏度指標，單位是 Jy。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G; the system noise temperature Tsys lumps sky, ground spillover and the receiver into one equivalent temperature. The radiometer equation ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) shows that sensitivity improves only through lower Tsys, wider bandwidth or longer integration; folding in the antenna effective area, the system equivalent flux density SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff is the combined antenna-plus-receiver sensitivity figure in Jy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “System noise temperature Tsys”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：綠堤望遠鏡口徑 100 m、孔徑效率取 0.7 時，有效面積 A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²；L 波段系統雜訊溫度 Tsys = 20 K 時 SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雜訊溫度就是接收機元件的實際物理溫度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Noise temperature is the actual physical temperature of the receiver parts." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “System noise temperature Tsys”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD
knowledge.text: 電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。輻射計方程 ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) 說明靈敏度只能靠降低 Tsys、加寬頻寬或拉長積分時間；把天線有效面積一起考慮，系統等效流量密度 SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff 就是接收機與天線合起來的靈敏度指標，單位是 Jy。
knowledge.textEn: The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G; the system noise temperature Tsys lumps sky, ground spillover and the receiver into one equivalent temperature. The radiometer equation ΔT = Tsys/√(B·τ) shows that sensitivity improves only through lower Tsys, wider bandwidth or longer integration; folding in the antenna effective area, the system equivalent flux density SEFD = 2k·Tsys/A_eff is the combined antenna-plus-receiver sensitivity figure in Jy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雜訊溫度就是接收機元件的實際物理溫度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Noise temperature is the actual physical temperature of the receiver parts. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD" is correct?
options: 雜訊溫度就是接收機元件的實際物理溫度。
電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。
把副鏡照明得越均勻，整體孔徑效率一定越高。
optionsEn: Noise temperature is the actual physical temperature of the receiver parts.
The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G.
The more uniformly the subreflector is illuminated, the higher the overall aperture efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 電波望遠鏡收到的天體訊號本身就是雜訊狀的隨機電壓，功率為 P = k·T·B·G；系統雜訊溫度 Tsys 把天空、地面溢出與接收機本身的貢獻加總成一個等效溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The signal a radio telescope collects is itself a noise-like random voltage with power P = k·T·B·G; the system noise temperature Tsys lumps sky, ground spillover and the receiver into one equivalent temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System noise temperature Tsys” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：綠堤望遠鏡口徑 100 m、孔徑效率取 0.7 時，有效面積 A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²；L 波段系統雜訊溫度 Tsys = 20 K 時 SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy。取頻寬 B = 1 MHz、積分時間 τ = 1 s，溫度靈敏度 ΔT = 20/√1e6 = 0.02 K，對應的流量靈敏度 ΔS = SEFD/√(Bτ) = 10 mJy。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy. With B = 1 MHz and τ = 1 s, ΔT = 20/√1e6 = 0.02 K, a flux sensitivity ΔS = SEFD/√(Bτ) = 10 mJy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用校正過的雜訊二極體或熱／冷負載量出 Tsys，再對一個無源天區做總功率積分，檢查量到的雜訊隨積分時間以 1/√τ 下降，直到增益漲落接管為止；把量到的 ΔT 與輻射計方程預測值比較，差異應在 10–20% 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure Tsys with a calibrated noise diode or hot/cold loads, then integrate total power on a source-free patch of sky and check that the measured noise falls as 1/√τ until gain fluctuations take over; compare the measured ΔT with the radiometer-equation prediction, which should agree within 10–20%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy. With B = 1 MHz and τ = 1 s, ΔT = 20/√1e6 = 0.02 K, a flux sensitivity ΔS = SEFD/√(Bτ) = 10 mJy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD", which statement holds?
options: 混頻器把訊號降到較低頻率，雜訊也會按比例降低。
積分時間越長，靈敏度一定越好。
綠堤望遠鏡口徑 100 m、孔徑效率取 0.7 時，有效面積 A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²。
optionsEn: Down-converting the signal to a lower frequency reduces the noise in proportion.
Longer integration always gives better sensitivity.
For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy.
quiz.explanation: 綠堤望遠鏡口徑 100 m、孔徑效率取 0.7 時，有效面積 A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²；L 波段系統雜訊溫度 Tsys = 20 K 時 SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For the 100 m GBT with aperture efficiency 0.7, A_eff = 0.7·π·50² ≈ 5500 m²; at L band with Tsys = 20 K, SEFD = 2×1.38e−23×20/5500 = 1.0e−25 W m⁻² Hz⁻¹ ≈ 10 Jy. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「系統雜訊溫度 Tsys」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “System noise temperature Tsys” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用校正過的雜訊二極體或熱／冷負載量出 Tsys，再對一個無源天區做總功率積分，檢查量到的雜訊隨積分時間以 1/√τ 下降，直到增益漲落接管為止；把量到的 ΔT 與輻射計方程預測值比較，差異應在 10–20% 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure Tsys with a calibrated noise diode or hot/cold loads, then integrate total power on a source-free patch of sky and check that the measured noise falls as 1/√τ until gain fluctuations take over; compare the measured ΔT with the radiometer-equation prediction, which should agree within 10–20%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若接收機增益有 ΔG/G = 1e−3 的漲落，等效雜訊下限為 Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK，在 Bτ = 1e6 時就與輻射計雜訊相等；再積分也不會更好，必須改用 Dicke 切換或頻率切換。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A gain fluctuation ΔG/G = 1e−3 sets an equivalent noise floor of Tsys×1e−3 = 20 mK, equal to the radiometer noise already at Bτ = 1e6; further integration does not help, and Dicke or frequency switching becomes necessary.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用校正過的雜訊二極體或熱／冷負載量出 Tsys，再對一個無源天區做總功率積分，檢查量到的雜訊隨積分時間以 1/√τ 下降，直到增益漲落接管為止；把量到的 ΔT 與輻射計方程預測值比較，差異應在 10–20% 內。
knowledge.textEn: Measure Tsys with a calibrated noise diode or hot/cold loads, then integrate total power on a source-free patch of sky and check that the measured noise falls as 1/√τ until gain fluctuations take over; compare the measured ΔT with the radiometer-equation prediction, which should agree within 10–20%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輻射計方程、Tsys 與 SEFD」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Radiometer equation, Tsys and SEFD"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
