steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把頻帶解套用到第二顆校正器，通道間的殘餘散布應與雜訊一致；注入單頻測試音，量鄰近通道的功率應低於 −60 dB；比較數小時前後兩次頻帶解的比值，檢查穩定度是否優於預算。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the bandpass solution to a second calibrator and check that the channel-to-channel residual scatter matches the noise; inject a single-frequency test tone and confirm the power in adjacent channels stays below −60 dB; take the ratio of two bandpass solutions hours apart to check that stability beats the budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。
把頻帶解套用到第二顆校正器，通道間的殘餘散布應與雜訊一致。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas.
Apply the bandpass solution to a second calibrator and check that the channel-to-channel residual scatter matches the noise.
quiz.explanation: 把頻帶解套用到第二顆校正器，通道間的殘餘散布應與雜訊一致；注入單頻測試音，量鄰近通道的功率應低於 −60 dB；比較數小時前後兩次頻帶解的比值，檢查穩定度是否優於預算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Apply the bandpass solution to a second calibrator and check that the channel-to-channel residual scatter matches the noise; inject a single-frequency test tone and confirm the power in adjacent channels stays below −60 dB; take the ratio of two bandpass solutions hours apart to check that stability beats the budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻帶響應與多相濾波器組」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bandpass and polyphase filter bank” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 頻帶校正器本身帶有大氣或天體譜線時，譜線的倒影會被印到所有科學頻譜中，出現假的吸收或發射特徵，常被誤認為真實訊號。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the bandpass calibrator carries atmospheric or intrinsic spectral lines, their inverse is imprinted on every science spectrum as false absorption or emission features that are often mistaken for real signal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：譜線觀測的頻譜動態範圍由頻帶解的訊噪比、頻帶穩定度與洩漏共同決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The spectral dynamic range of line observations is set jointly by the bandpass solution's signal-to-noise, bandpass stability and leakage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「FFT 的各通道彼此獨立，頻譜洩漏可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "FFT channels are independent of each other, so spectral leakage can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 頻帶校正器本身帶有大氣或天體譜線時，譜線的倒影會被印到所有科學頻譜中，出現假的吸收或發射特徵，常被誤認為真實訊號。
knowledge.textEn: If the bandpass calibrator carries atmospheric or intrinsic spectral lines, their inverse is imprinted on every science spectrum as false absorption or emission features that are often mistaken for real signal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 頻帶校正器本身帶有大氣或天體譜線時，譜線的倒影會被印到所有科學頻譜中，出現假的吸收或發射特徵，常被誤認為真實訊號。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。
optionsEn: If the bandpass calibrator carries atmospheric or intrinsic spectral lines, their inverse is imprinted on every science spectrum as false absorption or emission features that are often mistaken for real signal.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 頻帶校正器本身帶有大氣或天體譜線時，譜線的倒影會被印到所有科學頻譜中，出現假的吸收或發射特徵，常被誤認為真實訊號。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the bandpass calibrator carries atmospheric or intrinsic spectral lines, their inverse is imprinted on every science spectrum as false absorption or emission features that are often mistaken for real signal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」與「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate" and "End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「頻率參考與資料流」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency reference and data flow” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）；任何未修正的光纖相位變化都直接變成可見度相位誤差。相關器輸出以 1–16 s 積分、數千通道的可見度，輸出資料率受封存系統限制，因此積分時間與通道平均要依科學需求與資料率一起設計，時間戳記必須與 UTC 對齊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「頻率參考與資料流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector); any uncorrected fibre phase change becomes a visibility phase error directly. The correlator outputs visibilities integrated over 1–16 s with thousands of channels, the output rate is limited by the archive, so integration time and channel averaging are designed together with the science case and the data rate, and time stamps must be aligned to UTC. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Frequency reference and data flow”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「頻率參考與資料流」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Frequency reference and data flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率
knowledge.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate
knowledge.text: 所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）；任何未修正的光纖相位變化都直接變成可見度相位誤差。相關器輸出以 1–16 s 積分、數千通道的可見度，輸出資料率受封存系統限制，因此積分時間與通道平均要依科學需求與資料率一起設計，時間戳記必須與 UTC 對齊。
knowledge.textEn: Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector); any uncorrected fibre phase change becomes a visibility phase error directly. The correlator outputs visibilities integrated over 1–16 s with thousands of channels, the output rate is limited by the archive, so integration time and channel averaging are designed together with the science case and the data rate, and time stamps must be aligned to UTC.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate" is correct?
options: GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。
所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）。
相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。
optionsEn: GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary.

Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector).
The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration.
quiz.explanation: 所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）；任何未修正的光纖相位變化都直接變成可見度相位誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector); any uncorrected fibre phase change becomes a visibility phase error directly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻率參考與資料流」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frequency reference and data flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。輸出資料率：2016 基線 × 4 極化 × 4 基頻 × 2048 通道 × 8 byte，每 1 s 一次 = 528 MB/s；改為 16 s 積分並平均 2 個通道後約 16.5 MB/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm. Output data rate: 2016 baselines × 4 polarisations × 4 basebands × 2048 channels × 8 bytes every 1 s = 528 MB/s; with 16 s integrations and 2-channel averaging it falls to about 16.5 MB/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度；比對往返線長量測與相位變化；在輸入端注入 GPS 秒脈衝確認時間戳記對齊；以最高資料率連續輸出一小時確認封存不掉資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability; compare the round-trip line-length measurement with the phase change; inject a GPS pulse-per-second at the input to confirm time-stamp alignment; stream at the maximum data rate for an hour to confirm the archive drops nothing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。輸出資料率：2016 基線 × 4 極化 × 4 基頻 × 2048 通道 × 8 byte，每 1 s 一次 = 528 MB/s；改為 16 s 積分並平均 2 個通道後約 16.5 MB/s。
knowledge.textEn: A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm. Output data rate: 2016 baselines × 4 polarisations × 4 basebands × 2048 channels × 8 bytes every 1 s = 528 MB/s; with 16 s integrations and 2-channel averaging it falls to about 16.5 MB/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate", which statement holds?
options: 延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。
相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。
10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。
optionsEn: Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence.
Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas.
A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm.
quiz.explanation: 10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「頻率參考與資料流」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Frequency reference and data flow” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度；比對往返線長量測與相位變化；在輸入端注入 GPS 秒脈衝確認時間戳記對齊；以最高資料率連續輸出一小時確認封存不掉資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability; compare the round-trip line-length measurement with the phase change; inject a GPS pulse-per-second at the input to confirm time-stamp alignment; stream at the maximum data rate for an hour to confirm the archive drops nothing. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：氫邁射頻率偏差 1e−13 在 230 GHz 造成 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s（8°/s）的相位漂移，若延遲模型沒有跟上就會去相干；線長修正迴路失鎖時相位瞬間跳變，整段資料報廢。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A hydrogen-maser frequency offset of 1e−13 produces a phase drift of 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s (8°/s) at 230 GHz and decorrelates the data if the delay model does not follow; when the line-length correction loop loses lock the phase jumps instantly and the whole scan is lost.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度；比對往返線長量測與相位變化；在輸入端注入 GPS 秒脈衝確認時間戳記對齊；以最高資料率連續輸出一小時確認封存不掉資料。
knowledge.textEn: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability; compare the round-trip line-length measurement with the phase change; inject a GPS pulse-per-second at the input to confirm time-stamp alignment; stream at the maximum data rate for an hour to confirm the archive drops nothing.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate"?
options: 用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。
optionsEn: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines.
quiz.explanation: 用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度；比對往返線長量測與相位變化；在輸入端注入 GPS 秒脈衝確認時間戳記對齊；以最高資料率連續輸出一小時確認封存不掉資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability; compare the round-trip line-length measurement with the phase change; inject a GPS pulse-per-second at the input to confirm time-stamp alignment; stream at the maximum data rate for an hour to confirm the archive drops nothing. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻率參考與資料流」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Frequency reference and data flow” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 氫邁射頻率偏差 1e−13 在 230 GHz 造成 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s（8°/s）的相位漂移，若延遲模型沒有跟上就會去相干；線長修正迴路失鎖時相位瞬間跳變，整段資料報廢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A hydrogen-maser frequency offset of 1e−13 produces a phase drift of 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s (8°/s) at 230 GHz and decorrelates the data if the delay model does not follow; when the line-length correction loop loses lock the phase jumps instantly and the whole scan is lost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相關器輸出以 1–16 s 積分、數千通道的可見度，輸出資料率受封存系統限制，因此積分時間與通道平均要依科學需求與資料率一起設計，時間戳記必須與 UTC 對齊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The correlator outputs visibilities integrated over 1–16 s with thousands of channels, the output rate is limited by the archive, so integration time and channel averaging are designed together with the science case and the data rate, and time stamps must be aligned to UTC.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 氫邁射頻率偏差 1e−13 在 230 GHz 造成 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s（8°/s）的相位漂移，若延遲模型沒有跟上就會去相干；線長修正迴路失鎖時相位瞬間跳變，整段資料報廢。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
氫邁射頻率偏差 1e−13 在 230 GHz 造成 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s（8°/s）的相位漂移，若延遲模型沒有跟上就會去相干。
相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A hydrogen-maser frequency offset of 1e−13 produces a phase drift of 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s (8°/s) at 230 GHz and decorrelates the data if the delay model does not follow.
The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration.

quiz.explanationEn: A hydrogen-maser frequency offset of 1e−13 produces a phase drift of 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s (8°/s) at 230 GHz and decorrelates the data if the delay model does not follow; when the line-length correction loop loses lock the phase jumps instantly and the whole scan is lost. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、影像品質與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「相關器驗收與營運交接」如何決定電波陣列相關器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff” determines the key performance of “Radio-array correlators”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相關器的驗收分三層：板級測試向量、整機滿載運轉，以及上機試觀測——點源影像的動態範圍、流量尺度、頻譜純度、閉合量與每一種觀測模式（通道數、頻寬、積分時間）都要有紀錄。交接給營運單位時要附上模式表、已知限制、校正程序與回歸測試套件，之後每次韌體更新都重跑回歸測試，否則通道順序或相位符號的改變會以影像鏡像或頻譜翻轉的形式出現。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相關器驗收與營運交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Correlator acceptance has three layers: board-level test vectors, full-load operation of the whole machine, and on-sky commissioning where point-source image dynamic range, flux scale, spectral purity, closure quantities and every observing mode (channel count, bandwidth, integration time) are recorded. Handoff to operations includes the mode table, known limitations, calibration procedures and a regression suite that is rerun after every firmware update, otherwise a changed channel order or phase sign convention appears as mirrored images or flipped spectra. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal image sensitivity σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]: with 43 12 m antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, η_q = 0.96, 7.5 GHz total bandwidth and τ = 1 h, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「相關器驗收與營運交接」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Handoff to operations includes the mode table, known limitations, calibration procedures and a regression suite that is rerun after every firmware update, otherwise a changed channel order or phase sign convention appears as mirrored images or flipped spectra.

quiz.question: 關於「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。

Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、影像品質與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相關器驗收與營運交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱雜訊影像靈敏度 σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]：43 台 12 m 天線、SEFD 2600 Jy、η_q = 0.96、總頻寬 7.5 GHz、τ = 1 h 時 σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy。驗收準則：源外區域量到的影像均方根不超過理論值的 1.2 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal image sensitivity σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]: with 43 12 m antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, η_q = 0.96, 7.5 GHz total bandwidth and τ = 1 h, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy. Acceptance criterion: the image rms measured in a source-free region must not exceed 1.2 times the theoretical value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較；對 1 Jy 校正器的影像量動態範圍與殘餘假影；逐一執行模式表中的每一種模式並記錄結果；把整套測試寫成可自動執行的回歸套件，更新韌體後重跑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy; image a 1 Jy calibrator and record dynamic range and residual artefacts; execute every mode in the mode table and log the result; package the whole set as an automated regression suite and rerun it after firmware updates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 熱雜訊影像靈敏度 σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]：43 台 12 m 天線、SEFD 2600 Jy、η_q = 0.96、總頻寬 7.5 GHz、τ = 1 h 時 σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy。驗收準則：源外區域量到的影像均方根不超過理論值的 1.2 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal image sensitivity σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]: with 43 12 m antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, η_q = 0.96, 7.5 GHz total bandwidth and τ = 1 h, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy. Acceptance criterion: the image rms measured in a source-free region must not exceed 1.2 times the theoretical value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 8 位元取樣比 3 位元靈敏度高很多，所以位元數越多越好。
增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。

8-bit sampling is far more sensitive than 3-bit, so more bits are always better.
Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines.
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal image sensitivity σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]: with 43 12 m antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, η_q = 0.96, 7.5 GHz total bandwidth and τ = 1 h, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、影像品質與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「相關器驗收與營運交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較；對 1 Jy 校正器的影像量動態範圍與殘餘假影；逐一執行模式表中的每一種模式並記錄結果；把整套測試寫成可自動執行的回歸套件，更新韌體後重跑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy; image a 1 Jy calibrator and record dynamic range and residual artefacts; execute every mode in the mode table and log the result; package the whole set as an automated regression suite and rerun it after firmware updates. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis; without regression tests the error is found weeks later by users in science data.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較；對 1 Jy 校正器的影像量動態範圍與殘餘假影；逐一執行模式表中的每一種模式並記錄結果；把整套測試寫成可自動執行的回歸套件，更新韌體後重跑。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy; image a 1 Jy calibrator and record dynamic range and residual artefacts; execute every mode in the mode table and log the result; package the whole set as an automated regression suite and rerun it after firmware updates.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較。
FFT 的各通道彼此獨立，頻譜洩漏可以忽略。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy.

quiz.explanation: 在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較；對 1 Jy 校正器的影像量動態範圍與殘餘假影；逐一執行模式表中的每一種模式並記錄結果；把整套測試寫成可自動執行的回歸套件，更新韌體後重跑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy; image a 1 Jy calibrator and record dynamic range and residual artefacts; execute every mode in the mode table and log the result; package the whole set as an automated regression suite and rerun it after firmware updates. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 端到端驗證、影像品質與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相關器驗收與營運交接」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Correlator acceptance and operations handoff” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis; without regression tests the error is found weeks later by users in science data. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接給營運單位時要附上模式表、已知限制、校正程序與回歸測試套件，之後每次韌體更新都重跑回歸測試，否則通道順序或相位符號的改變會以影像鏡像或頻譜翻轉的形式出現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handoff to operations includes the mode table, known limitations, calibration procedures and a regression suite that is rerun after every firmware update, otherwise a changed channel order or phase sign convention appears as mirrored images or flipped spectra.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。
knowledge.textEn: A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis; without regression tests the error is found weeks later by users in science data.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「端到端驗證、影像品質與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。
韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image.
A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis.
quiz.explanation: 韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis; without regression tests the error is found weeks later by users in science data. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 重力波干涉儀懸吊
summary: 以 Advanced LIGO 的四級擺（40 kg 熔融石英測試質量、0.4 mm 石英纖維）與 Virgo 的超級衰減器為對象，從地面震動與 10⁻¹⁹ m 的位移目標出發，推導單擺 1/f² 與四級 1/f⁸ 的傳遞函數、擺動稀釋後的熱雜訊、葉片彈簧垂直隔振與致動層級，再整合局部阻尼、雜訊預算、真空安裝與鎖定取得，最後落到懸吊驗收與交接。
summaryEn: Using the Advanced LIGO quadruple pendulum (40 kg fused-silica test mass on 0.4 mm silica fibres) and the Virgo superattenuator as reference designs, the course starts from ground motion and the 10⁻¹⁹ m displacement target, derives the single-pendulum 1/f² and four-stage 1/f⁸ transfer functions, the dilution-reduced thermal noise, blade-spring vertical isolation and the actuation hierarchy, then integrates local damping, noise budgeting, in-vacuum installation and lock acquisition, ending with suspension acceptance and handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 懸吊熱雜訊與隔振練習：40 kg 測試質量由 4 根直徑 0.4 mm、長 0.6 m 的熔融石英纖維吊起。每根張力 98 N，截面 1.26×10⁻⁷ m²，應力 780 MPa。E = 72 GPa、I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴，稀釋因子 D ≈ √(EI/T)/l = 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³；取材料損耗 φ_mat = 10⁻⁷，φ_pend = 1.6×10⁻¹⁰。f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz，ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s。10 Hz 的熱雜訊 x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵) = 4×1.38×10⁻²³×293×16×1.6×10⁻¹⁰/(40×62.8⁵) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³⁹ m²/Hz，x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz，對 4 km 臂長 h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz。隔振：單級 10 Hz 衰減 (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³，四級理想 3×10⁻¹⁰；垂直路徑 (2.5/10)⁸×10⁻³ = 1.5×10⁻⁸ 反而主導，所以垂直隔振才是真正的瓶頸。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Suspension thermal-noise and isolation exercise: a 40 kg test mass hangs from 4 fused-silica fibres of 0.4 mm diameter and 0.6 m length. Each carries 98 N over 1.26×10⁻⁷ m², a stress of 780 MPa. With E = 72 GPa and I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴ the dilution factor D ≈ √(EI/T)/l = 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³; taking a material loss φ_mat = 10⁻⁷ gives φ_pend = 1.6×10⁻¹⁰. f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz, ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s. The thermal noise at 10 Hz, x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵) = 4×1.38×10⁻²³×293×16×1.6×10⁻¹⁰/(40×62.8⁵) ≈ 1.1×10⁻³⁹ m²/Hz, gives x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, or h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz over a 4 km arm. Isolation: one stage attenuates (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³ at 10 Hz and four ideal stages 3×10⁻¹⁰, but the vertical path (2.5/10)⁸×10⁻³ = 1.5×10⁻⁸ dominates, so vertical isolation is the real bottleneck. Values are teaching assumptions, not any detector's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求」與「單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement" and "The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「地面震動與測試質量」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground motion and the test mass” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力波把 4 km 臂長改變 ΔL = h·L，h ≈ 10⁻²³ 時 ΔL 只有 4×10⁻²⁰ m；而安靜場址的地面在 10 Hz 仍以約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 的幅度晃動，兩者相差十個數量級。LIGO 把這個差距分給兩層：主動地震隔離平台用慣性感測器與致動器把送到懸吊頂端的運動壓到約 2×10⁻¹³ m，再由四級擺懸吊以被動方式再降近六個數量級，使測試質量在偵測頻帶內只對重力波與熱雜訊有反應。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「地面震動與測試質量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gravitational wave changes the 4 km arm by ΔL = h·L, only 4×10⁻²⁰ m for h ≈ 10⁻²³, while the ground at a quiet site still moves by about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, ten orders of magnitude more. LIGO splits that gap across two layers: active seismic-isolation platforms with inertial sensors and actuators reduce the motion delivered to the top of the suspension to about 2×10⁻¹³ m, and the quadruple pendulum then passively removes nearly six more orders, so that in the detection band the test mass responds only to gravitational waves and thermal noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ground motion and the test mass”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「地面震動與測試質量」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Ground motion and the test mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求
knowledge.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement
knowledge.text: 重力波把 4 km 臂長改變 ΔL = h·L，h ≈ 10⁻²³ 時 ΔL 只有 4×10⁻²⁰ m；而安靜場址的地面在 10 Hz 仍以約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 的幅度晃動，兩者相差十個數量級。LIGO 把這個差距分給兩層：主動地震隔離平台用慣性感測器與致動器把送到懸吊頂端的運動壓到約 2×10⁻¹³ m，再由四級擺懸吊以被動方式再降近六個數量級，使測試質量在偵測頻帶內只對重力波與熱雜訊有反應。
knowledge.textEn: A gravitational wave changes the 4 km arm by ΔL = h·L, only 4×10⁻²⁰ m for h ≈ 10⁻²³, while the ground at a quiet site still moves by about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, ten orders of magnitude more. LIGO splits that gap across two layers: active seismic-isolation platforms with inertial sensors and actuators reduce the motion delivered to the top of the suspension to about 2×10⁻¹³ m, and the quadruple pendulum then passively removes nearly six more orders, so that in the detection band the test mass responds only to gravitational waves and thermal noise.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement" is correct?
options: 只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。
重力波把 4 km 臂長改變 ΔL = h·L，h ≈ 10⁻²³ 時 ΔL 只有 4×10⁻²⁰ m。
懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。
optionsEn: Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation.
A gravitational wave changes the 4 km arm by ΔL = h·L, only 4×10⁻²⁰ m for h ≈ 10⁻²³, while the ground at a quiet site still moves by about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, ten orders of magnitude more.
More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost.
quiz.explanation: 重力波把 4 km 臂長改變 ΔL = h·L，h ≈ 10⁻²³ 時 ΔL 只有 4×10⁻²⁰ m；而安靜場址的地面在 10 Hz 仍以約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 的幅度晃動，兩者相差十個數量級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gravitational wave changes the 4 km arm by ΔL = h·L, only 4×10⁻²⁰ m for h ≈ 10⁻²³, while the ground at a quiet site still moves by about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, ten orders of magnitude more. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地面震動與測試質量」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground motion and the test mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。平台負責約 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³，懸吊負責 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶。注意 4 km 兩端的鉛垂線夾角為 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad，垂直運動以這個比例耦合進臂長方向，所以垂直隔振不能忽略。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰. The platform supplies about 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³ and the suspension 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶. Note that the local verticals at the two ends of a 4 km arm differ by 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad, so vertical motion couples into the arm direction at that ratio and vertical isolation cannot be neglected. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用地震儀量場址的地面位移譜，用平台上的慣性感測器量殘餘運動，兩者相除得到平台的實測隔振；把平台殘餘乘以懸吊模型傳遞函數預測測試質量位移，與干涉儀差動臂長（DARM）在 10–20 Hz 的實測雜訊比較，差額即為未建模的耦合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the site's ground displacement spectrum with seismometers and the residual motion with the platform's inertial sensors, their ratio being the achieved platform isolation; multiply the platform residual by the suspension model transfer function to predict test-mass displacement and compare with the measured differential arm-length (DARM) noise at 10–20 Hz, the shortfall being unmodelled coupling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。平台負責約 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³，懸吊負責 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶。注意 4 km 兩端的鉛垂線夾角為 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad，垂直運動以這個比例耦合進臂長方向，所以垂直隔振不能忽略。
knowledge.textEn: Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰. The platform supplies about 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³ and the suspension 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶. Note that the local verticals at the two ends of a 4 km arm differ by 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad, so vertical motion couples into the arm direction at that ratio and vertical isolation cannot be neglected.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement", which statement holds?
options: 只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。
總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。
需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。
optionsEn: Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length.
Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms.
Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰.
quiz.explanation: 需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「地面震動與測試質量」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ground motion and the test mass” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用地震儀量場址的地面位移譜，用平台上的慣性感測器量殘餘運動，兩者相除得到平台的實測隔振；把平台殘餘乘以懸吊模型傳遞函數預測測試質量位移，與干涉儀差動臂長（DARM）在 10–20 Hz 的實測雜訊比較，差額即為未建模的耦合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the site's ground displacement spectrum with seismometers and the residual motion with the platform's inertial sensors, their ratio being the achieved platform isolation; multiply the platform residual by the suspension model transfer function to predict test-mass displacement and compare with the measured differential arm-length (DARM) noise at 10–20 Hz, the shortfall being unmodelled coupling. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：0.1–0.3 Hz 的海洋微震在風暴期間放大十倍，雖在偵測頻帶之外，卻讓致動器飽和、干涉儀無法維持鎖定；低估微震的隔振設計在冬季會損失大量觀測時間。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The 0.1–0.3 Hz ocean microseism grows tenfold during storms; although outside the detection band, it saturates the actuators and the interferometer cannot hold lock, so an isolation design that underestimates the microseism loses large amounts of winter observing time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地面震動與測試質量」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Ground motion and the test mass” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 0.1–0.3 Hz 的海洋微震在風暴期間放大十倍，雖在偵測頻帶之外，卻讓致動器飽和、干涉儀無法維持鎖定；低估微震的隔振設計在冬季會損失大量觀測時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: The 0.1–0.3 Hz ocean microseism grows tenfold during storms; although outside the detection band, it saturates the actuators and the interferometer cannot hold lock, so an isolation design that underestimates the microseism loses large amounts of winter observing time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：LIGO 把這個差距分給兩層：主動地震隔離平台用慣性感測器與致動器把送到懸吊頂端的運動壓到約 2×10⁻¹³ m，再由四級擺懸吊以被動方式再降近六個數量級，使測試質量在偵測頻帶內只對重力波與熱雜訊有反應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: LIGO splits that gap across two layers: active seismic-isolation platforms with inertial sensors and actuators reduce the motion delivered to the top of the suspension to about 2×10⁻¹³ m, and the quadruple pendulum then passively removes nearly six more orders, so that in the detection band the test mass responds only to gravitational waves and thermal noise.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「單擺傳遞函數」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pendulum transfer function” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單擺的懸點到擺錘的水平傳遞函數為 x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q)，共振頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l)；在 f ≫ f₀ 時以 (f₀/f)² 衰減，每級貢獻 1/f²，四級串接理想上給出 1/f⁸。代價是每一級都引入一個高 Q 的共振模態，必須在不注入感測器雜訊的前提下加以阻尼；Virgo 的超級衰減器更把倒立擺放在最上層，把起始共振壓到 0.03 Hz 量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單擺傳遞函數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A single pendulum's horizontal transfer function from suspension point to bob is x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q) with resonance f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l); for f ≫ f₀ it falls as (f₀/f)², each stage contributes 1/f² and four stages ideally give 1/f⁸. The price is a high-Q resonant mode per stage that must be damped without injecting sensor noise; the Virgo superattenuator goes further by placing an inverted pendulum at the top, pushing the first resonance down to the 0.03 Hz level. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pendulum transfer function”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With l = 0.6 m, f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「單擺傳遞函數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pendulum transfer function”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈
knowledge.titleEn: The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains
knowledge.text: 單擺的懸點到擺錘的水平傳遞函數為 x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q)，共振頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l)；在 f ≫ f₀ 時以 (f₀/f)² 衰減，每級貢獻 1/f²，四級串接理想上給出 1/f⁸。代價是每一級都引入一個高 Q 的共振模態，必須在不注入感測器雜訊的前提下加以阻尼；Virgo 的超級衰減器更把倒立擺放在最上層，把起始共振壓到 0.03 Hz 量級。
knowledge.textEn: A single pendulum's horizontal transfer function from suspension point to bob is x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q) with resonance f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l); for f ≫ f₀ it falls as (f₀/f)², each stage contributes 1/f² and four stages ideally give 1/f⁸. The price is a high-Q resonant mode per stage that must be damped without injecting sensor noise; the Virgo superattenuator goes further by placing an inverted pendulum at the top, pushing the first resonance down to the 0.03 Hz level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains" is correct?
options: 懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。
纖維越粗越安全，而且對雜訊沒有影響。
單擺的懸點到擺錘的水平傳遞函數為 x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q)，共振頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l)。
optionsEn: More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost.
Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise.
A single pendulum's horizontal transfer function from suspension point to bob is x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q) with resonance f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l).
quiz.explanation: 單擺的懸點到擺錘的水平傳遞函數為 x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q)，共振頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l)；在 f ≫ f₀ 時以 (f₀/f)² 衰減，每級貢獻 1/f²，四級串接理想上給出 1/f⁸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A single pendulum's horizontal transfer function from suspension point to bob is x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q) with resonance f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l); for f ≫ f₀ it falls as (f₀/f)², each stage contributes 1/f² and four stages ideally give 1/f⁸. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單擺傳遞函數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pendulum transfer function” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：l = 0.6 m：f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz。單級在 10 Hz 的衰減 (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³，四級理想值 (4.1×10⁻³)⁴ ≈ 3×10⁻¹⁰。實測隔振通常只有 10⁻⁶ 到 10⁻⁸，因為葉片彈簧的垂直模態（f_v ≈ 2.5 Hz，四級給 (2.5/10)⁸ = 1.5×10⁻⁵）經由約 10⁻³ 的垂直–水平耦合進來，貢獻 1.5×10⁻⁸，遠大於水平路徑。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With l = 0.6 m, f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz. One stage attenuates by (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³ at 10 Hz and four ideal stages by (4.1×10⁻³)⁴ ≈ 3×10⁻¹⁰. Measured isolation is usually 10⁻⁶ to 10⁻⁸, because the blade-spring vertical modes (f_v ≈ 2.5 Hz, four stages giving (2.5/10)⁸ = 1.5×10⁻⁵) enter through roughly 10⁻³ of vertical-to-horizontal coupling and contribute 1.5×10⁻⁸, far above the horizontal path. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以頂端致動器驅動掃頻或白雜訊，用各級的光學槓桿或影子感測器量測運動，得到逐級傳遞函數；與狀態空間模型比較模態頻率與 Q 值，模態頻率偏差應小於 5%；特別檢查 10 Hz 附近的實測衰減是否被垂直耦合支配。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Drive the top stage with swept-sine or white noise from its actuators and measure each stage's motion with optical levers or shadow sensors to obtain stage-by-stage transfer functions; compare mode frequencies and Q values with the state-space model, requiring frequency deviations under 5%; check in particular whether the measured attenuation near 10 Hz is dominated by vertical coupling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Measured isolation is usually 10⁻⁶ to 10⁻⁸, because the blade-spring vertical modes (f_v ≈ 2.5 Hz, four stages giving (2.5/10)⁸ = 1.5×10⁻⁵) enter through roughly 10⁻³ of vertical-to-horizontal coupling and contribute 1.5×10⁻⁸, far above the horizontal path.

steps.title: 單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「單擺傳遞函數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pendulum transfer function” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以頂端致動器驅動掃頻或白雜訊，用各級的光學槓桿或影子感測器量測運動，得到逐級傳遞函數；與狀態空間模型比較模態頻率與 Q 值，模態頻率偏差應小於 5%；特別檢查 10 Hz 附近的實測衰減是否被垂直耦合支配。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Drive the top stage with swept-sine or white noise from its actuators and measure each stage's motion with optical levers or shadow sensors to obtain stage-by-stage transfer functions; compare mode frequencies and Q values with the state-space model, requiring frequency deviations under 5%; check in particular whether the measured attenuation near 10 Hz is dominated by vertical coupling. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鋼絲或石英纖維的小提琴模態（數百 Hz）與葉片彈簧內部模態 Q 值極高，若落在偵測頻帶內而未阻尼或未用陷波濾波處理，會在靈敏度曲線上留下一整排尖峰並在控制迴路中引發不穩定。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Violin modes of the wires or silica fibres (hundreds of hertz) and internal blade-spring modes have extremely high Q; if they fall inside the detection band without damping or notch filtering they leave a comb of sharp lines in the sensitivity curve and can destabilise the control loops.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以頂端致動器驅動掃頻或白雜訊，用各級的光學槓桿或影子感測器量測運動，得到逐級傳遞函數；與狀態空間模型比較模態頻率與 Q 值，模態頻率偏差應小於 5%；特別檢查 10 Hz 附近的實測衰減是否被垂直耦合支配。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains"?

Drive the top stage with swept-sine or white noise from its actuators and measure each stage's motion with optical levers or shadow sensors to obtain stage-by-stage transfer functions.

quiz.explanationEn: Drive the top stage with swept-sine or white noise from its actuators and measure each stage's motion with optical levers or shadow sensors to obtain stage-by-stage transfer functions; compare mode frequencies and Q values with the state-space model, requiring frequency deviations under 5%; check in particular whether the measured attenuation near 10 Hz is dominated by vertical coupling. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單擺傳遞函數」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pendulum transfer function” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鋼絲或石英纖維的小提琴模態（數百 Hz）與葉片彈簧內部模態 Q 值極高，若落在偵測頻帶內而未阻尼或未用陷波濾波處理，會在靈敏度曲線上留下一整排尖峰並在控制迴路中引發不穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Violin modes of the wires or silica fibres (hundreds of hertz) and internal blade-spring modes have extremely high Q; if they fall inside the detection band without damping or notch filtering they leave a comb of sharp lines in the sensitivity curve and can destabilise the control loops. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是每一級都引入一個高 Q 的共振模態，必須在不注入感測器雜訊的前提下加以阻尼；Virgo 的超級衰減器更把倒立擺放在最上層，把起始共振壓到 0.03 Hz 量級。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is a high-Q resonant mode per stage that must be damped without injecting sensor noise; the Virgo superattenuator goes further by placing an inverted pendulum at the top, pushing the first resonance down to the 0.03 Hz level.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋」與「垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution" and "Vertical isolation, blade springs and the actuation hierarchy": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熔融石英纖維與單體末級」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fused-silica fibres and the monolithic final stage” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 依漲落–耗散定理，懸吊的熱雜訊由機械損耗角 φ 決定：鋼的 φ 約 10⁻³，熔融石英的本體 φ 可低到 10⁻⁷，所以 Advanced LIGO 的末級把 40 kg 石英測試質量以四根焊接的石英纖維吊起，形成單體結構。擺的回復力大部分來自無損耗的重力，只有纖維彎曲儲存的彈性能帶損耗，因此有效損耗角被「稀釋」為 φ_pend = φ_mat·D；纖維越細、張力越高，稀釋越強，但強度安全係數也越低，兩者必須一起設計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熔融石英纖維與單體末級」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: By the fluctuation–dissipation theorem suspension thermal noise is set by the mechanical loss angle φ: steel has φ ≈ 10⁻³ while bulk fused silica reaches 10⁻⁷, so the Advanced LIGO final stage hangs the 40 kg silica test mass from four welded silica fibres as a monolithic assembly. Most of the pendulum's restoring force comes from lossless gravity and only the elastic energy stored in fibre bending is lossy, so the effective loss angle is diluted to φ_pend = φ_mat·D; thinner fibres under higher tension dilute more strongly but lower the strength safety factor, so the two are designed together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fused-silica fibres and the monolithic final stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：40 kg 由 4 根直徑 0.4 mm 的纖維分擔：每根張力 T = 98 N，截面 1.26×10⁻⁷ m²，應力 780 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 40 kg shared by 4 fibres of 0.4 mm diameter: tension T = 98 N per fibre, cross-section 1.26×10⁻⁷ m², stress 780 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「纖維越粗越安全，而且對雜訊沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熔融石英纖維與單體末級」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fused-silica fibres and the monolithic final stage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋
knowledge.titleEn: Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution
knowledge.text: 依漲落–耗散定理，懸吊的熱雜訊由機械損耗角 φ 決定：鋼的 φ 約 10⁻³，熔融石英的本體 φ 可低到 10⁻⁷，所以 Advanced LIGO 的末級把 40 kg 石英測試質量以四根焊接的石英纖維吊起，形成單體結構。擺的回復力大部分來自無損耗的重力，只有纖維彎曲儲存的彈性能帶損耗，因此有效損耗角被「稀釋」為 φ_pend = φ_mat·D；纖維越細、張力越高，稀釋越強，但強度安全係數也越低，兩者必須一起設計。

Most of the pendulum's restoring force comes from lossless gravity and only the elastic energy stored in fibre bending is lossy, so the effective loss angle is diluted to φ_pend = φ_mat·D; thinner fibres under higher tension dilute more strongly but lower the strength safety factor, so the two are designed together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：纖維越粗越安全，而且對雜訊沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution" is correct?
options: 依漲落–耗散定理，懸吊的熱雜訊由機械損耗角 φ 決定：鋼的 φ 約 10⁻³，熔融石英的本體 φ 可低到 10⁻⁷，所以 Advanced LIGO 的末級把 40 kg 石英測試質量以四根焊接的石英纖維吊起，形成單體結構。

Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise.
Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熔融石英纖維與單體末級」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fused-silica fibres and the monolithic final stage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：40 kg 由 4 根直徑 0.4 mm 的纖維分擔：每根張力 T = 98 N，截面 1.26×10⁻⁷ m²，應力 780 MPa。稀釋因子 D ≈ √(EI/T)/l：E = 72 GPa、I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴、l = 0.6 m，D ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³，φ_pend ≈ 1.6×10⁻¹⁰。10 Hz 的熱雜訊 x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵)，代入 m = 40 kg、ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s、ω = 62.8 rad/s，x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz，對 4 km 相當於 h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 40 kg shared by 4 fibres of 0.4 mm diameter: tension T = 98 N per fibre, cross-section 1.26×10⁻⁷ m², stress 780 MPa. Dilution factor D ≈ √(EI/T)/l with E = 72 GPa, I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴ and l = 0.6 m gives D ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³, so φ_pend ≈ 1.6×10⁻¹⁰. The thermal noise at 10 Hz, x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵) with m = 40 kg, ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s and ω = 62.8 rad/s, is x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, equivalent to h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz over 4 km. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雷射輪廓儀量纖維沿長度的直徑（±1%）並做比例負載的強度測試；用小提琴模態的振鈴衰減量 Q 值，目標在 10⁸ 以上；把量到的 φ 代入熱雜訊模型，與 DARM 在 10–50 Hz 的雜訊預算比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Profile the fibre diameter along its length with a laser profiler (±1%) and proof-test it at a proportional load; measure Q from the ring-down of the violin modes, targeting above 10⁸; insert the measured φ into the thermal-noise model and compare with the DARM noise budget between 10 and 50 Hz.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
