knowledge.textEn: 40 kg shared by 4 fibres of 0.4 mm diameter: tension T = 98 N per fibre, cross-section 1.26×10⁻⁷ m², stress 780 MPa. Dilution factor D ≈ √(EI/T)/l with E = 72 GPa, I = πr⁴/4 = 1.26×10⁻¹⁵ m⁴ and l = 0.6 m gives D ≈ 9.6×10⁻⁴/0.6 = 1.6×10⁻³, so φ_pend ≈ 1.6×10⁻¹⁰. The thermal noise at 10 Hz, x² = 4k_B·T·ω₀²·φ_pend/(m·ω⁵) with m = 40 kg, ω₀ = 4.0 rad/s and ω = 62.8 rad/s, is x ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, equivalent to h ≈ 8×10⁻²⁴/√Hz over 4 km.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution", which statement holds?
options: 總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。
40 kg 由 4 根直徑 0.4 mm 的纖維分擔：每根張力 T = 98 N，截面 1.26×10⁻⁷ m²，應力 780 MPa。
懸吊安裝完成後就不再需要維護與重新校正。
optionsEn: Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms.
40 kg shared by 4 fibres of 0.4 mm diameter: tension T = 98 N per fibre, cross-section 1.26×10⁻⁷ m², stress 780 MPa.
Once installed, a suspension needs no maintenance or recalibration.
quiz.explanation: 40 kg 由 4 根直徑 0.4 mm 的纖維分擔：每根張力 T = 98 N，截面 1.26×10⁻⁷ m²，應力 780 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 40 kg shared by 4 fibres of 0.4 mm diameter: tension T = 98 N per fibre, cross-section 1.26×10⁻⁷ m², stress 780 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「熔融石英纖維與單體末級」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fused-silica fibres and the monolithic final stage” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以雷射輪廓儀量纖維沿長度的直徑（±1%）並做比例負載的強度測試；用小提琴模態的振鈴衰減量 Q 值，目標在 10⁸ 以上；把量到的 φ 代入熱雜訊模型，與 DARM 在 10–50 Hz 的雜訊預算比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Profile the fibre diameter along its length with a laser profiler (±1%) and proof-test it at a proportional load; measure Q from the ring-down of the violin modes, targeting above 10⁸; insert the measured φ into the thermal-noise model and compare with the DARM noise budget between 10 and 50 Hz. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：纖維表面的微裂或污染降低強度，在地震或搬運時斷裂，整個單體末級報廢；若退回鋼絲懸吊，熱雜訊上升約兩個數量級；焊接殘留應力則提高局部損耗，讓熱雜訊高於模型。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Surface microcracks or contamination lower the fibre strength and it breaks during an earthquake or transport, scrapping the whole monolithic stage; reverting to steel wires raises thermal noise by about two orders of magnitude, and residual weld stress raises local loss so that thermal noise exceeds the model.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以雷射輪廓儀量纖維沿長度的直徑（±1%）並做比例負載的強度測試；用小提琴模態的振鈴衰減量 Q 值，目標在 10⁸ 以上；把量到的 φ 代入熱雜訊模型，與 DARM 在 10–50 Hz 的雜訊預算比較。
knowledge.textEn: Profile the fibre diameter along its length with a laser profiler (±1%) and proof-test it at a proportional load; measure Q from the ring-down of the violin modes, targeting above 10⁸; insert the measured φ into the thermal-noise model and compare with the DARM noise budget between 10 and 50 Hz.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。
以雷射輪廓儀量纖維沿長度的直徑（±1%）並做比例負載的強度測試。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation.
Profile the fibre diameter along its length with a laser profiler (±1%) and proof-test it at a proportional load.
quiz.explanation: 以雷射輪廓儀量纖維沿長度的直徑（±1%）並做比例負載的強度測試；用小提琴模態的振鈴衰減量 Q 值，目標在 10⁸ 以上；把量到的 φ 代入熱雜訊模型，與 DARM 在 10–50 Hz 的雜訊預算比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Profile the fibre diameter along its length with a laser profiler (±1%) and proof-test it at a proportional load; measure Q from the ring-down of the violin modes, targeting above 10⁸; insert the measured φ into the thermal-noise model and compare with the DARM noise budget between 10 and 50 Hz. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熔融石英纖維與單體末級」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fused-silica fibres and the monolithic final stage” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 纖維表面的微裂或污染降低強度，在地震或搬運時斷裂，整個單體末級報廢；若退回鋼絲懸吊，熱雜訊上升約兩個數量級；焊接殘留應力則提高局部損耗，讓熱雜訊高於模型。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Surface microcracks or contamination lower the fibre strength and it breaks during an earthquake or transport, scrapping the whole monolithic stage; reverting to steel wires raises thermal noise by about two orders of magnitude, and residual weld stress raises local loss so that thermal noise exceeds the model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：擺的回復力大部分來自無損耗的重力，只有纖維彎曲儲存的彈性能帶損耗，因此有效損耗角被「稀釋」為 φ_pend = φ_mat·D；纖維越細、張力越高，稀釋越強，但強度安全係數也越低，兩者必須一起設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Most of the pendulum's restoring force comes from lossless gravity and only the elastic energy stored in fibre bending is lossy, so the effective loss angle is diluted to φ_pend = φ_mat·D; thinner fibres under higher tension dilute more strongly but lower the strength safety factor, so the two are designed together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「纖維越粗越安全，而且對雜訊沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 纖維表面的微裂或污染降低強度，在地震或搬運時斷裂，整個單體末級報廢；若退回鋼絲懸吊，熱雜訊上升約兩個數量級；焊接殘留應力則提高局部損耗，讓熱雜訊高於模型。
knowledge.textEn: Surface microcracks or contamination lower the fibre strength and it breaks during an earthquake or transport, scrapping the whole monolithic stage; reverting to steel wires raises thermal noise by about two orders of magnitude, and residual weld stress raises local loss so that thermal noise exceeds the model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱雜訊、損耗角與擺動稀釋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal noise, loss angle and pendulum dilution" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 纖維表面的微裂或污染降低強度，在地震或搬運時斷裂，整個單體末級報廢；若退回鋼絲懸吊，熱雜訊上升約兩個數量級；焊接殘留應力則提高局部損耗，讓熱雜訊高於模型。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。
optionsEn: Surface microcracks or contamination lower the fibre strength and it breaks during an earthquake or transport, scrapping the whole monolithic stage.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length.
quiz.explanation: 纖維表面的微裂或污染降低強度，在地震或搬運時斷裂，整個單體末級報廢；若退回鋼絲懸吊，熱雜訊上升約兩個數量級；焊接殘留應力則提高局部損耗，讓熱雜訊高於模型。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface microcracks or contamination lower the fibre strength and it breaks during an earthquake or transport, scrapping the whole monolithic stage; reverting to steel wires raises thermal noise by about two orders of magnitude, and residual weld stress raises local loss so that thermal noise exceeds the model. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Vertical isolation, blade springs and the actuation hierarchy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「葉片彈簧與致動層級」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Blade springs and actuator hierarchy” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每一級用預彎的馬氏體時效鋼三角形懸臂葉片提供垂直柔度，把垂直共振壓到 2–3 Hz；由於地球曲率與不對稱，垂直殘餘運動會以約 10⁻³ 的比例變成水平。致動依層級分配：頂端質量用線圈–磁鐵（OSEM）做大行程、毫米級的位置修正，倒數第二級用小線圈，測試質量只用靜電驅動施加奈牛頓級的力；反作用鏈與主鏈平行懸吊，使致動器不是推在震動的框架上。這種層級設計讓致動器的電子雜訊在測試質量上低於 10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「葉片彈簧與致動層級」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each stage uses pre-curved triangular maraging-steel cantilever blades for vertical compliance, bringing the vertical resonances down to 2–3 Hz; through Earth curvature and asymmetries the residual vertical motion turns horizontal at about 10⁻³. Actuation is allocated by hierarchy: the top mass uses coil–magnet OSEMs for large, millimetre-scale corrections, the penultimate mass small coils, and the test mass only an electrostatic drive delivering nanonewton forces; a reaction chain hangs beside the main chain so the actuators do not push against a vibrating frame. This hierarchy keeps actuator electronics noise below 10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz at the test mass. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Blade springs and actuator hierarchy”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：垂直路徑：f_v = 2.5 Hz，單級在 10 Hz 衰減 (2.5/10)² = 0.0625，四級 1.5×10⁻⁵；若測試質量層級的垂直殘餘為 10⁻¹⁶ m/√Hz，乘上 6.3×10⁻⁴ 的曲率耦合即為 6.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz，已達目標等級。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vertical path: f_v = 2.5 Hz, one stage attenuates (2.5/10)² = 0.0625 at 10 Hz and four stages 1.5×10⁻⁵; a vertical residual of 10⁻¹⁶ m/√Hz at the test-mass level times the 6.3×10⁻⁴ curvature coupling is 6.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, already at the target level.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「葉片彈簧與致動層級」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Blade springs and actuator hierarchy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級
knowledge.titleEn: Vertical isolation, blade springs and the actuation hierarchy
knowledge.text: 每一級用預彎的馬氏體時效鋼三角形懸臂葉片提供垂直柔度，把垂直共振壓到 2–3 Hz；由於地球曲率與不對稱，垂直殘餘運動會以約 10⁻³ 的比例變成水平。致動依層級分配：頂端質量用線圈–磁鐵（OSEM）做大行程、毫米級的位置修正，倒數第二級用小線圈，測試質量只用靜電驅動施加奈牛頓級的力；反作用鏈與主鏈平行懸吊，使致動器不是推在震動的框架上。
knowledge.textEn: Each stage uses pre-curved triangular maraging-steel cantilever blades for vertical compliance, bringing the vertical resonances down to 2–3 Hz; through Earth curvature and asymmetries the residual vertical motion turns horizontal at about 10⁻³. Actuation is allocated by hierarchy: the top mass uses coil–magnet OSEMs for large, millimetre-scale corrections, the penultimate mass small coils, and the test mass only an electrostatic drive delivering nanonewton forces; a reaction chain hangs beside the main chain so the actuators do not push against a vibrating frame.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vertical isolation, blade springs and the actuation hierarchy" is correct?
options: 只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。
每一級用預彎的馬氏體時效鋼三角形懸臂葉片提供垂直柔度，把垂直共振壓到 2–3 Hz；由於地球曲率與不對稱，垂直殘餘運動會以約 10⁻³ 的比例變成水平。
阻尼越強越好，振盪越快停下來就越安全。
optionsEn: Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length.
Each stage uses pre-curved triangular maraging-steel cantilever blades for vertical compliance, bringing the vertical resonances down to 2–3 Hz.
Stronger damping is always better because the oscillation stops sooner.
quiz.explanation: 每一級用預彎的馬氏體時效鋼三角形懸臂葉片提供垂直柔度，把垂直共振壓到 2–3 Hz；由於地球曲率與不對稱，垂直殘餘運動會以約 10⁻³ 的比例變成水平。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each stage uses pre-curved triangular maraging-steel cantilever blades for vertical compliance, bringing the vertical resonances down to 2–3 Hz; through Earth curvature and asymmetries the residual vertical motion turns horizontal at about 10⁻³. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vertical isolation, blade springs and the actuation hierarchy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「葉片彈簧與致動層級」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Blade springs and actuator hierarchy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：垂直路徑：f_v = 2.5 Hz，單級在 10 Hz 衰減 (2.5/10)² = 0.0625，四級 1.5×10⁻⁵；若測試質量層級的垂直殘餘為 10⁻¹⁶ m/√Hz，乘上 6.3×10⁻⁴ 的曲率耦合即為 6.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz，已達目標等級。靜電驅動：F = α·V_bias·V_sig，α = 2×10⁻¹⁰ N/V²、V_bias = 400 V 時每伏特 8×10⁻⁸ N，在 10 Hz 對 40 kg 的位移 x = F/(mω²) = 5×10⁻¹³ m/V；DAC 雜訊 10⁻⁷ V/√Hz 給 5×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vertical path: f_v = 2.5 Hz, one stage attenuates (2.5/10)² = 0.0625 at 10 Hz and four stages 1.5×10⁻⁵; a vertical residual of 10⁻¹⁶ m/√Hz at the test-mass level times the 6.3×10⁻⁴ curvature coupling is 6.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, already at the target level. Electrostatic drive: F = α·V_bias·V_sig with α = 2×10⁻¹⁰ N/V² and V_bias = 400 V gives 8×10⁻⁸ N per volt, a displacement at 10 Hz on 40 kg of x = F/(mω²) = 5×10⁻¹³ m/V; DAC noise of 10⁻⁷ V/√Hz yields 5×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以葉片激振量垂直傳遞函數並比對模型；用干涉儀或光學槓桿校正每一層致動器的力／電壓常數；量測致動的交叉耦合矩陣（垂直→水平、傾斜→長度）；掃描靜電驅動偏壓，由力對偏壓的線性關係推算測試質量上的殘留電荷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Excite the blades to measure the vertical transfer function and compare with the model; calibrate the force-per-volt constant of each actuation layer with the interferometer or an optical lever; measure the actuation cross-coupling matrix (vertical→horizontal, tilt→length); sweep the electrostatic-drive bias and infer residual charge on the test mass from the linearity of force versus bias.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 垂直路徑：f_v = 2.5 Hz，單級在 10 Hz 衰減 (2.5/10)² = 0.0625，四級 1.5×10⁻⁵；若測試質量層級的垂直殘餘為 10⁻¹⁶ m/√Hz，乘上 6.3×10⁻⁴ 的曲率耦合即為 6.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz，已達目標等級。靜電驅動：F = α·V_bias·V_sig，α = 2×10⁻¹⁰ N/V²、V_bias = 400 V 時每伏特 8×10⁻⁸ N，在 10 Hz 對 40 kg 的位移 x = F/(mω²) = 5×10⁻¹³ m/V；DAC 雜訊 10⁻⁷ V/√Hz 給 5×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Vertical path: f_v = 2.5 Hz, one stage attenuates (2.5/10)² = 0.0625 at 10 Hz and four stages 1.5×10⁻⁵; a vertical residual of 10⁻¹⁶ m/√Hz at the test-mass level times the 6.3×10⁻⁴ curvature coupling is 6.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, already at the target level. Electrostatic drive: F = α·V_bias·V_sig with α = 2×10⁻¹⁰ N/V² and V_bias = 400 V gives 8×10⁻⁸ N per volt, a displacement at 10 Hz on 40 kg of x = F/(mω²) = 5×10⁻¹³ m/V; DAC noise of 10⁻⁷ V/√Hz yields 5×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.explanationEn: Vertical path: f_v = 2.5 Hz, one stage attenuates (2.5/10)² = 0.0625 at 10 Hz and four stages 1.5×10⁻⁵; a vertical residual of 10⁻¹⁶ m/√Hz at the test-mass level times the 6.3×10⁻⁴ curvature coupling is 6.3×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz, already at the target level. steps.title: 垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vertical isolation, blade springs and the actuation hierarchy: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「葉片彈簧與致動層級」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Blade springs and actuator hierarchy” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以葉片激振量垂直傳遞函數並比對模型；用干涉儀或光學槓桿校正每一層致動器的力／電壓常數；量測致動的交叉耦合矩陣（垂直→水平、傾斜→長度）；掃描靜電驅動偏壓，由力對偏壓的線性關係推算測試質量上的殘留電荷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Excite the blades to measure the vertical transfer function and compare with the model; calibrate the force-per-volt constant of each actuation layer with the interferometer or an optical lever; measure the actuation cross-coupling matrix (vertical→horizontal, tilt→length); sweep the electrostatic-drive bias and infer residual charge on the test mass from the linearity of force versus bias. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：測試質量累積電荷後，靜電驅動的力隨電荷變化而漂移並引入力雜訊；馬氏體時效鋼葉片在熱處理後仍會潛變，數月後懸吊高度與對準改變，致動器行程被吃掉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Charge accumulating on the test mass makes the electrostatic-drive force drift with charge and injects force noise; maraging-steel blades keep creeping after heat treatment, so months later the suspension height and alignment have changed and actuator range is consumed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以葉片激振量垂直傳遞函數並比對模型；用干涉儀或光學槓桿校正每一層致動器的力／電壓常數；量測致動的交叉耦合矩陣（垂直→水平、傾斜→長度）；掃描靜電驅動偏壓，由力對偏壓的線性關係推算測試質量上的殘留電荷。
knowledge.textEn: Excite the blades to measure the vertical transfer function and compare with the model; calibrate the force-per-volt constant of each actuation layer with the interferometer or an optical lever; measure the actuation cross-coupling matrix (vertical→horizontal, tilt→length); sweep the electrostatic-drive bias and infer residual charge on the test mass from the linearity of force versus bias.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 以葉片激振量垂直傳遞函數並比對模型。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanationEn: Excite the blades to measure the vertical transfer function and compare with the model; calibrate the force-per-volt constant of each actuation layer with the interferometer or an optical lever; measure the actuation cross-coupling matrix (vertical→horizontal, tilt→length); sweep the electrostatic-drive bias and infer residual charge on the test mass from the linearity of force versus bias. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vertical isolation, blade springs and the actuation hierarchy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「葉片彈簧與致動層級」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Blade springs and actuator hierarchy” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 測試質量累積電荷後，靜電驅動的力隨電荷變化而漂移並引入力雜訊；馬氏體時效鋼葉片在熱處理後仍會潛變，數月後懸吊高度與對準改變，致動器行程被吃掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Charge accumulating on the test mass makes the electrostatic-drive force drift with charge and injects force noise; maraging-steel blades keep creeping after heat treatment, so months later the suspension height and alignment have changed and actuator range is consumed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種層級設計讓致動器的電子雜訊在測試質量上低於 10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This hierarchy keeps actuator electronics noise below 10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz at the test mass.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 測試質量累積電荷後，靜電驅動的力隨電荷變化而漂移並引入力雜訊；馬氏體時效鋼葉片在熱處理後仍會潛變，數月後懸吊高度與對準改變，致動器行程被吃掉。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「垂直隔振、葉片彈簧與致動層級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vertical isolation, blade springs and the actuation hierarchy" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
測試質量累積電荷後，靜電驅動的力隨電荷變化而漂移並引入力雜訊；馬氏體時效鋼葉片在熱處理後仍會潛變，數月後懸吊高度與對準改變，致動器行程被吃掉。
阻尼越強越好，振盪越快停下來就越安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Charge accumulating on the test mass makes the electrostatic-drive force drift with charge and injects force noise.
Stronger damping is always better because the oscillation stops sooner.
quiz.explanation: 測試質量累積電荷後，靜電驅動的力隨電荷變化而漂移並引入力雜訊；馬氏體時效鋼葉片在熱處理後仍會潛變，數月後懸吊高度與對準改變，致動器行程被吃掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Charge accumulating on the test mass makes the electrostatic-drive force drift with charge and injects force noise; maraging-steel blades keep creeping after heat treatment, so months later the suspension height and alignment have changed and actuator range is consumed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計」與「雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Local damping, sensor noise and loop design" and "Noise budget and the sensitivity curve": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Local damping, sensor noise and loop design: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「影子感測器與阻尼迴路」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shadow sensors and damping loops” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擺的模態 Q 值可達 10⁵ 以上，一旦被擾動會振盪數小時，必須用頂端質量上的影子感測器與線圈做主動阻尼，把 Q 降到約 10。但感測器雜訊會隨迴路推回懸吊，雖然下面三級以約 1/f⁶ 衰減，在 10 Hz 仍可能高於熱雜訊，所以阻尼迴路必須在偵測頻帶內急遽滾降（低通與橢圓濾波器），只在共振頻率附近有增益。Virgo 則在倒立擺頂端以加速度計做慣性阻尼。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影子感測器與阻尼迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pendulum modes with Q above 10⁵ ring for hours once disturbed, so shadow sensors and coils on the top mass provide active damping that brings Q to about 10. Sensor noise, however, is pushed back into the suspension by the loop; although the three lower stages attenuate it by roughly 1/f⁶, at 10 Hz it can still exceed thermal noise, so the damping loop must roll off steeply inside the detection band (low-pass and elliptic filters) and keep gain only around the resonances. Virgo instead damps inertially with accelerometers at the top of the inverted pendulum. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Shadow sensors and damping loops”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：影子感測器雜訊取 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz（10 Hz）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take shadow-sensor noise as 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz at 10 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼越強越好，振盪越快停下來就越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stronger damping is always better because the oscillation stops sooner." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「影子感測器與阻尼迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Shadow sensors and damping loops”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計
knowledge.titleEn: Local damping, sensor noise and loop design
knowledge.text: 擺的模態 Q 值可達 10⁵ 以上，一旦被擾動會振盪數小時，必須用頂端質量上的影子感測器與線圈做主動阻尼，把 Q 降到約 10。但感測器雜訊會隨迴路推回懸吊，雖然下面三級以約 1/f⁶ 衰減，在 10 Hz 仍可能高於熱雜訊，所以阻尼迴路必須在偵測頻帶內急遽滾降（低通與橢圓濾波器），只在共振頻率附近有增益。
knowledge.textEn: Pendulum modes with Q above 10⁵ ring for hours once disturbed, so shadow sensors and coils on the top mass provide active damping that brings Q to about 10. Sensor noise, however, is pushed back into the suspension by the loop; although the three lower stages attenuate it by roughly 1/f⁶, at 10 Hz it can still exceed thermal noise, so the damping loop must roll off steeply inside the detection band (low-pass and elliptic filters) and keep gain only around the resonances.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼越強越好，振盪越快停下來就越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stronger damping is always better because the oscillation stops sooner. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Local damping, sensor noise and loop design" is correct?
options: 阻尼越強越好，振盪越快停下來就越安全。
總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。
擺的模態 Q 值可達 10⁵ 以上，一旦被擾動會振盪數小時，必須用頂端質量上的影子感測器與線圈做主動阻尼，把 Q 降到約 10。
optionsEn: Stronger damping is always better because the oscillation stops sooner.
Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms.
Pendulum modes with Q above 10⁵ ring for hours once disturbed, so shadow sensors and coils on the top mass provide active damping that brings Q to about 10.
quiz.explanation: 擺的模態 Q 值可達 10⁵ 以上，一旦被擾動會振盪數小時，必須用頂端質量上的影子感測器與線圈做主動阻尼，把 Q 降到約 10。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pendulum modes with Q above 10⁵ ring for hours once disturbed, so shadow sensors and coils on the top mass provide active damping that brings Q to about 10. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local damping, sensor noise and loop design: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「影子感測器與阻尼迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shadow sensors and damping loops” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：影子感測器雜訊取 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz（10 Hz）。從頂端質量到測試質量三級的衰減 (0.64/10)⁶ = 7×10⁻⁸，若迴路在 10 Hz 增益為 1，注入的雜訊為 7×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz，比 10⁻¹⁹ 的目標高 70 倍；因此迴路在 10 Hz 的增益必須至少再降 40 dB（×0.01），注入量才降到 7×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take shadow-sensor noise as 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz at 10 Hz. Three stages from top mass to test mass attenuate by (0.64/10)⁶ = 7×10⁻⁸, so with unity loop gain at 10 Hz the injected noise is 7×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz, 70 times the 10⁻¹⁹ target; the loop gain at 10 Hz must therefore be cut by at least a further 40 dB (×0.01) to bring the injection down to 7×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用掃頻量阻尼迴路的開迴路傳遞函數，確認相位裕度與偵測頻帶內的滾降；比較阻尼開／關時各模態的振鈴時間；做雜訊注入測試——把迴路增益提高 10 倍，觀察 DARM 在 10–30 Hz 是否變化，藉此推算正常增益下的注入量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the damping loop's open-loop transfer function with swept sine to confirm phase margin and the in-band roll-off; compare mode ring-down times with damping on and off; perform a noise-injection test by raising the loop gain tenfold and watching whether DARM changes between 10 and 30 Hz, from which the injection at normal gain is inferred.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 影子感測器雜訊取 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz（10 Hz）。從頂端質量到測試質量三級的衰減 (0.64/10)⁶ = 7×10⁻⁸，若迴路在 10 Hz 增益為 1，注入的雜訊為 7×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz，比 10⁻¹⁹ 的目標高 70 倍；因此迴路在 10 Hz 的增益必須至少再降 40 dB（×0.01），注入量才降到 7×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Take shadow-sensor noise as 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz at 10 Hz. Three stages from top mass to test mass attenuate by (0.64/10)⁶ = 7×10⁻⁸, so with unity loop gain at 10 Hz the injected noise is 7×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz, 70 times the 10⁻¹⁹ target; the loop gain at 10 Hz must therefore be cut by at least a further 40 dB (×0.01) to bring the injection down to 7×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Local damping, sensor noise and loop design", which statement holds?
options: 影子感測器雜訊取 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz（10 Hz）。
懸吊安裝完成後就不再需要維護與重新校正。
懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。
optionsEn: Take shadow-sensor noise as 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz at 10 Hz.
Once installed, a suspension needs no maintenance or recalibration.
More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost.
quiz.explanation: 影子感測器雜訊取 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz（10 Hz）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take shadow-sensor noise as 10⁻¹⁰ m/√Hz at 10 Hz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local damping, sensor noise and loop design: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「影子感測器與阻尼迴路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Shadow sensors and damping loops” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用掃頻量阻尼迴路的開迴路傳遞函數，確認相位裕度與偵測頻帶內的滾降；比較阻尼開／關時各模態的振鈴時間；做雜訊注入測試——把迴路增益提高 10 倍，觀察 DARM 在 10–30 Hz 是否變化，藉此推算正常增益下的注入量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the damping loop's open-loop transfer function with swept sine to confirm phase margin and the in-band roll-off; compare mode ring-down times with damping on and off; perform a noise-injection test by raising the loop gain tenfold and watching whether DARM changes between 10 and 30 Hz, from which the injection at normal gain is inferred. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：阻尼增益過大時感測器雜訊進入頻帶，靈敏度在 10–30 Hz 被懸吊控制雜訊限制；增益過小則失鎖後擺動要幾十分鐘才平息，重新鎖定時間拉長。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Too much damping gain lets sensor noise into the band and sensitivity between 10 and 30 Hz becomes limited by suspension control noise; too little leaves the pendulum swinging for tens of minutes after a lock loss and stretches the relock time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用掃頻量阻尼迴路的開迴路傳遞函數，確認相位裕度與偵測頻帶內的滾降；比較阻尼開／關時各模態的振鈴時間；做雜訊注入測試——把迴路增益提高 10 倍，觀察 DARM 在 10–30 Hz 是否變化，藉此推算正常增益下的注入量。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the damping loop's open-loop transfer function with swept sine to confirm phase margin and the in-band roll-off; compare mode ring-down times with damping on and off; perform a noise-injection test by raising the loop gain tenfold and watching whether DARM changes between 10 and 30 Hz, from which the injection at normal gain is inferred.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local damping, sensor noise and loop design"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用掃頻量阻尼迴路的開迴路傳遞函數，確認相位裕度與偵測頻帶內的滾降。
纖維越粗越安全，而且對雜訊沒有影響。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure the damping loop's open-loop transfer function with swept sine to confirm phase margin and the in-band roll-off.
Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise.
quiz.explanation: 用掃頻量阻尼迴路的開迴路傳遞函數，確認相位裕度與偵測頻帶內的滾降；比較阻尼開／關時各模態的振鈴時間；做雜訊注入測試——把迴路增益提高 10 倍，觀察 DARM 在 10–30 Hz 是否變化，藉此推算正常增益下的注入量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the damping loop's open-loop transfer function with swept sine to confirm phase margin and the in-band roll-off; compare mode ring-down times with damping on and off; perform a noise-injection test by raising the loop gain tenfold and watching whether DARM changes between 10 and 30 Hz, from which the injection at normal gain is inferred. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local damping, sensor noise and loop design: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「影子感測器與阻尼迴路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Shadow sensors and damping loops” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 阻尼增益過大時感測器雜訊進入頻帶，靈敏度在 10–30 Hz 被懸吊控制雜訊限制；增益過小則失鎖後擺動要幾十分鐘才平息，重新鎖定時間拉長。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Too much damping gain lets sensor noise into the band and sensitivity between 10 and 30 Hz becomes limited by suspension control noise; too little leaves the pendulum swinging for tens of minutes after a lock loss and stretches the relock time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Virgo 則在倒立擺頂端以加速度計做慣性阻尼。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Virgo instead damps inertially with accelerometers at the top of the inverted pendulum.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼越強越好，振盪越快停下來就越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stronger damping is always better because the oscillation stops sooner." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 阻尼增益過大時感測器雜訊進入頻帶，靈敏度在 10–30 Hz 被懸吊控制雜訊限制；增益過小則失鎖後擺動要幾十分鐘才平息，重新鎖定時間拉長。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部阻尼、感測器雜訊與迴路設計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local damping, sensor noise and loop design" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。
阻尼增益過大時感測器雜訊進入頻帶，靈敏度在 10–30 Hz 被懸吊控制雜訊限制；增益過小則失鎖後擺動要幾十分鐘才平息，重新鎖定時間拉長。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms.
Too much damping gain lets sensor noise into the band and sensitivity between 10 and 30 Hz becomes limited by suspension control noise.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼增益過大時感測器雜訊進入頻帶，靈敏度在 10–30 Hz 被懸吊控制雜訊限制；增益過小則失鎖後擺動要幾十分鐘才平息，重新鎖定時間拉長。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Too much damping gain lets sensor noise into the band and sensitivity between 10 and 30 Hz becomes limited by suspension control noise; too little leaves the pendulum swinging for tens of minutes after a lock loss and stretches the relock time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Noise budget and the sensitivity curve: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「懸吊雜訊預算表」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suspension noise-budget table” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把殘餘地震、擺動熱雜訊、小提琴模態、垂直熱雜訊、致動器雜訊、感測器注入與牛頓雜訊各自寫成位移功率譜密度，以平方和開根號相加，再除以臂長 L 換成應變；與實測 DARM 比較就能看出哪一段頻率由懸吊支配（通常在 10–40 Hz）。預算表不是一次做完的文件，而是每次改動濾波器、換纖維或重新校正致動器後都要更新的工程工具。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「懸吊雜訊預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Write residual seismic, pendulum thermal, violin-mode, vertical thermal, actuator, sensor-injection and Newtonian noise each as a displacement power spectral density, add them in quadrature and divide by the arm length L to convert to strain; comparing with the measured DARM shows where the suspension dominates, typically 10–40 Hz. The budget is not a one-off document but an engineering tool updated whenever a filter changes, a fibre is replaced or an actuator is recalibrated. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Suspension noise-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：在 20 Hz 取殘餘地震 1×10⁻¹⁹、懸吊熱雜訊 2×10⁻²⁰、致動器 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz：總和 √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，對 L = 4 km 為 h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 20 Hz take residual seismic 1×10⁻¹⁹, suspension thermal 2×10⁻²⁰ and actuator 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz: the sum √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, or h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz for L = 4 km.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「懸吊雜訊預算表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Suspension noise-budget table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線
knowledge.titleEn: Noise budget and the sensitivity curve
knowledge.text: 把殘餘地震、擺動熱雜訊、小提琴模態、垂直熱雜訊、致動器雜訊、感測器注入與牛頓雜訊各自寫成位移功率譜密度，以平方和開根號相加，再除以臂長 L 換成應變；與實測 DARM 比較就能看出哪一段頻率由懸吊支配（通常在 10–40 Hz）。預算表不是一次做完的文件，而是每次改動濾波器、換纖維或重新校正致動器後都要更新的工程工具。
knowledge.textEn: Write residual seismic, pendulum thermal, violin-mode, vertical thermal, actuator, sensor-injection and Newtonian noise each as a displacement power spectral density, add them in quadrature and divide by the arm length L to convert to strain; comparing with the measured DARM shows where the suspension dominates, typically 10–40 Hz. The budget is not a one-off document but an engineering tool updated whenever a filter changes, a fibre is replaced or an actuator is recalibrated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Noise budget and the sensitivity curve" is correct?
options: 把殘餘地震、擺動熱雜訊、小提琴模態、垂直熱雜訊、致動器雜訊、感測器注入與牛頓雜訊各自寫成位移功率譜密度，以平方和開根號相加，再除以臂長 L 換成應變。
總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。
鎖定失敗是光學問題，與懸吊無關。
optionsEn: Write residual seismic, pendulum thermal, violin-mode, vertical thermal, actuator, sensor-injection and Newtonian noise each as a displacement power spectral density, add them in quadrature and divide by the arm length L to convert to strain.
Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms.
Lock failures are optical problems unrelated to the suspensions.
quiz.explanation: 把殘餘地震、擺動熱雜訊、小提琴模態、垂直熱雜訊、致動器雜訊、感測器注入與牛頓雜訊各自寫成位移功率譜密度，以平方和開根號相加，再除以臂長 L 換成應變；與實測 DARM 比較就能看出哪一段頻率由懸吊支配（通常在 10–40 Hz）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Write residual seismic, pendulum thermal, violin-mode, vertical thermal, actuator, sensor-injection and Newtonian noise each as a displacement power spectral density, add them in quadrature and divide by the arm length L to convert to strain; comparing with the measured DARM shows where the suspension dominates, typically 10–40 Hz. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Noise budget and the sensitivity curve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「懸吊雜訊預算表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Suspension noise-budget table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：在 20 Hz 取殘餘地震 1×10⁻¹⁹、懸吊熱雜訊 2×10⁻²⁰、致動器 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz：總和 √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，對 L = 4 km 為 h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz。地震項若再降 3 倍，總和降到約 4×10⁻²⁰，此時熱雜訊開始主導；數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 20 Hz take residual seismic 1×10⁻¹⁹, suspension thermal 2×10⁻²⁰ and actuator 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz: the sum √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, or h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz for L = 4 km. Reducing the seismic term by a further factor of 3 brings the total to about 4×10⁻²⁰, where thermal noise starts to dominate; values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在試算表或雜訊預算軟體中建立各項並畫出曲線；以注入測試量化每一項（例如把阻尼增益提高 10 倍看 DARM 變化）；總預算與實測 DARM 的差距應小於 10–20%，否則表示有未建模的耦合（散射光、傾斜耦合）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build each term in a spreadsheet or noise-budget tool and plot the curves; quantify each term by injection tests (for example raising damping gain tenfold and watching DARM); the gap between the total budget and the measured DARM should be below 10–20%, otherwise an unmodelled coupling (scattered light, tilt coupling) is present.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Noise budget and the sensitivity curve", which statement holds?
options: 只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。
在 20 Hz 取殘餘地震 1×10⁻¹⁹、懸吊熱雜訊 2×10⁻²⁰、致動器 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz：總和 √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，對 L = 4 km 為 h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz。
纖維越粗越安全，而且對雜訊沒有影響。
optionsEn: Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation.
At 20 Hz take residual seismic 1×10⁻¹⁹, suspension thermal 2×10⁻²⁰ and actuator 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz: the sum √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, or h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz for L = 4 km.
Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise.
quiz.explanation: 在 20 Hz 取殘餘地震 1×10⁻¹⁹、懸吊熱雜訊 2×10⁻²⁰、致動器 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz：總和 √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，對 L = 4 km 為 h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 20 Hz take residual seismic 1×10⁻¹⁹, suspension thermal 2×10⁻²⁰ and actuator 1×10⁻²⁰ m/√Hz: the sum √(1×10⁻³⁸ + 4×10⁻⁴⁰ + 1×10⁻⁴⁰) = 1.02×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, or h ≈ 2.6×10⁻²³/√Hz for L = 4 km. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Noise budget and the sensitivity curve: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「懸吊雜訊預算表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Suspension noise-budget table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在試算表或雜訊預算軟體中建立各項並畫出曲線；以注入測試量化每一項（例如把阻尼增益提高 10 倍看 DARM 變化）；總預算與實測 DARM 的差距應小於 10–20%，否則表示有未建模的耦合（散射光、傾斜耦合）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build each term in a spreadsheet or noise-budget tool and plot the curves; quantify each term by injection tests (for example raising damping gain tenfold and watching DARM); the gap between the total budget and the measured DARM should be below 10–20%, otherwise an unmodelled coupling (scattered light, tilt coupling) is present. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：懸吊籠架或擋板運動造成的散射光耦合是非線性、非平穩的，在低頻製造「肩狀」雜訊並常被誤判為地震殘餘；只用線性預算表永遠對不上實測曲線。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Scattered-light coupling from motion of the suspension cage or baffles is nonlinear and non-stationary, producing shoulder-shaped noise at low frequency that is often misread as seismic residual; a purely linear budget never matches the measured curve.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在試算表或雜訊預算軟體中建立各項並畫出曲線；以注入測試量化每一項（例如把阻尼增益提高 10 倍看 DARM 變化）；總預算與實測 DARM 的差距應小於 10–20%，否則表示有未建模的耦合（散射光、傾斜耦合）。
knowledge.textEn: Build each term in a spreadsheet or noise-budget tool and plot the curves; quantify each term by injection tests (for example raising damping gain tenfold and watching DARM); the gap between the total budget and the measured DARM should be below 10–20%, otherwise an unmodelled coupling (scattered light, tilt coupling) is present.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Noise budget and the sensitivity curve"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。
在試算表或雜訊預算軟體中建立各項並畫出曲線。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length.
Build each term in a spreadsheet or noise-budget tool and plot the curves.
quiz.explanation: 在試算表或雜訊預算軟體中建立各項並畫出曲線；以注入測試量化每一項（例如把阻尼增益提高 10 倍看 DARM 變化）；總預算與實測 DARM 的差距應小於 10–20%，否則表示有未建模的耦合（散射光、傾斜耦合）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build each term in a spreadsheet or noise-budget tool and plot the curves; quantify each term by injection tests (for example raising damping gain tenfold and watching DARM); the gap between the total budget and the measured DARM should be below 10–20%, otherwise an unmodelled coupling (scattered light, tilt coupling) is present. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Noise budget and the sensitivity curve: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「懸吊雜訊預算表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Suspension noise-budget table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 懸吊籠架或擋板運動造成的散射光耦合是非線性、非平穩的，在低頻製造「肩狀」雜訊並常被誤判為地震殘餘；只用線性預算表永遠對不上實測曲線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Scattered-light coupling from motion of the suspension cage or baffles is nonlinear and non-stationary, producing shoulder-shaped noise at low frequency that is often misread as seismic residual; a purely linear budget never matches the measured curve. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：預算表不是一次做完的文件，而是每次改動濾波器、換纖維或重新校正致動器後都要更新的工程工具。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The budget is not a one-off document but an engineering tool updated whenever a filter changes, a fibre is replaced or an actuator is recalibrated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 懸吊籠架或擋板運動造成的散射光耦合是非線性、非平穩的，在低頻製造「肩狀」雜訊並常被誤判為地震殘餘；只用線性預算表永遠對不上實測曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Scattered-light coupling from motion of the suspension cage or baffles is nonlinear and non-stationary, producing shoulder-shaped noise at low frequency that is often misread as seismic residual; a purely linear budget never matches the measured curve.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雜訊預算與靈敏度曲線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Noise budget and the sensitivity curve" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 懸吊籠架或擋板運動造成的散射光耦合是非線性、非平穩的，在低頻製造「肩狀」雜訊並常被誤判為地震殘餘；只用線性預算表永遠對不上實測曲線。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
鎖定失敗是光學問題，與懸吊無關。
optionsEn: Scattered-light coupling from motion of the suspension cage or baffles is nonlinear and non-stationary, producing shoulder-shaped noise at low frequency that is often misread as seismic residual.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Lock failures are optical problems unrelated to the suspensions.
quiz.explanation: 懸吊籠架或擋板運動造成的散射光耦合是非線性、非平穩的，在低頻製造「肩狀」雜訊並常被誤判為地震殘餘；只用線性預算表永遠對不上實測曲線。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scattered-light coupling from motion of the suspension cage or baffles is nonlinear and non-stationary, producing shoulder-shaped noise at low frequency that is often misread as seismic residual; a purely linear budget never matches the measured curve. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得」與「懸吊驗收、模型校正與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition" and "Suspension acceptance, model fitting and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「真空腔安裝與鎖定取得」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vacuum-chamber installation and lock acquisition” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 懸吊在潔淨室組裝後整組吊入真空腔，腔內壓力約 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級，纖維在搬運與抽氣期間必須加裝保護；抽真空後模態頻率與對準要重新確認，因為空氣阻尼消失、Q 值上升。鎖定取得依賴致動層級把臂腔推到共振：臂腔線寬只有奈米級，測試質量通過共振時的速度必須夠慢，否則來不及建立控制訊號，所以阻尼後的殘餘速度是懸吊交給鎖定系統的關鍵規格。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「真空腔安裝與鎖定取得」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After cleanroom assembly the whole suspension is lifted into a vacuum chamber held near 10⁻⁹ mbar, with fibre guards fitted during transport and pump-down; after evacuation mode frequencies and alignment are re-verified because air damping disappears and Q rises. Lock acquisition relies on the actuation hierarchy to bring the arm cavity onto resonance: the cavity linewidth is only nanometres, and the test mass must cross resonance slowly enough for the control signal to build up, so the damped residual velocity is the key specification the suspension hands to the locking system. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vacuum-chamber installation and lock acquisition”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：臂腔：L = 4 km、精細度 F = 450，自由光譜範圍 c/2L = 37.5 kHz，線寬 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz，換成長度 δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm；光儲存時間 τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms，可捕捉的鏡速 v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Arm cavity: L = 4 km, finesse F = 450, free spectral range c/2L = 37.5 kHz, linewidth 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz, in length δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm; the storage time τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms sets a catchable mirror velocity v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鎖定失敗是光學問題，與懸吊無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lock failures are optical problems unrelated to the suspensions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「真空腔安裝與鎖定取得」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Vacuum-chamber installation and lock acquisition”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得
knowledge.titleEn: Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition
knowledge.text: 懸吊在潔淨室組裝後整組吊入真空腔，腔內壓力約 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級，纖維在搬運與抽氣期間必須加裝保護；抽真空後模態頻率與對準要重新確認，因為空氣阻尼消失、Q 值上升。鎖定取得依賴致動層級把臂腔推到共振：臂腔線寬只有奈米級，測試質量通過共振時的速度必須夠慢，否則來不及建立控制訊號，所以阻尼後的殘餘速度是懸吊交給鎖定系統的關鍵規格。
knowledge.textEn: After cleanroom assembly the whole suspension is lifted into a vacuum chamber held near 10⁻⁹ mbar, with fibre guards fitted during transport and pump-down; after evacuation mode frequencies and alignment are re-verified because air damping disappears and Q rises. Lock acquisition relies on the actuation hierarchy to bring the arm cavity onto resonance: the cavity linewidth is only nanometres, and the test mass must cross resonance slowly enough for the control signal to build up, so the damped residual velocity is the key specification the suspension hands to the locking system.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鎖定失敗是光學問題，與懸吊無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lock failures are optical problems unrelated to the suspensions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition" is correct?
options: 鎖定失敗是光學問題，與懸吊無關。
懸吊在潔淨室組裝後整組吊入真空腔，腔內壓力約 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級，纖維在搬運與抽氣期間必須加裝保護。
懸吊安裝完成後就不再需要維護與重新校正。
optionsEn: Lock failures are optical problems unrelated to the suspensions.
After cleanroom assembly the whole suspension is lifted into a vacuum chamber held near 10⁻⁹ mbar, with fibre guards fitted during transport and pump-down.
Once installed, a suspension needs no maintenance or recalibration.
quiz.explanation: 懸吊在潔淨室組裝後整組吊入真空腔，腔內壓力約 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級，纖維在搬運與抽氣期間必須加裝保護；抽真空後模態頻率與對準要重新確認，因為空氣阻尼消失、Q 值上升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After cleanroom assembly the whole suspension is lifted into a vacuum chamber held near 10⁻⁹ mbar, with fibre guards fitted during transport and pump-down; after evacuation mode frequencies and alignment are re-verified because air damping disappears and Q rises. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「真空腔安裝與鎖定取得」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vacuum-chamber installation and lock acquisition” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臂腔：L = 4 km、精細度 F = 450，自由光譜範圍 c/2L = 37.5 kHz，線寬 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz，換成長度 δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm；光儲存時間 τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms，可捕捉的鏡速 v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s。而 0.15 Hz、振幅 1 µm 的微震給出 v = 2π×0.15×1 µm ≈ 0.9 µm/s，已超過，因此必須靠平台的感測器修正把微震壓下。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Arm cavity: L = 4 km, finesse F = 450, free spectral range c/2L = 37.5 kHz, linewidth 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz, in length δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm; the storage time τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms sets a catchable mirror velocity v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s. A microseism at 0.15 Hz with 1 µm amplitude gives v = 2π×0.15×1 µm ≈ 0.9 µm/s, already too fast, so the platform's sensor correction must suppress the microseism. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽氣後做壓升率測試估算出氣率；比較真空中與空氣中的模態頻率與 Q；統計鎖定取得時間與成功率對微震幅度的關係；用光學槓桿確認整條鏈的對準範圍足以覆蓋安裝誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After pump-down run a rate-of-rise test to estimate outgassing; compare mode frequencies and Q in vacuum with those in air; log lock-acquisition time and success rate against microseism amplitude; confirm with optical levers that the alignment range of the whole chain covers the installation errors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臂腔：L = 4 km、精細度 F = 450，自由光譜範圍 c/2L = 37.5 kHz，線寬 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz，換成長度 δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm；光儲存時間 τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms，可捕捉的鏡速 v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s。而 0.15 Hz、振幅 1 µm 的微震給出 v = 2π×0.15×1 µm ≈ 0.9 µm/s，已超過，因此必須靠平台的感測器修正把微震壓下。
knowledge.textEn: Arm cavity: L = 4 km, finesse F = 450, free spectral range c/2L = 37.5 kHz, linewidth 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz, in length δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm; the storage time τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms sets a catchable mirror velocity v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s. A microseism at 0.15 Hz with 1 µm amplitude gives v = 2π×0.15×1 µm ≈ 0.9 µm/s, already too fast, so the platform's sensor correction must suppress the microseism.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition", which statement holds?
options: 懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。
只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。
臂腔：L = 4 km、精細度 F = 450，自由光譜範圍 c/2L = 37.5 kHz，線寬 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz，換成長度 δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm。
optionsEn: More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost.
Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length.
Arm cavity: L = 4 km, finesse F = 450, free spectral range c/2L = 37.5 kHz, linewidth 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz, in length δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm.
quiz.explanation: 臂腔：L = 4 km、精細度 F = 450，自由光譜範圍 c/2L = 37.5 kHz，線寬 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz，換成長度 δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm；光儲存時間 τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms，可捕捉的鏡速 v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Arm cavity: L = 4 km, finesse F = 450, free spectral range c/2L = 37.5 kHz, linewidth 37.5 kHz/450 = 83 Hz, in length δL = λ/(2F) = 1064 nm/900 = 1.2 nm; the storage time τ_s = F·L/(πc) = 1.9 ms sets a catchable mirror velocity v ≲ δL/τ_s ≈ 0.6 µm/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「真空腔安裝與鎖定取得」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Vacuum-chamber installation and lock acquisition” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 抽氣後做壓升率測試估算出氣率；比較真空中與空氣中的模態頻率與 Q；統計鎖定取得時間與成功率對微震幅度的關係；用光學槓桿確認整條鏈的對準範圍足以覆蓋安裝誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After pump-down run a rate-of-rise test to estimate outgassing; compare mode frequencies and Q in vacuum with those in air; log lock-acquisition time and success rate against microseism amplitude; confirm with optical levers that the alignment range of the whole chain covers the installation errors. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：地震或搬運使纖維斷裂，整個真空腔必須開腔更換末級；石英纖維在受力下接觸水氣會發生應力腐蝕而緩慢裂開，所以安裝期間的濕度暴露會縮短壽命；測試質量上的微粒污染則增加散射損耗。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: An earthquake or transport breaks a fibre and the chamber must be opened to replace the final stage; stressed silica fibres exposed to humidity undergo stress corrosion and crack slowly, so humidity exposure during installation shortens their life; particulate contamination on the test mass adds scatter loss.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽氣後做壓升率測試估算出氣率；比較真空中與空氣中的模態頻率與 Q；統計鎖定取得時間與成功率對微震幅度的關係；用光學槓桿確認整條鏈的對準範圍足以覆蓋安裝誤差。
knowledge.textEn: After pump-down run a rate-of-rise test to estimate outgassing; compare mode frequencies and Q in vacuum with those in air; log lock-acquisition time and success rate against microseism amplitude; confirm with optical levers that the alignment range of the whole chain covers the installation errors.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition"?
options: 抽氣後做壓升率測試估算出氣率；比較真空中與空氣中的模態頻率與 Q；統計鎖定取得時間與成功率對微震幅度的關係；用光學槓桿確認整條鏈的對準範圍足以覆蓋安裝誤差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼越強越好，振盪越快停下來就越安全。
optionsEn: After pump-down run a rate-of-rise test to estimate outgassing.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Stronger damping is always better because the oscillation stops sooner.
quiz.explanation: 抽氣後做壓升率測試估算出氣率；比較真空中與空氣中的模態頻率與 Q；統計鎖定取得時間與成功率對微震幅度的關係；用光學槓桿確認整條鏈的對準範圍足以覆蓋安裝誤差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After pump-down run a rate-of-rise test to estimate outgassing; compare mode frequencies and Q in vacuum with those in air; log lock-acquisition time and success rate against microseism amplitude; confirm with optical levers that the alignment range of the whole chain covers the installation errors. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「真空腔安裝與鎖定取得」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Vacuum-chamber installation and lock acquisition” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 地震或搬運使纖維斷裂，整個真空腔必須開腔更換末級；石英纖維在受力下接觸水氣會發生應力腐蝕而緩慢裂開，所以安裝期間的濕度暴露會縮短壽命；測試質量上的微粒污染則增加散射損耗。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: An earthquake or transport breaks a fibre and the chamber must be opened to replace the final stage; stressed silica fibres exposed to humidity undergo stress corrosion and crack slowly, so humidity exposure during installation shortens their life; particulate contamination on the test mass adds scatter loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鎖定取得依賴致動層級把臂腔推到共振：臂腔線寬只有奈米級，測試質量通過共振時的速度必須夠慢，否則來不及建立控制訊號，所以阻尼後的殘餘速度是懸吊交給鎖定系統的關鍵規格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lock acquisition relies on the actuation hierarchy to bring the arm cavity onto resonance: the cavity linewidth is only nanometres, and the test mass must cross resonance slowly enough for the control signal to build up, so the damped residual velocity is the key specification the suspension hands to the locking system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鎖定失敗是光學問題，與懸吊無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lock failures are optical problems unrelated to the suspensions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 地震或搬運使纖維斷裂，整個真空腔必須開腔更換末級；石英纖維在受力下接觸水氣會發生應力腐蝕而緩慢裂開，所以安裝期間的濕度暴露會縮短壽命；測試質量上的微粒污染則增加散射損耗。
knowledge.textEn: An earthquake or transport breaks a fibre and the chamber must be opened to replace the final stage; stressed silica fibres exposed to humidity undergo stress corrosion and crack slowly, so humidity exposure during installation shortens their life; particulate contamination on the test mass adds scatter loss.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「真空整合、潔淨裝配與鎖定取得」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vacuum integration, clean assembly and lock acquisition" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
地震或搬運使纖維斷裂，整個真空腔必須開腔更換末級。
懸吊安裝完成後就不再需要維護與重新校正。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
An earthquake or transport breaks a fibre and the chamber must be opened to replace the final stage.
Once installed, a suspension needs no maintenance or recalibration.
quiz.explanation: 地震或搬運使纖維斷裂，整個真空腔必須開腔更換末級；石英纖維在受力下接觸水氣會發生應力腐蝕而緩慢裂開，所以安裝期間的濕度暴露會縮短壽命；測試質量上的微粒污染則增加散射損耗。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An earthquake or transport breaks a fibre and the chamber must be opened to replace the final stage; stressed silica fibres exposed to humidity undergo stress corrosion and crack slowly, so humidity exposure during installation shortens their life; particulate contamination on the test mass adds scatter loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 懸吊驗收、模型校正與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Suspension acceptance, model fitting and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「懸吊驗收與交接紀錄」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suspension acceptance and handoff record” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 驗收要逐項比對：所有模態頻率與模型的偏差、Q 值、逐級傳遞函數、阻尼後的安定時間、各層致動器校正常數、纖維的輪廓與強度紀錄、熱雜訊估計值。交接文件包含竣工圖、濾波器設定、感測器校正常數與控制系統中的狀態空間模型；交接後仍要長期監測對準漂移、葉片潛變與電荷累積，因為這些慢變量會在數月後改變控制器所依據的受控體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「懸吊驗收與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance compares item by item: deviation of every mode frequency from the model, Q values, stage-by-stage transfer functions, settling time after damping, calibration constants of each actuation layer, fibre profile and strength records and the thermal-noise estimate. The handoff record holds as-built drawings, filter settings, sensor calibration constants and the state-space model loaded in the control system; after handoff, alignment drift, blade creep and charge build-up are monitored long term because these slow variables change the plant the controllers were designed for months later. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Suspension acceptance and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：模態檢查：模型 0.643 Hz、實測 0.650 Hz，偏差 1.1%（接受門檻 5%）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mode check: model 0.643 Hz, measured 0.650 Hz, deviation 1.1% (acceptance threshold 5%).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸吊安裝完成後就不再需要維護與重新校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once installed, a suspension needs no maintenance or recalibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「懸吊驗收與交接紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Suspension acceptance and handoff record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：懸吊安裝完成後就不再需要維護與重新校正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once installed, a suspension needs no maintenance or recalibration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸吊驗收、模型校正與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Suspension acceptance, model fitting and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 懸吊安裝完成後就不再需要維護與重新校正。
只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。
驗收要逐項比對：所有模態頻率與模型的偏差、Q 值、逐級傳遞函數、阻尼後的安定時間、各層致動器校正常數、纖維的輪廓與強度紀錄、熱雜訊估計值。

Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation.

quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance compares item by item: deviation of every mode frequency from the model, Q values, stage-by-stage transfer functions, settling time after damping, calibration constants of each actuation layer, fibre profile and strength records and the thermal-noise estimate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸吊驗收、模型校正與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Suspension acceptance, model fitting and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「懸吊驗收與交接紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Suspension acceptance and handoff record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：模態檢查：模型 0.643 Hz、實測 0.650 Hz，偏差 1.1%（接受門檻 5%）。阻尼後 Q = 10 的振鈴時間 τ = Q/(πf₀) = 10/(π×0.643) ≈ 5 s；未阻尼 Q = 10⁵ 時約 14 小時。若頂端葉片每月潛變下沉 10 µm，一年累積 120 µm，占去 ±1 mm 致動行程的 12%，必須排程重新置中。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mode check: model 0.643 Hz, measured 0.650 Hz, deviation 1.1% (acceptance threshold 5%). With damping to Q = 10 the ring-down time τ = Q/(πf₀) = 10/(π×0.643) ≈ 5 s; undamped at Q = 10⁵ it is about 14 hours. If the top blades creep 10 µm per month, a year accumulates 120 µm, 12% of the ±1 mm actuator range, so re-centring must be scheduled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：執行最終測試矩陣：模態表比對、安定時間 < 10 s、致動器校正與干涉儀的光子校正器交叉比對；彙整成驗收紀錄並附上回歸測試腳本，任何濾波器或硬體變更後重跑並記錄差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run the final test matrix: mode-table comparison, settling time under 10 s, actuator calibration cross-checked against the interferometer's photon calibrator; compile the acceptance record with regression scripts, rerun after any filter or hardware change and log the differences.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 模態檢查：模型 0.643 Hz、實測 0.650 Hz，偏差 1.1%（接受門檻 5%）。阻尼後 Q = 10 的振鈴時間 τ = Q/(πf₀) = 10/(π×0.643) ≈ 5 s；未阻尼 Q = 10⁵ 時約 14 小時。若頂端葉片每月潛變下沉 10 µm，一年累積 120 µm，占去 ±1 mm 致動行程的 12%，必須排程重新置中。

With damping to Q = 10 the ring-down time τ = Q/(πf₀) = 10/(π×0.643) ≈ 5 s; undamped at Q = 10⁵ it is about 14 hours. If the top blades creep 10 µm per month, a year accumulates 120 µm, 12% of the ±1 mm actuator range, so re-centring must be scheduled.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「懸吊驗收、模型校正與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Suspension acceptance, model fitting and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 模態檢查：模型 0.643 Hz、實測 0.650 Hz，偏差 1.1%（接受門檻 5%）。

Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise.

steps.title: 懸吊驗收、模型校正與工程交接：量測與驗證

steps.instruction: 執行最終測試矩陣：模態表比對、安定時間 < 10 s、致動器校正與干涉儀的光子校正器交叉比對；彙整成驗收紀錄並附上回歸測試腳本，任何濾波器或硬體變更後重跑並記錄差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run the final test matrix: mode-table comparison, settling time under 10 s, actuator calibration cross-checked against the interferometer's photon calibrator; compile the acceptance record with regression scripts, rerun after any filter or hardware change and log the differences. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：模型與實測的差異未記錄，控制濾波器依錯誤的受控體設計，數月後在某個模態附近出現不穩定；或潛變未被追蹤，致動器行程用盡後懸吊無法再對準。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.instructionEn: Undocumented model-versus-measurement discrepancies lead to control filters designed on the wrong plant and an instability near some mode months later; or untracked creep exhausts the actuator range and the suspension can no longer be aligned. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

title: 低溫紅外偵測器
summary: 以 JWST NIRCam 的 Teledyne HAWAII-2RG（2048×2048、18 µm、2.5 µm 與 5 µm 截止、約 40 K 工作）與 SIDECAR ASIC 為對象，從 Hansen 能隙關係與暗電流的 Arrhenius 行為出發，建立混成陣列結構、冷光闌與熱背景、CDS／Fowler／up-the-ramp 讀出雜訊、非線性與持續影像校正、低溫線路熱負載，直到偵測器特性化矩陣與操作點交接。
