workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 紅外陣列操作練習：長波 HgCdTe 陣列 x = 0.30 在 T = 40 K 的能隙 E_g = −0.302 + 0.579 + 0.0086 − 0.0729 + 0.0225 = 0.235 eV，λ_c = 1.24/0.235 = 5.27 µm。擴散暗電流 ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT)，從 77 K 降到 60 K 的比值 (60/77)³×e^(−10) ≈ 2×10⁻⁵，但 40 K 實測地板約 0.035 e⁻/s。讀出：單次讀取雜訊 11.2 e⁻，up-the-ramp N = 93 時 σ = 11.2×√[12×92/(93×94)] = 11.2×0.355 = 4.0 e⁻；若每次讀取有 0.5 e⁻ 輝光，93 次累積 46 e⁻、散粒雜訊 6.8 e⁻，已超過省下的讀出雜訊。背景極限：σ_read = 7 e⁻、背景 2 e⁻/s 時 t = 49/2 = 25 s。線束：100 條磷青銅線 6.6 mW，銅線 264 mW。前次 80,000 e⁻ 曝光留下 0.1% = 80 e⁻ 的潛影，在 1000 s 內為 0.08 e⁻/s，比暗電流還大。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Infrared-array operating exercise: a long-wave HgCdTe array with x = 0.30 at T = 40 K has E_g = −0.302 + 0.579 + 0.0086 − 0.0729 + 0.0225 = 0.235 eV and λ_c = 1.24/0.235 = 5.27 µm. Diffusion dark current ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT) falls by (60/77)³×e^(−10) ≈ 2×10⁻⁵ from 77 K to 60 K, yet the measured floor at 40 K is about 0.035 e⁻/s. Readout: single-read noise 11.2 e⁻; up-the-ramp with N = 93 gives σ = 11.2×√[12×92/(93×94)] = 11.2×0.355 = 4.0 e⁻; with 0.5 e⁻ of glow per read, 93 reads accumulate 46 e⁻ whose shot noise of 6.8 e⁻ exceeds the read noise saved. Background limit: with σ_read = 7 e⁻ and a 2 e⁻/s background, t = 49/2 = 25 s. Harness: 100 phosphor-bronze wires 6.6 mW, copper 264 mW. A previous 80,000 e⁻ exposure leaves 0.1% = 80 e⁻ of latent charge, 0.08 e⁻/s over 1000 s, larger than the dark current. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「為何紅外偵測器必須低溫：能隙與熱激發」與「HgCdTe 光二極體、銦凸塊混成與 ROIC」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Why infrared detectors must be cold: bandgap and thermal excitation" and "HgCdTe photodiodes, indium-bump hybridisation and the ROIC": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 為何紅外偵測器必須低溫：能隙與熱激發：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Why infrared detectors must be cold: bandgap and thermal excitation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「窄能隙半導體與截止波長」如何決定低溫紅外偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Narrow-gap semiconductor and cutoff wavelength” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic infrared detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 1–5 µm 的紅外光子能量只有 0.25–1.2 eV，要吸收它們必須用能隙同樣小的半導體，而小能隙意味著在室溫下熱激發就能跨越能隙，產生遠大於天體訊號的暗電流。Hg₁₋ₓCdₓTe 的能隙可由 Cd 比例 x 連續調整，同一材料系統能做出 1.7、2.5 或 5 µm 截止的偵測器；但截止波長越長、能隙越小，所需的工作溫度就越低。此外 290 K 的光學元件本身在 3–5 µm 強烈發光，所以不只偵測器，整個光路也要冷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「窄能隙半導體與截止波長」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Infrared photons between 1 and 5 µm carry only 0.25–1.2 eV, so absorbing them needs a semiconductor with an equally small bandgap, and a small gap means thermal excitation crosses it at room temperature and produces a dark current far larger than any astronomical signal. The bandgap of Hg₁₋ₓCdₓTe is tuned continuously by the Cd fraction x, so one material system yields 1.7, 2.5 or 5 µm cutoff detectors; the longer the cutoff and the smaller the gap, the colder the required operating temperature. In addition, 290 K optics glow strongly at 3–5 µm, so the whole optical train must be cold, not just the detector. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Narrow-gap semiconductor and cutoff wavelength”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Hansen relation: E_g(x,T) = −0.302 + 1.93x + 5.35×10⁻⁴·T·(1−2x) − 0.81x² + 0.832x³ (eV), λ_c = 1.24/E_g µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「紅外偵測器冷卻只是為了降低讀出電子的雜訊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Infrared detectors are cooled only to reduce readout-electronics noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「窄能隙半導體與截止波長」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Narrow-gap semiconductor and cutoff wavelength”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 為何紅外偵測器必須低溫：能隙與熱激發
knowledge.titleEn: Why infrared detectors must be cold: bandgap and thermal excitation
knowledge.text: 1–5 µm 的紅外光子能量只有 0.25–1.2 eV，要吸收它們必須用能隙同樣小的半導體，而小能隙意味著在室溫下熱激發就能跨越能隙，產生遠大於天體訊號的暗電流。Hg₁₋ₓCdₓTe 的能隙可由 Cd 比例 x 連續調整，同一材料系統能做出 1.7、2.5 或 5 µm 截止的偵測器；但截止波長越長、能隙越小，所需的工作溫度就越低。
knowledge.textEn: Infrared photons between 1 and 5 µm carry only 0.25–1.2 eV, so absorbing them needs a semiconductor with an equally small bandgap, and a small gap means thermal excitation crosses it at room temperature and produces a dark current far larger than any astronomical signal. The bandgap of Hg₁₋ₓCdₓTe is tuned continuously by the Cd fraction x, so one material system yields 1.7, 2.5 or 5 µm cutoff detectors; the longer the cutoff and the smaller the gap, the colder the required operating temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：紅外偵測器冷卻只是為了降低讀出電子的雜訊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「為何紅外偵測器必須低溫：能隙與熱激發」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 紅外偵測器冷卻只是為了降低讀出電子的雜訊。
1–5 µm 的紅外光子能量只有 0.25–1.2 eV，要吸收它們必須用能隙同樣小的半導體，而小能隙意味著在室溫下熱激發就能跨越能隙，產生遠大於天體訊號的暗電流。

steps.title: 為何紅外偵測器必須低溫：能隙與熱激發：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Why infrared detectors must be cold: bandgap and thermal excitation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「窄能隙半導體與截止波長」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Narrow-gap semiconductor and cutoff wavelength” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Hansen 關係：E_g(x,T) = −0.302 + 1.93x + 5.35×10⁻⁴·T·(1−2x) − 0.81x² + 0.832x³（eV），λ_c = 1.24/E_g µm。x = 0.445、T = 77 K：E_g = 0.474 eV，λ_c = 2.61 µm；x = 0.30、T = 40 K：E_g = 0.235 eV，λ_c = 5.27 µm，對應 NIRCam 短波與長波偵測器的 2.5 µm 與 5 µm 截止。組成比 x 的微小偏差就會移動截止波長，因此長晶時必須監控組成均勻度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.instruction: 用單光儀加校正黑體量偵測器的光譜響應，找出響應下降一半的截止波長，與 Hansen 關係由材料組成預測的值比較；再在數個溫度重複，確認截止波長隨溫度的微小位移（每 10 K 約數十 nm）符合模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the detector's spectral response with a monochromator and a calibrated blackbody, locate the cutoff where response falls to half and compare with the Hansen prediction from the material composition; repeat at several temperatures and confirm the small cutoff shift (tens of nanometres per 10 K) matches the model. steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 把 5 µm 截止的陣列放在暖濾光片後面，290 K 濾光片的熱輻射在幾秒內就把位阱填滿，再怎麼降低偵測器溫度都救不回來；短波陣列若誤用在 L 波段則根本沒有響應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: HgCdTe 光二極體、銦凸塊混成與 ROIC：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「混成式焦平面與 ROIC」如何決定低溫紅外偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hybrid focal plane and ROIC” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic infrared detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: HAWAII-2RG 是混成陣列：HgCdTe 以分子束磊晶長在晶格匹配的 CdZnTe 基板上，每個像素是一個 p–n 光二極體，再以銦凸塊逐像素接到矽 CMOS 讀出電路（ROIC），由每像素的源極隨耦器把累積電荷轉成電壓；2048×2048 個 18 µm 像素、最外 4 圈參考像素、可選 1 到 32 個輸出。移除基板後可從背面照光並把響應延伸到 0.6 µm。與 CCD 不同，電荷不轉移，每個像素可被非破壞性地重複讀取。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「混成式焦平面與 ROIC」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The HAWAII-2RG is a hybrid: HgCdTe is grown by molecular-beam epitaxy on lattice-matched CdZnTe, each pixel is a p–n photodiode, and indium bumps connect every pixel to a silicon CMOS readout integrated circuit (ROIC) whose per-pixel source follower converts the integrated charge to a voltage; 2048×2048 pixels at 18 µm, a 4-pixel reference border and a selectable 1 to 32 outputs. Removing the substrate allows back-side illumination with response extending to 0.6 µm. Unlike a CCD the charge is never transferred, so every pixel can be read non-destructively many times. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hybrid focal plane and ROIC”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：節點電容 C = 40 fF（假設）、可用電壓擺幅 0.5 V：滿阱 Q = CV/q = 40×10⁻¹⁵×0.5/1.6×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 1.25×10⁵ e⁻，與 NIRCam 短波實測約 1.06×10⁵ e⁻ 同量級；轉換增益 q/C = 4 µV/e⁻。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a node capacitance C = 40 fF (assumed) and a usable swing of 0.5 V, the full well is Q = CV/q = 40×10⁻¹⁵×0.5/1.6×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 1.25×10⁵ e⁻, the same order as the measured NIRCam short-wave value of about 1.06×10⁵ e⁻; the conversion gain is q/C = 4 µV/e⁻.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「紅外混成陣列像 CCD 一樣，是靠電荷轉移來讀出的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An infrared hybrid array reads out by charge transfer, like a CCD." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Hybrid focal plane and ROIC”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：節點電容 C = 40 fF（假設）、可用電壓擺幅 0.5 V：滿阱 Q = CV/q = 40×10⁻¹⁵×0.5/1.6×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 1.25×10⁵ e⁻，與 NIRCam 短波實測約 1.06×10⁵ e⁻ 同量級；轉換增益 q/C = 4 µV/e⁻。以 4 個輸出、每像素 100 kHz 讀出整幅 2048² = 4.2×10⁶ 像素需 10.5 s，與 JWST 的 10.7 s 幀時間一致；32 個輸出可降到 1.3 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a node capacitance C = 40 fF (assumed) and a usable swing of 0.5 V, the full well is Q = CV/q = 40×10⁻¹⁵×0.5/1.6×10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 1.25×10⁵ e⁻, the same order as the measured NIRCam short-wave value of about 1.06×10⁵ e⁻; the conversion gain is q/C = 4 µV/e⁻. Reading all 2048² = 4.2×10⁶ pixels through 4 outputs at 100 kHz per pixel takes 10.5 s, consistent with JWST's 10.7 s frame time; 32 outputs bring it down to 1.3 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：做光子轉移曲線（變異數對平均值）求轉換增益（e⁻/ADU）與滿阱；用校正光二極體在數個波長量 QE；從熱像素的核心形狀量像素間電容（IPC），因為 IPC 會讓光子轉移法高估增益，必須先修正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take a photon-transfer curve (variance versus mean) to obtain the conversion gain in e⁻/ADU and the full well; measure QE at several wavelengths against a calibrated photodiode; measure interpixel capacitance (IPC) from the kernel shape of hot pixels, because IPC makes the photon-transfer method overestimate gain and must be corrected first.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「HgCdTe 光二極體、銦凸塊混成與 ROIC」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

讀取次數越多雜訊一定越低，沒有上限。
線材越粗越好，因為電阻越低雜訊越小。

More reads always lower the noise, without limit.

steps.title: HgCdTe 光二極體、銦凸塊混成與 ROIC：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: HgCdTe photodiodes, indium-bump hybridisation and the ROIC: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「混成式焦平面與 ROIC」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Hybrid focal plane and ROIC” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 做光子轉移曲線（變異數對平均值）求轉換增益（e⁻/ADU）與滿阱；用校正光二極體在數個波長量 QE；從熱像素的核心形狀量像素間電容（IPC），因為 IPC 會讓光子轉移法高估增益，必須先修正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take a photon-transfer curve (variance versus mean) to obtain the conversion gain in e⁻/ADU and the full well; measure QE at several wavelengths against a calibrated photodiode; measure interpixel capacitance (IPC) from the kernel shape of hot pixels, because IPC makes the photon-transfer method overestimate gain and must be corrected first. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：熱循環應力讓銦凸塊脫開，出現成片的死像素；HgCdTe/CdZnTe 與矽的熱膨脹不匹配若未由設計吸收，會在降溫時造成剪切而使整塊陣列斷裂；基板未移除則在 0.8–1 µm 出現 QE 下降與干涉條紋。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Thermal-cycling stress disconnects indium bumps and produces clusters of dead pixels; if the thermal-expansion mismatch between HgCdTe/CdZnTe and silicon is not absorbed by design, cooling shears and fractures the array; an unremoved substrate causes QE loss and interference fringes between 0.8 and 1 µm.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「HgCdTe 光二極體、銦凸塊混成與 ROIC」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "HgCdTe photodiodes, indium-bump hybridisation and the ROIC"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
做光子轉移曲線（變異數對平均值）求轉換增益（e⁻/ADU）與滿阱。

Take a photon-transfer curve (variance versus mean) to obtain the conversion gain in e⁻/ADU and the full well.
Datasheet QE and noise are fixed values independent of the operating point.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: HgCdTe 光二極體、銦凸塊混成與 ROIC：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: HgCdTe photodiodes, indium-bump hybridisation and the ROIC: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混成式焦平面與 ROIC」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Hybrid focal plane and ROIC” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 熱循環應力讓銦凸塊脫開，出現成片的死像素；HgCdTe/CdZnTe 與矽的熱膨脹不匹配若未由設計吸收，會在降溫時造成剪切而使整塊陣列斷裂；基板未移除則在 0.8–1 µm 出現 QE 下降與干涉條紋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Thermal-cycling stress disconnects indium bumps and produces clusters of dead pixels; if the thermal-expansion mismatch between HgCdTe/CdZnTe and silicon is not absorbed by design, cooling shears and fractures the array; an unremoved substrate causes QE loss and interference fringes between 0.8 and 1 µm. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：與 CCD 不同，電荷不轉移，每個像素可被非破壞性地重複讀取。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unlike a CCD the charge is never transferred, so every pixel can be read non-destructively many times.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「紅外混成陣列像 CCD 一樣，是靠電荷轉移來讀出的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An infrared hybrid array reads out by charge transfer, like a CCD." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 熱循環應力讓銦凸塊脫開，出現成片的死像素；HgCdTe/CdZnTe 與矽的熱膨脹不匹配若未由設計吸收，會在降溫時造成剪切而使整塊陣列斷裂；基板未移除則在 0.8–1 µm 出現 QE 下降與干涉條紋。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「HgCdTe 光二極體、銦凸塊混成與 ROIC」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "HgCdTe photodiodes, indium-bump hybridisation and the ROIC" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Dark current depends only on temperature, not on the cutoff wavelength.
Thermal-cycling stress disconnects indium bumps and produces clusters of dead pixels.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長」與「冷光學、冷光闌與背景光子率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dark-current mechanisms, temperature and cutoff" and "Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Dark-current mechanisms, temperature and cutoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「暗電流與 Arrhenius 曲線」如何決定低溫紅外偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dark current and the Arrhenius curve” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic infrared detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暗電流有三種主要來源：擴散電流正比於 T³·exp(−E_g/kT)，產生–復合電流正比於 T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT)，以及在高偏壓或缺陷處出現的穿隧電流。前兩者隨溫度指數下降，所以每降低十幾 K 暗電流就少一個數量級；但到了足夠低溫後曲線趨於平坦，由缺陷相關的穿隧與表面漏電決定地板值，再冷也沒有幫助。因此工作溫度是依截止波長選的：2.5 µm 陣列在 77 K 已可用，5 µm 陣列則要 40 K 以下。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「暗電流與 Arrhenius 曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dark current has three main sources: diffusion current proportional to T³·exp(−E_g/kT), generation–recombination current proportional to T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT), and tunnelling current at high bias or at defects. The first two fall exponentially with temperature, roughly an order of magnitude for every ten-odd kelvin, but at low enough temperature the curve flattens into a floor set by defect-related tunnelling and surface leakage, and further cooling no longer helps. The operating temperature is therefore chosen by cutoff: a 2.5 µm array is usable at 77 K, a 5 µm array needs 40 K or below. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Dark current and the Arrhenius curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：擴散極限下 J ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In the diffusion limit J ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「暗電流只跟溫度有關，與截止波長無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dark current depends only on temperature, not on the cutoff wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「暗電流與 Arrhenius 曲線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Dark current and the Arrhenius curve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長
knowledge.text: 暗電流有三種主要來源：擴散電流正比於 T³·exp(−E_g/kT)，產生–復合電流正比於 T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT)，以及在高偏壓或缺陷處出現的穿隧電流。前兩者隨溫度指數下降，所以每降低十幾 K 暗電流就少一個數量級；但到了足夠低溫後曲線趨於平坦，由缺陷相關的穿隧與表面漏電決定地板值，再冷也沒有幫助。
knowledge.textEn: Dark current has three main sources: diffusion current proportional to T³·exp(−E_g/kT), generation–recombination current proportional to T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT), and tunnelling current at high bias or at defects. The first two fall exponentially with temperature, roughly an order of magnitude for every ten-odd kelvin, but at low enough temperature the curve flattens into a floor set by defect-related tunnelling and surface leakage, and further cooling no longer helps.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：暗電流只跟溫度有關，與截止波長無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dark current depends only on temperature, not on the cutoff wavelength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dark-current mechanisms, temperature and cutoff" is correct?
options: 暗電流有三種主要來源：擴散電流正比於 T³·exp(−E_g/kT)，產生–復合電流正比於 T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT)，以及在高偏壓或缺陷處出現的穿隧電流。
暗電流只跟溫度有關，與截止波長無關。
只要偵測器夠冷，光學元件維持室溫也沒關係。
optionsEn: Dark current has three main sources: diffusion current proportional to T³·exp(−E_g/kT), generation–recombination current proportional to T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT), and tunnelling current at high bias or at defects.
Dark current depends only on temperature, not on the cutoff wavelength.
As long as the detector is cold, the optics can stay at room temperature.
quiz.explanation: 暗電流有三種主要來源：擴散電流正比於 T³·exp(−E_g/kT)，產生–復合電流正比於 T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT)，以及在高偏壓或缺陷處出現的穿隧電流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dark current has three main sources: diffusion current proportional to T³·exp(−E_g/kT), generation–recombination current proportional to T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT), and tunnelling current at high bias or at defects. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dark-current mechanisms, temperature and cutoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「暗電流與 Arrhenius 曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dark current and the Arrhenius curve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：擴散極限下 J ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT)。E_g = 0.234 eV（5.3 µm 截止）：E_g/kT 在 77 K 為 35.3、在 60 K 為 45.3，降溫比值 = (60/77)³×e^(−10) = 0.47×4.5×10⁻⁵ ≈ 2×10⁻⁵，即 77 K 到 60 K 暗電流降低約五萬倍；但實測在 40 K 的長波 NIRCam 陣列仍有約 0.035 e⁻/s/像素，短波約 0.001 e⁻/s，這就是缺陷決定的地板。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In the diffusion limit J ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT). With E_g = 0.234 eV (5.3 µm cutoff), E_g/kT is 35.3 at 77 K and 45.3 at 60 K, so the cooling ratio is (60/77)³×e^(−10) = 0.47×4.5×10⁻⁵ ≈ 2×10⁻⁵, a fifty-thousand-fold drop from 77 K to 60 K; yet the long-wave NIRCam arrays at 40 K still measure about 0.035 e⁻/s/pixel and the short-wave ones about 0.001 e⁻/s, which is the defect-set floor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 35–80 K 之間數個溫度拍長時間暗幀，畫 ln(I) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖：斜率給出活化能，接近 E_g 為擴散主導、接近 E_g/2 為產生–復合主導、趨於平坦為穿隧地板；改變讀出節奏以分離放大器輝光（glow）對暗幀的貢獻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take long dark frames at several temperatures between 35 and 80 K and plot ln(I) against 1/T: the slope gives the activation energy, near E_g for diffusion, near E_g/2 for generation–recombination and flat for the tunnelling floor; vary the read cadence to separate amplifier glow from true dark current.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 擴散極限下 J ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT)。E_g = 0.234 eV（5.3 µm 截止）：E_g/kT 在 77 K 為 35.3、在 60 K 為 45.3，降溫比值 = (60/77)³×e^(−10) = 0.47×4.5×10⁻⁵ ≈ 2×10⁻⁵，即 77 K 到 60 K 暗電流降低約五萬倍；但實測在 40 K 的長波 NIRCam 陣列仍有約 0.035 e⁻/s/像素，短波約 0.001 e⁻/s，這就是缺陷決定的地板。
knowledge.textEn: In the diffusion limit J ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT). With E_g = 0.234 eV (5.3 µm cutoff), E_g/kT is 35.3 at 77 K and 45.3 at 60 K, so the cooling ratio is (60/77)³×e^(−10) = 0.47×4.5×10⁻⁵ ≈ 2×10⁻⁵, a fifty-thousand-fold drop from 77 K to 60 K; yet the long-wave NIRCam arrays at 40 K still measure about 0.035 e⁻/s/pixel and the short-wave ones about 0.001 e⁻/s, which is the defect-set floor.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dark-current mechanisms, temperature and cutoff", which statement holds?
options: 平場校正可以把持續影像一起修掉。
擴散極限下 J ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT)。
規格表上的 QE 與雜訊是固定值，與操作點無關。
optionsEn: Flat-fielding removes persistence as well.
In the diffusion limit J ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT).

quiz.explanationEn: In the diffusion limit J ∝ T³·exp(−E_g/kT). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dark-current mechanisms, temperature and cutoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「暗電流與 Arrhenius 曲線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Dark current and the Arrhenius curve” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 35–80 K 之間數個溫度拍長時間暗幀，畫 ln(I) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖：斜率給出活化能，接近 E_g 為擴散主導、接近 E_g/2 為產生–復合主導、趨於平坦為穿隧地板；改變讀出節奏以分離放大器輝光（glow）對暗幀的貢獻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take long dark frames at several temperatures between 35 and 80 K and plot ln(I) against 1/T: the slope gives the activation energy, near E_g for diffusion, near E_g/2 for generation–recombination and flat for the tunnelling floor; vary the read cadence to separate amplifier glow from true dark current. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 5.3 µm 截止的陣列用液態氮在 77 K 操作，暗電流達到每像素每秒數百個電子，1000 s 曝光的暗電荷就接近滿阱；輻射損傷後熱像素比例上升，地板值逐年變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Operating a 5.3 µm cutoff array at 77 K with liquid nitrogen gives hundreds of electrons per pixel per second of dark current, and a 1000 s exposure accumulates dark charge close to full well; after radiation damage the hot-pixel population grows and the floor worsens year by year.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在 35–80 K 之間數個溫度拍長時間暗幀，畫 ln(I) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖：斜率給出活化能，接近 E_g 為擴散主導、接近 E_g/2 為產生–復合主導、趨於平坦為穿隧地板；改變讀出節奏以分離放大器輝光（glow）對暗幀的貢獻。
knowledge.textEn: Take long dark frames at several temperatures between 35 and 80 K and plot ln(I) against 1/T: the slope gives the activation energy, near E_g for diffusion, near E_g/2 for generation–recombination and flat for the tunnelling floor; vary the read cadence to separate amplifier glow from true dark current.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dark-current mechanisms, temperature and cutoff"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
紅外偵測器冷卻只是為了降低讀出電子的雜訊。
在 35–80 K 之間數個溫度拍長時間暗幀，畫 ln(I) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖：斜率給出活化能，接近 E_g 為擴散主導、接近 E_g/2 為產生–復合主導、趨於平坦為穿隧地板。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Infrared detectors are cooled only to reduce readout-electronics noise.

Take long dark frames at several temperatures between 35 and 80 K and plot ln(I) against 1/T: the slope gives the activation energy, near E_g for diffusion, near E_g/2 for generation–recombination and flat for the tunnelling floor.
quiz.explanation: 在 35–80 K 之間數個溫度拍長時間暗幀，畫 ln(I) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖：斜率給出活化能，接近 E_g 為擴散主導、接近 E_g/2 為產生–復合主導、趨於平坦為穿隧地板；改變讀出節奏以分離放大器輝光（glow）對暗幀的貢獻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take long dark frames at several temperatures between 35 and 80 K and plot ln(I) against 1/T: the slope gives the activation energy, near E_g for diffusion, near E_g/2 for generation–recombination and flat for the tunnelling floor; vary the read cadence to separate amplifier glow from true dark current. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dark-current mechanisms, temperature and cutoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「暗電流與 Arrhenius 曲線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Dark current and the Arrhenius curve” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 5.3 µm 截止的陣列用液態氮在 77 K 操作，暗電流達到每像素每秒數百個電子，1000 s 曝光的暗電荷就接近滿阱；輻射損傷後熱像素比例上升，地板值逐年變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Operating a 5.3 µm cutoff array at 77 K with liquid nitrogen gives hundreds of electrons per pixel per second of dark current, and a 1000 s exposure accumulates dark charge close to full well; after radiation damage the hot-pixel population grows and the floor worsens year by year. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此工作溫度是依截止波長選的：2.5 µm 陣列在 77 K 已可用，5 µm 陣列則要 40 K 以下。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The operating temperature is therefore chosen by cutoff: a 2.5 µm array is usable at 77 K, a 5 µm array needs 40 K or below.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「暗電流只跟溫度有關，與截止波長無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dark current depends only on temperature, not on the cutoff wavelength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把 5.3 µm 截止的陣列用液態氮在 77 K 操作，暗電流達到每像素每秒數百個電子，1000 s 曝光的暗電荷就接近滿阱；輻射損傷後熱像素比例上升，地板值逐年變差。
knowledge.textEn: Operating a 5.3 µm cutoff array at 77 K with liquid nitrogen gives hundreds of electrons per pixel per second of dark current, and a 1000 s exposure accumulates dark charge close to full well; after radiation damage the hot-pixel population grows and the floor worsens year by year.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「暗電流機制、溫度與截止波長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dark-current mechanisms, temperature and cutoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把 5.3 µm 截止的陣列用液態氮在 77 K 操作，暗電流達到每像素每秒數百個電子，1000 s 曝光的暗電荷就接近滿阱。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要偵測器夠冷，光學元件維持室溫也沒關係。
optionsEn: Operating a 5.3 µm cutoff array at 77 K with liquid nitrogen gives hundreds of electrons per pixel per second of dark current, and a 1000 s exposure accumulates dark charge close to full well.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
As long as the detector is cold, the optics can stay at room temperature.
quiz.explanation: 把 5.3 µm 截止的陣列用液態氮在 77 K 操作，暗電流達到每像素每秒數百個電子，1000 s 曝光的暗電荷就接近滿阱；輻射損傷後熱像素比例上升，地板值逐年變差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Operating a 5.3 µm cutoff array at 77 K with liquid nitrogen gives hundreds of electrons per pixel per second of dark current, and a 1000 s exposure accumulates dark charge close to full well; after radiation damage the hot-pixel population grows and the floor worsens year by year. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 冷光學、冷光闌與背景光子率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「冷光闌與熱背景」如何決定低溫紅外偵測器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cold stop and thermal background” determines the key performance of “Cryogenic infrared detectors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 紅外偵測器只能「看到」冷的表面：在光瞳像位置放一個與偵測器同溫度的冷光闌，讓偵測器除了經由光闌看到望遠鏡與天空之外，其他方向只看到低溫擋板；濾光片也必須放在冷端。任何 290 K 的表面以 Planck 定律輻射，其光子率乘上像素的 AΩ、頻寬、發射率與 QE 就是背景電子率，在 K 波段已是每像素每秒數百個電子的量級，在 L、M 波段更高數個數量級；偵測器溫度本身要穩定在 ±10 mK，否則暗電流與偏壓一起漂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「冷光闌與熱背景」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An infrared detector may only see cold surfaces: a cold stop at the pupil image, at the detector's own temperature, ensures that apart from the view through the stop toward telescope and sky the detector sees only cryogenic baffles, and the filters must sit on the cold side too. Any 290 K surface radiates by Planck's law, and its photon radiance times the pixel AΩ, bandwidth, emissivity and QE is the background electron rate, already hundreds of electrons per pixel per second in the K band and orders of magnitude more in the L and M bands; the detector temperature itself must hold to ±10 mK or dark current and bias drift together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cold stop and thermal background”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：λ = 2.2 µm、T = 290 K：hc/λkT = 22.6，B_λ = 2hc²/λ⁵/(e^22.6 − 1) ≈ 3.7×10⁻⁴ W m⁻² µm⁻¹ sr⁻¹，光子輻射率 ≈ 4.1×10¹⁵ 光子 s⁻¹ m⁻² µm⁻¹ sr⁻¹。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At λ = 2.2 µm and T = 290 K, hc/λkT = 22.6, B_λ = 2hc²/λ⁵/(e^22.6 − 1) ≈ 3.7×10⁻⁴ W m⁻² µm⁻¹ sr⁻¹, a photon radiance of ≈ 4.1×10¹⁵ photons s⁻¹ m⁻² µm⁻¹ sr⁻¹.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要偵測器夠冷，光學元件維持室溫也沒關係。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the detector is cold, the optics can stay at room temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「冷光闌與熱背景」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cold stop and thermal background”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 冷光學、冷光闌與背景光子率
knowledge.titleEn: Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate
knowledge.text: 紅外偵測器只能「看到」冷的表面：在光瞳像位置放一個與偵測器同溫度的冷光闌，讓偵測器除了經由光闌看到望遠鏡與天空之外，其他方向只看到低溫擋板；濾光片也必須放在冷端。任何 290 K 的表面以 Planck 定律輻射，其光子率乘上像素的 AΩ、頻寬、發射率與 QE 就是背景電子率，在 K 波段已是每像素每秒數百個電子的量級，在 L、M 波段更高數個數量級；偵測器溫度本身要穩定在 ±10 mK，否則暗電流與偏壓一起漂。
knowledge.textEn: An infrared detector may only see cold surfaces: a cold stop at the pupil image, at the detector's own temperature, ensures that apart from the view through the stop toward telescope and sky the detector sees only cryogenic baffles, and the filters must sit on the cold side too. Any 290 K surface radiates by Planck's law, and its photon radiance times the pixel AΩ, bandwidth, emissivity and QE is the background electron rate, already hundreds of electrons per pixel per second in the K band and orders of magnitude more in the L and M bands; the detector temperature itself must hold to ±10 mK or dark current and bias drift together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要偵測器夠冷，光學元件維持室溫也沒關係。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the detector is cold, the optics can stay at room temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「冷光學、冷光闌與背景光子率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate" is correct?
options: 只要偵測器夠冷，光學元件維持室溫也沒關係。
紅外偵測器只能「看到」冷的表面：在光瞳像位置放一個與偵測器同溫度的冷光闌，讓偵測器除了經由光闌看到望遠鏡與天空之外，其他方向只看到低溫擋板。
讀取次數越多雜訊一定越低，沒有上限。
optionsEn: As long as the detector is cold, the optics can stay at room temperature.

quiz.explanationEn: An infrared detector may only see cold surfaces: a cold stop at the pupil image, at the detector's own temperature, ensures that apart from the view through the stop toward telescope and sky the detector sees only cryogenic baffles, and the filters must sit on the cold side too. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冷光學、冷光闌與背景光子率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「冷光闌與熱背景」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cold stop and thermal background” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ = 2.2 µm、T = 290 K：hc/λkT = 22.6，B_λ = 2hc²/λ⁵/(e^22.6 − 1) ≈ 3.7×10⁻⁴ W m⁻² µm⁻¹ sr⁻¹，光子輻射率 ≈ 4.1×10¹⁵ 光子 s⁻¹ m⁻² µm⁻¹ sr⁻¹。18 µm 像素、f/8（Ω = π/(4F²) = 0.0123 sr）：AΩ = 3.24×10⁻¹⁰×0.0123 = 4.0×10⁻¹² m² sr；Δλ = 0.3 µm、ε = 0.1、QE = 0.8 時背景率 ≈ 4.1×10¹⁵×4.0×10⁻¹²×0.3×0.1×0.8 ≈ 390 e⁻/s/像素。這個背景光子率必須與暗電流及讀出雜訊比較，才能決定冷光闌口徑、濾光片頻寬與鏡筒溫度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At λ = 2.2 µm and T = 290 K, hc/λkT = 22.6, B_λ = 2hc²/λ⁵/(e^22.6 − 1) ≈ 3.7×10⁻⁴ W m⁻² µm⁻¹ sr⁻¹, a photon radiance of ≈ 4.1×10¹⁵ photons s⁻¹ m⁻² µm⁻¹ sr⁻¹. For an 18 µm pixel at f/8 (Ω = π/(4F²) = 0.0123 sr), AΩ = 3.24×10⁻¹⁰×0.0123 = 4.0×10⁻¹² m² sr; with Δλ = 0.3 µm, ε = 0.1 and QE = 0.8 the background rate is ≈ 4.1×10¹⁵×4.0×10⁻¹²×0.3×0.1×0.8 ≈ 390 e⁻/s/pixel. This background rate must be compared with dark current and read noise to choose the cold-stop aperture, filter bandwidth and optics-barrel temperature. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別在快門關閉、冷光闌遮蔽與正常狀態下量背景率，三者相減可分離偵測器暗電流、儀器內部漏光與外部熱背景；旋轉儀器找出背景隨方位變化的漏光；用低溫二極體溫度計記錄偵測器溫度穩定度並與暗幀偏移做相關分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the background rate with the shutter closed, with the cold stop blanked and in normal configuration; subtracting the three separates detector dark current, internal light leaks and external thermal background; rotate the instrument to find leaks that vary with orientation; log the detector temperature with cryogenic diode sensors and correlate its stability with dark-frame offsets.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cold optics, cold stop and background photon rate", which statement holds?
