knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電荷耦合搬運與轉移效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Charge-coupled transport and charge-transfer efficiency" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。
太空任務中質子輻射逐年增加陷阱，暗弱星點的流量損失與質心偏移隨在晶片上的位置而變，測光與天體測量都出現位置相依的系統誤差。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Read noise belongs to the chip alone and does not depend on readout speed.

In space, proton radiation adds traps year by year, so faint stars lose flux and shift centroid depending on their position on the chip, creating position-dependent systematics in both photometry and astrometry.
quiz.explanation: 太空任務中質子輻射逐年增加陷阱，暗弱星點的流量損失與質心偏移隨在晶片上的位置而變，測光與天體測量都出現位置相依的系統誤差；若只用亮平場驗收 CTE，低訊號的嚴重拖尾直到科學資料才被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In space, proton radiation adds traps year by year, so faint stars lose flux and shift centroid depending on their position on the chip, creating position-dependent systematics in both photometry and astrometry; accepting CTE with bright flats only hides the severe low-signal trailing until science data reveal it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率」與「背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate" and "Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「浮動擴散輸出放大器」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floating-diffusion output amplifier” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電荷包被倒入輸出端的浮動擴散節點，電容 C 把電荷轉成電壓 q/C，再由源極隨耦器送出晶片。每次倒入電荷前節點要先重設，重設帶來 kTC 雜訊，所以讀出電路在重設後與電荷倒入後各取樣一次並相減，常用雙斜率積分器實作相關雙取樣。讀出雜訊由放大器的白雜訊與 1/f 雜訊組成：取樣時間越長白雜訊越低，但 1/f 雜訊不隨之下降，而且整張影像讀出時間按像素數除以像素速率線性增加。大面積相機因此把晶片分成多個輸出同時讀出。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「浮動擴散輸出放大器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each charge packet is dumped onto the floating-diffusion node, whose capacitance C converts charge to voltage q/C before a source follower drives it off chip. The node must be reset before every dump and reset introduces kTC noise, so the readout chain samples once after reset and once after the charge transfer and subtracts them, usually with a dual-slope integrator implementing correlated double sampling. Read noise combines amplifier white noise and 1/f noise: longer sampling lowers the white part but not the 1/f part, while frame readout time grows linearly with pixel count divided by pixel rate. Large cameras therefore divide each chip into several outputs read in parallel. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Floating-diffusion output amplifier”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：C = 20 fF 時轉換增益 q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻；173 K 下的重設雜訊 √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻，必須靠 CDS 消除。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With C = 20 fF the conversion gain is q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻; reset noise at 173 K is √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻ and must be removed by CDS.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Read noise belongs to the chip alone and does not depend on readout speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「浮動擴散輸出放大器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Floating-diffusion output amplifier”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率
knowledge.titleEn: Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate
knowledge.text: 電荷包被倒入輸出端的浮動擴散節點，電容 C 把電荷轉成電壓 q/C，再由源極隨耦器送出晶片。每次倒入電荷前節點要先重設，重設帶來 kTC 雜訊，所以讀出電路在重設後與電荷倒入後各取樣一次並相減，常用雙斜率積分器實作相關雙取樣。
knowledge.textEn: Each charge packet is dumped onto the floating-diffusion node, whose capacitance C converts charge to voltage q/C before a source follower drives it off chip. The node must be reset before every dump and reset introduces kTC noise, so the readout chain samples once after reset and once after the charge transfer and subtracts them, usually with a dual-slope integrator implementing correlated double sampling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Read noise belongs to the chip alone and does not depend on readout speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate" is correct?
options: 電荷包被倒入輸出端的浮動擴散節點，電容 C 把電荷轉成電壓 q/C，再由源極隨耦器送出晶片。
讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。
矽越厚越好，因為紅光量子效率一定越高。
optionsEn: Each charge packet is dumped onto the floating-diffusion node, whose capacitance C converts charge to voltage q/C before a source follower drives it off chip.
Read noise belongs to the chip alone and does not depend on readout speed.
Thicker silicon is always better because red QE rises.
quiz.explanation: 電荷包被倒入輸出端的浮動擴散節點，電容 C 把電荷轉成電壓 q/C，再由源極隨耦器送出晶片。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each charge packet is dumped onto the floating-diffusion node, whose capacitance C converts charge to voltage q/C before a source follower drives it off chip. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「浮動擴散輸出放大器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floating-diffusion output amplifier” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：C = 20 fF 時轉換增益 q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻；173 K 下的重設雜訊 √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻，必須靠 CDS 消除。公開深冷相機規格列出 50 kHz 讀出 2.9 e⁻、1 MHz 為 7.0 e⁻，比值 2.4 小於純白雜訊的 √20 = 4.47，顯示 1/f 與固定項。2048² 像素以 1 MHz 讀出 4.2 s、50 kHz 需 84 s；4k × 4k 晶片分 16 個輸出、2 s 讀完，每輸出約 524 kHz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With C = 20 fF the conversion gain is q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻; reset noise at 173 K is √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻ and must be removed by CDS. A public deep-cooled camera datasheet lists 2.9 e⁻ at 50 kHz and 7.0 e⁻ at 1 MHz, a ratio of 2.4 rather than the √20 = 4.47 of pure white noise, revealing 1/f and fixed terms. 2048² pixels read in 4.2 s at 1 MHz but 84 s at 50 kHz; a 4k × 4k chip split into 16 outputs read in 2 s needs about 524 kHz per output. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在暗環境下以最短曝光取兩張偏壓影像相減，差值標準差除以 √2 再乘以增益即得讀出雜訊；在多個像素速率重複，畫出雜訊對取樣時間的曲線並擬合白雜訊與 1/f 項；以示波器檢查輸出波形的重設與訊號平台是否穩定，確認積分窗未落在時脈突波上。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take two minimum-exposure bias frames in darkness and subtract them; the standard deviation of the difference divided by √2 and multiplied by the gain gives read noise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: C = 20 fF 時轉換增益 q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻；173 K 下的重設雜訊 √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻，必須靠 CDS 消除。公開深冷相機規格列出 50 kHz 讀出 2.9 e⁻、1 MHz 為 7.0 e⁻，比值 2.4 小於純白雜訊的 √20 = 4.47，顯示 1/f 與固定項。2048² 像素以 1 MHz 讀出 4.2 s、50 kHz 需 84 s；4k × 4k 晶片分 16 個輸出、2 s 讀完，每輸出約 524 kHz。
knowledge.textEn: With C = 20 fF the conversion gain is q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻; reset noise at 173 K is √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻ and must be removed by CDS. A public deep-cooled camera datasheet lists 2.9 e⁻ at 50 kHz and 7.0 e⁻ at 1 MHz, a ratio of 2.4 rather than the √20 = 4.47 of pure white noise, revealing 1/f and fixed terms. 2048² pixels read in 4.2 s at 1 MHz but 84 s at 50 kHz; a 4k × 4k chip split into 16 outputs read in 2 s needs about 524 kHz per output.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate", which statement holds?
options: 增益就是 ADC 位元數除以滿井，不需量測。
C = 20 fF 時轉換增益 q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻；173 K 下的重設雜訊 √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻，必須靠 CDS 消除。
出廠規格合格的 CCD，裝進相機後不必再做系統驗收。
optionsEn: Gain is simply full well divided by ADC range and needs no measurement.
With C = 20 fF the conversion gain is q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻; reset noise at 173 K is √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻ and must be removed by CDS.
A CCD that met factory specifications needs no system acceptance once installed.
quiz.explanation: C = 20 fF 時轉換增益 q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻；173 K 下的重設雜訊 √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻，必須靠 CDS 消除。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With C = 20 fF the conversion gain is q/C = 8.0 µV/e⁻; reset noise at 173 K is √(kTC)/q ≈ 43 e⁻ and must be removed by CDS. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「浮動擴散輸出放大器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Floating-diffusion output amplifier” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在暗環境下以最短曝光取兩張偏壓影像相減，差值標準差除以 √2 再乘以增益即得讀出雜訊；在多個像素速率重複，畫出雜訊對取樣時間的曲線並擬合白雜訊與 1/f 項；以示波器檢查輸出波形的重設與訊號平台是否穩定，確認積分窗未落在時脈突波上。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take two minimum-exposure bias frames in darkness and subtract them; the standard deviation of the difference divided by √2 and multiplied by the gain gives read noise. Repeat at several pixel rates, plot noise versus sampling time and fit white and 1/f terms; inspect the output waveform on an oscilloscope to confirm stable reset and signal plateaus and that integration windows avoid clock feedthrough spikes. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了縮短讀出時間把像素速率提高而沒有調整積分窗，取樣落在時脈突波上，讀出雜訊翻倍且出現與列相關的圖樣；輸出電晶體在曝光期間持續開啟時，其熱電子發光在靠近輸出的角落形成放大器輝光。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising the pixel rate to shorten readout without retuning the integration windows puts samples on clock feedthrough, doubling read noise and adding row-correlated patterns; leaving the output transistor on during exposure makes its hot-carrier emission glow in the corner nearest the output.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在暗環境下以最短曝光取兩張偏壓影像相減，差值標準差除以 √2 再乘以增益即得讀出雜訊；在多個像素速率重複，畫出雜訊對取樣時間的曲線並擬合白雜訊與 1/f 項；以示波器檢查輸出波形的重設與訊號平台是否穩定，確認積分窗未落在時脈突波上。
knowledge.textEn: Take two minimum-exposure bias frames in darkness and subtract them; the standard deviation of the difference divided by √2 and multiplied by the gain gives read noise. Repeat at several pixel rates, plot noise versus sampling time and fit white and 1/f terms; inspect the output waveform on an oscilloscope to confirm stable reset and signal plateaus and that integration windows avoid clock feedthrough spikes.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。
在暗環境下以最短曝光取兩張偏壓影像相減，差值標準差除以 √2 再乘以增益即得讀出雜訊。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength.
Take two minimum-exposure bias frames in darkness and subtract them.
quiz.explanation: 在暗環境下以最短曝光取兩張偏壓影像相減，差值標準差除以 √2 再乘以增益即得讀出雜訊；在多個像素速率重複，畫出雜訊對取樣時間的曲線並擬合白雜訊與 1/f 項；以示波器檢查輸出波形的重設與訊號平台是否穩定，確認積分窗未落在時脈突波上。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take two minimum-exposure bias frames in darkness and subtract them; the standard deviation of the difference divided by √2 and multiplied by the gain gives read noise. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「浮動擴散輸出放大器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Floating-diffusion output amplifier” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了縮短讀出時間把像素速率提高而沒有調整積分窗，取樣落在時脈突波上，讀出雜訊翻倍且出現與列相關的圖樣；輸出電晶體在曝光期間持續開啟時，其熱電子發光在靠近輸出的角落形成放大器輝光。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the pixel rate to shorten readout without retuning the integration windows puts samples on clock feedthrough, doubling read noise and adding row-correlated patterns; leaving the output transistor on during exposure makes its hot-carrier emission glow in the corner nearest the output. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大面積相機因此把晶片分成多個輸出同時讀出。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large cameras therefore divide each chip into several outputs read in parallel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Read noise belongs to the chip alone and does not depend on readout speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了縮短讀出時間把像素速率提高而沒有調整積分窗，取樣落在時脈突波上，讀出雜訊翻倍且出現與列相關的圖樣；輸出電晶體在曝光期間持續開啟時，其熱電子發光在靠近輸出的角落形成放大器輝光。
knowledge.textEn: Raising the pixel rate to shorten readout without retuning the integration windows puts samples on clock feedthrough, doubling read noise and adding row-correlated patterns; leaving the output transistor on during exposure makes its hot-carrier emission glow in the corner nearest the output.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮動擴散節點、雙斜率積分與讀出速率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Floating-diffusion node, dual-slope integration and readout rate" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 為了縮短讀出時間把像素速率提高而沒有調整積分窗，取樣落在時脈突波上，讀出雜訊翻倍且出現與列相關的圖樣。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
矽越厚越好，因為紅光量子效率一定越高。
optionsEn: Raising the pixel rate to shorten readout without retuning the integration windows puts samples on clock feedthrough, doubling read noise and adding row-correlated patterns.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Thicker silicon is always better because red QE rises.
quiz.explanation: 為了縮短讀出時間把像素速率提高而沒有調整積分窗，取樣落在時脈突波上，讀出雜訊翻倍且出現與列相關的圖樣；輸出電晶體在曝光期間持續開啟時，其熱電子發光在靠近輸出的角落形成放大器輝光。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Raising the pixel rate to shorten readout without retuning the integration windows puts samples on clock feedthrough, doubling read noise and adding row-correlated patterns; leaving the output transistor on during exposure makes its hot-carrier emission glow in the corner nearest the output. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「減薄、深空乏與焦面平整度」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane flatness” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 背照式 CCD 把晶圓減薄到 10 到 20 µm，背面必須以離子佈植加雷射退火、分子束磊晶 δ 摻雜等方式鈍化，建立把光電子推向前側電位井的內建電場，否則藍光產生的電子在背面復合。深空乏元件改用高電阻率矽並施加基板偏壓，使 40 到 200 µm 厚的矽全部空乏，紅端 QE 提高且條紋減弱，但未空乏區的電荷橫向擴散會放大點擴散函數，宇宙射線徑跡也變長。大面積焦面由多片晶片拼成，封裝要控制平整度、間隙與低溫下的熱膨脹匹配。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「減薄、深空乏與焦面平整度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Back-illuminated CCDs thin the wafer to 10 to 20 µm, and the back surface must be passivated by ion implantation with laser annealing or molecular-beam-epitaxy delta doping to build a field that drives photoelectrons toward the front-side wells; otherwise electrons generated by blue light recombine at the surface. Deep-depletion devices use high-resistivity silicon and a substrate bias to deplete 40 to 200 µm fully, raising red QE and suppressing fringes, but lateral diffusion from any undepleted region broadens the point-spread function and cosmic-ray tracks lengthen. Large focal planes tile many chips, so packaging must control flatness, gaps and thermal-expansion matching at cryogenic temperature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane flatness”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Depletion depth W = √(2ε_Si·V/(q·N_A)): with ε_Si = 1.04×10⁻¹⁰ F/m, V = 20 V and N_A = 5×10¹² cm⁻³, W = √(2×1.04×10⁻¹⁰×20/(1.6×10⁻¹⁹×5×10¹⁸)) ≈ 72 µm, rising to about 161 µm at N_A = 1×10¹² cm⁻³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矽越厚越好，因為紅光量子效率一定越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker silicon is always better because red QE rises." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「減薄、深空乏與焦面平整度」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane flatness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝
knowledge.titleEn: Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging
knowledge.text: 背照式 CCD 把晶圓減薄到 10 到 20 µm，背面必須以離子佈植加雷射退火、分子束磊晶 δ 摻雜等方式鈍化，建立把光電子推向前側電位井的內建電場，否則藍光產生的電子在背面復合。深空乏元件改用高電阻率矽並施加基板偏壓，使 40 到 200 µm 厚的矽全部空乏，紅端 QE 提高且條紋減弱，但未空乏區的電荷橫向擴散會放大點擴散函數，宇宙射線徑跡也變長。
knowledge.textEn: Back-illuminated CCDs thin the wafer to 10 to 20 µm, and the back surface must be passivated by ion implantation with laser annealing or molecular-beam-epitaxy delta doping to build a field that drives photoelectrons toward the front-side wells; otherwise electrons generated by blue light recombine at the surface. Deep-depletion devices use high-resistivity silicon and a substrate bias to deplete 40 to 200 µm fully, raising red QE and suppressing fringes, but lateral diffusion from any undepleted region broadens the point-spread function and cosmic-ray tracks lengthen.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：矽越厚越好，因為紅光量子效率一定越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker silicon is always better because red QE rises. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging" is correct?
options: 矽越厚越好，因為紅光量子效率一定越高。
背照式 CCD 把晶圓減薄到 10 到 20 µm，背面必須以離子佈植加雷射退火、分子束磊晶 δ 摻雜等方式鈍化，建立把光電子推向前側電位井的內建電場，否則藍光產生的電子在背面復合。
溫度越低越好，CCD 冷到最低溫就沒有任何代價。
optionsEn: Thicker silicon is always better because red QE rises.

Back-illuminated CCDs thin the wafer to 10 to 20 µm, and the back surface must be passivated by ion implantation with laser annealing or molecular-beam-epitaxy delta doping to build a field that drives photoelectrons toward the front-side wells.
Colder is always better; cooling a CCD to its minimum has no penalty.
quiz.explanation: 背照式 CCD 把晶圓減薄到 10 到 20 µm，背面必須以離子佈植加雷射退火、分子束磊晶 δ 摻雜等方式鈍化，建立把光電子推向前側電位井的內建電場，否則藍光產生的電子在背面復合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Back-illuminated CCDs thin the wafer to 10 to 20 µm, and the back surface must be passivated by ion implantation with laser annealing or molecular-beam-epitaxy delta doping to build a field that drives photoelectrons toward the front-side wells; otherwise electrons generated by blue light recombine at the surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「減薄、深空乏與焦面平整度」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane flatness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：空乏深度 W = √(2ε_Si·V/(q·N_A))：ε_Si = 1.04×10⁻¹⁰ F/m、V = 20 V、N_A = 5×10¹² cm⁻³ 時 W = √(2×1.04×10⁻¹⁰×20/(1.6×10⁻¹⁹×5×10¹⁸)) ≈ 72 µm；N_A 降到 1×10¹² cm⁻³ 時約 161 µm。平整度：f/1.23 的快速光束中 10 µm 離焦造成 10/1.23 ≈ 8.1 µm 的模糊圈，約 0.8 個 10 µm 像素。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Depletion depth W = √(2ε_Si·V/(q·N_A)): with ε_Si = 1.04×10⁻¹⁰ F/m, V = 20 V and N_A = 5×10¹² cm⁻³, W = √(2×1.04×10⁻¹⁰×20/(1.6×10⁻¹⁹×5×10¹⁸)) ≈ 72 µm, rising to about 161 µm at N_A = 1×10¹² cm⁻³. Flatness: in a fast f/1.23 beam a 10 µm defocus blurs to 10/1.23 ≈ 8.1 µm, about 0.8 of a 10 µm pixel. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在工作溫度下以非接觸式雷射三角量測或干涉儀量測每片晶片與整個焦面的高度圖，比較峰谷值與景深預算；以點光源投射器在多個波長掃描焦面，量測點擴散函數寬度隨基板偏壓的變化，確認元件已完全空乏；逐片記錄晶片間隙與方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At operating temperature, map the height of every chip and of the full focal plane with non-contact laser triangulation or interferometry, comparing peak-to-valley with the depth-of-focus budget; scan the focal plane with a spot projector at several wavelengths and measure point-spread-function width versus substrate bias to confirm full depletion; record each chip's gaps and orientation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 空乏深度 W = √(2ε_Si·V/(q·N_A))：ε_Si = 1.04×10⁻¹⁰ F/m、V = 20 V、N_A = 5×10¹² cm⁻³ 時 W = √(2×1.04×10⁻¹⁰×20/(1.6×10⁻¹⁹×5×10¹⁸)) ≈ 72 µm；N_A 降到 1×10¹² cm⁻³ 時約 161 µm。平整度：f/1.23 的快速光束中 10 µm 離焦造成 10/1.23 ≈ 8.1 µm 的模糊圈，約 0.8 個 10 µm 像素。
knowledge.textEn: Depletion depth W = √(2ε_Si·V/(q·N_A)): with ε_Si = 1.04×10⁻¹⁰ F/m, V = 20 V and N_A = 5×10¹² cm⁻³, W = √(2×1.04×10⁻¹⁰×20/(1.6×10⁻¹⁹×5×10¹⁸)) ≈ 72 µm, rising to about 161 µm at N_A = 1×10¹² cm⁻³. Flatness: in a fast f/1.23 beam a 10 µm defocus blurs to 10/1.23 ≈ 8.1 µm, about 0.8 of a 10 µm pixel.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging", which statement holds?
options: 像素合併只是軟體後處理，任何感測器效果都一樣。
背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。
optionsEn: Binning is only software post-processing and works the same on any sensor.
A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength.
Depletion depth W = √(2ε_Si·V/(q·N_A)): with ε_Si = 1.04×10⁻¹⁰ F/m, V = 20 V and N_A = 5×10¹² cm⁻³, W = √(2×1.04×10⁻¹⁰×20/(1.6×10⁻¹⁹×5×10¹⁸)) ≈ 72 µm, rising to about 161 µm at N_A = 1×10¹² cm⁻³.
quiz.explanation: 空乏深度 W = √(2ε_Si·V/(q·N_A))：ε_Si = 1.04×10⁻¹⁰ F/m、V = 20 V、N_A = 5×10¹² cm⁻³ 時 W = √(2×1.04×10⁻¹⁰×20/(1.6×10⁻¹⁹×5×10¹⁸)) ≈ 72 µm；N_A 降到 1×10¹² cm⁻³ 時約 161 µm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Depletion depth W = √(2ε_Si·V/(q·N_A)): with ε_Si = 1.04×10⁻¹⁰ F/m, V = 20 V and N_A = 5×10¹² cm⁻³, W = √(2×1.04×10⁻¹⁰×20/(1.6×10⁻¹⁹×5×10¹⁸)) ≈ 72 µm, rising to about 161 µm at N_A = 1×10¹² cm⁻³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「減薄、深空乏與焦面平整度」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane flatness” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在工作溫度下以非接觸式雷射三角量測或干涉儀量測每片晶片與整個焦面的高度圖，比較峰谷值與景深預算；以點光源投射器在多個波長掃描焦面，量測點擴散函數寬度隨基板偏壓的變化，確認元件已完全空乏；逐片記錄晶片間隙與方向。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At operating temperature, map the height of every chip and of the full focal plane with non-contact laser triangulation or interferometry, comparing peak-to-valley with the depth-of-focus budget; scan the focal plane with a spot projector at several wavelengths and measure point-spread-function width versus substrate bias to confirm full depletion; record each chip's gaps and orientation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：基板偏壓不足時元件只部分空乏，紅光在未空乏區產生的電荷橫向擴散，點擴散函數隨波長變寬，弱重力透鏡等形狀量測出現色相依的偏差；封裝材料與矽的熱膨脹不匹配，降溫後晶片翹曲數十微米，視場邊緣影像失焦。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient substrate bias leaves the device partially depleted, charge from red light diffuses laterally in the undepleted region and the point-spread function broadens with wavelength, biasing shape measurements such as weak lensing in a colour-dependent way; a package whose expansion mismatches silicon bows the chip by tens of micrometres on cooldown and defocuses the field edges.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在工作溫度下以非接觸式雷射三角量測或干涉儀量測每片晶片與整個焦面的高度圖，比較峰谷值與景深預算；以點光源投射器在多個波長掃描焦面，量測點擴散函數寬度隨基板偏壓的變化，確認元件已完全空乏；逐片記錄晶片間隙與方向。
knowledge.textEn: At operating temperature, map the height of every chip and of the full focal plane with non-contact laser triangulation or interferometry, comparing peak-to-valley with the depth-of-focus budget; scan the focal plane with a spot projector at several wavelengths and measure point-spread-function width versus substrate bias to confirm full depletion; record each chip's gaps and orientation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging"?
options: 在工作溫度下以非接觸式雷射三角量測或干涉儀量測每片晶片與整個焦面的高度圖，比較峰谷值與景深預算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
CTE 為 0.99999 已經接近完美，大面積 CCD 不必再擔心。
optionsEn: At operating temperature, map the height of every chip and of the full focal plane with non-contact laser triangulation or interferometry, comparing peak-to-valley with the depth-of-focus budget.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A CTE of 0.99999 is essentially perfect even for large CCDs.
quiz.explanation: 在工作溫度下以非接觸式雷射三角量測或干涉儀量測每片晶片與整個焦面的高度圖，比較峰谷值與景深預算；以點光源投射器在多個波長掃描焦面，量測點擴散函數寬度隨基板偏壓的變化，確認元件已完全空乏；逐片記錄晶片間隙與方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At operating temperature, map the height of every chip and of the full focal plane with non-contact laser triangulation or interferometry, comparing peak-to-valley with the depth-of-focus budget; scan the focal plane with a spot projector at several wavelengths and measure point-spread-function width versus substrate bias to confirm full depletion; record each chip's gaps and orientation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「減薄、深空乏與焦面平整度」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane flatness” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 基板偏壓不足時元件只部分空乏，紅光在未空乏區產生的電荷橫向擴散，點擴散函數隨波長變寬，弱重力透鏡等形狀量測出現色相依的偏差；封裝材料與矽的熱膨脹不匹配，降溫後晶片翹曲數十微米，視場邊緣影像失焦。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient substrate bias leaves the device partially depleted, charge from red light diffuses laterally in the undepleted region and the point-spread function broadens with wavelength, biasing shape measurements such as weak lensing in a colour-dependent way; a package whose expansion mismatches silicon bows the chip by tens of micrometres on cooldown and defocuses the field edges. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大面積焦面由多片晶片拼成，封裝要控制平整度、間隙與低溫下的熱膨脹匹配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large focal planes tile many chips, so packaging must control flatness, gaps and thermal-expansion matching at cryogenic temperature.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「矽越厚越好，因為紅光量子效率一定越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker silicon is always better because red QE rises." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基板偏壓不足時元件只部分空乏，紅光在未空乏區產生的電荷橫向擴散，點擴散函數隨波長變寬，弱重力透鏡等形狀量測出現色相依的偏差；封裝材料與矽的熱膨脹不匹配，降溫後晶片翹曲數十微米，視場邊緣影像失焦。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient substrate bias leaves the device partially depleted, charge from red light diffuses laterally in the undepleted region and the point-spread function broadens with wavelength, biasing shape measurements such as weak lensing in a colour-dependent way; a package whose expansion mismatches silicon bows the chip by tens of micrometres on cooldown and defocuses the field edges.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「背面減薄、深空乏與焦面封裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Back-thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane packaging" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
基板偏壓不足時元件只部分空乏，紅光在未空乏區產生的電荷橫向擴散，點擴散函數隨波長變寬，弱重力透鏡等形狀量測出現色相依的偏差。
溫度越低越好，CCD 冷到最低溫就沒有任何代價。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Insufficient substrate bias leaves the device partially depleted, charge from red light diffuses laterally in the undepleted region and the point-spread function broadens with wavelength, biasing shape measurements such as weak lensing in a colour-dependent way.
Colder is always better; cooling a CCD to its minimum has no penalty.
quiz.explanation: 基板偏壓不足時元件只部分空乏，紅光在未空乏區產生的電荷橫向擴散，點擴散函數隨波長變寬，弱重力透鏡等形狀量測出現色相依的偏差；封裝材料與矽的熱膨脹不匹配，降溫後晶片翹曲數十微米，視場邊緣影像失焦。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient substrate bias leaves the device partially depleted, charge from red light diffuses laterally in the undepleted region and the point-spread function broadens with wavelength, biasing shape measurements such as weak lensing in a colour-dependent way; a package whose expansion mismatches silicon bows the chip by tens of micrometres on cooldown and defocuses the field edges. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計」與「光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design" and "Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「低溫恆溫器與暗電流」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cryostat and dark current” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暗電流來自熱激發的電子電洞對：空乏區的產生電流按 T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT) 變化，未空乏區的擴散電流按 T³·exp(−E_g/kT) 變化，矽與氧化層界面的表面態則在非反轉模式下貢獻最多。多釘扎相位（MPP）操作讓表面反轉，可把表面暗電流壓低約百倍。實驗室相機以多級熱電致冷到 −70 到 −100 °C，天文台常用液氮或閉循環冷頭到 −100 °C 以下；但溫度太低時部分陷阱釋放時間變長而使 CTE 變差，暗電流也會被時脈感應電荷與輝光等其他來源墊底。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「低溫恆溫器與暗電流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dark current comes from thermally generated electron–hole pairs: depletion-region generation scales as T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT), diffusion from undepleted silicon as T³·exp(−E_g/kT), and surface states at the silicon–oxide interface contribute most in non-inverted operation. Multi-pinned-phase (MPP) operation inverts the surface and suppresses surface dark current by roughly a hundredfold. Laboratory cameras use multistage thermoelectric coolers to reach −70 to −100 °C, and observatories use liquid nitrogen or closed-cycle cold heads below −100 °C; too cold, however, lengthens some trap emission times and worsens CTE, and dark current is floored by other sources such as clock-induced charge and glow. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cryostat and dark current”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Public specifications give 0.0004 e⁻/px/s at −70 °C and 0.00013 at −80 °C, a factor of 3.08 per 10 K, i.e. halving every 10×ln2/ln3.08 ≈ 6.2 K; at −100 °C the value is 0.000059, only 2.2 times lower over 20 K, near the floor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「溫度越低越好，CCD 冷到最低溫就沒有任何代價。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Colder is always better; cooling a CCD to its minimum has no penalty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「低溫恆溫器與暗電流」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cryostat and dark current”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計
knowledge.titleEn: Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design
knowledge.text: 暗電流來自熱激發的電子電洞對：空乏區的產生電流按 T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT) 變化，未空乏區的擴散電流按 T³·exp(−E_g/kT) 變化，矽與氧化層界面的表面態則在非反轉模式下貢獻最多。多釘扎相位（MPP）操作讓表面反轉，可把表面暗電流壓低約百倍。
knowledge.textEn: Dark current comes from thermally generated electron–hole pairs: depletion-region generation scales as T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT), diffusion from undepleted silicon as T³·exp(−E_g/kT), and surface states at the silicon–oxide interface contribute most in non-inverted operation. Multi-pinned-phase (MPP) operation inverts the surface and suppresses surface dark current by roughly a hundredfold.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：溫度越低越好，CCD 冷到最低溫就沒有任何代價。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Colder is always better; cooling a CCD to its minimum has no penalty. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design" is correct?
options: 溫度越低越好，CCD 冷到最低溫就沒有任何代價。
增益就是 ADC 位元數除以滿井，不需量測。
暗電流來自熱激發的電子電洞對：空乏區的產生電流按 T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT) 變化，未空乏區的擴散電流按 T³·exp(−E_g/kT) 變化，矽與氧化層界面的表面態則在非反轉模式下貢獻最多。
optionsEn: Colder is always better; cooling a CCD to its minimum has no penalty.
Gain is simply full well divided by ADC range and needs no measurement.

Dark current comes from thermally generated electron–hole pairs: depletion-region generation scales as T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT), diffusion from undepleted silicon as T³·exp(−E_g/kT), and surface states at the silicon–oxide interface contribute most in non-inverted operation.
quiz.explanation: 暗電流來自熱激發的電子電洞對：空乏區的產生電流按 T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT) 變化，未空乏區的擴散電流按 T³·exp(−E_g/kT) 變化，矽與氧化層界面的表面態則在非反轉模式下貢獻最多。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dark current comes from thermally generated electron–hole pairs: depletion-region generation scales as T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT), diffusion from undepleted silicon as T³·exp(−E_g/kT), and surface states at the silicon–oxide interface contribute most in non-inverted operation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低溫恆溫器與暗電流」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cryostat and dark current” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：公開規格：−70 °C 為 0.0004、−80 °C 為 0.00013 e⁻/px/s，每 10 K 相差 3.08 倍，即每 10×ln2/ln3.08 ≈ 6.2 K 減半；−100 °C 為 0.000059，20 K 只降 2.2 倍，已接近底限。1800 s 曝光在 −80 °C 累積 0.23 e⁻，散粒雜訊 0.48 e⁻ 遠小於 2.9 e⁻ 讀出雜訊；外推到 −40 °C 約 0.012 e⁻/px/s，累積 21 e⁻、雜訊 4.6 e⁻，超過讀出雜訊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Public specifications give 0.0004 e⁻/px/s at −70 °C and 0.00013 at −80 °C, a factor of 3.08 per 10 K, i.e. halving every 10×ln2/ln3.08 ≈ 6.2 K; at −100 °C the value is 0.000059, only 2.2 times lower over 20 K, near the floor. A 1800 s exposure at −80 °C accumulates 0.23 e⁻ with 0.48 e⁻ shot noise, far below 2.9 e⁻ read noise; extrapolated to −40 °C the rate is about 0.012 e⁻/px/s, giving 21 e⁻ and 4.6 e⁻ noise, above the read noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在至少四個溫度、各三種曝光時間取暗場，逐像素擬合斜率得暗電流，畫 ln(D) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖求活化能，判斷是產生、擴散或表面機制主導；以快門關閉與鏡頭完全遮蓋兩種方式比較，排除漏光；建立熱像素地圖並記錄角落是否有放大器輝光。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take darks at four or more temperatures with three exposure times each, fit the per-pixel slope to obtain dark current, and plot ln(D) against 1/T in an Arrhenius plot to find the activation energy and decide whether generation, diffusion or surface mechanisms dominate; compare shutter-closed with fully capped darks to rule out light leaks; build a hot-pixel map and note any amplifier glow at the corners.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 公開規格：−70 °C 為 0.0004、−80 °C 為 0.00013 e⁻/px/s，每 10 K 相差 3.08 倍，即每 10×ln2/ln3.08 ≈ 6.2 K 減半；−100 °C 為 0.000059，20 K 只降 2.2 倍，已接近底限。1800 s 曝光在 −80 °C 累積 0.23 e⁻，散粒雜訊 0.48 e⁻ 遠小於 2.9 e⁻ 讀出雜訊；外推到 −40 °C 約 0.012 e⁻/px/s，累積 21 e⁻、雜訊 4.6 e⁻，超過讀出雜訊。
knowledge.textEn: Public specifications give 0.0004 e⁻/px/s at −70 °C and 0.00013 at −80 °C, a factor of 3.08 per 10 K, i.e. halving every 10×ln2/ln3.08 ≈ 6.2 K; at −100 °C the value is 0.000059, only 2.2 times lower over 20 K, near the floor. A 1800 s exposure at −80 °C accumulates 0.23 e⁻ with 0.48 e⁻ shot noise, far below 2.9 e⁻ read noise; extrapolated to −40 °C the rate is about 0.012 e⁻/px/s, giving 21 e⁻ and 4.6 e⁻ noise, above the read noise.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design", which statement holds?
options: 出廠規格合格的 CCD，裝進相機後不必再做系統驗收。
CTE 為 0.99999 已經接近完美，大面積 CCD 不必再擔心。
optionsEn: Public specifications give 0.0004 e⁻/px/s at −70 °C and 0.00013 at −80 °C, a factor of 3.08 per 10 K, i.e. halving every 10×ln2/ln3.08 ≈ 6.2 K.
A CCD that met factory specifications needs no system acceptance once installed.
A CTE of 0.99999 is essentially perfect even for large CCDs.
quiz.explanationEn: Public specifications give 0.0004 e⁻/px/s at −70 °C and 0.00013 at −80 °C, a factor of 3.08 per 10 K, i.e. halving every 10×ln2/ln3.08 ≈ 6.2 K; at −100 °C the value is 0.000059, only 2.2 times lower over 20 K, near the floor. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「低溫恆溫器與暗電流」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cryostat and dark current” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在至少四個溫度、各三種曝光時間取暗場，逐像素擬合斜率得暗電流，畫 ln(D) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖求活化能，判斷是產生、擴散或表面機制主導；以快門關閉與鏡頭完全遮蓋兩種方式比較，排除漏光；建立熱像素地圖並記錄角落是否有放大器輝光。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take darks at four or more temperatures with three exposure times each, fit the per-pixel slope to obtain dark current, and plot ln(D) against 1/T in an Arrhenius plot to find the activation energy and decide whether generation, diffusion or surface mechanisms dominate; compare shutter-closed with fully capped darks to rule out light leaks; build a hot-pixel map and note any amplifier glow at the corners. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：恆溫器真空劣化或窗片結霜時晶片降不到設定溫度，暗電流每 6 K 翻倍而無人察覺；暗場與科學影像在不同溫度拍攝，扣除後殘留熱像素圖樣，長曝光的暗弱源被雜點淹沒或出現假源。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If cryostat vacuum degrades or the window frosts, the chip cannot reach its set point and dark current doubles every 6 K unnoticed; darks taken at a different temperature from science frames leave a residual hot-pixel pattern after subtraction, burying faint sources in long exposures or creating false ones.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在至少四個溫度、各三種曝光時間取暗場，逐像素擬合斜率得暗電流，畫 ln(D) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖求活化能，判斷是產生、擴散或表面機制主導；以快門關閉與鏡頭完全遮蓋兩種方式比較，排除漏光；建立熱像素地圖並記錄角落是否有放大器輝光。
knowledge.textEn: Take darks at four or more temperatures with three exposure times each, fit the per-pixel slope to obtain dark current, and plot ln(D) against 1/T in an Arrhenius plot to find the activation energy and decide whether generation, diffusion or surface mechanisms dominate; compare shutter-closed with fully capped darks to rule out light leaks; build a hot-pixel map and note any amplifier glow at the corners.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在至少四個溫度、各三種曝光時間取暗場，逐像素擬合斜率得暗電流，畫 ln(D) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖求活化能，判斷是產生、擴散或表面機制主導。
讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Take darks at four or more temperatures with three exposure times each, fit the per-pixel slope to obtain dark current, and plot ln(D) against 1/T in an Arrhenius plot to find the activation energy and decide whether generation, diffusion or surface mechanisms dominate.
Read noise belongs to the chip alone and does not depend on readout speed.
quiz.explanation: 在至少四個溫度、各三種曝光時間取暗場，逐像素擬合斜率得暗電流，畫 ln(D) 對 1/T 的 Arrhenius 圖求活化能，判斷是產生、擴散或表面機制主導；以快門關閉與鏡頭完全遮蓋兩種方式比較，排除漏光；建立熱像素地圖並記錄角落是否有放大器輝光。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take darks at four or more temperatures with three exposure times each, fit the per-pixel slope to obtain dark current, and plot ln(D) against 1/T in an Arrhenius plot to find the activation energy and decide whether generation, diffusion or surface mechanisms dominate; compare shutter-closed with fully capped darks to rule out light leaks; build a hot-pixel map and note any amplifier glow at the corners. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 暗電流的溫度依存與冷卻設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低溫恆溫器與暗電流」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cryostat and dark current” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 恆溫器真空劣化或窗片結霜時晶片降不到設定溫度，暗電流每 6 K 翻倍而無人察覺；暗場與科學影像在不同溫度拍攝，扣除後殘留熱像素圖樣，長曝光的暗弱源被雜點淹沒或出現假源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If cryostat vacuum degrades or the window frosts, the chip cannot reach its set point and dark current doubles every 6 K unnoticed; darks taken at a different temperature from science frames leave a residual hot-pixel pattern after subtraction, burying faint sources in long exposures or creating false ones. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實驗室相機以多級熱電致冷到 −70 到 −100 °C，天文台常用液氮或閉循環冷頭到 −100 °C 以下；但溫度太低時部分陷阱釋放時間變長而使 CTE 變差，暗電流也會被時脈感應電荷與輝光等其他來源墊底。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Laboratory cameras use multistage thermoelectric coolers to reach −70 to −100 °C, and observatories use liquid nitrogen or closed-cycle cold heads below −100 °C; too cold, however, lengthens some trap emission times and worsens CTE, and dark current is floored by other sources such as clock-induced charge and glow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「溫度越低越好，CCD 冷到最低溫就沒有任何代價。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Colder is always better; cooling a CCD to its minimum has no penalty." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Temperature dependence of dark current and cooling design" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
增益就是 ADC 位元數除以滿井，不需量測。

Gain is simply full well divided by ADC range and needs no measurement.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「平場對與 Fe-55 X 光源」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flat-field pairs and Fe-55 source” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相機增益 K（e⁻/DN）可由光子散粒雜訊的統計求得：訊號 S 個電子的變異數等於 S，兩張同條件平場相減可消去像素響應不均，差值變異數的一半等於 S/K 加上讀出雜訊平方。Fe-55 放射源的 Mn Kα 5.9 keV X 光在單一像素產生約 1616 個電子，提供獨立的絕對增益。厚 CCD 在高訊號時，已收集的電荷會把後來的電荷推向鄰近像素，造成相鄰像素正相關、單像素變異數低於泊松值的亮者變胖效應，必須把共變異數加回去。PTC 的轉折點同時給出滿井容量，要與 ADC 的量化範圍匹配。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「平場對與 Fe-55 X 光源」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Camera gain K in e⁻/DN follows from photon shot-noise statistics: a signal of S electrons has variance S, and subtracting two flats taken under identical conditions cancels pixel response non-uniformity, so half the variance of the difference equals S/K plus the read noise squared. The 5.9 keV Mn Kα X-rays from an Fe-55 source create about 1616 electrons in a single pixel, giving an independent absolute gain. In thick CCDs at high signal, collected charge pushes later charge into neighbouring pixels, the brighter-fatter effect, which correlates neighbours and lowers single-pixel variance below Poisson, so covariances must be added back. The PTC turnover also marks full well, which must be matched to the ADC range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Flat-field pairs and Fe-55 source”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume K = 1.5 e⁻/DN: a mean of 10 000 DN is 15 000 e⁻, shot variance 15 000/1.5² = 6667 DN², and 2.9 e⁻ read noise is 1.93 DN or 3.74 DN²; measuring 6670.4 DN² gives K = 10 000/(6670.4 − 3.74) = 1.50.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增益就是 ADC 位元數除以滿井，不需量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gain is simply full well divided by ADC range and needs no measurement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「平場對與 Fe-55 X 光源」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Flat-field pairs and Fe-55 source”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The 5.9 keV Mn Kα X-rays from an Fe-55 source create about 1616 electrons in a single pixel, giving an independent absolute gain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增益就是 ADC 位元數除以滿井，不需量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration" is correct?
options: 相機增益 K（e⁻/DN）可由光子散粒雜訊的統計求得：訊號 S 個電子的變異數等於 S，兩張同條件平場相減可消去像素響應不均，差值變異數的一半等於 S/K 加上讀出雜訊平方。
增益就是 ADC 位元數除以滿井，不需量測。
像素合併只是軟體後處理，任何感測器效果都一樣。
optionsEn: Camera gain K in e⁻/DN follows from photon shot-noise statistics: a signal of S electrons has variance S, and subtracting two flats taken under identical conditions cancels pixel response non-uniformity, so half the variance of the difference equals S/K plus the read noise squared.
Gain is simply full well divided by ADC range and needs no measurement.
Binning is only software post-processing and works the same on any sensor.
quiz.explanation: 相機增益 K（e⁻/DN）可由光子散粒雜訊的統計求得：訊號 S 個電子的變異數等於 S，兩張同條件平場相減可消去像素響應不均，差值變異數的一半等於 S/K 加上讀出雜訊平方。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Camera gain K in e⁻/DN follows from photon shot-noise statistics: a signal of S electrons has variance S, and subtracting two flats taken under identical conditions cancels pixel response non-uniformity, so half the variance of the difference equals S/K plus the read noise squared. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平場對與 Fe-55 X 光源」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flat-field pairs and Fe-55 source” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設 K = 1.5 e⁻/DN：平均 10 000 DN = 15 000 e⁻，散粒變異數 15 000/1.5² = 6667 DN²，讀出雜訊 2.9 e⁻ = 1.93 DN 即 3.74 DN²，量得 6670.4 DN²，K = 10 000/(6670.4 − 3.74) = 1.50。Fe-55：1616 e⁻ 峰值落在 1077 DN，K = 1.50 吻合。16 位元 ADC 上限 65 535 DN × 1.5 = 98 300 e⁻，略低於 100 000 e⁻ 的滿井，ADC 先飽和。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume K = 1.5 e⁻/DN: a mean of 10 000 DN is 15 000 e⁻, shot variance 15 000/1.5² = 6667 DN², and 2.9 e⁻ read noise is 1.93 DN or 3.74 DN²; measuring 6670.4 DN² gives K = 10 000/(6670.4 − 3.74) = 1.50. Fe-55: a 1616 e⁻ peak at 1077 DN gives K = 1.50, in agreement. A 16-bit ADC tops out at 65 535 DN × 1.5 = 98 300 e⁻, slightly below the 100 000 e⁻ full well, so the ADC saturates first. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從 100 DN 到飽和取 20 組以上的平場對，畫雜訊對訊號的對數 PTC，確認讀出雜訊平台、斜率 1/2 的散粒段與滿井轉折；計算最近鄰像素共變異數隨訊號的增長並加回變異數；另以 Fe-55 曝光挑出單像素事件做直方圖，比較兩種 K 值，差異應小於 1%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take more than 20 flat pairs from 100 DN to saturation and plot a log–log PTC of noise versus signal, confirming the read-noise floor, the slope-1/2 shot-noise segment and the full-well turnover; compute how nearest-neighbour covariance grows with signal and add it back to the variance; histogram single-pixel events from an Fe-55 exposure and require the two K values to agree within 1%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Assume K = 1.5 e⁻/DN: a mean of 10 000 DN is 15 000 e⁻, shot variance 15 000/1.5² = 6667 DN², and 2.9 e⁻ read noise is 1.93 DN or 3.74 DN²; measuring 6670.4 DN² gives K = 10 000/(6670.4 − 3.74) = 1.50. Fe-55: a 1616 e⁻ peak at 1077 DN gives K = 1.50, in agreement. A 16-bit ADC tops out at 65 535 DN × 1.5 = 98 300 e⁻, slightly below the 100 000 e⁻ full well, so the ADC saturates first.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration", which statement holds?
options: 背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。
讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。
optionsEn: A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength.
Assume K = 1.5 e⁻/DN: a mean of 10 000 DN is 15 000 e⁻, shot variance 15 000/1.5² = 6667 DN², and 2.9 e⁻ read noise is 1.93 DN or 3.74 DN².
Read noise belongs to the chip alone and does not depend on readout speed.
quiz.explanationEn: Assume K = 1.5 e⁻/DN: a mean of 10 000 DN is 15 000 e⁻, shot variance 15 000/1.5² = 6667 DN², and 2.9 e⁻ read noise is 1.93 DN or 3.74 DN²; measuring 6670.4 DN² gives K = 10 000/(6670.4 − 3.74) = 1.50. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「平場對與 Fe-55 X 光源」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Flat-field pairs and Fe-55 source” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從 100 DN 到飽和取 20 組以上的平場對，畫雜訊對訊號的對數 PTC，確認讀出雜訊平台、斜率 1/2 的散粒段與滿井轉折；計算最近鄰像素共變異數隨訊號的增長並加回變異數；另以 Fe-55 曝光挑出單像素事件做直方圖，比較兩種 K 值，差異應小於 1%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take more than 20 flat pairs from 100 DN to saturation and plot a log–log PTC of noise versus signal, confirming the read-noise floor, the slope-1/2 shot-noise segment and the full-well turnover; compute how nearest-neighbour covariance grows with signal and add it back to the variance; histogram single-pixel events from an Fe-55 exposure and require the two K values to agree within 1%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用單張平場而非平場對計算變異數，1% 的像素響應不均在 15 000 e⁻ 時貢獻 (0.01×15 000)² = 22 500 e⁻²，大於散粒變異數，估出的 K 只有 0.6 e⁻/DN，低估六成；忽略亮者變胖效應則高訊號段的 K 被高估，所有以電子數表示的雜訊與滿井數字都跟著錯。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Computing variance from single flats instead of pairs lets 1% response non-uniformity contribute (0.01×15 000)² = 22 500 e⁻² at 15 000 e⁻, more than the shot variance, so K comes out at 0.6 e⁻/DN, 60% low; ignoring the brighter-fatter effect overestimates K at high signal, and every noise and full-well number quoted in electrons is wrong with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從 100 DN 到飽和取 20 組以上的平場對，畫雜訊對訊號的對數 PTC，確認讀出雜訊平台、斜率 1/2 的散粒段與滿井轉折；計算最近鄰像素共變異數隨訊號的增長並加回變異數；另以 Fe-55 曝光挑出單像素事件做直方圖，比較兩種 K 值，差異應小於 1%。
knowledge.textEn: Take more than 20 flat pairs from 100 DN to saturation and plot a log–log PTC of noise versus signal, confirming the read-noise floor, the slope-1/2 shot-noise segment and the full-well turnover; compute how nearest-neighbour covariance grows with signal and add it back to the variance; histogram single-pixel events from an Fe-55 exposure and require the two K values to agree within 1%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
矽越厚越好，因為紅光量子效率一定越高。
從 100 DN 到飽和取 20 組以上的平場對，畫雜訊對訊號的對數 PTC，確認讀出雜訊平台、斜率 1/2 的散粒段與滿井轉折。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Thicker silicon is always better because red QE rises.
Take more than 20 flat pairs from 100 DN to saturation and plot a log–log PTC of noise versus signal, confirming the read-noise floor, the slope-1/2 shot-noise segment and the full-well turnover.
quiz.explanation: 從 100 DN 到飽和取 20 組以上的平場對，畫雜訊對訊號的對數 PTC，確認讀出雜訊平台、斜率 1/2 的散粒段與滿井轉折；計算最近鄰像素共變異數隨訊號的增長並加回變異數；另以 Fe-55 曝光挑出單像素事件做直方圖，比較兩種 K 值，差異應小於 1%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take more than 20 flat pairs from 100 DN to saturation and plot a log–log PTC of noise versus signal, confirming the read-noise floor, the slope-1/2 shot-noise segment and the full-well turnover; compute how nearest-neighbour covariance grows with signal and add it back to the variance; histogram single-pixel events from an Fe-55 exposure and require the two K values to agree within 1%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「平場對與 Fe-55 X 光源」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Flat-field pairs and Fe-55 source” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用單張平場而非平場對計算變異數，1% 的像素響應不均在 15 000 e⁻ 時貢獻 (0.01×15 000)² = 22 500 e⁻²，大於散粒變異數，估出的 K 只有 0.6 e⁻/DN，低估六成；忽略亮者變胖效應則高訊號段的 K 被高估，所有以電子數表示的雜訊與滿井數字都跟著錯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Computing variance from single flats instead of pairs lets 1% response non-uniformity contribute (0.01×15 000)² = 22 500 e⁻² at 15 000 e⁻, more than the shot variance, so K comes out at 0.6 e⁻/DN, 60% low; ignoring the brighter-fatter effect overestimates K at high signal, and every noise and full-well number quoted in electrons is wrong with it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：PTC 的轉折點同時給出滿井容量，要與 ADC 的量化範圍匹配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The PTC turnover also marks full well, which must be matched to the ADC range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增益就是 ADC 位元數除以滿井，不需量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gain is simply full well divided by ADC range and needs no measurement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「影像校正鏈、晶片上合併與宇宙射線」與「相機驗收、多輸出串擾與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Calibration chain, on-chip binning and cosmic rays" and "Camera acceptance, multi-output crosstalk and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 影像校正鏈、晶片上合併與宇宙射線：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Calibration chain, on-chip binning and cosmic rays: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「偏壓、暗場、平場與宇宙射線」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bias, darks, flats and cosmic rays” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 科學影像依序扣除過掃描區估得的偏壓位準與主偏壓的結構、扣除依曝光時間縮放的暗場、除以正規化的主平場，再套用壞像素遮罩並剔除宇宙射線；剔除可用多張曝光的中位數或以拉普拉斯邊緣偵測找出比點擴散函數更銳利的事件。CCD 可在晶片上合併像素：在水平暫存器或加總井中把相鄰電荷先相加再讀一次，整組只付一次讀出雜訊，這是 CCD 相對於逐像素讀出感測器的特殊優勢，但受水平暫存器滿井與解析度損失限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏壓、暗場、平場與宇宙射線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Science frames have the bias level estimated from the overscan and the master-bias structure removed, then a dark scaled to exposure time subtracted, a normalised master flat divided out, a bad-pixel mask applied and cosmic rays rejected, either by median-combining several exposures or by Laplacian edge detection of events sharper than the point-spread function. A CCD can bin on chip, summing neighbouring charge in the serial register or a summing well before a single read, so the group pays read noise only once; this is a distinctive CCD advantage over pixel-by-pixel readout sensors, limited by serial-register full well and loss of resolution. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bias, darks, flats and cosmic rays”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每像素 4 e⁻、讀出雜訊 2.9 e⁻：四像素分別讀出再相加 SNR = 16/√(16 + 4×8.41) = 2.27；晶片上 2×2 合併只讀一次 SNR = 16/√(16 + 8.41) = 3.24，提升 43%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 4 e⁻ per pixel and 2.9 e⁻ read noise, reading four pixels separately and summing gives SNR = 16/√(16 + 4×8.41) = 2.27, while 2×2 on-chip binning read once gives 16/√(16 + 8.41) = 3.24, 43% better.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「像素合併只是軟體後處理，任何感測器效果都一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Binning is only software post-processing and works the same on any sensor." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「偏壓、暗場、平場與宇宙射線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Bias, darks, flats and cosmic rays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 影像校正鏈、晶片上合併與宇宙射線
knowledge.titleEn: Calibration chain, on-chip binning and cosmic rays
knowledge.text: 科學影像依序扣除過掃描區估得的偏壓位準與主偏壓的結構、扣除依曝光時間縮放的暗場、除以正規化的主平場，再套用壞像素遮罩並剔除宇宙射線；剔除可用多張曝光的中位數或以拉普拉斯邊緣偵測找出比點擴散函數更銳利的事件。CCD 可在晶片上合併像素：在水平暫存器或加總井中把相鄰電荷先相加再讀一次，整組只付一次讀出雜訊，這是 CCD 相對於逐像素讀出感測器的特殊優勢，但受水平暫存器滿井與解析度損失限制。
knowledge.textEn: Science frames have the bias level estimated from the overscan and the master-bias structure removed, then a dark scaled to exposure time subtracted, a normalised master flat divided out, a bad-pixel mask applied and cosmic rays rejected, either by median-combining several exposures or by Laplacian edge detection of events sharper than the point-spread function. A CCD can bin on chip, summing neighbouring charge in the serial register or a summing well before a single read, so the group pays read noise only once; this is a distinctive CCD advantage over pixel-by-pixel readout sensors, limited by serial-register full well and loss of resolution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：像素合併只是軟體後處理，任何感測器效果都一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Binning is only software post-processing and works the same on any sensor. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「影像校正鏈、晶片上合併與宇宙射線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Calibration chain, on-chip binning and cosmic rays" is correct?
options: 像素合併只是軟體後處理，任何感測器效果都一樣。
科學影像依序扣除過掃描區估得的偏壓位準與主偏壓的結構、扣除依曝光時間縮放的暗場、除以正規化的主平場，再套用壞像素遮罩並剔除宇宙射線。
出廠規格合格的 CCD，裝進相機後不必再做系統驗收。
optionsEn: Binning is only software post-processing and works the same on any sensor.

Science frames have the bias level estimated from the overscan and the master-bias structure removed, then a dark scaled to exposure time subtracted, a normalised master flat divided out, a bad-pixel mask applied and cosmic rays rejected, either by median-combining several exposures or by Laplacian edge detection of events sharper than the point-spread function.
A CCD that met factory specifications needs no system acceptance once installed.
quiz.explanation: 科學影像依序扣除過掃描區估得的偏壓位準與主偏壓的結構、扣除依曝光時間縮放的暗場、除以正規化的主平場，再套用壞像素遮罩並剔除宇宙射線；剔除可用多張曝光的中位數或以拉普拉斯邊緣偵測找出比點擴散函數更銳利的事件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Science frames have the bias level estimated from the overscan and the master-bias structure removed, then a dark scaled to exposure time subtracted, a normalised master flat divided out, a bad-pixel mask applied and cosmic rays rejected, either by median-combining several exposures or by Laplacian edge detection of events sharper than the point-spread function. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 影像校正鏈、晶片上合併與宇宙射線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Calibration chain, on-chip binning and cosmic rays: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偏壓、暗場、平場與宇宙射線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bias, darks, flats and cosmic rays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每像素 4 e⁻、讀出雜訊 2.9 e⁻：四像素分別讀出再相加 SNR = 16/√(16 + 4×8.41) = 2.27；晶片上 2×2 合併只讀一次 SNR = 16/√(16 + 8.41) = 3.24，提升 43%。宇宙射線：海平面約 1 個/cm²/min，27.6 mm 見方晶片 7.6 cm²，1800 s 約 228 次；最小游離粒子在矽中約 80 e⁻/µm，垂直穿過 15 µm 留下 1200 e⁻，40 µm 深空乏留下 3200 e⁻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 4 e⁻ per pixel and 2.9 e⁻ read noise, reading four pixels separately and summing gives SNR = 16/√(16 + 4×8.41) = 2.27, while 2×2 on-chip binning read once gives 16/√(16 + 8.41) = 3.24, 43% better. Cosmic rays: about 1 per cm² per minute at sea level, so a 27.6 mm square 7.6 cm² chip sees about 228 in 1800 s; a minimum-ionising particle leaves about 80 e⁻/µm in silicon, 1200 e⁻ crossing 15 µm vertically and 3200 e⁻ in 40 µm of deep-depleted silicon. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每張影像記錄過掃描區平均與標準差以追蹤偏壓漂移；以 50 張偏壓影像建主偏壓並以兩兩相減驗證讀出雜訊；比較合併與未合併模式下的讀出雜訊與增益；以長時間暗場統計宇宙射線事件率與電荷分布，調整剔除門檻並檢查假剔除率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log overscan mean and standard deviation for every frame to track bias drift; build a master bias from 50 frames and verify read noise from pairwise differences; compare read noise and gain in binned and unbinned modes; use long darks to measure cosmic-ray event rate and charge distribution, then tune the rejection threshold and check the false-rejection rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 每像素 4 e⁻、讀出雜訊 2.9 e⁻：四像素分別讀出再相加 SNR = 16/√(16 + 4×8.41) = 2.27；晶片上 2×2 合併只讀一次 SNR = 16/√(16 + 8.41) = 3.24，提升 43%。宇宙射線：海平面約 1 個/cm²/min，27.6 mm 見方晶片 7.6 cm²，1800 s 約 228 次；最小游離粒子在矽中約 80 e⁻/µm，垂直穿過 15 µm 留下 1200 e⁻，40 µm 深空乏留下 3200 e⁻。
knowledge.textEn: At 4 e⁻ per pixel and 2.9 e⁻ read noise, reading four pixels separately and summing gives SNR = 16/√(16 + 4×8.41) = 2.27, while 2×2 on-chip binning read once gives 16/√(16 + 8.41) = 3.24, 43% better. Cosmic rays: about 1 per cm² per minute at sea level, so a 27.6 mm square 7.6 cm² chip sees about 228 in 1800 s; a minimum-ionising particle leaves about 80 e⁻/µm in silicon, 1200 e⁻ crossing 15 µm vertically and 3200 e⁻ in 40 µm of deep-depleted silicon.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.
