steps.title: 影像校正鏈、晶片上合併與宇宙射線：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Calibration chain, on-chip binning and cosmic rays: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「偏壓、暗場、平場與宇宙射線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Bias, darks, flats and cosmic rays” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每張影像記錄過掃描區平均與標準差以追蹤偏壓漂移；以 50 張偏壓影像建主偏壓並以兩兩相減驗證讀出雜訊；比較合併與未合併模式下的讀出雜訊與增益；以長時間暗場統計宇宙射線事件率與電荷分布，調整剔除門檻並檢查假剔除率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log overscan mean and standard deviation for every frame to track bias drift; build a master bias from 50 frames and verify read noise from pairwise differences; compare read noise and gain in binned and unbinned modes; use long darks to measure cosmic-ray event rate and charge distribution, then tune the rejection threshold and check the false-rejection rate. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：合併後的總電荷超過水平暫存器容量，亮星電荷沿水平方向溢出成條紋並污染同一列的暗弱源；在深空乏元件上只拍一張長曝光，數百條宇宙射線徑跡無法用中位數剔除，被誤認為暫現源或移動天體。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Binned charge that exceeds serial-register capacity spills bright-star charge into horizontal streaks that contaminate faint sources in the same row; taking a single long exposure on a deep-depletion device leaves hundreds of cosmic-ray tracks that cannot be median-rejected and are mistaken for transients or moving objects.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每張影像記錄過掃描區平均與標準差以追蹤偏壓漂移；以 50 張偏壓影像建主偏壓並以兩兩相減驗證讀出雜訊；比較合併與未合併模式下的讀出雜訊與增益；以長時間暗場統計宇宙射線事件率與電荷分布，調整剔除門檻並檢查假剔除率。
knowledge.textEn: Log overscan mean and standard deviation for every frame to track bias drift; build a master bias from 50 frames and verify read noise from pairwise differences; compare read noise and gain in binned and unbinned modes; use long darks to measure cosmic-ray event rate and charge distribution, then tune the rejection threshold and check the false-rejection rate.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「影像校正鏈、晶片上合併與宇宙射線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Calibration chain, on-chip binning and cosmic rays"?
options: 每張影像記錄過掃描區平均與標準差以追蹤偏壓漂移。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
溫度越低越好，CCD 冷到最低溫就沒有任何代價。
optionsEn: Log overscan mean and standard deviation for every frame to track bias drift.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Colder is always better; cooling a CCD to its minimum has no penalty.
quiz.explanation: 每張影像記錄過掃描區平均與標準差以追蹤偏壓漂移；以 50 張偏壓影像建主偏壓並以兩兩相減驗證讀出雜訊；比較合併與未合併模式下的讀出雜訊與增益；以長時間暗場統計宇宙射線事件率與電荷分布，調整剔除門檻並檢查假剔除率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log overscan mean and standard deviation for every frame to track bias drift; build a master bias from 50 frames and verify read noise from pairwise differences; compare read noise and gain in binned and unbinned modes; use long darks to measure cosmic-ray event rate and charge distribution, then tune the rejection threshold and check the false-rejection rate. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 影像校正鏈、晶片上合併與宇宙射線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Calibration chain, on-chip binning and cosmic rays: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏壓、暗場、平場與宇宙射線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Bias, darks, flats and cosmic rays” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 合併後的總電荷超過水平暫存器容量，亮星電荷沿水平方向溢出成條紋並污染同一列的暗弱源；在深空乏元件上只拍一張長曝光，數百條宇宙射線徑跡無法用中位數剔除，被誤認為暫現源或移動天體。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Binned charge that exceeds serial-register capacity spills bright-star charge into horizontal streaks that contaminate faint sources in the same row; taking a single long exposure on a deep-depletion device leaves hundreds of cosmic-ray tracks that cannot be median-rejected and are mistaken for transients or moving objects. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：CCD 可在晶片上合併像素：在水平暫存器或加總井中把相鄰電荷先相加再讀一次，整組只付一次讀出雜訊，這是 CCD 相對於逐像素讀出感測器的特殊優勢，但受水平暫存器滿井與解析度損失限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A CCD can bin on chip, summing neighbouring charge in the serial register or a summing well before a single read, so the group pays read noise only once; this is a distinctive CCD advantage over pixel-by-pixel readout sensors, limited by serial-register full well and loss of resolution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「像素合併只是軟體後處理，任何感測器效果都一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Binning is only software post-processing and works the same on any sensor." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 合併後的總電荷超過水平暫存器容量，亮星電荷沿水平方向溢出成條紋並污染同一列的暗弱源；在深空乏元件上只拍一張長曝光，數百條宇宙射線徑跡無法用中位數剔除，被誤認為暫現源或移動天體。
knowledge.textEn: Binned charge that exceeds serial-register capacity spills bright-star charge into horizontal streaks that contaminate faint sources in the same row; taking a single long exposure on a deep-depletion device leaves hundreds of cosmic-ray tracks that cannot be median-rejected and are mistaken for transients or moving objects.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「影像校正鏈、晶片上合併與宇宙射線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Calibration chain, on-chip binning and cosmic rays" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
合併後的總電荷超過水平暫存器容量，亮星電荷沿水平方向溢出成條紋並污染同一列的暗弱源。
出廠規格合格的 CCD，裝進相機後不必再做系統驗收。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Binned charge that exceeds serial-register capacity spills bright-star charge into horizontal streaks that contaminate faint sources in the same row.
A CCD that met factory specifications needs no system acceptance once installed.
quiz.explanation: 合併後的總電荷超過水平暫存器容量，亮星電荷沿水平方向溢出成條紋並污染同一列的暗弱源；在深空乏元件上只拍一張長曝光，數百條宇宙射線徑跡無法用中位數剔除，被誤認為暫現源或移動天體。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Binned charge that exceeds serial-register capacity spills bright-star charge into horizontal streaks that contaminate faint sources in the same row; taking a single long exposure on a deep-depletion device leaves hundreds of cosmic-ray tracks that cannot be median-rejected and are mistaken for transients or moving objects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 相機驗收、多輸出串擾與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Camera acceptance, multi-output crosstalk and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收測試台與交接紀錄」如何決定科學級 CCD 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance test bench and handoff record” determines the key performance of “Scientific CCD imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相機驗收把前面的模型逐項變成量測：各輸出的 PTC 增益與讀出雜訊、以 Fe-55 與延伸像素邊緣響應量 CTE、暗電流地圖、QE 對波長、線性度、滿井與溢出、壞像素與陷阱、多輸出同時讀出時的串擾矩陣、快門時間地圖，以及深空乏元件在近紅外過曝後的殘留體影像。交接紀錄要列出時脈電壓與時序、操作溫度、各輸出增益、壞像素遮罩、串擾係數與快門修正，因為任何一項改變都會讓既有校正失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收測試台與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Camera acceptance turns the earlier models into measurements: PTC gain and read noise per output, CTE from Fe-55 and extended pixel edge response, a dark-current map, QE versus wavelength, linearity, full well and blooming, bad pixels and traps, the crosstalk matrix between outputs read simultaneously, a shutter-timing map and, for deep-depletion devices, residual bulk image after near-infrared overexposure. The handoff record lists clock voltages and timing, operating temperature, per-output gain, bad-pixel mask, crosstalk coefficients and shutter correction, because a change in any of them invalidates the existing calibration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance test bench and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：快門：光圈式快門中央比邊緣多曝光 8 ms，1 s 平場的照度誤差 0.8%，10 s 時降為 0.08%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Shutter: an iris shutter exposing the centre 8 ms longer than the edge gives a 0.8% illumination error in a 1 s flat but only 0.08% at 10 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出廠規格合格的 CCD，裝進相機後不必再做系統驗收。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A CCD that met factory specifications needs no system acceptance once installed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收測試台與交接紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance test bench and handoff record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 相機驗收、多輸出串擾與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Camera acceptance, multi-output crosstalk and handoff
knowledge.text: 相機驗收把前面的模型逐項變成量測：各輸出的 PTC 增益與讀出雜訊、以 Fe-55 與延伸像素邊緣響應量 CTE、暗電流地圖、QE 對波長、線性度、滿井與溢出、壞像素與陷阱、多輸出同時讀出時的串擾矩陣、快門時間地圖，以及深空乏元件在近紅外過曝後的殘留體影像。交接紀錄要列出時脈電壓與時序、操作溫度、各輸出增益、壞像素遮罩、串擾係數與快門修正，因為任何一項改變都會讓既有校正失效。
knowledge.textEn: Camera acceptance turns the earlier models into measurements: PTC gain and read noise per output, CTE from Fe-55 and extended pixel edge response, a dark-current map, QE versus wavelength, linearity, full well and blooming, bad pixels and traps, the crosstalk matrix between outputs read simultaneously, a shutter-timing map and, for deep-depletion devices, residual bulk image after near-infrared overexposure. The handoff record lists clock voltages and timing, operating temperature, per-output gain, bad-pixel mask, crosstalk coefficients and shutter correction, because a change in any of them invalidates the existing calibration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出廠規格合格的 CCD，裝進相機後不必再做系統驗收。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A CCD that met factory specifications needs no system acceptance once installed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相機驗收、多輸出串擾與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Camera acceptance, multi-output crosstalk and handoff" is correct?
options: 出廠規格合格的 CCD，裝進相機後不必再做系統驗收。
背照式 CCD 在所有波長都有九成以上的量子效率。
相機驗收把前面的模型逐項變成量測：各輸出的 PTC 增益與讀出雜訊、以 Fe-55 與延伸像素邊緣響應量 CTE、暗電流地圖、QE 對波長、線性度、滿井與溢出、壞像素與陷阱、多輸出同時讀出時的串擾矩陣、快門時間地圖，以及深空乏元件在近紅外過曝後的殘留體影像。
optionsEn: A CCD that met factory specifications needs no system acceptance once installed.
A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength.

Camera acceptance turns the earlier models into measurements: PTC gain and read noise per output, CTE from Fe-55 and extended pixel edge response, a dark-current map, QE versus wavelength, linearity, full well and blooming, bad pixels and traps, the crosstalk matrix between outputs read simultaneously, a shutter-timing map and, for deep-depletion devices, residual bulk image after near-infrared overexposure.
quiz.explanation: 相機驗收把前面的模型逐項變成量測：各輸出的 PTC 增益與讀出雜訊、以 Fe-55 與延伸像素邊緣響應量 CTE、暗電流地圖、QE 對波長、線性度、滿井與溢出、壞像素與陷阱、多輸出同時讀出時的串擾矩陣、快門時間地圖，以及深空乏元件在近紅外過曝後的殘留體影像。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Camera acceptance turns the earlier models into measurements: PTC gain and read noise per output, CTE from Fe-55 and extended pixel edge response, a dark-current map, QE versus wavelength, linearity, full well and blooming, bad pixels and traps, the crosstalk matrix between outputs read simultaneously, a shutter-timing map and, for deep-depletion devices, residual bulk image after near-infrared overexposure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相機驗收、多輸出串擾與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Camera acceptance, multi-output crosstalk and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收測試台與交接紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance test bench and handoff record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：快門：光圈式快門中央比邊緣多曝光 8 ms，1 s 平場的照度誤差 0.8%，10 s 時降為 0.08%。串擾：係數 2×10⁻⁴ 時，一顆在 A 輸出達 60 000 DN 的亮星在 B 輸出產生 12 DN 的鬼影，若天光雜訊 10 DN，鬼影超過 1σ 會被誤判為暗弱源。線性度：在 1% 到 90% 滿井範圍內殘差需小於 1%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Shutter: an iris shutter exposing the centre 8 ms longer than the edge gives a 0.8% illumination error in a 1 s flat but only 0.08% at 10 s. Crosstalk: with a coefficient of 2×10⁻⁴, a bright star reaching 60 000 DN on output A creates a 12 DN ghost on output B, above 1σ of a 10 DN sky noise and liable to be catalogued as a faint source. Linearity residuals must stay below 1% from 1% to 90% of full well. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依固定順序執行：偏壓與讀出雜訊；PTC 與 Fe-55 增益；CTE；溫度掃描暗電流；QE；線性度與滿井；以單一輸出放置亮點光源量串擾矩陣；以多種短曝光平場相除求快門時間地圖；近紅外過曝後連續暗場量殘影。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Execute in a fixed order: bias and read noise; PTC and Fe-55 gain; CTE; dark current over a temperature scan; QE; linearity and full well; crosstalk matrix from a bright spot placed on one output at a time; shutter-timing map from ratios of short-exposure flats; residual image from consecutive darks after near-infrared overexposure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 快門：光圈式快門中央比邊緣多曝光 8 ms，1 s 平場的照度誤差 0.8%，10 s 時降為 0.08%。串擾：係數 2×10⁻⁴ 時，一顆在 A 輸出達 60 000 DN 的亮星在 B 輸出產生 12 DN 的鬼影，若天光雜訊 10 DN，鬼影超過 1σ 會被誤判為暗弱源。線性度：在 1% 到 90% 滿井範圍內殘差需小於 1%。
knowledge.textEn: Shutter: an iris shutter exposing the centre 8 ms longer than the edge gives a 0.8% illumination error in a 1 s flat but only 0.08% at 10 s. Crosstalk: with a coefficient of 2×10⁻⁴, a bright star reaching 60 000 DN on output A creates a 12 DN ghost on output B, above 1σ of a 10 DN sky noise and liable to be catalogued as a faint source. Linearity residuals must stay below 1% from 1% to 90% of full well.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「相機驗收、多輸出串擾與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Camera acceptance, multi-output crosstalk and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 快門：光圈式快門中央比邊緣多曝光 8 ms，1 s 平場的照度誤差 0.8%，10 s 時降為 0.08%。
讀出雜訊只與晶片有關，與讀出速度無關。
溫度越低越好，CCD 冷到最低溫就沒有任何代價。
optionsEn: Shutter: an iris shutter exposing the centre 8 ms longer than the edge gives a 0.8% illumination error in a 1 s flat but only 0.08% at 10 s.
Read noise belongs to the chip alone and does not depend on readout speed.
Colder is always better; cooling a CCD to its minimum has no penalty.
quiz.explanation: 快門：光圈式快門中央比邊緣多曝光 8 ms，1 s 平場的照度誤差 0.8%，10 s 時降為 0.08%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Shutter: an iris shutter exposing the centre 8 ms longer than the edge gives a 0.8% illumination error in a 1 s flat but only 0.08% at 10 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 相機驗收、多輸出串擾與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Camera acceptance, multi-output crosstalk and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收測試台與交接紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance test bench and handoff record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 依固定順序執行：偏壓與讀出雜訊；PTC 與 Fe-55 增益；CTE；溫度掃描暗電流；QE；線性度與滿井；以單一輸出放置亮點光源量串擾矩陣；以多種短曝光平場相除求快門時間地圖；近紅外過曝後連續暗場量殘影。全部結果與模型並列，超出允收值者記錄原因並重新調整時脈或溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Execute in a fixed order: bias and read noise; PTC and Fe-55 gain; CTE; dark current over a temperature scan; QE; linearity and full well; crosstalk matrix from a bright spot placed on one output at a time; shutter-timing map from ratios of short-exposure flats; residual image from consecutive darks after near-infrared overexposure. List every result beside its model value and, when an item exceeds its allowance, record the cause and retune clocks or temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：更換控制器韌體改變了時脈重疊時間，CTE 與增益同時漂移，但交接紀錄沒有時脈設定可比對，只能從頭重做全部校正；未建立串擾矩陣的巡天相機在每顆亮星的對稱位置產生鬼影，進入星表後需要大量人工清除。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A controller firmware update changes clock overlap timing so CTE and gain both drift, and without clock settings in the handoff record there is nothing to compare against except a full recalibration; a survey camera without a crosstalk matrix produces ghosts at the mirrored position of every bright star, which enter the catalogue and need extensive manual cleaning.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 相機驗收、多輸出串擾與工程交接：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收測試台與交接紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 更換控制器韌體改變了時脈重疊時間，CTE 與增益同時漂移，但交接紀錄沒有時脈設定可比對，只能從頭重做全部校正；未建立串擾矩陣的巡天相機在每顆亮星的對稱位置產生鬼影，進入星表後需要大量人工清除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A controller firmware update changes clock overlap timing so CTE and gain both drift, and without clock settings in the handoff record there is nothing to compare against except a full recalibration; a survey camera without a crosstalk matrix produces ghosts at the mirrored position of every bright star, which enter the catalogue and need extensive manual cleaning. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄要列出時脈電壓與時序、操作溫度、各輸出增益、壞像素遮罩、串擾係數與快門修正，因為任何一項改變都會讓既有校正失效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record lists clock voltages and timing, operating temperature, per-output gain, bad-pixel mask, crosstalk coefficients and shutter correction, because a change in any of them invalidates the existing calibration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出廠規格合格的 CCD，裝進相機後不必再做系統驗收。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A CCD that met factory specifications needs no system acceptance once installed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

A back-illuminated CCD has over 90% QE at every wavelength.
A controller firmware update changes clock overlap timing so CTE and gain both drift, and without clock settings in the handoff record there is nothing to compare against except a full recalibration.

title: 科學級 CMOS 成像系統
summary: 從釘扎光電二極體與背照式結構出發，理解 sCMOS 為何能以 1 e⁻ 以下的讀出雜訊和 95% 的量子效率成像，再把滾動快門時序、光子轉移校正、DSNU/PRNU 校正與資料鏈路檢查整合成一套可驗收的科學相機工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Start from the pinned photodiode and back-illuminated structure to see why an sCMOS can image with sub-electron read noise and 95 percent quantum efficiency, then integrate rolling-shutter timing, photon-transfer calibration, DSNU/PRNU correction and data-link checks into an acceptable scientific-camera engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 低光螢光成像的 SNR 預算練習：假設曝光 5 ms，每像素收到 50 個光子。背照式 sCMOS（QE 0.95、讀出雜訊 1.0 e⁻、暗電流 0.7 e⁻/px/s）：訊號 S = 47.5 e⁻，暗電荷 0.7×0.005 = 0.0035 e⁻ 可忽略，SNR = 47.5/√(47.5 + 0.0035 + 1.0²) = 47.5/6.96 = 6.8。前照式感測器（QE 0.60、讀出雜訊 1.6 e⁻）：S = 30 e⁻，SNR = 30/√(30 + 2.56) = 30/5.71 = 5.3。若實驗要求 SNR ≥ 20，背照式需要平均 (20/6.8)² ≈ 8.6，即 9 張；前照式需要 (20/5.3)² ≈ 14.2，即 15 張。再檢查快門：2304 列、列時間 10 µs 的偏斜為 23 ms，大於 5 ms 的曝光，所以不存在所有列同時曝光的窗口，脈衝照明必須改用全域重置模式或連續照明。數值為教學假設，不代表任何特定相機的規格。
workedExample.textEn: SNR-budget exercise for low-light fluorescence: assume a 5 ms exposure with 50 photons per pixel. A back-illuminated sCMOS with QE 0.95, read noise 1.0 electron and dark current 0.7 electron per pixel per second gives S = 47.5 electrons, a negligible dark charge of 0.7×0.005 = 0.0035 electron, and SNR = 47.5/√(47.5 + 0.0035 + 1.0²) = 47.5/6.96 = 6.8. A front-illuminated sensor with QE 0.60 and read noise 1.6 electrons gives S = 30 electrons and SNR = 30/√(30 + 2.56) = 30/5.71 = 5.3. If the experiment needs SNR ≥ 20, the back-illuminated camera must average (20/6.8)² ≈ 8.6, so 9 frames, while the front-illuminated one needs (20/5.3)² ≈ 14.2, so 15 frames. Then check the shutter: 2304 rows at a 10 µs line time give a skew of 23 ms, longer than the 5 ms exposure, so no window exists in which all rows are exposed together and pulsed illumination must switch to a global-reset mode or continuous light. Values are teaching assumptions, not the specification of any particular camera.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」與「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure" and "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 科學級 CMOS（sCMOS）的每個像素都是一個釘扎光電二極體加上四到五個電晶體：轉移閘把累積的電子送到浮動擴散節點，重置電晶體清空節點，源極隨耦器把電荷轉成電壓，列選擇電晶體把訊號送上行匯流排。量子效率 QE 是入射光子被轉成可收集電子的比例；前照式像素的金屬連線與多晶矽閘會遮擋並反射光，即使加微透鏡也只有約 60% 到 80%，背照式把晶圓薄化、從背面入光，峰值 QE 可到 95%。6.5 µm 的像素尺寸是取樣解析度與全井容量之間的折衷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every pixel of a scientific CMOS sensor is a pinned photodiode with four or five transistors: a transfer gate moves the collected electrons to a floating-diffusion node, a reset transistor empties the node, a source follower converts charge to voltage, and a row-select transistor puts the signal on the column bus. Quantum efficiency is the fraction of incident photons converted to collectable electrons; in a front-illuminated pixel the metal wiring and polysilicon gates shade and reflect light, so even with microlenses QE stays near 60 to 80 percent, whereas back-illumination thins the wafer and admits light from the rear, pushing peak QE to about 95 percent. The 6.5 µm pixel pitch is a compromise between sampling resolution and full-well capacity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要像素越小，科學相機的靈敏度就越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Smaller pixels always make a scientific camera more sensitive." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。取浮動擴散電容 C_FD = 1.6 fF，CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV/e⁻；全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應約 1.5 V 的節點電壓擺幅。若 100 個光子落在像素上，背照式（QE 0.95）得到 95 e⁻，前照式（QE 0.60）只有 60 e⁻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD. With a floating-diffusion capacitance C_FD = 1.6 fF, CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV per electron, so a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to about 1.5 V of node swing. If 100 photons land on a pixel, a back-illuminated sensor with QE 0.95 yields 95 electrons while a front-illuminated one with QE 0.60 yields only 60. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線；再與廠商的光譜響應曲線比較，重點核對 400 nm 以下與 800 nm 以上兩端，因為背面鈍化與矽厚度的差異在這兩端最明顯。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST; divide the mean electrons per pixel by the photon count at each wavelength to obtain the QE curve, then compare with the vendor spectral response, paying particular attention to the regions below 400 nm and above 800 nm where backside passivation and silicon thickness differ most.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: measurement and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線；再與廠商的光譜響應曲線比較，重點核對 400 nm 以下與 800 nm 以上兩端，因為背面鈍化與矽厚度的差異在這兩端最明顯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST; divide the mean electrons per pixel by the photon count at each wavelength to obtain the QE curve, then compare with the vendor spectral response, paying particular attention to the regions below 400 nm and above 800 nm where backside passivation and silicon thickness differ most. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history; images look normal but quantitative fluorescence ratios shift over time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「滾動快門時序圖」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rolling-shutter timing diagram” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。移動物體會被剪切變形，脈衝照明會在畫面上留下亮暗條帶。全域快門讓所有像素同時開始與結束曝光，但需要在像素內增加一個儲存節點與遮光結構，讀出雜訊通常高於滾動模式（例如 2.3 e⁻ 對 0.9 e⁻），填充因子也較低。許多 sCMOS 提供全域重置或光片讀出模式，用時序而非像素結構解決同時性問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「滾動快門時序圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. Moving objects shear and pulsed illumination leaves bright and dark bands across the frame. A global shutter starts and stops exposure for all pixels at once but needs an in-pixel storage node and light shield, so read noise is usually higher than in rolling mode (for example 2.3 versus 0.9 electrons) and the fill factor is lower. Many sCMOS cameras offer a global-reset or light-sheet readout mode that solves simultaneity with timing rather than pixel structure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rolling-shutter timing diagram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「滾動快門時序圖」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Rolling-shutter timing diagram”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何
knowledge.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry
knowledge.text: sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。移動物體會被剪切變形，脈衝照明會在畫面上留下亮暗條帶。
knowledge.textEn: Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. Moving objects shear and pulsed illumination leaves bright and dark bands across the frame.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry" is correct?
options: 滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。
讀出雜訊是感測器的固定常數，與讀出速度無關。
sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。
optionsEn: A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time.
Read noise is a fixed constant of the sensor, independent of readout speed.

Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line.
quiz.explanation: sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滾動快門時序圖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rolling-shutter timing diagram” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。取 2048 列、t_line = 10 µs，偏斜 = 20.48 ms。若曝光 t_exp = 30 ms，所有列同時開啟的窗口 = t_exp − 偏斜 = 9.52 ms，脈衝照明必須落在這 9.52 ms 內才不會產生條帶；若 t_exp 只有 5 ms，則不存在同時窗口，必須改用全域快門或全域重置。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line. For 2048 rows and t_line = 10 µs the skew is 20.48 ms. With an exposure t_exp = 30 ms the window in which every row is open at once is t_exp − skew = 9.52 ms, so a light pulse must fall inside those 9.52 ms to avoid banding; with t_exp = 5 ms no common window exists and a global shutter or global-reset mode is required. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。取 2048 列、t_line = 10 µs，偏斜 = 20.48 ms。若曝光 t_exp = 30 ms，所有列同時開啟的窗口 = t_exp − 偏斜 = 9.52 ms，脈衝照明必須落在這 9.52 ms 內才不會產生條帶；若 t_exp 只有 5 ms，則不存在同時窗口，必須改用全域快門或全域重置。
knowledge.textEn: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line. For 2048 rows and t_line = 10 µs the skew is 20.48 ms. With an exposure t_exp = 30 ms the window in which every row is open at once is t_exp − skew = 9.52 ms, so a light pulse must fall inside those 9.52 ms to avoid banding; with t_exp = 5 ms no common window exists and a global shutter or global-reset mode is required.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry", which statement holds?
options: 畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。
感測器的增益可以直接從位元深度算出，不需要量測。
放大率越高，影像解析度一定越好。
optionsEn: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line.
A sensor's gain can be derived from its bit depth without measurement.
Higher magnification always gives better image resolution.
quiz.explanation: 畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「滾動快門時序圖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Rolling-shutter timing diagram” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape; downstream particle tracking or deformation measurement then carries a systematic bias that no dark or flat correction can remove.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜。
相機資料表上的規格就是驗收標準，不需要自己量測。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated.
Datasheet specifications are the acceptance criteria and need no in-house measurement.
quiz.explanation: 用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滾動快門時序圖」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Rolling-shutter timing diagram” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape; downstream particle tracking or deformation measurement then carries a systematic bias that no dark or flat correction can remove. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：許多 sCMOS 提供全域重置或光片讀出模式，用時序而非像素結構解決同時性問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Many sCMOS cameras offer a global-reset or light-sheet readout mode that solves simultaneity with timing rather than pixel structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。
knowledge.textEn: Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape; downstream particle tracking or deformation measurement then carries a systematic bias that no dark or flat correction can remove.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
讀出雜訊是感測器的固定常數，與讀出速度無關。
若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Read noise is a fixed constant of the sensor, independent of readout speed.
Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape.
quiz.explanation: 若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape; downstream particle tracking or deformation measurement then carries a systematic bias that no dark or flat correction can remove. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「讀出鏈：相關雙取樣與雙增益 ADC」與「背照式製程、矽厚度與冷卻封裝」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Readout chain: correlated double sampling and dual-gain ADCs" and "Back-illuminated process, silicon thickness and cooled packaging": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 讀出鏈：相關雙取樣與雙增益 ADC：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Readout chain: correlated double sampling and dual-gain ADCs: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「源極隨耦器與行級 ADC」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Source follower and column ADC” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每一行都有自己的放大器與類比數位轉換器，數千個 ADC 平行工作，才能在低於 2 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊下達到每秒數十張全幅影像。重置浮動擴散節點時，開關的熱雜訊會在電容上留下隨機的 kTC 電荷，相關雙取樣先取樣重置電位、再取樣轉移後電位並相減，把這項雜訊消掉。剩下的讀出雜訊主要來自源極隨耦器的 1/f 與隨機電報雜訊，因此讀得越慢、取樣頻寬越窄，雜訊越低：同一顆相機在超靜音模式可達 0.7 e⁻，在快速模式約 1.6 e⁻。雙增益 ADC 同時以高增益與低增益數位化，再合成 16 位元輸出，兼顧低光靈敏度與全井動態範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「源極隨耦器與行級 ADC」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each column has its own amplifier and analog-to-digital converter, and thousands of ADCs work in parallel, which is how full frames can be read at tens of frames per second with read noise below 2 electrons. Resetting the floating-diffusion node leaves a random kTC charge from switch thermal noise on the capacitance; correlated double sampling samples the reset level, then the post-transfer level, and subtracts them, cancelling that term. The remaining read noise comes mainly from 1/f and random-telegraph noise in the source follower, so slower readout with narrower sampling bandwidth gives lower noise: the same camera reaches 0.7 electrons in ultra-quiet mode and about 1.6 electrons in fast mode. Dual-gain ADCs digitize each pixel at high and low gain simultaneously and merge the results into a 16-bit output, preserving both low-light sensitivity and full-well dynamic range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Source follower and column ADC”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：重置雜訊 σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Reset noise is σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「讀出雜訊是感測器的固定常數，與讀出速度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Read noise is a fixed constant of the sensor, independent of readout speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「源極隨耦器與行級 ADC」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Source follower and column ADC”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 讀出鏈：相關雙取樣與雙增益 ADC
knowledge.titleEn: Readout chain: correlated double sampling and dual-gain ADCs
knowledge.text: 每一行都有自己的放大器與類比數位轉換器，數千個 ADC 平行工作，才能在低於 2 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊下達到每秒數十張全幅影像。重置浮動擴散節點時，開關的熱雜訊會在電容上留下隨機的 kTC 電荷，相關雙取樣先取樣重置電位、再取樣轉移後電位並相減，把這項雜訊消掉。
knowledge.textEn: Each column has its own amplifier and analog-to-digital converter, and thousands of ADCs work in parallel, which is how full frames can be read at tens of frames per second with read noise below 2 electrons. Resetting the floating-diffusion node leaves a random kTC charge from switch thermal noise on the capacitance; correlated double sampling samples the reset level, then the post-transfer level, and subtracts them, cancelling that term.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：讀出雜訊是感測器的固定常數，與讀出速度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Read noise is a fixed constant of the sensor, independent of readout speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「讀出鏈：相關雙取樣與雙增益 ADC」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Readout chain: correlated double sampling and dual-gain ADCs" is correct?
options: 每一行都有自己的放大器與類比數位轉換器，數千個 ADC 平行工作，才能在低於 2 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊下達到每秒數十張全幅影像。
讀出雜訊是感測器的固定常數，與讀出速度無關。
矽層越厚，任何波長的量子效率都越高，沒有代價。
optionsEn: Each column has its own amplifier and analog-to-digital converter, and thousands of ADCs work in parallel, which is how full frames can be read at tens of frames per second with read noise below 2 electrons.
Read noise is a fixed constant of the sensor, independent of readout speed.
Thicker silicon raises quantum efficiency at every wavelength with no penalty.
quiz.explanation: 每一行都有自己的放大器與類比數位轉換器，數千個 ADC 平行工作，才能在低於 2 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊下達到每秒數十張全幅影像。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each column has its own amplifier and analog-to-digital converter, and thousands of ADCs work in parallel, which is how full frames can be read at tens of frames per second with read noise below 2 electrons. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 讀出鏈：相關雙取樣與雙增益 ADC：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Readout chain: correlated double sampling and dual-gain ADCs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「源極隨耦器與行級 ADC」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Source follower and column ADC” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：重置雜訊 σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q。取 T = 300 K、C_FD = 1.6 fF：kTC = 1.38×10⁻²³×300×1.6×10⁻¹⁵ = 6.62×10⁻³⁶ C²，開根號得 2.57×10⁻¹⁸ C，除以 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C 約為 16 e⁻ rms。沒有相關雙取樣時這 16 e⁻ 會主宰讀出雜訊；有 CDS 後殘餘雜訊降到約 1 e⁻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Reset noise is σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q. With T = 300 K and C_FD = 1.6 fF, kTC = 1.38×10⁻²³×300×1.6×10⁻¹⁵ = 6.62×10⁻³⁶ C², whose square root is 2.57×10⁻¹⁸ C, or about 16 electrons rms after dividing by 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C. Without correlated double sampling those 16 electrons would dominate the read noise; with CDS the residual falls to about 1 electron. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在完全遮光、最短曝光下連續拍 100 張，逐像素計算時間標準差並除以增益得到每像素的讀出雜訊分布；報告中位數與均方根兩個值，並分別在快速、標準與超靜音模式重複，確認雜訊隨讀出速度的趨勢與資料表一致，同時檢查直方圖尾端是否有隨機電報雜訊造成的高雜訊像素。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Capture 100 frames in complete darkness at the shortest exposure, compute the temporal standard deviation of each pixel and divide by the gain to obtain the per-pixel read-noise distribution; report both the median and the rms, repeat in fast, standard and ultra-quiet modes to confirm that noise falls with readout speed as the datasheet states, and inspect the histogram tail for high-noise pixels caused by random-telegraph noise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 重置雜訊 σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q。取 T = 300 K、C_FD = 1.6 fF：kTC = 1.38×10⁻²³×300×1.6×10⁻¹⁵ = 6.62×10⁻³⁶ C²，開根號得 2.57×10⁻¹⁸ C，除以 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C 約為 16 e⁻ rms。沒有相關雙取樣時這 16 e⁻ 會主宰讀出雜訊；有 CDS 後殘餘雜訊降到約 1 e⁻。
knowledge.textEn: Reset noise is σ_kTC = √(kTC)/q. With T = 300 K and C_FD = 1.6 fF, kTC = 1.38×10⁻²³×300×1.6×10⁻¹⁵ = 6.62×10⁻³⁶ C², whose square root is 2.57×10⁻¹⁸ C, or about 16 electrons rms after dividing by 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C. Without correlated double sampling those 16 electrons would dominate the read noise; with CDS the residual falls to about 1 electron.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 讀出鏈：相關雙取樣與雙增益 ADC：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Readout chain: correlated double sampling and dual-gain ADCs: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「源極隨耦器與行級 ADC」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Source follower and column ADC” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在完全遮光、最短曝光下連續拍 100 張，逐像素計算時間標準差並除以增益得到每像素的讀出雜訊分布；報告中位數與均方根兩個值，並分別在快速、標準與超靜音模式重複，確認雜訊隨讀出速度的趨勢與資料表一致，同時檢查直方圖尾端是否有隨機電報雜訊造成的高雜訊像素。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Capture 100 frames in complete darkness at the shortest exposure, compute the temporal standard deviation of each pixel and divide by the gain to obtain the per-pixel read-noise distribution; report both the median and the rms, repeat in fast, standard and ultra-quiet modes to confirm that noise falls with readout speed as the datasheet states, and inspect the histogram tail for high-noise pixels caused by random-telegraph noise. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雙增益合成點若校正不準，影像在合成訊號附近會出現一條明顯的非線性台階，光度量測在該強度區間出現 1% 到 2% 的系統誤差，且不同像素的台階位置不同。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the dual-gain merge point is miscalibrated, the response shows a visible nonlinear step near the merge signal, photometry in that intensity range carries a 1 to 2 percent systematic error, and the step position differs from pixel to pixel.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: 雙增益合成點若校正不準，影像在合成訊號附近會出現一條明顯的非線性台階，光度量測在該強度區間出現 1% 到 2% 的系統誤差，且不同像素的台階位置不同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 背照式製程、矽厚度與冷卻封裝：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Back-illuminated process, silicon thickness and cooled packaging: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「薄化晶圓與抗反射膜」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thinned wafer and anti-reflection coating” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 背照式感測器把完成電路的晶圓黏到載板上，從背面研磨與蝕刻到約 10 µm 的磊晶層，再以離子佈植與雷射退火做背面鈍化，形成把光生電子推向光電二極體的內建電場，最後鍍上針對可見光或近紅外最佳化的抗反射膜。矽的吸收長度隨波長快速增加，紅光與近紅外光子可能穿透整個薄矽層而不被吸收，因此矽越薄近紅外 QE 越低，但矽越厚電子橫向擴散造成的像素間串擾越大。感測器裝在充乾燥氣體或抽真空的封裝內，以熱電致冷器冷卻到 −8 °C 到 −45 °C，降低暗電流並避免結露。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「薄化晶圓與抗反射膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A back-illuminated sensor is bonded face-down to a carrier wafer, ground and etched from the rear to an epitaxial layer about 10 µm thick, then passivated by ion implantation and laser annealing to create a built-in field that drives photoelectrons toward the photodiodes, and finally coated with an anti-reflection stack optimized for the visible or near infrared. The absorption length of silicon rises steeply with wavelength, so red and near-infrared photons can cross the thin silicon without being absorbed; thinner silicon lowers near-infrared QE, while thicker silicon increases pixel-to-pixel crosstalk from lateral electron diffusion. The sensor sits in a dry-gas or vacuum package cooled by a thermoelectric cooler to between −8 °C and −45 °C, which lowers dark current and prevents condensation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thinned wafer and anti-reflection coating”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：厚度 d 的矽層吸收比例為 1 − exp(−α·d)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A silicon layer of thickness d absorbs the fraction 1 − exp(−α·d).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矽層越厚，任何波長的量子效率都越高，沒有代價。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker silicon raises quantum efficiency at every wavelength with no penalty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「薄化晶圓與抗反射膜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Thinned wafer and anti-reflection coating”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The absorption length of silicon rises steeply with wavelength, so red and near-infrared photons can cross the thin silicon without being absorbed; thinner silicon lowers near-infrared QE, while thicker silicon increases pixel-to-pixel crosstalk from lateral electron diffusion.

steps.title: 背照式製程、矽厚度與冷卻封裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Back-illuminated process, silicon thickness and cooled packaging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄化晶圓與抗反射膜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thinned wafer and anti-reflection coating” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：厚度 d 的矽層吸收比例為 1 − exp(−α·d)。取 d = 10 µm：700 nm 時 α ≈ 1.9×10³ cm⁻¹，α·d = 1.9，exp(−1.9) = 0.15，吸收比例 0.85；900 nm 時 α ≈ 306 cm⁻¹，α·d ≈ 0.31，exp(−0.31) = 0.73，吸收比例只有 0.27。這解釋了為何同一顆背照式感測器 700 nm 的 QE 可達 80% 以上，而 900 nm 掉到 30% 以下。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A silicon layer of thickness d absorbs the fraction 1 − exp(−α·d). With d = 10 µm: at 700 nm α ≈ 1.9×10³ cm⁻¹, α·d = 1.9, exp(−1.9) = 0.15 and 0.85 of the light is absorbed; at 900 nm α ≈ 306 cm⁻¹, α·d ≈ 0.31, exp(−0.31) = 0.73 and only 0.27 is absorbed. This is why the same back-illuminated sensor can exceed 80 percent QE at 700 nm yet fall below 30 percent at 900 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 850 nm 與 900 nm 的窄頻光源量 QE，與可見光 QE 比較，檢查近紅外衰減是否符合由矽厚度推算的吸收比例；再用針孔投影的點光源量測相鄰像素的訊號分攤比例（串擾），確認厚度的選擇在 QE 與串擾之間取得的平衡符合規格。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure QE with narrow-band sources at 850 nm and 900 nm and compare with the visible QE to check that the near-infrared roll-off matches the absorbed fraction predicted from the silicon thickness; then project a pinhole point source and measure how much signal spills into neighbouring pixels (crosstalk) to confirm that the chosen thickness balances QE and crosstalk as specified.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 厚度 d 的矽層吸收比例為 1 − exp(−α·d)。取 d = 10 µm：700 nm 時 α ≈ 1.9×10³ cm⁻¹，α·d = 1.9，exp(−1.9) = 0.15，吸收比例 0.85；900 nm 時 α ≈ 306 cm⁻¹，α·d ≈ 0.31，exp(−0.31) = 0.73，吸收比例只有 0.27。這解釋了為何同一顆背照式感測器 700 nm 的 QE 可達 80% 以上，而 900 nm 掉到 30% 以下。
knowledge.textEn: A silicon layer of thickness d absorbs the fraction 1 − exp(−α·d). With d = 10 µm: at 700 nm α ≈ 1.9×10³ cm⁻¹, α·d = 1.9, exp(−1.9) = 0.15 and 0.85 of the light is absorbed; at 900 nm α ≈ 306 cm⁻¹, α·d ≈ 0.31, exp(−0.31) = 0.73 and only 0.27 is absorbed. This is why the same back-illuminated sensor can exceed 80 percent QE at 700 nm yet fall below 30 percent at 900 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「背照式製程、矽厚度與冷卻封裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Back-illuminated process, silicon thickness and cooled packaging", which statement holds?
options: 放大率越高，影像解析度一定越好。
只要像素越小，科學相機的靈敏度就越高。
厚度 d 的矽層吸收比例為 1 − exp(−α·d)。
optionsEn: Higher magnification always gives better image resolution.
Smaller pixels always make a scientific camera more sensitive.
A silicon layer of thickness d absorbs the fraction 1 − exp(−α·d).
quiz.explanation: 厚度 d 的矽層吸收比例為 1 − exp(−α·d)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A silicon layer of thickness d absorbs the fraction 1 − exp(−α·d). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 背照式製程、矽厚度與冷卻封裝：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Back-illuminated process, silicon thickness and cooled packaging: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「薄化晶圓與抗反射膜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Thinned wafer and anti-reflection coating” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 850 nm 與 900 nm 的窄頻光源量 QE，與可見光 QE 比較，檢查近紅外衰減是否符合由矽厚度推算的吸收比例；再用針孔投影的點光源量測相鄰像素的訊號分攤比例（串擾），確認厚度的選擇在 QE 與串擾之間取得的平衡符合規格。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure QE with narrow-band sources at 850 nm and 900 nm and compare with the visible QE to check that the near-infrared roll-off matches the absorbed fraction predicted from the silicon thickness; then project a pinhole point source and measure how much signal spills into neighbouring pixels (crosstalk) to confirm that the chosen thickness balances QE and crosstalk as specified. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：封裝漏氣或乾燥劑失效後，冷卻到 −20 °C 的感測器窗口內側會結霜，影像出現局部模糊與緩慢變化的暗斑，常被誤判為光學系統髒污；長期還會腐蝕打線。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: After a package leak or desiccant failure, frost forms on the inner window of a sensor cooled to −20 °C, producing local blur and slowly changing dark patches that are often blamed on dirty optics; over time the moisture also corrodes the bond wires.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 850 nm 與 900 nm 的窄頻光源量 QE，與可見光 QE 比較，檢查近紅外衰減是否符合由矽厚度推算的吸收比例；再用針孔投影的點光源量測相鄰像素的訊號分攤比例（串擾），確認厚度的選擇在 QE 與串擾之間取得的平衡符合規格。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄化晶圓與抗反射膜」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。

steps.instruction: 封裝漏氣或乾燥劑失效後，冷卻到 −20 °C 的感測器窗口內側會結霜，影像出現局部模糊與緩慢變化的暗斑，常被誤判為光學系統髒污；長期還會腐蝕打線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: After a package leak or desiccant failure, frost forms on the inner window of a sensor cooled to −20 °C, producing local blur and slowly changing dark patches that are often blamed on dirty optics; over time the moisture also corrodes the bond wires. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「矽層越厚，任何波長的量子效率都越高，沒有代價。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量」與「固定圖樣雜訊：DSNU、PRNU 與影像校正」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity" and "Fixed-pattern noise: DSNU, PRNU and image correction": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光子轉移曲線」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Photon-transfer curve” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光子轉移法利用散粒雜訊的統計性質校正整條讀出鏈：電子數的變異數等於其平均值，所以在以數位單位（DN）量到的平均值與變異數之間，斜率就是增益 K（DN/e⁻）。做法是在均勻照明下對每個曝光時間拍兩張，取差影像的變異數除以 2 消除固定圖樣雜訊，對平均值作圖；零光點的截距給讀出雜訊，曲線在全井附近轉折並下降。這正是 EMVA 1288 標準規定的量測核心，所得的增益把後續所有雜訊都換算到電子單位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子轉移曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The photon-transfer method calibrates the whole readout chain from the statistics of shot noise: the variance of the electron count equals its mean, so the slope of variance against mean, both measured in digital numbers, is the gain K in DN per electron. Under uniform illumination two frames are taken at each exposure time, the variance of their difference is halved to remove fixed-pattern noise, and it is plotted against the mean; the intercept at zero light gives the read noise and the curve bends over and falls near full well. This is the core measurement prescribed by the EMVA 1288 standard, and the resulting gain converts every later noise figure into electrons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon-transfer curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器的增益可以直接從位元深度算出，不需要量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sensor's gain can be derived from its bit depth without measurement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光子轉移曲線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Photon-transfer curve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量
knowledge.titleEn: Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity
knowledge.text: 光子轉移法利用散粒雜訊的統計性質校正整條讀出鏈：電子數的變異數等於其平均值，所以在以數位單位（DN）量到的平均值與變異數之間，斜率就是增益 K（DN/e⁻）。做法是在均勻照明下對每個曝光時間拍兩張，取差影像的變異數除以 2 消除固定圖樣雜訊，對平均值作圖；零光點的截距給讀出雜訊，曲線在全井附近轉折並下降。
knowledge.textEn: The photon-transfer method calibrates the whole readout chain from the statistics of shot noise: the variance of the electron count equals its mean, so the slope of variance against mean, both measured in digital numbers, is the gain K in DN per electron. Under uniform illumination two frames are taken at each exposure time, the variance of their difference is halved to remove fixed-pattern noise, and it is plotted against the mean; the intercept at zero light gives the read noise and the curve bends over and falls near full well.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器的增益可以直接從位元深度算出，不需要量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sensor's gain can be derived from its bit depth without measurement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity" is correct?
options: 感測器的增益可以直接從位元深度算出，不需要量測。
固定圖樣雜訊只要多拍幾張平均就會消失。
光子轉移法利用散粒雜訊的統計性質校正整條讀出鏈：電子數的變異數等於其平均值，所以在以數位單位（DN）量到的平均值與變異數之間，斜率就是增益 K（DN/e⁻）。
optionsEn: A sensor's gain can be derived from its bit depth without measurement.
Fixed-pattern noise disappears if enough frames are averaged.

The photon-transfer method calibrates the whole readout chain from the statistics of shot noise: the variance of the electron count equals its mean, so the slope of variance against mean, both measured in digital numbers, is the gain K in DN per electron.
quiz.explanation: 光子轉移法利用散粒雜訊的統計性質校正整條讀出鏈：電子數的變異數等於其平均值，所以在以數位單位（DN）量到的平均值與變異數之間，斜率就是增益 K（DN/e⁻）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The photon-transfer method calibrates the whole readout chain from the statistics of shot noise: the variance of the electron count equals its mean, so the slope of variance against mean, both measured in digital numbers, is the gain K in DN per electron. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光子轉移曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photon-transfer curve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN。若平均值從 500 DN 增到 2500 DN 時變異數從 230 DN² 增到 1150 DN²，K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN/e⁻，即每 DN 約 2.17 e⁻；暗幀變異數 0.30 DN² 的截距給 σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 e⁻。全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應 6,900 DN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN. If the variance rises from 230 DN² to 1150 DN² while the mean rises from 500 DN to 2500 DN, then K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN per electron, about 2.17 electrons per DN; the dark-frame variance intercept of 0.30 DN² gives σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 electrons, and a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to 6,900 DN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用積分球或擴散板提供均勻度優於 1% 的照明，曝光時間以等比級數從暗到飽和取 20 個以上的點，每點兩張；在線性區以最小平方法擬合斜率與截距，把得到的讀出雜訊與前一單元的暗幀時間雜訊比較，並確認飽和轉折點換算的全井與資料表的 15,000 e⁻ 差異在 10% 以內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Provide illumination uniform to better than 1 percent with an integrating sphere or diffuser, step the exposure geometrically from dark to saturation in at least 20 points with two frames each, fit slope and intercept by least squares in the linear region, compare the derived read noise with the dark-frame temporal noise from the previous unit, and check that the full well implied by the saturation knee agrees with the datasheet value of 15,000 electrons to within 10 percent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN。若平均值從 500 DN 增到 2500 DN 時變異數從 230 DN² 增到 1150 DN²，K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN/e⁻，即每 DN 約 2.17 e⁻；暗幀變異數 0.30 DN² 的截距給 σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 e⁻。全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應 6,900 DN。
knowledge.textEn: σ²_DN = K·μ_DN + σ²_read,DN. If the variance rises from 230 DN² to 1150 DN² while the mean rises from 500 DN to 2500 DN, then K = 920/2000 = 0.46 DN per electron, about 2.17 electrons per DN; the dark-frame variance intercept of 0.30 DN² gives σ_read = 0.55 DN = 0.55/0.46 ≈ 1.2 electrons, and a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to 6,900 DN.

steps.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光子轉移曲線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photon-transfer curve” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用積分球或擴散板提供均勻度優於 1% 的照明，曝光時間以等比級數從暗到飽和取 20 個以上的點，每點兩張；在線性區以最小平方法擬合斜率與截距，把得到的讀出雜訊與前一單元的暗幀時間雜訊比較，並確認飽和轉折點換算的全井與資料表的 15,000 e⁻ 差異在 10% 以內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Provide illumination uniform to better than 1 percent with an integrating sphere or diffuser, step the exposure geometrically from dark to saturation in at least 20 points with two frames each, fit slope and intercept by least squares in the linear region, compare the derived read noise with the dark-frame temporal noise from the previous unit, and check that the full well implied by the saturation knee agrees with the datasheet value of 15,000 electrons to within 10 percent. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：照明不均或光源閃爍會使差影像的變異數偏大，擬合出的增益偏高、讀出雜訊偏低，後續以電子為單位的 SNR 模型全部樂觀；症狀是重複量測的增益值離散超過 5%。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Non-uniform or flickering illumination inflates the variance of the difference image, so the fitted gain is too high and the read noise too low, and every later SNR model in electrons becomes optimistic; the symptom is a gain value that scatters by more than 5 percent between repeated runs.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 光子轉移法：增益、讀出雜訊與全井容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photon-transfer method: gain, read noise and full-well capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光子轉移曲線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Photon-transfer curve” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 照明不均或光源閃爍會使差影像的變異數偏大，擬合出的增益偏高、讀出雜訊偏低，後續以電子為單位的 SNR 模型全部樂觀；症狀是重複量測的增益值離散超過 5%。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Non-uniform or flickering illumination inflates the variance of the difference image, so the fitted gain is too high and the read noise too low, and every later SNR model in electrons becomes optimistic; the symptom is a gain value that scatters by more than 5 percent between repeated runs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器的增益可以直接從位元深度算出，不需要量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sensor's gain can be derived from its bit depth without measurement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
