steps.title: 低溫系統：超流氦、熱負載與製冷功率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cryogenics: superfluid helium, heat loads and refrigeration power: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1.9 K superfluid-helium heat-exchanger tube” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: LHC 把 NbTi 磁鐵冷到 1.9 K 而不是 4.2 K，因為臨界電流密度隨溫度下降而上升，讓同樣的導體在 8.33 T 仍有餘裕。低於 2.17 K 的氦成為超流氦 He II，有效熱導極高、黏度極低，能滲進線圈絕緣帶走熱量；每顆磁鐵的冷質量浸在 1.9 K、1.3 bar 的靜態 He II 中，熱量再經由穿過磁鐵的貝氏熱交換管傳給 16 mbar 的兩相飽和 He II。八座 4.5 K 製冷站各約 18 kW，加上 1.8 K 冷壓縮機單元，維持約 36,000 噸冷質量與 120 噸氦；束流造成的同步輻射、影像電流與電子雲熱負載則由 5 K 到 20 K 的束流屏截住，不進入 1.9 K。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The LHC cools its NbTi magnets to 1.9 K rather than 4.2 K because critical current density rises as temperature falls, giving the same conductor margin at 8.33 T. Below 2.17 K helium becomes superfluid He II, with enormous effective thermal conductivity and negligible viscosity, so it penetrates the coil insulation and carries heat away; each magnet's cold mass sits in static He II at 1.9 K and 1.3 bar, and heat passes to two-phase saturated He II at 16 mbar in a bayonet heat-exchanger tube running through the magnets. Eight 4.5 K refrigerators of about 18 kW each, plus 1.8 K cold-compressor units, hold roughly 36,000 tonnes of cold mass and 120 tonnes of helium; beam-induced loads from synchrotron radiation, image currents and electron cloud are intercepted by beam screens at 5 to 20 K so they never reach 1.9 K. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1.9 K superfluid-helium heat-exchanger tube”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：卡諾比功 W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157；實際製冷機效率約卡諾的 20%，所以每瓦 1.9 K 熱負載約需 800 W 電力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Carnot work ratio W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157; real refrigerators reach about 20 percent of Carnot, so each watt at 1.9 K costs about 800 W of electricity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「冷到 4.2 K 已經是超導，再冷到 1.9 K 只是浪費電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Superconducting at 4.2 K already, going to 1.9 K merely wastes electricity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “1.9 K superfluid-helium heat-exchanger tube”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1.9 K superfluid-helium heat-exchanger tube” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：卡諾比功 W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157；實際製冷機效率約卡諾的 20%，所以每瓦 1.9 K 熱負載約需 800 W 電力。若一個 3.3 km 扇區的 1.9 K 熱負載為 2.4 kW，電力約 1.9 MW，八個扇區約 15 MW，加上 4.5 K 與束流屏負載，總耗電量級為公開的 40 MW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Carnot work ratio W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157; real refrigerators reach about 20 percent of Carnot, so each watt at 1.9 K costs about 800 W of electricity. If one 3.3 km sector carries 2.4 kW at 1.9 K, that is about 1.9 MW, about 15 MW for eight sectors, and with the 4.5 K and beam-screen loads the total is of the order of the public 40 MW figure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以熱平衡法量熱負載：關閉製冷供給一段時間，由 He II 槽的溫升速率乘以熱容得到靜態熱負載，與設計值（每公尺約零點幾瓦）比較；再用安裝在磁鐵上的 Cernox 溫度計與 16 mbar 管線的壓力計，確認整個扇區的溫度梯度小於 0.1 K。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure heat load by the thermal-balance method: interrupt refrigeration briefly and convert the warm-up rate of the He II bath, multiplied by its heat capacity, into the static load, comparing with the design value of a few tenths of a watt per metre; then use the Cernox thermometers on the magnets and the pressure gauges on the 16 mbar line to confirm that the temperature gradient along a sector stays below 0.1 K.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 卡諾比功 W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157；實際製冷機效率約卡諾的 20%，所以每瓦 1.9 K 熱負載約需 800 W 電力。若一個 3.3 km 扇區的 1.9 K 熱負載為 2.4 kW，電力約 1.9 MW，八個扇區約 15 MW，加上 4.5 K 與束流屏負載，總耗電量級為公開的 40 MW。
knowledge.textEn: The Carnot work ratio W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157; real refrigerators reach about 20 percent of Carnot, so each watt at 1.9 K costs about 800 W of electricity. If one 3.3 km sector carries 2.4 kW at 1.9 K, that is about 1.9 MW, about 15 MW for eight sectors, and with the 4.5 K and beam-screen loads the total is of the order of the public 40 MW figure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「低溫系統：超流氦、熱負載與製冷功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cryogenics: superfluid helium, heat loads and refrigeration power", which statement holds?
options: 16 MV 的 RF 電壓是用來把質子從 450 GeV 加速到 7 TeV 的主要動力。
只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。
卡諾比功 W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157；實際製冷機效率約卡諾的 20%，所以每瓦 1.9 K 熱負載約需 800 W 電力。
optionsEn: The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV.
With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV.
The Carnot work ratio W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157; real refrigerators reach about 20 percent of Carnot, so each watt at 1.9 K costs about 800 W of electricity.

quiz.explanationEn: The Carnot work ratio W/Q = (300 − 1.9)/1.9 ≈ 157; real refrigerators reach about 20 percent of Carnot, so each watt at 1.9 K costs about 800 W of electricity. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 低溫系統：超流氦、熱負載與製冷功率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cryogenics: superfluid helium, heat loads and refrigeration power: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “1.9 K superfluid-helium heat-exchanger tube” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以熱平衡法量熱負載：關閉製冷供給一段時間，由 He II 槽的溫升速率乘以熱容得到靜態熱負載，與設計值（每公尺約零點幾瓦）比較；再用安裝在磁鐵上的 Cernox 溫度計與 16 mbar 管線的壓力計，確認整個扇區的溫度梯度小於 0.1 K。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure heat load by the thermal-balance method: interrupt refrigeration briefly and convert the warm-up rate of the He II bath, multiplied by its heat capacity, into the static load, comparing with the design value of a few tenths of a watt per metre; then use the Cernox thermometers on the magnets and the pressure gauges on the 16 mbar line to confirm that the temperature gradient along a sector stays below 0.1 K. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：絕熱真空因洩漏劣化後，輻射與氣體導熱使熱負載倍增，製冷站無法維持 1.9 K，磁鐵溫度升到 2.2 K 以上失去超流，臨界電流下降，磁鐵在未達額定電流前就淬火。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the insulation vacuum degrades through a leak, radiation and gas conduction multiply the heat load, the plant can no longer hold 1.9 K, the magnets warm above 2.2 K and lose superfluidity, the critical current drops and the magnets quench before reaching nominal current.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以熱平衡法量熱負載：關閉製冷供給一段時間，由 He II 槽的溫升速率乘以熱容得到靜態熱負載，與設計值（每公尺約零點幾瓦）比較；再用安裝在磁鐵上的 Cernox 溫度計與 16 mbar 管線的壓力計，確認整個扇區的溫度梯度小於 0.1 K。
knowledge.textEn: Measure heat load by the thermal-balance method: interrupt refrigeration briefly and convert the warm-up rate of the He II bath, multiplied by its heat capacity, into the static load, comparing with the design value of a few tenths of a watt per metre; then use the Cernox thermometers on the magnets and the pressure gauges on the 16 mbar line to confirm that the temperature gradient along a sector stays below 0.1 K.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低溫系統：超流氦、熱負載與製冷功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cryogenics: superfluid helium, heat loads and refrigeration power"?
options: 以熱平衡法量熱負載：關閉製冷供給一段時間，由 He II 槽的溫升速率乘以熱容得到靜態熱負載，與設計值（每公尺約零點幾瓦）比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
亮度只跟束流能量有關，能量越高亮度越高。
optionsEn: Measure heat load by the thermal-balance method: interrupt refrigeration briefly and convert the warm-up rate of the He II bath, multiplied by its heat capacity, into the static load, comparing with the design value of a few tenths of a watt per metre.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Luminosity depends only on beam energy, so higher energy means higher luminosity.
quiz.explanation: 以熱平衡法量熱負載：關閉製冷供給一段時間，由 He II 槽的溫升速率乘以熱容得到靜態熱負載，與設計值（每公尺約零點幾瓦）比較；再用安裝在磁鐵上的 Cernox 溫度計與 16 mbar 管線的壓力計，確認整個扇區的溫度梯度小於 0.1 K。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure heat load by the thermal-balance method: interrupt refrigeration briefly and convert the warm-up rate of the He II bath, multiplied by its heat capacity, into the static load, comparing with the design value of a few tenths of a watt per metre; then use the Cernox thermometers on the magnets and the pressure gauges on the 16 mbar line to confirm that the temperature gradient along a sector stays below 0.1 K. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 低溫系統：超流氦、熱負載與製冷功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cryogenics: superfluid helium, heat loads and refrigeration power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “1.9 K superfluid-helium heat-exchanger tube” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 絕熱真空因洩漏劣化後，輻射與氣體導熱使熱負載倍增，製冷站無法維持 1.9 K，磁鐵溫度升到 2.2 K 以上失去超流，臨界電流下降，磁鐵在未達額定電流前就淬火。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the insulation vacuum degrades through a leak, radiation and gas conduction multiply the heat load, the plant can no longer hold 1.9 K, the magnets warm above 2.2 K and lose superfluidity, the critical current drops and the magnets quench before reaching nominal current. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：八座 4.5 K 製冷站各約 18 kW，加上 1.8 K 冷壓縮機單元，維持約 36,000 噸冷質量與 120 噸氦；束流造成的同步輻射、影像電流與電子雲熱負載則由 5 K 到 20 K 的束流屏截住，不進入 1.9 K。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Eight 4.5 K refrigerators of about 18 kW each, plus 1.8 K cold-compressor units, hold roughly 36,000 tonnes of cold mass and 120 tonnes of helium; beam-induced loads from synchrotron radiation, image currents and electron cloud are intercepted by beam screens at 5 to 20 K so they never reach 1.9 K.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「冷到 4.2 K 已經是超導，再冷到 1.9 K 只是浪費電。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Superconducting at 4.2 K already, going to 1.9 K merely wastes electricity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 絕熱真空因洩漏劣化後，輻射與氣體導熱使熱負載倍增，製冷站無法維持 1.9 K，磁鐵溫度升到 2.2 K 以上失去超流，臨界電流下降，磁鐵在未達額定電流前就淬火。
knowledge.textEn: When the insulation vacuum degrades through a leak, radiation and gas conduction multiply the heat load, the plant can no longer hold 1.9 K, the magnets warm above 2.2 K and lose superfluidity, the critical current drops and the magnets quench before reaching nominal current.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「低溫系統：超流氦、熱負載與製冷功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cryogenics: superfluid helium, heat loads and refrigeration power" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
絕熱真空因洩漏劣化後，輻射與氣體導熱使熱負載倍增，製冷站無法維持 1.9 K，磁鐵溫度升到 2.2 K 以上失去超流，臨界電流下降，磁鐵在未達額定電流前就淬火。
超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

When the insulation vacuum degrades through a leak, radiation and gas conduction multiply the heat load, the plant can no longer hold 1.9 K, the magnets warm above 2.2 K and lose superfluidity, the critical current drops and the magnets quench before reaching nominal current.
A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history.
quiz.explanation: 絕熱真空因洩漏劣化後，輻射與氣體導熱使熱負載倍增，製冷站無法維持 1.9 K，磁鐵溫度升到 2.2 K 以上失去超流，臨界電流下降，磁鐵在未達額定電流前就淬火。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When the insulation vacuum degrades through a leak, radiation and gas conduction multiply the heat load, the plant can no longer hold 1.9 K, the magnets warm above 2.2 K and lose superfluidity, the critical current drops and the magnets quench before reaching nominal current. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軌道、光學量測與磁場校正」與「機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration" and "Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軌道、光學量測與磁場校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 環上約一千組束流位置監測器（BPM）在每一圈量兩束的位置，軌道回授用數百顆校正磁鐵把閉軌壓到次毫米；調諧值由 BBQ 系統從束流的微小振盪頻譜讀出，色品度則以調變 RF 頻率、觀察調諧變化量測。光學函數 β 的誤差（β-beating）用 AC 偶極激發束流做逐圈量測再反解。超導磁鐵在注入能量 450 GeV 時持續電流會隨時間衰減、在升流開始時又「回彈」，改變六極場分量 b₃，因此必須以參考磁鐵的量測建立場模型，前饋修正六極校正磁鐵。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: About a thousand beam-position monitors read both beams every turn and an orbit feedback uses hundreds of corrector magnets to hold the closed orbit to sub-millimetre; the tune is read by the BBQ system from the spectrum of tiny beam oscillations, and chromaticity is measured by modulating the RF frequency and watching the tune shift. Errors in the beta function (beta-beating) are measured turn by turn with an AC dipole exciting the beam and then inverted. In superconducting magnets at the 450 GeV injection energy, persistent currents decay with time and snap back when the ramp starts, changing the sextupole component b₃, so a field model built from reference-magnet measurements feeds corrections forward to the sextupole correctors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一顆偶極的彎轉角 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad；1 單位（10⁻⁴）的場誤差產生 0.51 µrad 的踢角。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One dipole bends by 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad, so a 1-unit (10⁻⁴) field error gives a 0.51 µrad kick.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軌道、光學量測與磁場校正
knowledge.titleEn: Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration
knowledge.text: 環上約一千組束流位置監測器（BPM）在每一圈量兩束的位置，軌道回授用數百顆校正磁鐵把閉軌壓到次毫米；調諧值由 BBQ 系統從束流的微小振盪頻譜讀出，色品度則以調變 RF 頻率、觀察調諧變化量測。光學函數 β 的誤差（β-beating）用 AC 偶極激發束流做逐圈量測再反解。
knowledge.textEn: About a thousand beam-position monitors read both beams every turn and an orbit feedback uses hundreds of corrector magnets to hold the closed orbit to sub-millimetre; the tune is read by the BBQ system from the spectrum of tiny beam oscillations, and chromaticity is measured by modulating the RF frequency and watching the tune shift. Errors in the beta function (beta-beating) are measured turn by turn with an AC dipole exciting the beam and then inverted.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軌道、光學量測與磁場校正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration" is correct?
options: 超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。
束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。
環上約一千組束流位置監測器（BPM）在每一圈量兩束的位置，軌道回授用數百顆校正磁鐵把閉軌壓到次毫米。
optionsEn: A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history.
The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm.
About a thousand beam-position monitors read both beams every turn and an orbit feedback uses hundreds of corrector magnets to hold the closed orbit to sub-millimetre.
quiz.explanation: 環上約一千組束流位置監測器（BPM）在每一圈量兩束的位置，軌道回授用數百顆校正磁鐵把閉軌壓到次毫米；調諧值由 BBQ 系統從束流的微小振盪頻譜讀出，色品度則以調變 RF 頻率、觀察調諧變化量測。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: About a thousand beam-position monitors read both beams every turn and an orbit feedback uses hundreds of corrector magnets to hold the closed orbit to sub-millimetre; the tune is read by the BBQ system from the spectrum of tiny beam oscillations, and chromaticity is measured by modulating the RF frequency and watching the tune shift. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軌道、光學量測與磁場校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一顆偶極的彎轉角 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad；1 單位（10⁻⁴）的場誤差產生 0.51 µrad 的踢角。閉軌畸變峰值 ≈ θ√(β_i β_j)/(2 sin πQ)，取 β = 100 m、Q 的分數部分 0.31：0.51×10⁻⁶×100/(2×0.827) ≈ 31 µm。這是單顆磁鐵的量級，1232 顆隨機誤差則以均方根累加成毫米等級，必須校正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One dipole bends by 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad, so a 1-unit (10⁻⁴) field error gives a 0.51 µrad kick. The peak closed-orbit distortion ≈ θ√(β_i β_j)/(2 sin πQ); with β = 100 m and a fractional tune of 0.31, 0.51×10⁻⁶×100/(2×0.827) ≈ 31 µm. That is one magnet; the random errors of 1232 dipoles add in quadrature to the millimetre level and must be corrected. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：注入後比較 BPM 量到的閉軌與模型預測，用奇異值分解把校正磁鐵的響應矩陣反解，施加修正後確認軌道均方根小於 0.5 mm；在注入平台上每 100 s 量一次色品度，確認 b₃ 衰減的前饋修正把色品度維持在設定值 ±2 以內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After injection compare the BPM closed orbit with the model, invert the corrector response matrix by singular-value decomposition, apply the correction and confirm an rms orbit below 0.5 mm; on the injection plateau measure chromaticity every 100 s and confirm that the feed-forward for b₃ decay keeps it within ±2 of the set value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: One dipole bends by 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad, so a 1-unit (10⁻⁴) field error gives a 0.51 µrad kick. The peak closed-orbit distortion ≈ θ√(β_i β_j)/(2 sin πQ); with β = 100 m and a fractional tune of 0.31, 0.51×10⁻⁶×100/(2×0.827) ≈ 31 µm. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 軌道、光學量測與磁場校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 注入後比較 BPM 量到的閉軌與模型預測，用奇異值分解把校正磁鐵的響應矩陣反解，施加修正後確認軌道均方根小於 0.5 mm；在注入平台上每 100 s 量一次色品度，確認 b₃ 衰減的前饋修正把色品度維持在設定值 ±2 以內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After injection compare the BPM closed orbit with the model, invert the corrector response matrix by singular-value decomposition, apply the correction and confirm an rms orbit below 0.5 mm; on the injection plateau measure chromaticity every 100 s and confirm that the feed-forward for b₃ decay keeps it within ±2 of the set value. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若回彈補償的時間模型錯誤，升流開始時色品度在幾秒內跳變數十單位，頭尾不穩定性被激發，束流損失觸發束流傾卸，整個填充作廢並損失數小時。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the timing model of snapback compensation is wrong, chromaticity jumps by tens of units within seconds of the ramp starting, head-tail instabilities develop, beam losses trigger a dump and the whole fill is lost along with several hours.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 注入後比較 BPM 量到的閉軌與模型預測，用奇異值分解把校正磁鐵的響應矩陣反解，施加修正後確認軌道均方根小於 0.5 mm；在注入平台上每 100 s 量一次色品度，確認 b₃ 衰減的前饋修正把色品度維持在設定值 ±2 以內。
knowledge.textEn: After injection compare the BPM closed orbit with the model, invert the corrector response matrix by singular-value decomposition, apply the correction and confirm an rms orbit below 0.5 mm; on the injection plateau measure chromaticity every 100 s and confirm that the feed-forward for b₃ decay keeps it within ±2 of the set value.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軌道、光學量測與磁場校正」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
注入後比較 BPM 量到的閉軌與模型預測，用奇異值分解把校正磁鐵的響應矩陣反解，施加修正後確認軌道均方根小於 0.5 mm。
超導磁鐵一旦冷卻到工作溫度就不會再淬火。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
After injection compare the BPM closed orbit with the model, invert the corrector response matrix by singular-value decomposition, apply the correction and confirm an rms orbit below 0.5 mm.
Once cooled to operating temperature a superconducting magnet can no longer quench.
quiz.explanation: 注入後比較 BPM 量到的閉軌與模型預測，用奇異值分解把校正磁鐵的響應矩陣反解，施加修正後確認軌道均方根小於 0.5 mm；在注入平台上每 100 s 量一次色品度，確認 b₃ 衰減的前饋修正把色品度維持在設定值 ±2 以內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After injection compare the BPM closed orbit with the model, invert the corrector response matrix by singular-value decomposition, apply the correction and confirm an rms orbit below 0.5 mm; on the injection plateau measure chromaticity every 100 s and confirm that the feed-forward for b₃ decay keeps it within ±2 of the set value. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 軌道、光學量測與磁場校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若回彈補償的時間模型錯誤，升流開始時色品度在幾秒內跳變數十單位，頭尾不穩定性被激發，束流損失觸發束流傾卸，整個填充作廢並損失數小時。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the timing model of snapback compensation is wrong, chromaticity jumps by tens of units within seconds of the ramp starting, head-tail instabilities develop, beam losses trigger a dump and the whole fill is lost along with several hours. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：超導磁鐵在注入能量 450 GeV 時持續電流會隨時間衰減、在升流開始時又「回彈」，改變六極場分量 b₃，因此必須以參考磁鐵的量測建立場模型，前饋修正六極校正磁鐵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In superconducting magnets at the 450 GeV injection energy, persistent currents decay with time and snap back when the ramp starts, changing the sextupole component b₃, so a field model built from reference-magnet measurements feeds corrections forward to the sextupole correctors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若回彈補償的時間模型錯誤，升流開始時色品度在幾秒內跳變數十單位，頭尾不穩定性被激發，束流損失觸發束流傾卸，整個填充作廢並損失數小時。
knowledge.textEn: If the timing model of snapback compensation is wrong, chromaticity jumps by tens of units within seconds of the ramp starting, head-tail instabilities develop, beam losses trigger a dump and the whole fill is lost along with several hours.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「軌道、光學量測與磁場校正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。
若回彈補償的時間模型錯誤，升流開始時色品度在幾秒內跳變數十單位，頭尾不穩定性被激發，束流損失觸發束流傾卸，整個填充作廢並損失數小時。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm.

If the timing model of snapback compensation is wrong, chromaticity jumps by tens of units within seconds of the ramp starting, head-tail instabilities develop, beam losses trigger a dump and the whole fill is lost along with several hours.
quiz.explanation: 若回彈補償的時間模型錯誤，升流開始時色品度在幾秒內跳變數十單位，頭尾不穩定性被激發，束流損失觸發束流傾卸，整個填充作廢並損失數小時。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the timing model of snapback compensation is wrong, chromaticity jumps by tens of units within seconds of the ramp starting, head-tail instabilities develop, beam losses trigger a dump and the whole fill is lost along with several hours. steps.title: 機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 設計值下每束儲存 362 MJ，足以熔化約 700 kg 銅，而超導線圈只要吸收每立方公分數十毫焦的瞬間能量就會淬火，因此只有極小比例的束流可以在磁鐵附近損失。多級準直系統在 IR7 做橫向清除、IR3 做動量清除：主準直器以碳纖維複合材料顎板放在約 5 到 6 倍束流尺寸處攔截暈粒子，次級準直器與吸收器再接住散射產物，清除效率須達 99.99% 以上。環上約四千個游離室束流損失監測器以 40 µs 到 1.3 s 的多個時間窗持續積分，任何通道超過閾值就在三圈內觸發束流傾卸：踢磁鐵在 3 µs 的空檔中把束流引出，掃過 7 m 長的石墨傾卸塊分散能量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At design values each beam stores 362 MJ, enough to melt about 700 kg of copper, while a superconducting coil quenches after absorbing only tens of millijoules per cubic centimetre in a fast loss, so only a tiny fraction of the beam may be lost near magnets. A multi-stage collimation system cleans the betatron halo in IR7 and the momentum halo in IR3: primary collimators with carbon-fibre-composite jaws at about 5 to 6 beam sigmas intercept halo particles, secondary collimators and absorbers catch the scattered products, and the cleaning efficiency must exceed 99.99 percent. Some four thousand ionization-chamber beam-loss monitors integrate over several windows from 40 µs to 1.3 s, and any channel above threshold triggers a beam dump within three turns: kicker magnets extract the beam during a 3 µs gap and sweep it over a 7 m graphite dump block to spread the energy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Beam energy = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets" is correct?
options: 設計值下每束儲存 362 MJ，足以熔化約 700 kg 銅，而超導線圈只要吸收每立方公分數十毫焦的瞬間能量就會淬火，因此只有極小比例的束流可以在磁鐵附近損失。

The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm.
The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV.
quiz.explanation: 設計值下每束儲存 362 MJ，足以熔化約 700 kg 銅，而超導線圈只要吸收每立方公分數十毫焦的瞬間能量就會淬火，因此只有極小比例的束流可以在磁鐵附近損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At design values each beam stores 362 MJ, enough to melt about 700 kg of copper, while a superconducting coil quenches after absorbing only tens of millijoules per cubic centimetre in a fast loss, so only a tiny fraction of the beam may be lost near magnets. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：束流能量 = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J。銅從 300 K 升到熔點並熔化約需 505 kJ/kg，362 MJ 可熔化約 717 kg。若快速損失 10⁹ 個 7 TeV 質子（1.1 kJ）就可能淬火一顆磁鐵，這相當於束流的 3×10⁻⁶，所以準直系統的洩漏率必須遠低於 10⁻⁵。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Beam energy = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J. Heating copper from 300 K to its melting point and melting it takes about 505 kJ/kg, so 362 MJ melts about 717 kg. If a fast loss of 10⁹ protons at 7 TeV (1.1 kJ) can quench a magnet, that is 3×10⁻⁶ of the beam, so the collimation leakage must stay far below 10⁻⁵. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：做損失圖（loss map）：以橫向激發刻意讓束流暈增長，記錄環上每個束流損失監測器的讀數，確認最高損失集中在準直區且冷區的損失低於準直區峰值的 10⁻⁵；另外以低強度束流測試傾卸系統，核對踢磁鐵的同步與傾卸塊上的束流掃描軌跡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Produce loss maps: deliberately grow the beam halo with transverse excitation, record every beam-loss monitor around the ring, and confirm that losses peak in the collimation regions while cold-region losses stay below 10⁻⁵ of that peak; separately test the dump system with low-intensity beam, checking kicker synchronization and the swept beam trace on the dump block.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 束流能量 = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J。銅從 300 K 升到熔點並熔化約需 505 kJ/kg，362 MJ 可熔化約 717 kg。若快速損失 10⁹ 個 7 TeV 質子（1.1 kJ）就可能淬火一顆磁鐵，這相當於束流的 3×10⁻⁶，所以準直系統的洩漏率必須遠低於 10⁻⁵。
knowledge.textEn: Beam energy = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J. Heating copper from 300 K to its melting point and melting it takes about 505 kJ/kg, so 362 MJ melts about 717 kg. If a fast loss of 10⁹ protons at 7 TeV (1.1 kJ) can quench a magnet, that is 3×10⁻⁶ of the beam, so the collimation leakage must stay far below 10⁻⁵.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets", which statement holds?
options: 只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。
超導磁鐵一旦冷卻到工作溫度就不會再淬火。
optionsEn: With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV.
Beam energy = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J.
Once cooled to operating temperature a superconducting magnet can no longer quench.
quiz.explanation: 束流能量 = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Beam energy = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 做損失圖（loss map）：以橫向激發刻意讓束流暈增長，記錄環上每個束流損失監測器的讀數，確認最高損失集中在準直區且冷區的損失低於準直區峰值的 10⁻⁵；另外以低強度束流測試傾卸系統，核對踢磁鐵的同步與傾卸塊上的束流掃描軌跡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Produce loss maps: deliberately grow the beam halo with transverse excitation, record every beam-loss monitor around the ring, and confirm that losses peak in the collimation regions while cold-region losses stay below 10⁻⁵ of that peak; separately test the dump system with low-intensity beam, checking kicker synchronization and the swept beam trace on the dump block. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：準直器顎板若因對準誤差退到 8 σ 以外，暈粒子直接打到三合一四極磁鐵，束流損失監測器在數毫秒內超過閾值而傾卸束流；若監測器閾值設定過高，則磁鐵淬火、扇區升溫，恢復需數天。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If a misaligned collimator jaw retreats beyond 8 σ, halo particles strike the triplet quadrupoles directly and the beam-loss monitors exceed threshold within milliseconds and dump the beam; if the thresholds were set too high instead, a magnet quenches, the sector warms up and recovery takes days.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 做損失圖（loss map）：以橫向激發刻意讓束流暈增長，記錄環上每個束流損失監測器的讀數，確認最高損失集中在準直區且冷區的損失低於準直區峰值的 10⁻⁵；另外以低強度束流測試傾卸系統，核對踢磁鐵的同步與傾卸塊上的束流掃描軌跡。
knowledge.textEn: Produce loss maps: deliberately grow the beam halo with transverse excitation, record every beam-loss monitor around the ring, and confirm that losses peak in the collimation regions while cold-region losses stay below 10⁻⁵ of that peak; separately test the dump system with low-intensity beam, checking kicker synchronization and the swept beam trace on the dump block.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
冷到 4.2 K 已經是超導，再冷到 1.9 K 只是浪費電。
做損失圖（loss map）：以橫向激發刻意讓束流暈增長，記錄環上每個束流損失監測器的讀數，確認最高損失集中在準直區且冷區的損失低於準直區峰值的 10⁻⁵。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Superconducting at 4.2 K already, going to 1.9 K merely wastes electricity.

Produce loss maps: deliberately grow the beam halo with transverse excitation, record every beam-loss monitor around the ring, and confirm that losses peak in the collimation regions while cold-region losses stay below 10⁻⁵ of that peak.
quiz.explanation: 做損失圖（loss map）：以橫向激發刻意讓束流暈增長，記錄環上每個束流損失監測器的讀數，確認最高損失集中在準直區且冷區的損失低於準直區峰值的 10⁻⁵；另外以低強度束流測試傾卸系統，核對踢磁鐵的同步與傾卸塊上的束流掃描軌跡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Produce loss maps: deliberately grow the beam halo with transverse excitation, record every beam-loss monitor around the ring, and confirm that losses peak in the collimation regions while cold-region losses stay below 10⁻⁵ of that peak; separately test the dump system with low-intensity beam, checking kicker synchronization and the swept beam trace on the dump block. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 準直器顎板若因對準誤差退到 8 σ 以外，暈粒子直接打到三合一四極磁鐵，束流損失監測器在數毫秒內超過閾值而傾卸束流；若監測器閾值設定過高，則磁鐵淬火、扇區升溫，恢復需數天。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If a misaligned collimator jaw retreats beyond 8 σ, halo particles strike the triplet quadrupoles directly and the beam-loss monitors exceed threshold within milliseconds and dump the beam; if the thresholds were set too high instead, a magnet quenches, the sector warms up and recovery takes days. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：環上約四千個游離室束流損失監測器以 40 µs 到 1.3 s 的多個時間窗持續積分，任何通道超過閾值就在三圈內觸發束流傾卸：踢磁鐵在 3 µs 的空檔中把束流引出，掃過 7 m 長的石墨傾卸塊分散能量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Some four thousand ionization-chamber beam-loss monitors integrate over several windows from 40 µs to 1.3 s, and any channel above threshold triggers a beam dump within three turns: kicker magnets extract the beam during a 3 µs gap and sweep it over a 7 m graphite dump block to spread the energy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 準直器顎板若因對準誤差退到 8 σ 以外，暈粒子直接打到三合一四極磁鐵，束流損失監測器在數毫秒內超過閾值而傾卸束流；若監測器閾值設定過高，則磁鐵淬火、扇區升溫，恢復需數天。
knowledge.textEn: If a misaligned collimator jaw retreats beyond 8 σ, halo particles strike the triplet quadrupoles directly and the beam-loss monitors exceed threshold within milliseconds and dump the beam; if the thresholds were set too high instead, a magnet quenches, the sector warms up and recovery takes days.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合」與「硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration" and "Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 質子由 Linac4 的 160 MeV H⁻ 經 PS Booster 2 GeV、PS 26 GeV、SPS 450 GeV 逐級加速，SPS 分 12 批注入每個環，填滿約需 4 分 20 秒。每束由 4 個低溫模組內的 8 個 400.8 MHz 超導腔提供每腔 2 MV、共 16 MV 的電壓；這個電壓主要用來建立縱向的「桶」把粒子束縛成 1 ns 左右的團，真正的加速增量很小。升流時偶極電流從約 760 A 升到 11,850 A 約需 20 分鐘，RF 頻率隨速度微調，之後把 β* 從注入的 11 m 壓縮到 0.55 m 並把兩束對撞。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Protons from Linac4 at 160 MeV (as H⁻) are accelerated in turn by the PS Booster to 2 GeV, the PS to 26 GeV and the SPS to 450 GeV; the SPS injects 12 batches into each ring and filling takes about 4 minutes 20 seconds. Each beam is driven by 8 superconducting 400.8 MHz cavities in 4 cryomodules at 2 MV each, 16 MV in total; this voltage mainly builds the longitudinal bucket that confines particles into bunches of about 1 ns, and the actual acceleration increment is tiny. During the ramp the dipole current rises from about 760 A to 11,850 A in roughly 20 minutes while the RF frequency tracks the velocity, after which β* is squeezed from 11 m at injection to 0.55 m and the beams are brought into collision. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640；25 ns 的團間距等於 10 個 RF 桶，所以最多 3564 個團，注入踢磁鐵與傾卸空檔使實際上限為 2808。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640; a 25 ns bunch spacing equals 10 RF buckets, so at most 3564 bunches, and the injection-kicker and dump gaps reduce the practical limit to 2808.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「16 MV 的 RF 電壓是用來把質子從 450 GeV 加速到 7 TeV 的主要動力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合

knowledge.text: 質子由 Linac4 的 160 MeV H⁻ 經 PS Booster 2 GeV、PS 26 GeV、SPS 450 GeV 逐級加速，SPS 分 12 批注入每個環，填滿約需 4 分 20 秒。每束由 4 個低溫模組內的 8 個 400.8 MHz 超導腔提供每腔 2 MV、共 16 MV 的電壓；這個電壓主要用來建立縱向的「桶」把粒子束縛成 1 ns 左右的團，真正的加速增量很小。
knowledge.textEn: Protons from Linac4 at 160 MeV (as H⁻) are accelerated in turn by the PS Booster to 2 GeV, the PS to 26 GeV and the SPS to 450 GeV; the SPS injects 12 batches into each ring and filling takes about 4 minutes 20 seconds. Each beam is driven by 8 superconducting 400.8 MHz cavities in 4 cryomodules at 2 MV each, 16 MV in total; this voltage mainly builds the longitudinal bucket that confines particles into bunches of about 1 ns, and the actual acceleration increment is tiny.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：16 MV 的 RF 電壓是用來把質子從 450 GeV 加速到 7 TeV 的主要動力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration" is correct?
options: 16 MV 的 RF 電壓是用來把質子從 450 GeV 加速到 7 TeV 的主要動力。
質子由 Linac4 的 160 MeV H⁻ 經 PS Booster 2 GeV、PS 26 GeV、SPS 450 GeV 逐級加速，SPS 分 12 批注入每個環，填滿約需 4 分 20 秒。
每顆磁鐵都在測試站通過驗收，整個電路就不需要再量接頭。
optionsEn: The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV.
Protons from Linac4 at 160 MeV (as H⁻) are accelerated in turn by the PS Booster to 2 GeV, the PS to 26 GeV and the SPS to 450 GeV.
If every magnet passed its bench test, the assembled circuit needs no splice measurement.
quiz.explanation: 質子由 Linac4 的 160 MeV H⁻ 經 PS Booster 2 GeV、PS 26 GeV、SPS 450 GeV 逐級加速，SPS 分 12 批注入每個環，填滿約需 4 分 20 秒。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Protons from Linac4 at 160 MeV (as H⁻) are accelerated in turn by the PS Booster to 2 GeV, the PS to 26 GeV and the SPS to 450 GeV; the SPS injects 12 batches into each ring and filling takes about 4 minutes 20 seconds. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640；25 ns 的團間距等於 10 個 RF 桶，所以最多 3564 個團，注入踢磁鐵與傾卸空檔使實際上限為 2808。升流 20 分鐘內能量增加 6.55 TeV，每圈只需 6.55×10¹²/(1200×11,245) ≈ 0.49 MeV，遠小於 16 MV 的 RF 電壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640; a 25 ns bunch spacing equals 10 RF buckets, so at most 3564 bunches, and the injection-kicker and dump gaps reduce the practical limit to 2808. Over a 20-minute ramp the energy rises by 6.55 TeV, requiring only 6.55×10¹²/(1200×11,245) ≈ 0.49 MeV per turn, far below the 16 MV RF voltage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪；升流中記錄束流流強與發射度，確認損失小於 1% 且發射度膨脹小於 10%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation; during the ramp log intensity and emittance to confirm losses below 1 percent and emittance growth below 10 percent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640；25 ns 的團間距等於 10 個 RF 桶，所以最多 3564 個團，注入踢磁鐵與傾卸空檔使實際上限為 2808。升流 20 分鐘內能量增加 6.55 TeV，每圈只需 6.55×10¹²/(1200×11,245) ≈ 0.49 MeV，遠小於 16 MV 的 RF 電壓。
knowledge.textEn: Harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640; a 25 ns bunch spacing equals 10 RF buckets, so at most 3564 bunches, and the injection-kicker and dump gaps reduce the practical limit to 2808. Over a 20-minute ramp the energy rises by 6.55 TeV, requiring only 6.55×10¹²/(1200×11,245) ≈ 0.49 MeV per turn, far below the 16 MV RF voltage.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration", which statement holds?
options: 亮度只跟束流能量有關，能量越高亮度越高。
冷到 4.2 K 已經是超導，再冷到 1.9 K 只是浪費電。
optionsEn: Luminosity depends only on beam energy, so higher energy means higher luminosity.
Superconducting at 4.2 K already, going to 1.9 K merely wastes electricity.
Harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640.
quiz.explanation: 諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640；25 ns 的團間距等於 10 個 RF 桶，所以最多 3564 個團，注入踢磁鐵與傾卸空檔使實際上限為 2808。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640; a 25 ns bunch spacing equals 10 RF buckets, so at most 3564 bunches, and the injection-kicker and dump gaps reduce the practical limit to 2808. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪；升流中記錄束流流強與發射度，確認損失小於 1% 且發射度膨脹小於 10%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation; during the ramp log intensity and emittance to confirm losses below 1 percent and emittance growth below 10 percent. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：注入時 RF 相位誤差幾度，團在桶內做大幅同步振盪，部分粒子溢出桶外成為未被捕獲的「幽靈」電荷，在傾卸空檔中被踢磁鐵部分偏轉而損失在孔徑上，觸發保護系統。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A phase error of a few degrees at injection makes the bunches execute large synchrotron oscillations, some particles spill out of the bucket as uncaptured ghost charge, get partially deflected by the kickers in the dump gap and are lost on the aperture, triggering the protection system.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪；升流中記錄束流流強與發射度，確認損失小於 1% 且發射度膨脹小於 10%。
knowledge.textEn: Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation; during the ramp log intensity and emittance to confirm losses below 1 percent and emittance growth below 10 percent.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration"?
options: 以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。
optionsEn: Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history.
quiz.explanation: 以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪；升流中記錄束流流強與發射度，確認損失小於 1% 且發射度膨脹小於 10%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation; during the ramp log intensity and emittance to confirm losses below 1 percent and emittance growth below 10 percent. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 注入時 RF 相位誤差幾度，團在桶內做大幅同步振盪，部分粒子溢出桶外成為未被捕獲的「幽靈」電荷，在傾卸空檔中被踢磁鐵部分偏轉而損失在孔徑上，觸發保護系統。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A phase error of a few degrees at injection makes the bunches execute large synchrotron oscillations, some particles spill out of the bucket as uncaptured ghost charge, get partially deflected by the kickers in the dump gap and are lost on the aperture, triggering the protection system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：升流時偶極電流從約 760 A 升到 11,850 A 約需 20 分鐘，RF 頻率隨速度微調，之後把 β* 從注入的 11 m 壓縮到 0.55 m 並把兩束對撞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During the ramp the dipole current rises from about 760 A to 11,850 A in roughly 20 minutes while the RF frequency tracks the velocity, after which β* is squeezed from 11 m at injection to 0.55 m and the beams are brought into collision.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「16 MV 的 RF 電壓是用來把質子從 450 GeV 加速到 7 TeV 的主要動力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 注入時 RF 相位誤差幾度，團在桶內做大幅同步振盪，部分粒子溢出桶外成為未被捕獲的「幽靈」電荷，在傾卸空檔中被踢磁鐵部分偏轉而損失在孔徑上，觸發保護系統。
knowledge.textEn: A phase error of a few degrees at injection makes the bunches execute large synchrotron oscillations, some particles spill out of the bucket as uncaptured ghost charge, get partially deflected by the kickers in the dump gap and are lost on the aperture, triggering the protection system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
注入時 RF 相位誤差幾度，團在桶內做大幅同步振盪，部分粒子溢出桶外成為未被捕獲的「幽靈」電荷，在傾卸空檔中被踢磁鐵部分偏轉而損失在孔徑上，觸發保護系統。
每顆磁鐵都在測試站通過驗收，整個電路就不需要再量接頭。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

A phase error of a few degrees at injection makes the bunches execute large synchrotron oscillations, some particles spill out of the bucket as uncaptured ghost charge, get partially deflected by the kickers in the dump gap and are lost on the aperture, triggering the protection system.
If every magnet passed its bench test, the assembled circuit needs no splice measurement.
quiz.explanation: 注入時 RF 相位誤差幾度，團在桶內做大幅同步振盪，部分粒子溢出桶外成為未被捕獲的「幽靈」電荷，在傾卸空檔中被踢磁鐵部分偏轉而損失在孔徑上，觸發保護系統。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A phase error of a few degrees at injection makes the bunches execute large synchrotron oscillations, some particles spill out of the bucket as uncaptured ghost charge, get partially deflected by the kickers in the dump gap and are lost on the aperture, triggering the protection system. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「硬體試運轉與電路驗收表」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hardware commissioning and circuit acceptance sheet” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 冷卻完成後，每一個超導電路都要經過電氣品質保證（絕緣、接地、儀器線路）、淬火保護系統測試，再逐步升流到額定值並記錄訓練淬火；主偶極電路由 154 顆磁鐵串聯，匯流排接頭以軟焊連接，每個接頭的電阻必須在 nΩ 等級，否則焦耳熱會在失去超導時引發熱失控，這正是 2008 年 9 月事故的機制。束流試運轉再從第一圈、RF 捕獲、升流、壓縮到對撞逐步解鎖，每一步都有機器保護檢查表；交接給操作團隊的文件包括每個電路的訓練歷史、接頭電阻量測、損失監測器閾值表與亮度校正結果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「硬體試運轉與電路驗收表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After cool-down every superconducting circuit passes electrical quality assurance (insulation, grounding, instrumentation wiring) and quench-protection tests, then is ramped stepwise to nominal while training quenches are logged; a main-dipole circuit strings 154 magnets in series with soldered bus-bar splices whose resistance must stay at the nanoohm level, otherwise Joule heating after loss of superconductivity drives thermal runaway, which is exactly the mechanism of the September 2008 incident. Beam commissioning then unlocks first turn, RF capture, ramp, squeeze and collisions in turn, each step gated by a machine-protection checklist; the handoff package to operations contains every circuit's training history, splice-resistance measurements, loss-monitor threshold tables and luminosity-calibration results. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hardware commissioning and circuit acceptance sheet”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：接頭功率 P = I²R：I = 11,850 A 時，R = 1 nΩ 給 0.14 W，可由 He II 帶走；R = 220 nΩ 則為 31 W，遠超局部冷卻能力，銅穩定層會在數秒內升溫到失去超導並電弧。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Splice power P = I²R: at I = 11,850 A, R = 1 nΩ gives 0.14 W, which He II removes easily, whereas R = 220 nΩ gives 31 W, far beyond local cooling, so the copper stabilizer warms within seconds, loses superconductivity and arcs.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每顆磁鐵都在測試站通過驗收，整個電路就不需要再量接頭。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every magnet passed its bench test, the assembled circuit needs no splice measurement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「硬體試運轉與電路驗收表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Hardware commissioning and circuit acceptance sheet”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：每顆磁鐵都在測試站通過驗收，整個電路就不需要再量接頭。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every magnet passed its bench test, the assembled circuit needs no splice measurement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff" is correct?
options: 每顆磁鐵都在測試站通過驗收，整個電路就不需要再量接頭。
只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。
冷卻完成後，每一個超導電路都要經過電氣品質保證（絕緣、接地、儀器線路）、淬火保護系統測試，再逐步升流到額定值並記錄訓練淬火。
optionsEn: If every magnet passed its bench test, the assembled circuit needs no splice measurement.
With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV.

After cool-down every superconducting circuit passes electrical quality assurance (insulation, grounding, instrumentation wiring) and quench-protection tests, then is ramped stepwise to nominal while training quenches are logged.
quiz.explanation: 冷卻完成後，每一個超導電路都要經過電氣品質保證（絕緣、接地、儀器線路）、淬火保護系統測試，再逐步升流到額定值並記錄訓練淬火；主偶極電路由 154 顆磁鐵串聯，匯流排接頭以軟焊連接，每個接頭的電阻必須在 nΩ 等級，否則焦耳熱會在失去超導時引發熱失控，這正是 2008 年 9 月事故的機制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After cool-down every superconducting circuit passes electrical quality assurance (insulation, grounding, instrumentation wiring) and quench-protection tests, then is ramped stepwise to nominal while training quenches are logged; a main-dipole circuit strings 154 magnets in series with soldered bus-bar splices whose resistance must stay at the nanoohm level, otherwise Joule heating after loss of superconductivity drives thermal runaway, which is exactly the mechanism of the September 2008 incident. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「硬體試運轉與電路驗收表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hardware commissioning and circuit acceptance sheet” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：接頭功率 P = I²R：I = 11,850 A 時，R = 1 nΩ 給 0.14 W，可由 He II 帶走；R = 220 nΩ 則為 31 W，遠超局部冷卻能力，銅穩定層會在數秒內升溫到失去超導並電弧。因此驗收標準把接頭電阻上限訂在數 nΩ，整個電路 1232 顆磁鐵的接頭總電阻也只有微歐等級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Splice power P = I²R: at I = 11,850 A, R = 1 nΩ gives 0.14 W, which He II removes easily, whereas R = 220 nΩ gives 31 W, far beyond local cooling, so the copper stabilizer warms within seconds, loses superconductivity and arcs. Acceptance therefore caps splice resistance at a few nanoohms, and the total splice resistance of a 1232-magnet circuit is only at the microohm level. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 1.9 K 用高精度電壓量測在接頭兩端讀取電壓降，除以電流得到 nΩ 級電阻，與 1 nΩ 等級的驗收上限比較；室溫下再用量測銅穩定層連續性的方法檢查每個接頭的焊接品質，所有數據存入電路資料庫並在交接前由機器保護小組簽核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At 1.9 K read the voltage drop across each splice with high-resolution voltmeters and divide by the current to obtain the nanoohm resistance, comparing with the acceptance limit of the order of 1 nΩ; at room temperature check the soldering quality of each splice by measuring the continuity of the copper stabilizer, and store all data in the circuit database for sign-off by the machine-protection team before handoff.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 接頭功率 P = I²R：I = 11,850 A 時，R = 1 nΩ 給 0.14 W，可由 He II 帶走；R = 220 nΩ 則為 31 W，遠超局部冷卻能力，銅穩定層會在數秒內升溫到失去超導並電弧。因此驗收標準把接頭電阻上限訂在數 nΩ，整個電路 1232 顆磁鐵的接頭總電阻也只有微歐等級。
knowledge.textEn: Splice power P = I²R: at I = 11,850 A, R = 1 nΩ gives 0.14 W, which He II removes easily, whereas R = 220 nΩ gives 31 W, far beyond local cooling, so the copper stabilizer warms within seconds, loses superconductivity and arcs. Acceptance therefore caps splice resistance at a few nanoohms, and the total splice resistance of a 1232-magnet circuit is only at the microohm level.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff", which statement holds?
options: 接頭功率 P = I²R：I = 11,850 A 時，R = 1 nΩ 給 0.14 W，可由 He II 帶走。
超導磁鐵一旦冷卻到工作溫度就不會再淬火。
超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。
optionsEn: Splice power P = I²R: at I = 11,850 A, R = 1 nΩ gives 0.14 W, which He II removes easily, whereas R = 220 nΩ gives 31 W, far beyond local cooling, so the copper stabilizer warms within seconds, loses superconductivity and arcs.
Once cooled to operating temperature a superconducting magnet can no longer quench.
A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history.
quiz.explanation: 接頭功率 P = I²R：I = 11,850 A 時，R = 1 nΩ 給 0.14 W，可由 He II 帶走；R = 220 nΩ 則為 31 W，遠超局部冷卻能力，銅穩定層會在數秒內升溫到失去超導並電弧。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Splice power P = I²R: at I = 11,850 A, R = 1 nΩ gives 0.14 W, which He II removes easily, whereas R = 220 nΩ gives 31 W, far beyond local cooling, so the copper stabilizer warms within seconds, loses superconductivity and arcs. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「硬體試運轉與電路驗收表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Hardware commissioning and circuit acceptance sheet” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 1.9 K 用高精度電壓量測在接頭兩端讀取電壓降，除以電流得到 nΩ 級電阻，與 1 nΩ 等級的驗收上限比較；室溫下再用量測銅穩定層連續性的方法檢查每個接頭的焊接品質，所有數據存入電路資料庫並在交接前由機器保護小組簽核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At 1.9 K read the voltage drop across each splice with high-resolution voltmeters and divide by the current to obtain the nanoohm resistance, comparing with the acceptance limit of the order of 1 nΩ; at room temperature check the soldering quality of each splice by measuring the continuity of the copper stabilizer, and store all data in the circuit database for sign-off by the machine-protection team before handoff. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一個未被量到的高電阻接頭在升流到額定電流時過熱、電弧並擊穿氦槽，數噸氦瞬間汽化造成壓力波，把數十顆磁鐵推離定位，修復需一年以上；這就是為何接頭量測與升壓洩放閥成為驗收的必要項目。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A single unmeasured high-resistance splice overheats on the ramp to nominal current, arcs and breaches the helium enclosure, several tonnes of helium vaporize at once and the pressure wave shoves dozens of magnets off their supports, with repairs taking more than a year; this is why splice measurements and enlarged relief valves became mandatory acceptance items.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在 1.9 K 用高精度電壓量測在接頭兩端讀取電壓降，除以電流得到 nΩ 級電阻，與 1 nΩ 等級的驗收上限比較；室溫下再用量測銅穩定層連續性的方法檢查每個接頭的焊接品質，所有數據存入電路資料庫並在交接前由機器保護小組簽核。
knowledge.textEn: At 1.9 K read the voltage drop across each splice with high-resolution voltmeters and divide by the current to obtain the nanoohm resistance, comparing with the acceptance limit of the order of 1 nΩ; at room temperature check the soldering quality of each splice by measuring the continuity of the copper stabilizer, and store all data in the circuit database for sign-off by the machine-protection team before handoff.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在 1.9 K 用高精度電壓量測在接頭兩端讀取電壓降，除以電流得到 nΩ 級電阻，與 1 nΩ 等級的驗收上限比較。
束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
At 1.9 K read the voltage drop across each splice with high-resolution voltmeters and divide by the current to obtain the nanoohm resistance, comparing with the acceptance limit of the order of 1 nΩ.
The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm.
quiz.explanation: 在 1.9 K 用高精度電壓量測在接頭兩端讀取電壓降，除以電流得到 nΩ 級電阻，與 1 nΩ 等級的驗收上限比較；室溫下再用量測銅穩定層連續性的方法檢查每個接頭的焊接品質，所有數據存入電路資料庫並在交接前由機器保護小組簽核。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At 1.9 K read the voltage drop across each splice with high-resolution voltmeters and divide by the current to obtain the nanoohm resistance, comparing with the acceptance limit of the order of 1 nΩ; at room temperature check the soldering quality of each splice by measuring the continuity of the copper stabilizer, and store all data in the circuit database for sign-off by the machine-protection team before handoff. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「硬體試運轉與電路驗收表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Hardware commissioning and circuit acceptance sheet” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一個未被量到的高電阻接頭在升流到額定電流時過熱、電弧並擊穿氦槽，數噸氦瞬間汽化造成壓力波，把數十顆磁鐵推離定位，修復需一年以上；這就是為何接頭量測與升壓洩放閥成為驗收的必要項目。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A single unmeasured high-resistance splice overheats on the ramp to nominal current, arcs and breaches the helium enclosure, several tonnes of helium vaporize at once and the pressure wave shoves dozens of magnets off their supports, with repairs taking more than a year; this is why splice measurements and enlarged relief valves became mandatory acceptance items. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：束流試運轉再從第一圈、RF 捕獲、升流、壓縮到對撞逐步解鎖，每一步都有機器保護檢查表；交接給操作團隊的文件包括每個電路的訓練歷史、接頭電阻量測、損失監測器閾值表與亮度校正結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beam commissioning then unlocks first turn, RF capture, ramp, squeeze and collisions in turn, each step gated by a machine-protection checklist; the handoff package to operations contains every circuit's training history, splice-resistance measurements, loss-monitor threshold tables and luminosity-calibration results.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每顆磁鐵都在測試站通過驗收，整個電路就不需要再量接頭。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every magnet passed its bench test, the assembled circuit needs no splice measurement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一個未被量到的高電阻接頭在升流到額定電流時過熱、電弧並擊穿氦槽，數噸氦瞬間汽化造成壓力波，把數十顆磁鐵推離定位，修復需一年以上；這就是為何接頭量測與升壓洩放閥成為驗收的必要項目。
knowledge.textEn: A single unmeasured high-resistance splice overheats on the ramp to nominal current, arcs and breaches the helium enclosure, several tonnes of helium vaporize at once and the pressure wave shoves dozens of magnets off their supports, with repairs taking more than a year; this is why splice measurements and enlarged relief valves became mandatory acceptance items.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「硬體試運轉、接頭電阻與操作交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hardware commissioning, splice resistance and operations handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。
一個未被量到的高電阻接頭在升流到額定電流時過熱、電弧並擊穿氦槽，數噸氦瞬間汽化造成壓力波，把數十顆磁鐵推離定位，修復需一年以上。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV.

A single unmeasured high-resistance splice overheats on the ramp to nominal current, arcs and breaches the helium enclosure, several tonnes of helium vaporize at once and the pressure wave shoves dozens of magnets off their supports, with repairs taking more than a year.

quiz.explanationEn: A single unmeasured high-resistance splice overheats on the ramp to nominal current, arcs and breaches the helium enclosure, several tonnes of helium vaporize at once and the pressure wave shoves dozens of magnets off their supports, with repairs taking more than a year; this is why splice measurements and enlarged relief valves became mandatory acceptance items. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: CERN Linac4 直線加速器
summary: 以取代 Linac2、自 2020 年起為 CERN 全部質子束流源頭的 86 m 長 Linac4 為對象，說明為何把注入能量從 50 MeV 提高到 160 MeV 並改用 H⁻ 能讓 PS Booster 亮度約加倍，再把 45 keV 離子源、3 MeV RFQ、斬波線、三種 352.2 MHz 加速結構、飛行時間相位掃描、損失與剝離預算、碳膜電荷交換注入與可靠度驗收整合成可交接的加速器紀錄。
summaryEn: For the 86 m Linac4 that replaced Linac2 and since 2020 sources every proton beam at CERN, show why raising injection energy from 50 to 160 MeV with H⁻ ions roughly doubles PS Booster brightness, then integrate the 45 keV source, 3 MeV RFQ, chopper line, three 352.2 MHz accelerating structures, time-of-flight phase scans, loss and stripping budgets, carbon-foil charge-exchange injection and reliability acceptance into a transferable accelerator record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
