knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以束團相位訊號或縱向 Schottky 頻譜量測同步振盪頻率 f_s，並與 f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) 在兩種光學下的預測比較。
固態放大器只要有一個模組損壞，整套發射機就必須停機。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the synchrotron frequency f_s from bunch-phase signals or the longitudinal Schottky spectrum and compare with f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) for both optics.
If one solid-state module fails, the whole transmitter must stop.
quiz.explanation: 以束團相位訊號或縱向 Schottky 頻譜量測同步振盪頻率 f_s，並與 f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) 在兩種光學下的預測比較；改變 RF 頻率量測動量壓縮因子以獨立求 γt；在注入平台逐步提高束團強度，記錄束團長度振盪開始出現的門檻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the synchrotron frequency f_s from bunch-phase signals or the longitudinal Schottky spectrum and compare with f_s = f_rev·√(h|η|eV·cosφs/(2πβ²E)) for both optics; obtain γt independently by measuring momentum compaction from RF-frequency steps; raise bunch intensity step by step on the injection plateau and record the threshold at which bunch-length oscillations start. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 以 Q26 光學推高強度時，縱向耦合束團不穩定使束團長度與峰值在平台上振盪，送往 LHC 的束團長度超出規格，LHC 射頻捕獲損失增加；固定靶循環若轉變能穿越時的相位跳躍時序偏差，束流在轉變點大量流失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Pushing intensity in Q26 optics lets longitudinal coupled-bunch instabilities modulate bunch length and peak current on the plateau, bunches delivered to the LHC exceed the length specification and LHC RF capture losses grow; on fixed-target cycles a mistimed phase jump at transition crossing loses much of the beam at that point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：SPS 從 Q26 改用 Q20 光學，把轉變能 γt 由約 22.8 降到約 18，使 26 GeV/c 注入時 |η| 變大，同步頻率與不穩定性門檻跟著提高；固定靶束流若以 14 GeV/c（γ ≈ 15）注入，仍須在斜坡中穿越轉變能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moving from Q26 to Q20 optics lowered the transition gamma from about 22.8 to about 18, enlarging |η| at 26 GeV/c injection and raising both the synchrotron frequency and instability thresholds; fixed-target beams injected at 14 GeV/c (γ ≈ 15) still cross transition during the ramp.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以 Q26 光學推高強度時，縱向耦合束團不穩定使束團長度與峰值在平台上振盪，送往 LHC 的束團長度超出規格，LHC 射頻捕獲損失增加；固定靶循環若轉變能穿越時的相位跳躍時序偏差，束流在轉變點大量流失。
knowledge.textEn: Pushing intensity in Q26 optics lets longitudinal coupled-bunch instabilities modulate bunch length and peak current on the plateau, bunches delivered to the LHC exceed the length specification and LHC RF capture losses grow; on fixed-target cycles a mistimed phase jump at transition crossing loses much of the beam at that point.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "RF harmonic number, transition energy and Q20 optics" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
常溫磁鐵只要持續提高電流，場強就能無限制增加。
以 Q26 光學推高強度時，縱向耦合束團不穩定使束團長度與峰值在平台上振盪，送往 LHC 的束團長度超出規格，LHC 射頻捕獲損失增加。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit.

Pushing intensity in Q26 optics lets longitudinal coupled-bunch instabilities modulate bunch length and peak current on the plateau, bunches delivered to the LHC exceed the length specification and LHC RF capture losses grow.
quiz.explanation: 以 Q26 光學推高強度時，縱向耦合束團不穩定使束團長度與峰值在平台上振盪，送往 LHC 的束團長度超出規格，LHC 射頻捕獲損失增加；固定靶循環若轉變能穿越時的相位跳躍時序偏差，束流在轉變點大量流失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pushing intensity in Q26 optics lets longitudinal coupled-bunch instabilities modulate bunch length and peak current on the plateau, bunches delivered to the LHC exceed the length specification and LHC RF capture losses grow; on fixed-target cycles a mistimed phase jump at transition crossing loses much of the beam at that point. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史」與「電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history" and "Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 共有 1317 台常溫電磁鐵，其中 744 台為偶極，由疊片低碳鋼鐵芯與水冷銅線圈構成，場形由極面形狀決定。鐵芯在 2 T 附近開始飽和，因此 450 GeV 已接近常溫鐵磁鐵的實用上限，這也是 LHC 必須改用超導磁鐵的原因。疊片抑制斜坡時的渦電流，但鐵的磁滯使同一電流下的磁場取決於前一循環的最高場；SPS 在超循環中交錯 LHC、固定靶與其他用戶循環，磁場歷史不斷改變。偶極分為兩種孔徑型式，以配合不同位置的束流尺寸。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS has 1317 warm electromagnets, 744 of them dipoles, built from laminated low-carbon steel yokes and water-cooled copper coils, with the field shape set by the pole profile. The iron begins to saturate near 2 T, so 450 GeV is close to the practical limit of warm iron magnets, which is why the LHC had to use superconducting magnets. Laminations suppress eddy currents during the ramp, but iron hysteresis makes the field at a given current depend on the previous cycle's peak; the SPS interleaves LHC, fixed-target and other users in a supercycle, so the magnetic history keeps changing. The dipoles come in two aperture types matched to the local beam size. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鐵主導磁鐵所需安匝 NI ≈ B·g/μ₀。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an iron-dominated magnet the excitation is NI ≈ B·g/μ₀.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「常溫磁鐵只要持續提高電流，場強就能無限制增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史
knowledge.titleEn: Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history
knowledge.text: SPS 共有 1317 台常溫電磁鐵，其中 744 台為偶極，由疊片低碳鋼鐵芯與水冷銅線圈構成，場形由極面形狀決定。鐵芯在 2 T 附近開始飽和，因此 450 GeV 已接近常溫鐵磁鐵的實用上限，這也是 LHC 必須改用超導磁鐵的原因。
knowledge.textEn: The SPS has 1317 warm electromagnets, 744 of them dipoles, built from laminated low-carbon steel yokes and water-cooled copper coils, with the field shape set by the pole profile. The iron begins to saturate near 2 T, so 450 GeV is close to the practical limit of warm iron magnets, which is why the LHC had to use superconducting magnets.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：常溫磁鐵只要持續提高電流，場強就能無限制增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history" is correct?
options: SPS 共有 1317 台常溫電磁鐵，其中 744 台為偶極，由疊片低碳鋼鐵芯與水冷銅線圈構成，場形由極面形狀決定。
常溫磁鐵只要持續提高電流，場強就能無限制增加。
只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。
optionsEn: The SPS has 1317 warm electromagnets, 744 of them dipoles, built from laminated low-carbon steel yokes and water-cooled copper coils, with the field shape set by the pole profile.
Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit.
If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form.
quiz.explanation: SPS 共有 1317 台常溫電磁鐵，其中 744 台為偶極，由疊片低碳鋼鐵芯與水冷銅線圈構成，場形由極面形狀決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The SPS has 1317 warm electromagnets, 744 of them dipoles, built from laminated low-carbon steel yokes and water-cooled copper coils, with the field shape set by the pole profile. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鐵主導磁鐵所需安匝 NI ≈ B·g/μ₀。假設間隙 g = 40 mm、B = 2.02 T：NI ≈ 2.02×0.04/(4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.4×10⁴ A·匝，接近飽和時鐵的磁阻不可忽略，實際需多出數個百分比。假設剩磁 1.0 mT，相對注入場 0.117 T 佔 0.85%；循環間剩磁變動 1% 時 ΔB/B ≈ 8.5×10⁻⁵，在 D = 3 m 處造成約 0.26 mm 軌道偏移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an iron-dominated magnet the excitation is NI ≈ B·g/μ₀. Assuming a gap g = 40 mm and B = 2.02 T, NI ≈ 2.02×0.04/(4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.4×10⁴ ampere-turns, and near saturation the iron reluctance adds several percent more. Assuming a remanent field of 1.0 mT, it is 0.85% of the 0.117 T injection field; a 1% cycle-to-cycle change in remanence gives ΔB/B ≈ 8.5×10⁻⁵, an orbit shift of about 0.26 mm where D = 3 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以旋轉線圈或積分線圈量測代表性磁鐵的積分場與多極分量；先後執行不同前置循環（例如先跑 450 GeV 或 400 GeV 循環）再量注入場，建立歷史相依的修正表；運轉中把 B-train 讀值與束流平均徑向位置交叉比對，並記錄線圈冷卻水溫差以追蹤電阻變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure integrated field and multipoles of representative magnets with rotating or integrating coils; run different preceding cycles (for example a 450 GeV or a 400 GeV cycle) before measuring the injection field to build a history-dependent correction table; in operation cross-check the B-train reading against the beam's mean radial position and log coil cooling-water temperature rise to track resistance changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鐵主導磁鐵所需安匝 NI ≈ B·g/μ₀。假設間隙 g = 40 mm、B = 2.02 T：NI ≈ 2.02×0.04/(4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.4×10⁴ A·匝，接近飽和時鐵的磁阻不可忽略，實際需多出數個百分比。假設剩磁 1.0 mT，相對注入場 0.117 T 佔 0.85%；循環間剩磁變動 1% 時 ΔB/B ≈ 8.5×10⁻⁵，在 D = 3 m 處造成約 0.26 mm 軌道偏移。
knowledge.textEn: For an iron-dominated magnet the excitation is NI ≈ B·g/μ₀. Assuming a gap g = 40 mm and B = 2.02 T, NI ≈ 2.02×0.04/(4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.4×10⁴ ampere-turns, and near saturation the iron reluctance adds several percent more. Assuming a remanent field of 1.0 mT, it is 0.85% of the 0.117 T injection field; a 1% cycle-to-cycle change in remanence gives ΔB/B ≈ 8.5×10⁻⁵, an orbit shift of about 0.26 mm where D = 3 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history", which statement holds?
options: 只要把分離器細線做得更細，慢引出損失就能降到零。
鐵主導磁鐵所需安匝 NI ≈ B·g/μ₀。
固態放大器只要有一個模組損壞，整套發射機就必須停機。
optionsEn: Making the septum wires thin enough drives slow-extraction loss to zero.
For an iron-dominated magnet the excitation is NI ≈ B·g/μ₀.
If one solid-state module fails, the whole transmitter must stop.
quiz.explanation: 鐵主導磁鐵所需安匝 NI ≈ B·g/μ₀。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an iron-dominated magnet the excitation is NI ≈ B·g/μ₀. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以旋轉線圈或積分線圈量測代表性磁鐵的積分場與多極分量；先後執行不同前置循環（例如先跑 450 GeV 或 400 GeV 循環）再量注入場，建立歷史相依的修正表；運轉中把 B-train 讀值與束流平均徑向位置交叉比對，並記錄線圈冷卻水溫差以追蹤電阻變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure integrated field and multipoles of representative magnets with rotating or integrating coils; run different preceding cycles (for example a 450 GeV or a 400 GeV cycle) before measuring the injection field to build a history-dependent correction table; in operation cross-check the B-train reading against the beam's mean radial position and log coil cooling-water temperature rise to track resistance changes. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷卻水流量不足使線圈溫升、電阻增加，電源電壓餘裕耗盡，斜坡末段跟不上設定值；輻射區的線圈絕緣老化形成匝間短路，該磁鐵場強下降並扭曲軌道，必須停機更換。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient cooling-water flow heats the coil and raises its resistance until the converter runs out of voltage headroom and the end of the ramp lags the reference; radiation-aged coil insulation develops an inter-turn short, the magnet's field drops and distorts the orbit, and the magnet must be replaced during a stop.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以旋轉線圈或積分線圈量測代表性磁鐵的積分場與多極分量；先後執行不同前置循環（例如先跑 450 GeV 或 400 GeV 循環）再量注入場，建立歷史相依的修正表；運轉中把 B-train 讀值與束流平均徑向位置交叉比對，並記錄線圈冷卻水溫差以追蹤電阻變化。
knowledge.textEn: Measure integrated field and multipoles of representative magnets with rotating or integrating coils; run different preceding cycles (for example a 450 GeV or a 400 GeV cycle) before measuring the injection field to build a history-dependent correction table; in operation cross-check the B-train reading against the beam's mean radial position and log coil cooling-water temperature rise to track resistance changes.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。
以旋轉線圈或積分線圈量測代表性磁鐵的積分場與多極分量。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage.
Measure integrated field and multipoles of representative magnets with rotating or integrating coils.
quiz.explanation: 以旋轉線圈或積分線圈量測代表性磁鐵的積分場與多極分量；先後執行不同前置循環（例如先跑 450 GeV 或 400 GeV 循環）再量注入場，建立歷史相依的修正表；運轉中把 B-train 讀值與束流平均徑向位置交叉比對，並記錄線圈冷卻水溫差以追蹤電阻變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure integrated field and multipoles of representative magnets with rotating or integrating coils; run different preceding cycles (for example a 450 GeV or a 400 GeV cycle) before measuring the injection field to build a history-dependent correction table; in operation cross-check the B-train reading against the beam's mean radial position and log coil cooling-water temperature rise to track resistance changes. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 冷卻水流量不足使線圈溫升、電阻增加，電源電壓餘裕耗盡，斜坡末段跟不上設定值；輻射區的線圈絕緣老化形成匝間短路，該磁鐵場強下降並扭曲軌道，必須停機更換。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient cooling-water flow heats the coil and raises its resistance until the converter runs out of voltage headroom and the end of the ramp lags the reference; radiation-aged coil insulation develops an inter-turn short, the magnet's field drops and distorts the orbit, and the magnet must be replaced during a stop. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：偶極分為兩種孔徑型式，以配合不同位置的束流尺寸。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The dipoles come in two aperture types matched to the local beam size.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「常溫磁鐵只要持續提高電流，場強就能無限制增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Keep raising the current and a warm iron magnet's field grows without limit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 冷卻水流量不足使線圈溫升、電阻增加，電源電壓餘裕耗盡，斜坡末段跟不上設定值；輻射區的線圈絕緣老化形成匝間短路，該磁鐵場強下降並扭曲軌道，必須停機更換。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient cooling-water flow heats the coil and raises its resistance until the converter runs out of voltage headroom and the end of the ramp lags the reference; radiation-aged coil insulation develops an inter-turn short, the magnet's field drops and distorts the orbit, and the magnet must be replaced during a stop.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 冷卻水流量不足使線圈溫升、電阻增加，電源電壓餘裕耗盡，斜坡末段跟不上設定值；輻射區的線圈絕緣老化形成匝間短路，該磁鐵場強下降並扭曲軌道，必須停機更換。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。
optionsEn: Insufficient cooling-water flow heats the coil and raises its resistance until the converter runs out of voltage headroom and the end of the ramp lags the reference.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form.
quiz.explanation: 冷卻水流量不足使線圈溫升、電阻增加，電源電壓餘裕耗盡，斜坡末段跟不上設定值；輻射區的線圈絕緣老化形成匝間短路，該磁鐵場強下降並扭曲軌道，必須停機更換。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient cooling-water flow heats the coil and raises its resistance until the converter runs out of voltage headroom and the end of the ramp lags the reference; radiation-aged coil insulation develops an inter-turn short, the magnet's field drops and distorts the orbit, and the magnet must be replaced during a stop. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 25 ns 間隔的高強度質子束團會把真空室壁上的殘餘電子吸向束流中心並加速，電子撞牆時若二次電子產率（SEY）大於 1，電子數隨每個束團倍增而形成電子雲，造成橫向不穩定、發射度增長、壓力上升與熱負載。SPS 在 LS2 期間把 88 支聚焦四極（QF）的束管、相鄰短直線段與部分漂移段鍍上非晶碳，平均最大 SEY 約 0.99，低於漂移管約 1.1、QF 約 1.25 的倍增門檻；MBB 偶極的鍍膜規劃在 LS3 進行。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High-intensity proton bunches at 25 ns spacing pull residual electrons off the chamber wall towards the beam and accelerate them; if the secondary-electron yield (SEY) on impact exceeds 1, the electron population multiplies bunch after bunch into an electron cloud, causing transverse instabilities, emittance growth, pressure rise and heat load. During LS2 the SPS coated the beam pipes of its 88 focusing quadrupoles (QF), the adjacent short straight sections and some drifts with amorphous carbon, reaching an average maximum SEY of about 0.99, below multipacting thresholds of about 1.1 in drift tubes and 1.25 in QF chambers; coating of the MBB dipoles is planned for LS3. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜
knowledge.titleEn: Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating
knowledge.text: 25 ns 間隔的高強度質子束團會把真空室壁上的殘餘電子吸向束流中心並加速，電子撞牆時若二次電子產率（SEY）大於 1，電子數隨每個束團倍增而形成電子雲，造成橫向不穩定、發射度增長、壓力上升與熱負載。SPS 在 LS2 期間把 88 支聚焦四極（QF）的束管、相鄰短直線段與部分漂移段鍍上非晶碳，平均最大 SEY 約 0.99，低於漂移管約 1.1、QF 約 1.25 的倍增門檻；MBB 偶極的鍍膜規劃在 LS3 進行。
knowledge.textEn: High-intensity proton bunches at 25 ns spacing pull residual electrons off the chamber wall towards the beam and accelerate them; if the secondary-electron yield (SEY) on impact exceeds 1, the electron population multiplies bunch after bunch into an electron cloud, causing transverse instabilities, emittance growth, pressure rise and heat load. During LS2 the SPS coated the beam pipes of its 88 focusing quadrupoles (QF), the adjacent short straight sections and some drifts with amorphous carbon, reaching an average maximum SEY of about 0.99, below multipacting thresholds of about 1.1 in drift tubes and 1.25 in QF chambers; coating of the MBB dipoles is planned for LS3.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating" is correct?
options: 只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。
25 ns 間隔的高強度質子束團會把真空室壁上的殘餘電子吸向束流中心並加速，電子撞牆時若二次電子產率（SEY）大於 1，電子數隨每個束團倍增而形成電子雲，造成橫向不穩定、發射度增長、壓力上升與熱負載。
幾何發射度在加速中守恆，所以不同能量的量測可以直接比較。
optionsEn: If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form.
High-intensity proton bunches at 25 ns spacing pull residual electrons off the chamber wall towards the beam and accelerate them.
Geometric emittance is conserved during acceleration, so measurements at different energies compare directly.
quiz.explanation: 25 ns 間隔的高強度質子束團會把真空室壁上的殘餘電子吸向束流中心並加速，電子撞牆時若二次電子產率（SEY）大於 1，電子數隨每個束團倍增而形成電子雲，造成橫向不穩定、發射度增長、壓力上升與熱負載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: High-intensity proton bunches at 25 ns spacing pull residual electrons off the chamber wall towards the beam and accelerate them; if the secondary-electron yield (SEY) on impact exceeds 1, the electron population multiplies bunch after bunch into an electron cloud, causing transverse instabilities, emittance growth, pressure rise and heat load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。取 r = 20 mm（假設）、r_e = 2.82×10⁻¹⁵ m：N = 1.15×10¹¹ 時 ΔE ≈ 1022 keV×(0.0162)² ≈ 0.27 keV；N = 2.2×10¹¹（HL-LHC 型）時 ≈ 0.98 keV。前者恰落在未處理金屬 SEY 峰值的數百 eV 附近，強度翻倍後倍增依然存在，必須以鍍膜把最大 SEY 壓到門檻以下。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes. With r = 20 mm (assumed) and r_e = 2.82×10⁻¹⁵ m: N = 1.15×10¹¹ gives ΔE ≈ 1022 keV×(0.0162)² ≈ 0.27 keV, and N = 2.2×10¹¹ (HL-LHC type) gives ≈ 0.98 keV. The former sits right at the few-hundred-eV SEY peak of untreated metal, and doubling intensity keeps multipacting alive, so the coating must hold the maximum SEY below threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鍍膜樣片在實驗室量 SEY 對入射電子能量的曲線並記錄最大值，每次鍍膜批次都留樣；裝機後以真空計壓力上升、帶阻擋柵極的電子雲收集電極電流、逐束團位置訊號與發射度，比較鍍膜段與未鍍段在相同 25 ns 束流下的差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure SEY versus incident electron energy on witness samples in the laboratory and record the maximum, keeping a sample from every coating batch; after installation compare coated and uncoated sections under the same 25 ns beam using vacuum-gauge pressure rise, current on retarding-grid electron-cloud collectors, bunch-by-bunch position signals and emittance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。取 r = 20 mm（假設）、r_e = 2.82×10⁻¹⁵ m：N = 1.15×10¹¹ 時 ΔE ≈ 1022 keV×(0.0162)² ≈ 0.27 keV；N = 2.2×10¹¹（HL-LHC 型）時 ≈ 0.98 keV。前者恰落在未處理金屬 SEY 峰值的數百 eV 附近，強度翻倍後倍增依然存在，必須以鍍膜把最大 SEY 壓到門檻以下。
knowledge.textEn: An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes. With r = 20 mm (assumed) and r_e = 2.82×10⁻¹⁵ m: N = 1.15×10¹¹ gives ΔE ≈ 1022 keV×(0.0162)² ≈ 0.27 keV, and N = 2.2×10¹¹ (HL-LHC type) gives ≈ 0.98 keV. The former sits right at the few-hundred-eV SEY peak of untreated metal, and doubling intensity keeps multipacting alive, so the coating must hold the maximum SEY below threshold.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating", which statement holds?
options: 450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。
SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。
束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。
optionsEn: Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless.
The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage.
An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes.
quiz.explanation: 束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜樣片在實驗室量 SEY 對入射電子能量的曲線並記錄最大值，每次鍍膜批次都留樣；裝機後以真空計壓力上升、帶阻擋柵極的電子雲收集電極電流、逐束團位置訊號與發射度，比較鍍膜段與未鍍段在相同 25 ns 束流下的差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure SEY versus incident electron energy on witness samples in the laboratory and record the maximum, keeping a sample from every coating batch; after installation compare coated and uncoated sections under the same 25 ns beam using vacuum-gauge pressure rise, current on retarding-grid electron-cloud collectors, bunch-by-bunch position signals and emittance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鍍膜附著不良或長期暴露潮濕大氣，SEY 回升到 1.2 以上，高強度 25 ns 束串尾端出現垂直不穩定與發射度增長，只能降低強度或延長洗刷運轉，直接壓縮 LHC 可用的亮度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Poor coating adhesion or long exposure to humid air lets the SEY climb above 1.2, vertical instabilities and emittance growth appear at the tail of high-intensity 25 ns trains, and the only remedies are lower intensity or longer scrubbing runs, directly cutting the luminosity available to the LHC.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜附著不良或長期暴露潮濕大氣，SEY 回升到 1.2 以上，高強度 25 ns 束串尾端出現垂直不穩定與發射度增長，只能降低強度或延長洗刷運轉，直接壓縮 LHC 可用的亮度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Poor coating adhesion or long exposure to humid air lets the SEY climb above 1.2, vertical instabilities and emittance growth appear at the tail of high-intensity 25 ns trains, and the only remedies are lower intensity or longer scrubbing runs, directly cutting the luminosity available to the LHC. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：SPS 在 LS2 期間把 88 支聚焦四極（QF）的束管、相鄰短直線段與部分漂移段鍍上非晶碳，平均最大 SEY 約 0.99，低於漂移管約 1.1、QF 約 1.25 的倍增門檻；MBB 偶極的鍍膜規劃在 LS3 進行。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During LS2 the SPS coated the beam pipes of its 88 focusing quadrupoles (QF), the adjacent short straight sections and some drifts with amorphous carbon, reaching an average maximum SEY of about 0.99, below multipacting thresholds of about 1.1 in drift tubes and 1.25 in QF chambers; coating of the MBB dipoles is planned for LS3.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
