steps.title: 減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：3.57 GeV/c：E = √(3.57² + 0.938²) = 3.691 GeV，動能 2.75 GeV，β = 0.967；100 MeV/c：動能 5.31 MeV，β = 0.106。βγ 比 = 3.805/0.1066 ≈ 35.7，不冷卻時 5 π mm·mrad 會長到約 179 π mm·mrad。Bρ 由 11.91 降到 0.334 T·m；周長 182.4 m 時迴轉頻率由 1.59 MHz 降到 0.174 MHz，射頻須涵蓋約 9:1 的頻率範圍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 3.57 GeV/c, E = √(3.57² + 0.938²) = 3.691 GeV, kinetic energy 2.75 GeV and β = 0.967; at 100 MeV/c the kinetic energy is 5.31 MeV and β = 0.106. The βγ ratio is 3.805/0.1066 ≈ 35.7, so without cooling 5 π mm·mrad would grow to about 179 π mm·mrad. Bρ falls from 11.91 to 0.334 T·m, and for a 182.4 m circumference the revolution frequency falls from 1.59 MHz to 0.174 MHz, so the RF must span about 9:1 in frequency. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在每個平台以 Schottky 頻譜量測動量分散與強度、以掃描器量測發射度，與 βγ 標度預測比較；記錄磁場與射頻頻率程式的對應，在平台上微調射頻頻率檢查平均徑向位置是否置中，以此量化磁場—頻率追蹤誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On each plateau measure momentum spread and intensity from the Schottky spectrum and emittance with scanners, comparing with the βγ scaling; log the field and RF-frequency programmes side by side and trim the RF frequency on the plateau to check that the mean radial position is centred, quantifying the field–frequency tracking error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在每個平台以 Schottky 頻譜量測動量分散與強度、以掃描器量測發射度，與 βγ 標度預測比較；記錄磁場與射頻頻率程式的對應，在平台上微調射頻頻率檢查平均徑向位置是否置中，以此量化磁場—頻率追蹤誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On each plateau measure momentum spread and intensity from the Schottky spectrum and emittance with scanners, comparing with the βγ scaling; log the field and RF-frequency programmes side by side and trim the RF frequency on the plateau to check that the mean radial position is centred, quantifying the field–frequency tracking error. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：射頻頻率程式與實際磁場在低動量端有 10⁻³ 的追蹤誤差時，束流徑向偏到色散大的位置刮到孔徑，或在減速段逐步流失；低場時剩磁與渦電流的相對影響變大，常是 100 MeV/c 平台損失的根源。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 10⁻³ tracking error between the RF programme and the real field at low momentum pushes the beam radially into high-dispersion regions where it scrapes, or bleeds it away during the ramp down; at low field remanence and eddy currents matter relatively more and often cause losses on the 100 MeV/c plateau.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在每個平台以 Schottky 頻譜量測動量分散與強度、以掃描器量測發射度，與 βγ 標度預測比較；記錄磁場與射頻頻率程式的對應，在平台上微調射頻頻率檢查平均徑向位置是否置中，以此量化磁場—頻率追蹤誤差。
knowledge.textEn: On each plateau measure momentum spread and intensity from the Schottky spectrum and emittance with scanners, comparing with the βγ scaling; log the field and RF-frequency programmes side by side and trim the RF frequency on the plateau to check that the mean radial position is centred, quantifying the field–frequency tracking error.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 射頻頻率程式與實際磁場在低動量端有 10⁻³ 的追蹤誤差時，束流徑向偏到色散大的位置刮到孔徑，或在減速段逐步流失；低場時剩磁與渦電流的相對影響變大，常是 100 MeV/c 平台損失的根源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 10⁻³ tracking error between the RF programme and the real field at low momentum pushes the beam radially into high-dispersion regions where it scrapes, or bleeds it away during the ramp down; at low field remanence and eddy currents matter relatively more and often cause losses on the 100 MeV/c plateau. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：射頻系統還必須追蹤速度由 0.97c 降到 0.1c 的大幅頻率變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The RF system must also follow the large frequency swing as speed drops from 0.97c to 0.1c.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「動量為 100 MeV/c 的反質子，它的動能也就是 100 MeV。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An antiproton at 100 MeV/c has 100 MeV of kinetic energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 射頻頻率程式與實際磁場在低動量端有 10⁻³ 的追蹤誤差時，束流徑向偏到色散大的位置刮到孔徑，或在減速段逐步流失；低場時剩磁與渦電流的相對影響變大，常是 100 MeV/c 平台損失的根源。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

隨機冷卻是對每一顆反質子分別做精準修正。

Stochastic cooling corrects each antiproton individually.
A 10⁻³ tracking error between the RF programme and the real field at low momentum pushes the beam radially into high-dispersion regions where it scrapes, or bleeds it away during the ramp down.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間」與「電子冷卻：低能平台的速度匹配」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time" and "Electron cooling: velocity matching on low-energy plateaus": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「隨機冷卻拾取器與踢擊器」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stochastic-cooling pickups and kickers” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在 3.57 與 2 GeV/c 的高動量平台，AD 使用隨機冷卻：拾取電極量測束流某一取樣片段的平均位置或動量偏差，訊號經寬頻放大後沿環的弦線捷徑傳送，在同一批粒子抵達踢擊器時施加修正。每次修正只作用在約 1/(2W) 時間片內粒子的平均值，粒子數越少、頻寬越寬，冷卻越快；這是 van der Meer 為 SppS 對撞機累積反質子所發明的技術。放大器熱雜訊與粒子在拾取器到踢擊器之間混合不足，都會抵消冷卻效果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「隨機冷卻拾取器與踢擊器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On the high-momentum plateaus at 3.57 and 2 GeV/c the AD uses stochastic cooling: a pickup measures the mean position or momentum error of a sample slice of the beam, the signal is amplified over a wide band and sent along a chord across the ring, and a kicker corrects the same particles when they arrive. Each correction acts only on the average of the particles within a time slice of about 1/(2W), so fewer particles and wider bandwidth cool faster; van der Meer invented the technique to accumulate antiprotons for the SppS collider. Amplifier thermal noise and poor mixing between pickup and kicker both erode the cooling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Stochastic-cooling pickups and kickers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：最佳增益下冷卻率 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U))，W 為頻寬、N 為粒子數、M 為混合因子、U 為雜訊對訊號比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At optimum gain the cooling rate is 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U)), with W the bandwidth, N the particle number, M the mixing factor and U the noise-to-signal ratio.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隨機冷卻是對每一顆反質子分別做精準修正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stochastic cooling corrects each antiproton individually." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「隨機冷卻拾取器與踢擊器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Stochastic-cooling pickups and kickers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間
knowledge.titleEn: Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time
knowledge.text: 在 3.57 與 2 GeV/c 的高動量平台，AD 使用隨機冷卻：拾取電極量測束流某一取樣片段的平均位置或動量偏差，訊號經寬頻放大後沿環的弦線捷徑傳送，在同一批粒子抵達踢擊器時施加修正。每次修正只作用在約 1/(2W) 時間片內粒子的平均值，粒子數越少、頻寬越寬，冷卻越快；這是 van der Meer 為 SppS 對撞機累積反質子所發明的技術。
knowledge.textEn: On the high-momentum plateaus at 3.57 and 2 GeV/c the AD uses stochastic cooling: a pickup measures the mean position or momentum error of a sample slice of the beam, the signal is amplified over a wide band and sent along a chord across the ring, and a kicker corrects the same particles when they arrive. Each correction acts only on the average of the particles within a time slice of about 1/(2W), so fewer particles and wider bandwidth cool faster; van der Meer invented the technique to accumulate antiprotons for the SppS collider.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隨機冷卻是對每一顆反質子分別做精準修正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time" is correct?
options: 在 3.57 與 2 GeV/c 的高動量平台，AD 使用隨機冷卻：拾取電極量測束流某一取樣片段的平均位置或動量偏差，訊號經寬頻放大後沿環的弦線捷徑傳送，在同一批粒子抵達踢擊器時施加修正。

電子冷卻在任何能量都優於隨機冷卻，AD 全程都該使用。
optionsEn: On the high-momentum plateaus at 3.57 and 2 GeV/c the AD uses stochastic cooling: a pickup measures the mean position or momentum error of a sample slice of the beam, the signal is amplified over a wide band and sent along a chord across the ring, and a kicker corrects the same particles when they arrive.

quiz.explanationEn: On the high-momentum plateaus at 3.57 and 2 GeV/c the AD uses stochastic cooling: a pickup measures the mean position or momentum error of a sample slice of the beam, the signal is amplified over a wide band and sent along a chord across the ring, and a kicker corrects the same particles when they arrive. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隨機冷卻拾取器與踢擊器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stochastic-cooling pickups and kickers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：最佳增益下冷卻率 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U))，W 為頻寬、N 為粒子數、M 為混合因子、U 為雜訊對訊號比。假設 W = 0.75 GHz、N = 5×10⁷：理想（M + U = 1）τ ≈ 5×10⁷/7.5×10⁸ ≈ 0.067 s；假設 M + U = 50，振幅冷卻 τ ≈ 3.3 s，發射度 e 折時間約 1.7 s；由 200 降到 4 π mm·mrad 需 ln(50) ≈ 3.9 個 e 折，約 6.5 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At optimum gain the cooling rate is 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U)), with W the bandwidth, N the particle number, M the mixing factor and U the noise-to-signal ratio. Assuming W = 0.75 GHz and N = 5×10⁷, the ideal (M + U = 1) gives τ ≈ 5×10⁷/7.5×10⁸ ≈ 0.067 s; assuming M + U = 50, amplitude cooling takes τ ≈ 3.3 s and the emittance e-folding about 1.7 s, so going from 200 to 4 π mm·mrad needs ln(50) ≈ 3.9 e-foldings, about 6.5 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：開迴路量測拾取器到踢擊器的傳遞函數（增益與相位對頻率），確認整個頻帶內相位正確；閉迴路時以 Schottky 頻譜寬度隨時間縮小量測冷卻速率並與模型 τ 比較；改變增益找出冷卻最快點，用以反推 M + U 的實際值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the open-loop pickup-to-kicker transfer function (gain and phase versus frequency) to confirm correct phase across the band; in closed loop measure the cooling rate from the shrinking Schottky width over time and compare with the model τ; vary the gain to find the fastest cooling and infer the actual M + U.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 最佳增益下冷卻率 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U))，W 為頻寬、N 為粒子數、M 為混合因子、U 為雜訊對訊號比。假設 W = 0.75 GHz、N = 5×10⁷：理想（M + U = 1）τ ≈ 5×10⁷/7.5×10⁸ ≈ 0.067 s；假設 M + U = 50，振幅冷卻 τ ≈ 3.3 s，發射度 e 折時間約 1.7 s；由 200 降到 4 π mm·mrad 需 ln(50) ≈ 3.9 個 e 折，約 6.5 s。
knowledge.textEn: At optimum gain the cooling rate is 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U)), with W the bandwidth, N the particle number, M the mixing factor and U the noise-to-signal ratio. Assuming W = 0.75 GHz and N = 5×10⁷, the ideal (M + U = 1) gives τ ≈ 5×10⁷/7.5×10⁸ ≈ 0.067 s; assuming M + U = 50, amplitude cooling takes τ ≈ 3.3 s and the emittance e-folding about 1.7 s, so going from 200 to 4 π mm·mrad needs ln(50) ≈ 3.9 e-foldings, about 6.5 s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

最佳增益下冷卻率 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U))，W 為頻寬、N 為粒子數、M 為混合因子、U 為雜訊對訊號比。
AD 能累積足夠的反物質作為能源或推進燃料。
optionsEn: Antiprotons are lost only by annihilation, so residual-gas scattering does not affect lifetime.
At optimum gain the cooling rate is 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U)), with W the bandwidth, N the particle number, M the mixing factor and U the noise-to-signal ratio.
The AD can accumulate enough antimatter to serve as an energy source or propellant.
quiz.explanation: 最佳增益下冷卻率 1/τ ≈ W/(N(M + U))，W 為頻寬、N 為粒子數、M 為混合因子、U 為雜訊對訊號比。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「隨機冷卻拾取器與踢擊器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Stochastic-cooling pickups and kickers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 開迴路量測拾取器到踢擊器的傳遞函數（增益與相位對頻率），確認整個頻帶內相位正確；閉迴路時以 Schottky 頻譜寬度隨時間縮小量測冷卻速率並與模型 τ 比較；改變增益找出冷卻最快點，用以反推 M + U 的實際值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the open-loop pickup-to-kicker transfer function (gain and phase versus frequency) to confirm correct phase across the band; in closed loop measure the cooling rate from the shrinking Schottky width over time and compare with the model τ; vary the gain to find the fastest cooling and infer the actual M + U. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：延遲線匹配誤差使部分頻帶相位偏移超過 90° 時，該頻帶從冷卻變成加熱，Schottky 頻譜邊緣反而變寬；前級低溫放大器雜訊上升則冷卻時間拉長，循環被迫延長，每小時送出的反質子數下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A delay-matching error that shifts phase by more than 90° in part of the band turns cooling into heating there, and the Schottky spectrum widens at its edges; a rise in front-end cryogenic amplifier noise lengthens cooling, the cycle must be stretched, and antiprotons delivered per hour fall.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 開迴路量測拾取器到踢擊器的傳遞函數（增益與相位對頻率），確認整個頻帶內相位正確；閉迴路時以 Schottky 頻譜寬度隨時間縮小量測冷卻速率並與模型 τ 比較；改變增益找出冷卻最快點，用以反推 M + U 的實際值。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the open-loop pickup-to-kicker transfer function (gain and phase versus frequency) to confirm correct phase across the band; in closed loop measure the cooling rate from the shrinking Schottky width over time and compare with the model τ; vary the gain to find the fastest cooling and infer the actual M + U.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。
開迴路量測拾取器到踢擊器的傳遞函數（增益與相位對頻率），確認整個頻帶內相位正確。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly.
Measure the open-loop pickup-to-kicker transfer function (gain and phase versus frequency) to confirm correct phase across the band.
quiz.explanation: 開迴路量測拾取器到踢擊器的傳遞函數（增益與相位對頻率），確認整個頻帶內相位正確；閉迴路時以 Schottky 頻譜寬度隨時間縮小量測冷卻速率並與模型 τ 比較；改變增益找出冷卻最快點，用以反推 M + U 的實際值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the open-loop pickup-to-kicker transfer function (gain and phase versus frequency) to confirm correct phase across the band; in closed loop measure the cooling rate from the shrinking Schottky width over time and compare with the model τ; vary the gain to find the fastest cooling and infer the actual M + U. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隨機冷卻拾取器與踢擊器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Stochastic-cooling pickups and kickers” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 延遲線匹配誤差使部分頻帶相位偏移超過 90° 時，該頻帶從冷卻變成加熱，Schottky 頻譜邊緣反而變寬；前級低溫放大器雜訊上升則冷卻時間拉長，循環被迫延長，每小時送出的反質子數下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A delay-matching error that shifts phase by more than 90° in part of the band turns cooling into heating there, and the Schottky spectrum widens at its edges; a rise in front-end cryogenic amplifier noise lengthens cooling, the cycle must be stretched, and antiprotons delivered per hour fall. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：放大器熱雜訊與粒子在拾取器到踢擊器之間混合不足，都會抵消冷卻效果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Amplifier thermal noise and poor mixing between pickup and kicker both erode the cooling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隨機冷卻是對每一顆反質子分別做精準修正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stochastic cooling corrects each antiproton individually." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 延遲線匹配誤差使部分頻帶相位偏移超過 90° 時，該頻帶從冷卻變成加熱，Schottky 頻譜邊緣反而變寬；前級低溫放大器雜訊上升則冷卻時間拉長，循環被迫延長，每小時送出的反質子數下降。
knowledge.textEn: A delay-matching error that shifts phase by more than 90° in part of the band turns cooling into heating there, and the Schottky spectrum widens at its edges; a rise in front-end cryogenic amplifier noise lengthens cooling, the cycle must be stretched, and antiprotons delivered per hour fall.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隨機冷卻：頻寬、粒子數與冷卻時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stochastic cooling: bandwidth, particle number and cooling time" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 延遲線匹配誤差使部分頻帶相位偏移超過 90° 時，該頻帶從冷卻變成加熱，Schottky 頻譜邊緣反而變寬。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
電子冷卻在任何能量都優於隨機冷卻，AD 全程都該使用。
optionsEn: A delay-matching error that shifts phase by more than 90° in part of the band turns cooling into heating there, and the Schottky spectrum widens at its edges.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Electron cooling beats stochastic cooling at every energy, so the AD should use it throughout.
quiz.explanation: 延遲線匹配誤差使部分頻帶相位偏移超過 90° 時，該頻帶從冷卻變成加熱，Schottky 頻譜邊緣反而變寬；前級低溫放大器雜訊上升則冷卻時間拉長，循環被迫延長，每小時送出的反質子數下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A delay-matching error that shifts phase by more than 90° in part of the band turns cooling into heating there, and the Schottky spectrum widens at its edges; a rise in front-end cryogenic amplifier noise lengthens cooling, the cycle must be stretched, and antiprotons delivered per hour fall. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 電子冷卻：低能平台的速度匹配：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Electron cooling: velocity matching on low-energy plateaus: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「電子冷卻器電子槍、螺線管與收集極」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Electron-cooler gun, solenoid and collector” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在 300 與 100 MeV/c 的低動量平台改用電子冷卻：在一段直線段內讓一束約數 A、橫向溫度很低的電子與反質子以相同平均速度同行，反質子經庫侖碰撞把多餘的熱運動交給電子，電子束持續更新，並在收集極回收大部分能量。速度匹配要求電子的 γ 與反質子相同，即電子動能 T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec²；導引螺線管把電子約束成磁化的冷電子束。冷卻力在相對速度小時最強，所以電子冷卻擅長把已預冷的束流壓到極小的發射度與動量分散。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子冷卻器電子槍、螺線管與收集極」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: On the low-momentum plateaus at 300 and 100 MeV/c the AD switches to electron cooling: over a straight section an electron beam of a few amperes with very low transverse temperature travels at the same mean velocity as the antiprotons, which hand their excess thermal motion to the electrons through Coulomb collisions; the electron beam is continuously renewed and most of its energy is recovered in a collector. Velocity matching requires the same γ, so the electron kinetic energy is T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec², and a guiding solenoid keeps the electrons as a cold magnetized beam. The cooling force is strongest at small relative velocity, so electron cooling excels at squeezing a pre-cooled beam to tiny emittance and momentum spread. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-cooler gun, solenoid and collector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電子冷卻在任何能量都優於隨機冷卻，AD 全程都該使用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Electron cooling beats stochastic cooling at every energy, so the AD should use it throughout." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「電子冷卻器電子槍、螺線管與收集極」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Electron-cooler gun, solenoid and collector”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電子冷卻：低能平台的速度匹配
knowledge.titleEn: Electron cooling: velocity matching on low-energy plateaus
knowledge.text: 在 300 與 100 MeV/c 的低動量平台改用電子冷卻：在一段直線段內讓一束約數 A、橫向溫度很低的電子與反質子以相同平均速度同行，反質子經庫侖碰撞把多餘的熱運動交給電子，電子束持續更新，並在收集極回收大部分能量。速度匹配要求電子的 γ 與反質子相同，即電子動能 T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec²；導引螺線管把電子約束成磁化的冷電子束。
knowledge.textEn: On the low-momentum plateaus at 300 and 100 MeV/c the AD switches to electron cooling: over a straight section an electron beam of a few amperes with very low transverse temperature travels at the same mean velocity as the antiprotons, which hand their excess thermal motion to the electrons through Coulomb collisions; the electron beam is continuously renewed and most of its energy is recovered in a collector. Velocity matching requires the same γ, so the electron kinetic energy is T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec², and a guiding solenoid keeps the electrons as a cold magnetized beam.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電子冷卻在任何能量都優於隨機冷卻，AD 全程都該使用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Electron cooling beats stochastic cooling at every energy, so the AD should use it throughout. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電子冷卻：低能平台的速度匹配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Electron cooling: velocity matching on low-energy plateaus" is correct?
options: 電子冷卻在任何能量都優於隨機冷卻，AD 全程都該使用。
在 300 與 100 MeV/c 的低動量平台改用電子冷卻：在一段直線段內讓一束約數 A、橫向溫度很低的電子與反質子以相同平均速度同行，反質子經庫侖碰撞把多餘的熱運動交給電子，電子束持續更新，並在收集極回收大部分能量。
一般的直流電流變壓器就能精確量出 AD 的反質子數。
optionsEn: Electron cooling beats stochastic cooling at every energy, so the AD should use it throughout.

On the low-momentum plateaus at 300 and 100 MeV/c the AD switches to electron cooling: over a straight section an electron beam of a few amperes with very low transverse temperature travels at the same mean velocity as the antiprotons, which hand their excess thermal motion to the electrons through Coulomb collisions.
An ordinary DC current transformer can accurately count the AD's antiprotons.
quiz.explanation: 在 300 與 100 MeV/c 的低動量平台改用電子冷卻：在一段直線段內讓一束約數 A、橫向溫度很低的電子與反質子以相同平均速度同行，反質子經庫侖碰撞把多餘的熱運動交給電子，電子束持續更新，並在收集極回收大部分能量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: On the low-momentum plateaus at 300 and 100 MeV/c the AD switches to electron cooling: over a straight section an electron beam of a few amperes with very low transverse temperature travels at the same mean velocity as the antiprotons, which hand their excess thermal motion to the electrons through Coulomb collisions; the electron beam is continuously renewed and most of its energy is recovered in a collector. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電子冷卻：低能平台的速度匹配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electron cooling: velocity matching on low-energy plateaus: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電子冷卻器電子槍、螺線管與收集極」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Electron-cooler gun, solenoid and collector” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV。300 MeV/c 時 γ = 1.0499，T_e ≈ 25.5 keV；100 MeV/c 時 γ = 1.00566，T_e ≈ 2.89 keV。ELENA 的 650 keV 中間平台需 354 eV 電子、100 keV 末端只需 54.5 eV。若在 2 GeV/c 平台使用，T_e 需約 692 keV，高壓與電子槍尺度都不合理，這正是高動量平台改用隨機冷卻的原因。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV. At 300 MeV/c, γ = 1.0499 and T_e ≈ 25.5 keV; at 100 MeV/c, γ = 1.00566 and T_e ≈ 2.89 keV. ELENA's 650 keV intermediate plateau needs 354 eV electrons and its 100 keV end only 54.5 eV. Using it on the 2 GeV/c plateau would require T_e ≈ 692 keV, an impractical high voltage and gun scale, which is why high-momentum plateaus use stochastic cooling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：掃描電子槍高壓，量測反質子 Schottky 頻譜中心被電子拖曳的頻率位移，以拖曳為零的電壓定出速度匹配點，並與 (γ − 1)m_ec² 加上空間電荷電位修正的計算值比較；冷卻後以 Schottky 寬度與發射度量測確認達到 Δp/p ≈ 10⁻⁴ 與次 π mm·mrad 的發射度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan the gun high voltage and measure the drag-induced frequency shift of the antiproton Schottky centre, defining velocity match where the drag vanishes, and compare with (γ − 1)m_ec² plus the space-charge potential correction; after cooling confirm Δp/p ≈ 10⁻⁴ and sub-π mm·mrad emittance from Schottky width and emittance measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV。300 MeV/c 時 γ = 1.0499，T_e ≈ 25.5 keV；100 MeV/c 時 γ = 1.00566，T_e ≈ 2.89 keV。ELENA 的 650 keV 中間平台需 354 eV 電子、100 keV 末端只需 54.5 eV。若在 2 GeV/c 平台使用，T_e 需約 692 keV，高壓與電子槍尺度都不合理，這正是高動量平台改用隨機冷卻的原因。
knowledge.textEn: T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV. At 300 MeV/c, γ = 1.0499 and T_e ≈ 25.5 keV; at 100 MeV/c, γ = 1.00566 and T_e ≈ 2.89 keV. ELENA's 650 keV intermediate plateau needs 354 eV electrons and its 100 keV end only 54.5 eV. Using it on the 2 GeV/c plateau would require T_e ≈ 692 keV, an impractical high voltage and gun scale, which is why high-momentum plateaus use stochastic cooling.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電子冷卻：低能平台的速度匹配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Electron cooling: velocity matching on low-energy plateaus", which statement holds?
options: ELENA 只是再降低能量，並不會增加實驗可用的反質子數。
反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。
optionsEn: ELENA merely lowers the energy further and does not increase usable antiprotons.
Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly.
quiz.explanation: T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: T_e = (γ − 1)×511 keV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電子冷卻：低能平台的速度匹配：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electron cooling: velocity matching on low-energy plateaus: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電子冷卻器電子槍、螺線管與收集極」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Electron-cooler gun, solenoid and collector” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 掃描電子槍高壓，量測反質子 Schottky 頻譜中心被電子拖曳的頻率位移，以拖曳為零的電壓定出速度匹配點，並與 (γ − 1)m_ec² 加上空間電荷電位修正的計算值比較；冷卻後以 Schottky 寬度與發射度量測確認達到 Δp/p ≈ 10⁻⁴ 與次 π mm·mrad 的發射度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan the gun high voltage and measure the drag-induced frequency shift of the antiproton Schottky centre, defining velocity match where the drag vanishes, and compare with (γ − 1)m_ec² plus the space-charge potential correction; after cooling confirm Δp/p ≈ 10⁻⁴ and sub-π mm·mrad emittance from Schottky width and emittance measurements. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：電子束與反質子軌道之間有 1 mrad 夾角或螺線管場不直，等效相對速度大增，冷卻時間拉長數倍；收集極回收效率下降時真空壓力上升，又反過來增加反質子的殘氣散射損失。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 1 mrad angle between electron and antiproton trajectories, or a crooked solenoid field, greatly increases the effective relative velocity and lengthens cooling several-fold; a drop in collector efficiency raises the vacuum pressure, which in turn increases residual-gas scattering losses of the antiprotons.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 電子冷卻：低能平台的速度匹配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Electron cooling: velocity matching on low-energy plateaus: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電子冷卻器電子槍、螺線管與收集極」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Electron-cooler gun, solenoid and collector” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 電子束與反質子軌道之間有 1 mrad 夾角或螺線管場不直，等效相對速度大增，冷卻時間拉長數倍；收集極回收效率下降時真空壓力上升，又反過來增加反質子的殘氣散射損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 1 mrad angle between electron and antiproton trajectories, or a crooked solenoid field, greatly increases the effective relative velocity and lengthens cooling several-fold; a drop in collector efficiency raises the vacuum pressure, which in turn increases residual-gas scattering losses of the antiprotons. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：冷卻力在相對速度小時最強，所以電子冷卻擅長把已預冷的束流壓到極小的發射度與動量分散。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電子冷卻在任何能量都優於隨機冷卻，AD 全程都該使用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Electron cooling beats stochastic cooling at every energy, so the AD should use it throughout." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring intensity and momentum spread of a microampere beam" and "Residual-gas scattering, vacuum budget and beam lifetime": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 微安培束流的強度與動量分散量測：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measuring intensity and momentum spread of a microampere beam: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Schottky 拾取器與低強度診斷」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Schottky pickups and low-intensity diagnostics” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: AD 每循環只有 10⁷ 量級的反質子，平均電流低於一般直流電流變壓器的有效解析度，因此強度與動量分散主要靠縱向 Schottky 訊號量測：粒子隨機分佈在環上，在每個迴轉諧波 n·f₀ 附近產生雜訊帶，帶的功率正比於粒子數，寬度正比於動量分散。由頻寬換算 Δp/p 需要滑相因子 η，而 η 取決於晶格的動量壓縮因子，必須以獨立量測校正，否則所有冷卻效果的評估都帶有系統誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Schottky 拾取器與低強度診斷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With only about 10⁷ antiprotons per cycle, the AD's mean current is below the useful resolution of ordinary DC current transformers, so intensity and momentum spread are measured mainly from longitudinal Schottky signals: particles randomly distributed around the ring create noise bands near each revolution harmonic n·f₀, whose power is proportional to particle number and whose width is proportional to momentum spread. Converting width to Δp/p needs the slip factor η, which depends on the lattice momentum compaction and must be calibrated independently, or every assessment of cooling carries a systematic error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Schottky pickups and low-intensity diagnostics”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平均電流等於粒子數乘電荷乘迴轉頻率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mean current is particle number times charge times revolution frequency.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一般的直流電流變壓器就能精確量出 AD 的反質子數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An ordinary DC current transformer can accurately count the AD's antiprotons." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Schottky 拾取器與低強度診斷」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Schottky pickups and low-intensity diagnostics”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 微安培束流的強度與動量分散量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring intensity and momentum spread of a microampere beam: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Schottky 拾取器與低強度診斷」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Schottky pickups and low-intensity diagnostics” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平均電流等於粒子數乘電荷乘迴轉頻率。3×10⁷ 顆在 100 MeV/c（f₀ = 0.174 MHz）：I = N·e·f₀ = 3×10⁷×1.602×10⁻¹⁹×1.742×10⁵ ≈ 0.84 µA；在 3.57 GeV/c（f₀ = 1.59 MHz）約 7.6 µA。Schottky 帶寬 Δf = n·f₀·|η|·Δp/p，假設 |η| ≈ 0.95、n = 10、Δp/p = 1×10⁻⁴：Δf ≈ 10×174 200×0.95×10⁻⁴ ≈ 165 Hz，頻譜分析儀可清楚解析。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mean current is particle number times charge times revolution frequency. For 3×10⁷ particles at 100 MeV/c (f₀ = 0.174 MHz), I = N·e·f₀ = 3×10⁷×1.602×10⁻¹⁹×1.742×10⁵ ≈ 0.84 µA; at 3.57 GeV/c (f₀ = 1.59 MHz) it is about 7.6 µA. The Schottky band width is Δf = n·f₀·|η|·Δp/p; assuming |η| ≈ 0.95, n = 10 and Δp/p = 1×10⁻⁴, Δf ≈ 10×174 200×0.95×10⁻⁴ ≈ 165 Hz, easily resolved by a spectrum analyser. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知強度的質子或 H⁻ 校正束在相同設定下比對 Schottky 功率與電流變壓器讀值，建立每粒子功率刻度；改變射頻頻率量測平均軌道位移求動量壓縮因子並計算 η；在多個諧波 n 量測同一束流，確認 Δf 與 n 成正比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-calibrate Schottky power against transformer readings with a proton or H⁻ calibration beam of known intensity under the same settings to establish power per particle; measure momentum compaction from orbit shifts under RF-frequency steps and compute η; measure the same beam at several harmonics n to confirm that Δf scales with n.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 微安培束流的強度與動量分散量測：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring intensity and momentum spread of a microampere beam: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Schottky 拾取器與低強度診斷」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Schottky pickups and low-intensity diagnostics” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知強度的質子或 H⁻ 校正束在相同設定下比對 Schottky 功率與電流變壓器讀值，建立每粒子功率刻度；改變射頻頻率量測平均軌道位移求動量壓縮因子並計算 η；在多個諧波 n 量測同一束流，確認 Δf 與 n 成正比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-calibrate Schottky power against transformer readings with a proton or H⁻ calibration beam of known intensity under the same settings to establish power per particle; measure momentum compaction from orbit shifts under RF-frequency steps and compute η; measure the same beam at several harmonics n to confirm that Δf scales with n. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Schottky pickups and low-intensity diagnostics” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 前置放大器增益隨溫度漂移 1 dB 而未重新校正時，Schottky 推算的強度誤差約 26%，實驗端收到的數量與報告不符；諧波選得太高使相鄰雜訊帶重疊，寬度量測失真，冷卻效果被誤判。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Converting width to Δp/p needs the slip factor η, which depends on the lattice momentum compaction and must be calibrated independently, or every assessment of cooling carries a systematic error.

steps.title: 殘氣散射、真空預算與束流壽命：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Residual-gas scattering, vacuum budget and beam lifetime: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「NEG 鍍膜與極高真空」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “NEG coating and extreme-high vacuum” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反質子速度越低，與殘氣分子的散射截面越大，停留在平台上的時間也越長，因此真空要求隨能量下降而急遽提高。AD 平均真空約 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr，ELENA 則要求約 3×10⁻¹² Torr 的極高真空：真空室以低導磁率不鏽鋼（如 316LN）製作並可烘烤至 300 °C，廣泛採用 NEG（非蒸散型吸氣劑）鍍膜提供分布式抽氣，每台偶極與每段直線段配置 NEG 與離子泵組合，並使用全金屬閥門與 ConFlat 接頭。此壓力下殘氣以氫為主，損失與發射度增長主要來自單次散射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NEG 鍍膜與極高真空」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The slower the antiproton, the larger its scattering cross-section on residual gas and the longer it sits on a plateau, so vacuum requirements tighten sharply as energy falls. The AD averages about 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr, while ELENA needs extreme-high vacuum near 3×10⁻¹² Torr: chambers of low-permeability stainless steel such as 316LN bakeable to 300 °C, extensive NEG (non-evaporable getter) coating for distributed pumping, combined NEG and ion pumps at every dipole and straight section, and all-metal valves with ConFlat joints. At this pressure the residual gas is mostly hydrogen and losses and emittance growth come mainly from single scattering events. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “NEG coating and extreme-high vacuum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：壽命 τ = 1/(n·σ·v)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lifetime is τ = 1/(n·σ·v).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反質子只會與物質湮滅，殘氣散射對壽命沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Antiprotons are lost only by annihilation, so residual-gas scattering does not affect lifetime." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「NEG 鍍膜與極高真空」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “NEG coating and extreme-high vacuum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The AD averages about 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr, while ELENA needs extreme-high vacuum near 3×10⁻¹² Torr: chambers of low-permeability stainless steel such as 316LN bakeable to 300 °C, extensive NEG (non-evaporable getter) coating for distributed pumping, combined NEG and ion pumps at every dipole and straight section, and all-metal valves with ConFlat joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反質子只會與物質湮滅，殘氣散射對壽命沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Antiprotons are lost only by annihilation, so residual-gas scattering does not affect lifetime. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「殘氣散射、真空預算與束流壽命」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Residual-gas scattering, vacuum budget and beam lifetime" is correct?
options: 反質子速度越低，與殘氣分子的散射截面越大，停留在平台上的時間也越長，因此真空要求隨能量下降而急遽提高。
反質子只會與物質湮滅，殘氣散射對壽命沒有影響。
ELENA 只是再降低能量，並不會增加實驗可用的反質子數。
optionsEn: The slower the antiproton, the larger its scattering cross-section on residual gas and the longer it sits on a plateau, so vacuum requirements tighten sharply as energy falls.
Antiprotons are lost only by annihilation, so residual-gas scattering does not affect lifetime.
ELENA merely lowers the energy further and does not increase usable antiprotons.
quiz.explanation: 反質子速度越低，與殘氣分子的散射截面越大，停留在平台上的時間也越長，因此真空要求隨能量下降而急遽提高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The slower the antiproton, the larger its scattering cross-section on residual gas and the longer it sits on a plateau, so vacuum requirements tighten sharply as energy falls. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 殘氣散射、真空預算與束流壽命：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Residual-gas scattering, vacuum budget and beam lifetime: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「NEG 鍍膜與極高真空」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “NEG coating and extreme-high vacuum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：壽命 τ = 1/(n·σ·v)。100 keV 反質子 v = 0.0146c ≈ 4.4×10⁶ m/s；假設等效損失截面 σ = 1×10⁻²⁰ m²（教學假設）。3×10⁻¹² Torr 時 n = 9.7×10¹⁰ m⁻³：τ ≈ 1/(9.7×10¹⁰×10⁻²⁰×4.4×10⁶) ≈ 240 s；若只有 AD 的 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr（n = 1.3×10¹³ m⁻³），τ 只剩約 1.8 s，比冷卻平台還短。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Lifetime is τ = 1/(n·σ·v). A 100 keV antiproton moves at v = 0.0146c ≈ 4.4×10⁶ m/s; assume an effective loss cross-section σ = 1×10⁻²⁰ m² (teaching assumption). At 3×10⁻¹² Torr, n = 9.7×10¹⁰ m⁻³ and τ ≈ 1/(9.7×10¹⁰×10⁻²⁰×4.4×10⁶) ≈ 240 s; at the AD's 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr (n = 1.3×10¹³ m⁻³) τ shrinks to about 1.8 s, shorter than a cooling plateau. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：烘烤與 NEG 活化後以殘氣分析儀量各氣體分壓，用極高真空規量總壓並與分布式抽氣計算比較；有束流時量測平台上反質子數隨時間的衰減求 τ，並與局部壓力讀值關聯；長期追蹤 NEG 飽和造成的壓力上升，訂定再活化週期。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After bake-out and NEG activation measure partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and total pressure with extreme-high-vacuum gauges, comparing with the distributed-pumping calculation; with beam, fit the decay of antiproton number on a plateau to obtain τ and correlate it with local pressure readings; track the long-term pressure rise from NEG saturation to set the reactivation interval.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 壽命 τ = 1/(n·σ·v)。100 keV 反質子 v = 0.0146c ≈ 4.4×10⁶ m/s；假設等效損失截面 σ = 1×10⁻²⁰ m²（教學假設）。3×10⁻¹² Torr 時 n = 9.7×10¹⁰ m⁻³：τ ≈ 1/(9.7×10¹⁰×10⁻²⁰×4.4×10⁶) ≈ 240 s；若只有 AD 的 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr（n = 1.3×10¹³ m⁻³），τ 只剩約 1.8 s，比冷卻平台還短。
knowledge.textEn: Lifetime is τ = 1/(n·σ·v). A 100 keV antiproton moves at v = 0.0146c ≈ 4.4×10⁶ m/s; assume an effective loss cross-section σ = 1×10⁻²⁰ m² (teaching assumption). At 3×10⁻¹² Torr, n = 9.7×10¹⁰ m⁻³ and τ ≈ 1/(9.7×10¹⁰×10⁻²⁰×4.4×10⁶) ≈ 240 s; at the AD's 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr (n = 1.3×10¹³ m⁻³) τ shrinks to about 1.8 s, shorter than a cooling plateau.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「殘氣散射、真空預算與束流壽命」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Residual-gas scattering, vacuum budget and beam lifetime", which statement holds?
options: 反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。
壽命 τ = 1/(n·σ·v)。
隨機冷卻是對每一顆反質子分別做精準修正。
optionsEn: Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly.
Lifetime is τ = 1/(n·σ·v).
Stochastic cooling corrects each antiproton individually.
quiz.explanation: 壽命 τ = 1/(n·σ·v)。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 殘氣散射、真空預算與束流壽命：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual-gas scattering, vacuum budget and beam lifetime: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「NEG 鍍膜與極高真空」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “NEG coating and extreme-high vacuum” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 烘烤與 NEG 活化後以殘氣分析儀量各氣體分壓，用極高真空規量總壓並與分布式抽氣計算比較；有束流時量測平台上反質子數隨時間的衰減求 τ，並與局部壓力讀值關聯；長期追蹤 NEG 飽和造成的壓力上升，訂定再活化週期。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After bake-out and NEG activation measure partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and total pressure with extreme-high-vacuum gauges, comparing with the distributed-pumping calculation; with beam, fit the decay of antiproton number on a plateau to obtain τ and correlate it with local pressure readings; track the long-term pressure rise from NEG saturation to set the reactivation interval. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某段真空室微漏或烘烤不完全，局部壓力升到 10⁻¹⁰ Torr 級，100 keV 平台壽命從數分鐘降到數秒，ELENA 送出的反質子數大減；NEG 反覆暴露大氣而失效時壓力緩慢上升，問題常被誤認為冷卻器或注入故障。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A small leak or incomplete bake-out lets local pressure reach the 10⁻¹⁰ Torr range, the 100 keV plateau lifetime falls from minutes to seconds and ELENA's output collapses; NEG degraded by repeated venting raises pressure slowly, and the problem is often misdiagnosed as a cooler or injection fault.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 烘烤與 NEG 活化後以殘氣分析儀量各氣體分壓，用極高真空規量總壓並與分布式抽氣計算比較；有束流時量測平台上反質子數隨時間的衰減求 τ，並與局部壓力讀值關聯；長期追蹤 NEG 飽和造成的壓力上升，訂定再活化週期。
knowledge.textEn: After bake-out and NEG activation measure partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and total pressure with extreme-high-vacuum gauges, comparing with the distributed-pumping calculation; with beam, fit the decay of antiproton number on a plateau to obtain τ and correlate it with local pressure readings; track the long-term pressure rise from NEG saturation to set the reactivation interval.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「殘氣散射、真空預算與束流壽命」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Electron cooling beats stochastic cooling at every energy, so the AD should use it throughout.
After bake-out and NEG activation measure partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and total pressure with extreme-high-vacuum gauges, comparing with the distributed-pumping calculation.

quiz.explanationEn: After bake-out and NEG activation measure partial pressures with a residual-gas analyser and total pressure with extreme-high-vacuum gauges, comparing with the distributed-pumping calculation; with beam, fit the decay of antiproton number on a plateau to obtain τ and correlate it with local pressure readings; track the long-term pressure rise from NEG saturation to set the reactivation interval. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 殘氣散射、真空預算與束流壽命：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「NEG 鍍膜與極高真空」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “NEG coating and extreme-high vacuum” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某段真空室微漏或烘烤不完全，局部壓力升到 10⁻¹⁰ Torr 級，100 keV 平台壽命從數分鐘降到數秒，ELENA 送出的反質子數大減；NEG 反覆暴露大氣而失效時壓力緩慢上升，問題常被誤認為冷卻器或注入故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A small leak or incomplete bake-out lets local pressure reach the 10⁻¹⁰ Torr range, the 100 keV plateau lifetime falls from minutes to seconds and ELENA's output collapses; NEG degraded by repeated venting raises pressure slowly, and the problem is often misdiagnosed as a cooler or injection fault. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此壓力下殘氣以氫為主，損失與發射度增長主要來自單次散射。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At this pressure the residual gas is mostly hydrogen and losses and emittance growth come mainly from single scattering events.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反質子只會與物質湮滅，殘氣散射對壽命沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Antiprotons are lost only by annihilation, so residual-gas scattering does not affect lifetime." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「殘氣散射、真空預算與束流壽命」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Residual-gas scattering, vacuum budget and beam lifetime" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 某段真空室微漏或烘烤不完全，局部壓力升到 10⁻¹⁰ Torr 級，100 keV 平台壽命從數分鐘降到數秒，ELENA 送出的反質子數大減。

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束」與「效率鏈、循環時間與實驗交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments" and "Efficiency chain, cycle time and experiment handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ELENA 環與靜電傳輸線」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ELENA ring and electrostatic transfer lines” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 過去 AD 直接把 5.3 MeV 反質子送給實驗，實驗再以降能箔片把能量降到可捕捉的 keV 等級，絕大多數反質子在箔片中湮滅或散開。ELENA 是周長 30.4 m 的小型減速環，把動量由 100 MeV/c 降到 13.7 MeV/c（動能 5.3 MeV 到 100 keV），在中間平台與末端以電子冷卻縮小束流，再分成 4 個束團經靜電傳輸線送到不同實驗區；在 100 keV 時靜電偏轉元件輕巧且沒有磁滯。結果使可捕捉的反質子數增加 10 到 100 倍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ELENA 環與靜電傳輸線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The AD used to deliver 5.3 MeV antiprotons directly and experiments slowed them to trappable keV energies with degrader foils, where most annihilated or scattered away. ELENA is a 30.4 m decelerator ring that lowers momentum from 100 MeV/c to 13.7 MeV/c (5.3 MeV to 100 keV kinetic energy), electron-cools the beam on an intermediate plateau and at the end, and splits it into 4 bunches sent through electrostatic transfer lines to different experimental zones; at 100 keV electrostatic deflectors are compact and free of hysteresis. The result is 10 to 100 times more trappable antiprotons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ELENA ring and electrostatic transfer lines”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：100 keV 反質子 Bρ = 3.3356×0.0137 ≈ 0.0457 T·m，半徑 1 m 磁偏轉只需 0.046 T；靜電偏轉電場 E = 2T/(q·r) = 2×100 kV/1 m = 200 kV/m，與粒子質量無關，故以 100 keV H⁻ 調好的靜電線，相同設定即可用於反質子。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 100 keV antiproton has Bρ = 3.3356×0.0137 ≈ 0.0457 T·m, so a 1 m bending radius needs only 0.046 T; electrostatic bending needs E = 2T/(q·r) = 2×100 kV/1 m = 200 kV/m, independent of mass, so an electrostatic line tuned with 100 keV H⁻ works for antiprotons at the same settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「ELENA 只是再降低能量，並不會增加實驗可用的反質子數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "ELENA merely lowers the energy further and does not increase usable antiprotons." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「ELENA 環與靜電傳輸線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “ELENA ring and electrostatic transfer lines”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束
knowledge.titleEn: ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments
knowledge.text: 過去 AD 直接把 5.3 MeV 反質子送給實驗，實驗再以降能箔片把能量降到可捕捉的 keV 等級，絕大多數反質子在箔片中湮滅或散開。ELENA 是周長 30.4 m 的小型減速環，把動量由 100 MeV/c 降到 13.7 MeV/c（動能 5.3 MeV 到 100 keV），在中間平台與末端以電子冷卻縮小束流，再分成 4 個束團經靜電傳輸線送到不同實驗區；在 100 keV 時靜電偏轉元件輕巧且沒有磁滯。

ELENA is a 30.4 m decelerator ring that lowers momentum from 100 MeV/c to 13.7 MeV/c (5.3 MeV to 100 keV kinetic energy), electron-cools the beam on an intermediate plateau and at the end, and splits it into 4 bunches sent through electrostatic transfer lines to different experimental zones; at 100 keV electrostatic deflectors are compact and free of hysteresis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.question: 關於「ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments" is correct?

AD 能累積足夠的反物質作為能源或推進燃料。

steps.title: ELENA 減速到 100 keV 與實驗端送束：定量估算
steps.titleEn: ELENA deceleration to 100 keV and delivery to experiments: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ELENA 環與靜電傳輸線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “ELENA ring and electrostatic transfer lines” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：100 keV 反質子 Bρ = 3.3356×0.0137 ≈ 0.0457 T·m，半徑 1 m 磁偏轉只需 0.046 T；靜電偏轉電場 E = 2T/(q·r) = 2×100 kV/1 m = 200 kV/m，與粒子質量無關，故以 100 keV H⁻ 調好的靜電線，相同設定即可用於反質子。ELENA 每循環注入 3.0×10⁷、送出 1.8×10⁷（60%），4 束團各約 4.5×10⁶ 顆，引出發射度約 4 π mm·mrad、Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 100 keV antiproton has Bρ = 3.3356×0.0137 ≈ 0.0457 T·m, so a 1 m bending radius needs only 0.046 T; electrostatic bending needs E = 2T/(q·r) = 2×100 kV/1 m = 200 kV/m, independent of mass, so an electrostatic line tuned with 100 keV H⁻ works for antiprotons at the same settings. ELENA takes 3.0×10⁷ per cycle and delivers 1.8×10⁷ (60%), about 4.5×10⁶ in each of 4 bunches, with extracted emittance near 4 π mm·mrad and Δp/p ≈ 2.5×10⁻³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試運轉時以外部 100 keV H⁻／質子源平行於 AD 運轉調整 ELENA 與傳輸線；在每條線末端量測束團長度、發射度與每束團數量，並與實驗阱中實際捕獲數比較，求出從 ELENA 引出到阱內的傳輸效率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During commissioning tune ELENA and its lines with an external 100 keV H⁻/proton source in parallel with AD operation; at the end of each line measure bunch length, emittance and particles per bunch, and compare with the number actually captured in the experiment's trap to obtain the transfer efficiency from ELENA extraction to trap.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
