永磁彎轉磁鐵不用電，所以它的場強永遠不會變。
真空腔越小，體積越小，所以越容易抽到好真空。
optionsEn: Each 27 m cell carries 31 magnets: small-bore quadrupoles with gradients of order 90 T/m, permanent-magnet longitudinal-gradient dipoles that draw no power, and combined-function magnets that bend and focus at once.
Permanent-magnet bends draw no power, so their field never changes.
A smaller chamber is easier to pump because its volume is smaller.
quiz.explanation: 每個 27 m 單元有 31 個磁鐵：小孔徑、梯度達 90 T/m 等級的四極磁鐵，不耗電的永磁縱向梯度彎轉磁鐵，以及同時彎轉與聚焦的組合功能磁鐵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each 27 m cell carries 31 magnets: small-bore quadrupoles with gradients of order 90 T/m, permanent-magnet longitudinal-gradient dipoles that draw no power, and combined-function magnets that bend and focus at once. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 磁鐵設計、梯度與對準公差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnet design, gradient and alignment tolerances: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高梯度四極磁鐵與永磁彎轉」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-gradient quadrupoles and permanent-magnet bends” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：聚焦強度 k = 0.2998·G/E = 0.2998×90/6 ≈ 4.5 m⁻²，長 0.3 m 的四極焦距 f = 1/(kL) ≈ 0.74 m。四極偏移 Δ = 50 µm 產生踢角 θ = kLΔ = 1.35×5×10⁻⁵ ≈ 67 µrad；閉軌畸變 Δx ≈ θ√(β_q β)/(2|sin πν|)，取 β_q = β = 5 m、分數調諧 0.17（教學假設）得 Δx ≈ 67 µrad×5 m/(2×0.51) ≈ 0.33 mm，遠大於束流尺寸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Focusing strength k = 0.2998·G/E = 0.2998×90/6 ≈ 4.5 m⁻², so a 0.3 m quadrupole has focal length f = 1/(kL) ≈ 0.74 m. An offset Δ = 50 µm gives a kick θ = kLΔ = 1.35×5×10⁻⁵ ≈ 67 µrad; the closed-orbit distortion Δx ≈ θ√(β_q β)/(2|sin πν|) with β_q = β = 5 m and fractional tune 0.17 (teaching assumptions) is Δx ≈ 67 µrad×5 m/(2×0.51) ≈ 0.33 mm, far larger than the beam. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以旋轉線圈或拉線量測台量每顆磁鐵的梯度與諧波（高階項相對主場低於 10⁻⁴），用雷射追蹤儀把磁鐵中心標定到樑架基準；裝機後做束流對準（BBA）：改變單顆四極強度看軌道變化，找出束流穿過磁心的位置，再比較軌道響應矩陣與模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each magnet's gradient and harmonics on a rotating-coil or stretched-wire bench (higher multipoles below 10⁻⁴ of the main field), fiducialise magnet centres to girder references with a laser tracker; after installation run beam-based alignment by varying one quadrupole and watching the orbit to find where the beam passes its centre, then compare the orbit response matrix with the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 聚焦強度 k = 0.2998·G/E = 0.2998×90/6 ≈ 4.5 m⁻²，長 0.3 m 的四極焦距 f = 1/(kL) ≈ 0.74 m。四極偏移 Δ = 50 µm 產生踢角 θ = kLΔ = 1.35×5×10⁻⁵ ≈ 67 µrad；閉軌畸變 Δx ≈ θ√(β_q β)/(2|sin πν|)，取 β_q = β = 5 m、分數調諧 0.17（教學假設）得 Δx ≈ 67 µrad×5 m/(2×0.51) ≈ 0.33 mm，遠大於束流尺寸。
knowledge.textEn: Focusing strength k = 0.2998·G/E = 0.2998×90/6 ≈ 4.5 m⁻², so a 0.3 m quadrupole has focal length f = 1/(kL) ≈ 0.74 m. An offset Δ = 50 µm gives a kick θ = kLΔ = 1.35×5×10⁻⁵ ≈ 67 µrad; the closed-orbit distortion Δx ≈ θ√(β_q β)/(2|sin πν|) with β_q = β = 5 m and fractional tune 0.17 (teaching assumptions) is Δx ≈ 67 µrad×5 m/(2×0.51) ≈ 0.33 mm, far larger than the beam.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「磁鐵設計、梯度與對準公差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Magnet design, gradient and alignment tolerances", which statement holds?
options: 亮度就是通量，光子數越多亮度一定越高。
儲存環能存到 200 mA 就代表驗收完成。
optionsEn: Brilliance is just flux; more photons always means more brilliance.
Focusing strength k = 0.2998·G/E = 0.2998×90/6 ≈ 4.5 m⁻², so a 0.3 m quadrupole has focal length f = 1/(kL) ≈ 0.74 m.
Storing 200 mA means the ring is accepted.
quiz.explanation: 聚焦強度 k = 0.2998·G/E = 0.2998×90/6 ≈ 4.5 m⁻²，長 0.3 m 的四極焦距 f = 1/(kL) ≈ 0.74 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Focusing strength k = 0.2998·G/E = 0.2998×90/6 ≈ 4.5 m⁻², so a 0.3 m quadrupole has focal length f = 1/(kL) ≈ 0.74 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 磁鐵設計、梯度與對準公差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnet design, gradient and alignment tolerances: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「高梯度四極磁鐵與永磁彎轉」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “High-gradient quadrupoles and permanent-magnet bends” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以旋轉線圈或拉線量測台量每顆磁鐵的梯度與諧波（高階項相對主場低於 10⁻⁴），用雷射追蹤儀把磁鐵中心標定到樑架基準；裝機後做束流對準（BBA）：改變單顆四極強度看軌道變化，找出束流穿過磁心的位置，再比較軌道響應矩陣與模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each magnet's gradient and harmonics on a rotating-coil or stretched-wire bench (higher multipoles below 10⁻⁴ of the main field), fiducialise magnet centres to girder references with a laser tracker; after installation run beam-based alignment by varying one quadrupole and watching the orbit to find where the beam passes its centre, then compare the orbit response matrix with the model. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：永磁彎轉磁鐵的 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，隧道溫度漂移 1 K 就改變 0.1% 的彎轉場，束流能量與軌道跟著漂移；若沒有溫度補償分流或低溫係數材料，軌道回授會把這個錯誤推給校正磁鐵。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: NdFeB remanence in permanent-magnet bends changes by about −0.1 %/K, so a 1 K tunnel drift changes the bending field by 0.1% and shifts beam energy and orbit; without temperature-compensating shunts or low-coefficient material the orbit feedback simply pushes that error into the correctors.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以旋轉線圈或拉線量測台量每顆磁鐵的梯度與諧波（高階項相對主場低於 10⁻⁴），用雷射追蹤儀把磁鐵中心標定到樑架基準；裝機後做束流對準（BBA）：改變單顆四極強度看軌道變化，找出束流穿過磁心的位置，再比較軌道響應矩陣與模型。
knowledge.textEn: Measure each magnet's gradient and harmonics on a rotating-coil or stretched-wire bench (higher multipoles below 10⁻⁴ of the main field), fiducialise magnet centres to girder references with a laser tracker; after installation run beam-based alignment by varying one quadrupole and watching the orbit to find where the beam passes its centre, then compare the orbit response matrix with the model.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磁鐵設計、梯度與對準公差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Magnet design, gradient and alignment tolerances"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
提高電子能量只是讓光更亮，不會改變光譜形狀。
以旋轉線圈或拉線量測台量每顆磁鐵的梯度與諧波（高階項相對主場低於 10⁻⁴），用雷射追蹤儀把磁鐵中心標定到樑架基準。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Raising electron energy only makes the light brighter; it does not change the spectrum.

Measure each magnet's gradient and harmonics on a rotating-coil or stretched-wire bench (higher multipoles below 10⁻⁴ of the main field), fiducialise magnet centres to girder references with a laser tracker.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure each magnet's gradient and harmonics on a rotating-coil or stretched-wire bench (higher multipoles below 10⁻⁴ of the main field), fiducialise magnet centres to girder references with a laser tracker; after installation run beam-based alignment by varying one quadrupole and watching the orbit to find where the beam passes its centre, then compare the orbit response matrix with the model. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 磁鐵設計、梯度與對準公差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Magnet design, gradient and alignment tolerances: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高梯度四極磁鐵與永磁彎轉」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “High-gradient quadrupoles and permanent-magnet bends” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 永磁彎轉磁鐵的 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，隧道溫度漂移 1 K 就改變 0.1% 的彎轉場，束流能量與軌道跟著漂移；若沒有溫度補償分流或低溫係數材料，軌道回授會把這個錯誤推給校正磁鐵。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: NdFeB remanence in permanent-magnet bends changes by about −0.1 %/K, so a 1 K tunnel drift changes the bending field by 0.1% and shifts beam energy and orbit; without temperature-compensating shunts or low-coefficient material the orbit feedback simply pushes that error into the correctors. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：強聚焦意味著四極磁鐵的橫向位移會給束流一個踢角，並在全環被放大成閉軌畸變；因此磁鐵先在樑架上以 50 µm 等級互相對準，再以束流為基準微調。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Strong focusing means a transverse offset of a quadrupole kicks the beam, and the kick is amplified around the ring into closed-orbit distortion; magnets are therefore aligned to each other on girders at the 50 µm level and then trimmed with beam-based alignment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「永磁彎轉磁鐵不用電，所以它的場強永遠不會變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Permanent-magnet bends draw no power, so their field never changes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 永磁彎轉磁鐵的 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，隧道溫度漂移 1 K 就改變 0.1% 的彎轉場，束流能量與軌道跟著漂移；若沒有溫度補償分流或低溫係數材料，軌道回授會把這個錯誤推給校正磁鐵。
knowledge.textEn: NdFeB remanence in permanent-magnet bends changes by about −0.1 %/K, so a 1 K tunnel drift changes the bending field by 0.1% and shifts beam energy and orbit; without temperature-compensating shunts or low-coefficient material the orbit feedback simply pushes that error into the correctors.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磁鐵設計、梯度與對準公差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Magnet design, gradient and alignment tolerances" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 永磁彎轉磁鐵的 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，隧道溫度漂移 1 K 就改變 0.1% 的彎轉場，束流能量與軌道跟著漂移。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
真空腔越小，體積越小，所以越容易抽到好真空。
optionsEn: NdFeB remanence in permanent-magnet bends changes by about −0.1 %/K, so a 1 K tunnel drift changes the bending field by 0.1% and shifts beam energy and orbit.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A smaller chamber is easier to pump because its volume is smaller.
quiz.explanation: 永磁彎轉磁鐵的 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，隧道溫度漂移 1 K 就改變 0.1% 的彎轉場，束流能量與軌道跟著漂移；若沒有溫度補償分流或低溫係數材料，軌道回授會把這個錯誤推給校正磁鐵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: NdFeB remanence in permanent-magnet bends changes by about −0.1 %/K, so a 1 K tunnel drift changes the bending field by 0.1% and shifts beam energy and orbit; without temperature-compensating shunts or low-coefficient material the orbit feedback simply pushes that error into the correctors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 小口徑真空腔、分布抽氣與阻抗：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Small-aperture chambers, distributed pumping and impedance: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「NEG 鍍膜真空腔（每單元 14 段）」如何決定歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “NEG-coated vacuum chambers (14 per cell)” determines the key performance of “European Synchrotron Radiation Facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 緊湊的強磁鐵迫使真空腔內徑縮到 20 mm 等級。分子流狀態下細長管的導流量正比於 d³/L，集中式幫浦抽不到腔體中段，所以 EBS 腔體內壁鍍 TiZrV 非蒸發吸氣劑（NEG），把整段腔壁變成分布式幫浦並降低光致脫附。小孔徑同時提高電阻壁阻抗（正比於 1/b³），因此腔體用高導電材料並把所有截面變化做成平滑的射頻過渡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NEG 鍍膜真空腔（每單元 14 段）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compact strong magnets force the chamber bore down to the 20 mm class. In molecular flow the conductance of a long tube scales as d³/L, so lumped pumps cannot reach the middle of a chamber; EBS chambers are therefore coated inside with TiZrV non-evaporable getter (NEG), turning the whole wall into a distributed pump and lowering photon-stimulated desorption. The small bore also raises resistive-wall impedance (proportional to 1/b³), so chambers use high-conductivity material and every cross-section change is made a smooth RF transition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “NEG-coated vacuum chambers (14 per cell)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：空氣、20 °C 的長管導流量 C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s（d、L 以 cm 計）：d = 2 cm、L = 100 cm 得 C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s，即使末端接 100 L/s 幫浦，1 m 外的有效抽速仍不到 1 L/s；若每公尺氣載 q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s，壓力 P ≈ q/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar，只有分布式抽氣才能把整段壓到 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For air at 20 °C a long tube has conductance C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s with d and L in cm: d = 2 cm and L = 100 cm give C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s, so even a 100 L/s pump at the end leaves under 1 L/s effective speed 1 m away; with a gas load q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s per metre the pressure is P ≈ q/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar, and only distributed pumping brings the whole length below 10⁻⁹ mbar.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「真空腔越小，體積越小，所以越容易抽到好真空。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smaller chamber is easier to pump because its volume is smaller." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「NEG 鍍膜真空腔（每單元 14 段）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “NEG-coated vacuum chambers (14 per cell)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 小口徑真空腔、分布抽氣與阻抗
knowledge.titleEn: Small-aperture chambers, distributed pumping and impedance
knowledge.text: 緊湊的強磁鐵迫使真空腔內徑縮到 20 mm 等級。分子流狀態下細長管的導流量正比於 d³/L，集中式幫浦抽不到腔體中段，所以 EBS 腔體內壁鍍 TiZrV 非蒸發吸氣劑（NEG），把整段腔壁變成分布式幫浦並降低光致脫附。
knowledge.textEn: Compact strong magnets force the chamber bore down to the 20 mm class. In molecular flow the conductance of a long tube scales as d³/L, so lumped pumps cannot reach the middle of a chamber; EBS chambers are therefore coated inside with TiZrV non-evaporable getter (NEG), turning the whole wall into a distributed pump and lowering photon-stimulated desorption.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：真空腔越小，體積越小，所以越容易抽到好真空。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A smaller chamber is easier to pump because its volume is smaller. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「小口徑真空腔、分布抽氣與阻抗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Small-aperture chambers, distributed pumping and impedance" is correct?
options: 真空腔越小，體積越小，所以越容易抽到好真空。
緊湊的強磁鐵迫使真空腔內徑縮到 20 mm 等級。
軌道回授開著且 BPM 讀值為零，光源點就一定沒有移動。
optionsEn: A smaller chamber is easier to pump because its volume is smaller.
Compact strong magnets force the chamber bore down to the 20 mm class.
With feedback on and BPMs reading zero, the source point cannot have moved.
quiz.explanation: 緊湊的強磁鐵迫使真空腔內徑縮到 20 mm 等級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compact strong magnets force the chamber bore down to the 20 mm class. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 小口徑真空腔、分布抽氣與阻抗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Small-aperture chambers, distributed pumping and impedance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「NEG 鍍膜真空腔（每單元 14 段）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “NEG-coated vacuum chambers (14 per cell)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：空氣、20 °C 的長管導流量 C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s（d、L 以 cm 計）：d = 2 cm、L = 100 cm 得 C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s，即使末端接 100 L/s 幫浦，1 m 外的有效抽速仍不到 1 L/s；若每公尺氣載 q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s，壓力 P ≈ q/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar，只有分布式抽氣才能把整段壓到 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For air at 20 °C a long tube has conductance C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s with d and L in cm: d = 2 cm and L = 100 cm give C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s, so even a 100 L/s pump at the end leaves under 1 L/s effective speed 1 m away; with a gas load q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s per metre the pressure is P ≈ q/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar, and only distributed pumping brings the whole length below 10⁻⁹ mbar. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿單元以真空計與殘氣分析儀做壓力分布圖，比較有束流與無束流的動態壓力；記錄壓力隨累積束流劑量（A·h）的老化曲線，確認光致脫附係數持續下降；NEG 活化（約 180 到 250 °C）後量抽速；高電流運轉時監測腔體溫度判斷阻抗加熱。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map pressure along the cell with gauges and a residual-gas analyser, comparing dynamic pressure with and without beam; log the conditioning curve of pressure versus accumulated beam dose (A·h) to confirm that the photon-stimulated desorption yield keeps falling; measure pumping speed after NEG activation at about 180 to 250 °C; and monitor chamber temperature at high current to detect impedance heating.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 空氣、20 °C 的長管導流量 C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s（d、L 以 cm 計）：d = 2 cm、L = 100 cm 得 C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s，即使末端接 100 L/s 幫浦，1 m 外的有效抽速仍不到 1 L/s；若每公尺氣載 q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s，壓力 P ≈ q/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar，只有分布式抽氣才能把整段壓到 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下。
knowledge.textEn: For air at 20 °C a long tube has conductance C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s with d and L in cm: d = 2 cm and L = 100 cm give C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s, so even a 100 L/s pump at the end leaves under 1 L/s effective speed 1 m away; with a gas load q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s per metre the pressure is P ≈ q/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar, and only distributed pumping brings the whole length below 10⁻⁹ mbar.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「小口徑真空腔、分布抽氣與阻抗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Small-aperture chambers, distributed pumping and impedance", which statement holds?
options: 儲存環對準一次完成後就永久有效。
提高電子能量只是讓光更亮，不會改變光譜形狀。
空氣、20 °C 的長管導流量 C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s（d、L 以 cm 計）：d = 2 cm、L = 100 cm 得 C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s，即使末端接 100 L/s 幫浦，1 m 外的有效抽速仍不到 1 L/s。
optionsEn: Once the ring is aligned, it stays aligned.
Raising electron energy only makes the light brighter; it does not change the spectrum.

For air at 20 °C a long tube has conductance C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s with d and L in cm: d = 2 cm and L = 100 cm give C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s, so even a 100 L/s pump at the end leaves under 1 L/s effective speed 1 m away.
quiz.explanation: 空氣、20 °C 的長管導流量 C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s（d、L 以 cm 計）：d = 2 cm、L = 100 cm 得 C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s，即使末端接 100 L/s 幫浦，1 m 外的有效抽速仍不到 1 L/s；若每公尺氣載 q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s，壓力 P ≈ q/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar，只有分布式抽氣才能把整段壓到 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For air at 20 °C a long tube has conductance C ≈ 12.1·d³/L L/s with d and L in cm: d = 2 cm and L = 100 cm give C ≈ 12.1×8/100 ≈ 0.97 L/s, so even a 100 L/s pump at the end leaves under 1 L/s effective speed 1 m away; with a gas load q = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s per metre the pressure is P ≈ q/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁹ mbar, and only distributed pumping brings the whole length below 10⁻⁹ mbar. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 小口徑真空腔、分布抽氣與阻抗：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Small-aperture chambers, distributed pumping and impedance: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「NEG 鍍膜真空腔（每單元 14 段）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “NEG-coated vacuum chambers (14 per cell)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 沿單元以真空計與殘氣分析儀做壓力分布圖，比較有束流與無束流的動態壓力；記錄壓力隨累積束流劑量（A·h）的老化曲線，確認光致脫附係數持續下降；NEG 活化（約 180 到 250 °C）後量抽速；高電流運轉時監測腔體溫度判斷阻抗加熱。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map pressure along the cell with gauges and a residual-gas analyser, comparing dynamic pressure with and without beam; log the conditioning curve of pressure versus accumulated beam dose (A·h) to confirm that the photon-stimulated desorption yield keeps falling; measure pumping speed after NEG activation at about 180 to 250 °C; and monitor chamber temperature at high current to detect impedance heating. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：破真空後未重新活化的 NEG 已飽和，束流一來壓力隨電流上升，束流-氣體壽命掉到幾小時；腔體接頭的一個台階或縫隙會激發尾場，使束團加熱並引發不穩定，高電流無法達成。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: NEG left unreactivated after a vent is saturated, so pressure rises with current once beam returns and beam-gas lifetime drops to a few hours; a single step or gap at a chamber joint excites wakefields that heat the bunches and drive instabilities, blocking high-current operation.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿單元以真空計與殘氣分析儀做壓力分布圖，比較有束流與無束流的動態壓力；記錄壓力隨累積束流劑量（A·h）的老化曲線，確認光致脫附係數持續下降；NEG 活化（約 180 到 250 °C）後量抽速；高電流運轉時監測腔體溫度判斷阻抗加熱。
knowledge.textEn: Map pressure along the cell with gauges and a residual-gas analyser, comparing dynamic pressure with and without beam; log the conditioning curve of pressure versus accumulated beam dose (A·h) to confirm that the photon-stimulated desorption yield keeps falling; measure pumping speed after NEG activation at about 180 to 250 °C; and monitor chamber temperature at high current to detect impedance heating.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「小口徑真空腔、分布抽氣與阻抗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Small-aperture chambers, distributed pumping and impedance"?
options: 沿單元以真空計與殘氣分析儀做壓力分布圖，比較有束流與無束流的動態壓力。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
把彎轉磁鐵切得越多越細，發射度就能無限制下降。
optionsEn: Map pressure along the cell with gauges and a residual-gas analyser, comparing dynamic pressure with and without beam.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Slicing the bends ever finer lowers emittance without limit.
quiz.explanation: 沿單元以真空計與殘氣分析儀做壓力分布圖，比較有束流與無束流的動態壓力；記錄壓力隨累積束流劑量（A·h）的老化曲線，確認光致脫附係數持續下降；NEG 活化（約 180 到 250 °C）後量抽速；高電流運轉時監測腔體溫度判斷阻抗加熱。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map pressure along the cell with gauges and a residual-gas analyser, comparing dynamic pressure with and without beam; log the conditioning curve of pressure versus accumulated beam dose (A·h) to confirm that the photon-stimulated desorption yield keeps falling; measure pumping speed after NEG activation at about 180 to 250 °C; and monitor chamber temperature at high current to detect impedance heating. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 小口徑真空腔、分布抽氣與阻抗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Small-aperture chambers, distributed pumping and impedance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「NEG 鍍膜真空腔（每單元 14 段）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “NEG-coated vacuum chambers (14 per cell)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 破真空後未重新活化的 NEG 已飽和，束流一來壓力隨電流上升，束流-氣體壽命掉到幾小時；腔體接頭的一個台階或縫隙會激發尾場，使束團加熱並引發不穩定，高電流無法達成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: NEG left unreactivated after a vent is saturated, so pressure rises with current once beam returns and beam-gas lifetime drops to a few hours; a single step or gap at a chamber joint excites wakefields that heat the bunches and drive instabilities, blocking high-current operation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：小孔徑同時提高電阻壁阻抗（正比於 1/b³），因此腔體用高導電材料並把所有截面變化做成平滑的射頻過渡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The small bore also raises resistive-wall impedance (proportional to 1/b³), so chambers use high-conductivity material and every cross-section change is made a smooth RF transition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「真空腔越小，體積越小，所以越容易抽到好真空。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smaller chamber is easier to pump because its volume is smaller." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 破真空後未重新活化的 NEG 已飽和，束流一來壓力隨電流上升，束流-氣體壽命掉到幾小時；腔體接頭的一個台階或縫隙會激發尾場，使束團加熱並引發不穩定，高電流無法達成。
knowledge.textEn: NEG left unreactivated after a vent is saturated, so pressure rises with current once beam returns and beam-gas lifetime drops to a few hours; a single step or gap at a chamber joint excites wakefields that heat the bunches and drive instabilities, blocking high-current operation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「小口徑真空腔、分布抽氣與阻抗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Small-aperture chambers, distributed pumping and impedance" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
破真空後未重新活化的 NEG 已飽和，束流一來壓力隨電流上升，束流-氣體壽命掉到幾小時。
軌道回授開著且 BPM 讀值為零，光源點就一定沒有移動。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
NEG left unreactivated after a vent is saturated, so pressure rises with current once beam returns and beam-gas lifetime drops to a few hours.
With feedback on and BPMs reading zero, the source point cannot have moved.
quiz.explanation: 破真空後未重新活化的 NEG 已飽和，束流一來壓力隨電流上升，束流-氣體壽命掉到幾小時；腔體接頭的一個台階或縫隙會激發尾場，使束團加熱並引發不穩定，高電流無法達成。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: NEG left unreactivated after a vent is saturated, so pressure rises with current once beam returns and beam-gas lifetime drops to a few hours; a single step or gap at a chamber joint excites wakefields that heat the bunches and drive instabilities, blocking high-current operation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授」與「亮度、同調分率與繞射極限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Beam size, orbit stability and feedback" and "Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam size, orbit stability and feedback: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束流位置監測器與快速軌道回授」如何決定歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “BPMs and fast orbit feedback” determines the key performance of “European Synchrotron Radiation Facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發射度 130 pm×10 pm 代表直線段內的束流只有數十微米乘 5 µm，使用者要求光源點位置與角度的穩定度約為尺寸與發散角的 10%。每單元 10 個、全環 320 個鈕扣式 BPM 以次微米解析度把軌道送進快速軌道回授，驅動校正磁鐵抑制地面振動、樑架共振與插件磁鐵開合造成的軌道擾動，頻寬需達數百赫茲。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流位置監測器與快速軌道回授」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Emittances of 130 pm by 10 pm mean the beam in a straight is only tens of micrometres by 5 µm, and users require source position and angle stability of about 10% of size and divergence. Ten button BPMs per cell, 320 around the ring, feed sub-micrometre orbit readings into a fast orbit feedback that drives correctors to suppress ground motion, girder resonances and the orbit kicks from insertion-device gap changes, with a bandwidth of hundreds of hertz. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “BPMs and fast orbit feedback”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take β_x = 6.9 m and β_y = 2.7 m in the straight (teaching assumptions): σ_x = √(130 pm×6.9 m) ≈ 30 µm, σ_x' = √(130 pm/6.9 m) ≈ 4.3 µrad; σ_y = √(10 pm×2.7 m) ≈ 5.2 µm, σ_y' ≈ 1.9 µrad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「軌道回授開著且 BPM 讀值為零，光源點就一定沒有移動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With feedback on and BPMs reading zero, the source point cannot have moved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束流位置監測器與快速軌道回授」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “BPMs and fast orbit feedback”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授
knowledge.titleEn: Beam size, orbit stability and feedback
knowledge.text: 發射度 130 pm×10 pm 代表直線段內的束流只有數十微米乘 5 µm，使用者要求光源點位置與角度的穩定度約為尺寸與發散角的 10%。每單元 10 個、全環 320 個鈕扣式 BPM 以次微米解析度把軌道送進快速軌道回授，驅動校正磁鐵抑制地面振動、樑架共振與插件磁鐵開合造成的軌道擾動，頻寬需達數百赫茲。
knowledge.textEn: Emittances of 130 pm by 10 pm mean the beam in a straight is only tens of micrometres by 5 µm, and users require source position and angle stability of about 10% of size and divergence. Ten button BPMs per cell, 320 around the ring, feed sub-micrometre orbit readings into a fast orbit feedback that drives correctors to suppress ground motion, girder resonances and the orbit kicks from insertion-device gap changes, with a bandwidth of hundreds of hertz.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：軌道回授開著且 BPM 讀值為零，光源點就一定沒有移動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With feedback on and BPMs reading zero, the source point cannot have moved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Beam size, orbit stability and feedback" is correct?
options: 軌道回授開著且 BPM 讀值為零，光源點就一定沒有移動。
亮度就是通量，光子數越多亮度一定越高。
發射度 130 pm×10 pm 代表直線段內的束流只有數十微米乘 5 µm，使用者要求光源點位置與角度的穩定度約為尺寸與發散角的 10%。
optionsEn: With feedback on and BPMs reading zero, the source point cannot have moved.
Brilliance is just flux; more photons always means more brilliance.
Emittances of 130 pm by 10 pm mean the beam in a straight is only tens of micrometres by 5 µm, and users require source position and angle stability of about 10% of size and divergence.
quiz.explanation: 發射度 130 pm×10 pm 代表直線段內的束流只有數十微米乘 5 µm，使用者要求光源點位置與角度的穩定度約為尺寸與發散角的 10%。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Emittances of 130 pm by 10 pm mean the beam in a straight is only tens of micrometres by 5 µm, and users require source position and angle stability of about 10% of size and divergence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam size, orbit stability and feedback: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束流位置監測器與快速軌道回授」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “BPMs and fast orbit feedback” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：直線段取 β_x = 6.9 m、β_y = 2.7 m（教學假設）：σ_x = √(130 pm×6.9 m) ≈ 30 µm，σ_x' = √(130 pm/6.9 m) ≈ 4.3 µrad；σ_y = √(10 pm×2.7 m) ≈ 5.2 µm，σ_y' ≈ 1.9 µrad。10% 穩定度要求位置 3 µm／0.5 µm、角度 0.4 µrad／0.2 µrad，因此 BPM 在回授頻寬內的雜訊必須低於約 0.3 µm rms。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take β_x = 6.9 m and β_y = 2.7 m in the straight (teaching assumptions): σ_x = √(130 pm×6.9 m) ≈ 30 µm, σ_x' = √(130 pm/6.9 m) ≈ 4.3 µrad; σ_y = √(10 pm×2.7 m) ≈ 5.2 µm, σ_y' ≈ 1.9 µrad. A 10% stability requirement means 3 µm/0.5 µm in position and 0.4 µrad/0.2 µrad in angle, so BPM noise within the feedback bandwidth must stay below about 0.3 µm rms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用三顆相鄰 BPM 的相關法求單顆解析度；比較回授開與關時軌道的頻譜，確認 0.1 到 100 Hz 的積分位移下降；在光束線用光子 BPM 獨立確認光源角度；以頂注運轉連續 24 小時記錄長期漂移，並把量到的軌道響應矩陣與模型比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain single-BPM resolution from the correlation of three neighbouring BPMs; compare orbit spectra with feedback on and off to confirm that integrated motion from 0.1 to 100 Hz falls; confirm source angle independently with photon BPMs on the beamlines; log long-term drift over 24 h of top-up operation and compare the measured orbit response matrix with the model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 直線段取 β_x = 6.9 m、β_y = 2.7 m（教學假設）：σ_x = √(130 pm×6.9 m) ≈ 30 µm，σ_x' = √(130 pm/6.9 m) ≈ 4.3 µrad；σ_y = √(10 pm×2.7 m) ≈ 5.2 µm，σ_y' ≈ 1.9 µrad。10% 穩定度要求位置 3 µm／0.5 µm、角度 0.4 µrad／0.2 µrad，因此 BPM 在回授頻寬內的雜訊必須低於約 0.3 µm rms。
knowledge.textEn: Take β_x = 6.9 m and β_y = 2.7 m in the straight (teaching assumptions): σ_x = √(130 pm×6.9 m) ≈ 30 µm, σ_x' = √(130 pm/6.9 m) ≈ 4.3 µrad; σ_y = √(10 pm×2.7 m) ≈ 5.2 µm, σ_y' ≈ 1.9 µrad. A 10% stability requirement means 3 µm/0.5 µm in position and 0.4 µrad/0.2 µrad in angle, so BPM noise within the feedback bandwidth must stay below about 0.3 µm rms.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Beam size, orbit stability and feedback", which statement holds?
options: 儲存環能存到 200 mA 就代表驗收完成。
把彎轉磁鐵切得越多越細，發射度就能無限制下降。
optionsEn: Take β_x = 6.9 m and β_y = 2.7 m in the straight (teaching assumptions): σ_x = √(130 pm×6.9 m) ≈ 30 µm, σ_x' = √(130 pm/6.9 m) ≈ 4.3 µrad.
Storing 200 mA means the ring is accepted.
Slicing the bends ever finer lowers emittance without limit.
quiz.explanation: 直線段取 β_x = 6.9 m、β_y = 2.7 m（教學假設）：σ_x = √(130 pm×6.9 m) ≈ 30 µm，σ_x' = √(130 pm/6.9 m) ≈ 4.3 µrad；σ_y = √(10 pm×2.7 m) ≈ 5.2 µm，σ_y' ≈ 1.9 µrad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take β_x = 6.9 m and β_y = 2.7 m in the straight (teaching assumptions): σ_x = √(130 pm×6.9 m) ≈ 30 µm, σ_x' = √(130 pm/6.9 m) ≈ 4.3 µrad; σ_y = √(10 pm×2.7 m) ≈ 5.2 µm, σ_y' ≈ 1.9 µrad. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Beam size, orbit stability and feedback: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束流位置監測器與快速軌道回授」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “BPMs and fast orbit feedback” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用三顆相鄰 BPM 的相關法求單顆解析度；比較回授開與關時軌道的頻譜，確認 0.1 到 100 Hz 的積分位移下降；在光束線用光子 BPM 獨立確認光源角度；以頂注運轉連續 24 小時記錄長期漂移，並把量到的軌道響應矩陣與模型比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain single-BPM resolution from the correlation of three neighbouring BPMs; compare orbit spectra with feedback on and off to confirm that integrated motion from 0.1 to 100 Hz falls; confirm source angle independently with photon BPMs on the beamlines; log long-term drift over 24 h of top-up operation and compare the measured orbit response matrix with the model. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：BPM 鈕扣與支架的熱漂移達每 K 數百奈米，回授會忠實地把束流鎖到一個漂走的假基準上，電子 BPM 讀零而光束線看到光源點慢慢移動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Thermal drift of BPM buttons and supports reaches hundreds of nanometres per kelvin, so the feedback faithfully locks the beam to a drifting false reference: electron BPMs read zero while the beamline watches the source creep.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用三顆相鄰 BPM 的相關法求單顆解析度；比較回授開與關時軌道的頻譜，確認 0.1 到 100 Hz 的積分位移下降；在光束線用光子 BPM 獨立確認光源角度；以頂注運轉連續 24 小時記錄長期漂移，並把量到的軌道響應矩陣與模型比對。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain single-BPM resolution from the correlation of three neighbouring BPMs; compare orbit spectra with feedback on and off to confirm that integrated motion from 0.1 to 100 Hz falls; confirm source angle independently with photon BPMs on the beamlines; log long-term drift over 24 h of top-up operation and compare the measured orbit response matrix with the model.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam size, orbit stability and feedback"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用三顆相鄰 BPM 的相關法求單顆解析度。
永磁彎轉磁鐵不用電，所以它的場強永遠不會變。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Obtain single-BPM resolution from the correlation of three neighbouring BPMs.
Permanent-magnet bends draw no power, so their field never changes.
quiz.explanation: 用三顆相鄰 BPM 的相關法求單顆解析度；比較回授開與關時軌道的頻譜，確認 0.1 到 100 Hz 的積分位移下降；在光束線用光子 BPM 獨立確認光源角度；以頂注運轉連續 24 小時記錄長期漂移，並把量到的軌道響應矩陣與模型比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain single-BPM resolution from the correlation of three neighbouring BPMs; compare orbit spectra with feedback on and off to confirm that integrated motion from 0.1 to 100 Hz falls; confirm source angle independently with photon BPMs on the beamlines; log long-term drift over 24 h of top-up operation and compare the measured orbit response matrix with the model. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam size, orbit stability and feedback: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束流位置監測器與快速軌道回授」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “BPMs and fast orbit feedback” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: BPM 鈕扣與支架的熱漂移達每 K 數百奈米，回授會忠實地把束流鎖到一個漂走的假基準上，電子 BPM 讀零而光束線看到光源點慢慢移動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Thermal drift of BPM buttons and supports reaches hundreds of nanometres per kelvin, so the feedback faithfully locks the beam to a drifting false reference: electron BPMs read zero while the beamline watches the source creep. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每單元 10 個、全環 320 個鈕扣式 BPM 以次微米解析度把軌道送進快速軌道回授，驅動校正磁鐵抑制地面振動、樑架共振與插件磁鐵開合造成的軌道擾動，頻寬需達數百赫茲。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ten button BPMs per cell, 320 around the ring, feed sub-micrometre orbit readings into a fast orbit feedback that drives correctors to suppress ground motion, girder resonances and the orbit kicks from insertion-device gap changes, with a bandwidth of hundreds of hertz.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「軌道回授開著且 BPM 讀值為零，光源點就一定沒有移動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With feedback on and BPMs reading zero, the source point cannot have moved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: BPM 鈕扣與支架的熱漂移達每 K 數百奈米，回授會忠實地把束流鎖到一個漂走的假基準上，電子 BPM 讀零而光束線看到光源點慢慢移動。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal drift of BPM buttons and supports reaches hundreds of nanometres per kelvin, so the feedback faithfully locks the beam to a drifting false reference: electron BPMs read zero while the beamline watches the source creep.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束流尺寸、軌道穩定度與回授」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam size, orbit stability and feedback" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
亮度就是通量，光子數越多亮度一定越高。
BPM 鈕扣與支架的熱漂移達每 K 數百奈米，回授會忠實地把束流鎖到一個漂走的假基準上，電子 BPM 讀零而光束線看到光源點慢慢移動。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Brilliance is just flux; more photons always means more brilliance.

Thermal drift of BPM buttons and supports reaches hundreds of nanometres per kelvin, so the feedback faithfully locks the beam to a drifting false reference: electron BPMs read zero while the beamline watches the source creep.
quiz.explanation: BPM 鈕扣與支架的熱漂移達每 K 數百奈米，回授會忠實地把束流鎖到一個漂走的假基準上，電子 BPM 讀零而光束線看到光源點慢慢移動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal drift of BPM buttons and supports reaches hundreds of nanometres per kelvin, so the feedback faithfully locks the beam to a drifting false reference: electron BPMs read zero while the beamline watches the source creep. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 亮度、同調分率與繞射極限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「亮度計算表（通量除以相空間）」如何決定歐洲同步輻射設施 ESRF的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Brilliance table (flux over phase space)” determines the key performance of “European Synchrotron Radiation Facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 亮度 B = F/(4π²·Σx·Σy·Σx'·Σy')，F 是 0.1% 頻寬內的通量，Σ 由電子束尺寸、發散角與單電子輻射的繞射項 σ_r = √(2λL)/4π、σ_r' = √(λ/2L) 平方相加而成。當發射度小於 λ/4π 時光源進入繞射極限：在 1 Å 這個值約 8 pm，EBS 的垂直 10 pm 幾乎達到，水平 130 pm 則仍由電子束主導，這決定了同調分率與聚焦極限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「亮度計算表（通量除以相空間）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Brilliance is B = F/(4π²·Σx·Σy·Σx'·Σy'), where F is the flux in 0.1% bandwidth and each Σ adds in quadrature the electron size or divergence and the single-electron diffraction terms σ_r = √(2λL)/4π and σ_r' = √(λ/2L). When emittance falls below λ/4π the source becomes diffraction limited: at 1 Å that is about 8 pm, which the 10 pm vertical emittance of EBS nearly reaches while the 130 pm horizontal is still electron dominated, and that sets the coherent fraction and focusing limit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Brilliance table (flux over phase space)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取一支長 2 m、週期 λ_u = 18 mm、偏轉參數 K = 1 的波盪器裝在 6 GeV 儲存環：基頻波長 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å（光子能量 12.7 keV）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 2 m undulator with λ_u = 18 mm and K = 1 at 6 GeV gives λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 0.98 Å (12.7 keV).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「亮度就是通量，光子數越多亮度一定越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Brilliance is just flux; more photons always means more brilliance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「亮度計算表（通量除以相空間）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Brilliance table (flux over phase space)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 亮度、同調分率與繞射極限
knowledge.titleEn: Brilliance, coherent fraction and the diffraction limit
knowledge.text: 亮度 B = F/(4π²·Σx·Σy·Σx'·Σy')，F 是 0.1% 頻寬內的通量，Σ 由電子束尺寸、發散角與單電子輻射的繞射項 σ_r = √(2λL)/4π、σ_r' = √(λ/2L) 平方相加而成。當發射度小於 λ/4π 時光源進入繞射極限：在 1 Å 這個值約 8 pm，EBS 的垂直 10 pm 幾乎達到，水平 130 pm 則仍由電子束主導，這決定了同調分率與聚焦極限。
knowledge.textEn: Brilliance is B = F/(4π²·Σx·Σy·Σx'·Σy'), where F is the flux in 0.1% bandwidth and each Σ adds in quadrature the electron size or divergence and the single-electron diffraction terms σ_r = √(2λL)/4π and σ_r' = √(λ/2L). When emittance falls below λ/4π the source becomes diffraction limited: at 1 Å that is about 8 pm, which the 10 pm vertical emittance of EBS nearly reaches while the 130 pm horizontal is still electron dominated, and that sets the coherent fraction and focusing limit.
