quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。
在光束線以楊氏雙狹縫或針孔對掃描不同間距的條紋可見度，取得橫向同調長度並換算同調分率。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter.
On a beamline scan fringe visibility with a Young double slit or pinhole pair at several separations to obtain the transverse coherence length and convert it to a coherent fraction.
quiz.explanation: 在光束線以楊氏雙狹縫或針孔對掃描不同間距的條紋可見度，取得橫向同調長度並換算同調分率；與用針孔相機量到的發射度和 β 函數算出的預測值比較；以同調繞射成像的重建品質作為最終的使用者端驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On a beamline scan fringe visibility with a Young double slit or pinhole pair at several separations to obtain the transverse coherence length and convert it to a coherent fraction; compare with the prediction from pinhole-camera emittance and the β function; and use the reconstruction quality of coherent diffraction imaging as the final user-side verification. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「同調分率計算（1 Å）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation; accepting only at the source without measuring fringe visibility at the sample lets the upgrade's coherence gain be eaten in the optics chain. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在 1 Å 波長，λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad；SPring-8 現行水平發射度 2.4 nm·rad 使同調分率只有千分之幾，而 SPring-8-II 的 50 pm·rad 把它提高數十倍，這才是升級真正的驅動力，而不是總通量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At 1 Å wavelength λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad; the present SPring-8 horizontal emittance of 2.4 nm·rad leaves a coherent fraction of a few tenths of a percent, while the 50 pm·rad of SPring-8-II raises it by tens of times, and that gain, not total flux, is the real driver of the upgrade.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。
knowledge.textEn: Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation; accepting only at the source without measuring fringe visibility at the sample lets the upgrade's coherence gain be eaten in the optics chain.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。
optionsEn: Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same.
quiz.explanation: 單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation; accepting only at the source without measuring fringe visibility at the sample lets the upgrade's coherence gain be eaten in the optics chain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」與「綠色升級的驗收指標與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout" and "Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。新晶格的周長 1435.428 m 比現行 1435.949 m 短 0.521 m，諧波數若維持 2436，射頻頻率必須上移；所有磁鐵與真空腔先在樑架上預組裝並完成對準，停機期只做拆舊、吊裝與連接。光束線的光源點必須保留，而降能後每支波盪器都要換成更短週期的 IVU-II 才能維持原有的光子能量範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year. The new lattice circumference of 1435.428 m is 0.521 m shorter than the present 1435.949 m, so with the harmonic number kept at 2436 the RF frequency must rise; all magnets and chambers are pre-assembled and aligned on girders so that the blackout covers only removal, rigging and connection. Beamline source points must be preserved, and after the energy reduction every undulator is replaced by a shorter-period IVU-II to keep its photon-energy range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機
knowledge.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout
knowledge.text: SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。新晶格的周長 1435.428 m 比現行 1435.949 m 短 0.521 m，諧波數若維持 2436，射頻頻率必須上移；所有磁鐵與真空腔先在樑架上預組裝並完成對準，停機期只做拆舊、吊裝與連接。
knowledge.textEn: SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year. The new lattice circumference of 1435.428 m is 0.521 m shorter than the present 1435.949 m, so with the harmonic number kept at 2436 the RF frequency must rise; all magnets and chambers are pre-assembled and aligned on girders so that the blackout covers only removal, rigging and connection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout" is correct?
options: 隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。
SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。
升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。
optionsEn: If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same.
SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year.
Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower.
quiz.explanation: SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：定量估算
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f_RF = h·c/C：現行 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz；新環 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz，上移約 184 kHz，腔體調諧與低階模濾波器都要涵蓋。波盪器：λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ²，8→6 GeV 時 γ² 乘 0.5625，λ_u = 32 mm、K = 2.2 的基頻從 5.55 keV 掉到 3.12 keV；要維持 5.55 keV 可改用 λ_u = 18 mm（相同 K）或維持 32 mm 把 K 降到 1.36。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover. Undulators: λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ², and going from 8 to 6 GeV multiplies γ² by 0.5625, so the 5.55 keV fundamental of λ_u = 32 mm at K = 2.2 drops to 3.12 keV; keeping 5.55 keV needs λ_u = 18 mm at the same K, or 32 mm with K lowered to 1.36. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: f_RF = h·c/C：現行 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz；新環 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz，上移約 184 kHz，腔體調諧與低階模濾波器都要涵蓋。波盪器：λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ²，8→6 GeV 時 γ² 乘 0.5625，λ_u = 32 mm、K = 2.2 的基頻從 5.55 keV 掉到 3.12 keV；要維持 5.55 keV 可改用 λ_u = 18 mm（相同 K）或維持 32 mm 把 K 降到 1.36。
knowledge.textEn: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover. Undulators: λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ², and going from 8 to 6 GeV multiplies γ² by 0.5625, so the 5.55 keV fundamental of λ_u = 32 mm at K = 2.2 drops to 3.12 keV; keeping 5.55 keV needs λ_u = 18 mm at the same K, or 32 mm with K lowered to 1.36.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout", which statement holds?
options: 降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。
注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。
optionsEn: Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy.
An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter.
quiz.explanationEn: f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。
knowledge.textEn: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout"?
options: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。
optionsEn: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity.
quiz.explanation: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：光束線的光源點必須保留，而降能後每支波盪器都要換成更短週期的 IVU-II 才能維持原有的光子能量範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Beamline source points must be preserved, and after the energy reduction every undulator is replaced by a shorter-period IVU-II to keep its photon-energy range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。
knowledge.textEn: If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存。
升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all.
Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower.
quiz.explanation: 若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 綠色升級的驗收指標與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPring-8-II 的驗收同時包含光源性能與用電：發射度 50 pm·rad、電流 200 mA、亮度提升、以及永磁彎轉磁鐵與降能帶來的電力節省。射頻功率由 U₀·I 決定，彎轉磁鐵改用永磁後磁鐵電源的用電歸零，但阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加的輻射損失要由射頻補回；交接文件必須把每一項性能指標對應到量測方法、不確定度與運轉條件，使用者設施才能據此排程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance of SPring-8-II covers both source performance and electricity: 50 pm·rad emittance, 200 mA, the brilliance gain, and the power saved by permanent-magnet bends and the lower energy. RF power follows from U₀·I; permanent-magnet dipoles eliminate magnet power-supply consumption, but the extra radiation loss of damping wigglers must be restored by the RF; the handoff document must map every performance metric to a measurement method, an uncertainty and an operating condition before users can schedule on it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Present: U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV at 100 mA gives 0.92 MW of beam RF power.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 綠色升級的驗收指標與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade
knowledge.text: SPring-8-II 的驗收同時包含光源性能與用電：發射度 50 pm·rad、電流 200 mA、亮度提升、以及永磁彎轉磁鐵與降能帶來的電力節省。射頻功率由 U₀·I 決定，彎轉磁鐵改用永磁後磁鐵電源的用電歸零，但阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加的輻射損失要由射頻補回；交接文件必須把每一項性能指標對應到量測方法、不確定度與運轉條件，使用者設施才能據此排程。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance of SPring-8-II covers both source performance and electricity: 50 pm·rad emittance, 200 mA, the brilliance gain, and the power saved by permanent-magnet bends and the lower energy. RF power follows from U₀·I; permanent-magnet dipoles eliminate magnet power-supply consumption, but the extra radiation loss of damping wigglers must be restored by the RF; the handoff document must map every performance metric to a measurement method, an uncertainty and an operating condition before users can schedule on it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「綠色升級的驗收指標與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade" is correct?
options: 升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。
電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。
SPring-8-II 的驗收同時包含光源性能與用電：發射度 50 pm·rad、電流 200 mA、亮度提升、以及永磁彎轉磁鐵與降能帶來的電力節省。
optionsEn: Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower.
Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss.
Acceptance of SPring-8-II covers both source performance and electricity: 50 pm·rad emittance, 200 mA, the brilliance gain, and the power saved by permanent-magnet bends and the lower energy.
quiz.explanation: SPring-8-II 的驗收同時包含光源性能與用電：發射度 50 pm·rad、電流 200 mA、亮度提升、以及永磁彎轉磁鐵與降能帶來的電力節省。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance of SPring-8-II covers both source performance and electricity: 50 pm·rad emittance, 200 mA, the brilliance gain, and the power saved by permanent-magnet bends and the lower energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 綠色升級的驗收指標與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。新環：6 GeV、等效 ρ 取 45 m（教學假設）→ U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV，加阻尼扭擺 1.2 倍 → 約 5.6 MeV，200 mA → 1.12 MW；射頻功率略增，但 88 顆電磁彎轉磁鐵各 20 kW（教學假設）共 1.76 MW 的磁鐵電力歸零，整體仍淨省。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Present: U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV at 100 mA gives 0.92 MW of beam RF power. New ring: 6 GeV with an effective ρ of 45 m (teaching assumption) gives U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV, plus 1.2 times that for damping wigglers, about 5.6 MeV, so 1.12 MW at 200 mA; RF power rises slightly, but the 1.76 MW drawn by 88 electromagnetic dipoles at 20 kW each (teaching assumption) goes to zero, leaving a net saving. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以電力計分別記錄磁鐵電源、射頻與低溫（若有）的用電並與升級前比較；用針孔相機與 LOCO 模型驗證 50 pm 的發射度，用 DCCT 驗證 200 mA 與壽命；在代表性光束線以相同光學配置量升級前後的亮度比與同調分率；把所有數據連同量測不確定度寫入交接報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log magnet power-supply, RF and any cryogenic electricity separately with power meters and compare with pre-upgrade values; verify 50 pm emittance with pinhole camera and LOCO model and 200 mA with lifetime from the DCCT; measure the brilliance ratio and coherent fraction before and after on representative beamlines with identical optics; and write all data with measurement uncertainties into the handoff report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。新環：6 GeV、等效 ρ 取 45 m（教學假設）→ U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV，加阻尼扭擺 1.2 倍 → 約 5.6 MeV，200 mA → 1.12 MW；射頻功率略增，但 88 顆電磁彎轉磁鐵各 20 kW（教學假設）共 1.76 MW 的磁鐵電力歸零，整體仍淨省。
knowledge.textEn: Present: U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV at 100 mA gives 0.92 MW of beam RF power. New ring: 6 GeV with an effective ρ of 45 m (teaching assumption) gives U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV, plus 1.2 times that for damping wigglers, about 5.6 MeV, so 1.12 MW at 200 mA; RF power rises slightly, but the 1.76 MW drawn by 88 electromagnetic dipoles at 20 kW each (teaching assumption) goes to zero, leaving a net saving.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「綠色升級的驗收指標與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade", which statement holds?
options: 現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。
波盪器的功率密度只跟電流有關，與電子能量無關。
只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。
optionsEn: Present: U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV at 100 mA gives 0.92 MW of beam RF power.
Undulator power density depends only on current, not on electron energy.
Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity.
quiz.explanation: 現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Present: U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV at 100 mA gives 0.92 MW of beam RF power. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 綠色升級的驗收指標與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以電力計分別記錄磁鐵電源、射頻與低溫（若有）的用電並與升級前比較；用針孔相機與 LOCO 模型驗證 50 pm 的發射度，用 DCCT 驗證 200 mA 與壽命；在代表性光束線以相同光學配置量升級前後的亮度比與同調分率；把所有數據連同量測不確定度寫入交接報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log magnet power-supply, RF and any cryogenic electricity separately with power meters and compare with pre-upgrade values; verify 50 pm emittance with pinhole camera and LOCO model and 200 mA with lifetime from the DCCT; measure the brilliance ratio and coherent fraction before and after on representative beamlines with identical optics; and write all data with measurement uncertainties into the handoff report. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若驗收只看峰值亮度而不綁定運轉條件，使用者拿到的可能是壽命僅數小時、頂注頻繁、光束線快門常關的機器，帳面指標達標但有效束流時間反而減少。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If acceptance looks only at peak brilliance without binding it to operating conditions, users may receive a machine with a lifetime of a few hours, frequent top-ups and shutters often closed: the headline metric is met while effective beam time falls.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以電力計分別記錄磁鐵電源、射頻與低溫（若有）的用電並與升級前比較；用針孔相機與 LOCO 模型驗證 50 pm 的發射度，用 DCCT 驗證 200 mA 與壽命；在代表性光束線以相同光學配置量升級前後的亮度比與同調分率；把所有數據連同量測不確定度寫入交接報告。
knowledge.textEn: Log magnet power-supply, RF and any cryogenic electricity separately with power meters and compare with pre-upgrade values; verify 50 pm emittance with pinhole camera and LOCO model and 200 mA with lifetime from the DCCT; measure the brilliance ratio and coherent fraction before and after on representative beamlines with identical optics; and write all data with measurement uncertainties into the handoff report.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「綠色升級的驗收指標與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以電力計分別記錄磁鐵電源、射頻與低溫（若有）的用電並與升級前比較。
總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Log magnet power-supply, RF and any cryogenic electricity separately with power meters and compare with pre-upgrade values.
If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change.
quiz.explanation: 以電力計分別記錄磁鐵電源、射頻與低溫（若有）的用電並與升級前比較；用針孔相機與 LOCO 模型驗證 50 pm 的發射度，用 DCCT 驗證 200 mA 與壽命；在代表性光束線以相同光學配置量升級前後的亮度比與同調分率；把所有數據連同量測不確定度寫入交接報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log magnet power-supply, RF and any cryogenic electricity separately with power meters and compare with pre-upgrade values; verify 50 pm emittance with pinhole camera and LOCO model and 200 mA with lifetime from the DCCT; measure the brilliance ratio and coherent fraction before and after on representative beamlines with identical optics; and write all data with measurement uncertainties into the handoff report. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 綠色升級的驗收指標與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若驗收只看峰值亮度而不綁定運轉條件，使用者拿到的可能是壽命僅數小時、頂注頻繁、光束線快門常關的機器，帳面指標達標但有效束流時間反而減少。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If acceptance looks only at peak brilliance without binding it to operating conditions, users may receive a machine with a lifetime of a few hours, frequent top-ups and shutters often closed: the headline metric is met while effective beam time falls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：射頻功率由 U₀·I 決定，彎轉磁鐵改用永磁後磁鐵電源的用電歸零，但阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加的輻射損失要由射頻補回；交接文件必須把每一項性能指標對應到量測方法、不確定度與運轉條件，使用者設施才能據此排程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: RF power follows from U₀·I; permanent-magnet dipoles eliminate magnet power-supply consumption, but the extra radiation loss of damping wigglers must be restored by the RF; the handoff document must map every performance metric to a measurement method, an uncertainty and an operating condition before users can schedule on it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

title: SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
summary: 以 SLAC 的 LCLS 為對象：常溫銅直線加速器以 120 Hz 提供 13.6 GeV 電子，在 112 m 波盪器中以自放大自發輻射（SASE）產生 1.5 Å 的飛秒 X 光脈衝；本課推導 Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和功率，拆解光陰極注入、束流壓縮與雷射加熱器，再把單發診斷、脈衝統計與 LCLS-II 的 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器（最高 1 MHz）整合成可驗收的工程邏輯。
summaryEn: Taking SLAC's LCLS: a normal-conducting copper linac delivers 13.6 GeV electrons at 120 Hz, and a 112 m undulator produces femtosecond 1.5 Å X-ray pulses by self-amplified spontaneous emission (SASE). The course derives the Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation power, works through the photoinjector, bunch compression and laser heater, then integrates single-shot diagnostics, pulse statistics and the LCLS-II 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac (up to 1 MHz) into an acceptable engineering logic.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: SASE 增益練習：取 LCLS 硬 X 光模式 E = 13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、峰值電流 I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm。共振波長 λ = 0.030×(1+6.125)/(2×7.08×10⁸) ≈ 1.51×10⁻¹⁰ m，即 8.2 keV。Pierce 參數 ρ = [(1/16)(3000/17 045)(3.5²×0.74²)/(26 615³×(30×10⁻⁶)²×209²)]^(1/3) ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。增益長度 L_g = 0.030/(4π×1.732×4.6×10⁻⁴) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m，112 m 的波盪器留有餘裕。飽和功率 P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6×10⁹×3000 ≈ 1.9×10¹⁰ W，30 fs 脈衝能量約 0.57 mJ；頻寬 ≈ ρ×8.2 keV ≈ 3.8 eV；70 fs 全寬脈衝的模式數 M ≈ ρωT/2π ≈ 64，逐發能量抖動約 12%。若歸一化發射度 0.4 µm，幾何發射度 0.4×10⁻⁶/26 615 ≈ 15 pm，略大於 λ/4π ≈ 12 pm，接近繞射極限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: SASE gain exercise: take the LCLS hard X-ray mode with E = 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), peak current I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm. The resonant wavelength is λ = 0.030×(1+6.125)/(2×7.08×10⁸) ≈ 1.51×10⁻¹⁰ m, that is 8.2 keV. The Pierce parameter ρ = [(1/16)(3000/17 045)(3.5²×0.74²)/(26 615³×(30×10⁻⁶)²×209²)]^(1/3) ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. Gain length L_g = 0.030/(4π×1.732×4.6×10⁻⁴) ≈ 3.0 m, saturation after about 20L_g ≈ 60 m, so the 112 m undulator has margin. Saturated power P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6×10⁹×3000 ≈ 1.9×10¹⁰ W, about 0.57 mJ in a 30 fs pulse; bandwidth ≈ ρ×8.2 keV ≈ 3.8 eV; a 70 fs full-width pulse holds M ≈ ρωT/2π ≈ 64 modes with about 12% shot-to-shot energy fluctuation. With a normalised emittance of 0.4 µm the geometric emittance is 0.4×10⁻⁶/26 615 ≈ 15 pm, slightly above λ/4π ≈ 12 pm, close to the diffraction limit. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」與「Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" and "Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 裝入 1.3 GHz 鈮超導加速模組，在 2 K 下壁損耗低了五個數量級以上，可以連續波運轉，把重複率推到 1 MHz。兩種直線加速器共用同一個波盪器大廳，重複率、束流功率與光學熱負載因此差了四個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz niobium superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel, where wall losses at 2 K are more than five orders of magnitude lower, allowing continuous-wave operation and a repetition rate up to 1 MHz. Both linacs feed the same undulator hall, so repetition rate, beam power and optics heat load differ by four orders of magnitude. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界
knowledge.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration
knowledge.text: LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 裝入 1.3 GHz 鈮超導加速模組，在 2 K 下壁損耗低了五個數量級以上，可以連續波運轉，把重複率推到 1 MHz。
knowledge.textEn: LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz niobium superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel, where wall losses at 2 K are more than five orders of magnitude lower, allowing continuous-wave operation and a repetition rate up to 1 MHz.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" is correct?
options: 銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。
LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。
自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。
optionsEn: A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling.

LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz.
FEL output power is proportional to undulator length.
quiz.explanation: LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。超導腔以 Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ 運轉：V = 16.6 MV、R/Q = 1036 Ω 時 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W（2 K，連續波），單腔差了六個數量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m. A superconducting cavity at Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ with V = 16.6 MV and R/Q = 1036 Ω dissipates P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W at 2 K in continuous wave, six orders of magnitude less per cavity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散；以射頻功率計與量熱法比對銅結構的脈衝壁損與超導腔的 2 K 動態熱負載；用束流電荷監視器乘重複率核對平均束流功率，確認機器保護系統的設定門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen); compare copper pulsed wall loss and superconducting 2 K dynamic heat load using RF power meters and calorimetry; and check the average beam power from charge monitors times repetition rate to confirm the machine-protection thresholds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 銅結構壁損耗功率密度 P/L = E²/r_s：E = 17 MV/m、分路阻抗 r_s = 53 MΩ/m 得 (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m，只能靠 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ 的工作比把平均降到約 650 W/m。超導腔以 Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ 運轉：V = 16.6 MV、R/Q = 1036 Ω 時 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W（2 K，連續波），單腔差了六個數量級。
knowledge.textEn: Copper wall-loss density P/L = E²/r_s: with E = 17 MV/m and shunt impedance r_s = 53 MΩ/m, (17×10⁶)²/53×10⁶ ≈ 5.5 MW/m, so only a duty factor of 120 Hz×1 µs = 1.2×10⁻⁴ brings the average down to about 650 W/m. A superconducting cavity at Q₀ ≈ 2.7×10¹⁰ with V = 16.6 MV and R/Q = 1036 Ω dissipates P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀) = (16.6×10⁶)²/(1036×2.7×10¹⁰) ≈ 9.9 W at 2 K in continuous wave, six orders of magnitude less per cavity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。

optionsEn: Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated.
Large pulse-energy fluctuation always means the accelerator is unstable.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以能譜儀（彎轉磁鐵加螢幕）量兩條直線加速器末端的束流能量與能散；以射頻功率計與量熱法比對銅結構的脈衝壁損與超導腔的 2 K 動態熱負載；用束流電荷監視器乘重複率核對平均束流功率，確認機器保護系統的設定門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure beam energy and energy spread at the end of each linac with a spectrometer (bend plus screen); compare copper pulsed wall loss and superconducting 2 K dynamic heat load using RF power meters and calorimetry; and check the average beam power from charge monitors times repetition rate to confirm the machine-protection thresholds. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩種直線加速器共用同一個波盪器大廳，重複率、束流功率與光學熱負載因此差了四個數量級。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both linacs feed the same undulator hall, so repetition rate, beam power and optics heat load differ by four orders of magnitude.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “112 m undulator and SASE gain” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。成長率由 Pierce 參數 ρ 決定：ρ 由峰值電流、電子束尺寸、K 值與能量共同給出，典型只有 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級。功率每隔一個增益長度 L_g 增加 e 倍，約 20 個 L_g 後飽和；飽和功率約為 ρ 乘以電子束功率，頻寬也約為 ρ。LCLS 用 33 段共 112 m 的固定間隙波盪器就是為了在 8 keV 附近確保飽和。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The growth rate is set by the Pierce parameter ρ, which combines peak current, beam size, K and energy and is typically only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³. Power grows by e every gain length L_g and saturates after about 20 L_g; the saturated power is about ρ times the electron-beam power and the bandwidth is also about ρ. LCLS used 33 fixed-gap segments totalling 112 m precisely to guarantee saturation near 8 keV. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “112 m undulator and SASE gain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "FEL output power is proportional to undulator length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “112 m undulator and SASE gain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和
knowledge.titleEn: Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation
knowledge.text: 在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。成長率由 Pierce 參數 ρ 決定：ρ 由峰值電流、電子束尺寸、K 值與能量共同給出，典型只有 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級。
knowledge.textEn: Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The growth rate is set by the Pierce parameter ρ, which combines peak current, beam size, K and energy and is typically only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: FEL output power is proportional to undulator length. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation" is correct?
options: 自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。
波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。
在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。
optionsEn: FEL output power is proportional to undulator length.
An undulator is a passive magnet that needs no recalibration once installed.

Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE.
quiz.explanation: 在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “112 m undulator and SASE gain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm：λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å（8.2 keV）。ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3)，I_A = 17 kA、[JJ] = 0.74、k_u = 209 m⁻¹，得 ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m；P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW，30 fs 脈衝約 0.6 mJ，頻寬約 ρ ≈ 3.8 eV。數值顯示增益長度決定波盪器總長度，電子束發射度或能散不足時，飽和長度會明顯延長甚至無法飽和。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m, so saturation takes about 20L_g ≈ 60 m; P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW, about 0.6 mJ in a 30 fs pulse, with bandwidth about ρ ≈ 3.8 eV. The numbers show that the gain length sets total undulator length; if emittance or energy spread is poor, saturation moves much further downstream or never occurs. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 13.6 GeV（γ = 26 615）、I = 3 kA、K = 3.5、λ_u = 30 mm、σ_x = 30 µm：λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å（8.2 keV）。ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3)，I_A = 17 kA、[JJ] = 0.74、k_u = 209 m⁻¹，得 ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴。L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m，飽和長度約 20L_g ≈ 60 m；P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW，30 fs 脈衝約 0.6 mJ，頻寬約 ρ ≈ 3.8 eV。數值顯示增益長度決定波盪器總長度，電子束發射度或能散不足時，飽和長度會明顯延長甚至無法飽和。
knowledge.textEn: At 13.6 GeV (γ = 26 615), I = 3 kA, K = 3.5, λ_u = 30 mm and σ_x = 30 µm: λ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 1.51 Å (8.2 keV). ρ = [(1/16)(I/I_A)(K²[JJ]²)/(γ³σ_x²k_u²)]^(1/3) with I_A = 17 kA, [JJ] = 0.74 and k_u = 209 m⁻¹ gives ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴. L_g = λ_u/(4π√3·ρ) ≈ 3.0 m, so saturation takes about 20L_g ≈ 60 m; P_sat ≈ ρ·E·I = 4.6×10⁻⁴×13.6 GV×3 kA ≈ 19 GW, about 0.6 mJ in a 30 fs pulse, with bandwidth about ρ ≈ 3.8 eV. The numbers show that the gain length sets total undulator length; if emittance or energy spread is poor, saturation moves much further downstream or never occurs.

steps.title: Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “112 m undulator and SASE gain” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量增益曲線：依序把波盪器段的軌道踢開（或打開間隙）讓有效長度變短，記錄氣體偵測器的脈衝能量對長度的關係，對指數段取對數斜率得 L_g，與 3.0 m 比較，並確認曲線在 60 到 80 m 後轉平；再以單發光譜儀量頻寬核對 ρ。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the gain curve: kick the beam out of successive undulator segments (or open their gaps) to shorten the effective length, record gas-detector pulse energy versus length, take the log slope of the exponential region to get L_g and compare with 3.0 m, and confirm the curve flattens after 60 to 80 m; then check ρ from the bandwidth on a single-shot spectrometer. steps.observation: 注意干擾：能散若因壓縮過程的微束團不穩定而升到超過 ρ，增益長度拉長數倍，112 m 走完仍未飽和，脈衝能量掉一個數量級且逐發抖動劇烈；問題出在直線加速器，波盪器本身完全正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If energy spread rises above ρ through microbunching instability during compression, the gain length stretches several times, the beam leaves 112 m still unsaturated, pulse energy drops an order of magnitude and shot-to-shot jitter explodes; the fault lies in the linac while the undulator itself is perfectly fine.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波盪器 K 值公差、相位與溫控」與「注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Undulator K tolerance, phasing and temperature control" and "Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波盪器 K 值公差、相位與溫控：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Undulator K tolerance, phasing and temperature control: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「固定間隙波盪器段（λ_u = 30 mm，K = 3.5）」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fixed-gap undulator segments (λ_u = 30 mm, K = 3.5)” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SASE 的共振條件要求整段波盪器的 K 值一致到 ρ 的量級，否則不同段輻射的波長錯開、增益中斷。LCLS 波盪器以 NdFeB 永磁混合磁列組成，K 以微調磁極間隙的斜置機構校正；相鄰段之間的相位整合器（phase shifter）讓電子與光在段間漂移區保持同相；由於 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，波盪器大廳的溫度穩定度直接變成 K 的穩定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「固定間隙波盪器段（λ_u = 30 mm，K = 3.5）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SASE resonance requires K to be uniform along the whole undulator to the order of ρ, otherwise the segments radiate at different wavelengths and the gain breaks. LCLS undulators are hybrid NdFeB arrays whose K is trimmed by a mechanism that slightly cants the gap; phase shifters between segments keep electrons and light in phase across the drift sections; and because NdFeB remanence changes by about −0.1 %/K, the undulator-hall temperature stability becomes the K stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fixed-gap undulator segments (λ_u = 30 mm, K = 3.5)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tolerance ΔK/K ≲ ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴: at K = 3.5, ΔK ≈ 1.6×10⁻³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「固定間隙波盪器段（λ_u = 30 mm，K = 3.5）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fixed-gap undulator segments (λ_u = 30 mm, K = 3.5)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：公差 ΔK/K ≲ ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴：K = 3.5 時 ΔK ≈ 1.6×10⁻³。B₀ = K/(0.934·λ_u[cm]) = 3.5/(0.934×3.0) ≈ 1.25 T，ΔB/B 同為 4.6×10⁻⁴；以 −1×10⁻³/K 的溫度係數換算，溫度必須穩定在約 0.5 K 以內，實務上以 ±0.1 K 控溫留餘裕。段間相位：漂移段 Δz 內電子相對光滑移 Δz/(2γ²) 的距離，要以相位整合器補到 λ 的整數倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tolerance ΔK/K ≲ ρ ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴: at K = 3.5, ΔK ≈ 1.6×10⁻³. B₀ = K/(0.934·λ_u[cm]) = 3.5/(0.934×3.0) ≈ 1.25 T, and ΔB/B is the same 4.6×10⁻⁴; with a −1×10⁻³/K temperature coefficient the temperature must hold within about 0.5 K, and in practice ±0.1 K control leaves margin. Between segments the electrons slip behind the light by Δz/(2γ²) over a drift Δz, which the phase shifter must trim to an integer number of wavelengths. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每段在磁量測台用霍爾探針與移動線圈量 K 與相位誤差，建立 K 對溫度與斜置量的查表；裝機後用束流做 K 掃描：逐段改變斜置量並量單發光譜的中心波長，使各段共振波長對齊到 10⁻⁴；長期監看大廳溫度與脈衝能量的相關性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure K and phase error of each segment with Hall probe and moving coil on the magnet bench and build the K-versus-temperature-and-cant table; after installation do beam-based K scans, changing each segment's cant while measuring the single-shot central wavelength until all segments resonate within 10⁻⁴; and track the correlation between hall temperature and pulse energy over time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「波盪器 K 值公差、相位與溫控」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

機器保護系統只在束流完全丟失時才需要動作。

steps.title: 波盪器 K 值公差、相位與溫控：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undulator K tolerance, phasing and temperature control: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「固定間隙波盪器段（λ_u = 30 mm，K = 3.5）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fixed-gap undulator segments (λ_u = 30 mm, K = 3.5)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每段在磁量測台用霍爾探針與移動線圈量 K 與相位誤差，建立 K 對溫度與斜置量的查表；裝機後用束流做 K 掃描：逐段改變斜置量並量單發光譜的中心波長，使各段共振波長對齊到 10⁻⁴；長期監看大廳溫度與脈衝能量的相關性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure K and phase error of each segment with Hall probe and moving coil on the magnet bench and build the K-versus-temperature-and-cant table; after installation do beam-based K scans, changing each segment's cant while measuring the single-shot central wavelength until all segments resonate within 10⁻⁴; and track the correlation between hall temperature and pulse energy over time. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：束流損失照射磁列造成輻射退磁，某幾段的 K 下降超過公差，該段輻射偏離共振，增益曲線在那裡出現平台；若未定期做 K 掃描，操作人員只看到脈衝能量逐月下滑而找不到原因。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Radiation demagnetisation from beam losses lowers K in a few segments beyond tolerance, those segments radiate off resonance and the gain curve shows a plateau there; without regular K scans operators only see pulse energy sliding month by month with no visible cause.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每段在磁量測台用霍爾探針與移動線圈量 K 與相位誤差，建立 K 對溫度與斜置量的查表；裝機後用束流做 K 掃描：逐段改變斜置量並量單發光譜的中心波長，使各段共振波長對齊到 10⁻⁴；長期監看大廳溫度與脈衝能量的相關性。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波盪器 K 值公差、相位與溫控」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Undulator K tolerance, phasing and temperature control"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。
每段在磁量測台用霍爾探針與移動線圈量 K 與相位誤差，建立 K 對溫度與斜置量的查表。

A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling.
Measure K and phase error of each segment with Hall probe and moving coil on the magnet bench and build the K-versus-temperature-and-cant table.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 波盪器 K 值公差、相位與溫控：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Undulator K tolerance, phasing and temperature control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固定間隙波盪器段（λ_u = 30 mm，K = 3.5）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fixed-gap undulator segments (λ_u = 30 mm, K = 3.5)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 束流損失照射磁列造成輻射退磁，某幾段的 K 下降超過公差，該段輻射偏離共振，增益曲線在那裡出現平台；若未定期做 K 掃描，操作人員只看到脈衝能量逐月下滑而找不到原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Radiation demagnetisation from beam losses lowers K in a few segments beyond tolerance, those segments radiate off resonance and the gain curve shows a plateau there; without regular K scans operators only see pulse energy sliding month by month with no visible cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：LCLS 波盪器以 NdFeB 永磁混合磁列組成，K 以微調磁極間隙的斜置機構校正；相鄰段之間的相位整合器（phase shifter）讓電子與光在段間漂移區保持同相；由於 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，波盪器大廳的溫度穩定度直接變成 K 的穩定度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: LCLS undulators are hybrid NdFeB arrays whose K is trimmed by a mechanism that slightly cants the gap; phase shifters between segments keep electrons and light in phase across the drift sections; and because NdFeB remanence changes by about −0.1 %/K, the undulator-hall temperature stability becomes the K stability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An undulator is a passive magnet that needs no recalibration once installed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 束流損失照射磁列造成輻射退磁，某幾段的 K 下降超過公差，該段輻射偏離共振，增益曲線在那裡出現平台；若未定期做 K 掃描，操作人員只看到脈衝能量逐月下滑而找不到原因。
knowledge.textEn: Radiation demagnetisation from beam losses lowers K in a few segments beyond tolerance, those segments radiate off resonance and the gain curve shows a plateau there; without regular K scans operators only see pulse energy sliding month by month with no visible cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波盪器 K 值公差、相位與溫控」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Undulator K tolerance, phasing and temperature control" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 束流損失照射磁列造成輻射退磁，某幾段的 K 下降超過公差，該段輻射偏離共振，增益曲線在那裡出現平台。
