能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。
optionsEn: Radiation demagnetisation from beam losses lowers K in a few segments beyond tolerance, those segments radiate off resonance and the gain curve shows a plateau there.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated.
quiz.explanation: 束流損失照射磁列造成輻射退磁，某幾段的 K 下降超過公差，該段輻射偏離共振，增益曲線在那裡出現平台；若未定期做 K 掃描，操作人員只看到脈衝能量逐月下滑而找不到原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Radiation demagnetisation from beam losses lowers K in a few segments beyond tolerance, those segments radiate off resonance and the gain curve shows a plateau there; without regular K scans operators only see pulse energy sliding month by month with no visible cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高峰值電流來自壓縮：光陰極射頻槍產生約 250 pC、數十安培的束團，在直線加速器中以離峰相位加速得到能量啁啾，再經兩個磁性壓縮器（chicane）讓高能電子走短路徑追上低能電子，把長度壓縮約百倍到 3 kA。壓縮同時放大縱向密度調變與相干同步輻射（CSR）造成的微束團不穩定，所以在注入器加一台雷射加熱器，刻意把能散從幾 keV 提高到約 20 keV 以藍道阻尼抑制不穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High peak current comes from compression: the photocathode RF gun produces about 250 pC at tens of amperes, off-crest acceleration imprints an energy chirp, and two magnetic chicanes let high-energy electrons take the shorter path and catch up with low-energy ones, compressing the length about a hundredfold to 3 kA. Compression also amplifies longitudinal density modulations and the coherent-synchrotron-radiation (CSR) driven microbunching instability, so a laser heater in the injector deliberately raises the energy spread from a few keV to about 20 keV to suppress it by Landau damping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：槍出口 Q = 250 pC、I₀ = 30 A → 長度 τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps；目標 3 kA → τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs，壓縮比 C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At the gun, Q = 250 pC at I₀ = 30 A gives a length τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps; the 3 kA target gives τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs, a compression factor C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定
knowledge.titleEn: Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability
knowledge.text: 高峰值電流來自壓縮：光陰極射頻槍產生約 250 pC、數十安培的束團，在直線加速器中以離峰相位加速得到能量啁啾，再經兩個磁性壓縮器（chicane）讓高能電子走短路徑追上低能電子，把長度壓縮約百倍到 3 kA。壓縮同時放大縱向密度調變與相干同步輻射（CSR）造成的微束團不穩定，所以在注入器加一台雷射加熱器，刻意把能散從幾 keV 提高到約 20 keV 以藍道阻尼抑制不穩定。
knowledge.textEn: High peak current comes from compression: the photocathode RF gun produces about 250 pC at tens of amperes, off-crest acceleration imprints an energy chirp, and two magnetic chicanes let high-energy electrons take the shorter path and catch up with low-energy ones, compressing the length about a hundredfold to 3 kA. Compression also amplifies longitudinal density modulations and the coherent-synchrotron-radiation (CSR) driven microbunching instability, so a laser heater in the injector deliberately raises the energy spread from a few keV to about 20 keV to suppress it by Landau damping.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability" is correct?
options: 能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。
高峰值電流來自壓縮：光陰極射頻槍產生約 250 pC、數十安培的束團，在直線加速器中以離峰相位加速得到能量啁啾，再經兩個磁性壓縮器（chicane）讓高能電子走短路徑追上低能電子，把長度壓縮約百倍到 3 kA。
自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。
optionsEn: Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated.

High peak current comes from compression: the photocathode RF gun produces about 250 pC at tens of amperes, off-crest acceleration imprints an energy chirp, and two magnetic chicanes let high-energy electrons take the shorter path and catch up with low-energy ones, compressing the length about a hundredfold to 3 kA.
An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot.
quiz.explanation: 高峰值電流來自壓縮：光陰極射頻槍產生約 250 pC、數十安培的束團，在直線加速器中以離峰相位加速得到能量啁啾，再經兩個磁性壓縮器（chicane）讓高能電子走短路徑追上低能電子，把長度壓縮約百倍到 3 kA。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: High peak current comes from compression: the photocathode RF gun produces about 250 pC at tens of amperes, off-crest acceleration imprints an energy chirp, and two magnetic chicanes let high-energy electrons take the shorter path and catch up with low-energy ones, compressing the length about a hundredfold to 3 kA. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：槍出口 Q = 250 pC、I₀ = 30 A → 長度 τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps；目標 3 kA → τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs，壓縮比 C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100。壓縮條件 1/C = 1 + h·R₅₆：以 R₅₆ = −40 mm 的單級壓縮為例，C = 10 需啁啾 h = (1/C − 1)/R₅₆ = (0.1 − 1)/(−0.04 m) ≈ 22.5 m⁻¹，即每公尺束長 22.5 的相對能量斜率，兩級串聯得到 100 倍。雷射加熱器把切片能散從 3 keV 提到 20 keV，經 100 倍壓縮後仍只占 13.6 GeV 的 1.5×10⁻⁴，低於 ρ。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At the gun, Q = 250 pC at I₀ = 30 A gives a length τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps; the 3 kA target gives τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs, a compression factor C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100. The compression condition is 1/C = 1 + h·R₅₆: for one stage with R₅₆ = −40 mm, C = 10 needs a chirp h = (1/C − 1)/R₅₆ = (0.1 − 1)/(−0.04 m) ≈ 22.5 m⁻¹, a relative energy slope of 22.5 per metre of bunch, and two stages in series give 100. The laser heater raises the slice energy spread from 3 keV to 20 keV, which after hundredfold compression is still only 1.5×10⁻⁴ of 13.6 GeV, below ρ. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用橫向偏轉腔（transverse deflecting cavity）把時間座標映射到螢幕上量束團長度與切片能散，核對壓縮比與 83 fs；以相干輻射（CTR/CDR）功率監視器做壓縮回授；掃描雷射加熱器能量，觀察壓縮後的能譜是否從帶尖峰結構變為平滑，並找出使 FEL 脈衝能量最大的加熱量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map time onto a screen with a transverse deflecting cavity to measure bunch length and slice energy spread, checking the compression factor and the 83 fs; use a coherent-radiation (CTR/CDR) power monitor for compression feedback; scan the laser-heater energy and watch the post-compression energy spectrum change from spiky to smooth, finding the heating that maximises FEL pulse energy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 槍出口 Q = 250 pC、I₀ = 30 A → 長度 τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps；目標 3 kA → τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs，壓縮比 C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100。壓縮條件 1/C = 1 + h·R₅₆：以 R₅₆ = −40 mm 的單級壓縮為例，C = 10 需啁啾 h = (1/C − 1)/R₅₆ = (0.1 − 1)/(−0.04 m) ≈ 22.5 m⁻¹，即每公尺束長 22.5 的相對能量斜率，兩級串聯得到 100 倍。雷射加熱器把切片能散從 3 keV 提到 20 keV，經 100 倍壓縮後仍只占 13.6 GeV 的 1.5×10⁻⁴，低於 ρ。
knowledge.textEn: At the gun, Q = 250 pC at I₀ = 30 A gives a length τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps; the 3 kA target gives τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs, a compression factor C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100. The compression condition is 1/C = 1 + h·R₅₆: for one stage with R₅₆ = −40 mm, C = 10 needs a chirp h = (1/C − 1)/R₅₆ = (0.1 − 1)/(−0.04 m) ≈ 22.5 m⁻¹, a relative energy slope of 22.5 per metre of bunch, and two stages in series give 100. The laser heater raises the slice energy spread from 3 keV to 20 keV, which after hundredfold compression is still only 1.5×10⁻⁴ of 13.6 GeV, below ρ.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability", which statement holds?
options: 超導腔沒有電阻，所以 2 K 下完全不產生熱。
銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。
槍出口 Q = 250 pC、I₀ = 30 A → 長度 τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps。
optionsEn: Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so they produce no heat at 2 K.
A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling.
At the gun, Q = 250 pC at I₀ = 30 A gives a length τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps; the 3 kA target gives τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs, a compression factor C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100.
quiz.explanation: 槍出口 Q = 250 pC、I₀ = 30 A → 長度 τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps；目標 3 kA → τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs，壓縮比 C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At the gun, Q = 250 pC at I₀ = 30 A gives a length τ₀ = Q/I₀ ≈ 8.3 ps; the 3 kA target gives τ = 250 pC/3 kA ≈ 83 fs, a compression factor C = τ₀/τ ≈ 100. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用橫向偏轉腔（transverse deflecting cavity）把時間座標映射到螢幕上量束團長度與切片能散，核對壓縮比與 83 fs；以相干輻射（CTR/CDR）功率監視器做壓縮回授；掃描雷射加熱器能量，觀察壓縮後的能譜是否從帶尖峰結構變為平滑，並找出使 FEL 脈衝能量最大的加熱量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map time onto a screen with a transverse deflecting cavity to measure bunch length and slice energy spread, checking the compression factor and the 83 fs; use a coherent-radiation (CTR/CDR) power monitor for compression feedback; scan the laser-heater energy and watch the post-compression energy spectrum change from spiky to smooth, finding the heating that maximises FEL pulse energy. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雷射加熱器關閉或能量不足時，微束團不穩定在壓縮後把能譜撕成鋸齒狀，切片能散超過 ρ，FEL 增益崩潰；過度加熱則能散本身超過 ρ，兩邊都輸出不足，只有在一個窄窗內才正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With the laser heater off or too weak, microbunching instability tears the post-compression energy spectrum into a sawtooth, slice energy spread exceeds ρ and FEL gain collapses; overheating makes the energy spread itself exceed ρ, so output falls on both sides and only a narrow window works.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用橫向偏轉腔（transverse deflecting cavity）把時間座標映射到螢幕上量束團長度與切片能散，核對壓縮比與 83 fs；以相干輻射（CTR/CDR）功率監視器做壓縮回授；掃描雷射加熱器能量，觀察壓縮後的能譜是否從帶尖峰結構變為平滑，並找出使 FEL 脈衝能量最大的加熱量。
knowledge.textEn: Map time onto a screen with a transverse deflecting cavity to measure bunch length and slice energy spread, checking the compression factor and the 83 fs; use a coherent-radiation (CTR/CDR) power monitor for compression feedback; scan the laser-heater energy and watch the post-compression energy spectrum change from spiky to smooth, finding the heating that maximises FEL pulse energy.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability"?
options: 用橫向偏轉腔（transverse deflecting cavity）把時間座標映射到螢幕上量束團長度與切片能散，核對壓縮比與 83 fs。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。
optionsEn: Map time onto a screen with a transverse deflecting cavity to measure bunch length and slice energy spread, checking the compression factor and the 83 fs.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
FEL output power is proportional to undulator length.
quiz.explanation: 用橫向偏轉腔（transverse deflecting cavity）把時間座標映射到螢幕上量束團長度與切片能散，核對壓縮比與 83 fs；以相干輻射（CTR/CDR）功率監視器做壓縮回授；掃描雷射加熱器能量，觀察壓縮後的能譜是否從帶尖峰結構變為平滑，並找出使 FEL 脈衝能量最大的加熱量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map time onto a screen with a transverse deflecting cavity to measure bunch length and slice energy spread, checking the compression factor and the 83 fs; use a coherent-radiation (CTR/CDR) power monitor for compression feedback; scan the laser-heater energy and watch the post-compression energy spectrum change from spiky to smooth, finding the heating that maximises FEL pulse energy. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 雷射加熱器關閉或能量不足時，微束團不穩定在壓縮後把能譜撕成鋸齒狀，切片能散超過 ρ，FEL 增益崩潰；過度加熱則能散本身超過 ρ，兩邊都輸出不足，只有在一個窄窗內才正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With the laser heater off or too weak, microbunching instability tears the post-compression energy spectrum into a sawtooth, slice energy spread exceeds ρ and FEL gain collapses; overheating makes the energy spread itself exceed ρ, so output falls on both sides and only a narrow window works. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：壓縮同時放大縱向密度調變與相干同步輻射（CSR）造成的微束團不穩定，所以在注入器加一台雷射加熱器，刻意把能散從幾 keV 提高到約 20 keV 以藍道阻尼抑制不穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compression also amplifies longitudinal density modulations and the coherent-synchrotron-radiation (CSR) driven microbunching instability, so a laser heater in the injector deliberately raises the energy spread from a few keV to about 20 keV to suppress it by Landau damping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 雷射加熱器關閉或能量不足時，微束團不穩定在壓縮後把能譜撕成鋸齒狀，切片能散超過 ρ，FEL 增益崩潰；過度加熱則能散本身超過 ρ，兩邊都輸出不足，只有在一個窄窗內才正常。
knowledge.textEn: With the laser heater off or too weak, microbunching instability tears the post-compression energy spectrum into a sawtooth, slice energy spread exceeds ρ and FEL gain collapses; overheating makes the energy spread itself exceed ρ, so output falls on both sides and only a narrow window works.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「注入器、束流壓縮與微束團不穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Injector, bunch compression and microbunching instability" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
雷射加熱器關閉或能量不足時，微束團不穩定在壓縮後把能譜撕成鋸齒狀，切片能散超過 ρ，FEL 增益崩潰。
自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
With the laser heater off or too weak, microbunching instability tears the post-compression energy spectrum into a sawtooth, slice energy spread exceeds ρ and FEL gain collapses.
An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot.
quiz.explanation: 雷射加熱器關閉或能量不足時，微束團不穩定在壓縮後把能譜撕成鋸齒狀，切片能散超過 ρ，FEL 增益崩潰；過度加熱則能散本身超過 ρ，兩邊都輸出不足，只有在一個窄窗內才正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With the laser heater off or too weak, microbunching instability tears the post-compression energy spectrum into a sawtooth, slice energy spread exceeds ρ and FEL gain collapses; overheating makes the energy spread itself exceed ρ, so output falls on both sides and only a narrow window works. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」與「SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time" and "SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SASE 是由雜訊啟動的隨機過程，每一發的能量、光譜與時間結構都不同，所以 LCLS 的診斷全部必須逐發記錄並與實驗資料同標籤。氣體偵測器以 X 光游離稀薄氣體並收集離子或電子電流，無損地量每發脈衝能量；彎晶單發光譜儀把頻譜展開到條狀偵測器上；時序工具以 X 光在薄膜上誘發的折射率跳變，用啁啾的光學脈衝把 X 光到達時間量到飛秒等級，事後把資料按真實延遲重新排序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SASE starts from noise, so every shot differs in energy, spectrum and time structure, and all LCLS diagnostics must record shot by shot and share tags with the experiment data. Gas detectors ionise dilute gas with the X-rays and collect ion or electron current to measure pulse energy non-destructively; a bent-crystal single-shot spectrometer spreads the spectrum onto a strip detector; and the timing tool uses the X-ray-induced refractive-index step in a thin film, probed by a chirped optical pulse, to measure X-ray arrival time at the femtosecond level so data can be re-sorted by true delay afterwards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：電子能量抖動 σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ 經共振條件 λ ∝ 1/γ² 變成光子能量抖動 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³，在 8.2 keV 為 8 eV，大於單發頻寬 3.8 eV，故非逐發量光譜就無法知道每發的能量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Electron energy jitter σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ becomes, through the resonance λ ∝ 1/γ², a photon-energy jitter of 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³, that is 8 eV at 8.2 keV, larger than the 3.8 eV single-shot bandwidth, so the energy of each shot is unknown without a shot-by-shot spectrum.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間
knowledge.titleEn: Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time
knowledge.text: SASE 是由雜訊啟動的隨機過程，每一發的能量、光譜與時間結構都不同，所以 LCLS 的診斷全部必須逐發記錄並與實驗資料同標籤。氣體偵測器以 X 光游離稀薄氣體並收集離子或電子電流，無損地量每發脈衝能量；彎晶單發光譜儀把頻譜展開到條狀偵測器上；時序工具以 X 光在薄膜上誘發的折射率跳變，用啁啾的光學脈衝把 X 光到達時間量到飛秒等級，事後把資料按真實延遲重新排序。
knowledge.textEn: SASE starts from noise, so every shot differs in energy, spectrum and time structure, and all LCLS diagnostics must record shot by shot and share tags with the experiment data. Gas detectors ionise dilute gas with the X-rays and collect ion or electron current to measure pulse energy non-destructively; a bent-crystal single-shot spectrometer spreads the spectrum onto a strip detector; and the timing tool uses the X-ray-induced refractive-index step in a thin film, probed by a chirped optical pulse, to measure X-ray arrival time at the femtosecond level so data can be re-sorted by true delay afterwards.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time" is correct?
options: 自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。
脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。
SASE 是由雜訊啟動的隨機過程，每一發的能量、光譜與時間結構都不同，所以 LCLS 的診斷全部必須逐發記錄並與實驗資料同標籤。
optionsEn: An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot.
Large pulse-energy fluctuation always means the accelerator is unstable.
SASE starts from noise, so every shot differs in energy, spectrum and time structure, and all LCLS diagnostics must record shot by shot and share tags with the experiment data.
quiz.explanation: SASE 是由雜訊啟動的隨機過程，每一發的能量、光譜與時間結構都不同，所以 LCLS 的診斷全部必須逐發記錄並與實驗資料同標籤。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: SASE starts from noise, so every shot differs in energy, spectrum and time structure, and all LCLS diagnostics must record shot by shot and share tags with the experiment data. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：電子能量抖動 σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ 經共振條件 λ ∝ 1/γ² 變成光子能量抖動 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³，在 8.2 keV 為 8 eV，大於單發頻寬 3.8 eV，故非逐發量光譜就無法知道每發的能量。到達時間：直線加速器射頻相位抖動 0.1° 在 2.856 GHz 對應 0.1/360×350 ps ≈ 97 fs，經壓縮器轉成數十飛秒的到達時間抖動，與 30 fs 的脈衝同量級，所以時序工具是必要的。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Electron energy jitter σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ becomes, through the resonance λ ∝ 1/γ², a photon-energy jitter of 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³, that is 8 eV at 8.2 keV, larger than the 3.8 eV single-shot bandwidth, so the energy of each shot is unknown without a shot-by-shot spectrum. Arrival time: an RF phase jitter of 0.1° at 2.856 GHz corresponds to 0.1/360×350 ps ≈ 97 fs, which the compressors convert into tens of femtoseconds of arrival-time jitter, comparable with the 30 fs pulse, so the timing tool is indispensable. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以量熱計或標定過的光二極體在不同脈衝能量下標定氣體偵測器的線性度；用已知吸收邊（例如 Fe K 邊 7.112 keV）標定光譜儀的能量軸；對時序工具，掃描泵浦雷射延遲並確認量到的到達時間分佈與電子束能量抖動的相關性；所有診斷的時間戳記必須與資料擷取系統逐發對齊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate gas-detector linearity against a calorimeter or calibrated photodiode over a range of pulse energies; calibrate the spectrometer energy axis with a known absorption edge such as the Fe K edge at 7.112 keV; for the timing tool, scan the pump-laser delay and confirm that the measured arrival-time distribution correlates with electron-energy jitter; and align every diagnostic's time stamp with the data-acquisition system shot by shot.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 電子能量抖動 σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ 經共振條件 λ ∝ 1/γ² 變成光子能量抖動 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³，在 8.2 keV 為 8 eV，大於單發頻寬 3.8 eV，故非逐發量光譜就無法知道每發的能量。到達時間：直線加速器射頻相位抖動 0.1° 在 2.856 GHz 對應 0.1/360×350 ps ≈ 97 fs，經壓縮器轉成數十飛秒的到達時間抖動，與 30 fs 的脈衝同量級，所以時序工具是必要的。

Arrival time: an RF phase jitter of 0.1° at 2.856 GHz corresponds to 0.1/360×350 ps ≈ 97 fs, which the compressors convert into tens of femtoseconds of arrival-time jitter, comparable with the 30 fs pulse, so the timing tool is indispensable.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time", which statement holds?
options: 電子能量抖動 σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ 經共振條件 λ ∝ 1/γ² 變成光子能量抖動 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³，在 8.2 keV 為 8 eV，大於單發頻寬 3.8 eV，故非逐發量光譜就無法知道每發的能量。
機器保護系統只在束流完全丟失時才需要動作。
自由電子雷射的輸出功率和波盪器長度成正比。
optionsEn: Electron energy jitter σ_E/E = 5×10⁻⁴ becomes, through the resonance λ ∝ 1/γ², a photon-energy jitter of 2×5×10⁻⁴ = 1×10⁻³, that is 8 eV at 8.2 keV, larger than the 3.8 eV single-shot bandwidth, so the energy of each shot is unknown without a shot-by-shot spectrum.
Machine protection only needs to act when the beam is completely lost.

steps.title: 逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以量熱計或標定過的光二極體在不同脈衝能量下標定氣體偵測器的線性度；用已知吸收邊（例如 Fe K 邊 7.112 keV）標定光譜儀的能量軸；對時序工具，掃描泵浦雷射延遲並確認量到的到達時間分佈與電子束能量抖動的相關性；所有診斷的時間戳記必須與資料擷取系統逐發對齊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate gas-detector linearity against a calorimeter or calibrated photodiode over a range of pulse energies; calibrate the spectrometer energy axis with a known absorption edge such as the Fe K edge at 7.112 keV; for the timing tool, scan the pump-laser delay and confirm that the measured arrival-time distribution correlates with electron-energy jitter; and align every diagnostic's time stamp with the data-acquisition system shot by shot. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若實驗只用平均脈衝能量與名義延遲，泵浦-探測資料被 50 fs 的到達時間抖動塗抹，100 fs 的動力學訊號消失；更糟的是時間戳記錯位一發，整批資料與診斷配對錯誤而無法事後修正。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If an experiment uses only average pulse energy and nominal delay, 50 fs of arrival jitter smears the pump-probe data and a 100 fs dynamic signal disappears; worse, a one-shot offset in time stamps mispairs an entire run with its diagnostics beyond later repair.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以量熱計或標定過的光二極體在不同脈衝能量下標定氣體偵測器的線性度；用已知吸收邊（例如 Fe K 邊 7.112 keV）標定光譜儀的能量軸；對時序工具，掃描泵浦雷射延遲並確認量到的到達時間分佈與電子束能量抖動的相關性；所有診斷的時間戳記必須與資料擷取系統逐發對齊。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate gas-detector linearity against a calorimeter or calibrated photodiode over a range of pulse energies; calibrate the spectrometer energy axis with a known absorption edge such as the Fe K edge at 7.112 keV; for the timing tool, scan the pump-laser delay and confirm that the measured arrival-time distribution correlates with electron-energy jitter; and align every diagnostic's time stamp with the data-acquisition system shot by shot.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以量熱計或標定過的光二極體在不同脈衝能量下標定氣體偵測器的線性度。
波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Calibrate gas-detector linearity against a calorimeter or calibrated photodiode over a range of pulse energies.
An undulator is a passive magnet that needs no recalibration once installed.
quiz.explanation: 以量熱計或標定過的光二極體在不同脈衝能量下標定氣體偵測器的線性度；用已知吸收邊（例如 Fe K 邊 7.112 keV）標定光譜儀的能量軸；對時序工具，掃描泵浦雷射延遲並確認量到的到達時間分佈與電子束能量抖動的相關性；所有診斷的時間戳記必須與資料擷取系統逐發對齊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate gas-detector linearity against a calorimeter or calibrated photodiode over a range of pulse energies; calibrate the spectrometer energy axis with a known absorption edge such as the Fe K edge at 7.112 keV; for the timing tool, scan the pump-laser delay and confirm that the measured arrival-time distribution correlates with electron-energy jitter; and align every diagnostic's time stamp with the data-acquisition system shot by shot. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若實驗只用平均脈衝能量與名義延遲，泵浦-探測資料被 50 fs 的到達時間抖動塗抹，100 fs 的動力學訊號消失；更糟的是時間戳記錯位一發，整批資料與診斷配對錯誤而無法事後修正。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If an experiment uses only average pulse energy and nominal delay, 50 fs of arrival jitter smears the pump-probe data and a 100 fs dynamic signal disappears; worse, a one-shot offset in time stamps mispairs an entire run with its diagnostics beyond later repair. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：氣體偵測器以 X 光游離稀薄氣體並收集離子或電子電流，無損地量每發脈衝能量；彎晶單發光譜儀把頻譜展開到條狀偵測器上；時序工具以 X 光在薄膜上誘發的折射率跳變，用啁啾的光學脈衝把 X 光到達時間量到飛秒等級，事後把資料按真實延遲重新排序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gas detectors ionise dilute gas with the X-rays and collect ion or electron current to measure pulse energy non-destructively; a bent-crystal single-shot spectrometer spreads the spectrum onto a strip detector; and the timing tool uses the X-ray-induced refractive-index step in a thin film, probed by a chirped optical pulse, to measure X-ray arrival time at the femtosecond level so data can be re-sorted by true delay afterwards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若實驗只用平均脈衝能量與名義延遲，泵浦-探測資料被 50 fs 的到達時間抖動塗抹，100 fs 的動力學訊號消失；更糟的是時間戳記錯位一發，整批資料與診斷配對錯誤而無法事後修正。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。
若實驗只用平均脈衝能量與名義延遲，泵浦-探測資料被 50 fs 的到達時間抖動塗抹，100 fs 的動力學訊號消失。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Large pulse-energy fluctuation always means the accelerator is unstable.
If an experiment uses only average pulse energy and nominal delay, 50 fs of arrival jitter smears the pump-probe data and a 100 fs dynamic signal disappears.
quiz.explanation: 若實驗只用平均脈衝能量與名義延遲，泵浦-探測資料被 50 fs 的到達時間抖動塗抹，100 fs 的動力學訊號消失；更糟的是時間戳記錯位一發，整批資料與診斷配對錯誤而無法事後修正。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If an experiment uses only average pulse energy and nominal delay, 50 fs of arrival jitter smears the pump-probe data and a 100 fs dynamic signal disappears; worse, a one-shot offset in time stamps mispairs an entire run with its diagnostics beyond later repair. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SASE 脈衝由許多彼此不相干的縱向模式（尖峰）組成，尖峰的持續時間約為同調時間，由頻寬 ρ 決定；脈衝能量的逐發相對抖動近似為 1/√M，M 是模式數。長脈衝含數十到上百個尖峰，抖動只有百分之十幾；把束團壓到只含幾個模式時，抖動升到接近 100%，這正是 LCLS 短脈衝模式必須搭配逐發診斷的統計根源，也是「單尖峰」模式產生完全相干脈衝的原理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A SASE pulse consists of many mutually incoherent longitudinal modes (spikes); each spike lasts about one coherence time, set by the bandwidth ρ, and the shot-to-shot relative fluctuation of pulse energy is about 1/√M for M modes. A long pulse contains tens to a hundred spikes and fluctuates by only ten-odd percent; compressing the bunch to a few modes drives the fluctuation toward 100%, which is the statistical reason LCLS short-pulse modes need shot-by-shot diagnostics, and also the principle behind single-spike modes that yield fully coherent pulses. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mode count M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π): at 8.2 keV, ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s, ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴ and full pulse length T = 70 fs give M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64, so energy fluctuation ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Large pulse-energy fluctuation always means the accelerator is unstable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation" is correct?

脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。

steps.title: SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動：定量估算
steps.titleEn: SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：模式數 M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π)：8.2 keV 時 ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s，ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴，脈衝全寬 T = 70 fs → M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64，能量抖動 ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%。T = 5 fs 時 M ≈ 4.6，抖動 ≈ 47%；M = 1 時抖動 100%。同調時間 τ_c ≈ 2π/(ρω) ≈ 1.1 fs，對應合作長度 λ/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 15 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mode count M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π): at 8.2 keV, ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s, ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴ and full pulse length T = 70 fs give M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64, so energy fluctuation ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%. For T = 5 fs, M ≈ 4.6 and fluctuation ≈ 47%; for M = 1 it is 100%. The coherence time τ_c ≈ 2π/(ρω) ≈ 1.1 fs corresponds to a cooperation length λ/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 15 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從氣體偵測器累積數千發脈衝能量做直方圖，擬合伽瑪分佈取得 M，與 ρωT/2π 的估計比較；用單發光譜儀數尖峰數目與平均尖峰寬度核對同調時間；改變束團電荷或壓縮量，確認 M 隨脈衝長度線性變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Histogram several thousand gas-detector pulse energies, fit a gamma distribution to extract M and compare with the ρωT/2π estimate; count spikes and their mean width on the single-shot spectrometer to check the coherence time; and vary bunch charge or compression to confirm that M scales linearly with pulse length.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Mode count M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π): at 8.2 keV, ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s, ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴ and full pulse length T = 70 fs give M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64, so energy fluctuation ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%. For T = 5 fs, M ≈ 4.6 and fluctuation ≈ 47%; for M = 1 it is 100%. The coherence time τ_c ≈ 2π/(ρω) ≈ 1.1 fs corresponds to a cooperation length λ/(4π√3ρ) ≈ 15 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation", which statement holds?
options: 銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。
波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。
optionsEn: A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling.
Mode count M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π): at 8.2 keV, ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s, ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴ and full pulse length T = 70 fs give M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64, so energy fluctuation ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%.
An undulator is a passive magnet that needs no recalibration once installed.
quiz.explanationEn: Mode count M ≈ ρ·ω·T/(2π): at 8.2 keV, ω = 2πc/λ = 1.25×10¹⁹ rad/s, ρ = 4.6×10⁻⁴ and full pulse length T = 70 fs give M ≈ 4.6×10⁻⁴×1.25×10¹⁹×70×10⁻¹⁵/6.28 ≈ 64, so energy fluctuation ≈ 1/√64 ≈ 12%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從氣體偵測器累積數千發脈衝能量做直方圖，擬合伽瑪分佈取得 M，與 ρωT/2π 的估計比較；用單發光譜儀數尖峰數目與平均尖峰寬度核對同調時間；改變束團電荷或壓縮量，確認 M 隨脈衝長度線性變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Histogram several thousand gas-detector pulse energies, fit a gamma distribution to extract M and compare with the ρωT/2π estimate; count spikes and their mean width on the single-shot spectrometer to check the coherence time; and vary bunch charge or compression to confirm that M scales linearly with pulse length. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 SASE 的統計抖動誤當成機器故障而反覆調整直線加速器，反而引入真正的漂移；或者反過來把直線加速器的慢漂移誤當成 SASE 統計而不處理，兩種誤判都來自沒有先用直方圖分離隨機與系統成分。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Mistaking SASE statistical fluctuation for a machine fault and repeatedly retuning the linac introduces real drift; conversely, dismissing a slow linac drift as SASE statistics leaves it untreated.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從氣體偵測器累積數千發脈衝能量做直方圖，擬合伽瑪分佈取得 M，與 ρωT/2π 的估計比較；用單發光譜儀數尖峰數目與平均尖峰寬度核對同調時間；改變束團電荷或壓縮量，確認 M 隨脈衝長度線性變化。
knowledge.textEn: Histogram several thousand gas-detector pulse energies, fit a gamma distribution to extract M and compare with the ρωT/2π estimate; count spikes and their mean width on the single-shot spectrometer to check the coherence time; and vary bunch charge or compression to confirm that M scales linearly with pulse length.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。
從氣體偵測器累積數千發脈衝能量做直方圖，擬合伽瑪分佈取得 M，與 ρωT/2π 的估計比較。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.

quiz.explanationEn: Histogram several thousand gas-detector pulse energies, fit a gamma distribution to extract M and compare with the ρωT/2π estimate; count spikes and their mean width on the single-shot spectrometer to check the coherence time; and vary bunch charge or compression to confirm that M scales linearly with pulse length. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 SASE 的統計抖動誤當成機器故障而反覆調整直線加速器，反而引入真正的漂移；或者反過來把直線加速器的慢漂移誤當成 SASE 統計而不處理，兩種誤判都來自沒有先用直方圖分離隨機與系統成分。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking SASE statistical fluctuation for a machine fault and repeatedly retuning the linac introduces real drift; conversely, dismissing a slow linac drift as SASE statistics leaves it untreated. Both misjudgements come from not first separating random and systematic components with a histogram. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：長脈衝含數十到上百個尖峰，抖動只有百分之十幾；把束團壓到只含幾個模式時，抖動升到接近 100%，這正是 LCLS 短脈衝模式必須搭配逐發診斷的統計根源，也是「單尖峰」模式產生完全相干脈衝的原理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A long pulse contains tens to a hundred spikes and fluctuates by only ten-odd percent; compressing the bunch to a few modes drives the fluctuation toward 100%, which is the statistical reason LCLS short-pulse modes need shot-by-shot diagnostics, and also the principle behind single-spike modes that yield fully coherent pulses.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Large pulse-energy fluctuation always means the accelerator is unstable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把 SASE 的統計抖動誤當成機器故障而反覆調整直線加速器，反而引入真正的漂移；或者反過來把直線加速器的慢漂移誤當成 SASE 統計而不處理，兩種誤判都來自沒有先用直方圖分離隨機與系統成分。
knowledge.textEn: Mistaking SASE statistical fluctuation for a machine fault and repeatedly retuning the linac introduces real drift; conversely, dismissing a slow linac drift as SASE statistics leaves it untreated. Both misjudgements come from not first separating random and systematic components with a histogram.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「SASE 統計、同調時間與脈衝能量抖動」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "SASE statistics, coherence time and pulse-energy fluctuation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把 SASE 的統計抖動誤當成機器故障而反覆調整直線加速器，反而引入真正的漂移。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
超導腔沒有電阻，所以 2 K 下完全不產生熱。
optionsEn: Mistaking SASE statistical fluctuation for a machine fault and repeatedly retuning the linac introduces real drift.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so they produce no heat at 2 K.
quiz.explanation: 把 SASE 的統計抖動誤當成機器故障而反覆調整直線加速器，反而引入真正的漂移；或者反過來把直線加速器的慢漂移誤當成 SASE 統計而不處理，兩種誤判都來自沒有先用直方圖分離隨機與系統成分。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mistaking SASE statistical fluctuation for a machine fault and repeatedly retuning the linac introduces real drift; conversely, dismissing a slow linac drift as SASE statistics leaves it untreated. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合」與「高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "LCLS-II superconducting linac integration" and "Machine protection and acceptance at high average power": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: LCLS-II superconducting linac integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cryomodule string and the 2 K cryoplant” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 安裝 1.3 GHz 的 TESLA 型超導加速模組（每模組 8 個九腔鈮腔，另加 3.9 GHz 線性化模組），以約 16 MV/m 的連續波梯度把電子加速到 4 GeV；腔體以氮摻雜製程把 Q₀ 提高到 2.7×10¹⁰ 以壓低 2 K 熱負載。模組由 Fermilab 與 Jefferson Lab 組裝、測試後運到 SLAC 串接；2 K 低溫站的容量由所有腔體的動態損耗加靜態漏熱決定，再乘上 2 K 制冷的效率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz TESLA-type superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel (eight nine-cell niobium cavities per module, plus 3.9 GHz linearising modules), accelerating electrons to 4 GeV at a continuous-wave gradient of about 16 MV/m; nitrogen doping raises the cavity Q₀ to 2.7×10¹⁰ to limit the 2 K heat load. The modules were assembled and tested at Fermilab and Jefferson Lab and then strung together at SLAC; the 2 K cryoplant capacity follows from the dynamic loss of all cavities plus static heat leak, multiplied by the efficiency of 2 K refrigeration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cryomodule string and the 2 K cryoplant”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：35 個 1.3 GHz 模組×8 腔 = 280 腔，每腔 1.038 m、16 MV/m → 單腔 16.6 MV，總能量 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV，運轉 4 GeV 留餘裕。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 35 modules at 1.3 GHz × 8 cavities = 280 cavities; each 1.038 m at 16 MV/m gives 16.6 MV per cavity and 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV in total, leaving margin for 4 GeV operation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導腔沒有電阻，所以 2 K 下完全不產生熱。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so they produce no heat at 2 K." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: LCLS-II superconducting linac integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cryomodule string and the 2 K cryoplant” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：35 個 1.3 GHz 模組×8 腔 = 280 腔，每腔 1.038 m、16 MV/m → 單腔 16.6 MV，總能量 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV，運轉 4 GeV 留餘裕。每腔動態損耗 P = V²/((R/Q)Q₀) ≈ 9.9 W（連續波），280 腔 ≈ 2.8 kW（2 K）；2 K 制冷以每瓦約 800 W 的壁上電力（教學假設）換算，低溫站需約 2.2 MW 的電力，加上靜態漏熱後需要 4 kW 等級的 2 K 容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 35 modules at 1.3 GHz × 8 cavities = 280 cavities; each 1.038 m at 16 MV/m gives 16.6 MV per cavity and 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV in total, leaving margin for 4 GeV operation. Dynamic loss per cavity P = V²/((R/Q)Q₀) ≈ 9.9 W in continuous wave, about 2.8 kW at 2 K for 280 cavities; at roughly 800 W of wall-plug power per watt at 2 K (teaching assumption) the cryoplant draws about 2.2 MW, and with static heat leak a 2 K capacity of the 4 kW class is needed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個模組在組裝實驗室做低溫測試：量各腔的 Q₀ 對梯度曲線與場發射起始點，記錄 2 K 熱負載；串接後以量熱法（氦質量流量與焓差）量整條直線加速器的 2 K 總熱負載，與 280 腔的估算比較；以能譜儀驗證 4 GeV 與能散，並做 Lorentz 力失諧與微音效應（microphonics）的頻譜量測確認低階射頻控制餘裕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cold-test every module in the assembly laboratory: measure each cavity's Q₀ versus gradient and the field-emission onset and record the 2 K heat load; after stringing, measure the whole linac's 2 K load calorimetrically (helium mass flow times enthalpy difference) against the 280-cavity estimate; verify 4 GeV and energy spread with a spectrometer, and measure Lorentz-force detuning and microphonics spectra to confirm low-level RF control margin.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 35 個 1.3 GHz 模組×8 腔 = 280 腔，每腔 1.038 m、16 MV/m → 單腔 16.6 MV，總能量 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV，運轉 4 GeV 留餘裕。每腔動態損耗 P = V²/((R/Q)Q₀) ≈ 9.9 W（連續波），280 腔 ≈ 2.8 kW（2 K）；2 K 制冷以每瓦約 800 W 的壁上電力（教學假設）換算，低溫站需約 2.2 MW 的電力，加上靜態漏熱後需要 4 kW 等級的 2 K 容量。
knowledge.textEn: 35 modules at 1.3 GHz × 8 cavities = 280 cavities; each 1.038 m at 16 MV/m gives 16.6 MV per cavity and 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV in total, leaving margin for 4 GeV operation. Dynamic loss per cavity P = V²/((R/Q)Q₀) ≈ 9.9 W in continuous wave, about 2.8 kW at 2 K for 280 cavities; at roughly 800 W of wall-plug power per watt at 2 K (teaching assumption) the cryoplant draws about 2.2 MW, and with static heat leak a 2 K capacity of the 4 kW class is needed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "LCLS-II superconducting linac integration", which statement holds?

能散越小對自由電子雷射越好，所以應該完全避免加熱束流。
35 個 1.3 GHz 模組×8 腔 = 280 腔，每腔 1.038 m、16 MV/m → 單腔 16.6 MV，總能量 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV，運轉 4 GeV 留餘裕。
optionsEn: FEL output power is proportional to undulator length.
Smaller energy spread is always better for an FEL, so the beam should never be heated.
35 modules at 1.3 GHz × 8 cavities = 280 cavities.
quiz.explanation: 35 個 1.3 GHz 模組×8 腔 = 280 腔，每腔 1.038 m、16 MV/m → 單腔 16.6 MV，總能量 280×16.6 MV ≈ 4.65 GV，運轉 4 GeV 留餘裕。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: LCLS-II superconducting linac integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cryomodule string and the 2 K cryoplant” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每個模組在組裝實驗室做低溫測試：量各腔的 Q₀ 對梯度曲線與場發射起始點，記錄 2 K 熱負載；串接後以量熱法（氦質量流量與焓差）量整條直線加速器的 2 K 總熱負載，與 280 腔的估算比較；以能譜儀驗證 4 GeV 與能散，並做 Lorentz 力失諧與微音效應（microphonics）的頻譜量測確認低階射頻控制餘裕。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cold-test every module in the assembly laboratory: measure each cavity's Q₀ versus gradient and the field-emission onset and record the 2 K heat load; after stringing, measure the whole linac's 2 K load calorimetrically (helium mass flow times enthalpy difference) against the 280-cavity estimate; verify 4 GeV and energy spread with a spectrometer, and measure Lorentz-force detuning and microphonics spectra to confirm low-level RF control margin. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：少數腔體在運轉中因場發射或多次 quench 讓 Q₀ 掉到 1×10¹⁰，單腔損耗升到 27 W，整串的 2 K 負載超過低溫站容量，必須降梯度運轉，能量達不到 4 GeV，波盪器只好開大間隙而縮小光子能量範圍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If a few cavities lose Q₀ to 1×10¹⁰ through field emission or repeated quenches, their loss rises to 27 W each, the string's 2 K load exceeds the cryoplant, gradients must be lowered, 4 GeV is no longer reached, and undulators must open their gaps, shrinking the photon-energy range.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個模組在組裝實驗室做低溫測試：量各腔的 Q₀ 對梯度曲線與場發射起始點，記錄 2 K 熱負載；串接後以量熱法（氦質量流量與焓差）量整條直線加速器的 2 K 總熱負載，與 280 腔的估算比較；以能譜儀驗證 4 GeV 與能散，並做 Lorentz 力失諧與微音效應（microphonics）的頻譜量測確認低階射頻控制餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Cold-test every module in the assembly laboratory: measure each cavity's Q₀ versus gradient and the field-emission onset and record the 2 K heat load; after stringing, measure the whole linac's 2 K load calorimetrically (helium mass flow times enthalpy difference) against the 280-cavity estimate; verify 4 GeV and energy spread with a spectrometer, and measure Lorentz-force detuning and microphonics spectra to confirm low-level RF control margin.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "LCLS-II superconducting linac integration"?
options: 每個模組在組裝實驗室做低溫測試：量各腔的 Q₀ 對梯度曲線與場發射起始點，記錄 2 K 熱負載。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。
optionsEn: Cold-test every module in the assembly laboratory: measure each cavity's Q₀ versus gradient and the field-emission onset and record the 2 K heat load.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanationEn: Cold-test every module in the assembly laboratory: measure each cavity's Q₀ versus gradient and the field-emission onset and record the 2 K heat load; after stringing, measure the whole linac's 2 K load calorimetrically (helium mass flow times enthalpy difference) against the 280-cavity estimate; verify 4 GeV and energy spread with a spectrometer, and measure Lorentz-force detuning and microphonics spectra to confirm low-level RF control margin. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: LCLS-II superconducting linac integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cryomodule string and the 2 K cryoplant” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 少數腔體在運轉中因場發射或多次 quench 讓 Q₀ 掉到 1×10¹⁰，單腔損耗升到 27 W，整串的 2 K 負載超過低溫站容量，必須降梯度運轉，能量達不到 4 GeV，波盪器只好開大間隙而縮小光子能量範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If a few cavities lose Q₀ to 1×10¹⁰ through field emission or repeated quenches, their loss rises to 27 W each, the string's 2 K load exceeds the cryoplant, gradients must be lowered, 4 GeV is no longer reached, and undulators must open their gaps, shrinking the photon-energy range. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模組由 Fermilab 與 Jefferson Lab 組裝、測試後運到 SLAC 串接；2 K 低溫站的容量由所有腔體的動態損耗加靜態漏熱決定，再乘上 2 K 制冷的效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The modules were assembled and tested at Fermilab and Jefferson Lab and then strung together at SLAC; the 2 K cryoplant capacity follows from the dynamic loss of all cavities plus static heat leak, multiplied by the efficiency of 2 K refrigeration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導腔沒有電阻，所以 2 K 下完全不產生熱。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so they produce no heat at 2 K." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 少數腔體在運轉中因場發射或多次 quench 讓 Q₀ 掉到 1×10¹⁰，單腔損耗升到 27 W，整串的 2 K 負載超過低溫站容量，必須降梯度運轉，能量達不到 4 GeV，波盪器只好開大間隙而縮小光子能量範圍。
knowledge.textEn: If a few cavities lose Q₀ to 1×10¹⁰ through field emission or repeated quenches, their loss rises to 27 W each, the string's 2 K load exceeds the cryoplant, gradients must be lowered, 4 GeV is no longer reached, and undulators must open their gaps, shrinking the photon-energy range.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「LCLS-II 超導直線加速器整合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "LCLS-II superconducting linac integration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
少數腔體在運轉中因場發射或多次 quench 讓 Q₀ 掉到 1×10¹⁰，單腔損耗升到 27 W，整串的 2 K 負載超過低溫站容量，必須降梯度運轉，能量達不到 4 GeV，波盪器只好開大間隙而縮小光子能量範圍。
機器保護系統只在束流完全丟失時才需要動作。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

If a few cavities lose Q₀ to 1×10¹⁰ through field emission or repeated quenches, their loss rises to 27 W each, the string's 2 K load exceeds the cryoplant, gradients must be lowered, 4 GeV is no longer reached, and undulators must open their gaps, shrinking the photon-energy range.
Machine protection only needs to act when the beam is completely lost.
quiz.explanation: 少數腔體在運轉中因場發射或多次 quench 讓 Q₀ 掉到 1×10¹⁰，單腔損耗升到 27 W，整串的 2 K 負載超過低溫站容量，必須降梯度運轉，能量達不到 4 GeV，波盪器只好開大間隙而縮小光子能量範圍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a few cavities lose Q₀ to 1×10¹⁰ through field emission or repeated quenches, their loss rises to 27 W each, the string's 2 K load exceeds the cryoplant, gradients must be lowered, 4 GeV is no longer reached, and undulators must open their gaps, shrinking the photon-energy range. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Machine protection and acceptance at high average power: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」如何決定SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Machine protection and user-delivery specification” determines the key performance of “SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 1 MHz 連續波束流的平均功率達數百千瓦，任何導向錯誤都會在毫秒內熔穿真空腔，所以機器保護系統（MPS）必須以束流損失監視器、電流差分與溫度感測在百微秒內切斷注入器雷射。使用者驗收規格則包含光子能量範圍、脈衝能量、到達時間抖動、重複率與可用度；每一項都要綁定運轉模式（電荷、壓縮、波盪器設定），因為同一台機器在不同模式下的性能差異很大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A 1 MHz continuous-wave beam carries hundreds of kilowatts of average power, and any steering error would melt through a chamber within milliseconds, so the machine protection system (MPS) must cut the injector laser within about a hundred microseconds using beam-loss monitors, current differencing and temperature sensors. The user-acceptance specification covers photon-energy range, pulse energy, arrival-time jitter, repetition rate and availability, each bound to an operating mode (charge, compression, undulator settings) because the same machine performs very differently across modes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Machine protection and user-delivery specification”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平均束流功率 P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機器保護系統只在束流完全丟失時才需要動作。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Machine protection only needs to act when the beam is completely lost." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Machine protection and user-delivery specification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

1 MHz 連續波束流的平均功率達數百千瓦，任何導向錯誤都會在毫秒內熔穿真空腔，所以機器保護系統（MPS）必須以束流損失監視器、電流差分與溫度感測在百微秒內切斷注入器雷射。

steps.title: 高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Machine protection and acceptance at high average power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Machine protection and user-delivery specification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平均束流功率 P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW。若導向錯誤把束流集中在 1 mm² 的鋁腔壁上，100 µs 內沉積 40 J，足以把該體積加熱數千度；MPS 的反應時間必須遠小於此。光子端：100 µJ×1 MHz = 100 W 平均功率落在第一面鏡子，與 120 Hz 時代 2 mJ×120 Hz = 0.24 W 相比高 400 倍，鏡面必須水冷並控制熱斜率誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW. A steering error concentrating the beam on 1 mm² of aluminium chamber wall deposits 40 J within 100 µs, enough to heat that volume by thousands of degrees, so the MPS reaction must be far shorter. On the photon side, 100 µJ×1 MHz = 100 W of average power lands on the first mirror, 400 times the 2 mJ×120 Hz = 0.24 W of the 120 Hz era, so mirrors must be water-cooled with controlled thermal slope error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間；用量熱法驗證束流吸收器與第一面鏡的熱負載和溫升；在每一種交付模式下量脈衝能量直方圖、光譜與到達時間抖動並寫入規格表；以一段時間的運轉紀錄計算可用度與平均故障間隔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate; verify the heat load and temperature rise of beam absorbers and the first mirror calorimetrically; in every delivery mode measure the pulse-energy histogram, spectrum and arrival-time jitter and enter them in the specification table; and compute availability and mean time between failures from a period of operating logs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 平均束流功率 P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW。若導向錯誤把束流集中在 1 mm² 的鋁腔壁上，100 µs 內沉積 40 J，足以把該體積加熱數千度；MPS 的反應時間必須遠小於此。光子端：100 µJ×1 MHz = 100 W 平均功率落在第一面鏡子，與 120 Hz 時代 2 mJ×120 Hz = 0.24 W 相比高 400 倍，鏡面必須水冷並控制熱斜率誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW. A steering error concentrating the beam on 1 mm² of aluminium chamber wall deposits 40 J within 100 µs, enough to heat that volume by thousands of degrees, so the MPS reaction must be far shorter. On the photon side, 100 µJ×1 MHz = 100 W of average power lands on the first mirror, 400 times the 2 mJ×120 Hz = 0.24 W of the 120 Hz era, so mirrors must be water-cooled with controlled thermal slope error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Machine protection and acceptance at high average power", which statement holds?
options: 平均束流功率 P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW。
波盪器是被動磁鐵，裝好以後不需要再校正。
自由電子雷射像傳統雷射一樣，每一發脈衝都相同。
optionsEn: Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW.
An undulator is a passive magnet that needs no recalibration once installed.
An FEL, like a conventional laser, emits identical pulses every shot.
quiz.explanation: 平均束流功率 P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Average beam power P = E·Q·f = 4 GV×100 pC×1 MHz = 400 kW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Machine protection and acceptance at high average power: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Machine protection and user-delivery specification” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間；用量熱法驗證束流吸收器與第一面鏡的熱負載和溫升；在每一種交付模式下量脈衝能量直方圖、光譜與到達時間抖動並寫入規格表；以一段時間的運轉紀錄計算可用度與平均故障間隔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate; verify the heat load and temperature rise of beam absorbers and the first mirror calorimetrically; in every delivery mode measure the pulse-energy histogram, spectrum and arrival-time jitter and enter them in the specification table; and compute availability and mean time between failures from a period of operating logs. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降；若 MPS 門檻依 120 Hz 的損失設定，連續波下的慢損失不會觸發而長期活化元件，維修人員承受不必要的劑量。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity; if MPS thresholds follow 120 Hz loss levels, slow CW losses never trip and components are activated over time, exposing maintenance staff to needless dose.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間；用量熱法驗證束流吸收器與第一面鏡的熱負載和溫升；在每一種交付模式下量脈衝能量直方圖、光譜與到達時間抖動並寫入規格表；以一段時間的運轉紀錄計算可用度與平均故障間隔。
knowledge.textEn: Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate; verify the heat load and temperature rise of beam absorbers and the first mirror calorimetrically; in every delivery mode measure the pulse-energy histogram, spectrum and arrival-time jitter and enter them in the specification table; and compute availability and mean time between failures from a period of operating logs.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Machine protection and acceptance at high average power"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間。
脈衝能量抖動大一定代表加速器不穩定。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate.
Large pulse-energy fluctuation always means the accelerator is unstable.
quiz.explanation: 以可控的小幅導向錯誤在低重複率下測試 MPS 的觸發門檻與反應時間；用量熱法驗證束流吸收器與第一面鏡的熱負載和溫升；在每一種交付模式下量脈衝能量直方圖、光譜與到達時間抖動並寫入規格表；以一段時間的運轉紀錄計算可用度與平均故障間隔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test MPS thresholds and reaction time with controlled small steering errors at low repetition rate; verify the heat load and temperature rise of beam absorbers and the first mirror calorimetrically; in every delivery mode measure the pulse-energy histogram, spectrum and arrival-time jitter and enter them in the specification table; and compute availability and mean time between failures from a period of operating logs. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Machine protection and acceptance at high average power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Machine protection and user-delivery specification” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降；若 MPS 門檻依 120 Hz 的損失設定，連續波下的慢損失不會觸發而長期活化元件，維修人員承受不必要的劑量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity; if MPS thresholds follow 120 Hz loss levels, slow CW losses never trip and components are activated over time, exposing maintenance staff to needless dose. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用者驗收規格則包含光子能量範圍、脈衝能量、到達時間抖動、重複率與可用度；每一項都要綁定運轉模式（電荷、壓縮、波盪器設定），因為同一台機器在不同模式下的性能差異很大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The user-acceptance specification covers photon-energy range, pulse energy, arrival-time jitter, repetition rate and availability, each bound to an operating mode (charge, compression, undulator settings) because the same machine performs very differently across modes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「機器保護系統只在束流完全丟失時才需要動作。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Machine protection only needs to act when the beam is completely lost." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降；若 MPS 門檻依 120 Hz 的損失設定，連續波下的慢損失不會觸發而長期活化元件，維修人員承受不必要的劑量。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity; if MPS thresholds follow 120 Hz loss levels, slow CW losses never trip and components are activated over time, exposing maintenance staff to needless dose.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Machine protection and acceptance at high average power" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
銅直線加速器只要加強冷卻就能連續波運轉。
把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A copper linac could run continuous wave with just more cooling.
Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity.
quiz.explanation: 把 120 Hz 時代驗收的鏡面與光闌直接用於 1 MHz，熱凸起把聚焦斑放大數倍且位置漂移，實驗靈敏度下降；若 MPS 門檻依 120 Hz 的損失設定，連續波下的慢損失不會觸發而長期活化元件，維修人員承受不必要的劑量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing mirrors and masks accepted in the 120 Hz era at 1 MHz lets thermal bumps enlarge the focal spot several times and drift its position, degrading experimental sensitivity; if MPS thresholds follow 120 Hz loss levels, slow CW losses never trip and components are activated over time, exposing maintenance staff to needless dose. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射
summary: 從 European XFEL 的 3.4 km 超導直線加速器與每秒 10 列、每列最多 2700 發的突發模式出發，理解射頻脈衝預算、波盪器共振與段間相位、2 K 低溫負載、掠射反射鏡面形、AGIPD 記憶格校正、束團分配與機器保護如何串成一座可交接的硬 X 光雷射設施。
summaryEn: Starting from the 3.4 km superconducting linac of European XFEL and its burst mode of 10 trains per second with up to 2700 pulses each, see how the RF pulse budget, undulator resonance and inter-segment phase, 2 K cryogenic load, grazing-mirror figure, AGIPD memory-cell calibration, bunch distribution and machine protection combine into a hard X-ray laser facility that can be handed over.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.
