只要每段波盪器的 K 值都調好，段與段之間的間隔不會影響增益。
以暗場（無 X 光）量每個記憶格的偏移與雜訊。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
If every segment has the right K, the gaps between segments cannot affect the gain.
Take dark frames without X-rays to obtain offset and noise per memory cell.
quiz.explanation: 以暗場（無 X 光）量每個記憶格的偏移與雜訊；以晶片內建的脈衝電流源掃描三段增益的切換點與斜率；以已知能量的螢光做平場，用單光子峰把 ADU 換算成光子數；最後以粉末繞射環等標準樣品檢查強度在不同記憶格與增益交界處是否一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take dark frames without X-rays to obtain offset and noise per memory cell; sweep the on-chip pulsed current source to find the switching points and slopes of all three gain stages; flat-field with fluorescence of known energy and convert ADU to photons with the single-photon peak; finally check with a reference sample such as powder-diffraction rings that intensities agree across memory cells and gain boundaries. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: MHz 偵測器：增益切換、記憶格與逐格校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: MHz detectors: gain switching, memory cells and per-cell calibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「AGIPD 百萬畫素偵測器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “AGIPD megapixel detector” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若部分記憶格的偏移隨溫度漂移卻沿用舊常數，影像出現隨脈衝序號變化的條紋；增益切換門檻校正不準時，強布拉格峰在增益交界處出現階梯，結構解析的強度資料產生系統偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If some memory-cell offsets drift with temperature while old constants stay in use, images show stripes that change with pulse index; if gain-switch thresholds are miscalibrated, strong Bragg peaks show steps at gain boundaries and structural intensity data become systematically biased. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是每個畫素、每個記憶格、每段增益都有自己的偏移與增益係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is that every pixel, memory cell and gain stage has its own offset and gain coefficient.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個畫素只要一組偏移與增益常數就能完成校正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One offset and one gain constant per pixel are enough to calibrate the detector." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若部分記憶格的偏移隨溫度漂移卻沿用舊常數，影像出現隨脈衝序號變化的條紋；增益切換門檻校正不準時，強布拉格峰在增益交界處出現階梯，結構解析的強度資料產生系統偏差。
knowledge.textEn: If some memory-cell offsets drift with temperature while old constants stay in use, images show stripes that change with pulse index; if gain-switch thresholds are miscalibrated, strong Bragg peaks show steps at gain boundaries and structural intensity data become systematically biased.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「MHz 偵測器：增益切換、記憶格與逐格校正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "MHz detectors: gain switching, memory cells and per-cell calibration" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若部分記憶格的偏移隨溫度漂移卻沿用舊常數，影像出現隨脈衝序號變化的條紋；增益切換門檻校正不準時，強布拉格峰在增益交界處出現階梯，結構解析的強度資料產生系統偏差。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。
optionsEn: If some memory-cell offsets drift with temperature while old constants stay in use, images show stripes that change with pulse index.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent.
quiz.explanation: 若部分記憶格的偏移隨溫度漂移卻沿用舊常數，影像出現隨脈衝序號變化的條紋；增益切換門檻校正不準時，強布拉格峰在增益交界處出現階梯，結構解析的強度資料產生系統偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If some memory-cell offsets drift with temperature while old constants stay in use, images show stripes that change with pulse index; if gain-switch thresholds are miscalibrated, strong Bragg peaks show steps at gain boundaries and structural intensity data become systematically biased. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發」與「機器保護、束流功率與營運交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking" and "Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast kickers and bunch pattern” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 加速器末端以快速踢磁鐵與平頂踢磁鐵把同一列中的束團分到兩條電子束線：一條通往 SASE2，另一條依序通過 SASE1 與 SASE3，SASE3 使用 SASE1 下游的同一批電子。三台波盪器因此共用電子能量，但以各自的間隙設定光子能量；分配切換需要一段時間空檔，各光束線的束團數會互相牽動。實驗站（SPB/SFX、FXE、MID、HED、SQS、SCS）再依偵測器與樣品更新速度選擇列內重複率，不用的束團由踢磁鐵送入束流捕集器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the end of the linac, fast and flat-top kickers distribute bunches of the same train into two electron beamlines: one feeds SASE2 and the other passes through SASE1 and then SASE3, which uses the same electrons downstream of SASE1. The three undulators therefore share one electron energy but set their photon energies with their own gaps; switching needs a time gap, so the bunch counts of the beamlines are coupled. Instruments (SPB/SFX, FXE, MID, HED, SQS, SCS) then choose an intra-train repetition rate to suit detector and sample refresh, and unused bunches are kicked into beam dumps. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast kickers and bunch pattern”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設分配切換空檔 20 µs（教學假設），每次切換損失 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 個束團位置，約佔 2700 的 3.3%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a 20 µs switching gap (teaching assumption): each switch loses 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 bunch slots, 3.3% of 2700.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fast kickers and bunch pattern”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發
knowledge.titleEn: Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking
knowledge.text: 加速器末端以快速踢磁鐵與平頂踢磁鐵把同一列中的束團分到兩條電子束線：一條通往 SASE2，另一條依序通過 SASE1 與 SASE3，SASE3 使用 SASE1 下游的同一批電子。三台波盪器因此共用電子能量，但以各自的間隙設定光子能量；分配切換需要一段時間空檔，各光束線的束團數會互相牽動。
knowledge.textEn: At the end of the linac, fast and flat-top kickers distribute bunches of the same train into two electron beamlines: one feeds SASE2 and the other passes through SASE1 and then SASE3, which uses the same electrons downstream of SASE1. The three undulators therefore share one electron energy but set their photon energies with their own gaps; switching needs a time gap, so the bunch counts of the beamlines are coupled.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking" is correct?
options: 三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。
加速器末端以快速踢磁鐵與平頂踢磁鐵把同一列中的束團分到兩條電子束線：一條通往 SASE2，另一條依序通過 SASE1 與 SASE3，SASE3 使用 SASE1 下游的同一批電子。
超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。
optionsEn: The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent.

At the end of the linac, fast and flat-top kickers distribute bunches of the same train into two electron beamlines: one feeds SASE2 and the other passes through SASE1 and then SASE3, which uses the same electrons downstream of SASE1.
A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 加速器末端以快速踢磁鐵與平頂踢磁鐵把同一列中的束團分到兩條電子束線：一條通往 SASE2，另一條依序通過 SASE1 與 SASE3，SASE3 使用 SASE1 下游的同一批電子。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At the end of the linac, fast and flat-top kickers distribute bunches of the same train into two electron beamlines: one feeds SASE2 and the other passes through SASE1 and then SASE3, which uses the same electrons downstream of SASE1. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast kickers and bunch pattern” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設分配切換空檔 20 µs（教學假設），每次切換損失 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 個束團位置，約佔 2700 的 3.3%。若 SASE2 分得 1000 發，SASE1/3 剩 2700 − 1000 − 90 = 1610 發。14 GeV 時 SASE1 在 K = 2.5 給 11.3 keV，同一批電子進 SASE3 若要 1.0 keV，需 K ≈ 7.3（λu = 68 mm）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a 20 µs switching gap (teaching assumption): each switch loses 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 bunch slots, 3.3% of 2700. If SASE2 receives 1000 bunches, SASE1/3 keep 2700 − 1000 − 90 = 1610. At 14 GeV, SASE1 at K = 2.5 gives 11.3 keV, and for the same electrons to give 1.0 keV in SASE3 needs K ≈ 7.3 (λu = 68 mm). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求；在切換點附近檢查第一個與最後一個束團的軌跡與能量，確認踢磁鐵上升沿與平頂起伏沒有讓邊緣束團偏離波盪器軸線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing; near each switching point inspect the orbit and energy of the first and last bunch to make sure that kicker rise and flat-top ripple do not push edge bunches off the undulator axis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設分配切換空檔 20 µs（教學假設），每次切換損失 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 個束團位置，約佔 2700 的 3.3%。若 SASE2 分得 1000 發，SASE1/3 剩 2700 − 1000 − 90 = 1610 發。14 GeV 時 SASE1 在 K = 2.5 給 11.3 keV，同一批電子進 SASE3 若要 1.0 keV，需 K ≈ 7.3（λu = 68 mm）。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a 20 µs switching gap (teaching assumption): each switch loses 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 bunch slots, 3.3% of 2700. If SASE2 receives 1000 bunches, SASE1/3 keep 2700 − 1000 − 90 = 1610. At 14 GeV, SASE1 at K = 2.5 gives 11.3 keV, and for the same electrons to give 1.0 keV in SASE3 needs K ≈ 7.3 (λu = 68 mm).

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking", which statement holds?
options: 要改變 X 光光子能量就一定得改變電子束能量。
只要每段波盪器的 K 值都調好，段與段之間的間隔不會影響增益。
假設分配切換空檔 20 µs（教學假設），每次切換損失 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 個束團位置，約佔 2700 的 3.3%。
optionsEn: Changing the X-ray photon energy always requires changing the electron energy.
If every segment has the right K, the gaps between segments cannot affect the gain.
Assume a 20 µs switching gap (teaching assumption): each switch loses 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 bunch slots, 3.3% of 2700.
quiz.explanation: 假設分配切換空檔 20 µs（教學假設），每次切換損失 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 個束團位置，約佔 2700 的 3.3%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume a 20 µs switching gap (teaching assumption): each switch loses 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 bunch slots, 3.3% of 2700. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fast kickers and bunch pattern” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求；在切換點附近檢查第一個與最後一個束團的軌跡與能量，確認踢磁鐵上升沿與平頂起伏沒有讓邊緣束團偏離波盪器軸線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing; near each switching point inspect the orbit and energy of the first and last bunch to make sure that kicker rise and flat-top ripple do not push edge bunches off the undulator axis. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏；使用者若沒有記錄束團模式，容易把它誤認為樣品響應。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index; users who do not record the bunch pattern easily mistake it for a sample response.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求；在切換點附近檢查第一個與最後一個束團的軌跡與能量，確認踢磁鐵上升沿與平頂起伏沒有讓邊緣束團偏離波盪器軸線。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing; near each switching point inspect the orbit and energy of the first and last bunch to make sure that kicker rise and flat-top ripple do not push edge bunches off the undulator axis.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking"?
options: 以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。
optionsEn: Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise.
quiz.explanation: 以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求；在切換點附近檢查第一個與最後一個束團的軌跡與能量，確認踢磁鐵上升沿與平頂起伏沒有讓邊緣束團偏離波盪器軸線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing; near each switching point inspect the orbit and energy of the first and last bunch to make sure that kicker rise and flat-top ripple do not push edge bunches off the undulator axis. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fast kickers and bunch pattern” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏；使用者若沒有記錄束團模式，容易把它誤認為樣品響應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index; users who do not record the bunch pattern easily mistake it for a sample response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實驗站（SPB/SFX、FXE、MID、HED、SQS、SCS）再依偵測器與樣品更新速度選擇列內重複率，不用的束團由踢磁鐵送入束流捕集器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Instruments (SPB/SFX, FXE, MID, HED, SQS, SCS) then choose an intra-train repetition rate to suit detector and sample refresh, and unused bunches are kicked into beam dumps.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏；使用者若沒有記錄束團模式，容易把它誤認為樣品響應。
knowledge.textEn: A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index; users who do not record the bunch pattern easily mistake it for a sample response.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏。
超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index.
A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏；使用者若沒有記錄束團模式，容易把它誤認為樣品響應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index; users who do not record the bunch pattern easily mistake it for a sample response. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束流損失監測與捕集器」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-loss monitors and dumps” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在 17.5 GeV、每秒 27,000 個束團下，電子束平均功率可達百 kW 級以上，一整列打到真空管或波盪器磁鐵都可能造成損傷，或讓 NdFeB 永久磁鐵受輻射去磁。機器保護系統以束流損失監測器、軌跡與入出口電荷差在脈衝列內即時判斷，在微秒級時間內停止後續束團；波盪器旁的劑量計長期追蹤累積輻射。X 光側也要限制每列的總能量，避免反射鏡與樣品前光學元件被熱負載或燒蝕破壞。交接時要把能量、電荷、列長、波盪器設定、偵測器模式與保護門檻一起記錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流損失監測與捕集器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At 17.5 GeV and 27,000 bunches per second the average electron-beam power reaches the hundred-kilowatt class, and a whole train hitting the vacuum pipe or undulator magnets can cause damage or radiation-induced demagnetisation of the NdFeB magnets. Machine protection judges beam-loss monitors, orbit and the charge difference between entrance and exit within the train and stops the following bunches within microseconds, while dosimeters beside the undulators track accumulated radiation. On the X-ray side the energy per train must also be limited so that mirrors and optics in front of the sample are not destroyed by heat or ablation. The handoff records energy, charge, train length, undulator settings, detector mode and protection thresholds together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-loss monitors and dumps”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：束流平均功率 P = E·q·f：E = 17.5 GeV、q = 0.25 nC、27,000 束團/s 時 P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW，q = 1 nC 時約 473 kW；每列電子能量約 11.8 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Average beam power is P = E·q·f: for E = 17.5 GeV, q = 0.25 nC and 27,000 bunches/s, P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW, and about 473 kW at 1 nC; each train carries about 11.8 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束流損失監測與捕集器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Beam-loss monitors and dumps”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接
knowledge.titleEn: Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff

knowledge.textEn: At 17.5 GeV and 27,000 bunches per second the average electron-beam power reaches the hundred-kilowatt class, and a whole train hitting the vacuum pipe or undulator magnets can cause damage or radiation-induced demagnetisation of the NdFeB magnets. Machine protection judges beam-loss monitors, orbit and the charge difference between entrance and exit within the train and stops the following bunches within microseconds, while dosimeters beside the undulators track accumulated radiation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「機器保護、束流功率與營運交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff" is correct?
options: 超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。
超導腔沒有損耗，所以脈衝列可以任意加長，只受電子槍限制。
在 17.5 GeV、每秒 27,000 個束團下，電子束平均功率可達百 kW 級以上，一整列打到真空管或波盪器磁鐵都可能造成損傷，或讓 NdFeB 永久磁鐵受輻射去磁。
optionsEn: A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary.
Superconducting cavities are lossless, so the train can be made arbitrarily long and only the gun limits it.

At 17.5 GeV and 27,000 bunches per second the average electron-beam power reaches the hundred-kilowatt class, and a whole train hitting the vacuum pipe or undulator magnets can cause damage or radiation-induced demagnetisation of the NdFeB magnets.

quiz.explanationEn: At 17.5 GeV and 27,000 bunches per second the average electron-beam power reaches the hundred-kilowatt class, and a whole train hitting the vacuum pipe or undulator magnets can cause damage or radiation-induced demagnetisation of the NdFeB magnets. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束流損失監測與捕集器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-loss monitors and dumps” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：束流平均功率 P = E·q·f：E = 17.5 GeV、q = 0.25 nC、27,000 束團/s 時 P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW，q = 1 nC 時約 473 kW；每列電子能量約 11.8 kJ。X 光每發 2 mJ 在 12.4 keV 約 1.0×10¹² 光子，2700 發在 0.6 ms 內傳送 5.4 J，列內瞬時功率約 9 kW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average beam power is P = E·q·f: for E = 17.5 GeV, q = 0.25 nC and 27,000 bunches/s, P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW, and about 473 kW at 1 nC; each train carries about 11.8 kJ. At 2 mJ per X-ray pulse, 12.4 keV gives about 1.0×10¹² photons, and 2700 pulses deliver 5.4 J in 0.6 ms, about 9 kW during the train. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收時以低電荷單束團做受控損失測試，確認損失監測器在預期時間內觸發並中止後續束團；比對入出口電荷監測器在正常運轉時的差值低於門檻；定期讀取波盪器劑量計並以 K 值追蹤確認沒有去磁；為每條光束線列出最大列能量下各光學元件的熱負載評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During acceptance perform controlled-loss tests with a single low-charge bunch and confirm that the loss monitors trip and stop the following bunches within the expected time; check that the entrance-to-exit charge difference stays below threshold in normal running; read undulator dosimeters periodically and track K to confirm no demagnetisation; and list the heat-load assessment of every optical element at the maximum train energy for each beamline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 束流平均功率 P = E·q·f：E = 17.5 GeV、q = 0.25 nC、27,000 束團/s 時 P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW，q = 1 nC 時約 473 kW；每列電子能量約 11.8 kJ。X 光每發 2 mJ 在 12.4 keV 約 1.0×10¹² 光子，2700 發在 0.6 ms 內傳送 5.4 J，列內瞬時功率約 9 kW。
knowledge.textEn: Average beam power is P = E·q·f: for E = 17.5 GeV, q = 0.25 nC and 27,000 bunches/s, P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW, and about 473 kW at 1 nC; each train carries about 11.8 kJ. At 2 mJ per X-ray pulse, 12.4 keV gives about 1.0×10¹² photons, and 2700 pulses deliver 5.4 J in 0.6 ms, about 9 kW during the train.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「機器保護、束流功率與營運交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff", which statement holds?
options: 超導腔沒有電阻，所以低溫系統只需補償外界熱漏。
掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。

Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so the cryoplant only has to cover external heat leaks.
At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise.

quiz.explanationEn: Average beam power is P = E·q·f: for E = 17.5 GeV, q = 0.25 nC and 27,000 bunches/s, P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW, and about 473 kW at 1 nC; each train carries about 11.8 kJ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束流損失監測與捕集器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Beam-loss monitors and dumps” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收時以低電荷單束團做受控損失測試，確認損失監測器在預期時間內觸發並中止後續束團；比對入出口電荷監測器在正常運轉時的差值低於門檻；定期讀取波盪器劑量計並以 K 值追蹤確認沒有去磁；為每條光束線列出最大列能量下各光學元件的熱負載評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During acceptance perform controlled-loss tests with a single low-charge bunch and confirm that the loss monitors trip and stop the following bunches within the expected time; check that the entrance-to-exit charge difference stays below threshold in normal running; read undulator dosimeters periodically and track K to confirm no demagnetisation; and list the heat-load assessment of every optical element at the maximum train energy for each beamline. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若保護系統只在列與列之間判斷而無法在列內中止，一次軌跡錯誤會讓整列約 12 kJ 的電子能量集中在同一點，熔穿真空管或讓一段波盪器去磁，造成數週停機與重新磁量測。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If protection only acts between trains and cannot stop a train in progress, a single orbit error dumps about 12 kJ of electron energy into one spot, which can puncture the vacuum pipe or demagnetise an undulator segment and cause weeks of downtime and remeasurement.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收時以低電荷單束團做受控損失測試，確認損失監測器在預期時間內觸發並中止後續束團；比對入出口電荷監測器在正常運轉時的差值低於門檻；定期讀取波盪器劑量計並以 K 值追蹤確認沒有去磁；為每條光束線列出最大列能量下各光學元件的熱負載評估。
knowledge.textEn: During acceptance perform controlled-loss tests with a single low-charge bunch and confirm that the loss monitors trip and stop the following bunches within the expected time; check that the entrance-to-exit charge difference stays below threshold in normal running; read undulator dosimeters periodically and track K to confirm no demagnetisation; and list the heat-load assessment of every optical element at the maximum train energy for each beamline.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「機器保護、束流功率與營運交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff"?

optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

steps.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束流損失監測與捕集器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Beam-loss monitors and dumps” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若保護系統只在列與列之間判斷而無法在列內中止，一次軌跡錯誤會讓整列約 12 kJ 的電子能量集中在同一點，熔穿真空管或讓一段波盪器去磁，造成數週停機與重新磁量測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If protection only acts between trains and cannot stop a train in progress, a single orbit error dumps about 12 kJ of electron energy into one spot, which can puncture the vacuum pipe or demagnetise an undulator segment and cause weeks of downtime and remeasurement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時要把能量、電荷、列長、波盪器設定、偵測器模式與保護門檻一起記錄。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

title: ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT
summary: 以 Paranal 山頂四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡為對象，從視寧度與繞射的差距出發，拆解 Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與多焦點、177 mm 薄 Zerodur 主鏡製作、1170 致動器可變形副鏡、四雷射導引星、VLTI 延遲線與 ESPRESSO 的 10 cm/s 量測，最後整合成多望遠鏡的營運交接。
summaryEn: Taking the four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes on Cerro Paranal, start from the gap between seeing and diffraction and work through the Ritchey–Chrétien train and its foci, the 177 mm thin Zerodur primary, the 1170-actuator deformable secondary, four laser guide stars, VLTI delay lines and ESPRESSO's 10 cm/s measurement, ending in a multi-telescope operational handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: UT4 自適應光學 K 波段練習：假設 500 nm 的 r₀ = 0.15 m，換算到 2.2 µm 為 r₀ = 0.15 × (2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 0.89 m。擬合誤差以投影間距 0.205 m 計 σ_fit² ≈ 0.28 × (0.205/0.89)^5/3 ≈ 0.024 rad²；風速 15 m/s 時 Greenwood 頻率 f_G = 0.427v/r₀ ≈ 7.2 Hz，假設修正頻寬 60 Hz，時間誤差 σ_t² = (7.2/60)^5/3 ≈ 0.029 rad²；另給雜訊與混疊 0.03 rad²。總和 0.084 rad²，Strehl ≈ exp(−0.084) ≈ 0.92。修正後影像寬約 λ/D ≈ 55 mas，而 K 波段未修正視寧度約 0.50″，相差約 9 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表 VLT 的實際規格。
workedExample.textEn: UT4 adaptive-optics exercise in K band: assume r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm, which scales to r₀ = 0.15 × (2.2/0.5)^1.2 ≈ 0.89 m at 2.2 µm. With a projected pitch of 0.205 m the fitting error is σ_fit² ≈ 0.28 × (0.205/0.89)^5/3 ≈ 0.024 rad²; for a 15 m/s wind the Greenwood frequency is f_G = 0.427v/r₀ ≈ 7.2 Hz, and with an assumed 60 Hz correction bandwidth the temporal error is σ_t² = (7.2/60)^5/3 ≈ 0.029 rad²; allow 0.03 rad² for noise and aliasing. The total is 0.084 rad² and Strehl ≈ exp(−0.084) ≈ 0.92. The corrected image is about λ/D ≈ 55 mas wide, against about 0.50″ of uncorrected K-band seeing, a factor of about 9. Values are teaching assumptions, not VLT specifications.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界」與「RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary" and "RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VLT 由四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡、四座可移動的 1.8 m 輔助望遠鏡與地下干涉實驗室組成，涵蓋近紫外到 25 µm。口徑帶來兩種好處：集光面積讓暗弱天體在有限時間內達到訊雜比，角解析度則理論上隨 λ/D 變好；但大氣湍流把波前切成尺寸約 Fried 參數 r₀ 的同調區塊，未修正時影像寬度由 λ/r₀ 決定，與口徑無關。因此 VLT 的工程設計一直沿著兩條線前進：把四座望遠鏡的光合在一起增加集光或基線，以及以主動與自適應光學把影像拉回繞射極限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The VLT comprises four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes, four relocatable 1.8 m Auxiliary Telescopes and an underground interferometric laboratory, covering the near ultraviolet to 25 µm. Aperture brings two benefits: collecting area lets faint targets reach a useful signal-to-noise ratio in finite time, and angular resolution in principle improves as λ/D. Atmospheric turbulence, however, breaks the wavefront into coherent patches of about the Fried parameter r₀, so the uncorrected image width is set by λ/r₀ regardless of aperture. VLT engineering has therefore advanced along two lines: combining the four telescopes for more collecting area or longer baselines, and using active and adaptive optics to pull images back toward the diffraction limit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取 r₀ = 0.15 m（500 nm，假設），視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″，而 8.2 m 的繞射極限 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas，差 40 倍以上；D/r₀ ≈ 55，瞳面約含 (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 個同調區塊。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm (assumption): seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″, while the 8.2 m diffraction limit 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas is more than 40 times smaller; D/r₀ ≈ 55, so the pupil holds about (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 coherent patches.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「望遠鏡口徑加倍，地面影像的解析度就一定加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling the aperture always doubles the resolution of ground-based images." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Aperture brings two benefits: collecting area lets faint targets reach a useful signal-to-noise ratio in finite time, and angular resolution in principle improves as λ/D.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：望遠鏡口徑加倍，地面影像的解析度就一定加倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling the aperture always doubles the resolution of ground-based images. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary" is correct?
options: 望遠鏡口徑加倍，地面影像的解析度就一定加倍。
VLT 由四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡、四座可移動的 1.8 m 輔助望遠鏡與地下干涉實驗室組成，涵蓋近紫外到 25 µm。
副鏡只是轉折光路的鏡子，位置差幾十微米沒有影響。
optionsEn: Doubling the aperture always doubles the resolution of ground-based images.

quiz.explanationEn: The VLT comprises four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes, four relocatable 1.8 m Auxiliary Telescopes and an underground interferometric laboratory, covering the near ultraviolet to 25 µm. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 r₀ = 0.15 m（500 nm，假設），視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″，而 8.2 m 的繞射極限 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas，差 40 倍以上；D/r₀ ≈ 55，瞳面約含 (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 個同調區塊。四座 UT 非同調合光的等效口徑為 √4 × 8.2 m = 16.4 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm (assumption): seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″, while the 8.2 m diffraction limit 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas is more than 40 times smaller; D/r₀ ≈ 55, so the pupil holds about (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 coherent patches. Incoherently combining the four UTs gives an equivalent aperture of √4 × 8.2 m = 16.4 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以差分影像運動監測器（DIMM）量 r₀ 與視寧度，並同時記錄望遠鏡導星相機的影像 FWHM；把兩者換算到相同波長與天頂角（FWHM ∝ λ^−1/5、∝ sec z^3/5）比較，差額即為望遠鏡本身與圓頂的貢獻，再與影像品質預算比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure r₀ and seeing with a differential image-motion monitor (DIMM) while logging image FWHM from the telescope guide camera; convert both to the same wavelength and zenith angle (FWHM ∝ λ^−1/5 and ∝ sec z^3/5) and compare, treating the difference as the telescope and enclosure contribution to be checked against the image-quality budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 取 r₀ = 0.15 m（500 nm，假設），視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″，而 8.2 m 的繞射極限 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas，差 40 倍以上；D/r₀ ≈ 55，瞳面約含 (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 個同調區塊。四座 UT 非同調合光的等效口徑為 √4 × 8.2 m = 16.4 m。
knowledge.textEn: Take r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm (assumption): seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″, while the 8.2 m diffraction limit 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas is more than 40 times smaller; D/r₀ ≈ 55, so the pupil holds about (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 coherent patches. Incoherently combining the four UTs gives an equivalent aperture of √4 × 8.2 m = 16.4 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary", which statement holds?
options: 致動器越多越好，與觀測波長無關。
只要基線夠長，干涉儀的角解析度就自動實現，與光程穩定度無關。
取 r₀ = 0.15 m（500 nm，假設），視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″，而 8.2 m 的繞射極限 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas，差 40 倍以上。
optionsEn: More actuators are always better, regardless of the observing wavelength.
With a long enough baseline the interferometer's resolution is achieved automatically, regardless of path stability.
Take r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm (assumption): seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″, while the 8.2 m diffraction limit 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas is more than 40 times smaller.
quiz.explanation: 取 r₀ = 0.15 m（500 nm，假設），視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″，而 8.2 m 的繞射極限 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas，差 40 倍以上；D/r₀ ≈ 55，瞳面約含 (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 個同調區塊。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm (assumption): seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r₀ ≈ 0.67″, while the 8.2 m diffraction limit 1.22λ/D ≈ 15 mas is more than 40 times smaller; D/r₀ ≈ 55, so the pupil holds about (D/r₀)² ≈ 3000 coherent patches. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以差分影像運動監測器（DIMM）量 r₀ 與視寧度，並同時記錄望遠鏡導星相機的影像 FWHM；把兩者換算到相同波長與天頂角（FWHM ∝ λ^−1/5、∝ sec z^3/5）比較，差額即為望遠鏡本身與圓頂的貢獻，再與影像品質預算比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure r₀ and seeing with a differential image-motion monitor (DIMM) while logging image FWHM from the telescope guide camera; convert both to the same wavelength and zenith angle (FWHM ∝ λ^−1/5 and ∝ sec z^3/5) and compare, treating the difference as the telescope and enclosure contribution to be checked against the image-quality budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只看口徑而忽略站址與局部湍流，8 m 級望遠鏡的影像會和 1 m 級望遠鏡一樣寬，只多了集光；更常見的是把圓頂內熱湍流誤當成大氣視寧度，導致錯誤地升級光學而非改善熱控。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Judging a telescope by aperture alone, without site and local turbulence, leaves an 8 m class telescope with images as wide as a 1 m telescope and only more light; more commonly, dome thermal turbulence is mistaken for atmospheric seeing and the optics are upgraded instead of the thermal control.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以差分影像運動監測器（DIMM）量 r₀ 與視寧度，並同時記錄望遠鏡導星相機的影像 FWHM；把兩者換算到相同波長與天頂角（FWHM ∝ λ^−1/5、∝ sec z^3/5）比較，差額即為望遠鏡本身與圓頂的貢獻，再與影像品質預算比對。
knowledge.textEn: Measure r₀ and seeing with a differential image-motion monitor (DIMM) while logging image FWHM from the telescope guide camera; convert both to the same wavelength and zenith angle (FWHM ∝ λ^−1/5 and ∝ sec z^3/5) and compare, treating the difference as the telescope and enclosure contribution to be checked against the image-quality budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary"?
options: 以差分影像運動監測器（DIMM）量 r₀ 與視寧度，並同時記錄望遠鏡導星相機的影像 FWHM。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要解析度夠高，徑向速度精度就不受儀器穩定度限制。
optionsEn: Measure r₀ and seeing with a differential image-motion monitor (DIMM) while logging image FWHM from the telescope guide camera.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With high enough resolving power, radial-velocity precision is not limited by instrument stability.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure r₀ and seeing with a differential image-motion monitor (DIMM) while logging image FWHM from the telescope guide camera; convert both to the same wavelength and zenith angle (FWHM ∝ λ^−1/5 and ∝ sec z^3/5) and compare, treating the difference as the telescope and enclosure contribution to be checked against the image-quality budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若只看口徑而忽略站址與局部湍流，8 m 級望遠鏡的影像會和 1 m 級望遠鏡一樣寬，只多了集光；更常見的是把圓頂內熱湍流誤當成大氣視寧度，導致錯誤地升級光學而非改善熱控。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Judging a telescope by aperture alone, without site and local turbulence, leaves an 8 m class telescope with images as wide as a 1 m telescope and only more light; more commonly, dome thermal turbulence is mistaken for atmospheric seeing and the optics are upgraded instead of the thermal control. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此 VLT 的工程設計一直沿著兩條線前進：把四座望遠鏡的光合在一起增加集光或基線，以及以主動與自適應光學把影像拉回繞射極限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: VLT engineering has therefore advanced along two lines: combining the four telescopes for more collecting area or longer baselines, and using active and adaptive optics to pull images back toward the diffraction limit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「望遠鏡口徑加倍，地面影像的解析度就一定加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling the aperture always doubles the resolution of ground-based images." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只看口徑而忽略站址與局部湍流，8 m 級望遠鏡的影像會和 1 m 級望遠鏡一樣寬，只多了集光；更常見的是把圓頂內熱湍流誤當成大氣視寧度，導致錯誤地升級光學而非改善熱控。
knowledge.textEn: Judging a telescope by aperture alone, without site and local turbulence, leaves an 8 m class telescope with images as wide as a 1 m telescope and only more light; more commonly, dome thermal turbulence is mistaken for atmospheric seeing and the optics are upgraded instead of the thermal control.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集光、視寧度與繞射的系統邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Light grasp, seeing and diffraction as the system boundary" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若只看口徑而忽略站址與局部湍流，8 m 級望遠鏡的影像會和 1 m 級望遠鏡一樣寬，只多了集光。
副鏡只是轉折光路的鏡子，位置差幾十微米沒有影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Judging a telescope by aperture alone, without site and local turbulence, leaves an 8 m class telescope with images as wide as a 1 m telescope and only more light.
The secondary only folds the beam, so tens of micrometres of position error do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 若只看口徑而忽略站址與局部湍流，8 m 級望遠鏡的影像會和 1 m 級望遠鏡一樣寬，只多了集光；更常見的是把圓頂內熱湍流誤當成大氣視寧度，導致錯誤地升級光學而非改善熱控。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Judging a telescope by aperture alone, without site and local turbulence, leaves an 8 m class telescope with images as wide as a 1 m telescope and only more light; more commonly, dome thermal turbulence is mistaken for atmospheric seeing and the optics are upgraded instead of the thermal control. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每座 UT 為 Ritchey–Chrétien 設計：f/1.8 的薄主鏡與剛性輕量化的凸雙曲面副鏡共同消除球差與彗差，經地平式機架指向全天。光可以送到主鏡下方的 Cassegrain 焦點、兩側的 Nasmyth 焦點，或再經轉折送到地下的 coudé 焦點，讓大型穩定儀器固定不動。副鏡單元以五個自由度定位：一軸對焦、兩軸置中、兩軸指向；因為副鏡把主鏡焦比放大約 8 倍，副鏡的微小軸向位移會在焦面被放大，所以副鏡對焦是主動光學閉環中最頻繁的修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each UT is a Ritchey–Chrétien design: an f/1.8 thin primary and a rigid, lightweight convex hyperboloidal secondary jointly cancel spherical aberration and coma, pointed over the whole sky by an alt-azimuth mount. Light can go to the Cassegrain focus below the primary, to the two Nasmyth foci at the sides, or be relayed to a coudé focus in the basement so that large, stable instruments stay fixed. The secondary unit is positioned in five degrees of freedom: one for focus, two for centring and two for pointing. Because the secondary magnifies the primary focal ratio about eightfold, small axial secondary motions are amplified at the focal plane, which makes secondary focus the most frequent correction in the active-optics loop. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主鏡曲率半徑約 28.8 m，焦距 14.4 m，焦比 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「副鏡只是轉折光路的鏡子，位置差幾十微米沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The secondary only folds the beam, so tens of micrometres of position error do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置
knowledge.titleEn: RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci
knowledge.text: 每座 UT 為 Ritchey–Chrétien 設計：f/1.8 的薄主鏡與剛性輕量化的凸雙曲面副鏡共同消除球差與彗差，經地平式機架指向全天。光可以送到主鏡下方的 Cassegrain 焦點、兩側的 Nasmyth 焦點，或再經轉折送到地下的 coudé 焦點，讓大型穩定儀器固定不動。
knowledge.textEn: Each UT is a Ritchey–Chrétien design: an f/1.8 thin primary and a rigid, lightweight convex hyperboloidal secondary jointly cancel spherical aberration and coma, pointed over the whole sky by an alt-azimuth mount. Light can go to the Cassegrain focus below the primary, to the two Nasmyth foci at the sides, or be relayed to a coudé focus in the basement so that large, stable instruments stay fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：副鏡只是轉折光路的鏡子，位置差幾十微米沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The secondary only folds the beam, so tens of micrometres of position error do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci" is correct?
options: 副鏡只是轉折光路的鏡子，位置差幾十微米沒有影響。
主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。

steps.title: RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主鏡曲率半徑約 28.8 m，焦距 14.4 m，焦比 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76。若 Nasmyth 焦比約 f/15，副鏡放大率 m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5，焦面位移 ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz：副鏡移動 10 µm 使焦點移 0.74 mm，而 500 nm 的焦深 ±2λN² 只有 ±0.23 mm。等效焦距 123 m 對應底片比例尺 ≈ 1.68″/mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76. With a Nasmyth ratio near f/15 the secondary magnification is m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5 and the focal shift is ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz: a 10 µm secondary move shifts focus by 0.74 mm, while the 500 nm depth of focus ±2λN² is only ±0.23 mm. The 123 m effective focal length gives a plate scale ≈ 1.68″/mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較；再以已知角距的星對量測底片比例尺，並在不同仰角重複，分離重力撓曲造成的置中與彗差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction; then measure plate scale on star pairs of known separation and repeat at several elevations to separate gravity-flexure-induced decentre and coma.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主鏡曲率半徑約 28.8 m，焦距 14.4 m，焦比 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76。若 Nasmyth 焦比約 f/15，副鏡放大率 m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5，焦面位移 ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz：副鏡移動 10 µm 使焦點移 0.74 mm，而 500 nm 的焦深 ±2λN² 只有 ±0.23 mm。等效焦距 123 m 對應底片比例尺 ≈ 1.68″/mm。
knowledge.textEn: The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76. With a Nasmyth ratio near f/15 the secondary magnification is m ≈ 15/1.76 ≈ 8.5 and the focal shift is ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz ≈ 74·Δz: a 10 µm secondary move shifts focus by 0.74 mm, while the 500 nm depth of focus ±2λN² is only ±0.23 mm. The 123 m effective focal length gives a plate scale ≈ 1.68″/mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci", which statement holds?
options: 有了雷射導引星就完全不需要自然星。
只要解析度夠高，徑向速度精度就不受儀器穩定度限制。
optionsEn: The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76.
With laser guide stars no natural star is needed at all.
With high enough resolving power, radial-velocity precision is not limited by instrument stability.
quiz.explanation: 主鏡曲率半徑約 28.8 m，焦距 14.4 m，焦比 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The primary radius of curvature is about 28.8 m, so f = 14.4 m and the focal ratio is 14.4/8.2 ≈ f/1.76. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較；再以已知角距的星對量測底片比例尺，並在不同仰角重複，分離重力撓曲造成的置中與彗差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction; then measure plate scale on star pairs of known separation and repeat at several elevations to separate gravity-flexure-induced decentre and coma. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma; if it is mistaken for primary figure error and handed to the primary actuators, the primary is loaded with unnecessary forces and new aberrations appear after an elevation change.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較；再以已知角距的星對量測底片比例尺，並在不同仰角重複，分離重力撓曲造成的置中與彗差。
knowledge.textEn: Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction; then measure plate scale on star pairs of known separation and repeat at several elevations to separate gravity-flexure-induced decentre and coma.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較。
鏡面反射率降低幾個百分點，對望遠鏡效能幾乎沒有影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction.
A few percent of lost reflectance hardly affects telescope performance.
quiz.explanation: 在 Nasmyth 焦面以波前感測器做副鏡對焦掃描，量離焦項對副鏡位移的斜率，與 (m² + 1) 的預測比較；再以已知角距的星對量測底片比例尺，並在不同仰角重複，分離重力撓曲造成的置中與彗差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run a secondary focus scan with the wavefront sensor at the Nasmyth focus, measure the slope of the defocus term versus secondary displacement and compare it with the (m² + 1) prediction; then measure plate scale on star pairs of known separation and repeat at several elevations to separate gravity-flexure-induced decentre and coma. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Ritchey–Chrétien 光路與焦點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Ritchey–Chrétien train and foci” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma; if it is mistaken for primary figure error and handed to the primary actuators, the primary is loaded with unnecessary forces and new aberrations appear after an elevation change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：副鏡單元以五個自由度定位：一軸對焦、兩軸置中、兩軸指向；因為副鏡把主鏡焦比放大約 8 倍，副鏡的微小軸向位移會在焦面被放大，所以副鏡對焦是主動光學閉環中最頻繁的修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the secondary magnifies the primary focal ratio about eightfold, small axial secondary motions are amplified at the focal plane, which makes secondary focus the most frequent correction in the active-optics loop.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「副鏡只是轉折光路的鏡子，位置差幾十微米沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The secondary only folds the beam, so tens of micrometres of position error do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。
knowledge.textEn: A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma; if it is mistaken for primary figure error and handed to the primary actuators, the primary is loaded with unnecessary forces and new aberrations appear after an elevation change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「RC 光學、副鏡五軸與多焦點配置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "RC optics, the five-axis secondary and multiple foci" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。
副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A thicker, stiffer primary always gives better image quality.
A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma.
quiz.explanation: 副鏡置中誤差會產生與視場無關的固定彗差，若被誤當成主鏡面形誤差而交給主鏡致動器修正，主鏡會被施加不必要的力，並在換仰角後留下新的像差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A secondary decentre produces field-constant coma; if it is mistaken for primary figure error and handed to the primary actuators, the primary is loaded with unnecessary forces and new aberrations appear after an elevation change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數」與「可變形副鏡：薄殼、音圈致動器與散熱」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant" and "Deformable secondary: thin shell, voice coils and heat removal": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: UT 主鏡是直徑 8.2 m、厚約 177 mm 的 Zerodur 彎月鏡，成品重約 23 t；每片由 SCHOTT 澆鑄約 45 t 的玻璃陶瓷，經約 3 個月退火與 9 個月陶瓷化，膨脹係數規格 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K，交貨量測約 −0.03 到 −0.04×10⁻⁶/K。REOSC 在模擬最終鏡室的 150 點氣動支撐上研磨拋光，因為薄鏡本身不保形，驗收必須在主動模式下進行：允許致動器以有限的力修正低階面形，交付的波前約 40 nm RMS。薄鏡的另一個好處是熱慣量小，能跟上夜間氣溫，減少鏡面視寧度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each UT primary is a Zerodur meniscus 8.2 m across and about 177 mm thick, weighing about 23 t finished; SCHOTT cast about 45 t of glass ceramic per blank, followed by roughly 3 months of annealing and 9 months of ceramisation, to a thermal-expansion specification of 0 ± 0.15×10⁻⁶/K, with delivered blanks measuring about −0.03 to −0.04×10⁻⁶/K. REOSC ground and polished on a 150-point pneumatic support that mimics the final cell; because a thin mirror cannot hold its own shape, acceptance is done in active mode, letting actuators correct low-order figure with limited forces, and delivered wavefronts were about 40 nm RMS. The thin mirror's low thermal inertia also lets it follow the night-time air temperature, reducing mirror seeing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Zerodur 熱擴散率 κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s，厚度 t 的熱時間常數 τ ≈ t²/(π²κ)：t = 0.177 m 時約 1.3 h；若用 1:6 厚徑比的傳統鏡（t ≈ 1.37 m）則約 75 h，重量也從 23 t 增加到約 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Zerodur's diffusivity is κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s, and the thermal time constant of thickness t is τ ≈ t²/(π²κ): about 1.3 h for t = 0.177 m, but about 75 h for a conventional 1:6 mirror (t ≈ 1.37 m), whose mass would also rise from 23 t to about 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thicker, stiffer primary always gives better image quality." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant" is correct?
options: UT 主鏡是直徑 8.2 m、厚約 177 mm 的 Zerodur 彎月鏡，成品重約 23 t。

steps.title: 薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Zerodur 熱擴散率 κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s，厚度 t 的熱時間常數 τ ≈ t²/(π²κ)：t = 0.177 m 時約 1.3 h；若用 1:6 厚徑比的傳統鏡（t ≈ 1.37 m）則約 75 h，重量也從 23 t 增加到約 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Zerodur's diffusivity is κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s, and the thermal time constant of thickness t is τ ≈ t²/(π²κ): about 1.3 h for t = 0.177 m, but about 75 h for a conventional 1:6 mirror (t ≈ 1.37 m), whose mass would also rise from 23 t to about 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：拋光驗收時在多個支撐方位量全口徑干涉相位圖，扣除主動光學可修正的低階模態後計算殘差 RMS、斜率與中心強度比；營運中以鏡面溫度感測器與氣溫的差值追蹤熱平衡，並比對該差值與影像 FWHM 的相關性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For polishing acceptance, take full-aperture interferometric phase maps at several support orientations, remove the low-order modes that active optics can correct and compute residual RMS, slope error and central-intensity ratio; in operation, track the mirror-to-air temperature difference with surface sensors and correlate it with image FWHM.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Zerodur 熱擴散率 κ = k/(ρc) ≈ 1.46/(2530×821) ≈ 7.0×10⁻⁷ m²/s，厚度 t 的熱時間常數 τ ≈ t²/(π²κ)：t = 0.177 m 時約 1.3 h；若用 1:6 厚徑比的傳統鏡（t ≈ 1.37 m）則約 75 h，重量也從 23 t 增加到約 23 × 1367/177 ≈ 178 t。

steps.title: 薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thin-primary blank, polishing and thermal time constant: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 拋光驗收時在多個支撐方位量全口徑干涉相位圖，扣除主動光學可修正的低階模態後計算殘差 RMS、斜率與中心強度比；營運中以鏡面溫度感測器與氣溫的差值追蹤熱平衡，並比對該差值與影像 FWHM 的相關性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For polishing acceptance, take full-aperture interferometric phase maps at several support orientations, remove the low-order modes that active optics can correct and compute residual RMS, slope error and central-intensity ratio; in operation, track the mirror-to-air temperature difference with surface sensors and correlate it with image FWHM. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：支撐點的力誤差或吊運時的局部應力會在薄鏡上直接留下面形印記；若鏡面比夜間空氣溫度高 1 K 以上，鏡面上方形成上升熱羽，影像 FWHM 增加，被誤判為大氣視寧度變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Force errors at support points or local stress during handling print directly into the figure of a thin mirror; if the mirror runs more than about 1 K warmer than the night air, a rising thermal plume forms above it and image FWHM grows, often misread as worse atmospheric seeing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度

Doubling the aperture always doubles the resolution of ground-based images.

steps.title: 薄主鏡鏡坯、拋光與熱時間常數：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「8.2 m Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “8.2 m Zerodur thin meniscus primary” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 支撐點的力誤差或吊運時的局部應力會在薄鏡上直接留下面形印記；若鏡面比夜間空氣溫度高 1 K 以上，鏡面上方形成上升熱羽，影像 FWHM 增加，被誤判為大氣視寧度變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Force errors at support points or local stress during handling print directly into the figure of a thin mirror; if the mirror runs more than about 1 K warmer than the night air, a rising thermal plume forms above it and image FWHM grows, often misread as worse atmospheric seeing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄鏡的另一個好處是熱慣量小，能跟上夜間氣溫，減少鏡面視寧度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The thin mirror's low thermal inertia also lets it follow the night-time air temperature, reducing mirror seeing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主鏡越厚越剛，影像品質就一定越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thicker, stiffer primary always gives better image quality." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 可變形副鏡：薄殼、音圈致動器與散熱：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Deformable secondary: thin shell, voice coils and heat removal: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」如何決定ESO 甚大望遠鏡 VLT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1170-actuator deformable secondary” determines the key performance of “ESO Very Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: UT4 的自適應光學設施把原本的剛性副鏡換成直徑 1120 mm、厚約 2 mm 的 Zerodur 薄殼可變形副鏡，背後以 1170 個音圈致動器推動；薄殼由 SAGEM 製作，參考體由 SESO 以輕量化 Zerodur 製造，系統由 Microgate 與 ADS International 整合。每個致動器旁有電容感測器量測薄殼與參考體的約 90 µm 間隙，內迴路以 80 kHz 維持形狀，這層空氣膜同時提供阻尼。把自適應元件放在副鏡，讓所有焦點共用修正且不增加額外反射面與熱背景。致動器與電子機箱的熱必須以液冷帶走，否則副鏡附近形成局部湍流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The UT4 Adaptive Optics Facility replaced the rigid secondary with a deformable secondary: a Zerodur shell 1120 mm across and about 2 mm thick, pushed by 1170 voice-coil actuators. SAGEM produced the shell, SESO the lightweighted Zerodur reference body, and Microgate with ADS International integrated the system. A capacitive sensor beside each actuator measures the roughly 90 µm gap between shell and reference body, an internal loop at 80 kHz holds the shape, and the air film provides damping. Putting the adaptive element at the secondary lets all foci share the correction without extra reflections or thermal background. Heat from actuators and electronics must be carried away by liquid cooling, or local turbulence forms around the secondary. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1170-actuator deformable secondary”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：致動器最小間距約 28 mm，投影到 8.2 m 瞳面約 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The minimum actuator pitch of about 28 mm projects to about 28 × 8.2/1120 m ≈ 0.205 m on the 8.2 m pupil.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器越多越好，與觀測波長無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More actuators are always better, regardless of the observing wavelength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「1170 致動器可變形副鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “1170-actuator deformable secondary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「可變形副鏡：薄殼、音圈致動器與散熱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

UT4 的自適應光學設施把原本的剛性副鏡換成直徑 1120 mm、厚約 2 mm 的 Zerodur 薄殼可變形副鏡，背後以 1170 個音圈致動器推動。
