It follows that the ELT's value depends heavily on adaptive optics and segment phasing: with seeing-limited images only the D² gain from area remains.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：望遠鏡的靈敏度只和集光面積成正比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Telescope sensitivity scales only with collecting area. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture" is correct?
options: 望遠鏡的靈敏度只和集光面積成正比。
ELT 的科學理由不只是集光：當自適應光學把影像修正到接近繞射極限時，點源影像的角大小隨 λ/D 縮小，背景只在更小的立體角內與訊號競爭，因此在背景主導的條件下，達到相同訊雜比所需時間按 D⁴ 縮短，其中 D² 來自集光、另一個 D² 來自影像面積縮小。
鏡子越少越好，所以五鏡設計只是為了配合建築空間。
optionsEn: Telescope sensitivity scales only with collecting area.

The scientific case for the ELT is not only light grasp: once adaptive optics brings images close to the diffraction limit, a point-source image shrinks as λ/D and the background competes with the signal over a much smaller solid angle, so in the background-limited regime the time to reach a given signal-to-noise ratio falls as D⁴, with D² from collecting area and another D² from the smaller image.
Fewer mirrors are always better, so the five-mirror design only fits the building.
quiz.explanation: ELT 的科學理由不只是集光：當自適應光學把影像修正到接近繞射極限時，點源影像的角大小隨 λ/D 縮小，背景只在更小的立體角內與訊號競爭，因此在背景主導的條件下，達到相同訊雜比所需時間按 D⁴ 縮短，其中 D² 來自集光、另一個 D² 來自影像面積縮小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The scientific case for the ELT is not only light grasp: once adaptive optics brings images close to the diffraction limit, a point-source image shrinks as λ/D and the background competes with the signal over a much smaller solid angle, so in the background-limited regime the time to reach a given signal-to-noise ratio falls as D⁴, with D² from collecting area and another D² from the smaller image. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “39 m segmented aperture” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：K 波段（2.2 µm）繞射極限 1.22λ/D：D = 39 m 時約 14.2 mas，8.2 m 時約 67.5 mas。背景主導且繞射受限時，所需時間比 ≈ (39/8.2)⁴ ≈ 512；只有集光時為 (39/8.2)² ≈ 22.6。以外半徑 18.5 m、內半徑 5.5 m 估算面積 π(18.5² − 5.5²) ≈ 980 m²，遮擋佔外圓面積約 (11.1/39)² ≈ 8%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The K-band (2.2 µm) diffraction limit 1.22λ/D is about 14.2 mas for D = 39 m and 67.5 mas for 8.2 m. Background-limited and diffraction-limited, the time ratio is ≈ (39/8.2)⁴ ≈ 512, versus (39/8.2)² ≈ 22.6 from area alone. With outer radius 18.5 m and inner radius 5.5 m the area is π(18.5² − 5.5²) ≈ 980 m², and the obstruction covers about (11.1/39)² ≈ 8% of the outer disc. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以觀測模擬器把相同目標在不同 Strehl 與視寧度下的點擴散函數、天光背景與偵測器雜訊代入訊雜比方程，畫出所需時間對 Strehl 的曲線，確認 D⁴ 收益只在高 Strehl 區間成立；並把結果與單元望遠鏡的實測曝光時間計算器比較，作為科學需求與自適應光學需求的連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Feed the point-spread function, sky background and detector noise for the same target at different Strehl ratios and seeing into the signal-to-noise equation with an observation simulator, plot required time versus Strehl and confirm that the D⁴ gain holds only at high Strehl; compare against exposure-time calculators of existing 8 m telescopes to link science requirements with adaptive-optics requirements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Background-limited and diffraction-limited, the time ratio is ≈ (39/8.2)⁴ ≈ 512, versus (39/8.2)² ≈ 22.6 from area alone. steps.title: 39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “39 m segmented aperture” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以觀測模擬器把相同目標在不同 Strehl 與視寧度下的點擴散函數、天光背景與偵測器雜訊代入訊雜比方程，畫出所需時間對 Strehl 的曲線，確認 D⁴ 收益只在高 Strehl 區間成立；並把結果與單元望遠鏡的實測曝光時間計算器比較，作為科學需求與自適應光學需求的連結。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Feed the point-spread function, sky background and detector noise for the same target at different Strehl ratios and seeing into the signal-to-noise equation with an observation simulator, plot required time versus Strehl and confirm that the D⁴ gain holds only at high Strehl; compare against exposure-time calculators of existing 8 m telescopes to link science requirements with adaptive-optics requirements. steps.observation: 注意干擾：若專案只追求主鏡面積而低估共相與自適應光學的難度，完成的望遠鏡會變成昂貴的視寧度受限光桶，在背景主導的紅外觀測中只得到約 23 倍而非數百倍的時間收益。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If a project chases mirror area while underestimating phasing and adaptive optics, the finished telescope becomes an expensive seeing-limited light bucket that gains only about 23 times, not hundreds of times, in background-limited infrared observing time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 39 m 口徑的繞射極限與 D⁴ 靈敏度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diffraction limit and D⁴ sensitivity of a 39 m aperture: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「39 m 分段主鏡口徑」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “39 m segmented aperture” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若專案只追求主鏡面積而低估共相與自適應光學的難度，完成的望遠鏡會變成昂貴的視寧度受限光桶，在背景主導的紅外觀測中只得到約 23 倍而非數百倍的時間收益。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If a project chases mirror area while underestimating phasing and adaptive optics, the finished telescope becomes an expensive seeing-limited light bucket that gains only about 23 times, not hundreds of times, in background-limited infrared observing time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：主鏡外徑 39 m、中央遮擋約 11 m，集光面積接近 1000 m²。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The primary is 39 m across with a central obstruction of about 11 m, giving a collecting area close to 1000 m².
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「望遠鏡的靈敏度只和集光面積成正比。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Telescope sensitivity scales only with collecting area." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」如何決定ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “M1 to M5 five-mirror train” determines the key performance of “ESO Extremely Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: ELT 的光學由五面鏡組成：M1 為曲率半徑約 68.7 m 的 39 m 分段凹面橢球鏡，M2 為 4.2 m 凸面薄彎月鏡，M3 為 3.8 m 主動凹面鏡，三者構成在較大視場內同時校正球差、彗差與像散的三鏡消像散系統。M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，修正大氣湍流與望遠鏡振動；M5 是約 2.6 m × 2.1 m 的平面橢圓鏡，負責數 Hz 以下的影像穩定並把光送到 Nasmyth 平台。把自適應鏡做在望遠鏡內，所有儀器都能共用修正，但也代表每多一面鏡就多一次反射損失與熱發射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: ELT optics consist of five mirrors: M1 is a 39 m segmented concave ellipsoid with a radius of curvature of about 68.7 m, M2 a 4.2 m convex thin meniscus and M3 a 3.8 m active concave mirror, together forming a three-mirror anastigmat that corrects spherical aberration, coma and astigmatism over a wide field. M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across that corrects atmospheric turbulence and telescope vibration; M5 is a flat elliptical mirror of about 2.6 m × 2.1 m that stabilises the image below a few hertz and sends the beam to the Nasmyth platforms. Building the adaptive mirror into the telescope lets every instrument share the correction, but each extra mirror adds a reflection loss and thermal emission. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “M1 to M5 five-mirror train”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：五次反射的通量為 R⁵：每面 R = 0.95（假設）時 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774，R = 0.97 時 ≈ 0.859，差異相當於 11% 的曝光時間。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Five reflections give a throughput of R⁵: 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774 with R = 0.95 per mirror (assumption) and ≈ 0.859 with R = 0.97, a difference worth 11% of exposure time.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡子越少越好，所以五鏡設計只是為了配合建築空間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fewer mirrors are always better, so the five-mirror design only fits the building." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “M1 to M5 five-mirror train”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “M1 to M5 five-mirror train” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：五次反射的通量為 R⁵：每面 R = 0.95（假設）時 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774，R = 0.97 時 ≈ 0.859，差異相當於 11% 的曝光時間。M1 的曲率半徑 68.7 m 對應焦距約 34.4 m，主鏡邊緣的光線傾角 r/R = 18.5/68.7 ≈ 0.27 rad（約 15°），顯示 M1 是非常快的分段鏡面。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Five reflections give a throughput of R⁵: 0.95⁵ ≈ 0.774 with R = 0.95 per mirror (assumption) and ≈ 0.859 with R = 0.97, a difference worth 11% of exposure time. M1's 68.7 m radius of curvature gives a focal length of about 34.4 m, and the surface slope at the rim r/R = 18.5/68.7 ≈ 0.27 rad (about 15°) shows how fast the segmented primary is. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光學設計軟體建立五鏡模型，對每面鏡的位移與傾斜計算 Zernike 靈敏度矩陣，確認 M2 與 M3 的主動定位範圍足以涵蓋重力與溫度變形；在整合階段以內部光源與波前感測器量測系統像差，並以分項反射率乘積與實測天文通量比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the five-mirror model in optical-design software and compute the Zernike sensitivity matrix for displacement and tilt of each mirror, confirming that the active positioning ranges of M2 and M3 cover gravity and thermal deformation; during integration measure system aberrations with internal sources and wavefront sensors, and compare the product of individual reflectances with measured on-sky throughput.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “M1 to M5 five-mirror train” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以光學設計軟體建立五鏡模型，對每面鏡的位移與傾斜計算 Zernike 靈敏度矩陣，確認 M2 與 M3 的主動定位範圍足以涵蓋重力與溫度變形；在整合階段以內部光源與波前感測器量測系統像差，並以分項反射率乘積與實測天文通量比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the five-mirror model in optical-design software and compute the Zernike sensitivity matrix for displacement and tilt of each mirror, confirming that the active positioning ranges of M2 and M3 cover gravity and thermal deformation; during integration measure system aberrations with internal sources and wavefront sensors, and compare the product of individual reflectances with measured on-sky throughput. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：M2 若因重力或溫度產生微小橫移，會在整個視場引入彗差，若誤由 M4 吸收，M4 的行程被常態偏置占用而失去修正湍流的餘量；M5 的低頻任務若交給 M4，也會造成同樣的行程飽和。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A small lateral shift of M2 from gravity or temperature introduces coma across the field; if M4 absorbs it, part of M4's stroke is permanently biased and its margin for turbulence shrinks, and handing M5's low-frequency job to M4 saturates its stroke in the same way.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 五鏡設計：三鏡消像散加兩面平面控制鏡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Five-mirror design: a three-mirror anastigmat plus two flat control mirrors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「M1 至 M5 五鏡光路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “M1 to M5 five-mirror train” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: M2 若因重力或溫度產生微小橫移，會在整個視場引入彗差，若誤由 M4 吸收，M4 的行程被常態偏置占用而失去修正湍流的餘量；M5 的低頻任務若交給 M4，也會造成同樣的行程飽和。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把自適應鏡做在望遠鏡內，所有儀器都能共用修正，但也代表每多一面鏡就多一次反射損失與熱發射。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Building the adaptive mirror into the telescope lets every instrument share the correction, but each extra mirror adds a reflection loss and thermal emission.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鏡子越少越好，所以五鏡設計只是為了配合建築空間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fewer mirrors are always better, so the five-mirror design only fits the building." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「M1 鏡段：133 種段型、離軸非球面與 8 nm 拋光」與「M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "M1 segments: 133 types, off-axis aspheres and an 8 nm polish" and "M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: M1 鏡段：133 種段型、離軸非球面與 8 nm 拋光：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: M1 segments: 133 types, off-axis aspheres and an 8 nm polish: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1.45 m 六角形 Zerodur 鏡段」如何決定ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1.45 m hexagonal Zerodur segment” determines the key performance of “ESO Extremely Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: M1 由 798 片約 1.45 m、厚約 5 cm 的六角形 Zerodur 鏡段組成，分成六個相同的扇區，每扇區 133 片各不相同，另備第七組 133 片供輪替重鍍，共 931 片。因為 M1 是接近拋物面的橢球，每個鏡段都是主鏡不同位置的離軸片，越外圈的鏡段非球面偏離越大。SCHOTT 製作鏡坯，Safran Reosc 研磨、拋光、切邊並整合，表面不規則度約 8 nm 以內。每片背後有 27 點 whiffletree 支撐、9 個翹曲調整器修正低階面形，以及 3 個定位致動器控制活塞與傾斜。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.45 m 六角形 Zerodur 鏡段」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: M1 is made of 798 hexagonal Zerodur segments about 1.45 m across and 5 cm thick, arranged in six identical sectors of 133 different segments each, plus a seventh set of 133 for rotation through recoating, 931 in all. Because M1 is a near-paraboloidal ellipsoid, each segment is an off-axis piece of the parent mirror, and the outer rings depart more from a sphere. SCHOTT makes the blanks and Safran Reosc grinds, polishes, cuts and integrates them, holding surface irregularities to about 8 nm. Behind each segment sit a 27-point whiffletree support, 9 warping-harness actuators for low-order figure and 3 position actuators controlling piston and tilt. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1.45 m hexagonal Zerodur segment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：近似拋物面時，鏡面與同頂點曲率球面的差 Δz ≈ r⁴/(8R³)：R = 68.7 m，r = 10 m 時約 3.9 mm，r = 18.5 m 時約 45 mm，以 r⁴ 增長，所以不同半徑的鏡段必須拋成不同的離軸非球面。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a near-paraboloid, the departure from the vertex sphere is Δz ≈ r⁴/(8R³): with R = 68.7 m it is about 3.9 mm at r = 10 m and about 45 mm at r = 18.5 m, growing as r⁴, so segments at different radii must be polished as different off-axis aspheres.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「798 片六角鏡段形狀都一樣，可以任意互換位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All 798 hexagonal segments have the same shape and can be swapped anywhere." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「1.45 m 六角形 Zerodur 鏡段」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “1.45 m hexagonal Zerodur segment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: M1 鏡段：133 種段型、離軸非球面與 8 nm 拋光

knowledge.text: M1 由 798 片約 1.45 m、厚約 5 cm 的六角形 Zerodur 鏡段組成，分成六個相同的扇區，每扇區 133 片各不相同，另備第七組 133 片供輪替重鍍，共 931 片。因為 M1 是接近拋物面的橢球，每個鏡段都是主鏡不同位置的離軸片，越外圈的鏡段非球面偏離越大。

Because M1 is a near-paraboloidal ellipsoid, each segment is an off-axis piece of the parent mirror, and the outer rings depart more from a sphere.

steps.title: M1 鏡段：133 種段型、離軸非球面與 8 nm 拋光：定量估算
steps.titleEn: M1 segments: 133 types, off-axis aspheres and an 8 nm polish: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1.45 m 六角形 Zerodur 鏡段」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1.45 m hexagonal Zerodur segment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：近似拋物面時，鏡面與同頂點曲率球面的差 Δz ≈ r⁴/(8R³)：R = 68.7 m，r = 10 m 時約 3.9 mm，r = 18.5 m 時約 45 mm，以 r⁴ 增長，所以不同半徑的鏡段必須拋成不同的離軸非球面。單片鏡段本身的矢高約 r²/(2R) = 0.725²/137.4 ≈ 3.8 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a near-paraboloid, the departure from the vertex sphere is Δz ≈ r⁴/(8R³): with R = 68.7 m it is about 3.9 mm at r = 10 m and about 45 mm at r = 18.5 m, growing as r⁴, so segments at different radii must be polished as different off-axis aspheres. A single segment's own sag is about r²/(2R) = 0.725²/137.4 ≈ 3.8 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每片鏡段在拋光後以干涉儀配合電腦全像或零位光學量測面形，扣除翹曲調整器可修正的低階項後檢查殘差；再以座標量測確認六角外形與邊緣切削尺寸，並在支撐單元上重測以確認 whiffletree 與黏結墊沒有引入印記。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After polishing, measure each segment's figure interferometrically with a computer-generated hologram or null optic, remove the low-order terms the warping harness can correct and inspect the residual; then confirm hexagonal outline and edge dimensions with coordinate metrology, and remeasure on the support assembly to make sure the whiffletree and bonded pads leave no print-through.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: M1 鏡段：133 種段型、離軸非球面與 8 nm 拋光：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: M1 segments: 133 types, off-axis aspheres and an 8 nm polish: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「1.45 m 六角形 Zerodur 鏡段」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “1.45 m hexagonal Zerodur segment” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每片鏡段在拋光後以干涉儀配合電腦全像或零位光學量測面形，扣除翹曲調整器可修正的低階項後檢查殘差；再以座標量測確認六角外形與邊緣切削尺寸，並在支撐單元上重測以確認 whiffletree 與黏結墊沒有引入印記。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After polishing, measure each segment's figure interferometrically with a computer-generated hologram or null optic, remove the low-order terms the warping harness can correct and inspect the residual; then confirm hexagonal outline and edge dimensions with coordinate metrology, and remeasure on the support assembly to make sure the whiffletree and bonded pads leave no print-through. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若某一段型的離軸參數在拋光時用錯半徑位置，鏡段面形自身合格，但裝上後在該位置產生大量像散，翹曲調整器的行程不夠修正，只能重拋；黏結墊收縮不均也會在 27 點支撐處留下規則的面形印記。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If a segment type is polished with the off-axis parameters of the wrong radius, it passes on its own but produces large astigmatism once installed, beyond the warping-harness range, and must be repolished; uneven shrinkage of bonded pads also leaves a regular figure print at the 27 support points.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: M1 鏡段：133 種段型、離軸非球面與 8 nm 拋光：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: M1 segments: 133 types, off-axis aspheres and an 8 nm polish: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1.45 m 六角形 Zerodur 鏡段」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “1.45 m hexagonal Zerodur segment” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若某一段型的離軸參數在拋光時用錯半徑位置，鏡段面形自身合格，但裝上後在該位置產生大量像散，翹曲調整器的行程不夠修正，只能重拋；黏結墊收縮不均也會在 27 點支撐處留下規則的面形印記。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If a segment type is polished with the off-axis parameters of the wrong radius, it passes on its own but produces large astigmatism once installed, beyond the warping-harness range, and must be repolished; uneven shrinkage of bonded pads also leaves a regular figure print at the 27 support points. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Behind each segment sit a 27-point whiffletree support, 9 warping-harness actuators for low-order figure and 3 position actuators controlling piston and tilt.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「798 片六角鏡段形狀都一樣，可以任意互換位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「M4 六片薄殼與 SiC 參考體」如何決定ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “M4 six shells and SiC reference body” determines the key performance of “ESO Extremely Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，由六片 60° 扇形 Zerodur 薄殼組成，每片從約 35 mm 的鏡坯磨薄到 1.95 mm，厚度均勻度優於 15 µm。薄殼漂浮在 2.7 m 碳化矽參考結構前約 90 µm 處，背後超過 5000 個音圈致動器以最高每秒 1000 次的速率改變形狀，位置則以每秒 70,000 次量測，行程可達 50 µm。SCHOTT 供應鏡坯，Safran Reosc 磨薄與拋光，AdOptica 聯盟製作殼體組件與支撐單元。由於薄殼也需定期重鍍，共製作 12 片薄殼，重鍍時可整組替換而不停機太久。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「M4 六片薄殼與 SiC 參考體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across made of six 60° Zerodur shell petals, each thinned from a roughly 35 mm blank to 1.95 mm with thickness uniformity better than 15 µm. The shells float about 90 µm in front of a 2.7 m silicon-carbide reference structure, and more than 5000 voice-coil actuators reshape them up to 1000 times per second while position is sensed 70,000 times per second, with up to 50 µm of stroke. SCHOTT supplies the blanks, Safran Reosc thins and polishes them, and the AdOptica consortium builds the shell assemblies and support unit. Since the shells also need periodic recoating, 12 are made so that a full set can be swapped during recoating without long downtime. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “M4 six shells and SiC reference body”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：板的彎曲剛度 ∝ t³：從 35 mm 磨到 1.95 mm，剛度降為 (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴，約柔軟 5800 倍，才讓音圈的小力量就能推出數十微米形變。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Plate bending stiffness scales as t³: thinning from 35 mm to 1.95 mm reduces it to (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴, about 5800 times softer, which lets small voice-coil forces push tens of micrometres of deformation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自適應鏡越硬越好，因為剛性才能保持形狀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An adaptive mirror should be as stiff as possible because stiffness holds shape." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「M4 六片薄殼與 SiC 參考體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “M4 six shells and SiC reference body”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略
knowledge.titleEn: M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy
knowledge.text: M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，由六片 60° 扇形 Zerodur 薄殼組成，每片從約 35 mm 的鏡坯磨薄到 1.95 mm，厚度均勻度優於 15 µm。薄殼漂浮在 2.7 m 碳化矽參考結構前約 90 µm 處，背後超過 5000 個音圈致動器以最高每秒 1000 次的速率改變形狀，位置則以每秒 70,000 次量測，行程可達 50 µm。
knowledge.textEn: M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across made of six 60° Zerodur shell petals, each thinned from a roughly 35 mm blank to 1.95 mm with thickness uniformity better than 15 µm. The shells float about 90 µm in front of a 2.7 m silicon-carbide reference structure, and more than 5000 voice-coil actuators reshape them up to 1000 times per second while position is sensed 70,000 times per second, with up to 50 µm of stroke.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自適應鏡越硬越好，因為剛性才能保持形狀。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An adaptive mirror should be as stiff as possible because stiffness holds shape. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy" is correct?
options: 自適應鏡越硬越好，因為剛性才能保持形狀。
M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，由六片 60° 扇形 Zerodur 薄殼組成，每片從約 35 mm 的鏡坯磨薄到 1.95 mm，厚度均勻度優於 15 µm。
邊緣感測器夠精確，就能單獨決定整面主鏡的形狀。
optionsEn: An adaptive mirror should be as stiff as possible because stiffness holds shape.
M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across made of six 60° Zerodur shell petals, each thinned from a roughly 35 mm blank to 1.95 mm with thickness uniformity better than 15 µm.
Accurate edge sensors alone can determine the shape of the whole primary.
quiz.explanation: M4 是約 2.4 m 的平面自適應鏡，由六片 60° 扇形 Zerodur 薄殼組成，每片從約 35 mm 的鏡坯磨薄到 1.95 mm，厚度均勻度優於 15 µm。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: M4 is a flat adaptive mirror about 2.4 m across made of six 60° Zerodur shell petals, each thinned from a roughly 35 mm blank to 1.95 mm with thickness uniformity better than 15 µm. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略：定量估算
steps.titleEn: M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「M4 六片薄殼與 SiC 參考體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “M4 six shells and SiC reference body” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：板的彎曲剛度 ∝ t³：從 35 mm 磨到 1.95 mm，剛度降為 (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴，約柔軟 5800 倍，才讓音圈的小力量就能推出數十微米形變。面積 π/4 × 2.4² ≈ 4.52 m² 分給 5000 個致動器，每個約 9.0×10⁻⁴ m²，間距約 30 mm，投影到 39 m 瞳面約 0.49 m。每次命令之間有約 70 次位置量測可用於內迴路。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Plate bending stiffness scales as t³: thinning from 35 mm to 1.95 mm reduces it to (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴, about 5800 times softer, which lets small voice-coil forces push tens of micrometres of deformation. Dividing π/4 × 2.4² ≈ 4.52 m² among 5000 actuators gives about 9.0×10⁻⁴ m² each, a pitch near 30 mm and about 0.49 m projected onto the 39 m pupil. About 70 position samples are available to the inner loop between successive commands. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以干涉儀量每片薄殼在參考體上的平面化殘差，確認低於 14 nm RMS；逐一推動致動器量影響函數並檢查失效或耦合異常的單元；以階躍命令量測穩定時間與頻寬，並在整合後以六片之間的接縫活塞差檢查分片控制的一致性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each shell's flattened residual on the reference body interferometrically and confirm it is below 14 nm RMS; poke each actuator to record influence functions and flag dead or abnormally coupled units; measure settling time and bandwidth with step commands, and after integration check the piston steps across the six petal seams for consistent petal control.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 板的彎曲剛度 ∝ t³：從 35 mm 磨到 1.95 mm，剛度降為 (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴，約柔軟 5800 倍，才讓音圈的小力量就能推出數十微米形變。面積 π/4 × 2.4² ≈ 4.52 m² 分給 5000 個致動器，每個約 9.0×10⁻⁴ m²，間距約 30 mm，投影到 39 m 瞳面約 0.49 m。每次命令之間有約 70 次位置量測可用於內迴路。
knowledge.textEn: Plate bending stiffness scales as t³: thinning from 35 mm to 1.95 mm reduces it to (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴, about 5800 times softer, which lets small voice-coil forces push tens of micrometres of deformation. Dividing π/4 × 2.4² ≈ 4.52 m² among 5000 actuators gives about 9.0×10⁻⁴ m² each, a pitch near 30 mm and about 0.49 m projected onto the 39 m pupil. About 70 position samples are available to the inner loop between successive commands.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy", which statement holds?
options: 分段主鏡可以像單片主鏡一樣，幾年才一次整面重鍍。
望遠鏡的靈敏度只和集光面積成正比。
板的彎曲剛度 ∝ t³：從 35 mm 磨到 1.95 mm，剛度降為 (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴，約柔軟 5800 倍，才讓音圈的小力量就能推出數十微米形變。
optionsEn: A segmented primary can be recoated all at once every few years like a monolithic one.
Telescope sensitivity scales only with collecting area.

Plate bending stiffness scales as t³: thinning from 35 mm to 1.95 mm reduces it to (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴, about 5800 times softer, which lets small voice-coil forces push tens of micrometres of deformation.
quiz.explanation: 板的彎曲剛度 ∝ t³：從 35 mm 磨到 1.95 mm，剛度降為 (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴，約柔軟 5800 倍，才讓音圈的小力量就能推出數十微米形變。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Plate bending stiffness scales as t³: thinning from 35 mm to 1.95 mm reduces it to (1.95/35)³ ≈ 1.7×10⁻⁴, about 5800 times softer, which lets small voice-coil forces push tens of micrometres of deformation. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「M4 六片薄殼與 SiC 參考體」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “M4 six shells and SiC reference body” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以干涉儀量每片薄殼在參考體上的平面化殘差，確認低於 14 nm RMS；逐一推動致動器量影響函數並檢查失效或耦合異常的單元；以階躍命令量測穩定時間與頻寬，並在整合後以六片之間的接縫活塞差檢查分片控制的一致性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each shell's flattened residual on the reference body interferometrically and confirm it is below 14 nm RMS; poke each actuator to record influence functions and flag dead or abnormally coupled units; measure settling time and bandwidth with step commands, and after integration check the piston steps across the six petal seams for consistent petal control. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：六片薄殼之間的接縫若控制不一致，會在瞳面形成扇形活塞誤差，即使每片各自平整，影像也出現花瓣狀的旁瓣；冷卻或電子機箱熱量若沒有移除，薄殼附近的局部湍流會抵消一部分修正。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the six shells are not controlled consistently across their seams, sector-shaped piston errors appear in the pupil, and even with each shell flat the image shows petal-like sidelobes; heat from electronics that is not removed creates local turbulence near the shells that cancels part of the correction.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以干涉儀量每片薄殼在參考體上的平面化殘差，確認低於 14 nm RMS；逐一推動致動器量影響函數並檢查失效或耦合異常的單元；以階躍命令量測穩定時間與頻寬，並在整合後以六片之間的接縫活塞差檢查分片控制的一致性。
knowledge.textEn: Measure each shell's flattened residual on the reference body interferometrically and confirm it is below 14 nm RMS; poke each actuator to record influence functions and flag dead or abnormally coupled units; measure settling time and bandwidth with step commands, and after integration check the piston steps across the six petal seams for consistent petal control.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy"?
options: 以干涉儀量每片薄殼在參考體上的平面化殘差，確認低於 14 nm RMS。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鏡子越少越好，所以五鏡設計只是為了配合建築空間。
optionsEn: Measure each shell's flattened residual on the reference body interferometrically and confirm it is below 14 nm RMS.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Fewer mirrors are always better, so the five-mirror design only fits the building.
quiz.explanation: 以干涉儀量每片薄殼在參考體上的平面化殘差，確認低於 14 nm RMS；逐一推動致動器量影響函數並檢查失效或耦合異常的單元；以階躍命令量測穩定時間與頻寬，並在整合後以六片之間的接縫活塞差檢查分片控制的一致性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure each shell's flattened residual on the reference body interferometrically and confirm it is below 14 nm RMS; poke each actuator to record influence functions and flag dead or abnormally coupled units; measure settling time and bandwidth with step commands, and after integration check the piston steps across the six petal seams for consistent petal control. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「M4 六片薄殼與 SiC 參考體」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “M4 six shells and SiC reference body” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 六片薄殼之間的接縫若控制不一致，會在瞳面形成扇形活塞誤差，即使每片各自平整，影像也出現花瓣狀的旁瓣；冷卻或電子機箱熱量若沒有移除，薄殼附近的局部湍流會抵消一部分修正。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the six shells are not controlled consistently across their seams, sector-shaped piston errors appear in the pupil, and even with each shell flat the image shows petal-like sidelobes; heat from electronics that is not removed creates local turbulence near the shells that cancels part of the correction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：由於薄殼也需定期重鍍，共製作 12 片薄殼，重鍍時可整組替換而不停機太久。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Since the shells also need periodic recoating, 12 are made so that a full set can be swapped during recoating without long downtime.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自適應鏡越硬越好，因為剛性才能保持形狀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An adaptive mirror should be as stiff as possible because stiffness holds shape." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 六片薄殼之間的接縫若控制不一致，會在瞳面形成扇形活塞誤差，即使每片各自平整，影像也出現花瓣狀的旁瓣；冷卻或電子機箱熱量若沒有移除，薄殼附近的局部湍流會抵消一部分修正。
knowledge.textEn: If the six shells are not controlled consistently across their seams, sector-shaped piston errors appear in the pupil, and even with each shell flat the image shows petal-like sidelobes; heat from electronics that is not removed creates local turbulence near the shells that cancels part of the correction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「M4 自適應鏡：薄殼、音圈陣列與更換策略」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "M4 adaptive mirror: thin shells, voice-coil array and exchange strategy" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
六片薄殼之間的接縫若控制不一致，會在瞳面形成扇形活塞誤差，即使每片各自平整，影像也出現花瓣狀的旁瓣。
邊緣感測器夠精確，就能單獨決定整面主鏡的形狀。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If the six shells are not controlled consistently across their seams, sector-shaped piston errors appear in the pupil, and even with each shell flat the image shows petal-like sidelobes.
Accurate edge sensors alone can determine the shape of the whole primary.

quiz.explanationEn: If the six shells are not controlled consistently across their seams, sector-shaped piston errors appear in the pupil, and even with each shell flat the image shows petal-like sidelobes; heat from electronics that is not removed creates local turbulence near the shells that cancels part of the correction. stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分段共相：邊緣感測器、致動器與弱可觀測模態」與「影像穩定預算：風振、結構振動與 M4／M5 分工」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Segment phasing: edge sensors, actuators and weakly observable modes" and "Image-stability budget: wind shake, structural vibration and the M4/M5 split": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分段共相：邊緣感測器、致動器與弱可觀測模態：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Segment phasing: edge sensors, actuators and weakly observable modes: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「邊緣感測器與定位致動器」如何決定ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Edge sensors and position actuators” determines the key performance of “ESO Extremely Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 798 片鏡段必須在整個 39 m 範圍內對齊到數十奈米，否則 M1 會變成許多彼此不相干的小鏡子。相鄰鏡段的邊上裝有成對的邊緣感測器，量測彼此的高度差與間隙，精度為數奈米；控制器把約 9000 個感測器讀值反解成每片 3 個定位致動器的命令，致動器精度約 2 nm、行程 10 mm。邊緣感測器只量相對高度，因此整體活塞、整體傾斜與類似離焦的碗狀模態幾乎看不到，必須由望遠鏡的波前感測器或專用共相相機定期量測，並重設感測器的參考值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「邊緣感測器與定位致動器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The 798 segments must be aligned to tens of nanometres across the whole 39 m, or M1 becomes many mutually incoherent small mirrors. Pairs of edge sensors along adjacent edges measure relative height and gap to a few nanometres; the controller inverts about 9000 sensor readings into commands for the 3 position actuators of each segment, which have about 2 nm precision and 10 mm stroke. Edge sensors only see relative height, so global piston, global tilt and a defocus-like bowl mode are nearly invisible to them and must be measured periodically by the telescope's wavefront sensors or a dedicated phasing camera, which then resets the sensor reference values. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Edge sensors and position actuators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：六角拼接中共享邊數約為 3N 扣除邊界：模擬 804 片環形拼接得約 2268 條共享邊，每邊 2 對感測器約 4500 對，即約 9000 個感測器，與公開數字一致。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: In a hexagonal tiling the number of shared edges is about 3N minus the boundary: simulating an annulus of 804 segments gives about 2268 shared edges, and 2 sensor pairs per edge make about 4500 pairs, about 9000 sensors, matching the published figure.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「邊緣感測器夠精確，就能單獨決定整面主鏡的形狀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Accurate edge sensors alone can determine the shape of the whole primary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「邊緣感測器與定位致動器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 分段共相：邊緣感測器、致動器與弱可觀測模態：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segment phasing: edge sensors, actuators and weakly observable modes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊緣感測器與定位致動器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Edge sensors and position actuators” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：六角拼接中共享邊數約為 3N 扣除邊界：模擬 804 片環形拼接得約 2268 條共享邊，每邊 2 對感測器約 4500 對，即約 9000 個感測器，與公開數字一致。鏡段活塞的面誤差 σ = 10 nm 時波前誤差 20 nm，Strehl = exp[−(2π×20/λ)²]：λ = 1.65 µm 時約 0.994，500 nm 時約 0.939。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: In a hexagonal tiling the number of shared edges is about 3N minus the boundary: simulating an annulus of 804 segments gives about 2268 shared edges, and 2 sensor pairs per edge make about 4500 pairs, about 9000 sensors, matching the published figure. A segment piston surface error σ = 10 nm doubles to 20 nm of wavefront, and Strehl = exp[−(2π×20/λ)²] is about 0.994 at 1.65 µm and 0.939 at 500 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共相相機量測各鏡段的活塞與傾斜，與邊緣感測器推得的值比對，得到感測器偏移量；在不同仰角與溫度下重複，建立感測器零點對溫度與重力的模型；並以奇異值分解檢查控制矩陣中最小奇異值對應的模態，估算感測器雜訊在這些模態上的放大倍數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure segment piston and tilt with the phasing camera and compare with values inferred from the edge sensors to obtain sensor offsets; repeat at different elevations and temperatures to model sensor zero points against temperature and gravity; and use singular-value decomposition to identify the modes with the smallest singular values in the control matrix and estimate how much sensor noise they amplify.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

A segment piston surface error σ = 10 nm doubles to 20 nm of wavefront, and Strehl = exp[−(2π×20/λ)²] is about 0.994 at 1.65 µm and 0.939 at 500 nm.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 分段共相：邊緣感測器、致動器與弱可觀測模態：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segment phasing: edge sensors, actuators and weakly observable modes: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「邊緣感測器與定位致動器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Edge sensors and position actuators” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以共相相機量測各鏡段的活塞與傾斜，與邊緣感測器推得的值比對，得到感測器偏移量；在不同仰角與溫度下重複，建立感測器零點對溫度與重力的模型；並以奇異值分解檢查控制矩陣中最小奇異值對應的模態，估算感測器雜訊在這些模態上的放大倍數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure segment piston and tilt with the phasing camera and compare with values inferred from the edge sensors to obtain sensor offsets; repeat at different elevations and temperatures to model sensor zero points against temperature and gravity; and use singular-value decomposition to identify the modes with the smallest singular values in the control matrix and estimate how much sensor noise they amplify. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若感測器零點隨溫度漂移而沒有以共相相機重設，邊緣感測器迴路會忠實地把錯誤維持住，鏡段逐漸形成碗狀或鋸齒狀的活塞誤差；在可見光與近紅外短波，Strehl 會先受害，而長波仍看似正常，讓問題延遲被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If sensor zero points drift with temperature and are not reset by the phasing camera, the edge-sensor loop faithfully holds the error, and the segments develop a bowl-shaped or sawtooth piston pattern; Strehl suffers first in the visible and short near-infrared while long wavelengths still look normal, delaying discovery.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以共相相機量測各鏡段的活塞與傾斜，與邊緣感測器推得的值比對，得到感測器偏移量；在不同仰角與溫度下重複，建立感測器零點對溫度與重力的模型；並以奇異值分解檢查控制矩陣中最小奇異值對應的模態，估算感測器雜訊在這些模態上的放大倍數。

steps.title: 分段共相：邊緣感測器、致動器與弱可觀測模態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Segment phasing: edge sensors, actuators and weakly observable modes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊緣感測器與定位致動器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Edge sensors and position actuators” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若感測器零點隨溫度漂移而沒有以共相相機重設，邊緣感測器迴路會忠實地把錯誤維持住，鏡段逐漸形成碗狀或鋸齒狀的活塞誤差；在可見光與近紅外短波，Strehl 會先受害，而長波仍看似正常，讓問題延遲被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If sensor zero points drift with temperature and are not reset by the phasing camera, the edge-sensor loop faithfully holds the error, and the segments develop a bowl-shaped or sawtooth piston pattern; Strehl suffers first in the visible and short near-infrared while long wavelengths still look normal, delaying discovery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：邊緣感測器只量相對高度，因此整體活塞、整體傾斜與類似離焦的碗狀模態幾乎看不到，必須由望遠鏡的波前感測器或專用共相相機定期量測，並重設感測器的參考值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Edge sensors only see relative height, so global piston, global tilt and a defocus-like bowl mode are nearly invisible to them and must be measured periodically by the telescope's wavefront sensors or a dedicated phasing camera, which then resets the sensor reference values.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「邊緣感測器夠精確，就能單獨決定整面主鏡的形狀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Accurate edge sensors alone can determine the shape of the whole primary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 影像穩定預算：風振、結構振動與 M4／M5 分工：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Image-stability budget: wind shake, structural vibration and the M4/M5 split: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「M5 傾斜鏡與 M4 頻段分工」如何決定ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “M5 tip-tilt and M4 frequency split” determines the key performance of “ESO Extremely Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: ELT 的主結構與鏡面在風載、追蹤與機械振動下會讓影像移動，影像移動若不修正，即使波前其他部分完美也會把繞射極限的影像抹寬。M5 以大行程、低頻寬的傾斜修正吸收數 Hz 以下的風振與追蹤誤差；M4 以小行程、高頻寬的傾斜加上高階形狀修正處理較快的振動與湍流，並持續把平均傾斜卸載給 M5，避免 M4 行程飽和。工程上要分別為每個頻段估計干擾振幅，再乘上各迴路的抑制函數，最後把殘餘影像移動換算成 Strehl 損失。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「M5 傾斜鏡與 M4 頻段分工」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wind load, tracking and mechanical vibration make the ELT image move, and uncorrected image motion smears a diffraction-limited image even if the rest of the wavefront is perfect. M5 provides large-stroke, low-bandwidth tip-tilt to absorb wind shake and tracking errors below a few hertz; M4 adds small-stroke, high-bandwidth tip-tilt and high-order shape correction for faster vibration and turbulence, continuously offloading its average tilt to M5 so its stroke does not saturate. The engineering task is to estimate disturbance amplitude in each frequency band, multiply by the rejection function of each loop and convert the residual image motion into a Strehl loss. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “M5 tip-tilt and M4 frequency split”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一階迴路在 f 遠低於交越頻率 f_c 時的殘差約為 f/f_c。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A first-order loop leaves a residual of roughly f/f_c well below its crossover f_c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要自適應鏡夠快，望遠鏡結構振動就不需要另外管理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the adaptive mirror is fast enough, structural vibration needs no separate management." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「M5 傾斜鏡與 M4 頻段分工」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “M5 tip-tilt and M4 frequency split”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

If the adaptive mirror is fast enough, structural vibration needs no separate management.

steps.title: 影像穩定預算：風振、結構振動與 M4／M5 分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Image-stability budget: wind shake, structural vibration and the M4/M5 split: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「M5 傾斜鏡與 M4 頻段分工」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “M5 tip-tilt and M4 frequency split” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一階迴路在 f 遠低於交越頻率 f_c 時的殘差約為 f/f_c。風振 20 mas 在 0.3 Hz、M5 交越 3 Hz（假設）殘差約 2.0 mas；結構振動 3 mas 在 10 Hz、M4 傾斜迴路交越 50 Hz（假設）殘差約 0.6 mas，合計約 2.1 mas。K 波段 λ/D ≈ 11.6 mas，S_jitter ≈ 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ/(λ/D))²] ≈ 0.86。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A first-order loop leaves a residual of roughly f/f_c well below its crossover f_c. Wind shake of 20 mas at 0.3 Hz with an assumed 3 Hz M5 crossover leaves about 2.0 mas; structural vibration of 3 mas at 10 Hz with an assumed 50 Hz M4 tip-tilt crossover leaves about 0.6 mas, about 2.1 mas combined. With λ/D ≈ 11.6 mas in K band, S_jitter ≈ 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ/(λ/D))²] ≈ 0.86. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構上布置加速度計與風速計，記錄不同風速與方位下的影像移動功率譜；以自然星的快速傾斜感測器量閉迴路殘差，分頻段比較 M5 與 M4 各自的抑制效果，並檢查卸載迴路是否讓 M4 的平均傾斜保持在行程中央。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Instrument the structure with accelerometers and anemometers and record image-motion power spectra at different wind speeds and azimuths; measure closed-loop residuals with a fast natural-star tip-tilt sensor, compare M5 and M4 rejection band by band, and check that the offload loop keeps M4's average tilt near the centre of its stroke.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一階迴路在 f 遠低於交越頻率 f_c 時的殘差約為 f/f_c。風振 20 mas 在 0.3 Hz、M5 交越 3 Hz（假設）殘差約 2.0 mas；結構振動 3 mas 在 10 Hz、M4 傾斜迴路交越 50 Hz（假設）殘差約 0.6 mas，合計約 2.1 mas。K 波段 λ/D ≈ 11.6 mas，S_jitter ≈ 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ/(λ/D))²] ≈ 0.86。
knowledge.textEn: A first-order loop leaves a residual of roughly f/f_c well below its crossover f_c. Wind shake of 20 mas at 0.3 Hz with an assumed 3 Hz M5 crossover leaves about 2.0 mas; structural vibration of 3 mas at 10 Hz with an assumed 50 Hz M4 tip-tilt crossover leaves about 0.6 mas, about 2.1 mas combined. With λ/D ≈ 11.6 mas in K band, S_jitter ≈ 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ/(λ/D))²] ≈ 0.86.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「影像穩定預算：風振、結構振動與 M4／M5 分工」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Image-stability budget: wind shake, structural vibration and the M4/M5 split", which statement holds?
options: 望遠鏡的靈敏度只和集光面積成正比。
一階迴路在 f 遠低於交越頻率 f_c 時的殘差約為 f/f_c。
798 片六角鏡段形狀都一樣，可以任意互換位置。
optionsEn: Telescope sensitivity scales only with collecting area.
A first-order loop leaves a residual of roughly f/f_c well below its crossover f_c.
All 798 hexagonal segments have the same shape and can be swapped anywhere.
quiz.explanation: 一階迴路在 f 遠低於交越頻率 f_c 時的殘差約為 f/f_c。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A first-order loop leaves a residual of roughly f/f_c well below its crossover f_c. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 影像穩定預算：風振、結構振動與 M4／M5 分工：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Image-stability budget: wind shake, structural vibration and the M4/M5 split: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「M5 傾斜鏡與 M4 頻段分工」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “M5 tip-tilt and M4 frequency split” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在結構上布置加速度計與風速計，記錄不同風速與方位下的影像移動功率譜；以自然星的快速傾斜感測器量閉迴路殘差，分頻段比較 M5 與 M4 各自的抑制效果，並檢查卸載迴路是否讓 M4 的平均傾斜保持在行程中央。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Instrument the structure with accelerometers and anemometers and record image-motion power spectra at different wind speeds and azimuths; measure closed-loop residuals with a fast natural-star tip-tilt sensor, compare M5 and M4 rejection band by band, and check that the offload loop keeps M4's average tilt near the centre of its stroke. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若某個結構共振恰好落在 M5 與 M4 迴路的交接頻段，兩個迴路都只有部分抑制，甚至互相放大，影像出現特定頻率的抖動；如果卸載迴路增益太低，強風下 M4 行程飽和，整個自適應光學系統開迴路。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If a structural resonance falls in the handover band between the M5 and M4 loops, both reject it only partially or even amplify it, and the image jitters at that frequency; if the offload gain is too low, M4 saturates in strong wind and the whole adaptive-optics system drops out of closed loop.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在結構上布置加速度計與風速計，記錄不同風速與方位下的影像移動功率譜；以自然星的快速傾斜感測器量閉迴路殘差，分頻段比較 M5 與 M4 各自的抑制效果，並檢查卸載迴路是否讓 M4 的平均傾斜保持在行程中央。
knowledge.textEn: Instrument the structure with accelerometers and anemometers and record image-motion power spectra at different wind speeds and azimuths; measure closed-loop residuals with a fast natural-star tip-tilt sensor, compare M5 and M4 rejection band by band, and check that the offload loop keeps M4's average tilt near the centre of its stroke.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「影像穩定預算：風振、結構振動與 M4／M5 分工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Image-stability budget: wind shake, structural vibration and the M4/M5 split"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
自適應鏡越硬越好，因為剛性才能保持形狀。
在結構上布置加速度計與風速計，記錄不同風速與方位下的影像移動功率譜。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
An adaptive mirror should be as stiff as possible because stiffness holds shape.
Instrument the structure with accelerometers and anemometers and record image-motion power spectra at different wind speeds and azimuths.
quiz.explanation: 在結構上布置加速度計與風速計，記錄不同風速與方位下的影像移動功率譜；以自然星的快速傾斜感測器量閉迴路殘差，分頻段比較 M5 與 M4 各自的抑制效果，並檢查卸載迴路是否讓 M4 的平均傾斜保持在行程中央。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Instrument the structure with accelerometers and anemometers and record image-motion power spectra at different wind speeds and azimuths; measure closed-loop residuals with a fast natural-star tip-tilt sensor, compare M5 and M4 rejection band by band, and check that the offload loop keeps M4's average tilt near the centre of its stroke. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 影像穩定預算：風振、結構振動與 M4／M5 分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Image-stability budget: wind shake, structural vibration and the M4/M5 split: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「M5 傾斜鏡與 M4 頻段分工」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “M5 tip-tilt and M4 frequency split” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若某個結構共振恰好落在 M5 與 M4 迴路的交接頻段，兩個迴路都只有部分抑制，甚至互相放大，影像出現特定頻率的抖動；如果卸載迴路增益太低，強風下 M4 行程飽和，整個自適應光學系統開迴路。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If a structural resonance falls in the handover band between the M5 and M4 loops, both reject it only partially or even amplify it, and the image jitters at that frequency; if the offload gain is too low, M4 saturates in strong wind and the whole adaptive-optics system drops out of closed loop. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：工程上要分別為每個頻段估計干擾振幅，再乘上各迴路的抑制函數，最後把殘餘影像移動換算成 Strehl 損失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The engineering task is to estimate disturbance amplitude in each frequency band, multiply by the rejection function of each loop and convert the residual image motion into a Strehl loss.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要自適應鏡夠快，望遠鏡結構振動就不需要另外管理。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the adaptive mirror is fast enough, structural vibration needs no separate management." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若某個結構共振恰好落在 M5 與 M4 迴路的交接頻段，兩個迴路都只有部分抑制，甚至互相放大，影像出現特定頻率的抖動；如果卸載迴路增益太低，強風下 M4 行程飽和，整個自適應光學系統開迴路。
knowledge.textEn: If a structural resonance falls in the handover band between the M5 and M4 loops, both reject it only partially or even amplify it, and the image jitters at that frequency; if the offload gain is too low, M4 saturates in strong wind and the whole adaptive-optics system drops out of closed loop.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「影像穩定預算：風振、結構振動與 M4／M5 分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Image-stability budget: wind shake, structural vibration and the M4/M5 split" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若某個結構共振恰好落在 M5 與 M4 迴路的交接頻段，兩個迴路都只有部分抑制，甚至互相放大，影像出現特定頻率的抖動。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
分段主鏡可以像單片主鏡一樣，幾年才一次整面重鍍。
optionsEn: If a structural resonance falls in the handover band between the M5 and M4 loops, both reject it only partially or even amplify it, and the image jitters at that frequency.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A segmented primary can be recoated all at once every few years like a monolithic one.
quiz.explanation: 若某個結構共振恰好落在 M5 與 M4 迴路的交接頻段，兩個迴路都只有部分抑制，甚至互相放大，影像出現特定頻率的抖動；如果卸載迴路增益太低，強風下 M4 行程飽和，整個自適應光學系統開迴路。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a structural resonance falls in the handover band between the M5 and M4 loops, both reject it only partially or even amplify it, and the image jitters at that frequency; if the offload gain is too low, M4 saturates in strong wind and the whole adaptive-optics system drops out of closed loop. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「Armazones 營運：鏡段輪替、重鍍節奏與可用率」與「初光驗收：點擴散函數取樣與 Strehl 量測」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Operations on Armazones: segment rotation, recoating cadence and availability" and "First-light acceptance: PSF sampling and Strehl measurement": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: Armazones 營運：鏡段輪替、重鍍節奏與可用率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Operations on Armazones: segment rotation, recoating cadence and availability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鏡段輪替重鍍與備用扇區」如何決定ESO 極大望遠鏡 ELT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Segment rotation recoating and spare sector” determines the key performance of “ESO Extremely Large Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: ELT 位於海拔約 3000 m 的 Cerro Armazones，灰塵與高紫外輻射會逐漸降低鏡面反射率並增加散射。M1 的每片鏡段約每 18 個月重鍍一次，因此營運上是一條連續的生產線：每天卸下約兩片、送到山上的鍍膜設施清洗重鍍，再裝回並重新共相。第七組 133 片備用鏡段讓卸下的位置能立即補上已鍍好的鏡段，避免主鏡出現空洞。每次更換都會擾動邊緣感測器的參考值，所以交換流程必須和共相校正綁在一起。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡段輪替重鍍與備用扇區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The ELT sits at about 3000 m on Cerro Armazones, where dust and strong ultraviolet gradually lower reflectance and increase scatter. Each M1 segment is recoated roughly every 18 months, so operations run as a continuous production line: about two segments per day are removed, cleaned and recoated in the on-site coating facility, reinstalled and rephased. The seventh set of 133 spare segments lets a freshly coated segment fill each vacated position immediately, so the primary never has holes. Every exchange disturbs the edge-sensor references, so the exchange procedure must be tied to phasing calibration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Segment rotation recoating and spare sector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：798 片 ÷ 每天 2 片 ≈ 399 天，18 個月約 548 天，所以約 73% 的日子都有鏡段更換；一組 133 片備用鏡段相當於約 66 天的更換緩衝。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 798 segments ÷ 2 per day ≈ 399 days, against about 548 days in 18 months, so segments are exchanged on about 73% of days; a spare set of 133 segments is a buffer of about 66 exchange days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分段主鏡可以像單片主鏡一樣，幾年才一次整面重鍍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A segmented primary can be recoated all at once every few years like a monolithic one." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鏡段輪替重鍍與備用扇區」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Segment rotation recoating and spare sector”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: Armazones 營運：鏡段輪替、重鍍節奏與可用率
knowledge.titleEn: Operations on Armazones: segment rotation, recoating cadence and availability
knowledge.text: ELT 位於海拔約 3000 m 的 Cerro Armazones，灰塵與高紫外輻射會逐漸降低鏡面反射率並增加散射。M1 的每片鏡段約每 18 個月重鍍一次，因此營運上是一條連續的生產線：每天卸下約兩片、送到山上的鍍膜設施清洗重鍍，再裝回並重新共相。
knowledge.textEn: The ELT sits at about 3000 m on Cerro Armazones, where dust and strong ultraviolet gradually lower reflectance and increase scatter. Each M1 segment is recoated roughly every 18 months, so operations run as a continuous production line: about two segments per day are removed, cleaned and recoated in the on-site coating facility, reinstalled and rephased.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分段主鏡可以像單片主鏡一樣，幾年才一次整面重鍍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A segmented primary can be recoated all at once every few years like a monolithic one. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Armazones 營運：鏡段輪替、重鍍節奏與可用率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Operations on Armazones: segment rotation, recoating cadence and availability" is correct?
options: 分段主鏡可以像單片主鏡一樣，幾年才一次整面重鍍。
ELT 位於海拔約 3000 m 的 Cerro Armazones，灰塵與高紫外輻射會逐漸降低鏡面反射率並增加散射。
看到星像變小就代表望遠鏡已達設計 Strehl。
optionsEn: A segmented primary can be recoated all at once every few years like a monolithic one.

A visibly smaller star image proves the telescope meets its design Strehl.
