knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開環查表、閉環修正與大氣平均」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and atmospheric averaging" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
開環查表若以錯誤的溫度感測器為索引，入夜降溫時預設力偏離數十牛頓，閉環需要多個週期才能追回，期間星像帶著明顯像散；若此時操作員手動提高增益，迴路可能進入振盪。
望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

If the open-loop table is indexed by a faulty temperature sensor, the preset forces drift by tens of newtons as the night cools, the closed loop needs several cycles to catch up and star images carry visible astigmatism meanwhile.
Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image.
quiz.explanation: 開環查表若以錯誤的溫度感測器為索引，入夜降溫時預設力偏離數十牛頓，閉環需要多個週期才能追回，期間星像帶著明顯像散；若此時操作員手動提高增益，迴路可能進入振盪。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the open-loop table is indexed by a faulty temperature sensor, the preset forces drift by tens of newtons as the night cools, the closed loop needs several cycles to catch up and star images carry visible astigmatism meanwhile; an operator who raises the gain by hand can push the loop into oscillation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 調試、驗收與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」如何決定ESO 新技術望遠鏡 NTT的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Commissioning log and accepted image quality” determines the key performance of “ESO New Technology Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 望遠鏡交接時，工程師要交付的不是一台「裝好的機器」，而是一套可重現的狀態：致動器校正曲線、影響矩陣、查表、指向模型、影像分析儀零點與影像品質驗收數據。驗收以全系統指標進行：在量測視寧度下的星像 FWHM 與 80% 能量集中直徑、主動光學從大誤差起始的收斂時間、指向與追蹤殘差，以及儀器更換（Nasmyth 兩側）後的重現性。NTT 之後持續承接 EFOSC2、SOXS 等儀器，每次換裝都要重做這組驗證。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At handoff the engineer delivers not an assembled machine but a reproducible state: actuator calibration curves, the influence matrix, lookup tables, the pointing model, image-analyser zero points and the image-quality acceptance data. Acceptance uses whole-system metrics: stellar FWHM and 80% encircled-energy diameter at the measured seeing, the convergence time of active optics from a large initial error, pointing and tracking residuals, and repeatability after instrument changes between the two Nasmyth sides. The NTT went on to host instruments such as EFOSC2 and SOXS, and each installation repeats this verification set. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning log and accepted image quality”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：低增益迭代的收斂：殘餘 = (1 − g)^k × 初始誤差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Convergence of a low-gain iteration: residual = (1 − g)^k × initial error.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Commissioning log and accepted image quality”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 調試、驗收與工程交接
knowledge.text: 望遠鏡交接時，工程師要交付的不是一台「裝好的機器」，而是一套可重現的狀態：致動器校正曲線、影響矩陣、查表、指向模型、影像分析儀零點與影像品質驗收數據。驗收以全系統指標進行：在量測視寧度下的星像 FWHM 與 80% 能量集中直徑、主動光學從大誤差起始的收斂時間、指向與追蹤殘差，以及儀器更換（Nasmyth 兩側）後的重現性。
knowledge.textEn: At handoff the engineer delivers not an assembled machine but a reproducible state: actuator calibration curves, the influence matrix, lookup tables, the pointing model, image-analyser zero points and the image-quality acceptance data. Acceptance uses whole-system metrics: stellar FWHM and 80% encircled-energy diameter at the measured seeing, the convergence time of active optics from a large initial error, pointing and tracking residuals, and repeatability after instrument changes between the two Nasmyth sides.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「調試、驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。
鏡子越薄越容易變形，所以薄鏡望遠鏡的影像一定比厚鏡差。
望遠鏡交接時，工程師要交付的不是一台「裝好的機器」，而是一套可重現的狀態：致動器校正曲線、影響矩陣、查表、指向模型、影像分析儀零點與影像品質驗收數據。
optionsEn: Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image.
Thinner mirrors deform more, so a thin-mirror telescope must give worse images.

At handoff the engineer delivers not an assembled machine but a reproducible state: actuator calibration curves, the influence matrix, lookup tables, the pointing model, image-analyser zero points and the image-quality acceptance data.
quiz.explanation: 望遠鏡交接時，工程師要交付的不是一台「裝好的機器」，而是一套可重現的狀態：致動器校正曲線、影響矩陣、查表、指向模型、影像分析儀零點與影像品質驗收數據。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At handoff the engineer delivers not an assembled machine but a reproducible state: actuator calibration curves, the influence matrix, lookup tables, the pointing model, image-analyser zero points and the image-quality acceptance data. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 調試、驗收與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Commissioning log and accepted image quality” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：低增益迭代的收斂：殘餘 = (1 − g)^k × 初始誤差。初始像散 1 µm、增益 g = 0.5 時，5 個週期後為 0.5⁵ ≈ 0.031，即 31 nm，5×30 s = 2.5 min 收斂到判準內；g = 0.3 時殘餘為 0.7^k，需要 9 個週期才降到 0.7⁹ ≈ 0.040，即 40 nm。穩態雜訊 σ_ss ≈ σ_m·√(g/(2−g))：σ_m ≈ 21 nm、g = 0.5 時約 12 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Convergence of a low-gain iteration: residual = (1 − g)^k × initial error. With 1 µm of initial astigmatism and gain g = 0.5, five cycles leave 0.5⁵ ≈ 0.031, that is 31 nm, so 5×30 s = 2.5 min reaches the criterion; with g = 0.3 the residual is 0.7^k and nine cycles are needed to reach 0.7⁹ ≈ 0.040, that is 40 nm. Steady-state noise is σ_ss ≈ σ_m·√(g/(2−g)): with σ_m ≈ 21 nm and g = 0.5 it is about 12 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收測試：故意在支撐力中注入 1 µm 像散，閉環後記錄每個週期的殘餘，確認收斂曲線符合 (1 − g)^k 且穩態殘餘低於 36 nm；同夜在三個天頂距各量一次 FWHM 與 DIMM 視寧度，寫入驗收紀錄，連同致動器校正與指向模型檔案一起歸檔並標註版本。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Acceptance test: inject 1 µm of astigmatism into the support forces on purpose, close the loop and log the residual each cycle, confirming the convergence follows (1 − g)^k with a steady-state residual below 36 nm; on the same night measure FWHM and DIMM seeing at three zenith distances, enter them in the acceptance record and archive them with the actuator calibrations and pointing-model files under a version label.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 低增益迭代的收斂：殘餘 = (1 − g)^k × 初始誤差。初始像散 1 µm、增益 g = 0.5 時，5 個週期後為 0.5⁵ ≈ 0.031，即 31 nm，5×30 s = 2.5 min 收斂到判準內；g = 0.3 時殘餘為 0.7^k，需要 9 個週期才降到 0.7⁹ ≈ 0.040，即 40 nm。穩態雜訊 σ_ss ≈ σ_m·√(g/(2−g))：σ_m ≈ 21 nm、g = 0.5 時約 12 nm。
knowledge.textEn: Convergence of a low-gain iteration: residual = (1 − g)^k × initial error. With 1 µm of initial astigmatism and gain g = 0.5, five cycles leave 0.5⁵ ≈ 0.031, that is 31 nm, so 5×30 s = 2.5 min reaches the criterion; with g = 0.3 the residual is 0.7^k and nine cycles are needed to reach 0.7⁹ ≈ 0.040, that is 40 nm. Steady-state noise is σ_ss ≈ σ_m·√(g/(2−g)): with σ_m ≈ 21 nm and g = 0.5 it is about 12 nm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「調試、驗收與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 低增益迭代的收斂：殘餘 = (1 − g)^k × 初始誤差。
支撐點越多，主動光學就能修正任意高階的像差。
參考星越暗越好，因為亮星會讓 CCD 飽和。
optionsEn: Convergence of a low-gain iteration: residual = (1 − g)^k × initial error.
With enough support points active optics can correct arbitrarily high-order aberrations.
Fainter reference stars are better because bright stars saturate the CCD.
quiz.explanation: 低增益迭代的收斂：殘餘 = (1 − g)^k × 初始誤差。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Convergence of a low-gain iteration: residual = (1 − g)^k × initial error. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 調試、驗收與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Commissioning log and accepted image quality” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收測試：故意在支撐力中注入 1 µm 像散，閉環後記錄每個週期的殘餘，確認收斂曲線符合 (1 − g)^k 且穩態殘餘低於 36 nm；同夜在三個天頂距各量一次 FWHM 與 DIMM 視寧度，寫入驗收紀錄，連同致動器校正與指向模型檔案一起歸檔並標註版本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptance test: inject 1 µm of astigmatism into the support forces on purpose, close the loop and log the residual each cycle, confirming the convergence follows (1 − g)^k with a steady-state residual below 36 nm; on the same night measure FWHM and DIMM seeing at three zenith distances, enter them in the acceptance record and archive them with the actuator calibrations and pointing-model files under a version label. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時只交付「目前能看到好星像」而沒有版本化的查表與校正檔，幾個月後換儀器或更換致動器時無人知道原始狀態，調試得從頭再來，損失數週觀測時間。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Handing over only a telescope that currently shows good images, without versioned tables and calibration files, means that months later an instrument change or actuator replacement finds nobody who knows the original state, commissioning restarts from scratch and weeks of observing time are lost.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收測試：故意在支撐力中注入 1 µm 像散，閉環後記錄每個週期的殘餘，確認收斂曲線符合 (1 − g)^k 且穩態殘餘低於 36 nm；同夜在三個天頂距各量一次 FWHM 與 DIMM 視寧度，寫入驗收紀錄，連同致動器校正與指向模型檔案一起歸檔並標註版本。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance test: inject 1 µm of astigmatism into the support forces on purpose, close the loop and log the residual each cycle, confirming the convergence follows (1 − g)^k with a steady-state residual below 36 nm; on the same night measure FWHM and DIMM seeing at three zenith distances, enter them in the acceptance record and archive them with the actuator calibrations and pointing-model files under a version label.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「調試、驗收與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
驗收測試：故意在支撐力中注入 1 µm 像散，閉環後記錄每個週期的殘餘，確認收斂曲線符合 (1 − g)^k 且穩態殘餘低於 36 nm。
指向越準，星像就越銳利。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Acceptance test: inject 1 µm of astigmatism into the support forces on purpose, close the loop and log the residual each cycle, confirming the convergence follows (1 − g)^k with a steady-state residual below 36 nm.
The more accurate the pointing, the sharper the star images.
quiz.explanation: 驗收測試：故意在支撐力中注入 1 µm 像散，閉環後記錄每個週期的殘餘，確認收斂曲線符合 (1 − g)^k 且穩態殘餘低於 36 nm；同夜在三個天頂距各量一次 FWHM 與 DIMM 視寧度，寫入驗收紀錄，連同致動器校正與指向模型檔案一起歸檔並標註版本。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance test: inject 1 µm of astigmatism into the support forces on purpose, close the loop and log the residual each cycle, confirming the convergence follows (1 − g)^k with a steady-state residual below 36 nm; on the same night measure FWHM and DIMM seeing at three zenith distances, enter them in the acceptance record and archive them with the actuator calibrations and pointing-model files under a version label. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 調試、驗收與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調試紀錄與驗收影像品質」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Commissioning log and accepted image quality” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時只交付「目前能看到好星像」而沒有版本化的查表與校正檔，幾個月後換儀器或更換致動器時無人知道原始狀態，調試得從頭再來，損失數週觀測時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Handing over only a telescope that currently shows good images, without versioned tables and calibration files, means that months later an instrument change or actuator replacement finds nobody who knows the original state, commissioning restarts from scratch and weeks of observing time are lost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：NTT 之後持續承接 EFOSC2、SOXS 等儀器，每次換裝都要重做這組驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The NTT went on to host instruments such as EFOSC2 and SOXS, and each installation repeats this verification set.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「望遠鏡驗收就是看一張漂亮的星像照片。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Telescope acceptance is just looking at one pretty star image." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「調試、驗收與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Commissioning, acceptance and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
鏡子越薄越容易變形，所以薄鏡望遠鏡的影像一定比厚鏡差。
交接時只交付「目前能看到好星像」而沒有版本化的查表與校正檔，幾個月後換儀器或更換致動器時無人知道原始狀態，調試得從頭再來，損失數週觀測時間。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Thinner mirrors deform more, so a thin-mirror telescope must give worse images.

Handing over only a telescope that currently shows good images, without versioned tables and calibration files, means that months later an instrument change or actuator replacement finds nobody who knows the original state, commissioning restarts from scratch and weeks of observing time are lost.

quiz.explanationEn: Handing over only a telescope that currently shows good images, without versioned tables and calibration files, means that months later an instrument change or actuator replacement finds nobody who knows the original state, commissioning restarts from scratch and weeks of observing time are lost. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡
summary: 以 ESO 帕拉納爾的 VISTA 為對象，從 1.65° 視場與 12 m² 集光面積的集光率出發，解析 f/1 Zerodur 主鏡與 84 點支撐、三噸重 VIRCAM 低溫相機內 16 片 Raytheon VIRGO HgCdTe 陣列的背景極限、副鏡六足平台的閉環波前控制、2MASS 光度與天文定位校正，以及每晚數百 GB 的巡天資料流與驗收。
summaryEn: Taking ESO's VISTA at Paranal, this course starts from the étendue of a 1.65° field on 12 m² of collecting area and works through the f/1 Zerodur primary on 84 supports, the background-limited performance of the 16 Raytheon VIRGO HgCdTe arrays inside the three-tonne cryogenic VIRCAM, closed-loop wavefront control of the secondary hexapod, photometric and astrometric calibration against 2MASS, and the hundreds of gigabytes per night of survey data flow and acceptance.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: Ks 波段深度練習（教學假設）：零點 24.6 等（1 e⁻/s），天空 13.0 等/arcsec²，像素 0.339″，一顆 Ks = 18.0 的星每秒給 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 18.0)) ≈ 437 e⁻；天空每像素 ≈ 5000 e⁻/s。測光孔徑直徑 2″（面積 3.14 arcsec²，27.3 像素），60 s 總曝光（6 幀各 10 s，讀出雜訊 20 e⁻）：訊號 437×60 = 26200 e⁻；天空 27.3×5000×60 = 8.2×10⁶ e⁻；讀出雜訊變異數 27.3×6×20² ≈ 6.6×10⁴ e⁻²。SNR = 26200/√(26200 + 8.2×10⁶ + 6.6×10⁴) = 26200/2880 ≈ 9.1。5σ 極限星等 ≈ 18.0 + 2.5·log₁₀(9.1/5) ≈ 18.65 等。讀出雜訊只占總變異數的 0.8%，證實為背景極限；要再深 1 等需要 6.3 倍的曝光時間。數值為教學假設，不代表望遠鏡實際規格。
workedExample.textEn: Ks-band depth exercise (teaching assumptions): zero point 24.6 mag for 1 e⁻/s, sky 13.0 mag/arcsec², pixel 0.339″, so a Ks = 18.0 star gives 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 18.0)) ≈ 437 e⁻/s and the sky ≈ 5000 e⁻/s per pixel. For a 2″ photometric aperture (3.14 arcsec², 27.3 pixels) and 60 s total exposure (6 frames of 10 s, read noise 20 e⁻): signal 437×60 = 26200 e⁻; sky 27.3×5000×60 = 8.2×10⁶ e⁻; read-noise variance 27.3×6×20² ≈ 6.6×10⁴ e⁻². SNR = 26200/√(26200 + 8.2×10⁶ + 6.6×10⁴) = 26200/2880 ≈ 9.1. The 5σ limiting magnitude ≈ 18.0 + 2.5·log₁₀(9.1/5) ≈ 18.65 mag. Read noise is only 0.8% of the total variance, confirming the background limit; going 1 magnitude deeper needs 6.3 times the exposure. Values are teaching assumptions, not telescope specifications.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巡天望遠鏡的集光率與近紅外背景」與「快焦比光學、矢高與焦深」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Survey étendue and the near-infrared background" and "Fast optics, sag and depth of focus": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巡天望遠鏡的集光率與近紅外背景：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Survey étendue and the near-infrared background: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1.65° 視場與集光率」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1.65° field and étendue” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 巡天望遠鏡的效率由集光率 A·Ω 決定：集光面積乘以視場立體角，代表單位時間能以給定深度覆蓋多少天區。VISTA 以 4.1 m 主鏡（中央有 1.2 m 孔）配上直徑 1.65° 的視場，是專為 0.8–2.3 µm 近紅外巡天設計的系統。近紅外天空並不暗：J 波段由 OH 氣輝主導，Ks 波段則加上大氣與望遠鏡的熱輻射，天空亮度約 13 等每平方角秒，因此偵測極限由天空光子雜訊而非偵測器決定，曝光策略必須繞著背景設計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.65° 視場與集光率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A survey telescope's efficiency is set by its étendue A·Ω, collecting area times field solid angle, which measures how much sky can be covered to a given depth per unit time. VISTA pairs a 4.1 m primary with a 1.2 m central hole to a 1.65° diameter field, a system designed specifically for 0.8–2.3 µm near-infrared surveys. The near-infrared sky is not dark: the J band is dominated by OH airglow and the Ks band adds thermal emission from the atmosphere and telescope, giving a sky brightness near 13 magnitudes per square arcsecond, so the detection limit is set by sky photon noise rather than the detector and the exposure strategy must be built around the background. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1.65° field and étendue”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：集光面積 A = π(2.05² − 0.60²) ≈ 12.1 m²；VIRCAM 偵測器有效視場 0.60 deg² = 0.60×(π/180)² ≈ 1.8×10⁻⁴ sr，故 A·Ω ≈ 2.2×10⁻³ m²·sr。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Collecting area A = π(2.05² − 0.60²) ≈ 12.1 m²; the VIRCAM detector field of 0.60 deg² = 0.60×(π/180)² ≈ 1.8×10⁻⁴ sr gives A·Ω ≈ 2.2×10⁻³ m²·sr.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「望遠鏡口徑越大，巡天速度一定越快。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger aperture always means a faster survey." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「1.65° 視場與集光率」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “1.65° field and étendue”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 巡天望遠鏡的集光率與近紅外背景
knowledge.titleEn: Survey étendue and the near-infrared background
knowledge.text: 巡天望遠鏡的效率由集光率 A·Ω 決定：集光面積乘以視場立體角，代表單位時間能以給定深度覆蓋多少天區。VISTA 以 4.1 m 主鏡（中央有 1.2 m 孔）配上直徑 1.65° 的視場，是專為 0.8–2.3 µm 近紅外巡天設計的系統。
knowledge.textEn: A survey telescope's efficiency is set by its étendue A·Ω, collecting area times field solid angle, which measures how much sky can be covered to a given depth per unit time. VISTA pairs a 4.1 m primary with a 1.2 m central hole to a 1.65° diameter field, a system designed specifically for 0.8–2.3 µm near-infrared surveys.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：望遠鏡口徑越大，巡天速度一定越快。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A larger aperture always means a faster survey. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巡天望遠鏡的集光率與近紅外背景」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Survey étendue and the near-infrared background" is correct?
options: 望遠鏡口徑越大，巡天速度一定越快。
巡天望遠鏡的效率由集光率 A·Ω 決定：集光面積乘以視場立體角，代表單位時間能以給定深度覆蓋多少天區。
焦比快只是讓曝光更短，對機械與熱設計沒有影響。
optionsEn: A larger aperture always means a faster survey.
A survey telescope's efficiency is set by its étendue A·Ω, collecting area times field solid angle, which measures how much sky can be covered to a given depth per unit time.
A fast focal ratio only shortens exposures and has no mechanical or thermal consequences.
quiz.explanation: 巡天望遠鏡的效率由集光率 A·Ω 決定：集光面積乘以視場立體角，代表單位時間能以給定深度覆蓋多少天區。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A survey telescope's efficiency is set by its étendue A·Ω, collecting area times field solid angle, which measures how much sky can be covered to a given depth per unit time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巡天望遠鏡的集光率與近紅外背景：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Survey étendue and the near-infrared background: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1.65° 視場與集光率」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1.65° field and étendue” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：集光面積 A = π(2.05² − 0.60²) ≈ 12.1 m²；VIRCAM 偵測器有效視場 0.60 deg² = 0.60×(π/180)² ≈ 1.8×10⁻⁴ sr，故 A·Ω ≈ 2.2×10⁻³ m²·sr。相比之下，一座 8.2 m 望遠鏡配 6.8′×6.8′ 視場（0.0128 deg² ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁶ sr、A ≈ 50 m²）的 A·Ω ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁴ m²·sr，VISTA 的巡天速度約為其 11 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Collecting area A = π(2.05² − 0.60²) ≈ 12.1 m²; the VIRCAM detector field of 0.60 deg² = 0.60×(π/180)² ≈ 1.8×10⁻⁴ sr gives A·Ω ≈ 2.2×10⁻³ m²·sr. By comparison an 8.2 m telescope with a 6.8′×6.8′ field (0.0128 deg² ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁶ sr, A ≈ 50 m²) has A·Ω ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁴ m²·sr, so VISTA surveys about 11 times faster. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從一組 Ks 波段影像量天空背景計數，換算成每平方角秒的星等並與帕拉納爾公開的近紅外天空亮度比較；再用集光率與量到的天空亮度，預測達到指定 5σ 深度所需的曝光時間，與巡天實際排程比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the sky background counts in a set of Ks images, convert them to magnitudes per square arcsecond and compare with the published Paranal near-infrared sky brightness; then use the étendue and the measured sky to predict the exposure time needed for a specified 5σ depth and compare with the survey's actual scheduling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 集光面積 A = π(2.05² − 0.60²) ≈ 12.1 m²；VIRCAM 偵測器有效視場 0.60 deg² = 0.60×(π/180)² ≈ 1.8×10⁻⁴ sr，故 A·Ω ≈ 2.2×10⁻³ m²·sr。相比之下，一座 8.2 m 望遠鏡配 6.8′×6.8′ 視場（0.0128 deg² ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁶ sr、A ≈ 50 m²）的 A·Ω ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁴ m²·sr，VISTA 的巡天速度約為其 11 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Collecting area A = π(2.05² − 0.60²) ≈ 12.1 m²; the VIRCAM detector field of 0.60 deg² = 0.60×(π/180)² ≈ 1.8×10⁻⁴ sr gives A·Ω ≈ 2.2×10⁻³ m²·sr. By comparison an 8.2 m telescope with a 6.8′×6.8′ field (0.0128 deg² ≈ 3.9×10⁻⁶ sr, A ≈ 50 m²) has A·Ω ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁴ m²·sr, so VISTA surveys about 11 times faster.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 巡天望遠鏡的集光率與近紅外背景：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey étendue and the near-infrared background: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「1.65° 視場與集光率」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “1.65° field and étendue” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從一組 Ks 波段影像量天空背景計數，換算成每平方角秒的星等並與帕拉納爾公開的近紅外天空亮度比較；再用集光率與量到的天空亮度，預測達到指定 5σ 深度所需的曝光時間，與巡天實際排程比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the sky background counts in a set of Ks images, convert them to magnitudes per square arcsecond and compare with the published Paranal near-infrared sky brightness; then use the étendue and the measured sky to predict the exposure time needed for a specified 5σ depth and compare with the survey's actual scheduling. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用可見光巡天的長曝光策略拍 Ks 波段，天空在數十秒內就讓偵測器接近飽和並進入非線性區，星像光度全部偏差；資料雖然「拍到了」，卻無法校正。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Applying a visible-survey long-exposure strategy in the Ks band drives the detector near saturation and into nonlinearity within tens of seconds, biasing every stellar magnitude; the data were taken but cannot be calibrated.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Measure the sky background counts in a set of Ks images, convert them to magnitudes per square arcsecond and compare with the published Paranal near-infrared sky brightness; then use the étendue and the measured sky to predict the exposure time needed for a specified 5σ depth and compare with the survey's actual scheduling.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.title: 巡天望遠鏡的集光率與近紅外背景：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Survey étendue and the near-infrared background: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1.65° 視場與集光率」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “1.65° field and étendue” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用可見光巡天的長曝光策略拍 Ks 波段，天空在數十秒內就讓偵測器接近飽和並進入非線性區，星像光度全部偏差；資料雖然「拍到了」，卻無法校正。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Applying a visible-survey long-exposure strategy in the Ks band drives the detector near saturation and into nonlinearity within tens of seconds, biasing every stellar magnitude; the data were taken but cannot be calibrated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：近紅外天空並不暗：J 波段由 OH 氣輝主導，Ks 波段則加上大氣與望遠鏡的熱輻射，天空亮度約 13 等每平方角秒，因此偵測極限由天空光子雜訊而非偵測器決定，曝光策略必須繞著背景設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The near-infrared sky is not dark: the J band is dominated by OH airglow and the Ks band adds thermal emission from the atmosphere and telescope, giving a sky brightness near 13 magnitudes per square arcsecond, so the detection limit is set by sky photon noise rather than the detector and the exposure strategy must be built around the background.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「望遠鏡口徑越大，巡天速度一定越快。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger aperture always means a faster survey." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 用可見光巡天的長曝光策略拍 Ks 波段，天空在數十秒內就讓偵測器接近飽和並進入非線性區，星像光度全部偏差；資料雖然「拍到了」，卻無法校正。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「巡天望遠鏡的集光率與近紅外背景」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Survey étendue and the near-infrared background" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
用可見光巡天的長曝光策略拍 Ks 波段，天空在數十秒內就讓偵測器接近飽和並進入非線性區，星像光度全部偏差；資料雖然「拍到了」，卻無法校正。
焦比快只是讓曝光更短，對機械與熱設計沒有影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Applying a visible-survey long-exposure strategy in the Ks band drives the detector near saturation and into nonlinearity within tens of seconds, biasing every stellar magnitude.
A fast focal ratio only shortens exposures and has no mechanical or thermal consequences.

steps.title: 快焦比光學、矢高與焦深：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Fast optics, sag and depth of focus: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「f/1 雙曲面主鏡與 f/3.25 卡塞格林焦點」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “f/1 hyperboloid primary and f/3.25 Cassegrain focus” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 為了在 4 m 級口徑上得到大視場又讓相機尺寸可控，VISTA 的主鏡做成 f/1 的雙曲面，副鏡為 1.24 m 的凸雙曲面，系統焦距 12.07 m、卡塞格林焦比 f/3.25；視場像差由相機內的透鏡校正器修正。f/1 的鏡面曲率極深，矢高超過鏡坯厚度，拋光與檢測都比傳統 f/2 以上的鏡面困難得多；而 f/3.25 的焦深只有數十微米，副鏡位置與鏡筒的熱伸縮必須持續補償。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「f/1 雙曲面主鏡與 f/3.25 卡塞格林焦點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: To obtain a wide field at 4 m aperture while keeping the camera a manageable size, VISTA's primary is an f/1 hyperboloid and the secondary a 1.24 m convex hyperboloid, giving a system focal length of 12.07 m and an f/3.25 Cassegrain focus; field aberrations are corrected by lenses inside the camera. An f/1 surface is extremely deeply curved, with a sag exceeding the blank thickness, making polishing and testing far harder than for conventional f/2 or slower mirrors, and the f/3.25 depth of focus is only tens of micrometres, so secondary position and tube thermal expansion must be compensated continuously. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “f/1 hyperboloid primary and f/3.25 Cassegrain focus”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主鏡近似球面曲率半徑 R = 2f = 8.2 m，邊緣矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 2.05²/16.4 ≈ 0.256 m，比 0.17 m 的鏡坯厚度還深。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The primary's paraxial radius is R = 2f = 8.2 m and the edge sag z = r²/(2R) = 2.05²/16.4 ≈ 0.256 m, deeper than the 0.17 m blank thickness.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焦比快只是讓曝光更短，對機械與熱設計沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fast focal ratio only shortens exposures and has no mechanical or thermal consequences." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「f/1 雙曲面主鏡與 f/3.25 卡塞格林焦點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “f/1 hyperboloid primary and f/3.25 Cassegrain focus”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 快焦比光學、矢高與焦深
knowledge.titleEn: Fast optics, sag and depth of focus
knowledge.text: 為了在 4 m 級口徑上得到大視場又讓相機尺寸可控，VISTA 的主鏡做成 f/1 的雙曲面，副鏡為 1.24 m 的凸雙曲面，系統焦距 12.07 m、卡塞格林焦比 f/3.25；視場像差由相機內的透鏡校正器修正。f/1 的鏡面曲率極深，矢高超過鏡坯厚度，拋光與檢測都比傳統 f/2 以上的鏡面困難得多；而 f/3.25 的焦深只有數十微米，副鏡位置與鏡筒的熱伸縮必須持續補償。
knowledge.textEn: To obtain a wide field at 4 m aperture while keeping the camera a manageable size, VISTA's primary is an f/1 hyperboloid and the secondary a 1.24 m convex hyperboloid, giving a system focal length of 12.07 m and an f/3.25 Cassegrain focus; field aberrations are corrected by lenses inside the camera. An f/1 surface is extremely deeply curved, with a sag exceeding the blank thickness, making polishing and testing far harder than for conventional f/2 or slower mirrors, and the f/3.25 depth of focus is only tens of micrometres, so secondary position and tube thermal expansion must be compensated continuously.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焦比快只是讓曝光更短，對機械與熱設計沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

steps.title: 快焦比光學、矢高與焦深：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fast optics, sag and depth of focus: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「f/1 雙曲面主鏡與 f/3.25 卡塞格林焦點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “f/1 hyperboloid primary and f/3.25 Cassegrain focus” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主鏡近似球面曲率半徑 R = 2f = 8.2 m，邊緣矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 2.05²/16.4 ≈ 0.256 m，比 0.17 m 的鏡坯厚度還深。焦深 ±2λF²：λ = 1.0 µm、F = 3.25 時 ±2×1.0×10⁻⁶×10.6 ≈ ±21 µm，Ks 波段（λ = 2.15 µm）為 ±45 µm；像素 20 µm 對應 20×10⁻⁶/12.07 ≈ 1.66×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.34″。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The primary's paraxial radius is R = 2f = 8.2 m and the edge sag z = r²/(2R) = 2.05²/16.4 ≈ 0.256 m, deeper than the 0.17 m blank thickness. Depth of focus ±2λF²: with λ = 1.0 µm and F = 3.25 it is ±2×1.0×10⁻⁶×10.6 ≈ ±21 µm, or ±45 µm in Ks (λ = 2.15 µm); a 20 µm pixel subtends 20×10⁻⁶/12.07 ≈ 1.66×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.34″. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：做焦點序列：以 10 µm 步進移動副鏡並量每一步的星像 FWHM，擬合拋物線取最佳焦點與曲率，曲率寬度應與 ±2λF² 的預測一致；同時以已知角距的雙星或星表位置量實際像素比例，與 0.34″/px 的設計值比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a focus sequence: step the secondary in 10 µm increments, measure stellar FWHM at each step and fit a parabola for best focus and curvature, whose width should match the ±2λF² prediction; at the same time measure the actual pixel scale from stars of known separation or catalogue positions and compare with the 0.34″/px design value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: The primary's paraxial radius is R = 2f = 8.2 m and the edge sag z = r²/(2R) = 2.05²/16.4 ≈ 0.256 m, deeper than the 0.17 m blank thickness. Depth of focus ±2λF²: with λ = 1.0 µm and F = 3.25 it is ±2×1.0×10⁻⁶×10.6 ≈ ±21 µm, or ±45 µm in Ks (λ = 2.15 µm); a 20 µm pixel subtends 20×10⁻⁶/12.07 ≈ 1.66×10⁻⁶ rad ≈ 0.34″.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「快焦比光學、矢高與焦深」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fast optics, sag and depth of focus", which statement holds?
options: 主鏡近似球面曲率半徑 R = 2f = 8.2 m，邊緣矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 2.05²/16.4 ≈ 0.256 m，比 0.17 m 的鏡坯厚度還深。
副鏡對準只需要在白天用雷射做一次。
一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。
optionsEn: The primary's paraxial radius is R = 2f = 8.2 m and the edge sag z = r²/(2R) = 2.05²/16.4 ≈ 0.256 m, deeper than the 0.17 m blank thickness.
Secondary alignment only needs to be done once by day with a laser.
One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field.
quiz.explanation: 主鏡近似球面曲率半徑 R = 2f = 8.2 m，邊緣矢高 z = r²/(2R) = 2.05²/16.4 ≈ 0.256 m，比 0.17 m 的鏡坯厚度還深。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The primary's paraxial radius is R = 2f = 8.2 m and the edge sag z = r²/(2R) = 2.05²/16.4 ≈ 0.256 m, deeper than the 0.17 m blank thickness. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 快焦比光學、矢高與焦深：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fast optics, sag and depth of focus: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「f/1 雙曲面主鏡與 f/3.25 卡塞格林焦點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “f/1 hyperboloid primary and f/3.25 Cassegrain focus” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 做焦點序列：以 10 µm 步進移動副鏡並量每一步的星像 FWHM，擬合拋物線取最佳焦點與曲率，曲率寬度應與 ±2λF² 的預測一致；同時以已知角距的雙星或星表位置量實際像素比例，與 0.34″/px 的設計值比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a focus sequence: step the secondary in 10 µm increments, measure stellar FWHM at each step and fit a parabola for best focus and curvature, whose width should match the ±2λF² prediction; at the same time measure the actual pixel scale from stars of known separation or catalogue positions and compare with the 0.34″/px design value. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鏡筒在入夜降溫時收縮，主副鏡間距改變數十微米，若焦點只在黃昏設定一次，一小時後星像 FWHM 從 0.6″ 退化到超過 1″，整段巡天影像深度不足需要重拍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: As the tube contracts during evening cooling the primary-secondary separation changes by tens of micrometres; if focus is set only once at dusk, stellar FWHM degrades from 0.6″ to more than 1″ within an hour and the survey images fall short of depth and must be repeated.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 做焦點序列：以 10 µm 步進移動副鏡並量每一步的星像 FWHM，擬合拋物線取最佳焦點與曲率，曲率寬度應與 ±2λF² 的預測一致；同時以已知角距的雙星或星表位置量實際像素比例，與 0.34″/px 的設計值比對。
knowledge.textEn: Run a focus sequence: step the secondary in 10 µm increments, measure stellar FWHM at each step and fit a parabola for best focus and curvature, whose width should match the ±2λF² prediction; at the same time measure the actual pixel scale from stars of known separation or catalogue positions and compare with the 0.34″/px design value.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「快焦比光學、矢高與焦深」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fast optics, sag and depth of focus"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
做焦點序列：以 10 µm 步進移動副鏡並量每一步的星像 FWHM，擬合拋物線取最佳焦點與曲率，曲率寬度應與 ±2λF² 的預測一致。
望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Run a focus sequence: step the secondary in 10 µm increments, measure stellar FWHM at each step and fit a parabola for best focus and curvature, whose width should match the ±2λF² prediction.
Once a telescope is accepted, swapping instruments needs no re-verification.
quiz.explanation: 做焦點序列：以 10 µm 步進移動副鏡並量每一步的星像 FWHM，擬合拋物線取最佳焦點與曲率，曲率寬度應與 ±2λF² 的預測一致；同時以已知角距的雙星或星表位置量實際像素比例，與 0.34″/px 的設計值比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 快焦比光學、矢高與焦深：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fast optics, sag and depth of focus: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「f/1 雙曲面主鏡與 f/3.25 卡塞格林焦點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “f/1 hyperboloid primary and f/3.25 Cassegrain focus” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鏡筒在入夜降溫時收縮，主副鏡間距改變數十微米，若焦點只在黃昏設定一次，一小時後星像 FWHM 從 0.6″ 退化到超過 1″，整段巡天影像深度不足需要重拍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: As the tube contracts during evening cooling the primary-secondary separation changes by tens of micrometres; if focus is set only once at dusk, stellar FWHM degrades from 0.6″ to more than 1″ within an hour and the survey images fall short of depth and must be repeated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：f/1 的鏡面曲率極深，矢高超過鏡坯厚度，拋光與檢測都比傳統 f/2 以上的鏡面困難得多；而 f/3.25 的焦深只有數十微米，副鏡位置與鏡筒的熱伸縮必須持續補償。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An f/1 surface is extremely deeply curved, with a sag exceeding the blank thickness, making polishing and testing far harder than for conventional f/2 or slower mirrors, and the f/3.25 depth of focus is only tens of micrometres, so secondary position and tube thermal expansion must be compensated continuously.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焦比快只是讓曝光更短，對機械與熱設計沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fast focal ratio only shortens exposures and has no mechanical or thermal consequences." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鏡筒在入夜降溫時收縮，主副鏡間距改變數十微米，若焦點只在黃昏設定一次，一小時後星像 FWHM 從 0.6″ 退化到超過 1″，整段巡天影像深度不足需要重拍。
knowledge.textEn: As the tube contracts during evening cooling the primary-secondary separation changes by tens of micrometres; if focus is set only once at dusk, stellar FWHM degrades from 0.6″ to more than 1″ within an hour and the survey images fall short of depth and must be repeated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「快焦比光學、矢高與焦深」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fast optics, sag and depth of focus" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A 17 cm thick blank is stiff enough to need no active support.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主鏡坯、氣動軸向支撐與副鏡六足平台」與「紅外相機：偵測器、低溫與背景極限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Primary blank, pneumatic axial supports and the secondary hexapod" and "The infrared camera: detectors, cryogenics and the background limit": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主鏡坯、氣動軸向支撐與副鏡六足平台：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Primary blank, pneumatic axial supports and the secondary hexapod: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「17 cm Zerodur 主鏡與 84 點支撐」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “17 cm Zerodur primary and 84-point support” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VISTA 主鏡是厚 17 cm、中央開孔 1.2 m 的 Zerodur 彎月鏡，由 84 點軸向支撐承載：81 個氣動致動器提供可調的支撐力，3 個被動定義點決定鏡面位置，側向支撐則承擔指向偏離天頂時的橫向重量。副鏡裝在五軸六足平台上，可做微米級的平移與 0.1″ 級的傾斜，以修正離焦與彗差。氣動支撐的優點是力的均勻性與低摩擦，但壓力迴路的響應與洩漏必須監控。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「17 cm Zerodur 主鏡與 84 點支撐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: VISTA's primary is a Zerodur meniscus 17 cm thick with a 1.2 m central hole, carried by 84 axial supports: 81 pneumatic actuators provide adjustable force, 3 passive definers fix the mirror position, and lateral supports take the transverse load away from zenith. The secondary sits on a five-axis hexapod capable of micrometre translations and 0.1″ tilts to correct defocus and coma. Pneumatic supports offer uniform force and low friction, but the response and leakage of the pressure loops must be monitored. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “17 cm Zerodur primary and 84-point support”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The primary mass is m ≈ ρ·A·t = 2530×12.1×0.17 ≈ 5.2 t, so each axial support carries on average 5200×9.81/84 ≈ 610 N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡坯厚度 17 cm 已經夠厚，不需要主動支撐。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A 17 cm thick blank is stiff enough to need no active support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「17 cm Zerodur 主鏡與 84 點支撐」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “17 cm Zerodur primary and 84-point support”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主鏡坯、氣動軸向支撐與副鏡六足平台
knowledge.titleEn: Primary blank, pneumatic axial supports and the secondary hexapod
knowledge.text: VISTA 主鏡是厚 17 cm、中央開孔 1.2 m 的 Zerodur 彎月鏡，由 84 點軸向支撐承載：81 個氣動致動器提供可調的支撐力，3 個被動定義點決定鏡面位置，側向支撐則承擔指向偏離天頂時的橫向重量。副鏡裝在五軸六足平台上，可做微米級的平移與 0.1″ 級的傾斜，以修正離焦與彗差。
knowledge.textEn: VISTA's primary is a Zerodur meniscus 17 cm thick with a 1.2 m central hole, carried by 84 axial supports: 81 pneumatic actuators provide adjustable force, 3 passive definers fix the mirror position, and lateral supports take the transverse load away from zenith. The secondary sits on a five-axis hexapod capable of micrometre translations and 0.1″ tilts to correct defocus and coma.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鏡坯厚度 17 cm 已經夠厚，不需要主動支撐。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A 17 cm thick blank is stiff enough to need no active support. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

steps.title: 主鏡坯、氣動軸向支撐與副鏡六足平台：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Primary blank, pneumatic axial supports and the secondary hexapod: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「17 cm Zerodur 主鏡與 84 點支撐」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “17 cm Zerodur primary and 84-point support” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主鏡質量 m ≈ ρ·A·t = 2530×12.1×0.17 ≈ 5.2 t，每個軸向支撐平均承力 5200×9.81/84 ≈ 610 N。多點支撐的重力印痕 RMS 可用 δ ≈ γ·(q/D_f)·(A/N)² 估計（γ ≈ 1.2×10⁻³ 為最佳化支撐的形狀係數）：面載荷 q = ρgt ≈ 4220 Pa，板剛度 D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] ≈ 3.9×10⁷ N·m，A/N = 12.1/84 ≈ 0.144 m²，得 δ ≈ 1.2×10⁻³×1.08×10⁻⁴×0.0207 ≈ 2.7 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The primary mass is m ≈ ρ·A·t = 2530×12.1×0.17 ≈ 5.2 t, so each axial support carries on average 5200×9.81/84 ≈ 610 N. Gravity print-through RMS for a multi-point support can be estimated as δ ≈ γ·(q/D_f)·(A/N)² (γ ≈ 1.2×10⁻³ for an optimised support): with areal load q = ρgt ≈ 4220 Pa, plate stiffness D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] ≈ 3.9×10⁷ N·m and A/N = 12.1/84 ≈ 0.144 m², δ ≈ 1.2×10⁻³×1.08×10⁻⁴×0.0207 ≈ 2.7 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在鏡室內裝荷重元監控每個氣動支撐的實際力，比較與指令壓力的線性度與滯後；以望遠鏡在不同天頂距下的高階波前量測結果反推支撐印痕，確認其 RMS 在奈米等級而非數十奈米；六足平台則以位移感測器驗證 1 µm 步進的重複性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Monitor the actual force of each pneumatic support with load cells in the cell, checking linearity and hysteresis against commanded pressure; back out the support print-through from high-order wavefront measurements at several zenith distances and confirm an RMS at the nanometre rather than tens-of-nanometre level; verify the hexapod's 1 µm step repeatability with displacement sensors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主鏡質量 m ≈ ρ·A·t = 2530×12.1×0.17 ≈ 5.2 t，每個軸向支撐平均承力 5200×9.81/84 ≈ 610 N。多點支撐的重力印痕 RMS 可用 δ ≈ γ·(q/D_f)·(A/N)² 估計（γ ≈ 1.2×10⁻³ 為最佳化支撐的形狀係數）：面載荷 q = ρgt ≈ 4220 Pa，板剛度 D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] ≈ 3.9×10⁷ N·m，A/N = 12.1/84 ≈ 0.144 m²，得 δ ≈ 1.2×10⁻³×1.08×10⁻⁴×0.0207 ≈ 2.7 nm。
knowledge.textEn: The primary mass is m ≈ ρ·A·t = 2530×12.1×0.17 ≈ 5.2 t, so each axial support carries on average 5200×9.81/84 ≈ 610 N. Gravity print-through RMS for a multi-point support can be estimated as δ ≈ γ·(q/D_f)·(A/N)² (γ ≈ 1.2×10⁻³ for an optimised support): with areal load q = ρgt ≈ 4220 Pa, plate stiffness D_f = Et³/[12(1−ν²)] ≈ 3.9×10⁷ N·m and A/N = 12.1/84 ≈ 0.144 m², δ ≈ 1.2×10⁻³×1.08×10⁻⁴×0.0207 ≈ 2.7 nm.

steps.title: 主鏡坯、氣動軸向支撐與副鏡六足平台：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Primary blank, pneumatic axial supports and the secondary hexapod: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「17 cm Zerodur 主鏡與 84 點支撐」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “17 cm Zerodur primary and 84-point support” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在鏡室內裝荷重元監控每個氣動支撐的實際力，比較與指令壓力的線性度與滯後；以望遠鏡在不同天頂距下的高階波前量測結果反推支撐印痕，確認其 RMS 在奈米等級而非數十奈米；六足平台則以位移感測器驗證 1 µm 步進的重複性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor the actual force of each pneumatic support with load cells in the cell, checking linearity and hysteresis against commanded pressure; back out the support print-through from high-order wavefront measurements at several zenith distances and confirm an RMS at the nanometre rather than tens-of-nanometre level; verify the hexapod's 1 µm step repeatability with displacement sensors. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一個氣動迴路慢速洩漏使該區支撐力偏低數十牛頓，鏡面局部下陷，影像一角出現像散與星像拉長；若監控只讀取壓力設定值而非實際力，這個偏差會持續數週。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A slow leak in one pneumatic loop lowers the local support force by tens of newtons, the mirror sags locally and one corner of the field shows astigmatism and elongated stars; if monitoring reads only the pressure setpoint rather than the actual force, the error persists for weeks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: 一個氣動迴路慢速洩漏使該區支撐力偏低數十牛頓，鏡面局部下陷，影像一角出現像散與星像拉長；若監控只讀取壓力設定值而非實際力，這個偏差會持續數週。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 紅外相機：偵測器、低溫與背景極限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The infrared camera: detectors, cryogenics and the background limit: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「VIRCAM 低溫相機與 16 片 VIRGO HgCdTe 陣列」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “VIRCAM cryogenic camera and 16 VIRGO HgCdTe arrays” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VIRCAM 重約 3 t，內部以 4×4 排列安裝 16 片 Raytheon VIRGO 2048×2048 的 HgCdTe 陣列，像素 20 µm，總計 6700 萬像素，偵測器間留有間隙，因此一次曝光（pawprint）覆蓋 0.60 deg² 而非整個 1.65° 視場。偵測器與濾鏡輪在低溫下工作以壓低暗電流與自身熱輻射，相機入口是一片直徑近 1 m 的大型紅外窗；系統不設冷光闌，而以長冷擋光筒抑制來自望遠鏡結構的熱背景。在 Ks 波段，天空與熱背景的光子雜訊遠大於讀出雜訊，是典型的背景極限成像。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「VIRCAM 低溫相機與 16 片 VIRGO HgCdTe 陣列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: VIRCAM weighs about 3 t and holds 16 Raytheon VIRGO 2048×2048 HgCdTe arrays in a 4×4 layout with 20 µm pixels, 67 million pixels in all; gaps between detectors mean one exposure, a pawprint, covers 0.60 deg² rather than the full 1.65° field. Detectors and the filter wheel run cold to suppress dark current and their own thermal emission, the camera entrance is a large infrared window nearly 1 m across, and instead of a cold pupil stop a long cold baffle tube suppresses thermal background from the telescope structure. In Ks the photon noise of sky and thermal background far exceeds read noise, the classic background-limited regime. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “VIRCAM cryogenic camera and 16 VIRGO HgCdTe arrays”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 Ks 波段零點 24.6 等（每秒 1 電子，教學假設）與天空 13.0 等/arcsec² 計算：天空電子率 = 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 13.0)) ≈ 4.4×10⁴ e⁻/s/arcsec²，每像素（0.339″，0.115 arcsec²）約 5000 e⁻/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a Ks zero point of 24.6 mag for 1 electron per second (teaching assumption) and a sky of 13.0 mag/arcsec²: sky rate = 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 13.0)) ≈ 4.4×10⁴ e⁻/s/arcsec², about 5000 e⁻/s per 0.339″ pixel (0.115 arcsec²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「紅外偵測器只要夠冷，曝光越長影像越深。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the infrared detector is cold enough, longer exposures always go deeper." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「VIRCAM 低溫相機與 16 片 VIRGO HgCdTe 陣列」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “VIRCAM cryogenic camera and 16 VIRGO HgCdTe arrays”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 紅外相機：偵測器、低溫與背景極限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The infrared camera: detectors, cryogenics and the background limit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「VIRCAM 低溫相機與 16 片 VIRGO HgCdTe 陣列」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “VIRCAM cryogenic camera and 16 VIRGO HgCdTe arrays” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 Ks 波段零點 24.6 等（每秒 1 電子，教學假設）與天空 13.0 等/arcsec² 計算：天空電子率 = 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 13.0)) ≈ 4.4×10⁴ e⁻/s/arcsec²，每像素（0.339″，0.115 arcsec²）約 5000 e⁻/s。滿井約 1.5×10⁵ e⁻ 時 30 s 就飽和，為保持線性區曝光須控制在 5–10 s；低溫下暗電流 < 1 e⁻/s/px，相對天空可忽略。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a Ks zero point of 24.6 mag for 1 electron per second (teaching assumption) and a sky of 13.0 mag/arcsec²: sky rate = 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 13.0)) ≈ 4.4×10⁴ e⁻/s/arcsec², about 5000 e⁻/s per 0.339″ pixel (0.115 arcsec²). With a full well of about 1.5×10⁵ e⁻ the pixel saturates in 30 s, so exposures must stay at 5–10 s to remain in the linear range; the cold dark current below 1 e⁻/s/px is negligible against the sky. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以暗場與不同曝光時間的平場做線性度曲線，找出每片偵測器的非線性起點與滿井；在實際天空影像中量每像素的天空電子率與其雜訊，確認雜訊接近 √N 的光子統計，且讀出雜訊的貢獻小於 10%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build linearity curves from darks and flats of increasing exposure time to find each detector's nonlinearity onset and full well; in real sky images measure the sky electron rate per pixel and its noise, confirming the noise approaches √N photon statistics with read noise contributing less than 10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 Ks 波段零點 24.6 等（每秒 1 電子，教學假設）與天空 13.0 等/arcsec² 計算：天空電子率 = 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 13.0)) ≈ 4.4×10⁴ e⁻/s/arcsec²，每像素（0.339″，0.115 arcsec²）約 5000 e⁻/s。滿井約 1.5×10⁵ e⁻ 時 30 s 就飽和，為保持線性區曝光須控制在 5–10 s；低溫下暗電流 < 1 e⁻/s/px，相對天空可忽略。
knowledge.textEn: With a Ks zero point of 24.6 mag for 1 electron per second (teaching assumption) and a sky of 13.0 mag/arcsec²: sky rate = 10^(0.4×(24.6 − 13.0)) ≈ 4.4×10⁴ e⁻/s/arcsec², about 5000 e⁻/s per 0.339″ pixel (0.115 arcsec²). With a full well of about 1.5×10⁵ e⁻ the pixel saturates in 30 s, so exposures must stay at 5–10 s to remain in the linear range; the cold dark current below 1 e⁻/s/px is negligible against the sky.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

optionsEn: One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field.
A larger aperture always means a faster survey.

steps.title: 紅外相機：偵測器、低溫與背景極限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The infrared camera: detectors, cryogenics and the background limit: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「VIRCAM 低溫相機與 16 片 VIRGO HgCdTe 陣列」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “VIRCAM cryogenic camera and 16 VIRGO HgCdTe arrays” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以暗場與不同曝光時間的平場做線性度曲線，找出每片偵測器的非線性起點與滿井；在實際天空影像中量每像素的天空電子率與其雜訊，確認雜訊接近 √N 的光子統計，且讀出雜訊的貢獻小於 10%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build linearity curves from darks and flats of increasing exposure time to find each detector's nonlinearity onset and full well; in real sky images measure the sky electron rate per pixel and its noise, confirming the noise approaches √N photon statistics with read noise contributing less than 10%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：相機內某個低溫級溫度升高幾 K 時，濾鏡與擋光筒的熱輻射在 Ks 波段迅速增加，背景計數翻倍而深度損失 0.4 等；若未同時記錄溫度，這會被誤判成天氣變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If one cryogenic stage inside the camera warms by a few kelvin, thermal emission from the filters and baffle rises sharply in Ks, the background doubles and the depth loses 0.4 magnitudes; without a temperature log this is mistaken for bad weather.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以暗場與不同曝光時間的平場做線性度曲線，找出每片偵測器的非線性起點與滿井；在實際天空影像中量每像素的天空電子率與其雜訊，確認雜訊接近 √N 的光子統計，且讀出雜訊的貢獻小於 10%。
knowledge.textEn: Build linearity curves from darks and flats of increasing exposure time to find each detector's nonlinearity onset and full well; in real sky images measure the sky electron rate per pixel and its noise, confirming the noise approaches √N photon statistics with read noise contributing less than 10%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「紅外相機：偵測器、低溫與背景極限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The infrared camera: detectors, cryogenics and the background limit"?
options: 以暗場與不同曝光時間的平場做線性度曲線，找出每片偵測器的非線性起點與滿井。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
焦比快只是讓曝光更短，對機械與熱設計沒有影響。
optionsEn: Build linearity curves from darks and flats of increasing exposure time to find each detector's nonlinearity onset and full well.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A fast focal ratio only shortens exposures and has no mechanical or thermal consequences.
quiz.explanation: 以暗場與不同曝光時間的平場做線性度曲線，找出每片偵測器的非線性起點與滿井；在實際天空影像中量每像素的天空電子率與其雜訊，確認雜訊接近 √N 的光子統計，且讀出雜訊的貢獻小於 10%。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build linearity curves from darks and flats of increasing exposure time to find each detector's nonlinearity onset and full well; in real sky images measure the sky electron rate per pixel and its noise, confirming the noise approaches √N photon statistics with read noise contributing less than 10%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 紅外相機：偵測器、低溫與背景極限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The infrared camera: detectors, cryogenics and the background limit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「VIRCAM 低溫相機與 16 片 VIRGO HgCdTe 陣列」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “VIRCAM cryogenic camera and 16 VIRGO HgCdTe arrays” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 相機內某個低溫級溫度升高幾 K 時，濾鏡與擋光筒的熱輻射在 Ks 波段迅速增加，背景計數翻倍而深度損失 0.4 等；若未同時記錄溫度，這會被誤判成天氣變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If one cryogenic stage inside the camera warms by a few kelvin, thermal emission from the filters and baffle rises sharply in Ks, the background doubles and the depth loses 0.4 magnitudes; without a temperature log this is mistaken for bad weather. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在 Ks 波段，天空與熱背景的光子雜訊遠大於讀出雜訊，是典型的背景極限成像。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In Ks the photon noise of sky and thermal background far exceeds read noise, the classic background-limited regime.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「紅外偵測器只要夠冷，曝光越長影像越深。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the infrared detector is cold enough, longer exposures always go deeper." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相機內某個低溫級溫度升高幾 K 時，濾鏡與擋光筒的熱輻射在 Ks 波段迅速增加，背景計數翻倍而深度損失 0.4 等；若未同時記錄溫度，這會被誤判成天氣變差。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「紅外相機：偵測器、低溫與背景極限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The infrared camera: detectors, cryogenics and the background limit" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

quiz.explanationEn: If one cryogenic stage inside the camera warms by a few kelvin, thermal emission from the filters and baffle rises sharply in Ks, the background doubles and the depth loses 0.4 magnitudes; without a temperature log this is mistaken for bad weather. stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波前感測與副鏡閉環對準」與「光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wavefront sensing and closed-loop secondary alignment" and "Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波前感測與副鏡閉環對準：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing and closed-loop secondary alignment: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「低階波前感測器與副鏡閉環」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low-order wavefront sensors and the secondary loop” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VIRCAM 內建兩個低階波前感測器，在視場邊緣以 CCD 取得離焦星像做曲率感測，每分鐘左右輸出離焦與彗差，驅動六足平台做五軸閉環對準；高階波前則由可移入的分光鏡把星光送到科學偵測器量測，每晚數次用來修正主鏡的 81 個氣動支撐力。這種分工讓快速變化的熱效應交給副鏡、慢變的鏡面模態交給主鏡，是廣視場望遠鏡能在整夜維持次角秒影像的關鍵。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「低階波前感測器與副鏡閉環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: VIRCAM carries two low-order wavefront sensors that take defocused star images on CCDs at the field edge for curvature sensing, delivering defocus and coma about once a minute to drive the hexapod in five-axis closed-loop alignment; high-order wavefront is measured by moving beamsplitters that send starlight to the science detectors, a few times a night, to update the 81 pneumatic support forces of the primary. This division sends fast thermal effects to the secondary and slow mirror modes to the primary, and is what lets a wide-field telescope hold sub-arcsecond images all night. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Low-order wavefront sensors and the secondary loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：副鏡軸向移動 Δz 造成的焦面位移 Δf ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz，m = 3.25 為副鏡放大率，故 m² + 1 ≈ 11.6；要把焦面保持在 ±21 µm 焦深內，副鏡軸向位置須控制在 ±21/11.6 ≈ ±1.8 µm，與六足平台約 1 µm 的步進相當。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An axial secondary shift Δz moves the focal plane by Δf ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz, with secondary magnification m = 3.25 giving m² + 1 ≈ 11.6; holding the focal plane within the ±21 µm depth of focus requires the secondary axial position within ±21/11.6 ≈ ±1.8 µm, comparable to the hexapod's roughly 1 µm step.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「副鏡對準只需要在白天用雷射做一次。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Secondary alignment only needs to be done once by day with a laser." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「低階波前感測器與副鏡閉環」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Low-order wavefront sensors and the secondary loop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波前感測與副鏡閉環對準

This division sends fast thermal effects to the secondary and slow mirror modes to the primary, and is what lets a wide-field telescope hold sub-arcsecond images all night.

knowledge.text: 誤解：副鏡對準只需要在白天用雷射做一次。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

steps.title: 波前感測與副鏡閉環對準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wavefront sensing and closed-loop secondary alignment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低階波前感測器與副鏡閉環」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low-order wavefront sensors and the secondary loop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：副鏡軸向移動 Δz 造成的焦面位移 Δf ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz，m = 3.25 為副鏡放大率，故 m² + 1 ≈ 11.6；要把焦面保持在 ±21 µm 焦深內，副鏡軸向位置須控制在 ±21/11.6 ≈ ±1.8 µm，與六足平台約 1 µm 的步進相當。若 3 m 長的鋼結構（α ≈ 12×10⁻⁶/K）降溫 1 K，間距改變 36 µm，焦面移動約 420 µm，故每分鐘更新一次是必要的。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An axial secondary shift Δz moves the focal plane by Δf ≈ (m² + 1)·Δz, with secondary magnification m = 3.25 giving m² + 1 ≈ 11.6; holding the focal plane within the ±21 µm depth of focus requires the secondary axial position within ±21/11.6 ≈ ±1.8 µm, comparable to the hexapod's roughly 1 µm step. A 3 m steel structure (α ≈ 12×10⁻⁶/K) cooling by 1 K changes the separation by 36 µm and moves the focus by about 420 µm, so updates every minute are necessary. steps.title: 波前感測與副鏡閉環對準：量測與驗證

steps.instruction: 波前感測器導星的參考星太暗或落在偵測器邊緣時，曲率感測給出帶雜訊的離焦解，六足平台每分鐘來回跳動數微米，星像 FWHM 隨之起伏；若迴路沒有訊噪比門檻，整夜影像品質會隨導星亮度而變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VISTA 的每張影像都含有數百顆 2MASS 星表中的星，可直接解出零點與消光，不必另拍標準星；但 2MASS 到 VISTA 濾鏡系統的顏色轉換、偵測器之間的量子效率差異、平場的「照明修正」與視場邊緣的徑向畸變，都是系統誤差來源。天文定位同樣以 2MASS 為參考框架，畸變以徑向多項式建模，殘差的統計要分別記錄為每顆星的隨機誤差與整片偵測器的系統誤差，形成可追溯的誤差預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every VISTA frame contains hundreds of 2MASS catalogue stars, so zero point and extinction can be solved directly without separate standard-star fields; but the colour transformation from 2MASS to the VISTA filter system, quantum-efficiency differences between detectors, the illumination correction to the flat field and radial distortion at the field edge are all systematic error sources. Astrometry uses 2MASS as the reference frame as well, distortion is modelled with a radial polynomial, and the residual statistics are logged separately as per-star random error and per-detector systematic error, forming a traceable error budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：零點誤差預算以 RSS 合成：2MASS 參考系統 0.02 等、照明修正殘餘 0.01 等、平場 0.01 等、消光時間變化 0.01 等，總和 √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 等。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The zero-point budget combines in RSS: 2MASS reference system 0.02 mag, illumination-correction residual 0.01 mag, flat field 0.01 mag and extinction variation 0.01 mag, giving √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 mag.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有了 2MASS 星，VISTA 的光度校正就不會有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With 2MASS stars in every frame, VISTA photometry has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：零點誤差預算以 RSS 合成：2MASS 參考系統 0.02 等、照明修正殘餘 0.01 等、平場 0.01 等、消光時間變化 0.01 等，總和 √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 等。天文定位單星隨機誤差 σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/SNR：FWHM = 0.9″、SNR = 100 時 ≈ 0.0038″ ≈ 4 mas，遠小於 2MASS 參考框架本身約 70 mas 的單星誤差，因此整體精度受參考框架限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The zero-point budget combines in RSS: 2MASS reference system 0.02 mag, illumination-correction residual 0.01 mag, flat field 0.01 mag and extinction variation 0.01 mag, giving √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 mag. The per-star astrometric random error is σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/SNR: with FWHM = 0.9″ and SNR = 100 it is ≈ 0.0038″ ≈ 4 mas, far below the roughly 70 mas per-star error of the 2MASS frame itself, so overall precision is limited by the reference frame. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內；天文定位則比較重疊區的位置殘差，檢查是否隨視場半徑增長，若是則更新畸變模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget; for astrometry compare position residuals in the overlap regions and check whether they grow with field radius, updating the distortion model if they do.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 零點誤差預算以 RSS 合成：2MASS 參考系統 0.02 等、照明修正殘餘 0.01 等、平場 0.01 等、消光時間變化 0.01 等，總和 √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 等。天文定位單星隨機誤差 σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/SNR：FWHM = 0.9″、SNR = 100 時 ≈ 0.0038″ ≈ 4 mas，遠小於 2MASS 參考框架本身約 70 mas 的單星誤差，因此整體精度受參考框架限制。

The per-star astrometric random error is σ ≈ (FWHM/2.355)/SNR: with FWHM = 0.9″ and SNR = 100 it is ≈ 0.0038″ ≈ 4 mas, far below the roughly 70 mas per-star error of the 2MASS frame itself, so overall precision is limited by the reference frame.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets", which statement holds?
options: 望遠鏡口徑越大，巡天速度一定越快。

鏡坯厚度 17 cm 已經夠厚，不需要主動支撐。
optionsEn: A larger aperture always means a faster survey.

A 17 cm thick blank is stiff enough to need no active support.
quiz.explanation: 零點誤差預算以 RSS 合成：2MASS 參考系統 0.02 等、照明修正殘餘 0.01 等、平場 0.01 等、消光時間變化 0.01 等，總和 √(0.02² + 0.01² + 0.01² + 0.01²) = √0.0007 ≈ 0.026 等。 重算時請保留單位。
