steps.title: 光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內；天文定位則比較重疊區的位置殘差，檢查是否隨視場半徑增長，若是則更新畸變模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget; for astrometry compare position residuals in the overlap regions and check whether they grow with field radius, updating the distortion model if they do. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries; stellar-population analysis built on it finds spurious density gradients.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內；天文定位則比較重疊區的位置殘差，檢查是否隨視場半徑增長，若是則更新畸變模型。
knowledge.textEn: Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget; for astrometry compare position residuals in the overlap regions and check whether they grow with field radius, updating the distortion model if they do.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
紅外偵測器只要夠冷，曝光越長影像越深。
把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
As long as the infrared detector is cold enough, longer exposures always go deeper.

Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget.
quiz.explanation: 把同一天區在不同夜晚、不同偵測器位置的重複觀測互相比較：星等差的分佈寬度給出隨機誤差，平均偏移給出系統誤差，兩者都應落在預算內；天文定位則比較重疊區的位置殘差，檢查是否隨視場半徑增長，若是則更新畸變模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare repeated observations of the same field on different nights and at different detector positions: the width of the magnitude-difference distribution gives the random error and the mean offset the systematic error, both of which must fall within the budget; for astrometry compare position residuals in the overlap regions and check whether they grow with field radius, updating the distortion model if they do. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「2MASS 參考星與光度校正表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “2MASS reference stars and photometric calibration table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries; stellar-population analysis built on it finds spurious density gradients. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：天文定位同樣以 2MASS 為參考框架，畸變以徑向多項式建模，殘差的統計要分別記錄為每顆星的隨機誤差與整片偵測器的系統誤差，形成可追溯的誤差預算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Astrometry uses 2MASS as the reference frame as well, distortion is modelled with a radial polynomial, and the residual statistics are logged separately as per-star random error and per-detector systematic error, forming a traceable error budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有了 2MASS 星，VISTA 的光度校正就不會有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With 2MASS stars in every frame, VISTA photometry has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries; stellar-population analysis built on it finds spurious density gradients.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光度、天文定位校正與誤差預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Photometric and astrometric calibration and error budgets" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。
optionsEn: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field.
quiz.explanation: 忽略照明修正而只用圓頂平場時，視場邊緣的零點偏差可達 0.05 等以上，巡天目錄在拼接邊界出現星等跳階；研究者若據此做星族分析，會得到假的密度梯度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring the illumination correction and using only dome flats leaves zero-point errors above 0.05 mag at the field edge, and the survey catalogue shows magnitude steps at tile boundaries; stellar-population analysis built on it finds spurious density gradients. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巡天觀測策略與資料流」與「驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline" and "Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 因為偵測器之間有約 0.9 與 0.425 片的間隙，VISTA 以 6 個互相偏移的 pawprint 拼成一個約 1.5 deg² 的連續 tile，每個天區至少被覆蓋兩次；再加上小幅抖動（jitter）去除壞像素與偵測器特徵，Ks 波段用短曝光多幀疊加避免飽和。資料先在帕拉納爾做即時品質檢查，再送到英國 CASU 與 WFAU 的 VISTA 資料流系統做校正、堆疊、目錄抽取與品質分級，公開巡天如 VVV、VHS、VIKING、UltraVISTA 都以此流程產生資料釋出。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because the detectors are separated by gaps of about 0.9 and 0.425 detector widths, VISTA combines 6 offset pawprints into one contiguous tile of about 1.5 deg², covering every point at least twice; small jitter offsets remove bad pixels and detector features, and Ks uses many short exposures stacked to avoid saturation. Data pass a real-time quality check at Paranal and then flow to the VISTA data-flow system at CASU and WFAU in the UK for calibration, stacking, catalogue extraction and quality grading; public surveys such as VVV, VHS, VIKING and UltraVISTA produce their data releases through this pipeline. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流
knowledge.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline
knowledge.text: 因為偵測器之間有約 0.9 與 0.425 片的間隙，VISTA 以 6 個互相偏移的 pawprint 拼成一個約 1.5 deg² 的連續 tile，每個天區至少被覆蓋兩次；再加上小幅抖動（jitter）去除壞像素與偵測器特徵，Ks 波段用短曝光多幀疊加避免飽和。資料先在帕拉納爾做即時品質檢查，再送到英國 CASU 與 WFAU 的 VISTA 資料流系統做校正、堆疊、目錄抽取與品質分級，公開巡天如 VVV、VHS、VIKING、UltraVISTA 都以此流程產生資料釋出。
knowledge.textEn: Because the detectors are separated by gaps of about 0.9 and 0.425 detector widths, VISTA combines 6 offset pawprints into one contiguous tile of about 1.5 deg², covering every point at least twice; small jitter offsets remove bad pixels and detector features, and Ks uses many short exposures stacked to avoid saturation. Data pass a real-time quality check at Paranal and then flow to the VISTA data-flow system at CASU and WFAU in the UK for calibration, stacking, catalogue extraction and quality grading; public surveys such as VVV, VHS, VIKING and UltraVISTA produce their data releases through this pipeline.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「巡天觀測策略與資料流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline" is correct?
options: 一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。
因為偵測器之間有約 0.9 與 0.425 片的間隙，VISTA 以 6 個互相偏移的 pawprint 拼成一個約 1.5 deg² 的連續 tile，每個天區至少被覆蓋兩次。
望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。
optionsEn: One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field.
Because the detectors are separated by gaps of about 0.9 and 0.425 detector widths, VISTA combines 6 offset pawprints into one contiguous tile of about 1.5 deg², covering every point at least twice.
Once a telescope is accepted, swapping instruments needs no re-verification.
quiz.explanation: 因為偵測器之間有約 0.9 與 0.425 片的間隙，VISTA 以 6 個互相偏移的 pawprint 拼成一個約 1.5 deg² 的連續 tile，每個天區至少被覆蓋兩次；再加上小幅抖動（jitter）去除壞像素與偵測器特徵，Ks 波段用短曝光多幀疊加避免飽和。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Because the detectors are separated by gaps of about 0.9 and 0.425 detector widths, VISTA combines 6 offset pawprints into one contiguous tile of about 1.5 deg², covering every point at least twice; small jitter offsets remove bad pixels and detector features, and Ks uses many short exposures stacked to avoid saturation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。資料量：每幀 16×2048²×2 位元組 ≈ 134 MB；以 12 s 的節奏（10 s 曝光加讀出）在 10 小時夜晚取得約 3000 幀，原始資料約 400 GB，因此需要專用的網路與歸檔。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average. Data volume: each frame is 16×2048²×2 bytes ≈ 134 MB; at a 12 s cadence (10 s exposure plus readout) a 10 hour night yields about 3000 frames and roughly 400 GB of raw data, which demands dedicated networking and archiving. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿；統計每夜的原始資料量與傳輸延遲，確認歸檔在隔日完成；並抽樣比對 pipeline 輸出目錄與獨立測光結果，檢查堆疊與目錄抽取沒有引入偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps; record the nightly raw data volume and transfer latency to confirm archiving completes by the next day; and spot-check the pipeline catalogue against independent photometry to make sure stacking and extraction introduce no bias.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。資料量：每幀 16×2048²×2 位元組 ≈ 134 MB；以 12 s 的節奏（10 s 曝光加讀出）在 10 小時夜晚取得約 3000 幀，原始資料約 400 GB，因此需要專用的網路與歸檔。
knowledge.textEn: A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average. Data volume: each frame is 16×2048²×2 bytes ≈ 134 MB; at a 12 s cadence (10 s exposure plus readout) a 10 hour night yields about 3000 frames and roughly 400 GB of raw data, which demands dedicated networking and archiving.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「巡天觀測策略與資料流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline", which statement holds?
options: 焦比快只是讓曝光更短，對機械與熱設計沒有影響。
紅外偵測器只要夠冷，曝光越長影像越深。
一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。
optionsEn: A fast focal ratio only shortens exposures and has no mechanical or thermal consequences.
As long as the infrared detector is cold enough, longer exposures always go deeper.
A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average.
quiz.explanation: 一個 tile 由 6 個 pawprint 組成：曝光覆蓋總面積 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg²，tile 面積 1.5 deg²，平均每點被覆蓋 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A tile is built from 6 pawprints: the total exposed area is 6×0.60 = 3.6 deg² over a 1.5 deg² tile, so each point is covered 3.6/1.5 = 2.4 times on average. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿；統計每夜的原始資料量與傳輸延遲，確認歸檔在隔日完成；並抽樣比對 pipeline 輸出目錄與獨立測光結果，檢查堆疊與目錄抽取沒有引入偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps; record the nightly raw data volume and transfer latency to confirm archiving completes by the next day; and spot-check the pipeline catalogue against independent photometry to make sure stacking and extraction introduce no bias. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若 6 個 pawprint 的偏移量輸入錯誤 10%，tile 中出現未覆蓋的條狀間隙，而且某些區域只有單次覆蓋無法去除壞像素；問題往往在資料釋出前的覆蓋檢查才被發現，該天區必須整個重拍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the 6 pawprint offsets are entered 10% wrong, uncovered strips appear in the tile and some areas receive only single coverage so bad pixels cannot be rejected; the problem is often found only at the coverage check before data release, and the whole field must be re-observed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿；統計每夜的原始資料量與傳輸延遲，確認歸檔在隔日完成；並抽樣比對 pipeline 輸出目錄與獨立測光結果，檢查堆疊與目錄抽取沒有引入偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps; record the nightly raw data volume and transfer latency to confirm archiving completes by the next day; and spot-check the pipeline catalogue against independent photometry to make sure stacking and extraction introduce no bias.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「巡天觀測策略與資料流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline"?
options: 對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
副鏡對準只需要在白天用雷射做一次。
optionsEn: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Secondary alignment only needs to be done once by day with a laser.
quiz.explanation: 對一個完成的 tile 畫覆蓋次數地圖，確認最少 2 次、平均約 2.4 次且間隙全部補滿；統計每夜的原始資料量與傳輸延遲，確認歸檔在隔日完成；並抽樣比對 pipeline 輸出目錄與獨立測光結果，檢查堆疊與目錄抽取沒有引入偏差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot a coverage-count map for a completed tile, confirming a minimum of 2, an average near 2.4 and no remaining gaps; record the nightly raw data volume and transfer latency to confirm archiving completes by the next day; and spot-check the pipeline catalogue against independent photometry to make sure stacking and extraction introduce no bias. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 巡天觀測策略與資料流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Pawprint 拼貼與巡天資料流」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pawprint tiling and survey data flow” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若 6 個 pawprint 的偏移量輸入錯誤 10%，tile 中出現未覆蓋的條狀間隙，而且某些區域只有單次覆蓋無法去除壞像素；問題往往在資料釋出前的覆蓋檢查才被發現，該天區必須整個重拍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the 6 pawprint offsets are entered 10% wrong, uncovered strips appear in the tile and some areas receive only single coverage so bad pixels cannot be rejected; the problem is often found only at the coverage check before data release, and the whole field must be re-observed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：資料先在帕拉納爾做即時品質檢查，再送到英國 CASU 與 WFAU 的 VISTA 資料流系統做校正、堆疊、目錄抽取與品質分級，公開巡天如 VVV、VHS、VIKING、UltraVISTA 都以此流程產生資料釋出。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Data pass a real-time quality check at Paranal and then flow to the VISTA data-flow system at CASU and WFAU in the UK for calibration, stacking, catalogue extraction and quality grading; public surveys such as VVV, VHS, VIKING and UltraVISTA produce their data releases through this pipeline.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次曝光就能拍滿整個 1.65° 視場。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One exposure fills the whole 1.65° field." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若 6 個 pawprint 的偏移量輸入錯誤 10%，tile 中出現未覆蓋的條狀間隙，而且某些區域只有單次覆蓋無法去除壞像素；問題往往在資料釋出前的覆蓋檢查才被發現，該天區必須整個重拍。
knowledge.textEn: If the 6 pawprint offsets are entered 10% wrong, uncovered strips appear in the tile and some areas receive only single coverage so bad pixels cannot be rejected; the problem is often found only at the coverage check before data release, and the whole field must be re-observed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「巡天觀測策略與資料流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Survey observing strategy and the data pipeline" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若 6 個 pawprint 的偏移量輸入錯誤 10%，tile 中出現未覆蓋的條狀間隙，而且某些區域只有單次覆蓋無法去除壞像素。
望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
If the 6 pawprint offsets are entered 10% wrong, uncovered strips appear in the tile and some areas receive only single coverage so bad pixels cannot be rejected.
Once a telescope is accepted, swapping instruments needs no re-verification.
quiz.explanation: 若 6 個 pawprint 的偏移量輸入錯誤 10%，tile 中出現未覆蓋的條狀間隙，而且某些區域只有單次覆蓋無法去除壞像素；問題往往在資料釋出前的覆蓋檢查才被發現，該天區必須整個重拍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the 6 pawprint offsets are entered 10% wrong, uncovered strips appear in the tile and some areas receive only single coverage so bad pixels cannot be rejected; the problem is often found only at the coverage check before data release, and the whole field must be re-observed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」如何決定VISTA 紅外巡天望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover” determines the key performance of “VISTA infrared survey telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: VISTA 由英國大學聯盟以實物貢獻方式建造，2009 年 12 月通過 ESO 臨時驗收並取得首光；驗收不只看單張影像，而是把量得的星像 FWHM 扣除當時的大氣視寧度後反推望遠鏡加相機的貢獻，並與設計的 50% 能量集中直徑等指標比對。VIRCAM 於 2023 年退役，卡塞格林焦點改裝 4MOST 多目標光纖光譜儀，這次換裝再度要求重做焦面幾何、波前感測與指向的全套驗證並更新交接文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: VISTA was built by a UK university consortium as an in-kind contribution and passed ESO's provisional acceptance in December 2009, when it saw first light; acceptance did not rely on single images but on subtracting the atmospheric seeing of the moment from the measured stellar FWHM to back out the telescope-plus-camera contribution and comparing it with design metrics such as the 50% encircled-energy diameter. VIRCAM was decommissioned in 2023 and the Cassegrain focus was refitted with the 4MOST multi-object fibre spectrograph, a changeover that again demanded the full verification set for focal-plane geometry, wavefront sensing and pointing, with updated handover documents. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Seeing scales with wavelength as λ^(−1/5): a 0.75″ DIMM seeing at 500 nm becomes 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″ in Ks (2.15 µm).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a telescope is accepted, swapping instruments needs no re-verification." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝
knowledge.titleEn: Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover
knowledge.text: VISTA 由英國大學聯盟以實物貢獻方式建造，2009 年 12 月通過 ESO 臨時驗收並取得首光；驗收不只看單張影像，而是把量得的星像 FWHM 扣除當時的大氣視寧度後反推望遠鏡加相機的貢獻，並與設計的 50% 能量集中直徑等指標比對。VIRCAM 於 2023 年退役，卡塞格林焦點改裝 4MOST 多目標光纖光譜儀，這次換裝再度要求重做焦面幾何、波前感測與指向的全套驗證並更新交接文件。
knowledge.textEn: VISTA was built by a UK university consortium as an in-kind contribution and passed ESO's provisional acceptance in December 2009, when it saw first light; acceptance did not rely on single images but on subtracting the atmospheric seeing of the moment from the measured stellar FWHM to back out the telescope-plus-camera contribution and comparing it with design metrics such as the 50% encircled-energy diameter. VIRCAM was decommissioned in 2023 and the Cassegrain focus was refitted with the 4MOST multi-object fibre spectrograph, a changeover that again demanded the full verification set for focal-plane geometry, wavefront sensing and pointing, with updated handover documents.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a telescope is accepted, swapping instruments needs no re-verification. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover" is correct?
options: 望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。
望遠鏡口徑越大，巡天速度一定越快。
VISTA 由英國大學聯盟以實物貢獻方式建造，2009 年 12 月通過 ESO 臨時驗收並取得首光。
optionsEn: Once a telescope is accepted, swapping instruments needs no re-verification.
A larger aperture always means a faster survey.
VISTA was built by a UK university consortium as an in-kind contribution and passed ESO's provisional acceptance in December 2009, when it saw first light.
quiz.explanation: VISTA 由英國大學聯盟以實物貢獻方式建造，2009 年 12 月通過 ESO 臨時驗收並取得首光；驗收不只看單張影像，而是把量得的星像 FWHM 扣除當時的大氣視寧度後反推望遠鏡加相機的貢獻，並與設計的 50% 能量集中直徑等指標比對。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: VISTA was built by a UK university consortium as an in-kind contribution and passed ESO's provisional acceptance in December 2009, when it saw first light; acceptance did not rely on single images but on subtracting the atmospheric seeing of the moment from the measured stellar FWHM to back out the telescope-plus-camera contribution and comparing it with design metrics such as the 50% encircled-energy diameter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：視寧度隨波長按 λ^(−1/5) 變化：500 nm 的 DIMM 視寧度 0.75″ 換算到 Ks（2.15 µm）為 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″。若 Ks 影像量到 FWHM 0.90″，以 5/3 次方相減得望遠鏡加相機項 = (0.90^(5/3) − 0.56^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.839 − 0.380)^(0.6) ≈ 0.63″，高於例如 0.45″ 的分配值，表示須檢查對焦、準直或追蹤而非歸咎天氣。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Seeing scales with wavelength as λ^(−1/5): a 0.75″ DIMM seeing at 500 nm becomes 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″ in Ks (2.15 µm). If the Ks images show FWHM 0.90″, subtracting in 5/3 power gives a telescope-plus-camera term of (0.90^(5/3) − 0.56^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.839 − 0.380)^(0.6) ≈ 0.63″, above an allocation of, say, 0.45″, which means focus, collimation or tracking must be checked rather than blaming the weather. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收夜以同步的 DIMM 紀錄與各偵測器的星像 FWHM 建立表格，逐偵測器反推望遠鏡項並檢查是否在視場內均勻；將指向模型殘差、波前感測器零點、六足平台校正與氣動支撐力表一併歸檔，換裝 4MOST 後重做同一套量測並與舊紀錄比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On acceptance nights tabulate synchronous DIMM records against stellar FWHM on every detector, back out the telescope term detector by detector and check uniformity across the field; archive the pointing-model residuals, wavefront-sensor zero points, hexapod calibration and pneumatic force table together, and after the 4MOST changeover repeat the same measurements and compare with the old record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Seeing scales with wavelength as λ^(−1/5): a 0.75″ DIMM seeing at 500 nm becomes 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″ in Ks (2.15 µm). If the Ks images show FWHM 0.90″, subtracting in 5/3 power gives a telescope-plus-camera term of (0.90^(5/3) − 0.56^(5/3))^(3/5) = (0.839 − 0.380)^(0.6) ≈ 0.63″, above an allocation of, say, 0.45″, which means focus, collimation or tracking must be checked rather than blaming the weather.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover", which statement holds?
options: 鏡坯厚度 17 cm 已經夠厚，不需要主動支撐。
副鏡對準只需要在白天用雷射做一次。
optionsEn: Seeing scales with wavelength as λ^(−1/5): a 0.75″ DIMM seeing at 500 nm becomes 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″ in Ks (2.15 µm).
A 17 cm thick blank is stiff enough to need no active support.
Secondary alignment only needs to be done once by day with a laser.
quiz.explanation: 視寧度隨波長按 λ^(−1/5) 變化：500 nm 的 DIMM 視寧度 0.75″ 換算到 Ks（2.15 µm）為 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Seeing scales with wavelength as λ^(−1/5): a 0.75″ DIMM seeing at 500 nm becomes 0.75×(2.15/0.5)^(−0.2) ≈ 0.56″ in Ks (2.15 µm). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收夜以同步的 DIMM 紀錄與各偵測器的星像 FWHM 建立表格，逐偵測器反推望遠鏡項並檢查是否在視場內均勻；將指向模型殘差、波前感測器零點、六足平台校正與氣動支撐力表一併歸檔，換裝 4MOST 後重做同一套量測並與舊紀錄比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On acceptance nights tabulate synchronous DIMM records against stellar FWHM on every detector, back out the telescope term detector by detector and check uniformity across the field; archive the pointing-model residuals, wavefront-sensor zero points, hexapod calibration and pneumatic force table together, and after the 4MOST changeover repeat the same measurements and compare with the old record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：換裝新儀器時若沿用舊相機的波前感測器零點，閉環把副鏡對準到錯誤的位置，整個視場帶著固定的彗差，而操作團隊誤以為是新儀器的光學問題，調試時間拖長數週。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Reusing the old camera's wavefront-sensor zero points after installing a new instrument makes the closed loop align the secondary to the wrong position, the whole field carries a fixed coma, and the operations team blames the new instrument's optics while commissioning drags on for weeks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收夜以同步的 DIMM 紀錄與各偵測器的星像 FWHM 建立表格，逐偵測器反推望遠鏡項並檢查是否在視場內均勻；將指向模型殘差、波前感測器零點、六足平台校正與氣動支撐力表一併歸檔，換裝 4MOST 後重做同一套量測並與舊紀錄比對。
knowledge.textEn: On acceptance nights tabulate synchronous DIMM records against stellar FWHM on every detector, back out the telescope term detector by detector and check uniformity across the field; archive the pointing-model residuals, wavefront-sensor zero points, hexapod calibration and pneumatic force table together, and after the 4MOST changeover repeat the same measurements and compare with the old record.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
驗收夜以同步的 DIMM 紀錄與各偵測器的星像 FWHM 建立表格，逐偵測器反推望遠鏡項並檢查是否在視場內均勻。
有了 2MASS 星，VISTA 的光度校正就不會有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
On acceptance nights tabulate synchronous DIMM records against stellar FWHM on every detector, back out the telescope term detector by detector and check uniformity across the field.
With 2MASS stars in every frame, VISTA photometry has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 驗收夜以同步的 DIMM 紀錄與各偵測器的星像 FWHM 建立表格，逐偵測器反推望遠鏡項並檢查是否在視場內均勻；將指向模型殘差、波前感測器零點、六足平台校正與氣動支撐力表一併歸檔，換裝 4MOST 後重做同一套量測並與舊紀錄比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On acceptance nights tabulate synchronous DIMM records against stellar FWHM on every detector, back out the telescope term detector by detector and check uniformity across the field; archive the pointing-model residuals, wavefront-sensor zero points, hexapod calibration and pneumatic force table together, and after the 4MOST changeover repeat the same measurements and compare with the old record. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收影像品質與卡塞格林儀器交接」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Accepted image quality and Cassegrain instrument handover” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 換裝新儀器時若沿用舊相機的波前感測器零點，閉環把副鏡對準到錯誤的位置，整個視場帶著固定的彗差，而操作團隊誤以為是新儀器的光學問題，調試時間拖長數週。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing the old camera's wavefront-sensor zero points after installing a new instrument makes the closed loop align the secondary to the wrong position, the whole field carries a fixed coma, and the operations team blames the new instrument's optics while commissioning drags on for weeks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：VIRCAM 於 2023 年退役，卡塞格林焦點改裝 4MOST 多目標光纖光譜儀，這次換裝再度要求重做焦面幾何、波前感測與指向的全套驗證並更新交接文件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: VIRCAM was decommissioned in 2023 and the Cassegrain focus was refitted with the 4MOST multi-object fibre spectrograph, a changeover that again demanded the full verification set for focal-plane geometry, wavefront sensing and pointing, with updated handover documents.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「望遠鏡驗收過一次，換儀器後就不必重新驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a telescope is accepted, swapping instruments needs no re-verification." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 換裝新儀器時若沿用舊相機的波前感測器零點，閉環把副鏡對準到錯誤的位置，整個視場帶著固定的彗差，而操作團隊誤以為是新儀器的光學問題，調試時間拖長數週。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing the old camera's wavefront-sensor zero points after installing a new instrument makes the closed loop align the secondary to the wrong position, the whole field carries a fixed coma, and the operations team blames the new instrument's optics while commissioning drags on for weeks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「驗收、營運移交與 4MOST 換裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Acceptance, operational handover and the 4MOST changeover" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
望遠鏡口徑越大，巡天速度一定越快。
換裝新儀器時若沿用舊相機的波前感測器零點，閉環把副鏡對準到錯誤的位置，整個視場帶著固定的彗差，而操作團隊誤以為是新儀器的光學問題，調試時間拖長數週。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A larger aperture always means a faster survey.

Reusing the old camera's wavefront-sensor zero points after installing a new instrument makes the closed loop align the secondary to the wrong position, the whole field carries a fixed coma, and the operations team blames the new instrument's optics while commissioning drags on for weeks.

quiz.explanationEn: Reusing the old camera's wavefront-sensor zero points after installing a new instrument makes the closed loop align the secondary to the wrong position, the whole field carries a fixed coma, and the operations team blames the new instrument's optics while commissioning drags on for weeks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
